fields.description: Grants Isaac's familiars homing shots.

Backstabber.title: Backstabber
Backstabber.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When Isaac's attacks land on the "back" of enemies, they deal double damage and inflict bleeding.

• [Before Repentance] Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot be inflicted with bleeding, but will still take the extra damage.

• [Repentance] Enemies bleed for 5 seconds, bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.

• The extra damage is dealt even if the enemy is already bleeding.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The damage is dealt as 2 separate hits, as opposed to one double damage hit.

• What is considered to be the "back" of an enemy is based solely on their velocity when the attacks land: their back is opposite to their movement direction.

• High knockback makes it easier to get follow-up backstabs as the enemies are pushed away from the tears.

• Pushing enemies while shooting makes them easy to backstab, though is mostly viable only on ones that don't deal contact damage or while having a shield.

• Completely stationary enemies generally have their back on their upper and right sides, but knockback considerations apply.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Dark Arts: Freezing an enemy from its back using Dark Arts will apply bleeding, though there is no extra direct damage.

• Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Ipecac: These explosives can backstab but deal only 3.5 bonus damage instead of double damage.

• [Before Repentance] Shooting familiars: Tears fired by familiars can inflict the effects of Backstabber.

• The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico tear will nearly always backstab when over an enemy.

• Trisagion: The Trisagion blasts' shape and size make them almost guaranteed to backstab.

• Worm Trinkets, like Hook Worm and Wiggle Worm make Backstabber's effect possible even if the enemy is facing Isaac.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Akeldama: Akeldama tears cannot backstab.

• Bag of Crafting: The melee swing cannot backstab.

• Bombs: Unlike Dr. Fetus bombs, normal bombs cannot backstab.

• Breath of Life: Neither normal contact beams or the perfectly timed ones cannot backstab.

• Divine Intervention: The shield cannot backstab.

• Hemoptysis/Tainted Azazel: The sneeze cannot backstab.

• Lost Cork: No effect on enemy blood creep.

• Salvation: The beams cannot backstab.

• Spear Of Destiny: The spear cannot backstab.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the backstabbing mechanic in various video games, where backstabbing results in more damage done to the target. However, the mechanic of backstabbing is usually applied to melee weapons, not ranged weapons.

• It may also be a reference to Judas' betrayal of Jesus.

• Backstabber was originally an unofficial item which was supposed to showcase the modding capabilities of Afterbirth+ in the PAX 2016 livestream. However, all items included in the demo were later added to the final game.

fields.description: Isaac's tears deal double damage and inflict bleeding on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.

Bag Lunch.title: Bag Lunch
Bag Lunch.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the trinket; the item; Lunch]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Taking damage has a [Before Repentance+] 2% / [Repentance+] 5% chance to destroy the trinket and spawn Lunch.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Adds +5% chance to destroy the trinket upon taking damage per copy.

• Bag Lunch: Two copies cannot be held at the same time.

fields.description: Taking damage has a small chance to destroy the trinket and spawn Lunch.

Bag of Crafting.title: Bag of Crafting
Bag of Crafting.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.

• The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size.

• The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his range is.

• The swipe can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.

• The swipe can be used to block bullets.

• The swipe can be aimed at any direction.

• Swiping a pickup on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.

• Double pickups like Double Hearts will add two copies to the bag. Blended Hearts will add one red heart and one soul heart.

• Sticky Nickels can't be picked up unless unstuck.

• Chests and Grab Bag can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles.

• If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a Shop, using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag.

• Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.

• If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead.

• There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome.

As Tainted Cain:

• If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.

• Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.

• Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would.

• [cu: Blind] hides the crafting preview.

Item Tags:

The Bag of Crafting respects item tags, and which items are available during the current run. This includes the following:

• As The Lost, Birthright prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.

• As Tainted Lost, items without the offensive item tag will not appear.

• As Keeper, items with the nokeeper item tag will not appear.

• In [mode: greed; greedier] Greed Mode or Greedier Mode, items with the nogreed item tag will not appear.

• In Daily Challenges, items with the nodaily item tag will not appear.

• In Challenge, items with the nochallenge item tag will not appear.

• If NO! is held, active items will be skipped.

• If Sacred Orb is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

sections.heading: Component Types and Qualities
sections.text:
The cumulative quality of the components impacts the quality of the item received. The pickups belonging to each component type and their qualities are listed as below. The item received can be from the Treasure Room item pool (1× chance), Shop item pool (2× chance), Boss Room item pool (2× chance), or one of the pools listed in the table below. The pools in the table below require at least 1 of the corresponding component. For example, Devil Room items require at least 1 Black Heart.

If the recipe chooses an item from Devil, Angel, or Secret Room pools, the total component quality is lowered by 5 before the resulting item quality, and consequently the resulting item, is determined.

| Component | Pickups | Quality | Notes 
| | Poop Nugget | 0 | Adds a chance of getting a Shell Game item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Penny | 1 |

| | Red Heart (full, half, or scared) | 1 |

| | Rotten Heart | 1 | Adds a chance of getting a Curse Room item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Bomb | 2 |

| | Card | 2 |

| | Cracked Key | 2 | Adds a chance of getting a Red Chest item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Key | 2 |

| | Nickel (regular and sticky) | 3 |

| | Dice Shard | 4 |

| | Lil' Battery | 4 |

| | Rune (includes Soul Stones) | 4 | Adds chance of getting a Planetarium item if the bag doesn't contain a Penny, Bomb, Key, or Red Heart. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Soul Heart (full or half) | 4 |

| | Black Heart | 5 | Adds a chance of getting a Devil Room item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Bone Heart | 5 | Adds a chance of getting a Secret Room item. The chance increases by 5× per component.

| | Charged Key | 5 |

| | Dime | 5 |

| | Eternal Heart | 5 | Adds a chance of getting an Angel Room item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

| | Gold Heart | 5 | Adds a chance of getting a Golden Chest item. The chance increases by 10× per component.

• 'Special Pools' are defined for this chart as Angel Room, Devil Room, and Secret Room item pools.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Abyss / Void: Can be used in conjunction with Bag of Crafting to gain a large amount of locusts/stat boosts.

• Serpent's Kiss: Due to the high amount of Black Hearts generated by the item, they can be utilized to either craft a high amount of Devil Room items, or a ludicrous amount of Brimstone, due to its recipe always consisting of eight Black Hearts.

• Book of Belial interaction: Collecting Red Hearts, Half Red Hearts, or Double Hearts with this item has a chance to transform them into Black Hearts. When a heart is transformed in this way, a special sound plays and a black smoke puff appears. Does not work with Scared Hearts.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a random wisp when an item is crafted.

• Pay to Win / XX - Judgement?: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not Tainted Cain as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the Treasure Room which can be rerolled repeatedly using the generated Shop Restock Machine.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Butter!: Bag of Crafting is dropped before pickups can be collected or items crafted.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• The Ludovico Technique: Swiping the bag at the Ludovico tear will bat it in the direction of the knockback.

• Sacred Orb: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

• Tainted Eden: If the Tainted Eden loses Bag of Crafting from a reroll while it contains pickups, then rerolls back into it at a later point, it will still contain the pickups.

• Wild Card: Holding up Bag of Crafting counts as an active item use for Wild Card, and can be replicated.

• ? Card: Does NOT give a free duplicate of whatever the full bag would create.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• There are \left(\!\!\binom{29}{8}\!\!\right) = \binom{29+8-1}{8} = 30,260,340, or about 30.3 million, combinations of pickups and consumables that can be used in the Bag of Crafting. The item chosen is based on a formula mapping the chosen consumables, item weights, and quality values into a single outcome. On average, about 1/4th of all items will represent over 1/2 of all recipes.

• The average consumable value is ~4.31.

• Bag of Crafting's item description hints to The D6's item description as well as Tainted Cain's description, implying that "Destiny" is the items that will appear in a given seed.

• Bag of Crafting used to have the "nochallenge" and "nodaily" tag instead of the "offensive" tag. The resulting changes now allow it to be encountered on challenges, daily challenges, and by Tainted Lost.

• It is possible, with the crafting of 4x R Keys, to get every Completion Mark for a character in a single run, except the ones for Greed Mode.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: While being controlled by mouse, having both The Ludovico Technique + Pop! will mess up the direction control of Bag of Crafting.
Bug note: In the Cantripped!, using a Bag of Crafting will crash the game.
Bug note: If the Bag of Crafting is used but not swung (i.e., is being held overhead) while returning from the Mirrored world, Isaac will not go back to normal, and will still have the properties of The Lost (flying, Holy Mantle effect) when returning. This effect persists across floors, but Isaac will turn back after some time.

fields.description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.

Ball and Chain.title: Ball and Chain
Ball and Chain.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ball and Chain are an indestructible enemy that rotate at various speeds around an obstacle which they are attached to with chains of varying lengths. Touching the chain does not harm Isaac. They can destroy rocks and other obstacles they come into contact with.

If the anchor obstacle is destroyed, the ball will be launched across the room at its current velocity, eventually coming to a stop. When the room is re-entered, the ball will be at rest where the anchor obstacle used to be. A detached ball can be pushed by touch, tears and explosions.

[Repentance+] The Ball and Chain and all of its variations are destroyed by Hagalaz.

sections.heading: Spikeball
sections.text:
Spikeballs fly back and forth in a line either horizontally or vertically, bouncing off walls and obstacles. They will be destroyed once the room is cleared. However, if the room doesn't need clearing, they will remain permanently.

Spikeballs will be destroyed immediately upon entering a room while holding the Flat File.

sections.heading: Singe's Ball
sections.text: Singe's Balls are movable Spikeballs spawned during the Singe boss fight. They will not move on their own, but can be pushed via touch, tears, and explosions — particularly Singe's. They deal half a heart of contact damage and are destroyed upon Singe's defeat.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Spikeball first appeared in the Antibirth mod where it behaved similarly; however, it would not be destroyed and would continue moving after the room was cleared.

Ball of Bandages.title: Ball of Bandages
Ball of Bandages.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns an orbital familiar that deals [edition alternatives: baseline: 105; Repentance: 52.5] contact damage per second.

• [Rebirth only] Unlike the Cube of Meat, it does not block enemy shots.

• [Afterbirth onward] Ball of Bandages blocks enemy shots.

• Each subsequent Ball of Bandages obtained are combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics:

• Level 2: Gives the orbital the ability to shoot Charm tears once every [edition alternatives: baseline: second; Repentance: 0.73 seconds] , with each tear dealing 3.5 damage.

• Level 3: Changes it from an orbital to a Bandage Girl that that chases nearby enemies dealing [edition alternatives: baseline: 52.5; Afterbirth+ before Repentance: 8.75; Repentance: 12.5] contact damage per second and fires Charm tears in the direction Isaac shoots. The tears it fires are the same as the ones fired by the Level 2 form.

• Level 4: Increases the size of the Bandage Girl and increases its contact damage to [edition alternatives: baseline: 82.5; Afterbirth+ before Repentance: 13.75; Repentance: 25] per second. Enemies killed by a level 4 Bandage Girl's tears have a chance to drop full Red Hearts.

• The fifth Ball of Bandages will create a new Level 1 ball, and start the cycle again.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Multiple Balls of Bandages can be collected in a single run.

• [Repentance] The orbital orbits Isaac significantly faster, making it more effective at blocking shots but less effective for dealing damage.

• Famine, Pestilence, War, and Death will always drop either a Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat. After the first one drops, further Harbingers will only drop that same one and never the other for the duration of the run.

• The ticking rate for Bandage Girls' contact damage causes them to often deal damage twice once they touch an enemy, making their first second of DPS up to 1.5x higher than normal.

• Level 3 and 4 Bandage Girls' tears inherit Isaac's momentum.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Revelations: Ensures that Harbingers that haven't already been defeated will replace their respective floor's boss, making it drastically easier to collect multiple Balls of Bandages.

• Box of Friends / Monster Manual: Additional copies of Ball of Bandages combine with the first, increasing its level as normal.

• [Repentance+] Potato Peeler: Spawns a Ball of Bandages instead of a Cube of Meat. If Isaac already has a Cube of Meat, that is still spawned. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Duct Tape: Familiar will stay in place relative to Isaac at levels 1 and 2. No effect at levels 3 and 4.

• Pretty Fly: Ball of Bandages will replace one if Isaac already has 3 Pretty Flies. If the Ball of Bandages reaches level 3 or 4, the Pretty Fly will come back when a familiar is obtained, until another Ball of Bandages orbital is obtained.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: A Bandage]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bandage Girl is a secondary character in Super Meat Boy, a game by Edmund McMillen, the creator of The Binding of Isaac.

• Ball of Bandages' item description, "Gotta Lick 'em All!", could be a reference to the "Gotta Catch 'em All!" advertising slogan used in Pokémon media.

fields.description: Creates an orbital familiar. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot Charm tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.

Ball of Tar.title: Ball of Tar
Ball of Tar.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectiles they fire.

• Isaac leaves a trail of slowing Black creep.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire slowing tears depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5 \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Second Hand: The creep generated by Ball of Tar will disable the slowing effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item's costume has the appearance of Gish, the titular main character of one of Edmund McMillen's earlier games and a boss in Rebirth.

• [Repentance] ???'s costume has the appearance of Ash, the main character of The End is Nigh, Edmund McMillen's 2017 platformer game.

fields.description: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears. Isaac leaves a trail of slowing creep behind as he moves, impeding enemies' speed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Beelzebub, also known by "Lord of the Flies" and many other names, is known as one of the 7 princes of hell. Beelzebub is also another name for the devil.

• In modern Catholic tradition, Beelzebub is regarded as one of the 7 princes of Hell; however, the origins of the name Beelzebub actually dates back to an early Jewish insult for worshippers of a Canaanite Deity Ba'al 'Lord', or Ba'al-Zvul 'Lord of the manor/dwelling', calling him Ba'al-Zvuv, 'Lord of the flies'.

• The achievement 'Lord of the Flies' is a reference to this.

Belly Jelly.title: Belly Jelly
Belly Jelly.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.

• If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.

• When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.

• Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The damage enemies receive when they get bounced into a wall or an obstacle is equal to 8 + 2 * floor.

• The same damage value applies when an enemy gets bounced into by another enemy.

• Enemies that don't deal contact damage cannot be bounced off.

• Since contact damage is applied rapidly, it is possible to end up taking damage and then immediately bouncing the enemy off.

• Bounced off projectiles deal a flat damage that doesn't scale with the current floor or Isaac's stats. This damage is usually 6, but can slightly vary depending on the enemy that shot the projectile.

• Lasers cannot be bounced off.

• The bouncing effect also works against Fire Places and spiked enemies such as Poky, Slide, and Grudge, granting a chance to avoid unintentional damage.

• Isaac can also bounce off Fly Bombs spawned by Blasters and even deny damage from their explosion.

• Bombs and Troll Bombs cannot be bounced off.

• Belly Jelly can prevent damage from Bad Trip pills.

• Belly Jelly can prevent Tainted Jacob from being turned into his Lost form by Dark Esau.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Aries: Retains the chance to bounce enemies while preventing damage simultaneously.

• Book of Shadows / Unicorn Stump: Can be used as a powerful offensive item since Isaac can still bounce off enemies while invincible.

• Cone Head / Hallowed Ground / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate / Star of Bethlehem: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.

• Gnawed Leaf: The bouncing effect works while Isaac is invincible.

• Serpent's Kiss: Allows Isaac to bounce enemies and poison them at the same time, with a decent chance to get a lot more health back in the form of Black Hearts than originally spent.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Panic Button: The active item will still be activated if Belly Jelly blocks damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item can be considered a direct upgrade to Infamy, as the chances to deny projectile damage are equal, but Belly Jelly additionally works with contact damage, unlike Infamy.

• Belly Jelly is just the brand of jelly beans Jelly Belly®, but the words are flipped. Given the game's theme, this also might be a reference to the jelly spread on the belly before an ultrasound.

• The costume given by this item is identical to Bucket of Lard and Binge Eater.

fields.description: Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.

Berkano.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns 6 Blue Flies and 6 Blue Spiders.

• Fish Tail: Doubles the flies and spiders spawned.

• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Increases the locusts' size and damage by 25%.

• These two items don't stack.

• Extension Cord: Electricity will flow between Isaac and the locusts.

• Ipecac: Locusts gain a flat +2 damage.

• Sacrificial Altar: Locust summoned for the room can be sacrificed as regular Abyss locust, allowing to use the item even if no familiars have been yet obtained.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

[Before Repentance+] Spawns 3 Blue Flies and 3 Blue Spiders.
[Repentance+] Gives Isaac 3 standard Abyss locusts for the room.

Berserk!.title: Berserk!
Berserk!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:

• +0.4 speed.

• +3 flat damage .

• Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to The Forgotten's bone club.

• • The jaw bone deals 3× Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5× Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3× Isaac's damage per second).

• • The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.

• • 
• Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

• • The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.

• • The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open chests.

• • A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as IV Bag or Blood Donation Machine.

• While Berserking, Isaac's fire rate is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.

• • If playing as The Forgotten, the ×0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.

• Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.

• Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.

• Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.

• Isaac is unable to die while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 hearts, but will not die until the effect ends.

• • This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as Damocles and Plan C) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.

• This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The jaw bone has all the same synergies that The Forgotten's bone club does.

• Mom's Knife: This version of the attack doesn't deflect projectiles.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a pale wisp on the middle ring. The wisp has extra HP and does not shoot.

• C Section: Replaces club throw with two swings in quick succession which fire a fetus. All fetuses fired will hold bone clubs, similar to the interaction with The Forgotten.

• Scapular: If the fatal damage occurs during Berserk state, Scapular will trigger and grant the Soul Heart.

• Suplex!: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a Mama Mega! style explosion, destroying all obstacles in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage.

• The Lost / Tainted Lost: This can allow either variant of The Lost to survive being damaged if it happens while Berserk is active. Despite having no visible health bar, their health is normally set to a Half Soul Heart. If they take damage while Berserk is active, they will not die if they are able to pick up a Soul Heart or half soul heart before the effect ends. Black Hearts do not count for this.

• The Ludovico Technique: While under the Berserk state, you lose control of the Ludovico Technique tear, which can now be deflected by the jaw bone swing, bouncing off nearby walls and dealing damage to enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt / 9 Volt / Jumper Cables: No effect.

• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.

• Car Battery: Duration is only extended if no enemies are killed during the first half, thus only providing a benefit against bosses that can't spawn enemies.

• E. Coli / Flush!: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.

• Freeze Effects: Killing enemies by freezing them will not extend the timer, which can make it difficult to maintain the duration.

• [Repentance+] Frozen enemies do extend the timer.

• Libra: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra will instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stats with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit due to the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.

• Sharp Plug: Isaac will take damage without gaining any charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is the active item equivalent of Tainted Samson's passive ability, with the only differences being that the player can choose to activate this, and this doesn't charge upon taking damage.

• The item's name, description, and effects are likely a reference to the Berserk power-up from the Doom franchise, which forces the player to use powered-up melee attacks in some games.

• The phrase 'rip and tear' is frequently used throughout the Doom franchise, and was first used in the 1996 Doom comic after protagonist Doomguy picked up the Berserk power-up.

• In addition, Isaac's inability to die during the effect could be a reference to the common joke of Doomguy being "literally too angry to die", as well as his indestructible nature in the later series lore.

• This item may also be a reference to the character Chicken from Nuclear Throne who, unlike other characters in the game, wields a katana and, upon losing all HP, instead of immediately dying, her head gets cut off and she can restore health in a short amount of time to stay alive before dying for good.

• This item may also be a reference to the "Rage Beyond Death" ability with similar effects that Barbarians can gain in 5th edition of Dungeons & Dragons, as the original Isaac characters were modeled after character classes from the game.

• The jawbone Isaac uses is a donkey's jawbone, which is a reference to a passage from the Book of Judges in which Samson kills one thousand Philistines using only the jawbone of a donkey.

• It may also be a reference to the item Donkey's Jawbone from Antibirth that didn't make the cut for Repentance.

• This event is also referred to by the pickup message for the Soul of Samson — "Slay a thousand".

• This item's special synergy with Suplex! was inspired by a bug in Repentance's initial release where any enemy (including final bosses like Hush and Delirium) that Suplex! was used on as Berserk!'s timer was ending would be instantly killed.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If Berserk wears off at 0 hearts and the player has Spirit Shackles, the game will crash.

fields.description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.

Best Bud.title: Best Bud
Best Bud.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon taking damage, spawns a white attack fly for the duration of the current room. The fly orbits Isaac at medium range, similar to Forever alone, but with much higher speed.

• [Before Repentance] The fly deals 5 damage per tick (75 contact damage per second).

• [Repentance] The fly deals 10 damage per tick (150 contact damage per second).

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Best Bud: Multiple copies of Best Buds do not stack, only 1 fly can be spawned

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth onward] Best Bud is very similar in appearance to Friend Zone and Lost Fly, making them difficult to distinguish. [end edition note] 

• The pickup quote ("Sworn protector") is also an Item.

• [Repentance] Best Bud deals the most contact damage out of all Orbitals in the game (a title previously held by Sacrificial Dagger).

fields.description: When hit, spawns a quickly orbiting attack fly similar to Forever alone for the current room that deals high damage.

Best Friend.title: Best Friend
Best Friend.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a decoy vaguely resembling Isaac in his crying animation, which explodes after 5 seconds with the blast radius of a Mega Troll Bomb.

• [Before Repentance] The explosion deals 110 damage.

• [Repentance] The explosion deals 185 damage.

• The decoy bomb distracts enemies, as they will target the decoy instead of Isaac regardless of distance.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• All Bomb modifier items will affect Best Friend, with the exception of Bobby-Bomb, Bomber Boy, Fast Bombs, Mr. Mega, and Rocket in a Jar.

• Scatter Bombs will create mini decoys.

• Sticky Bombs. When sticking to a flying enemy that can fly off-screen, Best Friend will fly off with them but will not deal explosion damage.

• Bosses such as Chub or Carrion Queen can swallow the decoy bomb just like a regular bomb.

• Isaac can push the decoy bomb by walking into it or shooting it with his tears just like regular bombs.

• If Isaac leaves and re-enters a room after placing the decoy bomb, its explosion timer will be set to that of a regular bomb (1.5 seconds).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Creates wisps that are small Isaac heads with a white flame in the middle ring. Tears shot by these have a 7.5% of applying the bait status effect, akin to Rotten Tomato.

• Car Battery: Spawns two decoys on top of each other.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Remote Detonator + Schoolbag: The decoy bomb is affected by remote detonator.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Edmund McMillen stated that Best Friend would no longer "Die upon touch". This is a reference to a bug in the original The Binding of Isaac where, in many circumstances, Isaac could take glitched hits (often killing Isaac outright).

• Best Friend works remarkably similar to Pipe Bombs in Left 4 Dead, down to the 5 second timer and not working on bosses.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Gurgles, Splashers, Boils, Guts, and Sacks are immune to Best Friend's explosion.
Bug note: Doubles when Multidimensional Baby passes through it.

fields.description: Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.

Beth's Essence.title: Beth's Essence
Beth's Essence.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Beth's Faith]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 normal blue wisp orbitals.

• Also applies to The Stairway's shop.

• Donating to any kind of Beggar has a chance to create a random wisp orbital.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: The wisps have a 50% chance to be special wisps. Having both increases the chance to 100%.

fields.description: Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 wisp orbitals. Giving money to Beggars can spawn wisps.

Bestiary (Repentance).title: Bestiary (Repentance)
Bestiary (Repentance).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The bestiary is a new addition to The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth † that is accessible through the "Stats" menu. The Bestiary shows information and statistics on all encountered monsters and bosses except for some alternate forms of some enemies.

It shows the number of times an enemy has been encountered, how much health it has, how much damage it has done to Isaac, how many times it's been killed, and how many times it has killed Isaac.

Because Repentance added a lot of new enemies, the whole page layout was reworked, requiring this page to be separate from the Afterbirth † Bestiary.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Encountering a boss while fighting Delirium does not count towards the bestiary.

• Seeded and challenge runs will affect bestiary entries, including whether an enemy has been found at least once or not, meaning that regardless of whether achievements are disabled or not, bestiary entries will still be updated.

• This also means that enemies spawned using the developer console will be counted as well.

• While fighting Hush, the Blue Boil will count as an encounter but the Blue Gaper will not. A Blue Gaper must be found on its own to be marked as an encounter.

sections.heading: Pages
sections.text:
These are the monsters on each of the bestiary's pages.

(Click on the images to open the corresponding monster page.)

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Sin collector]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Cross Stoneys are not featured in the Bestiary because they only appear in the Aprils Fool challenge and were added as a joke by _Killburn revealed in a tweet made on April Fools Day.

• Henry has no bestiary entry.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: The Bestiary is bugged with bosses that have multiple parts (such as Larry Jr., Pin, The Hollow, and so forth):

• For Pin, The Frail, and Scolex, each body part counts as an encounter and a kill.

• For Larry Jr. and The Hollow, only their heads count as a kill but each part counts as an encounter.

• Satan, War, The Matriarch and Dogma kills are not registered.
Bug note: The Visage's mask is not included in the Bestiary (only the Heart is), while both of Mask of Infamy's halves are included.
Bug note: The Sin Collector achievement can be obtained without a full Bestiary. It requires 2 entries less than what is actually featured.
Bug note: The Bestiary counts every time Delirium changes forms as separate encounters.

Homunculus.title: Homunculus
Homunculus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Homunculi attempt to chase Isaac but have a limited range of movement due to spawning attached to a wall or an [Afterbirth+ onward] Obstacle. Given enough time it will detach, spawning a small pool of Red Creep and shooting 6 projectiles in all directions and chasing quickly after Isaac. It also leaves a small pool of Red Creep upon death.

Destroying the obstacle that a Homunculus is attached to will prematurely release it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The Homunculi encountered in the Mr. Fred boss fight can only detach under Mr. Fred's command, not at free will. If there are any remaining Homunculi after Mr. Fred is killed they will remain permanently attached.

sections.heading: Begotten
sections.text: Begottens behave like Homunculi but do not spawn any Red Creep. When it detaches from the wall or [Afterbirth+ onward] Obstacle, it fires 6 blood shots in all directions, turns the room dark and becomes invisible. Attacking it causes it to temporarily become visible.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A homunculus is a very small human or humanoid creature.

• In medieval art, the infant Jesus Christ was often portrayed as a homunculus, with a man's face on a baby's body, to signify being perfectly formed at birth.

• Similar to Frowning Gapers and Nulls, Homunculi and Begottens are seen in a sleep-like state at the start of a room before they immediately open their eyes and attempt to pursue the player.

• Begottens are the only non-boss enemies that can cast a "curse of darkness" effect.

• Homunculi will still leave behind creep if re-rolled with D10.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If an Explosivo tear is stuck to a Begotten, when it becomes invisible, the tear will fall to the ground.
Bug note: In the "RoomEditor" modding tool, Homunculi cannot be placed.

Second Hand.title: Second Hand
Second Hand.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Increases the time that status effects stay on enemies.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Further increases the duration of status effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Acid Baby / The Bean / The Black Bean / Contagion: The poison duration from these items is not affected by Second Hand.

• Hemoptysis: The Brimstone curse duration is affected by Second Hand. This also applies to Tainted Azazel.

• Meconium: The confuse duration from Black Poops is unaffected by Second Hand.

• Mega Bean: Doubles the petrification duration but not the poison duration.

• 2Spooky / Venus: The fear/charm effect will last for twice as long after an enemy leaves Isaac's radius.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth+ onward] Second Hand's sprite was changed for Booster Pack #5.

• Its appearance is based off a clock's second hand, i.e. the hand that displays the seconds elapsed.

fields.name: Second Hand
fields.description: Increases the time that status effects stay on enemies.

Seraphim.title: Seraphim
Seraphim.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the item; the transformation; Seraphim (Transformation)]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns an angel familiar who follows Isaac and fires homing tears similar to Sacred Heart, which deal 10 damage at 75% shot speed.

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Seraphim having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Sacrificial Altar: This familiar will also reward 2 Black Hearts when sacrificed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Seraphim is the plural form of the word Seraph. Its use here to refer to a singular familiar as well as being used in the name of the transformation may be a mistake.

fields.name: Seraphim
fields.description: Spawns an angel familiar who follows Isaac and fires homing tears which deal 10 damage and have 75% shot speed.

Seraphim (Transformation).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

Serpent's Kiss.title: Serpent's Kiss
Serpent's Kiss.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a 15% chance to fire poison tears, each tick dealing damage equal to Isaac's.

• Poison from the shots will tick 2 times.

• Inflicts poison on enemies who make contact with Isaac.

• Contact poison will tick 6 times.

• [Before Repentance] Enemies who are killed after they have been inflicted with this type of poison have a 20% chance to drop Black Hearts. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.

• [Repentance] Enemies that make contact with Isaac have a 20% chance to drop a Black Heart. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Not affected by luck.

• Enemies and bosses with multiple segments, such as Chub and Larry Jr., have a chance to drop multiple Black Hearts.

• If a boss would have been poisoned, but negates it with status immunity, they can still drop a black heart.

• Contact poisoning enemies that don't deal contact damage can be an easy way to generate black hearts (e.g. all variants of Pooter, Host, Boil, Cod Worm, and any of Ultra Greed's non-blank coins).

• [Before Repentance] Although Stoney and Shopkeepers can't be visibly poisoned, they still can drop Black Hearts if destroyed after being touched.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs and missiles may become poisonous, and enemies hit by them may drop black hearts.

• [Repentance] Bombs no longer grant black hearts but poison bombs leave a poison cloud similar to Bob's Curse.

• Gnawed Leaf: Standing still allows for safe kills and possibly spawn infinite black hearts.

• Mars: Dashing into enemies will often both kill enemies, and cause them to drop black hearts.

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife: Enemies poisoned by the knife may drop black hearts.

• Tainted Forgotten: Especially strong as you are likely to apply contact poison when attacking enemies, giving you black hearts frequently.

• Any item or card that grants Isaac temporary invincibility lets Isaac use Serpent's Kiss on any enemy without taking damage. This includes, but is not limited to:

• VII - The Chariot/VII - The Chariot?

• A Pony/White Pony

• Book of Shadows/Celtic Cross/Empty Vessel/Algiz/The Polaroid/Virgo

• Breath of Life

• Dark Arts using the very brief period after reappearing where Isaac is immune to damage

• Dull Razor

• Holy Mantle

• My Little Unicorn/Unicorn Stump/Feels like I'm walking on Sunshine!

• [Repentance] Aries (if walking speed is at least 0.85)

• The Gamekid/Power Pill!

• Ventricle Razor (briefly after exiting a portal)

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Godhead: The Godhead aura cannot inflict poison but the tears themselves may poison enemies on contact.

• [Before Repentance] The following interactions are trivial in Repentance:

• Athame / Maw Of The Void: The black rings may poison enemies but do not generate black hearts.

• Brimstone: The blood barrage may poison enemies but does not generate black hearts.

• Tech.5 / Tech X / Technology / Technology 2: The lasers may poison enemies but do not generate black hearts.

• Trisagion: May poison enemies but does not generate black hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Serpent's Kiss is most likely referencing Viper (Madame Hydra) from Marvel Comics, who has green lipstick and has transmitted poison through hollow fangs or poisoned lipstick before.

fields.description: Tears have a chance to apply a poison effect to enemies. Isaac poisons enemies on contact. Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a Black Heart when killed.

Seven Deadly Sins.title: Seven Deadly Sins
Seven Deadly Sins.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Seven Deadly Sins are mini-bosses that can be encountered on any floor in their respective Mini-Boss rooms outside of The Chest and Dark Room. Unlike with bosses, there is no special door leading to a mini-boss room, meaning that there is no way to tell whether a room is inhabited by a mini-boss unless the player has an item that reveals map icons such as The Compass or a Map item. Once in a mini-boss room, the player cannot escape through means of bombing the door, as it will be boarded off. The Sins and Super Sins notably become tougher the later in the game they are encountered.

Each of the Sins has specific drops, that are consumables or a pedestal item (less frequently). In a room containing multiple Sins, only the last one will drop something, allowing you to choose what drop you want by killing a certain mini-boss last.

All of them are based on the Seven Deadly Sins.

sections.text:
These are much stronger alternatives to the original sins, known as the Seven Super Deadly Sins.

sections.heading: Ultra Sins
sections.text:
There is an Ultra variant of both Pride and Greed. Ultra Pride resembles Edmund and Florian, while Ultra Greed and Ultra Greedier serve as the final bosses for Greed Mode and Greedier Mode respectively.

Shade.title: Shade
Shade.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a [Before Repentance] 1-second/ [Repentance] 0.66-second delay and deals [Before Repentance] 2/ [Repentance] 5 contact damage per tick, or [Before Repentance] 30/ [Repentance] 75 damage per second, to enemies.

• Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing [Before Repentance] over 600 damage [Repentance] over 666 damage.

• The familiar disappears and turns into friendly dark My Shadows, identical to those spawned by My Shadow.

• Isaac will now do equal contact damage at the same rate as the Shade used to.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as Multidimensional Baby have been collected before the Shade, it will follow them instead with further delay.

• If Isaac gains a method of flight, Shade will gain wings.

• Cannot be removed with Sacrificial Altar.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

• BFFS!: Will continue to work on Isaac even after Shade is absorbed, doubling contact damage.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly Chargers as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly Chargers however friendly Chargers can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly chargers.

• Eraser: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning as the item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.

• [Repentance] Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly chargers. [end edition note] 

• Shade: Isaac's contact damage increases when absorbing multiple Shade familiars.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Obsessed Fan behaves similarly to Shade before the disappearance, but with a longer delay on following Isaac's movements.

• If playing as Black Judas or Tainted Judas, the shade familiar will have red eyes instead of white ones.

• Shade's pickup quote may be a reference to the horror film "It Follows".

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Shade will revert back to it's non-absorbed form after escaping Mother's Shadow.

fields.name: Shade
fields.description: Spawns a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1 second delay and deals contact damage to enemies. After dealing enough damage, it is absorbed by Isaac and spawns friendly My Shadows.

Shard of Glass.title: Shard of Glass
Shard of Glass.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:

• 25% chance to drop a full Red Heart.

• [Before Repentance] 10% chance to gain the Anemic effect (+5 range, red creep trail) for the current room upon taking damage.

• [Repentance] Causes Isaac to bleed, spewing blood tears around him constantly.

• The sprayed tears vary in damage, roughly in range of 67% to 101% of Isaac's base damage.

• Holding a direction of fire focuses the bleeding tears to that direction, with slightly increased range.

• • The bleeding tears can be aimed at any direction just like having Analog Stick.

• After bleeding for 20 seconds, Isaac's Red Hearts or Rotten Hearts will take damage (bypassing other Hearts); this is indicated by Isaac slowly turning red after and eventually blinking. This damage also has a 25% chance to drop a full Red Heart. The damaging effect will continue to occur every 20 seconds until the bleeding effect ends.

• • The damage amount is always half a Red Heart, a Coin Heart, or a Rotten Heart, even in later chapters where most damage is now a full Heart or two Rotten Hearts.

• The bleeding effect ends when Isaac receives any form of Red Heart or Rotten Heart healing, if he has no more Red or Rotten Hearts, if he fills an Eternal Heart, or if the next hit would kill him.

• If Isaac has no Red or Rotten Hearts, the bleeding effect of Shard of Glass will not activate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Red Hearts spawned by this item may become different hearts in certain Super Secret Rooms.

• [Repentance] Regarding the bleeding effect:

• Taking bleed damage does not affect Devil Room or Angel Room chances.

• Bleeding blood tears will not keep any tear effects or special tears that Isaac has.

• The bleeding effect persists between floor transitions.

• If Shard of Glass is re-rolled or lost while Isaac is bleeding, the bleeding will continue, but Red Hearts will no longer spawn when Isaac takes damage.

• The Forgotten can end the bleeding by switching to The Soul.

• The bleeding effect works with Keeper [Repentance] (and Tainted Keeper) [end edition note] . They will bleed and lose a coin heart until only one coin is left. Receiving coins will stop the bleeding effect. Due to Tainted Keeper only having two coin hearts in most circumstances, bleeding will rarely apply to him.

• Rotten Hearts will take bleeding damage only when Isaac has no red hearts remaining. Picking up Rotten Hearts will also end the bleeding.

• Using a bed or a Full Health pill to heal Isaac's red hearts will not stop the bleeding.

• Turning into The Lost via the White Fire Place or Soul of the Lost will stop bleeding effect.

• Using the Yum Heart will stop the bleeding effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Epic Fetus / Marked: Bleeding tears will aim at the crosshair.

• [Repentance] The Ludovico Technique: Bleeding tears will aim at the controlled tear.

• Cambion Conception / Candy Heart / Immaculate Conception / Fanny Pack / Piggy Bank: Isaac can get the rewards from items that give items/resources on hit by intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the hearts, for essentially half the cost (as every 4 hits generates 1 full heart on average, which let isaac take 2 more hits)

• IV Bag: Lets Isaac generate large amounts of money

• Maggy's Bow: Doubles the healing received from the hearts spawned, letting isaac effectively take infinite red heart damage (on average) if each hit takes half a heart.

• Humbleing Bundle generates 3 hits of health on average for every 4 taken.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • "Blood and guts" is a term for violence, typically in fiction.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Upon taking damage, Isaac has a chance to drop a full red heart, gain 5 range, and leave a trail of damaging red creep for the current room.
[Repentance] Taking damage causes Isaac to bleed, spraying a volley of blood in the direction he fires. Bleeding will eventually damage him, but it can be stopped by picking up a Red Heart.

Sharp Key.title: Sharp Key
Sharp Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives five Keys.

• On use, Isaac holds a key above his head. Pressing a fire button removes one key and throws it as a piercing projectile. The key damages enemies, as well as opens locked doors and Locked Chests it hits.

• The key will also break the first rock it hits, as well as Key Blocks.

• The thrown key does damage equal to 5× Isaac's damage + 30.

• Enemies killed by Sharp Key have a chance to spawn the contents of a chest; the contents they can drop includes the rewards of any possible chest contents, including items.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Sharp Key gives Isaac five keys for the price of three when bought at a Shop, making its purchase a good value if the player is low on keys.

• Thrown keys follow almost the same unlocking rules as Dad's Key. They can open:

• Secret Rooms

• The doors to access Mines, Mausoleum

• Mega Satan's door

• A Strange Door

• The flesh door to Mom's Heart in Mausoleum / Gehenna

• • Unlike others, this cannot be unlocked with Dad's key.

• The only rooms Dad's Key can open that Sharp Key cannot are Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms.

• The entrance to Boss Rush and the gate leading to Hush can both be opened from the inside by throwing a key on where the entrance was.

• It cannot be used as a substitute for Red Key or to open the doors to Boss Rush or ??? past their timer.

• Doors will be opened in one thrown key, even if they require multiple keys or bombs to open.

• Thrown keys can also destroy Angel statues, but not Blue Fire Places.

• Thrown keys cannot pierce or destroy Stoneys.

• Destroying a rock will create a bridge at the opposite side the thrown key hit the rock from.

• Despite being a substitute to bombs, thrown keys will not destroy Shopkeepers.

• Thrown keys will open all the locked chests they move through, allowing multiple chests to be opened with a single key.

• Only locked chests (such as Locked Chests, Eternal Chests, or Old Chests) can be opened by Sharp Key; all other chests are unaffected.

• • In the case of Eternal Chests, thrown keys will only count toward opening the chest one time.

• • Despite Mega Chests requiring keys to unlock, Sharp Key has no effect on it.

• Opening locked chests with thrown keys in Challenge rooms will not cause the challenge room to start spawning enemies.

• Thrown keys will retain Isaac's tear/status effects, but are unaffected by items that replace Isaac's tears (such as Dr. Fetus, Brimstone, or Mom's Knife).

• Whether or not an enemy gives chest contents when killed by Sharp Key is seeded per enemy. As such, rooms can be re-entered (using Sharp Key itself or with Door Stop / Mercurius etc.) before they're fully cleared to repeatedly get rewards from the same enemy.

• The type of chest that enemies will give the contents of is determined by standard chest generation rules. This makes the contents of standard chests more common, and prevents enemies from giving the contents of Old Chests or Mom's Chest.

• The pickups that enemies killed by Sharp Key can drop are affected by items/trinkets that modify chest spawns/rewards. 

• This includes the Chest and Dark Room's effect of causing chests to contain Treasure Room items.

• Sharp Key can open the chests in Challenge Rooms without triggering them. However, picking up an item dropped from a chest will trigger them.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Ace of Spades / Child's Heart / Lucky Toe / Match Stick / Rusted Key / Safety Cap: If an enemy drops pickups, it has a ⅓ chance to drop an extra pickup; the pickup will be the one the trinket is associated with (random in the case of Lucky Toe).

• Angelic Prism: A thrown key will duplicate into 4 keys, which can be used to open multiple rooms or chests with only 1 key. If Isaac stands at the middle far left or middle far right of the first room in Chest, a thrown key can open all 4 chests.

• Book of Belial interaction: Invokes the effect of Razor Blade without dealing damage to Judas along with the original effect.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns white wisps in the shape of keys, on the middle ring. Despite the wisps' appearance, they cannot unlock anything, and act as normal wisps.

• Continuum: Thrown keys can unlock multiple doors it passes through.

• Gilded Key: Enemies will only give the contents of locked chests. The pickups they can drop will also include runes and Lil' Battery.

• The Left Hand: Enemies will only give the contents of red chests.

• As locked/red chests are able to give Items whereas normal chests cannot, the previous two trinkets also allow items to be obtained through Sharp Key more consistently.

• Mom's Key: Doubles the amount of pickups dropped by enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Daemon's Tail: Enemies are much less likely to drop hearts; these hearts will still be Black Hearts.

• Dead Eye: Keys thrown will contribute to Dead Eye's damage modifier.

• Golden Keys: Ignored by Sharp Key; it will still require and consume keys to use.

• Guppy's Eye: There will be no overlay on enemies that would drop pickups on death.

• Haemolacria/The Parasite: Split tears from thrown keys are normal tears.

• Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: Sharp Key loses almost all of its range, and can only be improved with tear height ups.

• The Ludovico Technique: No effect.

• Multidimensional Baby: Keys passing through the baby turn into normal tears and loses all of its effects.

• Pay To Play: The key cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests and open secret room doors.

• Poker Chip: Enemies have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an Attack Fly: The attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.

• Spectral Tears: Rocks that thrown keys pass over have a chance of being destroyed.

• Trisagion: Thrown keys become Trisagion blasts and no longer cause enemies to drop chest contents on kill.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sharp Key originates from the Antibirth mod, where it was less powerful, as killing enemies with it did not drop chest contents.

• This item can be considered to be the Key counterpart to Blood Bombs. Both items can use their respective pickups at the expense of another, with Sharp Key sacrificing Keys, while Blood Bombs sacrifices health.

fields.description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.

Sharp Plug.title: Sharp Plug
Sharp Plug.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.

• [Before Repentance] Sharp Plug costs two hearts of health to use.

• • [Repentance] Sharp Plug's heart cost is one half-heart per charge slot filled. The health cost is not increased in later stages where half-heart damage is upgraded to full heart.

• If the item has no charges, the Sharp Plug will not activate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] If Isaac has less than two Black or Soul Hearts, it will remove them but will not remove any Red Hearts.

• [Repentance] Sharp Plug attempts to draw from Red Hearts first.

• [Repentance] Sharp Plug cannot deal fatal damage. If used at half a heart, it will not work.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Damage-triggered items: Each half heart used up by activating Sharp Plug triggers damage effects separately, allowing multiple payouts.

• Habit: Each damage taken triggers the extra charge, which can be seen when Isaac has The Battery, or when using Sharp Plug without having enough health to fully charge the active.

• Glowing Hourglass: As long as Isaac has more than 2 full hearts, time can be rewinded indefinitely since the health used to recharge the item is refunded upon use.

• Jacob's Ladder / 120 Volt: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, to 100% if Isaac owns both.

• Keeper: The Keeper takes only one heart of damage.

• [Repentance] Expends health for charges at the rate of 2 charges per 1 Coin Heart. If an item is 1-charge, removes 1 Coin Heart.

• Schoolbag: The active item in the main slot is fully charged as normal and the secondary slot gains as many charges as the main one did.

• [Repentance] : Only the front item is charged.

• Tainted Magdalene: Tainted Magdalene's Yum Heart can be used infinitely, allowing for infinite invincibility frames from taking damage. Paired with Tainted Magdalene's melee attack, this can easily win a run.

• [Repentance+] Bleeding hearts grant 1 charge per full bleeding heart. Non bleeding hearts grant charges as normal.

• The Wafer: Reduces the health cost to half a heart (except for Keeper).

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 9 Volt: Renders the Sharp Plug unusable. Sharp Plug can only be used if the item is at 0 charges, but 9 Volt instantly gives 1 charge to the item upon activation.

• [Repentance] As Sharp Plug can now be used with charges and the cost is based on charges filled, 9 Volt now synergizes with Sharp Plug, lowering the cost of using it by half a heart on 2+ charge items.

• Alabaster Box: Expends up to 6 full hearts if possible with no charges given.

• Bethany / Tainted Bethany: Soul/blood charges are used before Sharp Plug when available.

• Eraser: Attempting to recharge the Eraser with the Sharp Plug fails and only hurts Isaac for half a heart.

• Holy Mantle: Holy Mantle blocks the damage from Sharp Plug if the shield is active, but also keeps Isaac's active item from charging.

• [Repentance] Bypasses the Holy Mantle and gives charges as usual.

• Isaac's Heart: Renders the Sharp Plug unusable.

• The Lost: No benefit from this item unless he has a respawn item because his active item's charge will not refill if the Holy Mantle effect activates. Sharp Plug only activates upon receiving actual damage.

• [Repentance] No effect, as The Lost doesn't have health.

• Tainted Jacob or White Fire Place Lost form: Activating Sharp Plug will take the health cost from the original character's health. Holy Mantle will not block the health cost.

• • Lost form + Heartbreak: Every point of health taken to activate Sharp Plug is considered fatal damage, leaving Isaac with as little as half a soul heart. It is possible to get 12 Broken Hearts in addition to this final half heart, past the normal limit.

• Mega Blast: Sharp Plug will not work with Mega Blast.

• [Repentance] Works as intended, giving 1 charge per half a heart.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Charge with blood; Repentance: Infinite charge... at a cost]
fields.description: Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.

Sharp Straw.title: Sharp Straw
Sharp Straw.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Damages all enemies in the room.

• The damage dealt is equal to Isaac's current tear damage plus 10% of the enemy's max health.

• Has a 15% chance to drop Half Red Hearts when it damages an enemy.

• [Before Repentance] May also drop Half Soul Hearts. Half red hearts will always drop when Isaac has at least one red heart container; otherwise, half soul hearts will drop.

• The amount of enemies damaged does not improve the chance.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When used on Delirium, this item should be used when it isn't transformed to deal the most damage, as Delirium doesn't have his armor up when in his true form.

• For enemies that can disappear or go underground, it only affects them if they are visible.

• The Sharp Straw works exceptionally well with Samson, giving the chance to collect large amounts of health per floor, allowing more damage to be taken resulting in more damage being dealt per use.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Enemies have a chance to spawn wisps in the outer ring upon use, although they sometimes extinguish instantly. Using it in a room with no enemies does not grant a wisp. Despite Sharp Straw having a timed charge, the wisps persist between rooms.

• Car Battery: Damage is doubled and two half hearts may be dropped.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • [Repentance] Ipecac: Only provides a +2 damage bonus instead of +40.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Before Booster Pack #5, Sharp Straw would instantly kill Big Horn if used while his hands were out due to their arbitrarily high health.

• Sharp Straw was originally an unofficial item which was supposed to showcase the modding capabilities of Afterbirth+ in the PAX 2016 livestream. However, all items included in the demo were later added to the final game.

• In the livestream, Sharp Straw had the name 'Isaacula', a different appearance, and a recharge time of six rooms.

fields.name: Sharp Straw
fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit.
[Repentance] Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.

Shiny Rock.title: Shiny Rock
Shiny Rock.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Tinted rocks and rocks with Crawl Spaces underneath flash white upon entering the room and every 10 seconds afterward.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either also makes Secret Room doors flash. Having both makes the gleam appears twice as often.

fields.name: Shiny Rock
fields.description: Tinted rocks and rocks with Crawl Spaces underneath flash white upon entering the room and every 10 seconds afterward.

Shoop da Whoop!.title: Shoop da Whoop!
Shoop da Whoop!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When used, the next shot will fire a large, Brimstone-like laser in the direction Isaac shoots that deals double Isaac's tear damage. If Isaac is already shooting, the item immediately activates in that direction.

• [Before Repentance] The laser hits up to 13 times.

• [Repentance] The laser hits up to 12 times.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Status effects can be applied by the laser.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can drop from killing Envy [Before Afterbirth+] or Super Envy. [Before Repentance] Envy and Super Envy can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• Despite the laser looking very similar to Brimstone, it doesn't share most of the Brimstone-specific interactions.

• Can still be used while blindfolded.

• This item synergizes extremely well with items that significantly increase damage, such as Polyphemus and Ipecac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: Allows the item to be charged and used multiple times in a room, which can help with dealing extra damage in enduring fights like most endgame bosses.

• 9 Volt: Can be used once every room, and more frequently in Challenge Rooms.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns white wisps in the outer ring that resemble Shoop da Whoop!. The wisps will not fire tears, but will each fire a thin Shoop da Whoop! laser whenever Isaac uses it (including the wisp that was just summoned). The lasers deal 7 damage per tick (BUG: 3.5 if Isaac has BFFS!), and can hit up to 10 times for a total of 70 damage.

• Broken Remote: Since item charges aren't expended until Isaac chooses a direction to shoot, the player can teleport across the floor indefinitely.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the power of the laser by 2× and +3 flat damage, on top of the 2× base damage already applied by Shoop da Whoop. Enemies who die to the laser under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Ipecac: Increases the damage of the beam greatly, as Ipecac's +40 flat damage boost is added straight to Shoop Da Whoop whithout any damage decrease unlike Brimstone. This basically allows Isaac to kill most normal bosses in 1 shot.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Shoop da Whoop! is a reference to an internet meme depicting an edited face of Cell from the anime Dragon Ball Z firing a laser from its mouth. This meme is usually accompanied by the quote "I'm-a firin' mah lazar!", followed by "BLLLARRRRGGG!", which is where the item's tooltip comes from.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Using the item at the same time that you touch a large Golden Chest (dropped by final bosses such as The Lamb and ???) will freeze Isaac, and the ending won't appear. Leaving and re-entering the run will fix the bug.

fields.description: Fires a laser from Isaac's mouth that deals twice Isaac's tear damage.

Shopkeeper.title: Shopkeeper
Shopkeeper.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Shopkeepers are non-hostile NPCs that are present in every Shop and most Secret Rooms, and can also be found in Vaults, Arcades, Bedrooms, and I AM ERROR rooms. They take on various appearances, such as sporting various facial expressions or occasionally hanging in the air on nooses, though these differences are only cosmetic.

They can be destroyed by explosions and specific items for potential rewards. Destroying a shopkeeper also increases the chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room to appear by 10% for the current floor.

sections.heading: Possible Rewards
sections.text:
[Rebirth only] 

| + | Chance | Payout 
| 33% | Nothing

| 33% | 2 random Coins

| 33% | 2 Spiders

| 1% | Steam Sale

[end edition note] 
[Afterbirth only] 

| + | Chance | Payout 
| 32.66% | Nothing

| 32.66% | 2 random Coins
