Pulse Worm.title: Pulse Worm
Pulse Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Tears pulsate in size between 1x to 1.6x as they travel. The effect changes the hitbox of the tear but does not affect damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Pin, Larry Jr., The Hollow or Scolex. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Each copy multiplies the maximum tear size.

• Godhead: The damaging aura pulses along with the tear.

fields.name: Pulse Worm
fields.description: Tears pulsate in size as they travel.

Punching Bag.title: Punching Bag
Punching Bag.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a Mulligan familiar that walks around the room and acts as a decoy for monsters.

• If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.

• [Repentance] Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.

• [edition nar+] Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.

• [Afterbirth only] Punching Bag will die after taking too much damage and eventually respawn after a long time. Exiting and continuing the run will cause it to reappear right away.

• [Afterbirth only] Punching Bag will reappear instantly each time a familiar or orbital item is picked up.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Punching Bag will be targeted by enemies if it is closer to them than Isaac, for up to 6 seconds. Then they will target Isaac for 6 seconds regardless of distance, before acknowledging the Punching Bag again.

• [Afterbirth only] The Punching Bag will die instantly by enemies' beam-type attacks, such as Brimstone or by Uriel's and Gabriel's beam. This also includes enemies' Technology lasers such as Eye and Camillo Jr.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Box of Friends: Adds another Punching Bag. This may cause enemies to become unpredictable, so use with caution.

• If the Punching Bag has died, it can be forced to respawn with a double upon using the Box of Friends.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in The Guardian.

• A punching bag, used in this context, is a target of frequent criticism and abuse.

• The term "scape goat" in the pickup quote means someone who is blamed for problems that were caused by another person, or being treated like a punching bag.

fields.name: Punching Bag
fields.description: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that wanders randomly. Enemies will attack the Mulligan if it's closer.

Pupula Duplex.title: Pupula Duplex
Pupula Duplex.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants spectral tears.

• [Before Repentance] Tear size multiplier: 2x.

• [Repentance] +0.6 tear size.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Despite their crescent shape, the tears still have a circular hitbox.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Godhead: The damaging aura benefits from the increased size significantly.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel/Tainted Azazel/The Forgotten/Tainted Forgotten: No effect, only has an effect on The Soul.

• Epic Fetus/Mom's Knife/Tech X/Spirit Sword/Brimstone: No effect on those items.

• The Ludovico Technique: Only tear appearance changes, no tear size up.

• [Repentance] My Reflection: Tears will spin like boomerangs. This is a purely cosmetic effect.

• [Repentance] Technology: Lasers are much wider.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Pupula Duplex" is said to be a condition in which a person has two irises and two pupils in one eye, without any actual recorded cases. An actual rare medical condition similar to it exists, called polycoria.

• This item's appearance is similar to Diplopia.

fields.description: Gives Isaac spectral tears and gives his tears a wide arc shape, increasing their size.

Purgatory.title: Purgatory
Purgatory.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a red crack in the ground somewhere in the room while Isaac is in a room with enemies. Walking over the crack summons a ghost that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.

• The ghost spends one second spawning in before it attacks.

• The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Only one crack is active at a time.

• The amount of cracks does not increase with additional copies of the item.

• The explosion does not hurt Isaac.

• If a crack is stepped on and the room is cleared before the ghost spawns, it will fly to a random location and explode there.

• The explosions from the ghosts will destroy enemy tears.

• [Before Repentance+] Cracks don't spawn in Challenge Rooms, Boss Rush and [mode: greed] Greed Mode.

• Friendly enemies can be killed by the ghosts.

• The ghosts aren't considered familiars, therefore they're unaffected by items or trinkets that alter familiars or their behavior, such as BFFS!, King Baby, Box of Friends or Friendship Necklace.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dark Arts: Walking over cracks will not summon ghosts while under the effect of Dark Arts.

• Spindown Dice: When used on Purgatory, turns the item into Dogma, a unique item usually only able to be obtained by killing the boss Dogma.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Purgatory is a place or state of suffering inhabited by the souls of sinners who are expiating their sins before going to heaven.

• Purgatory is one of only five items to appear in both the Angel and Devil item pools, the others being 7 Seals, Duality, Lil Delirium and Void.

fields.description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.

Purity.title: Purity
Purity.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a random aura around Isaac that grants a boost depending on the aura's color:

• Red: +4 damage.

• [Before Repentance] Blue: -4 tear delay.

• [Repentance] Blue: +2.0 fire rate.

• Yellow: +0.5 speed.

• • [Before Repentance] Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).

• [Before Repentance] Orange: +7.5 range, +1.0 tear falling speed.

• [Repentance] Orange: +3.0 range.

• Taking damage causes the aura to disappear. When the next room is entered, the aura will reappear with a random color.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The tear delay boost can allow the player's tears to go over the normal maximum rate of fire.

• [Repentance] If Tainted Isaac swaps Purity for another item and picks it back up again, it will have a different aura. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Diplopia/Crooked Penny: Holding multiple copies of Purity will still only grant one aura, providing no additional benefit.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item's sprite references purity roses, white roses commonly associated with weddings.

fields.description: Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura around him. The aura disappears upon taking damage and reappears with a random color upon entering a new room. Red boosts damage, blue boosts tears, yellow boosts speed, and orange boosts range.

Purple Heart.title: Purple Heart
Purple Heart.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Doubles the chance for champion enemies to appear.

• Also increases the chance of encountering champion bosses.

• [Repentance+] The chance for champion enemies to drop special or double loot is increased to 50%.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The increased number of Champions means that more enemies will drop additional loot, which can be useful when low on keys or bombs.

• The chance to spawn a champion in Normal is very low (5%), [Before Repentance+] and the drop chance for additional loot in Hard mode is only 33%, making this trinket very rarely worth keeping.

• [Afterbirth onward] Since champions don't drop any consumables in Greed Mode, this trinket only has a downside in this mode.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Mom's Box / Golden Trinket: Each copy of Purple Heart increases the multiplier by 2 (e.g. 6x with 3 Purple Hearts, 20x with 10 Purple Hearts).

• Mom's Box / Golden Trinket: Having either increases the chance of special or double loot to 66%. Having both to 75%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Purple Heart is a military decoration awarded to soldiers who are wounded or killed while serving in the U.S. Military.

fields.name: Purple Heart
fields.description: Increases the chance of encountering champion enemies and bosses. [Repentance+] The chance for champion enemies to drop special or double loot is increased to 50%.

Push Pin.title: Push Pin
Push Pin.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Pin; Safety Pin]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Adds a chance to shoot a piercing and spectral tear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire a special tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5 \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 20% and having both to 33%.

fields.name: Push Pin
fields.description: Adds a 10% chance to shoot a piercing and spectral tear.

Pyro.title: Pyro
Pyro.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the item that grants bombs; the explosion immunity item; Pyromaniac]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Grants Isaac 99 Bombs on pickup.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Rerolling this item with the D4, etc., will not remove 99 Bombs.

• This item can appear when using the 0 - The Fool? with 99 bombs in inventory.

• [Repentance] As Tainted ??? cannot use bombs, this item has no effect. No extra poop pickups are granted.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Beans!.

• Pyro is a reference to pyromania, a disorder characterized by an obsession with setting things on fire. In this case it's bomb fuses.

• This item is the bomb counterpart to A Dollar and Skeleton Key.

• This item uses a similar costume to Boom!.

fields.image name: * [edition alternatives: Before Afterbirth+: Rebirth; Before Repentance: Afterbirth+]
fields.description: Grants 99 Bombs.

Pyromaniac.title: Pyromaniac
Pyromaniac.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the explosion immunity item; the item that grants bombs; Pyro]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +5 Bombs.

• All explosions heal Isaac instead of damaging him. If Isaac has no Red Heart containers or full health, no damage is taken.

• [Before Repentance] Explosions heal one full Red Heart.

• [Repentance] Explosions heal one half Red Heart.

• [Repentance] Grants immunity to damage from Fire Places or enemy fires, but does not heal Isaac.

• It does not protect the player from taking damage from fire projectiles or the White Fire Place in Downpour II. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Pyromaniac is a Special Item.

• [Before Repentance] Makes the player immune to Mom's, Satan's, and other enemies' stomp attacks, making those fights substantially less difficult.

• Due to the immunity to Mom's stomping attack, Mom's Toenail has improved usefulness.

• [Before Repentance] Makes the player immune to The Cage's, The Adversary's, Mega Satan's, and Ultra Greedier's rock wave attack.

• [Before Repentance] Makes the player immune to fires left behind by enemies and their hot bombs, as well as projectiles from Red Fire Places and Purple Fire Places, but not the fireplaces themselves.

• The item is unable to produce Soul Hearts, Black Hearts, or Eternal Hearts, making Pyromaniac a little less effective if used with ???, Black Judas, [Repentance] Tainted Judas, The Lost, Tainted Forgotten, or Tainted Bethany. However, these characters still gain immunity to explosions, with Tainted ??? benefiting the most out of all.

• Ultra Greedier uses explosive attacks almost exclusively. As a result, Pyromaniac makes characters nearly invulnerable against him [Repentance] except for his rock waves.

• Makes Isaac immune to the lake of fire in the fight against The Beast, but not to her fire inhalation attack. [end edition note] 

• One of only two items that grant full immunity to explosive damage, the other being Host Hat.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Anarchist Cookbook: Spawned bombs can be used for mass healing.

• Blood Bombs: If the player has run out of bombs, they can spend half a heart to drop a bomb and recover it by getting caught in the explosion (it won't work on characters that can't obtain red health).

• This allows Isaac to infinitely damage himself for items such as Fanny Pack.

• Bomber Boy: Heals Isaac multiple times per bomb depending on the number of explosions that hit him.

• Curse of the Tower: Whenever Isaac gets hit, numerous healing troll bombs fill the room, nullifying nearly any red heart damage taken.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Ipecac: Explosions heal Isaac, essentially making him invincible as long as he has more than one red heart container and a decent rate of fire.

• Kamikaze!: Provides an unlimited source of explosions which will heal.

• Tainted Magdalene: Explosions heal a full Red Heart again.

• Walnut: Walnut will only require 1-5 explosions to open. As Isaac is immune to explosions, he can safely open Walnut without taking any damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Blue Bomber.

• Pyromania is an impulse control disorder in which individuals repeatedly fail to resist impulses to deliberately start fires.

• The item description is a reference to the song Hurt So Good by John Cougar.

fields.description: +5 bombs. Grants immunity to explosion damage and causes explosions to heal Isaac. [Repentance] Also grants immunity to fire.

Queen of Hearts.title: Queen of Hearts
Queen of Hearts.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Drops 1-20 full Red Hearts on the ground.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Red Hearts spawned by this card are not affected by most replacement effects, other than those of Super Secret Rooms.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Any extra hearts left over could be used for a [machine: Blood Donation Machine] to get extra money.

• The same can also be used for [machine: Devil Beggar] s, [machine: Hell Game] s, and [machine: Confessional] s.

• Any characters that are unable to have red hearts can benefit from this card if they have Dark Bum, as it can drop Black Hearts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Maggy's Bow: With the increased healing, Isaac could get up to 40 hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

fields.name: Queen of Hearts
fields.description: Drops 1-20 full Red Hearts on the ground.

Quints.title: Quints
Quints.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon killing enemies, spawns a stationary familiar in their place for the room, up to a maximum of 5. These familiars do not follow Isaac.

• The following familiars can spawn:

• Abel

• Boiled Baby

• Brother Bobby

• Demon Baby

• Freezer Baby

• Ghost Baby

• Guardian Angel

• Harlequin Baby

• Lil Brimstone

• Little Steven

• Multidimensional Baby

• Robo-Baby

• Rotten Baby

• Seraphim

• Sister Maggy

• Rainbow Baby

• ???'s Soul

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Killing the heads thrown by Rag Man before they turn into a Rag Man's Ragling is not counted as a kill and will not spawn a baby.

• The same familiar can spawn multiple times.

• Despite being stationary, tear-shooting babies will still inherit Isaac's movement, angling their tears accordingly.

• Enemies killed by Dark Esau count as yours and will spawn a baby.

• During The Beast fight, familiars spawned by Quints stay on screen throughout the chase sequence.

• [Before Repentance+] When playing as Tainted Lazarus, Quints will not disappear on Flip but instead give the ability to spawn more Quints if Flip is used again. This is very effective in Greed mode and Boss rush because the automatic flip triggers when completing a wave, giving more Quints for every other wave.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: All shooting familiars spawned are affected, save for Little Steven and Seraphim.

• BFFS!: Affects Quints familiars, doubling their damage.

• Quints: Lets you spawn an additional 5 Quints familiars per copy.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Sacrificial Altar: The item will be lost, and each spawned familiar counts as one sacrifice. If Quints is sacrificed first (or is the only item available to sacrifice) and at least two familiars are summoned, two Devil Room items will be spawned while only losing one item.

• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t leave familiars behind.

• Box of Friends: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't leave familiars behind.

• King Baby: Familiars do not follow King Baby, nor are the familiars aiming independently at enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The name of this item is a shortened form of "Quintuplets", or five babies born at the same time. This is likely why it can create up to 5 familiars.

fields.description: The first five enemies killed in a room will spawn stationary shooting familiars where they died.

RC Remote.title: RC Remote
RC Remote.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Instead of trailing behind Isaac, familiars are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.

• Holding the drop button will allow Isaac to move while keeping the familiars in place, identical to Jacob and Esau.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket affects the same familiars King Baby effects. For a list of the familiars unaffected by this trinket, visit King Baby's page.

• Throwable familiars do not return to Isaac upon impact; instead, they treat their impact location as their new "launch" location, and can be fired in any direction from there. The only exception is Jaw Bone which will return to the location it was launched from.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Familiars gain contact damage, dealing 2 damage per tick (about 8.6 damage per second). Having both increases the damage to 5 per tick (about 21.4 damage per second).

• Friendship Necklace + Spin to Win: Familiars affected by Friendship Necklace are still considered orbitals regardless of positioning allowing Isaac to use their contact damage without getting close to enemies. RC Remote also prevents familiars that weren't already orbitals from flashing when Spin to Win is used despite still being affected by the active item.

• King Baby: Familiars are not held in place while firing but still auto-target enemies.

• Lilith: Incubus can be positioned on top of Lilith, effectively removing Lilith's downside.

• Tainted Forgotten: Familiars will move with Tainted Soul, and not follow behind Tainted Forgotten like they normally do. This is massively beneficial as it allows Tainted Soul to have actual protection against enemies. Orbitals still remain orbiting Tainted Forgotten as expected.

fields.description: Instead of trailing behind Isaac, familiars are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.

R Key.title: R Key
R Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in Chapter 1, with all stat boosts, items, pickups, and trinkets intact, similar to a Victory Lap. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Angel Rooms once again become possible to appear even if the player has made a previous devil deal.

• The chance for a Planetarium to appear can once again be increased above 1% without a Telescope Lens, even if the player has previously entered a Planetarium.

• If the Donation Machine was jammed before usage, it will no longer be jammed.

• True Co-Op players can be spawned at the first room after using the R Key.

• If used in a run while achievements and character unlocks are enabled, they will still be enabled after use. Similarly, if these are disabled because the player is in a Victory Lap or seeded run, they will remain disabled after use.

• Beware that using R Key during a Victory Lap will reset the lap counter to 0, as though every Victory Lap is considered part of the same run. Shops will appear as normal, and no items will be removed upon starting the next lap. However, the character will remain The Lost if it had been changed, and the game will remain on Hard difficulty.

• The timer and score do not reset.

• This means that the timer requirements to access Boss Rush, ???, and Broken Shovel 1 do NOT reset.

• Item pools are not reset. This means that another R Key can't spawn (and neither can any other items that were already encountered).

• The 13 pill pool does not reset, unlike with a victory lap.

• Due to the acquisition of Key Piece 1 and Key Piece 2 being dependent on whether or not the items are currently in Isaac's possession, R Key may be used to revisit previous floors and collect the pieces again after already consuming them in the Chest or Dark Room to unlock Mega Satan's door.

• Since Knife Piece 1 and Knife Piece 2 will spawn any time their respective floors are visited, R Key may be used to revisit these floors and obtain multiple copies of the items.

• In scenarios where R Key can be purchased, it uniquely costs 99 coins instead of 15.

• This rule does not apply to the extra shop created by Member Card.

• This rule also does not apply to devil deals spawned by A Pound of Flesh.

• Despite this, using IX - The Hermit? on R Key will still only spawn 15 coins.

• In Greed mode, using the item after jamming the Greed Donation Machine will fix the machine, while also preserving the coin total the machine had before jamming.

• R Key cannot be obtained in the Daily Challenge.

• This includes through use of a Death Certificate.

• If an achievement is obtained in the final room of a floor, e.g defeating Delirium for the first time, the achievements are awarded to the player once they complete the first floor of the new run.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • ? Card: Activates R Key without consuming it, allowing for multiple run restarts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Dad's Note: Using R Key during the Ascent sequence will end it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• R Key originates from the Antibirth mod.

• This item is a reference to how holding down the R key on PC will restart a run.

• This item is very similar to Clone from Enter the Gungeon. The only difference is that R Key is an activated item while Clone is a passive item that activates upon death.

• Although unobtainable in challenges, if used in the Backasswards challenge, R key will send you back to Mega Satan.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: While difficult, it is possible to use R Key while swapping it out with another active item, allowing to bring a different active item to the restarted run.
Bug note: If Sprinkler is used on the room the R Key is used in, the sprinkler will come with Isaac to the starting room.
Bug note: If you use the R Key then spawn in a True Co-Op player and restart the game, the Co-Op players' active item and health will disappear.
Bug note: If you use the R Key during a victory lap, then exit and re-enter the run, unlocks will be re-enabled.

fields.description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.

Rag Man.title: Rag Man
Rag Man.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Rag Man is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] In all environments of Chapter 1 (Basement, Cellar, Burning Basement).

• [Repentance] Only in the Cellar and the Burning Basement. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Rag Man chases Isaac if there are no Rag Man's Raglings alive and can stop to perform the following attacks:

• Throws his head towards Isaac. The head rolls for a bit, after which it turns into a Rag Man's Ragling. His head then reappears on his body. While his head is rolling, his body walks around aimlessly, occasionally shooting a homing projectile in a random direction, behaving similar to a Gusher.

• The head has 25 HP and can be shot to damage both Rag Man and the Ragling spawned from it.

• Rag Man's Raglings leave remains on the ground after death. If the head is destroyed before transforming, it still creates a Ragling's remains.

• Rag Man can only spawn up to 4 Raglings.

• If there are any Rag Man's Raglings alive, Rag Man switches from chasing Isaac to following one of his Raglings.

• Revives all nearby Raglings from their remains and heals himself for 10 HP during the process, regardless of the number of Raglings resurrected.

• By doing this, he can overheal above his original HP amount of 200.

• Fires 1, 3, or 5 homing projectiles at Isaac in quick succession.
Once Rag Man is killed, his Raglings' remains disappear, and the Raglings that are still alive won't leave remains upon death.

• [Repentance] Raglings that are still alive will instantly die once Rag Man is killed even if they were not originally spawned by Rag Man himself.

• However, they will not die if they're in their spawning/head stage when Rag Man was killed.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 18] : The head roll attack spawns 1-2 Spiders instead of a Ragling. He fires a spray of 3 arcing projectiles, instead of a resurrection attack. He can perform this attack at any time and it will still heal him.
[bc: 1] : Does not fire homing bullets, and instead constantly creates and revives Raglings. The Raglings spawned by this version have the same red color as Rag Man and have 19.8 HP (34% less than the normal ones).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Rag Man will often be accompanied by his own Raglings at the start of the battle, but they aren't able to leave remains upon death.

• He can also start surrounded by 8 spiders.

• The health bar of Rag Man will flash orange for a short time to indicate that he is healing.

• Killing Rag Man's spawned Raglings with Lusty Blood doesn't boost Isaac's damage.

• Rag Man's head can be caught using the Friendly Ball.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• His name comes from a Magic: The Gathering card.

• According to a tweet by Edmund McMillen, the theme comes from an old character he made years ago, called "Ghost".

• Rag Man is referred to as male in Edmund's design documents.

• Edmund mentioned that it is highly likely that Rag Man can be also be found in Crawl Spaces in addition to being a normal boss. However, this is not the case, though Rag Man can be found in an I AM ERROR room and a [Before Afterbirth+] Closet.

• Rag Man is also a term for the Devil.

• Rag Man is very similar in appearance to a Mummy, the result of an ancient practice to preserve corpses by embalming them and wrapping them in bandages.

• If Rag Man's head is Shrunk while rolling, a lower body can be seen.

• Rag Mega is an evolved version of Rag Man.

• Originally, the End Is Nigh's protagonist, Ash, was going to look similar to Rag Man, but with legs and one arm. However, Edmund thought the design looked bad, so he cut off his body and removed the rags.

Rag Mega.title: Rag Mega
Rag Mega.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rag Mega is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth † that can appear in all environments of Chapter 2 (Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves).

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Rag Mega spawns with 3 Purple Balls which are immune to damage and block shots. They circle around him as he floats around the room while he performs the following attacks:

• Each time Rag Mega loses around 25% HP, he breaks off a Purple Ball which starts to chase Isaac.

• Periodically wraps his body in bandages and becomes immune to damage.

• Spawns a Rag Man's Ragling. They will leave remains on the ground after death.

• Fires 3 beams from the sky that travel outwards. If the beam hits the remains of a dead Ragling, it is revived.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Little Horn shots can kill the Purple Balls.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• It appears to be an "evolved" variant of Rag Man.

• Rag Mega looks and behaves similarly to The Duke of Flies.

• Although it is an upgraded version of Rag Man, it has 80 less health.

• This is likely due to the fact that Rag Mega can become invincible for extended periods and has tear-blocking Purple Balls, making him harder to damage.

Dark Ball.title: Dark Ball
Dark Ball.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dark Balls chase Isaac, flying at a moderate pace and take increased knockback from tears. They're most often encountered when spawned by Little Horn, Big Horn, and Blisters but can be sometimes encountered in some rare rooms in the Caves or Flooded Caves as well as Mausoleum rooms with Bishops. The Dark Balls Big Horn can spawn are larger and can either behave normally or have different behavior where they travel diagonally, bouncing off walls.

sections.heading: Purple Ball
sections.text:
Purple Balls behave similarly to regular Dark Balls, but are immune to all damage. 3 of them will always spawn orbiting Rag Mega and detach to chase Isaac as the boss's HP drops. Cultists spawn a variant of Purple Balls that are indestructible but slowly transform into vulnerable Dark Balls.

Purple Balls can be destroyed by any instant kill effects, such as Little Horn or Ace of Diamonds.

sections.heading: Visage Plasma
sections.text: Visage Plasma are similar to the Dark Balls summoned by Big Horn and slowly float diagonally around the room bouncing off walls. If The Visage's mask is deactivated, one will travel towards it to revive the mask. If there are 3 alive at once, they can be absorbed by The Visage's heart to heal it and cause it to perform a special attack.

sections.heading: Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball
sections.text: Ultra Pestilence Fly Balls behave like regular Dark Balls and float towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. Each time it takes enough damage it spawns an Ultra Pestilence Fly and can spawn multiple at once if it takes a large singular amount of damage. Upon death, it leaves behind another Ultra Pestilence Fly.

Maw.title: Maw
Maw.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[distinguish: Mr. Maw; Mega Maw] 

Maws slowly drift towards Isaac while spitting a blood shot at him when near him, the latter behavior is similar to that of Horfs.

They resemble pale floating heads with misshapen eye sockets that drip blood and an open mouth with only two teeth.

sections.heading: Red Maw
sections.text:
Red Maws float towards Isaac considerably faster than the Maw but do not fire any projectiles. Instead it will fire 4 blood shots in cardinal directions upon death, similar to Suckers.

They resemble other types of Maw, but with pink skin and a their mouth stitched shut, as if to prevent blood shots from being fired.

sections.heading: Psychic Maw
sections.text:
Psychic Maws behave identically to Maws but fire purple homing shots that deal a whole heart of damage. Similar to the Hanger, the Psychic Maw will always spawn with an Eternal Fly circling it.

The Psychic Maw resembles a pale floating head with its eyes and mouth stitched shut and a third eye opened in its forehead dripping blood. The third eye emits a small purple fire.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If you slow, stun or fear a Maw at the same time that it tries to shoot Isaac, its sound effect will loop infinitely until the Maw is killed.

Trite.title: Trite
Trite.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the enemy; the trinket; Blister] 

The Trite is a spider variant of the Hoppers. Leaps with less frequency, but at greater distances. This can make them extremely dangerous, as they could potentially leap from one side of the room to the other, catching the player off guard.

sections.heading: Ragling
sections.text: The Ragling is a variant to the normal Trite. They do not leap as often as the Trite and rarely move directly towards Isaac but gains the ability to occasionally shoot 2 magenta-colored orbiting shots.

sections.heading: Rag Man's Ragling
sections.text: Rag Man's Ragling is an alternate version of the Ragling that behave like normal Raglings but have more health. They can be spawned by Rag Man and Rag Mega and used as a part of their attacks. If they were spawned by Rag Man or by Rag Mega, they will leave a pile of Rags upon death, from which Rag Man and Rag Mega can revive them. If Rag Man or Rag Mega is killed before them, then they will not leave Rags behind.

sections.heading: Blister
sections.text: A Blister is a Trite variant that has much higher health but leaps very slowly. They occasionally spawn a Dark Ball like the ones spawned by Little Horn. They spawn a Sack upon death.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • If Blisters aren't unlocked yet, they are replaced by Trites in Normal mode, or Ticking Spiders in Hard mode.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A trite is the name of a genus of the jumping spider family.

• Trites share the same name with an enemy in Doom 3, an enemy that leaps towards the player and has an upside-down human-like face.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Blisters were given a shooting animation in Booster Pack #5, based on this Steam Workshop mod by TheShadyOne.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Blisters originally had 54 base hp and 0 stage hp; however, this was changed in Booster Pack #5.

• Blisters had the fifth-highest base health of all the non-boss enemies, after Dingas, Mama Guts, MemBrains, and Oobs.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If a Blister is scared, stunned, or shrunken, the Blister will still attack Isaac by chasing him or spawning Dark Balls.

Wall Creep.title: Wall Creep
Wall Creep.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wall Creeps will try to line up with Isaac, and shoot three blood shots quickly in a horizontal line. They walk moderately quickly on the wall they were originally placed onto and they cannot move on another wall. They have a long blood-shot range, but Isaac can attack them safely by shooting diagonally.

sections.heading: Blind Creep
sections.text: Blind Creeps will crawl along walls randomly and shoot 3 spreading blood shots, like The Inner Eye. They are slower than Wall Creeps, fire less frequently and do not directly target Isaac, but their shots are less predictable.

sections.heading: The Thing
sections.text:
The Thing will try to line up with Isaac and spit a line of damaging Red Creep. The creep has a fairly long range, spanning about half of the width of a normal-sized room. During this attack, a tongue will protrude from its mouth which can deal contact damage.

After it uses its Creep attack, it will not be able to do so again until the Creep has faded, although it will still be moving to follow Isaac with its tongue out.

sections.heading: Rage Creep
sections.text: Rage Creeps will try to line up with Isaac and fire a Brimstone laser. They are much slower than other Creeps and also take more time to charge up their attacks, but they have infinite range and their laser instantly travels across the room, forcing Isaac to be careful when dealing with them, especially when there are many Rage Creeps in the same room.

sections.heading: Soy Creep
sections.text: Soy Creeps will try to line up with Isaac and fire a continuous stream of shots that are seemingly affected by Soy Milk. Their range is quite impressive, rendering them able to hit Isaac when he cannot see them. In dark areas, the rooms are illuminated by their eyes.

sections.heading: Tainted Soy Creep
sections.text: The Tainted Soy Creeps appear in the Ascent path and will fire continuous streams of tears, similar to the Soy Creep. These streams are shot diagonally in four directions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Rage Creeps can kill other enemies with their Brimstone laser.

• Unlike other Creeps, The Thing can be a Champion.

• [Repentance] Wall Creeps also have Champion forms.

• [Repentance] If The Thing isn't unlocked yet, it will be replaced by Wall Creeps in Normal mode, or Blind Creeps in Hard Mode.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Thing is a reference to the eponymous movie.

• Their sprites prior to Repentance consist of a red-colored Blind Creep with a stitched mouth and a Nerve Ending reused as a tongue.

• The Thing is one of five enemies (four without Repentance, three without Afterbirth+) in the game that uses Creep as projectiles, the others are Conjoined Fatty, Bloaty, Ultra Pride and Meatball.

• Soy Creeps are from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Soy Creeps were named Soi Creeps.

• They originally were able to spawn in Caves, Catacombs, Depths, and Necropolis.

• [Repentance] There is an unused version of a Rage Creep known as a Split Rage Creep which shot two Brimstone lasers at diagonal angles instead of one.

• [Repentance] An unused Repentance boss called Raglich would have spawned rag themed Creeps known as Rag Creeps which are also unused.

• [Repentance] Soy Creeps and Tainted Soy Creeps' eyes glow bright white in dark rooms.
