Rainbow Worm.title: Rainbow Worm
Rainbow Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears gain a worm trinket effect that changes every 3 seconds of the in-game timer. The effects include:

• Pulse Worm

• Ring Worm

• Tape Worm

• Whip Worm

• Wiggle Worm

• Flat Worm

• Hook Worm

• Lazy Worm

• Ouroboros Worm

• Brain Worm

• The order of the effects is always as above, in a cycle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Pin, Larry Jr., The Hollow or Scolex. [end edition note] 

• Rainbow Worm can't give the effects of worms that are already in effect (with Mom's Purse or Belly Button) or ones that were gulped.

• Therefore, somehow gulping all the worm trinkets in one run makes Rainbow Worm useless.

• [Repentance] Rainbow Worm acts as giving a second copy of worms you're currently holding, usually doubling any stat increases of the worm.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Mom's Box: Doubles the effect of each worm.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box / Rainbow Worm : Having Rainbow Worm as a Golden Trinket doubles the effect of each worm if possible whereas having Mom's Box triples them.

• Having both quadruples the effect of each worm if possible.

• Tractor Beam: The altered patterns tears travel in is confined to the beam allowing Isaac to benefit from the stat bonuses granted without losing accuracy.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This trinket is used in Challenge #28 (PRIDE DAY!).

Range.title: Range
Range.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Range determines how long tears will travel before landing and is represented by a bow and arrow.

[Before Repentance] This attribute's name is misleading because Range determines the time that a shot stays in the air rather than the "distance" that it travels. The effective Range is calculated based on said travel time, Shot Speed, and Tear Falling Speed. Range cannot be lowered below 5.0 but has no upper limit. Internally, this attribute is called Tear Height, and also affects the starting height that tears spawn at.

• [Repentance] Range now represents how many tiles a tear will travel. Range cannot be lowered below 1.0, but has no upper limit. Tear Height no longer represents this attribute and no longer affects effective range.

Extremely high Tear Height makes Isaac's tears start so high in the air they can cross over obstacles as if they were spectral, but they won't go through room walls. Once the tears fall down, they will start hitting obstacles again. This compounds with Tear Falling Speed.

Each character's base Range is as follows:

Tainted Eve Tainted Azazel Dead Tainted Lazarus Tainted Lost Tainted Lilith Tainted Keeper Tainted Apollyon Tainted Forgotten Tainted Bethany Tainted Jacob | 6.5

| Esau | 8.0

• Azazel: The mini-Brimstone beam doesn't calculate its Range the same way as normal tear attacks, so his Range stat is misleading. His attack has a much shorter Range than other characters with the same value.

• Eden and Tainted Eden: Range is a random value between 5.0 and 8.0, inclusive.

• The Forgotten and Tainted Forgotten: Their melee attacks don't calculate their Range the same way as normal tear attacks, and their actual attack Range is far less than other characters with the same value.

• The Soul: Tear attack range works normally.

• Tainted Soul: Incapable of firing tears. The range of the thrown Forgotten body is unaffected by Range.

• Tainted Magdalene: The lethal hug is unaffected by Range. Tear attack range works normally.

• Tainted Samson: The melee attack in the berserk state doesn't calculate its Range in the same way as normal tear attacks, and its actual attack Range is far less than other characters with the same value. Tear attack range for non-berserk state works normally.

• Tainted Azazel: The thin Brimstone beam has unlimited Range, while Hemoptysis is not affected by Range, so his Range stat isn't commonly relevant.

sections.heading: Other
sections.text:
• Range Up pills increase Range by [Before Repentance] 2.5 [Repentance] 1.25, and Range Down pills decrease Range by [Before Repentance] 2 [Repentance] 1.

• [Afterbirth onward] In co-op, Long Baby will occasionally briefly increase Range, Shot Speed, and Tear Falling Speed. Dark Baby will occasionally briefly increase all stats, including Range. Dripping Baby will occasionally briefly grant Anemic, increasing Range.

• XI - Strength activates the Magic Mushroom effect for the current room, which increases Range.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Absorbing an item using Black Rune can increase Range by 2.5.

• Huge Growth and [Repentance] horse Power Pill! increases Range, Damage, and Isaac's size for the current room.

Raw Liver.title: Raw Liver
Raw Liver.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Gives Isaac 2 Red Heart containers and fully restores Isaac's health.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Cursed!.

• Edmund McMillen mentions Raw Liver on his first post-Repentance Lore Stream, and relates two things without directly stating which one (if any, or if both) inspired the Raw Liver item.

• The first thing McMillen relates is the phrase "I ate his liver with some fava beans and a nice Chianti", which is a quote from the character of Hannibal Lecter, a serial killing cannibal in the 1991 film The Silence of The Lambs.

• The second statement is a personal anecdote from McMillen about abuse he suffered at the hands of his step-father while growing up at the age of six. According to Edmund, he was offered raw chicken's liver to eat by his step-father, and upon accepting and finding the taste to be unpleasant, was still forced to eat as much as he could before being taken to the bathroom and told under duress to vomit up the liver.

• Raw Liver’s sprites can be seen as part of Binge Eater despite Raw Liver not being a food item affected by Binge Eater.

fields.name: Raw Liver
fields.description: Grants 2 Red Heart containers and completely restores health.

Razor Blade.title: Razor Blade
Razor Blade.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On use, damages Isaac for a full heart of health and grants +1.2 damage for the current room.

• Razor Blade takes Red Hearts before other heart types.

• [Repentance] When used more than once in the same room, damage taken is lowered to half a heart.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth onward] Eve starts with this item after unlocking it and donating 439 coins to the Greed Donation Machine. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Both conditions must be met for Eve to hold it; donating 439 coins before defeating Satan with Eve will wrongly state on Eve's profile on the Character Selection Screen that she has it equipped.

• [Repentance] Eve starts with the Razor Blade if unlocked from the Greed Machine, even if Satan has not been defeated with Eve.

• [Before Repentance] If Isaac has half a red heart left, Razor Blade will damage other heart types.

• It is possible to die using Razor Blade if Isaac does not have enough hearts.

• The effect stacks with itself and Red Patch, which provides a similar benefit.

• Using this item does not affect Devil Room/Angel Room chances.

• Using the Razor Blade grants immunity frames; this allows access to Curse Rooms without losing soul hearts.

• [Afterbirth onward] Using this item in the Ultra Greed boss room will remove 2-4 coins and drop 1-3 pennies on the floor, as if Isaac was hit by an enemy attack. [end edition note] 

• Using this item as The Lost will kill The Lost, even if the protective effect from Holy Mantle is still active.

• [Repentance] This interaction will kill Isaac while temporarily transformed into The Lost by a White Fire Place, even when he would otherwise have enough hearts to survive.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Invulnerability / Shield: The Razor can be used at no cost while invulnerability / shield is active, allowing damage to be significantly increased for the room.

• Book of Belial interaction: Invokes the effect of The Necronomicon effect along with the original effect.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns red wisps in the middle ring. Wisps have higher health.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's Heart: Isaac cannot take damage from the Razor Blade, allowing for infinite uses of the item.

• Old Bandage / Shard of Glass: Isaac has a chance to drop a red heart while using the item.

• Panic Button: Self-damage occurs before enemy damage, making it almost impossible to lose Angel or Devil chance.

• [Before Repentance] The Polaroid: Isaac takes no damage while invincible, allowing for repeated free uses of the item.

• The Wafer: Isaac loses half a heart instead of a full heart.

• Whore of Babylon/Dark Prince's Crown: Can lower Isaac's health on demand to activate the bonus.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Holy Mantle / Similar effects: The shield is not broken, but Razor Blade still damages Isaac.

• [Repentance] Shield / Invulnerability: Will not protect against this item's damage.

• [Repentance] Tainted Samson / Berserk!: The Razor Blade can be used in order to gain a massive damage boost in a room as long as there's a source of HP within reach. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Darkness Falls.

• The item itself is a reference to the act of cutting one's self, usually at the wrists, to inflict self-harm or to commit suicide by loss of blood.

• Isaac's appearance after using the item is just like the Dople.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, Razor Blade was unlocked by defeating Mom's Heart / It Lives! as Eve.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: As Eve, there is a very unlikely chance that using this to activate Whore of Babylon will not activate it, despite being at the correct health to do so.

fields.description: Damages Isaac for one heart and grants +1.2 damage for the current room. [Repentance] Subsequent uses in the same room only take half a heart.

Reap Creep.title: Reap Creep
Reap Creep.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reap Creep is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in the Depths and the Dank Depths, as well as in the Mines in the alternate path.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
Upon spawning, Reap Creep jumps up to the top of the Boss Room similarly to The Haunt. It starts off taking Wall Creep's form and can perform the following attacks:

• Spawns a Wall Creep on either the left, right or bottom wall.

• Spews out a continuous stream of projectiles vertically while attempting to follow Isaac's movements.

• When reaching near the end of either wall, it leaves a gap between the stream and the wall.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
After losing 33% health, Reap Creep takes Blind Creep's form and has new attacks:

• Spews a huge number of disorganized projectiles, similar to Monstro, but larger.

• Spews out a wide spread of spaced projectiles.

• Spawns 3-4 Spiders or a Trite downwards.

sections.heading: Phase 3
sections.text:
After losing 66% health, Reap Creep takes Rage Creep's form and has new attacks:

• Slams itself against either the left or right wall, causing rock projectiles and 3-4 Spiders to fall from the ceiling.

• If it's fought in the Mines, 3-4 Rock Spiders fall instead.

• Charges for a moderate period of time before shooting a wide Brimstone laser while attempting to follow Isaac's movements.

• When reaching near the end of either wall, it leaves a gap between the laser and the wall.

• Charges for a long period of time before shooting 4 regular Brimstone lasers diagonally outwards while attempting to follow Isaac's movements. The beams slowly come together leaving a small gap within the center.

• The two Brimstone attacks have distinct charge sounds, allowing the player to distinguish them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Reap Creep's arena always has a hollow upper layer, preventing Isaac from getting too close with it. This makes the situation tricky if Isaac somehow has to deal damage with melee or grounded attacks.

• Due to this, as of V1.06.J791, Reap Creep cannot appear in the Scat Man challenge.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Reap Creep originates from a Reddit post by NotYourSaggitarius in 2015, as a boss mockup. The boss was later incorporated into the Antibirth mod.

• Originally in Antibirth, killing it, Baby Plum and The Pile were necessary to unlock Antibirth's alternate chapters.

• Reap Creep is one of two bosses that can appear in both the main path and the alternate path, the other being The Pile.

• Because of this, its battle theme will be different, depending on where it's fought. If it's fought in The Depths or the Dank Depths, either Crusade or Cerebrum Dispersio will play, while if it's fought in the Mines, Juggernaut will play.

• It is the boss version of Wall Creeps, Blind Creeps and Rage Creeps.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If Tainted Forgotten's body is thrown next to the boss during Phase 3, it will continuously charge in place against the body, making for an easy kill.

Recall.title: Recall
Recall.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: It is available solely for Tainted Forgotten as his Birthright effect.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Retrieves the Tainted Forgotten's body automatically, even from a distance.

• Tainted Soul is invincible while Tainted Forgotten is returning to him (except to Devil Beggars and similar forms of self-damage).

• Tainted Forgotten will deal ~4-6 times Isaac's damage to enemies that collide with it while it's returning to the Soul.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item is not in any item pool and is set to be hidden from appearing in any normal scenario. The only way to obtain it is by picking up Birthright as Tainted Forgotten which will give Tainted Forgotten the item in the consumable slot.

• It can, however, activate when using Metronome. This does nothing with most characters, however it will return Tainted Forgotten's body to him if it is activated.

• Re-rolling Birthright via D4, D100 or similar items will not remove Recall from the consumable slot.

• The item cannot be used while the Soul is holding the body or the body is traveling after it has been thrown. Trying to use it will not waste its charge.

• Obtaining Recall on any other character has no effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The name of the item could be a joke relating to the antonym of Forgotten, as in 'recalling memories'.

fields.description: Retrieves the Forgotten's body from any distance. Only available as the Birthright effect for Tainted Forgotten.

Red Candle.title: Red Candle
Red Candle.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On use, Isaac raises the candle above his head. On pressing a fire button, a red flame, similar to a Red Fire Place, will fire in the chosen direction. It can pass over pits, but can not travel through obstacles.

• [Before Repentance] The flame deals 23 damage per tick, and can hit up to 5 times for a maximum of 115 damage per flame.

• [Repentance] The flame can hit up to 4 times, and the damage decreases as the flame shrinks. The first hit deals 23 damage, the second hit deals 17.5 damage, and the last two ticks deal 11.5 damage, for a maximum of 63.25 damage per flame.

• The flame also destroys enemy shots it comes into contact with, which decreases its size each time being hit until the flame is entirely extinguished by this process.

• [Before Repentance] The flame projectile is persistent and will remain active in the room until it deals a set amount of damage.

• [Repentance] Flames will disappear automatically after 10 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] While Isaac holds the candle above his head, his movement speed is reduced.

• [Before Repentance] There is no limit to the number of fires that can be active. This is useful in situations where mob spawning can be controlled: for example, beating Boss Rush or Greed Mode as The Lost. This is time-consuming but can be viable if other sources of damage are weak or unreliable.

• [Before Repentance] It will block Isaac's tears but won't burn him. Isaac's tears can also shrink the size of the flame.

• [Repentance] Flames do not block Isaac's shots, nor are they put out by them.

• Flames will destroy Shopkeepers.

• [Repentance] Flames will turn certain enemies (such as Hoppers and Clotty) into their flaming variants, making them stronger. The flame is unable to damage these monsters.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns red wisps in the middle ring. The wisps shoot small flames instead of tears, with a very high tear delay; flames last for 5 seconds or until they block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage. The wisps do not persist between rooms, and the damage they deal does not increase with BFFS! or scale up on later floors.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: [Repentance+] Spawns a second flame that travels a shorter distance.

• [Before Repentance] The Ludovico Technique: When the fire hits the tear, the tear resets and appears again on the player. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Legend of Zelda, a major inspiration for The Binding of Isaac, also has a red candle item that can be activated to create flames for burning enemies and bushes, as well as lighting dark rooms. Unlike in Isaac however, where the red candle is unlocked first, the blue candle is the inferior version of the red one, which can be activated only once per room.

• The Candle is a variation of this item unlocked after donating 900 coins, diminishing over time as opposed to contact.

• The pickup quote of this item is a reference to the catchphrase of the Human Torch, a member of the Marvel Comics Fantastic Four.

• This item can be found as one of the Nintendo-themed Treasure Room items in the 6th of December's Daily Run, which is an homage to the late CEO of Nintendo, Satoru Iwata.

fields.name: Red Candle
fields.description: Throws out a flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it hits enemies or blocks shots.

Red Key.title: Red Key
Red Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, creates a Red Room next to a wall where there would be no conditions that could prevent a room from spawning there (i.e., the same conditions for a Secret Room to spawn). This is indicated by red door outlines on walls.

• These rooms are most commonly normal rooms, but have a 10% chance to be a special room instead, even including Red Devil Rooms or Angel Rooms.

• Red special rooms of any kind can appear on every floor.

• These rooms use a special Red Room icon on the map.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The types of special rooms that a Red Room can be are the following:

• All rooms made by Red Key will be 1x1 rooms that can have doors available on all sides.

• All doors within a Red Room will be unlocked or opened, regardless of the room type they lead to. This can open Secret Rooms, and normally inaccessible Challenge Rooms if they are adjacent to a Red Room. Red Room doors will also stay permanently open in the case of Challenge Rooms.

• In Home, Isaac can create a "Red Room" on the left side of the map right under Mom's room. This room will actually be a closet containing a non-tainted character's Tainted form.

• If the respective Tainted character has already been found or a Tainted character is played, the room will contain Inner Child instead. If Inner Child has not been unlocked, the room will contain a Shopkeeper.

• [Repentance+] In Online Co-Op, each player will unlock the Tainted version of the character they are playing as, regardless of whether they are alive or not, and if they are alive, they will also see the correct character, else seeing the host's character. However, if the host is playing as a Tainted character, the room will not contain any Tainted characters even if other players have not found their respective Tainted character, and the character will not be unlocked for anyone.

• If a door created by Red Key takes Isaac outside of the 13x13 area of the floor, he will be taken to the I AM ERROR room.

• The starting room of a floor is always in the center of the 13x13 area.

• This does not occur in Corpse II, Dark Room, Chest, The Void, or the special version of Mausoleum / Gehenna II containing Dad's Note. No door outlines will appear at any boundary walls.

• • Additionally, this doesn't work during Red Redemption.

• The I AM ERROR room door can only be created while already inside a Red Room. Normal rooms will not show the red outline if they are at the map's boundary.

• Special Red Rooms can be versions that aren't normally encountered without a specific item or character.

• These include:

• • Tainted Keeper's Shops, which can additionally contain items from the Boss and Treasure Room pools, and offer trinkets for sale.

• • Voodoo Head's Curse Rooms.

• • Cain's Birthright Arcades.

• • More Options' double item Treasure Rooms.

• • Pay to Win's Shop Restock Machine Treasure Rooms.

• • More Options' and Pay to Win's combined double item Treasure Rooms with a Shop Restock Machine.

• These do not include:

• • Number Magnet's Devil Rooms.

• • The Stairway's Angel Rooms.

• • Devil's Crown's Devil Treasure Rooms.

• Red Key can't overwrite Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms. This can be used to discern their locations by finding walls that don't have red door outlines that would otherwise be valid Red Room spots.

• Red Key can't create a room adjacent to the Boss Room on most floors, with some exceptions:

• Red Key can create a room adjacent to Hush's room in the top right where the room that leads to The Void usually generates. The door to this looks like a crack. This Red Room can only be created when Isaac is in another Red Room adjacent to it, i.e. from branching off one of the Treasure Room.

• • Isaac can enter Hush's room from this crack, but going the other direction will lead him to the Entrance Portal room.

• • Isaac also can't create Red Rooms adjacent to the Shop on this floor either.

• Red Key can create rooms adjacent to most Boss Rooms in The Void, including Delirium's room. This can be used to find a Boss Room door leading to what would be an empty space (though this may find Mr. Fred instead).

• Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the Boss Room in the Mirrored World of Downpour / Dross II.

• Red Key can create rooms adjacent to the first Boss Room if [cu: Labyrinth] takes effect on the floor.

• When Isaac enters any Red Room adjacent to the Ultra Secret Room, it immediately appears on the map along with the Secret Room jingle, and its door will automatically open.

• If Isaac encounters a Red special room, all of its doors will be its special theme doors.

• All doors in a Red Curse Room still feature spikes, which will damage Isaac if he decides to enter/exit.

• A Red Vault's doors or a Red Dice Room's doors each require two keys to open. The door where Isaac uses Red Key will be automatically unlocked, but the other doors remain locked until Isaac goes through them from inside or unlocks them from outside.

• Multiple Red special rooms of the same type can spawn on one floor.

• All Red Sacrifice Rooms will have their own independent use counters and rewards.

• If Isaac has a teleport to a specific room (XVII - The Stars, IX - The Hermit, Teleport 2.0, etc.) and has created a special room such that there are multiple of a certain type on one floor, the teleport will choose randomly between each room.

• However, if Isaac has found a Red Planetarium, XVII - The Stars will always teleport Isaac to it over any Treasure Rooms.

• It is possible to obtain Knife Piece 1 outside of the intended method by spawning the Treasure Room that contains it in Downpour / Dross.

• Red Rooms in Downpour/Dross can contain White Fire Places as well.

• Isaac is able to create Red Rooms in the Mirrored World of Downpour / Dross II. They will be reflections of the original floor's Red Rooms, and special rooms created in this way will still be empty.

• Red Rooms can't be created around the Mine Cart Room of Mines / Ashpit II.

• Red Rooms on these floors can contain the yellow buttons used to build the mine cart track; however, these ones do nothing.

• Red Rooms in Chapter 3 can contain Marked Skulls even before the Ascent is unlocked.

• When in Dark Room or Chest, their spawn room containing their respective chests can be created by Red Key. These will function the same way regular chests of their respective type would on Dark Room/Chest outside the starting room.

• New Mega Satan doors can't be found in these rooms.

• Red Treasure Rooms will be present in the Ascent, and will not replace regular Treasure Rooms.

• If a red Sacrifice Room appears in the Dark Room and Isaac teleports via the 12th or higher sacrifice, Isaac will be sent back to the starting room without restarting the floor.

• If a red Sacrifice Room appears in The Void, then it is possible to defeat The Lamb after taking the path through Chest. This makes it possible, without the use of R Key, to get up to 8 Completion Marks in the same run if playing quickly.

• Red Key can be obtained by using Pandora's Box at Home.

• Greed, Super Greed, and Krampus can spawn in red Mini-Boss Rooms.

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight Cracked Keys.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Creates a Red Key wisp in the middle ring. The wisps have a chance to create Red Rooms when Isaac enters an unexplored room.

• Broken Glasses / Devil's Crown / More Options: Affects Red Treasure Rooms.

• Judas' Tongue / Keeper's Bargain / Number Magnet / A Pound of Flesh / Sanguine Bond: Affects Red Devil Rooms.

• Luna: Affects Red Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms.

• Mama Mega!: Will trigger its effect in new Red Rooms, provided it has already been used on the floor.

• Spelunker Hat: Instantly reveals the Ultra Secret Room if it is adjacent to the Red Room created.

• Found Soul: If Found Soul is positioned against a different wall, activating the Red Key will open two red rooms at once: One near Isaac, and one near Found Soul.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: Usually generates fewer than 1 charge per room, as Red Rooms are always 1x1.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Member Card: The trap door will always lead to the same special room as the regular Shop.

• Pay to Win: No effect on Red Treasure Rooms.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Red Redemption.

• In the Antibirth mod, this item used to be unlocked by defeating The Witness (Now known as Mother) as Cain.

• During the Kickstarter campaign for The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls Requiem, the Red Key was revealed to be present in Repentance by developer Kilburn.

• Red Rooms may be a reference to the Plagues of Egypt in the Bible where the tenth and final plague, death of first-born, could be prevented by painting lambs blood on their doors, making them red.

fields.description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.

Red Patch.title: Red Patch
Red Patch.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
Notes
sections.text: • Can trigger multiple times in the same room and stack with itself or Razor Blade, which provides a similar effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 33% and having both to 50%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This trinket has the same flavor text as Samson's Lock.

fields.name: Red Patch
fields.description: Grants a chance to gain +1.8 damage for the current room upon taking damage.

Red Stew.title: Red Stew
Red Stew.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On pickup, fully heals Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 damage up.

• The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the damage formula works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.

• While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to Lusty Blood, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Due to the high amount of damage you temporarily gain, this item is extremely effective in Greed Mode, as all fights are done within the same room and you are easily able to make the most out of it.

• The damage bonuses on kills can exceed the damage increase given from picking up Red Stew.

• The default length of Red Stew is 5390 game frames, which is just short of 3 minutes. (This will be the length if no enemies are killed during the effect.)

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Rock Bottom: The damage up becomes permanent and if Isaac kills enemies fast enough it can increase even further. It would be difficult to gain further damages 3 minutes later, but the first damage up is so high that this isn't a real problem.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn’t grant the damage bonus.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Turning enemies into poop doesn’t grant the damage bonus.

• Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen don't grant the damage bonus.

• [Repentance+] Frozen enemies do grant the damage bonus.

• Red Stew: Picking up another stew will reset the bonus to its full amount.

• Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Red Stew originates from the Antibirth mod.

• In the Book of Genesis in the Bible, Esau sold his birthright to his younger brother, Jacob, for a serving of lentil stew, so that Jacob would receive their dying father's blessing instead.

• The item's powerful but temporary effects reflect this exchange, akin to the idiom "to sell one's birthright for a mess of pottage", which itself alludes to the Genesis story.

• Prior to V1.7.5, Red Stew was the only unlockable item added in Repentance with a quality of 0.

fields.description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.

Redemption.title: Redemption
Redemption.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon entering a Devil Room, a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a Soul Heart and +1.0 damage.

• Taking anything generated by the room (items or consumables) will result in the icon going away, including opening Red Chests / Black Sacks.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• After Isaac has taken a Devil Deal, while a Confessional would give an Angel Room, it has a 100% chance to spawn Redemption instead; while a Sacrifice Room would give a Soul Heart, it has a 50% chance to spawn Redemption instead. This is the only way Redemption can be naturally generated during a run, as the item is not in any item pool.

• Other reliable ways include using Death Certificate, or using Spindown Dice on Spirit Shackles.

• Redemption has a small chance to be a starting item as Eden, Tainted Eden, or any character with Eden's Blessing.

• Using Birthright as Eden has a small chance to spawn Redemption.

• If Act of Contrition was taken after taking a Devil Deal, Redemption is not guaranteed to spawn.

• If there is an item in a Red Chest, the icon will not disappear, even if the item is taken.

• Opening Red Chests that have been spawned after room generation, e.g. as a room clear reward or enemy drop, or opening them with Magneto, won't remove the icon.

• Taking A Lump of Coal or Head of Krampus after a Krampus fight will keep the icon.

• Picking up items made free through usage of items such as Coupon or a Credit Card will still remove the icon and provide no benefit.

• However, swapping out a free active item for another that was already held will not remove the icon.

• Taking free pickups/items that spawned after the room was entered (e. g. room clear rewards, drops from Fire Places, rewards from Devil Beggars) will not remove the cross.

• Taking pickups/items spawned by Keeper's Box inside the Devil Room will remove the cross.

• Taking items from a Black Market or A Pound of Flesh affected Shop will not remove the cross.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Devil's Crown: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular Devil Rooms for the purposes of this item.

• Found Soul: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.

• Jacob and Esau: The cross will only disappear if the character holding Redemption takes something. The other character is free to take items and pickups.

• Satanic Bible: Taking a Boss item that was replaced with a Devil Deal will remove the cross, however the Boss Room doesn't give the cross.

• Tainted Lazarus: Only the character initially entering the Devil Room will receive the cross over his head. The character that leaves the floor with the icon above his head is the one that gains Redemption's benefits.

• Using Flip inside the Devil Room will make both forms have the icon over their heads. Even if one form's cross is removed, the other's is unaffected.

• Ghostly items that were already bought from taking a deal can safely be taken without deactivating Redemption.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The pickup quote is taken from the last verse of the Lord's Prayer: "And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.'"

fields.description: If Isaac enters a Devil Room but leaves without taking/opening anything in it, he gets +1 Damage and a Soul Heart at the start of the next floor.

Remote Detonator.title: Remote Detonator
Remote Detonator.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Activating the Remote Detonator will cause all Bombs placed by Isaac to explode.

• Bombs will no longer explode without the usage of the detonator.

• Gives 5 bombs when picked up. If the same instance of the item is picked up a second time in the same run, this effect will not be applied.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if Hornfel is killed in his second phase. [end edition note] 

• Remote Detonator gives Isaac five bombs for the price of three (using the bombs on the Donation Machine to trade for coins) when bought at a Shop, making its purchase a good value if the player is low on bombs.

• [Repentance] The Donation Machine explodes once bombed and while it drops many coins, it is destroyed for the rest of the run

• Remote Detonator does not control the explosions of Troll Bombs and Mega Troll Bombs.

• It does control throwable bombs spat out by Bomb Grimaces, once picked up. The bombs can be carried throughout rooms without ever exploding until Remote Detonator is used, making a Bomb Grimace essentially equivalent to a Golden Bomb with this item.

• If Chub or Carrion Queen swallow a remote bomb, the bomb will be released from them after the animation unless it is detonated manually.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Anarchist Cookbook/Best Friend/Mr. Boom + Schoolbag: The active item bombs are affected by remote detonator.

• Broken Remote: Allows unlimited teleportation.

• Bob's Bladder: Bombs will continue to leave creep until they are manually detonated. Allows for maximization of creep damage, potentially dealing more damage over time to a boss than just a singular bomb.

• Bobby-Bomb: Bombs placed will chase after the enemy, making it easier to do massive amounts of damage to enemies.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps in the inner ring when bombs placed by Isaac explode. Using Remote Detonator also causes the wisps' tears to explode, dealing 16.5 damage to enemies that are close to them (24 if Isaac has BFFS!).

• Curse of the Tower / XVI - The Tower: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until the Remote Detonator is used, unlike normal Troll Bombs.

• Dr. Fetus: Remote Detonator can be used to detonate the fired bombs early, which can be useful against moving enemies.

• No. 2: The bombs automatically dropped by No. 2 will not detonate on their own, greatly reducing the risk of accidental explosive self-damage.

• Rocket in a Jar: Rockets do not explode on impact with surfaces, requiring manual detonation.

• Rocket in a Jar + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will still explode on impact, but can be manually detonated.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Scatter Bombs: Remote Detonator can be used on the original bomb, but not on the small bombs that are spawned.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in Demo Man.

fields.description: Bombs placed by Isaac only explode when Remote Detonator is used. Gives 5 bombs.

Restock.title: Restock
Restock.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All characters start with Restock in Greed mode.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon purchasing an item from the Shop, a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.

• Collectibles created correspond to the shop's item pool.

• [Before Repentance] Drops 3 random pickups around Isaac.

• [Repentance] Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

• For items, the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.

• For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2

• The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through Steam Sale: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.

• The maximum price is 99 cents.

• A small restock icon appears under the map, just like Treasure Map, Blue Map, The Compass [Repentance] and any active curses.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• All characters start with a permanent copy of this item in Greed Mode. It cannot be removed or rerolled by any means.

• [Before Repentance] If used with IV Bag/Blood Donation Machine and an item which can spawn additional coins (Counterfeit Penny, Swallowed Penny, Humbleing Bundle, etc.), infinite money can be produced by buying hearts for 3 coins and getting more than 3 coins back after donating health.

• When purchasing Restock from a Shop, the slot that Restock was purchased from will not be restocked.

• Restock does not affect Black Markets, purchasable items generated via The Stairway and purchasable items generated by A Pound of Flesh that cost coins.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Purchasing an item that is on sale will replace it with another that is on sale.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 2 of Diamonds + Blank Card:

• [edition anr] Coins can be infinitely generated by buying Lil' Battery. As Lil' Batteries only cost 5 coins, as long as Isaac starts with at least 11, the maximum of 99 coins can be quickly reached. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as Restock now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it.

• • Deep Pockets allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Steam Sale x2: Items can be infinitely bought from shops.

• Blank Card + 2 of Diamonds: [Before Repentance] If a Lil' Battery is on sale, items can be bought infinitely.

• [Repentance] If a Lil' Battery is on sale, Isaac can buy a lot of items before the prices become too high in that shop.

• Chaos: Restock is affected by Chaos, and can be used to obtain otherwise rare items.

• [Before Repentance] Chaos + Steam Sale x2: Items can be bought infinitely, allowing Isaac to theoretically obtain every item in the game.

• Keeper's Box: Buying spawned pickup or item in Shop will always restock into the same thing as what being sold in the upper left of the shop and their prices will never increase. This still works even if the top left slot already brought and allowed to change the top left spot with restock machine to items or your desired pickups. This does not work outside of the shop.

• Member Card: Items bought in the separate shop will also be restocked.

• A Pound of Flesh: Restocked items in a shop will still require hearts to be bought. 

• If playing as The Lost, Tainted Lost, or if currently affected by Soul of the Lost / White Fire Place, items can be bought indefinitely.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Coupon/Credit Card: Items made free will not be restocked, even while playing Greed Mode.

• Mr. ME!: Items stolen by Mr. ME! will be not restocked, even while playing Greed Mode.

fields.description: Causes Shops to instantly restock their items when they are bought. [Repentance] Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

Revelation.title: Revelation
Revelation.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants flight.

• [Before Repentance+] Grants 2 Soul Hearts on pickup.

• Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the Angel bosses.

• The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).

• • With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to Analog Stick.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Tear delay has no effect on the charge time of the laser; it is fixed at 2.35 seconds.

• This item's effects will still work while Blindfolded, which makes it extremely valuable for Lilith and in challenges such as BRAINS! or Hot Potato.

• Many of Revelation's synergies are similar to Brimstone's.

• Having any charged tear effects like Monstro's Lung or Brimstone will lower their DPS if their charge time is under 2.35 seconds, in order to use Revelation's laser.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Revelation, Maw Of The Void, No. 2, and Montezuma's Revenge all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at the same time.

• Angelic Prism: When the laser hits the prism, it will split in four.

• Brain Worm: The laser can bend completely to hit an enemy, effectively acting as a better form of homing on single enemies and bosses.

• Continuum The laser loops around. The laser cannot hit the same enemy twice.

• Cricket's Body: Spawns 4 split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits every other tick. The tears are Piercing and deal half damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

• Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly increased.

• Homing tears: The laser will home in on enemies in a very effective way.

• Lachryphagy: The laser has reduced range, but spawns a red Lachryphagy tear per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

• Marked: The laser is fired automatically upon reaching full charge in the direction of the mark. Combined with charged attacks, this allows them to keep their DPS.

• Multidimensional Baby: The baby can duplicate the laser.

• Multidimensional Baby + Lachryphagy / Pop!: Lasers modified by Multidimensional Baby are no longer affected by Lachryphagy or Pop!, being normal length and not firing additional tears/eyes out the end.

• The Parasite: Spawns two perpendicular lasers on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits. The laser and its split lasers cannot hit the same enemy.

• [Repentance+] Also spawn small split tears.

• Pop!: The laser has reduced range, but shoots out an eyeball per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

• Proptosis: The beam deals ~2.47× Isaac's Damage at point blank range.

• Rubber Cement: The laser will bounce off the walls for a short distance.

• Tiny Planet: The laser will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.

• Jacob's Ladder: Upon hitting an enemy, wall or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: The laser fires in place, not following Isaac.

• Almond Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased. The laser do not gain worm trinket effects.

• Diplopia: Multiple copies of Revelation have no extra effect.

• Explosivo / Mucormycosis / Sinus Infection: No effect.

• Eye of the Occult: No effect.

• Eye of the Occult + Brimstone/Technology: The Revelation beam also automatically fires at the crosshair.

• Ipecac: The laser will poison enemies and repeatedly explode on contact with an enemy or obstacle. Despite its high damage increase, Ipecac only adds +2 damage to the beam, similarly to Brimstone.

• Kidney Stone: The laser can be fired as normal while the kidney stone is charging. The laser is charged and fired automatically after the kidney stone is fired.

• Luck-based tear effects: No effect.

• Libra: The laser ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

• My Reflection: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac and then shoots straight backwards.

• Mysterious Liquid: The laser leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the laser hits per tick.

• Playdough Cookie: The laser rapidly flashes between different colors while firing, with a chance to inflict status effects.

• Soy Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased.

• Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The laser will occasionally break obstacles.

• Tech X: If the Revelation beam and the Tech X are both charged, it will sometimes fire the Revelation beam first and the Tech X ring at the end of it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item makes Isaac resemble Uriel and Gabriel, and its ability resembles the two angels' abilities to fire a directed holy blast.

• This item may be a reference to the Seraph Robe from the Fire Emblem video game series, which shared a similar sprite in previous installments of the game.

• Isaac's glowing eyes with the item may be a reference to Moses in the Book of Exodus. Chapter 34 details how, after he received another set of stone tablets with the Ten Commandments from God, Moses' face started shining and became difficult to look at. Henceforth, Moses would only show his face when revealing what God had told him.

• Revelation originates from the Antibirth mod. This item is significantly different from its Antibirth counterpart, which gave stats up and a spectral Brain Worm effect to Isaac's tears. It also gave Isaac two immortal hearts instead of soul hearts, which was a heart pickup that was never transferred to Repentance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When combined with Chocolate Milk, Cursed Eye, Monstro's Lung, or Tech X, releasing a Revelation attack may prevent a charged shot from firing at the same time as expected. The charged shot is delayed by about ~0.5 seconds. Holding a full charge for a longer time makes the delay more likely to happen.

fields.description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. [Before Repentance+] Also grants two Soul Hearts.

Rib of Greed.title: Rib of Greed
Rib of Greed.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Prevents Greed and Super Greed from appearing in Shops and Secret Rooms.

• Increases the chance of coin drops when clearing rooms at the expense of heart drops.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Cannot appear in Greed Mode.

• If Rib of Greed is picked up after a Greed fight in a Shop or a Secret Room, reentering the room will turn the room into a regular shop with items for sale or a secret room respectively (while keeping the previously dropped items on the floor).

• By dropping the Rib of Greed before entering a shop, fighting Greed, then picking up the trinket again, the shop can be accessed while also having made free money from the Greed fight.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Also increases chance of Double Penny, Nickel, Dime, Lucky Penny, and Golden Penny drops.

fields.name: Rib of Greed
fields.description: Prevents Greed and Super Greed from appearing in Shops and Secret Rooms, and makes coin drops after clearing rooms more likely.

Wizoob.title: Wizoob
Wizoob.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wizoobs are ghost enemies that disappear, then reappear near Isaac and spit a cluster of spectral tears at him. While they can appear to any side of Isaac, they most often will appear below him.

sections.heading: Red Ghost
sections.text: Red Ghosts behave the same as Wizoobs, but fire a Brimstone beam instead of spectral shots.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Wizoobs may be a reference to Wizzrobes from The Legend of Zelda due to their similar names, similar sound effects, and attack patterns.

• They could be a reference to Boos from the Super Mario series as well, considering that they look and act like boos, as well as having "boo" spelled backward at the end of their name.

• [Repentance] Wizoobs and Red Ghosts are the only entities in the game whose Stage HPs were reduced in Repentance, both from 5 to 4.

• [Repentance+] This is once again true in Repentance+, both from 4 to 3. [end edition note]

fields.environment:
Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths / 
Sheol / Cathedral / 
Dark Room / Chest / 
challenge / number magnet /
fields.behavior: Disappears, then appears near Isaac and spits a cluster of spectral tears at him.

fields.name: Red Ghost
fields.environment:
Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb / 
Sheol / Cathedral / 
Dark Room / 
challenge /
fields.behavior: Disappears, then reappears near Isaac and fires a brimstone laser.

Marbles.title: Marbles
Marbles.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns 3 random trinkets.

• Taking damage has a 10% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently, similar to Smelter.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If activated while carrying two trinkets, both will be swallowed.

• Trinkets swallowed via Marbles will not be removed or rerolled by items such as the D4.

• Perfection is still lost after Isaac takes damage from regular sources.

• [Repentance] Faded Polaroid cannot be used to open A Strange Door if swallowed. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Glyph of Balance: Allows a trinket to appear every time there's a room clear drop as long as the other room clear drop criteria aren't satisfied, as it empties the trinket slot.

• Tainted Eden: Absorbed trinkets are not rerolled by Tainted Eden's passive effect.

• Tainted Isaac: Absorbed trinkets do not take up an item slot.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Marbles is based on this Steam Workshop item by FoksMachine and Bustin Blotch.

• This item is used in Pica Run.

• This item is a reference to how marbles and small toys are sometimes swallowed by children.

fields.name: Marbles
fields.description: Spawns 3 random trinkets. Taking damage has a 5% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently.

Marked.title: Marked
Marked.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: The Mark]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Creates a controllable crosshair. Isaac automatically and continuously fires towards the crosshair.

• [Repentance] The crosshair will not appear in each room until Isaac fires. Pressing the "drop" key or button (Keyboard default: left Control key; Controller default: right trigger) will make the crosshair disappear and stop Isaac from firing tears until a firing key is pressed again.

• [Repentance] Shooting familiars and throwable familiars now fire towards or launch themselves in the direction of the crosshair automatically.

• +0.7 tears.

• [Repentance] +3.0 range.

• [Before Repentance] +3.15 range.

• [Before Repentance] +0.3 tear falling speed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• On PC, it is possible to control Marked with the mouse. On Windows, go to [code: C:/Users/[username]/Documents/My Games/The Binding Of Isaac [Rebirth/Afterbirth/Afterbirth+/Repentance/Repentance+]/] and in the options.ini file, change the line that says [code: MouseControl0] to [code: MouseControl1] .

• [Repentance+] Marked's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Brimstone: Automatically charges and fires in the direction of the mark. The angle the beam is shot from Isaac will correct itself when the mark or Isaac repositions to continue hitting the mark.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Camo Undies: Isaac will stay camouflaged until the crosshair is moved. If you control Marked with the mouse (only possible on PC) Camo Undies will stay camouflaged. [end edition note] 

• Chocolate Milk: Charge and fire rate based on proximity to mark. Fully charges when farther away, charges less but fires faster when closer. Damage scales with the distance between Isaac and the crosshair.

• Cursed Eye: Greatly increases the firing rate without needing to charge. The teleporting effect of the eye is removed.

• [Repentance] Lil Brimstone: While firing, Lil Brimstone automatically charges and fires the beam immediately upon full charge, the beam will now target the crosshair.

• [Repentance] Maw Of The Void/Montezuma's Revenge: While firing, these items charge automatically and activate immediately upon full charge. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Mom's Knife: Charge and fire rate based on proximity to mark. Fully charges when farther away, charges less but fires faster when closer.

• [Repentance] Monstro's Lung: Automatically charges and fires in the direction of the mark.

• Pointy Rib: The rib familiar will aim at the crosshair.

• Quints: The spawned familiars will aim at the crosshair.

• Revelation: Light beams are charged and fired at the crosshair automatically at a fixed angle from Isaac.

• Rocket in a Jar: Bombs placed will blast at the crosshair, and cannot be placed normally until the crosshair disappears.

• [Repentance] Tech X: Fires in the direction of the crosshair, with charging time proportionate to the distance of the crosshair from Isaac.

• [Repentance] Tractor Beam: The beam is aimed at Marked's crosshair. Moving the crosshair rotates the entire beam along with any tears inside it.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Lilith : Marked gives the stat upgrades but not the mark.

• [Repentance] Tainted Lilith : When the baby is launched, it permanently fires at the crosshair. Pressing the "drop" key or button (Keyboard default: left Control key; Controller default: right trigger) will make the crosshair disappear and cause the baby to return to Tainted Lilith. [end edition note] 

• The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten : Gives stats up without any drawbacks, and allows the bone to be angled in any direction, similar to Analog Stick.

• Anti-Gravity: The tear hover effect is nullified, though the tear delay down is applied.

• [Before Repentance] Brimstone/Mom's Knife/Monstro's Lung/Technology/Tech X: Overrides Marked, stat bonuses still apply.

• Chocolate Milk + Neptunus: Not recommended. Isaac will not be able to fire any tears, effectively becoming softlocked and forcing the player to restart the game.

• Dead Tooth: The green aura only activates when pressing the buttons to fire Isaac's tears.

• Dr. Fetus: Continuously fires bombs towards the marked spot.

• Epic Fetus: Continuously fires missiles at the marked spot.

• [Repentance] If the crosshair is dismissed before the next missile is dropped, it still drops in the crosshair’s last position.

• Epiphora: Both items work as normal, with tear rate gradually increasing until Isaac turns his head, which can happen via him or the crosshair moving too out of parallel.

• Eye of the Occult: Tears will always attempt to land on the crosshair, changing direction mid-air to do so.

• GB Bug: Unaffected by Marked.

• [Before Repentance] Gnawed Leaf: Tears will stop auto-firing once Isaac is invulnerable.

• [Repentance] Gnawed Leaf cannot activate while Isaac is auto-firing.

• [Before Repentance] Lil Brimstone: Lil Brimstone only charges while moving the mark.

• The Ludovico Technique: Overrides Marked, but stat bonuses still apply.

• Mr. ME!: The Mr. ME! crosshair will move constantly in the direction of the Marked crosshair relative to Isaac. It will not attempt to match with where Marked is aiming, making it difficult to control. Pressing the drop button will stop the Mr. ME! crosshair.

• My Little Unicorn/Unicorn Stump/Taurus: Isaac's tears will still fire, but he will be unable to move the crosshair while invincible.

• [Repentance] The crosshair can still be spawned while invincible.

• [Repentance] Spirit Sword: Overrides Marked, but stat bonuses still apply, and allows the sword to be angled in any direction, similar to Analog Stick. [end edition note] 

• Sprinkler: No effect on the sprinkler.

• [Before Repentance] Technology 2: Laser only fires while the crosshair is moving, and only in cardinal directions.

• [Before Repentance] Tractor Beam: Tears are fired automatically but only in cardinal directions.

• Tiny Planet: The tears' center of orbit can be slightly modified using the crosshair.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] This item's icon shares the same icon as Zodiac but red instead of white. Isaac's sprite is also the same as Zodiac but red instead of black.

• The mark on the ground is the same as used by Epic Fetus.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Mom's Knife + Haemolacria: Causes the crosshair to follow the camera instead of player input. In normal rooms this makes the crosshair get stuck in the middle. In larger rooms, the marker will only move when the camera moves, allowing for minimal control when aiming due to how the camera moves based on the direction Isaac is currently aiming.

Mars.title: Mars
Mars.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Double tapping a direction makes Isaac quickly dash in that direction.

• Isaac is immune to damage from all sources during the dash, with the exception of Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and similar self-damage active items.

• • [Repentance+] At the end of the dash, Isaac gains i-frames that protect him against Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars damage. They will also not activate if touched during those i-frames.

• The dash deals damage equal to 4× Isaac's damage + 8.

• The direction of the dash can be angled by holding another button.

• The dash has an approximate 3 second cooldown.

• [Repentance+] If Isaac collides with a wall or obstacle, he releases 8 columns of fire that deal 10 damage and can burn enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The dash can be used to enter Curse Rooms and open Spiked Chests/Mimic Chests without taking damage.

• The dash can destroy Shopkeepers.

• With a controller, tapping the joystick is rather inconsistent, and the dash can often activate by accident. Using the directional pad instead is recommended.

• When Mars's dash is charged, Isaac will occasionally flash brightly, and visible steam will emit from his nose.

• Extra care needs to be taken with this item, as tapping for precise movements too quickly will cause a dash.

• [Repentance+] Mars' quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Camo Undies: Can be used to deal damage without breaking the confusion effect.

• Kamikaze!: Kamikaze can be used without taking damage while dashing.

• A Pony / White Pony: Lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1.5 seconds.

• Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten will charge on double-tap if Tainted Soul is not holding him. This can be used to let Tainted Forgotten attack enemies from a resting position, or move him away from damaging hazards so Tainted Soul can pick him up.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mars originates from the Antibirth mod.

• Isaac resembles War when holding the item, referencing the Roman god of war, Mars.

fields.description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. [Repentance+] Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.

Mask + Heart.title: Mask + Heart
Mask + Heart.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[distinguish: Mask of Infamy] 

The Mask + Heart is an enemy commonly found in Necropolis, uncommonly in Womb/Utero, and rarely in Catacombs. Hearts may be found on their own in The Womb/Utero as well.

It consists of two parts:

• an invulnerable mask, which uses a movement pattern similar to a Knight.

• a slow-moving heart that will shoot 4 projectiles in the cardinal directions when the player approaches it.

Destroying the heart will also destroy the mask. If the heart is afflicted by a status effect, the mask will also gain that status effect.

sections.heading: Mask II + 1/2 Heart
sections.text:
The Mask II + 1/2 Heart is a more advanced variation of Mask + Heart that was introduced in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance.

While Mask II behaves very similarly to the default Mask most of the time, the 1/2 Heart that accompanies it behaves drastically different. As the name implies, the heart is split into 2 individual halves. Unlike the default Heart, neither half actively avoids the player and instead floats around the room somewhat erratically. While both halves are intact, they create a steady stream of blood shots between themselves acting as somewhat of a barrier between the two. Once one of the halves are destroyed, the mask becomes angry and begins moving much quicker while the remaining half begins slowly floating towards the player while frequently firing 4 blood shots in the ordinal directions. Once both halves are defeated, the Mask II dies with them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Although the mask appears to be floating, it cannot pass over obstacles and the heart can be affected by Creep.

• The hearts do not do contact damage.

• The masks can be killed with Chaos Card, Euthanasia, and Little Horn.

• [Repentance+] Notably, they are all unaffected by Hagalaz.

• If a mask is shrunk, it can be killed by walking over it.

• Small versions of the hearts can be spawned by Pink Champion Carrion Queen.

• The hearts can be spawned by Mom's Heart / It Lives!.

• Although the Heart and its shots will be slowed by Broken Watch and Stop Watch, the Mask will move normally.

• [Before Repentance] Though shown and dying as one enemy, using items such as D10 will cause both the mask and the heart to reroll as if it were two different enemies.

• Mask of Infamy is the boss version of this enemy.

Mask of Infamy.title: Mask of Infamy
Mask of Infamy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Mask of Infamy is a boss that can appear in Necropolis.

The Heart of Infamy has 200 HP and the Mask of Infamy the remaining 150.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
In the first phase, the two constituent parts act exactly like a regular-sized Mask + Heart; the Heart of Infamy tries to move away from Isaac while the Mask of Infamy charges at him if he crosses her path in any cardinal direction.

• During this phase, the mask cannot be hurt or otherwise affected by virtually any item. When the heart takes damage of any kind, the mask attempts to chase Isaac with increased speed, interrupting her current movement.

• The heart shoots 8 bullets in all directions if Isaac gets too close to it.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
• Once the heart is dead, Mask of Infamy begins the second phase. A crack appears in the back of the Mask and can be shot at to deal damage to her. Its behavior remains mostly identical but with increased speed.

• When damaged, she may interrupt her current movement and redirect at Isaac aggressively, but less often than when the heart was being attacked in the first phase.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text: [bc: 18] : 15% larger. The heart shoots 4 homing shots in a cross formation and has 25% more HP (250). The mask behaves like the normal version during both phases.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Even though they appear to float, both the mask and the heart can be damaged by Creep and spikes.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mask of Infamy was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Mask of Infamy is a tribute to Carmilla from Castlevania II.

• She is the boss version of the Mask + Hearts.

• Mask of Infamy is confirmed to be a female.

• It is confirmed that Isaac is peering out of the crack in the back of the mask. Isaac can also be spotted during the death animation of The Gate. 

• [Before Repentance] Additionally, both bosses are fought in Necropolis.

• The item Infamy is a reference to this boss.

• In the original game, Mask of Infamy did not have a health bar. This, coupled with the difficulty of harming her without specific upgrades, made her one of the more frustrating bosses.

• The Bestiary states that the heart is called the Heart of Infamy.

• When the Mask is killed, during the death animation, she flattens and instantly disappears; she doesn't explode into blood.

• Rarely in Greed Mode, The Heart can be found without the Mask.

• The mask's design may be reminiscent of the masks of tragedy from the Greek and Roman periods.

• This could be the reason why the boss is only encountered in Necropolis, i.e a cluster of tombs typical of the classical era.

• The Visage appears to be a fiery version of her.

sections.heading: Synergies

Match Stick.title: Match Stick
Match Stick.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Match Book]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a 10% chance of changing the room drop reward to a Bomb.

• Gives a 33% chance of adding a bomb to the rewards from opening certain Chests, destroying Tinted Rocks, or certain Machines.

• Other than Tinted Rocks, these can only drop the bomb if they drop coins, hearts, Bombs, or Keys.

• This includes:

fields.name: Match Stick

Maw Of The Void.title: Maw Of The Void
Maw Of The Void.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] +1.0 damage.

• After firing tears for 2.35 seconds, if Isaac stops shooting, he unleashes a black Brimstone ring around Isaac that expands and contracts, dealing damage at a rapid rate to all enemies touching it.

• The black ring deals damage equal to Isaac's current damage per tick, and ticks a total of 30 times. It lasts ~1.97 seconds (118 frames).

• [Before Repentance] Enemies killed by the black ring have a 5% chance to drop Black Hearts.

• Contributes to the Leviathan transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The charge is completed when a red upside-down cross appears on Isaac's forehead.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] With charge bars enabled, there is also an indicator that displays the charge.

• [Before Repentance] This item does not work while playing a blindfolded character, as it requires tears to charge.

• This restriction can, however, be bypassed by picking up The Ludovico Technique.

• This item's effect will not fully activate if picked up by Lilith; its stat ups will still apply to her Incubus familiar, but the ring will not appear unless she also has the Ludovico Technique.

• [Repentance] This item will still work while playing as a blindfolded character.

• The ring will apply any tear status effects such as poison if Isaac has them.

• This item can begin to be recharged again immediately after activating it, effectively cutting its charge time in half in situations where it may be needed again quickly.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Maw Of The Void, No. 2, Montezuma's Revenge and Revelation all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at same time.

• Dark Arts: Extremely powerful. Isaac will unleash a black Brimstone ring while using Dark Arts, letting Isaac do crazy damage while invincible.

• Guppy: Damaging enemies with Maw Of The Void allows flies to spawn from the Guppy transformation. Flies are spawned at a rate of approximately one fly per tick of damage for each enemy it hits. This causes a lot of flies to spawn very quickly. The spawned flies will also move to attack the nearest enemy immediately.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Homing tears: The ring curves towards enemies.

• Ipecac: Massively increases ring damage and poisons enemies.

• [Repentance] The ring also explodes on enemy or obstacle contact.

• Jacob's Ladder: The ring sends out electric currents when it hits something.

• Lost Contact: Ring can destroy projectiles.

• Mysterious Liquid: Occasionally spawns a pool of creep where the ring makes contact with an enemy.

• Pisces/8 Inch Nails: Ring obtains knockback effect.

• Proptosis: [Before Afterbirth+] The ring is much larger and deals 1.5x damage per tick.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] The ring is larger but deals normal damage.

• [Repentance] No effect.

• Strange Attractor: Ring attracts pickups and enemies towards it.

• Wiggle Worm: The ring has wavy edges.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• The Ludovico Technique: Tear must be moved before the ring activates.

• A Lump of Coal: [Before Afterbirth+] The ring damage is halved.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The ring deals normal damage.

• Marked: [Before Repentance] Crosshair must be moved for 4 seconds before the ring activates.

• [Repentance] While firing, the ring charges automatically and activates immediately upon full charge.

• Soy Milk: No effect on charge time but massively reduces damage.

• Diplopia: Having multiple copies has no effect

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Maw Of The Void has a unique charge bar, filling with red instead of the usual green, as well as having a small swirl reminiscent of its shape in the middle of it.

• Maw Of The Void and the Isaac's Fork share nearly identical item descriptions, the fork lacking an exclamation point.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When combined with Chocolate Milk, Cursed Eye, Monstro's Lung or Tech X, releasing a Maw Of The Void attack may prevent a charged shot from firing at the same time as expected. The charged shot is delayed by about ~0.5 seconds. Holding a full charge for a longer time makes the delay more likely to happen.

fields.description: While firing, Isaac can charge and unleash a black ring that rapidly deals damage around him. [Before Repentance] The ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. +1 damage. [end edition note]

Meat Cleaver.title: Meat Cleaver
Meat Cleaver.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.

• Normal enemies can be split twice, while champions and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.

• If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as Squirt, Teratoma, or The Fallen, they will instead take the damage required to split them.

• If the enemy has segments, such as Larry Jr. or Buttlickers, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.

• If the enemy has a cable between them, such as Mr. Maw, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Invincible enemies, such as Stone Grimaces and lowered Hosts, will not be split.

• Multi-segmented enemies will only take damage on one segment.

• Pin, Mom's Heart, It Lives!, Isaac, Satan, ???, The Lamb, Mega Satan, Hush, Ultra Greed, Mother, Dogma, Ultra Famine, Ultra Pestilence, Ultra War, Ultra Death, and The Beast cannot be split.

• Unlike other enemies, Delirium has no limit on how many times it can be split with Meat Cleaver.

• If used enough times, Delirium will die.

• Gemini will immediately separate in two, resulting in Suture being enraged even if no damage has been dealt otherwise.

• Using it on Loki will turn him into Lokii.

• Using it on Grubs will instantly kill them.

• Using it on Carrion Queen, Chub, or C.H.A.D. will split them into two one-segmented pieces, instantly killing both halves.

• [Before Repentance+] Using it on Gabriel or Uriel will cause them to drop Key Piece 1 and Key Piece 2 (killing them both without picking up a key piece can result in getting the same key piece twice).

• [Repentance+] Only one key piece will drop.

• Using it on The Horny Boys will turn them into Loki and Hornfel. Hornfel will be in his "fleeing" state, but will never exit the room and will only drop extra rewards if Loki is killed first.

• Using it on The Scourge will instantly kill it instead of splitting.

• [Before Repentance+] In daily runs, using this item on enemies, especially angel statues increases a part of exploration bonus by quite a bit.

• [Repentance+] Each half enemy give half the points the normal enemy gives.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns one red wisp on the middle ring on use. Before spawning wisps, Meat Cleaver divides all of Isaac's wisps into two wisps that deal half tear damage. Wisps will be destroyed if they try to divide a third time.

• Filigree Feather: Each split angel will drop an item.

• Lusty Blood: Each split enemy killed grants a damage boost.

• Sigil of Baphomet: Split enemies will allow the shield to activate and stack up more easily.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Blood Puppy: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Meat Cleaver originated from the Antibirth mod.

• This item's pickup quote is a reference to the phrase "Slice and Dice", which means to cut or divide something into smaller parts.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If used on Reap Creep, during his 3rd Phase, he cannot properly collide with the walls in order to perform his rock attack and will infinitely run against the wall.
Bug note: If used against Mom's foot, both will count as their own instance, and the second foot will only be able to be killed once the first one is dead.
If the first foot is killed instantly, the second foot may never drop, requiring a reset.
Bug note: If used during Min-Min's phase change, both bosses will be unable to be damaged.
Bug note: If used on The Stain, the boss will be back to normal size when poking out of the ground. This is most likely due to the boss becoming smaller when going underground and therefore overriding the size it was given by the Meat Cleaver.

fields.description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.

Meatball.title: Meatball
Meatball.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Meatballs are grotesque enemies found only in Chapter 4. They slowly slide around the room aimlessly. If Isaac is in sight, they will stop to spew a fountain of short-range blood shots in all directions or spit a line of damaging Red Creep towards Isaac. Upon death, they spawn a Host, which can be faintly seen partially sticking out of the Meatball on one side.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Meatballs are one of five enemies (four without Repentance, three without Afterbirth+) in the game that uses Creep as projectiles, the others are Conjoined Fatty, Bloaty, Ultra Pride and The Thing.

• Meatballs are one of two only enemies from the Afterbirth expansion that are entirely new enemies and not new variants of already existing enemies. The other is the Corn Mine. The Dukie is an exception as it's technically a smaller version of The Duke of Flies.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Meatballs now make sounds when they attack.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Prior to Booster Pack #5, Meatballs had a chance to spawn Mushrooms upon death instead of Hosts.
