The Void.title: The Void
The Void.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the chapter; the item; Void; the enemy; Portal] 

The Void is a chapter added in Afterbirth+. It is unlocked by defeating Hush. The Void is one of five final levels in The Binding of Isaac, alongside the Chest, the Dark Room, the Corpse, and Home.

Each room in this chapter takes the form of a different chapter, ranging from the Basement to the Chest and the Dark Room, including variant chapters like the Cellar and the Burning Basement. The Void is extremely large compared to other floors, and it is the only floor in the game (not counting XL floors) to contain multiple boss rooms. Most of them contain random bosses from other floors, including some of the final bosses, such as It Lives!, Satan, Isaac, etc. One of them, however, contains the main boss of the floor, which is always Delirium.

Monsters encountered in The Void have a much higher chance of appearing as Champions.

[Repentance] The Portal monster is exclusive to this floor, and all rooms in which it would have been previously encountered on other chapters now only generate on this floor.

sections.heading: Access
sections.text:
After defeating Hush at least once, a new exit will appear in the upper right-hand corner of the 2x2 boss room in which Hush was fought. The new room contains nothing except for a Portal. It does not spawn enemies and serves as the entrance to The Void.

After unlocking The Void, the portal can then appear after every major boss starting with Mom, even if Hush was not defeated in that run.

The deeper the boss, the higher the spawning chance:

• 5% after Mom (Only if Isaac has 10+ tear damage or 20+ items)

• 10% after Mom's Heart / It Lives!

• 15% after Isaac or Satan

• [Before Repentance+] 20% after ??? or The Lamb

• [Before Repentance+] 50% after Mega Satan (If the portal appears, the run will not end instantly like it normally does)

• Defeating Hush will guarantee entrance to The Void.

• [Repentance+] Defeating ???, The Lamb, Mega Satan, or Mother will also guarantee a portal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The portal can appear multiple times during a single run.

• [Before Repentance+] The chance for at least one portal to open after fighting It Lives!, Isaac/Satan, and ???/The Lamb is 38.8%.

• [Before Repentance+] If Mega Satan is defeated, the chance for at least one portal increases to 69.4%.

• If a portal appears after Mega Satan, a big chest will appear alongside it. Jumping into the chest will end the run normally.

• [Before Repentance] If the portal spawns below Isaac's position after defeating a boss, he will immediately enter The Void.

• [Before Repentance] Jumping into a trapdoor will reset The Void, an effect identical to Forget Me Now. This is useful if it has already been explored, but the player wants to clear more rooms to acquire health items before the final fight. The trapdoor must be found via a black market under rocks, as We Need To Go Deeper! and Ehwaz won't work.

• [Before Repentance] Similarly, going to an I AM ERROR Room in The Void allows Isaac to reset the floor, so teleport items like Undefined can let Isaac repeat The Void multiple times.

• [Repentance] The I AM ERROR room can be reached by leaving a Crawl Space through an unintended direction in the Chest and the Dark Room. The room will always contain a portal leading to The Void. However, any other method of getting to the I AM ERROR room will fail and generate an I am Error shopkeeper instead. Thus, the likelihood of this ever happening is practically zero without using items that can force the generation of the Crawl Space trapdoor, such as We Need To Go Deeper!

• [Repentance] If the portal appears after Mom and the player chooses the Ascent path, the portal will still visually spawn on the way up. However, it is closed and can not be interacted with.

• Once the Portal Entrance to the Void is spawned in a Boss Room, it will stay open even after leaving the room.

sections.heading: Bosses
sections.text:
| | 
| Delirium

This floor contains multiple boss rooms, only one of which will contain Delirium. The other boss rooms contain a random boss from any floor including final bosses, except Mom, Mega Satan, Hush, Ultra Greed, Mother, Dogma, the Ultra Harbingers, The Beast, and all Repentance bosses that only appear on the alternate path.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Delirium's boss room is a 2x2 room, but appears as a 1x1 room on the minimap.

• Similarly, Mr. Fred's 1x2 room will appear as a 1x1 room if he spawns.

• [Repentance] Unlike normal boss rooms, Red Rooms can be created adjacent to these non-appearing rooms. [end edition note] 

• Items awarded from defeating bosses in The Void are generated as if Chaos was active, drawing from any item pool.

• If rerolled, the new items use the Boss item pool.

• Since the Void has multiple boss rooms, using IV - The Emperor will teleport Isaac to one of them randomly.

• Defeating a final boss in The Void that is not Delirium will not give a Completion Mark of that boss and will not unlock the respective item. It will however count towards other unlocks, like Triachnid for killing Isaac.

sections.heading: Locating Delirium
sections.text:
[main: The Void/Locating Delirium] 

• To locate boss rooms which will most likely contain Delirium, Isaac must look at the boss rooms on the map:

• Try to find a boss room that would not be connected to other rooms if it was a 2x2 room. If it would connect, the room won't contain Delirium.

• Remember that the boundaries of the map are at a maximum of 13x13 squares. If a 2x2 boss room would extend past those boundaries, that room cannot contain Delirium.

• By knowing which boss rooms cannot contain Delirium, Isaac can safely enter certain boss rooms to gather items before fighting Delirium, or not enter these boss rooms knowing that Delirium is not there.

• Entering boss rooms with a teleport card is also smart in case you encounter Delirium.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• It is implied that the different forms (floors from chapters 1 to 6) of this floor are just Isaac's hallucinations, as the Void's icon on the progress bar (after advancing to the next floor) is a red vortex, and the "floor" graphic (below the player character and bosses in "VS" screens) is a red vortex as well.

• On Isaac's last will, The Void is referred to as "some dying memory".

• Occasionally, there will be a static distortion and the background and objects of the room may change to those of other chapters.

• Mom's Heart can still spawn as a boss, even after being replaced by It Lives! in Chapter 4.

• [Before Repentance] The Void is the only floor that can be cleared indefinitely with Undefined (or Teleport 2.0 plus The Battery or a guaranteed Lil' Battery drop).

• The champion enemies spawned in The Void will never drop any of their assigned drops.

• [Before Repentance] The Void can be entered in Greed Mode by entering "stage 8" in the Debug Console. The rooms have random backdrops and the music is the same as The Void in regular mode, but the boss is Ultra Greed and will drop the Final Boss Chest. Entering the chest will play Ending 20 instead of Ending 18 or 19.

• [Repentance] The "stage 8" floor has no name, no music and plays no ending when entering the Chest.

• The starting room and the boss rooms of The Void do not have the visual effects of the environment they're based on (i.e. a boss room with a Womb backdrop will not have the red static of the Womb).

• [Before Repentance] Also, Caves-based rooms do not have the visual effects of Caves.

• Even if a boss isn't unlocked (i.e. Sisters Vis before beating ??? 6 times), it can still appear in one of the boss rooms.

• [Repentance] An unused floor found in Repentance sharing the name "The Void" can be found in the game's files and contains a variety of unique unimplemented rooms, some of which feature Repentance bosses.

• This may have been related to the Delirium revamp which Kilburn noted in a tweet.

• [Repentance] As of Repentance, The Void is the only chapter in which the boss VS screen is completely black, as opposed to having a slightly coloured shade to represent the current chapter/environment Isaac is in.

sections.heading: Music
sections.text:
• The music that plays in The Void is titled Terminus.

• The track appears to be a remix of Crusade, Genesis 22:10 (title screen), and the Basement and the Burning Basement themes.

• • This may be inspired by the Void's theme in Antibirth, which was a mashup of several floor tracks in the game.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: A Stoney can spawn alone in a room, causing it to instantly die.
Bug note: D12 can still generate trapdoors. Entering one will send Isaac into a different version of The Void.

fields.bosses: Delirium

Treasure Room.title: Treasure Room
Treasure Room.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[Repentance] with Devil's Crown [end edition note] 

A Treasure Room, or Item Room, is a room that contains items from the Treasure Room. They appear in chapters 1, 2, and 3 (and 4 if Isaac holds Bloody Crown, 5 with Holy Crown or Wicked Crown). Two also appear in the ???. A Treasure Room can be identified by the gold edges of the door. When the current floor is under the effect of [cu: Labyrinth] , making a floor an XL floor, there will be two Treasure Rooms on the floor instead of one.

Treasure Rooms on the first floor of any run do not require a key to open, even under the effect of Curse of the Labyrinth. Treasure Rooms never border more than a single regular room, but there may be a Secret Room adjacent to it.

[Afterbirth onward] In Greed Mode, Treasure Rooms appear in Chapters 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, and are always locked. Silver Treasure Rooms appear next to these rooms, they give items from the Boss but are always unlocked.

sections.heading: Variations
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth onward] There is a rare chance that a Treasure Room might contain two items, only one of which can be taken.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Occasionally, both items can be taken. In this case, the treasure room will have a unique layout with 8 "special" obstacles (Urns in Basement, Mushrooms in Caves and so on). 

• Golden Horse Shoe will increase the chance for a Treasure Room to become a double Treasure Room, and More Options will cause every Treasure Room to become a double Treasure Room.

• [Repentance] If the Treasure Room was unexplored, Tarot Cloth + XVII - The Stars will make the Treasure Room a double Treasure Room.

• [Repentance] Treasure Rooms in Downpour, Dross, Mines, Ashpit, Mausoleum, Gehenna, and Corpse will always contain two items. One item will be hidden with a non-removable [cu: Blind] effect. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If a Treasure Room on the alt path spawns with an extra item, it will have three items. One can be taken freely while the other two are still a choice. There is no visual indication which is which, although one of the choice items is still hidden.

• • Broken Glasses have a chance to add a hidden item choice to regular Treasure Rooms, or reveal the hidden choice in alt Treasure Rooms.

• [Afterbirth onward] Treasure Rooms may contain a Shop Restock Machine, allowing Isaac to re-roll offered items if he has coins or bombs. [end edition note] 

• Pay to Win guarantees a Shop Restock Machine in newly generated Treasure Rooms.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] 2-3 Greed Gapers may appear in some rooms.

• [Repentance] 1-3 Bulbs may appear in some rooms.

• [Repentance] Some themed enemies from their respective floors may appear in some alt path Treasure Rooms.

• Treasure Rooms have a few very rare layouts that do not spawn items. Instead, they spawn:

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Poop surrounded by a trinket, five pickups, and Attack Fly.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] A trinket surrounded by eight pickups.

• [Repentance] (Downpour only) A trinket surrounded by four Blue Fire Places, with two pairs of Pills, Cards or Runes. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] (Mines only) Eight various pickups in the middle of the room, with additional pickups surrounded by rocks and a fireplace at each corner. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] (Ashpit only) A Key Master, with keys surrounded by spiked rocks on the top left and bottom right of the room. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] (Mausoleum and Gehenna only) Spikes surrounded by a trinket, two Golden Chests, one Stone Chest, a trinket, and a random heart, bomb, key and pill. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] (Corpse only) A Rotten Beggar and a random coin at each room corner. [end edition note]

Utero.title: Utero
Utero.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Utero is an alternate floor to the Womb. Unlike other alternate floors, the Utero does not need to be unlocked, aside from unlocking the Womb. While the theme of Utero overlaps heavily with the Womb, it appears to emphasize gore and disfigurement rather than its counterpart's focus on 'intact' viscera, though the difference in enemy make-up is still more subtle compared to other floors nonetheless. Its walls are slightly different, with white ribs spaced out on the walls, and the floor contains several new enemies that are bloodier and more deformed, as well as more enemies borrowed from later chapters, such as the Cathedral and Sheol, such as Holy Leeches or Bloodshot Eyes.

Like the Womb, from this floor onward, Treasure Rooms and Shops will no longer naturally generate and all damage that is taken deducts a full heart from Isaac's HP (unless he has The Wafer), regardless of the source.

[Repentance] While in the Utero, a dark yellowish desaturated screen shader and a warping effect will be applied to the screen, making it appear as if the area is submerged in fluid and further distinguishing the floor's appearance from the Womb.

sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] The music for the Utero is titled Viscera. The term “viscera” refers to the internal organs in the body.

• [Before Repentance] The Utero is one of [Rebirth only] two/ [Afterbirth onward] four floors not to have its own track, along with Womb, which shares a song with this floor, and The Shop and Ultra Greed, which share their song with both each other and Shops.

• [Repentance] The music for the Utero is titled Caesarian. A caesarian is a medical procedure where a baby is surgically removed from the mother due to complications during birth.

• The music heard during the fight against Mom's Heart/It Lives! is called Ventricide. Ventricide combines ventricle, a word that means a hollow area in an organ and is often associated with the heart, and the suffix -cide, which denotes the act of killing.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Utero is the ablative or dative form for the Latin word and medical term "uterus", meaning "womb", and it probably stands for the expression in utero, "within the womb", which refers to certain surgical procedures or other occurrences taking place inside the womb or during the length of time that a fetus is in the uterus of the pregnant female.

• The Utero's backdrop (red walls with white ribs) was also the backdrop of the Womb in flash Isaac, as both floors looked exactly the same in flash Isaac.

Womb.title: Womb
Womb.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Womb is the fourth chapter of the game, unlocked after beating Mom. From the Womb onward, floors do not naturally generate item rooms or shops, and all damage taken will do a full heart of damage to Isaac's HP (unless he has The Wafer), regardless of the source. Like the Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths, the Womb's second floor has a preset boss that will always be fought: Mom's Heart initially, and It Lives! after beating Mom's Heart 11 times.

The Womb has two alternate floors. The Utero, which, unlike alternate floors before it, does not need to be unlocked separately from the Womb and the Scarred Womb.

Angel.title: Angel
Angel.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Angels are mini-bosses that can appear most commonly in Angel Rooms. There are two angel variants: Uriel and Gabriel.

sections.heading: Locations
sections.text:
• A random angel appears when destroying an angel statue in an Angel Room with an explosion or similar effects.

• Dark "fallen" versions of both angels show up during the battle against Mega Satan.

• Fallen Uriel has 450 health instead of 400.

• Fallen Gabriel has 750 health instead of 660.

• [Afterbirth onward] Uriel appears after the 9th sacrifice and Gabriel appears after the 11th sacrifice in a Sacrifice Room.

• [Afterbirth onward] Both angels have a chance of appearing in Boss Rush, though it does not drop a Key Piece on death.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Angel Statues can sometimes appear in Super Secret Rooms, and I AM ERROR rooms, and in a rare Cathedral closet.

• An angel defeated in a Super Secret Room will award a key piece, but ones defeated in an I AM ERROR room or a closet will not.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] There's a small chance for an angel statue to replace the Satan statue in the Devil Room.

sections.heading: Uriel
sections.text: Uriel wears a light blue robe. He drops Key Piece 1 upon defeat.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Uriel moves towards Isaac, and attempts to position himself above Isaac while doing so. He stops moving to perform the following attacks:

• Folds his wings, then fires a spread of 5 projectiles in Isaac's direction.

• Uriel's hands begin to glow before shooting a Revelation beam either straight downward or 2 beams in diagonal directions downwards.
Uriel deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Gabriel
sections.text: Gabriel wears a bright red robe. He drops Key Piece 2 upon defeat.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Gabriel moves towards Isaac, and attempts to position himself above Isaac while doing so. He stops moving to perform the following attacks:

• Folds his wings, then either shoots a ring of 12 projectiles or Revelation beams in the diagonal directions.

• Folds his wings, then summons an Angelic Baby with a maximum of 2 alive at once.

• Angelic Babies can be damaged and killed by Gabriel's light beams.

• Gabriel's hands begin to glow before shooting Revelation beams in the cardinal directions.
Gabriel deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Dad's Key, The Family Man, Filigree Feather, Angelic Prism]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The angels will always alternate in order of appearance. Thus, if Uriel has just been defeated, the next angel spawn is guaranteed to be Gabriel and vice versa.

• If the player defeats an angel, and they already have both Key Pieces, no Key Piece drops. However, if this occurs, it counts as a normal room clear, and the player may be rewarded with a pickup or chest.

• Angels only drop a Key Piece the first time they are defeated, even if Isaac does not pick up the Key Piece, subsequent kills in the same run provide no pedestal item rewards.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Angels will drop a Key Piece even if they were defeated before. Additionally, if Isaac has one of the Key Pieces, angels will always drop the other piece, even if he already skipped that piece or that particular angel normally wouldn't drop it (for instance, Uriel will drop Key Piece 2 if Isaac already has Key Piece 1 from fighting him earlier).

• Rerolling Key Piece 1 or Key Piece 2 will yield an item from a pool, depending on which room the Key Pieces are in.

• Rerolling the Key Pieces in an Angel Room will yield an item from the Angel Room item pool.

• The angel's beams of light are rendered at a height, though their hitbox is on the ground (and their shadow is invisible). For diagonal beams, this causes Isaac to take damage even if he is below them, and allows him to partially walk into the beams if he is above them.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Angels will drop items from the Angel Room item pool instead of the Key Pieces if Isaac is holding Filigree Feather. [end edition note] 

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Sometimes, two angel statues can appear in the same room. Destroying both at the same time will spawn both Uriel and Gabriel, but only one Key Piece will drop. If each angel is spawned and defeated separately, both will drop Key Pieces.

• [Repentance] Both angels will drop key pieces if fought at the same time.

• Uriel and Gabriel are immune to the Fear effect.

• When spawned inside a Sacrifice Room, the room is not locked, allowing Isaac to simply walk out of the fight.

• When returning to the Sacrifice Room, the angel will be gone.

• [Before Afterbirth+] As a result, it is possible to miss obtaining Key Piece 1 while getting Key Piece 2.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Uriel (or Auriel/Oriel) is one of the archangels of post-Exilic Rabbinic tradition, and also of certain Christian traditions. The name means "God is my light" - in Hebrew, ori (or uri) means "my light" and el means "god".

• Gabriel is an archangel who typically serves as a messenger sent from God to certain people in Abrahamic religions. The name means "God is my strength".

• Uriel and Gabriel, along with the angel statues, have no face. This is in reference to Exodus 33:20 in the Bible, when God stated:

• "But," He said, "you cannot see my face, for man shall not see me and live."

• Uriel and Gabriel may be based on Seraph and Cherub angels. Seraphim are angels that fly above God's throne while Cherubim guard the throne.

• [Repentance] The angels' battle theme is different depending on which route they are fought in. If they are fought on the main route, either Crusade or Cerebrum Dispersio will play; if fought on the alternate route, Juggernaut will play. They share this characteristic with The Pile and Reap Creep. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Delirium can transform into Fallen Uriel and Fallen Gabriel but they do not have unique Delirium skins.

Anarchist Cookbook.title: Anarchist Cookbook
Anarchist Cookbook.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns 6 Troll Bombs, generally near the center of the room.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can drop from killing Pride. [Before Repentance] Pride can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• Although visually unchanged, all passive Bomb effect items affect the spawned Troll Bombs unless otherwise noted.

• The Troll Bombs created by Anarchist Cookbook spawn in one at a time; if Isaac leaves the room soon after using it, not all 6 Troll Bombs will spawn.

• Using this item without any blast protection is not always recommended as it is very easy to be caught in the blast.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like bombs. The wisps spawn Troll Bombs when destroyed. These troll bombs will use Isaac's bomb synergies.

• Blasting Cap: Spawned Troll Bombs can drop extra bomb pickups.

• Car Battery : Spawns 13 troll bombs.

• Remote Detonator: The Troll Bombs generated will not explode until Remote Detonator is activated, unlike regular Troll Bombs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bomber Boy: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.

• Mr. Mega: No effect.

• Pyromaniac: Spawned bombs can be used for mass healing.

• Safety Scissors: Spawned troll bombs become bomb pickups.

• Scatter Bombs: Not recommended. Each Troll Bomb will spawn several smaller bombs upon exploding, making it very hard to avoid taking damage.

• [Repentance] No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is a reference to the book of the same name, which explains how to make explosives, rudimentary communication devices, and other items.

fields.description: Spawns six Troll Bombs around the room.

Ancient Recall.title: Ancient Recall
Ancient Recall.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Spawns 3 random cards.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Being a special card, Ancient Recall has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.

• Special "cards" like Cracked Key and Dice Shard can be spawned, but runes cannot spawn.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Ancient Recall has been added in Booster Pack #1, after the initial release of the DLC.

• Ancient Recall is based on this Steam Workshop mod by aeiou.

• Ancient Recall is a reference to the card Ancestral Recall from Magic: The Gathering.

• [Repentance] Prior to patch v1.7.7 of Repentance, it was possible to spawn infinite cards with this card and Echo Chamber. [end edition note]

fields.description: Spawns 3 random cards.

Anemic.title: Anemic
Anemic.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon taking damage, Isaac leaves a trail of red creep that damages enemies until he leaves the room.

• The creep deals 2 damage per tick (6 damage per second) to enemies that walk over it.

• [edition alternatives: baseline: +5; Repentance: +1.5] range.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The effects of this item do not stack if multiple copies of the item or its effects are acquired; Isaac only gets the range bonus once.

• Lazarus, or anyone holding Lazarus' Rags, is resurrected with this item upon his first death.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] After Backasswards is beaten, Lazarus will start with Anemic, and Lazarus Risen will have its increased range and creep trail effect permanently active, regardless of whether he possesses the item. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Anemia is a decrease in the blood's ability to carry oxygen. This can either be caused by a decrease in hemoglobin in blood cells, or red blood cells altogether. Sensitivity towards bleeding is a symptom, hence this item's effect.

• [Repentance] This item is used in Bloody Mary. [end edition note] 

• Glass Cannon invokes the effects of Anemic for the current room when Isaac takes damage.

fields.description: After Isaac is damaged, a trail of red creep will be left behind him until he leaves the current room. [Before Repentance] +5 range. [end edition note] [Repentance] +1.5 range. [end edition note]

Angelic Prism.title: Angelic Prism
Angelic Prism.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • It will also quadruple shooting familiar tears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Akeldama: Turns the chain of tears into four multi-colored chains.

• Anti-Gravity: Tears that are floating in the air when they hit the prism will quadruple but will not move. Tears that begin moving before they hit the prism will travel outwards normally.

• By releasing the built up tears as the prism passes by, significantly more tears can be affected than normal.

• With Flat Stone, split suspended tears will bounce in place until their duration ends.

• Duct Tape: By keeping the prism in the same spot, damage output can be significantly increased in that direction.

• Duct Tape + Incubus: By stacking the incubus familiar on top of the prism before picking up Duct Tape, the shots will be affected no matter what direction Isaac is firing.

• Immaculate Heart: The extra spectral tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.

• Jacob's Ladder: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, electric arcs that pass through the prism will be split.

• The Ludovico Technique: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.

• Saturnus: Since the prism and the orbiting tears have the exact same orbital radius, orbiting tears will immediately be split into 28 multi-colored tears upon entering a room.

• Tractor Beam: Tears will split but continue stacked on top of each other along the tractor beam, essentially quadrupling the shot's damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bot Fly: Its tears are split in four.

• BFFS!: Only a visual size change, with no difference in the hitbox and thus usefulness of the Prism.

• Brimstone / Revelation / Salvation / Shoop da Whoop! / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2: The laser is split in four.

• C Section: Fetuses split in four.

• Chaos Card: Four cards are shot out if Chaos Card hits the prism.

• [Before Repentance] Dr. Fetus: Split bombs can also damage charmed enemies summoned by Friendly Ball, Poke Go, and Delirious.

• [Before Repentance] Dr. Fetus + Remote Detonator: Bombs split through the prism cannot be remotely detonated.

• Epic Fetus: No effect.

• Eraser: The Eraser splits, like normal tears.

• [Before Repentance] Ipecac: Split explosions can also damage charmed enemies summoned by Friendly Ball, Poke Go, and Delirious.

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife: When the knife touches the prism, split knives are launched that do not return to Isaac. The extra knives deal only 1x damage, unlike normal thrown knives.

• [Repentance] The duplicated knives deal full damage and return to Isaac normally.

• My Reflection: Tears made by the prism will not quadruple once more if they hit the prism again.

• Proptosis: Tears that hit the prism will continue to shrink as normal even after they split until they disappear.

• Rocket in a Jar: Rockets do not split, unless its paired with Dr. Fetus, and even then only normal attacks are affected.

• Rubber Cement: Tears will split and will bounce if they hit a wall. However, if split tears hit the prism, they will not split again.

• Sharp Key: Key projectiles can split through the prism.

• Tech X: Laser rings are split into four.

• Tiny Planet: Tears that hit the prism will quadruple, but all four tears will overlap and follow the same orbit.

• Urn of Souls: The flames split into four multicolored flames.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Angelic Prism is based on this Steam Workshop item by electoon and Erfly, originally known as Thought.

• The description and appearance of the item are references to Pink Floyd's 8th studio album, The Dark Side of The Moon.

• The description is an excerpt from the final line of Eclipse, the last song on the album: "And everything under the sun is in tune / But the sun is eclipsed by the moon"

• The familiar spawned by this item is geometrically not a prism, but rather a square pyramid.

fields.description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

Angry Fly.title: Angry Fly
Angry Fly.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 2 damage per tick/30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

• It will occasionally make a lunge towards the enemy it is orbiting, allowing brief contact even with smaller enemies.

• If the enemy it is orbiting dies, it starts orbiting a different enemy.

• If there are no enemies, it orbits Isaac.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Angry Fly will orbit around invincible enemies such as Stone Grimaces without dealing damage.

• Due to its movement pattern, its actual damage dealt per second is erratic against most enemies and groups of them.

• [Repentance] As Tainted Jacob, Angry Fly will orbit around Dark Esau.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Angry Fly is based on this Steam Workshop item by Custom Phase.

fields.description: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

Anima Sola.title: Anima Sola
Anima Sola.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tainted Jacob starts with this item in the consumable slot.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, chains down the nearest enemy, completely preventing them from acting for 5 seconds.

• This effect works on enemies that are invulnerable.

• If used again, it releases the enemy early.

• If multiple enemies are chained down at once, the enemy released early will be the one closest to Isaac even if Dark Esau is chained down too.

• While playing as Tainted Jacob:

• Anima Sola will always target Dark Esau if he is present.

• While Dark Esau is chained down, using Anima Sola again will release him and cause him to charge directly at Tainted Jacob, damaging and burning enemies in its path. This will not use up additional item charges.

• Dark Esau deals no contact damage to Jacob while chained down.

• If used in a room with no enemies, Anima Sola will immediately summon Dark Esau.

• If Birthright is obtained, the recharge time is lowered to 10 seconds and the chain duration is increased to 6.67 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Enemies other than Dark Esau can also be released. This will not cause them to do anything special.

• If The Visage's mask is chained down when it runs out of HP, it will outright die instead of becoming temporarily inactive, leaving only the heart to be fought. It is unknown if this is a bug.

• If Mom's Heart / It Lives! is chained down before it can spawn the Eyes at the beginning of the fight and is damaged enough to advance a phase by the time the chains break, the Eyes will not spawn.

• Delirium will stop shapeshifting when chained.

• If an enemy is in the middle of attacking with tears, their tears will still be fired after the effect ends. This happens even if the enemy has zero HP by the end of the ability.

• If used against The Beast during her chase attack, the destructible pillars will stop spawning until the effect ends.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 9 Volt: Halves recharge time, allowing for chaining enemies much more frequently.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a dark wisp that orbits the locked enemy and shoots at them. When the enemy dies, the wisp despawns.

• Car Battery: Two enemies will be chained simultaneously. If only one valid enemy is present, it will be chained for twice the duration. Using Anima Sola again will unchain the enemy closest to Isaac first.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Anima Sola" translates to "Lone Soul" or "Lonely Soul" in Latin. In a Christian context, it refers to a lone soul stranded and suffering in purgatory.

• The most popular depiction of this concept also involves both a chain, binding the lone soul's hands, as well as flames, like those following Dark Esau.

• • A splash of color in the chains can also be seen in the Anima Sola's icon, depicting said flames.

• The Anima Sola shares its name with an enemy from one of Edmund McMillen's other games, The End is Nigh.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If Anima Sola is used on segmented enemies (such as Larry Jr.) and targets one of the middle segments, the enemy will sometimes be split into two after the chains break.

fields.description: Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from moving or attacking.

Ankh.title: Ankh
Ankh.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Upon death, Isaac will respawn as ??? in the previous room, with 3 Soul Hearts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Resurrection items activate in a set order. [Before Repentance] Ankh is 6th in this order after 1up!, Dead Cat, Lazarus' inherent extra life, Guppy's Collar, and Lazarus' Rags.

• [Repentance] Ankh is 8th in this order after Soul of Lazarus, 1up!, Lazarus' inherent extra life, Dead Cat, Inner Child, Guppy's Collar, and Lazarus' Rags.

• Like other items that grant an extra life, but respawn Isaac as a different character, all completion marks earned from the moment of death onward will count towards the new character, not the old.

• [Repentance] During The Beast fight, Isaac respawns in the place he died. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tainted ???: Revives as himself, rather than normal ???. Effectively acts as a 1up!.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Ankh is an Egyptian hieroglyph that means "life".

• It's possible that the resurrection as ??? is a reference to mummies, often depicted as undead in pop culture.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, the Ankh gave Isaac eyeshadow, like the one Eve wears.

• This item shares a pickup quote with Guppy's Collar.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When downloading a synced file where player 2 was revived as ??? before the character is unlocked, Player 2 will become Player 1 and be loaded as Isaac.

fields.description: Upon death, Isaac will respawn as ??? in the previous room, with 3 Soul Hearts.

Ansuz.title: Ansuz
Ansuz.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Reveals the whole map, including the Secret Room and the Super Secret Room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Does not reveal the Ultra Secret Room. [end edition note] 

• Will not remove [cu: Lost] .

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Secrets: The mapping provided by Ansuz counts as one mapping effect. After using Ansuz, the X-Ray Vision effect can be activated by using the Book of Secrets three times instead of four.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

fields.name: Ansuz
fields.description: Reveals the whole map, including the Secret Room and the Super Secret Room. (This will not remove [cu: Lost] .) [Repentance] Does not reveal the Ultra Secret Room. [end edition note]

Anti-Gravity.title: Anti-Gravity
Anti-Gravity.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Holding the fire buttons causes tears to hover in midair. When released, the tears will all shoot in the direction they were originally fired.

• If the fire buttons are not released, the tears will fire on their own after 3 seconds.

• [Before Repentance] [tear delay down: 2] 

• [Repentance] +1.0 fire rate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Gravitational effects, such as Mega Fatty's inhalation or a Gaping Maw will pull floating tears toward them.

• The range attribute only affects the lifespan of the tears after they have been released.

• Hovering tears can damage monsters like Knights or Mask of Infamy from the front, even if they don't have the piercing effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• C Section: Fetuses stand in place while the fire button is held. They will still home on enemies in this state. Fetuses attacking this way deal more damage.

• The Forgotten: Each swing of his club creates an additional hitbox in front of him that lasts for about a second before proceeding forward and disappearing. The club throw is unaffected.

• Lachryphagy: Tears will float in midair, making them easier to feed. Burst tears will also float in midair before moving.

• Proptosis: The tears will not decrease in size or damage until they start moving, making this excellent against enemies that chase Isaac.

• Tainted Magdalene: Hug swipes float, allowing for extra hits as the swipes remain mid-air.

• Tech.5: Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.

• Technology Zero: All of the tears fired are connected by electricity, creating a series of electric fences.

• Tiny Planet: Tears stay in place until released, they will start to orbit around Isaac when released.

• [Repentance] Tears orbit close to Isaac when held, then snap to the edge of the orbit when released.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel / Brimstone: A red mist expands and then contracts, doing contact damage to any enemy that touches it. It then fires the original Brimstone shot before disappearing. It allows a new shot to be charged up immediately after firing without interrupting the first shot. It does not increase the range of Azazel's Brimstone beam.

• [Before Repentance] Brimstone + Conjoined: Fires a single laser instead of a triple laser.

• Brimstone + Soy Milk: Brimstone continues firing from the position it was fired.

• Bob's Rotten Head: Continues to hover in the air while the fire button is pressed after launching it.

• Chocolate Milk: Overrides Anti-Gravity.

• Chocolate Milk + Soy Milk: Tears are released immediately, despite not charging.

• Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / Haemolacria / The Parasite: Burst tears will not hover even if a fire button is held.

• Cursed Eye / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Eye of the Occult / The Ludovico Technique / Marked / Mom's Knife / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Only tear delay down applies.

• Diplopia: No effect; -2 tears delay does not stack.

• Euthanasia: If a needle tear destroys an enemy and the fire button is held, the burst needles will hover until the button is released.

• Kidney Stone: When the Kidney Stone effect is activated, the tear barrage will hover until released. The stone will not hover and will travel regardless.

• [Repentance] : (Not recommended) The anti-gravity effect stays in place for the whole duration of the tear barrage even if the fire button isn't held resulting in a complete loss of control of fire for as long as the barrage is active.

• A Lump of Coal: Despite the visual increase in size, damage still only increases based on the distance traveled.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Tears no longer increase in size while hovering.

• Multidimensional Baby: Multidimensional Baby will travel the same path as the Anti-Gravity tears, easily doubling any stationary shots. Any moving tears that hit it will produce a normal moving copy, however stationary tears will spawn a copy that will eventually fall to the ground even after the direction is released.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.

• My Reflection: Combines both effects. Tears no longer hover in place; instead, they will weakly home in on Isaac like he is a pivot point, following as he moves. Releasing the attack buttons will launch the tears from their position as usual.

• Notched Axe: Melee attacks will generate a hovering tear in the shape of the swing of the pickaxe.

• Spirit Sword: Sword beams are affected normally by Anti-Gravity. Regular sword swipes are unaffected, but spin attacks freeze for a short time before firing.

• Technology: Only tear delay down applies.

• [Repentance] Creates floating laser balls that will all fire simultaneously when the fire button is released.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Isaac's appearance bears a strong resemblance to the character Dr. Manhattan of the graphic novel Watchmen.

• After picking up Anti-Gravity, whenever Isaac picks up an item that alters the appearance of his face, his head becomes the same color as ???'s.

• This item is used in Waka Waka.

fields.description: Tears float in position until firing ceases, after which they will fly off in the direction they were shot in. [Before Repentance] -2 Tear Delay. [Repentance] +1 Fire Rate.

Apollyon's Best Friend.title: Apollyon's Best Friend
Apollyon's Best Friend.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns an attack locust familiar identical to the default ones spawned by Abyss. It will fly forward while Isaac is shooting and deals contact damage [Before Repentance+] equal to Isaac's damage.

• [Repentance+] The locust is treated as a Quality 3 locust and deals 1.5x Isaac's damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Apollyon's Best Friend / Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Each effect/trinket copy stacks, granting an extra locust per stack.

• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Increases the locust's damage by 25%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Unlike many other effects which grant a familiar lasting multiple rooms, Apollyon's Best Friend is unaffected by the duplication bug from Glowing Hourglass.

fields.description: Spawns an Abyss locust familiar which will fly forward while Isaac shoots.

Apple!.title: Apple!
Apple!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a chance to fire razor blades that deal quadruple Isaac's tear damage.

• +0.3 tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire a razor blade depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 15 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 6.66%, maxing out at 100% at 14 luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Cricket's Body / Compound Fracture / The Parasite: When razors are fired, the split tears will also be razors and do quadruple damage. The Parasite's split tears look like normal tears.

• Dr. Fetus: Adds a chance for the bombs to deal increased damage. See the page for the specific damage formula.

• [Before Repentance] Glass Cannon: Adds a chance to fire a giant razor that does roughly triple damage.

• [Repentance] Adds a chance to fire a giant razor that does quadruple damage (x40 + 10 flat damage).

• Haemolacria: Adds a chance for tears to do quadruple damage. Burst tears will also do quadruple damage if the main tear does quadruple damage.

• Technology Zero: When razors are fired, they will connect to other tears via electricity. The electricity also does quadruple damage.

• Lachryphagy: Tears can be fed to razors, increasing damage and splitting into 8 razors after a little while. If razors are fed to the tears, the razor damage doesn't apply to the tear both before and after splitting.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone: Each entire beam has a chance to gain the damage boost.

• [Repentance] Each tick of the beam has a chance to gain the damage boost.

• Papa Fly/Pointy Rib/Linger Bean: Can benefit the damage multiplier. 

• Tech X: Overrides Apple!.

• [Repentance] Each tick of the laser rings have a chance to gain the damage boost.

• Tough Love: With 14 luck, overrides Tough Love, as the razor blades do more damage anyways. With 13 luck, Apple and Tough Love each have about an equal chance to trigger.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Both the item itself and the description is a reflection of one of Isaac's nightmares between floors that involves him finding a razor blade inside a piece of candy.

• The item and pickup quote are a reference to the urban legend of giving away candies with razor blades hidden inside of them as a way of harming people.

fields.description: +0.3 tears. Adds a chance to fire a razor blade that deals 4× Isaac's damage.

Apple of Sodom.title: Apple of Sodom
Apple of Sodom.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Picking up a Red Heart has a 50% chance to consume the heart and spawn Blue Spiders, causing a fart that deals no damage.

• Isaac can pick up hearts even while at full health. In this case, the chance goes to 100%.

• Has no effect on Rotten Hearts, Blended Hearts, or any other type of heart.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The number of spiders spawned depends on the type of heart that was picked up:

• Half Red Hearts will spawn 1-3 spiders.

• Full Red Hearts will spawn 3-5 spiders.

• Double Hearts will spawn 6-8 spiders.

• The trinket allows characters that cannot use red hearts to gain value from red hearts.

• Items that directly heal Isaac, such as Yum Heart, cannot produce any spiders. The hearts must be picked up off the ground.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: All types of hearts can be converted to spiders.

• Hypercoagulation / Soul of Magdalene / Tainted Magdalene: Temporary hearts can be turned into blue spiders.

• Options?: Converting hearts dropped by Options? will not cause the other consumable to disappear.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: No effect.

• Candy Heart: Does not increase stats if the heart is converted to spiders.

• The Jar: Has a 50% chance to turn a heart into a blue spider or put it in The Jar.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Apple of Sodom was a cut trinket from Antibirth. It was most likely going to be an unlock for the unused character Edith.

• Calotropis procera, known under the name of apple of Sodom, is a plant that produces a hollow fruit with fibers inside of it. It is named so because it supposedly grew on the land of Sodom. In the Hebrew Bible, the apple of Sodom is referenced metaphorically to represent something that appears good but is actually poisonous.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Converting a heart by buying it will not consume any money. However, Isaac must have the amount of coins needed to purchase the heart.

fields.description: Picking up Red Hearts, even while at full health, can convert them into blue spiders. The effect may consume hearts needed for healing.

Aquarius.title: Aquarius
Aquarius.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Isaac leaves a trail of blue creep where he walks that damages enemies that walk over it.

• [Before Repentance] The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second.

• [Repentance] The creep deals 66% of Isaac's damage 10 times per second.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Lil Blub. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] The creep copies Isaac's tear effects and changes colors based on Isaac's tears.

• Chance for triggering the effects works like it does for tears.

• The creep's color changes even if the items don't have an applicable tear effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Apple! / Knockout Drops / Tough Love: Creep does not appear visually different but has a chance to inflict the respective bonus effects.

• [Repentance] Homing tears: Creep moves towards nearby enemies that are on the ground, ignoring ones that fly.

• Ipecac: Creep becomes green and poisons enemies but does not explode.

• Lost Cork: The creep is 50% larger.

• A Lump of Coal: Creep does more damage the farther Isaac is from the enemy.

• Proptosis: Creep deals 2x Isaac's damage instead of 66%.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Eye of the Occult: Turns the creep purple but creep can't be controlled.

• Fire Mind: Turns the creep orange and burns enemies but does not explode.

• Godhead: Creep becomes homing as expected but does not have a larger radius.

• Montezuma's Revenge: Turns the creep brown despite the item not affecting Isaac's tear color.

• Sulfuric Acid: Occasionally turns the creep yellow but doesn't destroy obstacles.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The pickup quote "Trail of Tears" is a common phrase referencing the U.S. Indian Removal Act of 1830.

fields.description: A trail of blue creep is left behind Isaac, which damages enemies. [Repentance] The creep scales with damage and inherits most tear effects.

Aries.title: Aries
Aries.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.25 speed.

• [Before Repentance] Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).

• Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal [edition alternatives: baseline: 18; Repentance: 25] damage.

• At least 0.85 Speed is required to be able to move quickly enough.

• • [Repentance] Moving at this speed also prevents contact damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Serpent's Kiss: Allows Isaac to poison enemies without needing to take a hit, allowing for an impressive amount of Black Hearts to be collected.

• Tainted Forgotten: Throwing the skeleton will deal 80 damage on contact.

• Tainted Magdalene's hugs stack with Aries, dealing insane combined contact damage to enemies. This also makes T. Magdalene invulnerable at high speeds, whilst still generating a decent amount of red hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Isaac's Heart: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The horns that Isaac receives after obtaining Aries are similar to The Lamb's, and very similar to Curved Horn.

fields.description: +0.25 speed. Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal damage. [Repentance] Prevents Isaac from taking contact damage while moving at high speed.

Astral Projection.title: Astral Projection
Astral Projection.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has flight and spectral tears and the next hit he takes is negated.

• Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.

• Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Clutch. [end edition note] 

• The damage blocked by being in ghost form also affects self-damage and red-heart draining sources, like Devil Beggars, IV Bag, etc.

• Receiving lethal damage can potentially save Isaac's life if he manages to heal before the ghost reenters the body.

• Dull Razor may be used to safely activate Astral Projection as The Lost.

• It's also possible to leave the room while the ghost is outside the body, either by bombing it or having items that keep doors open, such as Door Stop or Mercurius. This grants Isaac an additional chance to heal.

• Teleporting outside of the room will not work.

• [Before Repentance+] Astral Projection cannot be triggered inside of Boss Rush.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Hypercoagulation: Due to the effective speed up, the heart used to activate Astral Projection can easily be collected before it disappears.

• IV Bag / Dull Razor / Other sources of self damage: If used in a hostile room, Astral Projection will trigger, effectively granting flight and Holy Mantle for the room.

• Old Bandage / Gimpy: When getting hit with only one heart left, Astral Projection allows for picking up the dropped heart in the brief time of invincibility even when the player has no hearts left. Failing to do so or having no hearts dropped results in guaranteed death however, but with luck this loop can be used to potentially save runs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Holy Mantle: The shield will activate before Astral Projection.

• The Lost / Tainted Lost: The Lost will continue to fight after taking damage, however he will instantly die upon taking damage again or once the room is cleared.

• If The Lost receives at least half a Soul Heart through any means while the effect is active, he will survive. Black Hearts cannot be used for this.

• Plan C / Other insta-kill effects: Will kill Isaac without triggering the ghost effect.

• Rock Bottom: Does not preserve the tears and speed bonus Isaac receives after activating Astral Projection.

• Spirit Shackles: This item will not activate if Isaac received lethal damage when Astral Projection activated.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item description is a reference to Guillotine.

• Astral projection is an esoteric belief where the "astral body" is separated from the physical body and can travel throughout the universe.

fields.description: Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him flight and spectral tears and blocking the next hit he takes.

Athame.title: Athame
Athame.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] When Isaac takes damage, a black ring briefly appears around him, dealing tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it.

• When an enemy is killed with the black ring, there is a 15% chance for it to drop a Black Heart.

• Black Hearts will drop as soon as the enemy is killed. (In other words, the heart will drop at the beginning of the death animation rather than at the end of the death animation.)

• [Repentance] When Isaac kills an enemy, gives a chance for a black ring to appear around where it once was, dealing Isaac's tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it. The chance scales with Isaac's luck. The base chance is 25%, with an additional 2.5% chance per point of luck, capping out at 100% at 30 luck.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The ring created by Athame is identical to the ring created by Maw Of The Void.

• Athame is especially effective against bosses that summon many monsters, such as Envy, Super Envy, and Brownie.

• [Before Repentance] Each piece of Envy/Brownie Corn grants a 15% chance for a Black Heart.

• [Repentance] Black rings can also be generated by destroyed Shopkeepers.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Contagion/Toxic Shock: Can allow for substantial chains of enemy kills and rapid room clearing. [end edition note] 

• Homing tears: The black ring becomes homing, curving around to hit enemies.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Ipecac: Massively increases damage and poisons enemies. [Repentance] Causes the ring to explode upon contact with walls or obstacles. The explosions can damage Isaac.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Proptosis: The ring is much larger and deals 1.5x damage.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Proptosis: The ring is much larger but deals normal damage.

• Wiggle Worm: The ring has wavy edges.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can't create black rings.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create black rings.

• Holy Mantle: Getting hit when the Holy Mantle shield is active prevents Athame from triggering its effect.

• [Before Afterbirth+] A Lump of Coal: The ring damage is halved.

• [Repentance] Proptosis: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• An athame is a ceremonial blade, generally with a black handle. It is the main ritual implement or magical tool among several used in the religion of Wicca and is also used in various other neopagan witchcraft traditions. The athame stands as one of the four elemental tools in Wicca, traditionally standing for fire.

• A black-handled knife called an athame appears in certain versions of the Key of Solomon, a grimoire originating in the Middle Ages.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts.
[Repentance] After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a luck-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.

Azazel's Rage.title: Azazel's Rage
Azazel's Rage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.

• After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large Brimstone laser for ~3.33 seconds.

• The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The counter for activation will go up during Greed Mode, Challenge Rooms, Boss Challenge Rooms and Boss Rush waves, as well as the waves in the The Beast fight.

• If the Brimstone laser is ready, it will fire automatically after clearing a Greed Mode or Beast fight wave.

• [Before Repentance+] It will not fire in challenge rooms or boss rush.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is, most likely, Azazel's severed right horn.

• This item resembles one of the horns of The Beast.

fields.description: Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large Brimstone laser when entering the next room.

Azazel's Stump.title: Azazel's Stump
Azazel's Stump.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a 33% chance to visually turn into Azazel when clearing a room. Isaac keeps his hearts and items, but changes his tears to be a short range Brimstone, gains a x1.5 damage multiplier, a Speed increase, and the ability to fly.

• The effect lasts until clearing and leaving another room.

• The effect can be taken to the next floor.

• The Speed increase is equal to the difference between the current character's base speed and Azazel's (which is 1.25). For instance, Keeper will gain +0.35 Speed since his base speed is 0.9.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Dropping the trinket after this transformation will not reverse it until a new room is cleared.

• The trinket only changes Isaac's appearance to be as Azazel's but doesn't change the actual character. This means that the trinket cannot be used to unlock achievements for Azazel.

• The effect will not change Isaac's health mechanics. For example, The Lost will retain his zero health and Holy Mantle.

• When entering the area in Mines / Ashpit to obtain Knife Piece 2 while in the Azazel form, flight and the Brimstone laser will remain despite visually reverting.

• However, because picking up the Knife Piece triggers a room clear, the form will be reverted upon leaving the knife piece room, and the escape sequence will not benefit from the trinket's effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box / multiple copies: One boost or additional copy increases the chance of Isaac turning into Azazel to 50%. Further boosts or copies increase the chance to 100%.

• Rock Bottom: Isaac retains the damage multiplier and base speed increase after the effect ends. Also removes the tear delay multiplier when transformed into Azazel.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel: Increases the width of his Brimstone, identical to his Birthright effect.

• Birthright as Azazel: Azazel's Stump has no further effect.

• The Forgotten: Still uses his regular bone club attack while in skeleton form. The Soul will work as expected, and use the short-range Brimstone.

• Tainted Forgotten: The bone pile will visually turn into Azazel, with no gameplay effects.

sections.heading: References
sections.text: • The Binding of Isaac Item Trigger Testing

fields.description: When clearing a room, adds a 33% chance to turn into Azazel until clearing another.

BBF.title: BBF
BBF.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that flies around the room like a Boom Fly and explodes on contact with an enemy.

• Deals [edition alternatives: baseline: 60; Repentance: 100] damage to all enemies within its blast radius and 10 damage to the enemy it touched.

• It will respawn 10 seconds after exploding, or upon entering a different room.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Most obtained bomb modifiers are applied to BBF as well.

• The blast can damage Isaac as a normal bomb would.

• For the first few moments after entering a room, the familiar will do contact damage instead of exploding. This means the familiar will not blow up in Isaac's face if there is an enemy right next to the familiar's starting point. However, it may kill enemies that explode on death.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles the contact damage to 20 and increases explosion damage by 25.

• [Repentance] Contact damage becomes 20 and explosion damage increases to 125.

• Mr. Mega: The explosion damage increases by 50 points.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Effects applied as normal:

• Blood Bombs

• Brimstone Bombs

• Butt Bombs

• Glitter Bombs

• Hot Bombs

• Nancy Bombs

• Sad Bombs

• No effect:

• Bobby-Bomb

• Fast Bombs

• Ghost Bombs

• Rocket in a Jar

• Scatter Bombs

• Sticky Bombs

• Bob's Curse: The explosion applies poison effect.

• [Repentance] Does not leave the poison cloud. [end edition note] 

• Bomber Boy: No cross explosions. Damage from the explosion is halved against the initial target, but others caught in the blast take full damage.

• [Repentance] Explodes in a cross-shaped pattern. Damage from the main explosion deals a flat 37.5 damage, and any additional explosion deals flat 75 damage to which Bomber boy's damage reduction is not applied.

• • Bomber Boy + BFFS! / Hive Mind: Explosion damages are increased to 1.25x, which are 46.875/93.75 each.

• • Bomber Boy + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.5x, which are 56.25/112.5 each.

• • Bomber Boy + BFFS! / Hive Mind + Mr. Mega: Explosion damages are increased to 1.75x, which are 65.625/131.25 each.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The item's name is a reference to the acronym BBW, which stands for "Big Beautiful Woman".

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: BBF sometimes does contact damage to certain enemies without exploding.
Bug note: BBF can get stuck in corners in The Beast fight.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that flies around the room in a zig-zag pattern and explodes on contact with an enemy. Respawns after ten seconds.

BFFS!.title: BFFS!
BFFS!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Visually increases the size of all familiars by 25%, and improves the effectiveness of most of them.

• Doubles the damage of Familiars that deal damage through tears and contact damage.

• • Has no effect on Creep generated by familiars.

• For pickup-generating familiars, increases the frequency that they drop pickups.

• • Familiars that require clearing a certain number of rooms will require one less room.

• • Familiars that have a random chance to drop items have a higher chance.

• • Familiars that pick up consumables require less, except Dark Bum which is unaffected.

• Some familiars have unique synergies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The size change is only cosmetic: familiars' hitbox for blocking damage or attacking is not affected.

• Familiars summoned by a trinket or by Monster Manual are also affected by BFFS!.

• [Repentance] Wisps are also affected by BFFS!.

• Blue Flies and Blue Spiders are not affected, they instead benefit from Hive Mind.

• Does not increase the frequency or effectiveness of status effects applied by familiars.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BBF/Bob's Brain: Doubles impact damage and increases explosive damage by 25.

• Bird Cage: Spawns 4 rock waves in an x pattern. Doubles the damage when the bird lands and doubles contact damage. Damage of waves unaffected.

• Blood Oath: Adds 2 extra full hearts worth of bonuses if any health is drained.

• [Repentance] Holy Water: Double water damage and spawns a blue flame at point of impact.

• Incubus: Shoots tears that do [edition alternatives: baseline: 2x; Repentance: 1.5x] Isaac's damage. Still deals 2x as Lilith.

• [Repentance] Isaac's Heart: Fires additional shots in random directions and leaves a larger puddle of creep. Does not change the heart's size.

• Juicy Sack: Spawns an extra Blue Spider.

• Lil Spewer: Increases the creep pool's size, but not its damage.

• Lost Soul: Gives the Lost Soul a Holy Mantle effect.

• Mystery Egg: Spawns a champion variant of an enemy, even if the enemy normally can't be a champion.

• Stitches: On use, fires eight tears from Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects.

• Succubus: The aura's radius increases, but the damage multiplier and damage to enemies remain the same.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blood Puppy: Only increases the damage and size while it isn't hostile.

• Evil Eye: The eyes are not treated as familiars and therefore will not synergize with BFFS!

• Guillotine/Scissors: Doesn't change the head's size, but still improves its damage.

• [Repentance] Hive Mind: Does not stack.

• Shade: Retains the increased damage even after being absorbed.

sections.heading: No Effect
sections.text: The following familiars will appear larger, but gain no actual benefits.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• BFF stands for Best Friends Forever.

• This item is used in The Family Man and Scat Man.

fields.description: Increases the size and effectiveness of most familiars.

BOGO Bombs.title: BOGO Bombs
BOGO Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • All normal Bombs become Double Bombs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Humbleing Bundle: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "B.O.G.O." is an acronym for the term "Buy One, Get One (Free)".

• The description on this item is a reference to picking up double bombs in the original The Binding of Isaac where the message "1+1 Free!" would pop up in the bottom right whenever picking up a double bomb.

fields.description: All normal Bombs become Double Bombs.

Baby Long Legs.title: Baby Long Legs
Baby Long Legs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Baby Long Legs quickly run away from Isaac and occasionally stops to spawn a Spider. Usually, they can spawn a maximum of 3 Spiders. They run around erratically when Isaac is nearby and can sometimes run directly into him when this occurs.

sections.heading: Small Baby Long Legs
sections.text: The Small Baby Long Legs is a tiny variant of Baby Long Legs that simultaneously spawns Sacks along with a small puddle of slowing White Creep. The Sacks it spawns start at around half health and take a while to regenerate fully.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • If a Small Baby Long Legs attempts to spawn a Sack on top of an already spawned Sack, the newly spawned Sack will replace the previous one.

Baby Plum.title: Baby Plum
Baby Plum.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Baby Plum is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in all environments of Chapter 1 (Basement, Cellar, Burning Basement).

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Baby Plum floats slowly towards Isaac and attempts to orbit a certain distance around him. She will not break this distance unless she performs an attack with a movement ability. While chasing Isaac, she also performs the following attacks:

• Spits a diagonal stream of projectiles, propelling herself backwards across the room and bouncing off any walls she collides into.

• Randomly scattered in the stream are larger projectiles that deal a whole heart of damage.

• Baby Plum takes increased knockback from any source during this attack.

• Twirls towards Isaac, sending out a spiral of projectiles.

• The spiral will always start pointing down, then make a full rotation starting in the direction closest to Isaac.

• Slams the ground, firing two rings of projectiles outwards and leaving behind a small pool of Red Creep. The inner ring consists of 14 slow-moving projectiles while the outer one consists of 8 fast-moving projectiles.

• The outer ring's projectiles will always be fired in the cardinal and ordinal directions, while the inner ring's projectiles will have a random spread.

• Upon death, releases a ring of 10 projectiles.
If Baby Plum doesn't take damage for 30 seconds, she will wave at the screen before flying away. The Boss Room item that spawns when the room is cleared will also be replaced by Plum Flute if Isaac isn't already holding it.

• If Baby Plum takes damage, it does not negate the ability to spare her but rather resets the timer for her to fly away.

• This does not apply in Greed mode, or any rooms she appears in that are not actually her own boss room.

sections.heading: Unlockable achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Fruity Plum, Plum Flute]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The copy of Baby Plum created by Vanishing Twin drops a random boss item if spared.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Baby Plum may be the boss version of a Red Boom Fly.

• This is made more apparent due to the fact that she shares several room layouts with one.

• So far, Baby Plum is the only boss from Repentance to have a Delirium sprite. Delirium can transform into Bumbino and The Pile but doesn't have a Delirium sprite for them.

• There is an unused animation file next to Baby Plum's called "Derpy Plum" that has no associated sprites.

• There is an unused sprite called "plum_hint" that depicts a timer icon next to a Baby Plum with a heart, hinting at the fact that Baby Plum can be spared.

• It is found in the "backdrops" folder, which means it was most likely intended to be a floor or wall decoration.

• Baby Plum is one of only 3 bosses that can be spared, with the others being Bumbino and Hornfel.

• Coincidentally, they all made their debut in Repentance.

• Baby Plum's chasing behavior is reflected by her item equivalent, Fruity Plum, when it is following Isaac.

• According to the patch notes description for patch 1.7.9a, Baby Plum's death animation during normal runs will have a 0.0001% chance to use the explosion animations provided by G FUEL!, even if the item has not been encountered. The chance was 100% in the 1.7.9 patch before it.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Concussive effects don't work on Baby Plum.
