Forget Me Now.title: Forget Me Now
Forget Me Now.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On use, the current floor will be completely re-generated and Forget Me Now will be removed from Isaac's inventory.

• Isaac will restart the level as if he had entered a new floor.

• This will be a brand new floor, with different rooms and mapping generation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The re-generated floor will count as the same floor number as the one Isaac used Forget Me Now in.

• If a Devil Room / Angel Room is not encountered after defeating the boss of the re-generated floor, the multiplier tied to the number of floors since the last Devil/Angel Room affecting the spawn chance will not change.

• • [Repentance] If the first possible Devil Room is encountered, the 100% chance for the next deal to be an angel chance is preserved upon regenerating the floor.

• If a Devil/Angel Room is encountered before regenerating the floor, the multiplier will become x0.25 upon regenerating the floor.

• Any items earned before using the re-generation effect will remain in Isaac's inventory.

• [Before Repentance+] There is an extremely brief time window after using Forget Me Now where Isaac can pick up another active item before the floor regenerates.

• If used on the Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths II after beating Mom, both The Negative and The Polaroid can be obtained in one run. Additionally, two Boss Rushes can be entered as long as the total playtime of the run stays under 20 minutes.

• [Repentance] This also allows opening the door to Mausoleum / Gehenna II in the starting room. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If used on Downpour / Dross II after collecting Knife Piece 1, a second Knife Piece 1 will spawn in the mirrored world's Treasure Room, which can be rerolled into a random item from the Treasure Room (Item Pool). [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If used on Mines / Ashpit II after collecting Knife Piece 1 and Knife Piece 2, a second Knife Piece 2 will spawn in the chase sequence, which if picked up results in a Knife Piece 2 familiar following Isaac if he doesn't have a second Knife Piece 1. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance+] If used on Chest or Dark Room when the door to Mega Satan has been opened, the golden key will not re-open the door and you will be unable to fight him.

• [Repentance+] The door to Mega Satan will now stay open after restarting the floor.

• If used on an XL floor, the merged chapter can be re-generated as two separate floors instead.

• If used on Womb II/Utero II/Scarred Womb II after defeating Mom's Heart, and Mom's Heart is again defeated on the regenerated floor, it will count as having defeated Mom's Heart 2 separate times, therefore unlocking 2 consequent endings.

• Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms will have the same rewards and enemy waves as the Challenge Room in the previous iteration of the floor.

• [Repentance] If left in a Treasure or Boss Room and then returned to during the Ascent, the Forget Me Now item will return to the room it was left each time it is used, allowing the floor to be repeated indefinitely.

• This can be useful in conjunction with The Stairway, as it allows for unlimited Angel Shops to be visited. [end edition note] 

• Upon reentry, items, pickups, and trinkets left in the treasure and boss room after using Forget Me Now will be removed and not converted into cracked keys.

• [Repentance] If used on Home, each room is re-generated and players can obtain an additional item from the chest in Mom's room. [end edition note] 

• If used in Floor 1, the chance of Devil/Angel room is still 0%.

• [Repentance] If a Treasure Room hasn't been visited, the Planetarium chance persists unchanged. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If used on Mausoleum or Gehenna II after the special version of Mom's Heart is defeated, the newly generated floor will be dimly lit as though Mom's Heart was already defeated. Additionally, no items will naturally generate in rooms where they would have. After the player defeats Mom again, there will be no flesh door, and the trapdoor to Corpse will appear. [end edition note] 

• This item is significantly useful for both score and time-related daily runs. For score, it gives you a significant boost of exploration while for time, using it on the final floor locks in the finish time at which it was consumed. Meaning — you don't have to do the final floor and save up a lot of time.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Grants +2 damage up for the entirety of the new floor.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a wisp in the middle ring with infinite health. The wisp only lasts for the floor Forget Me Now created.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Glowing Hourglass + Schoolbag: Using Forget Me Now will fully recharge Glowing Hourglass on the new floor, using Glowing Hourglass after that will take Isaac back to the previous room while also giving back Forget Me Now. This allows for infinite usage of Glowing Hourglass as well as infinite retries of any room as long as Forget Me Now is used before the room is cleared. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Forget me now" is a reference to the show Arrested Development, in which Gob the magician gives people who have figured out how he does a trick a "Forget-me-now", which is a Roofie.

• The phrase "Forget me now" is also a play on words of the flower "Forget me not".

• The 5 pip Dice Room has the same effect as Forget Me Now.

• Plan C has the same sprite as Forget Me Now tinted red.

• In the original Binding of Isaac, this item was present in the Devil Room item pool. It was restored to that pool in Repentance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: The new floor is improperly seeded. This results in a high chance for rooms to repeat from the previous floor. This is most noticeable when looping via the error room. This bug is due to ForgetStageSeed using the same xorshift constants as the level generator.
Bug note: Using Forget Me Now while holding Broken Remote will result in a crash.

fields.description: Restarts the current floor with a new layout. Any items and pickups from the original floor are kept.

Forgotten Lullaby.title: Forgotten Lullaby
Forgotten Lullaby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Doubles the fire rate of Isaac's familiars.

• Familiars with charged shots will have their charge time halved. The recovery time between shots is not affected.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Siren. [end edition note] 

• Does not affect wisps.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either applies a 2.5x multiplier on the fire rate of familiars. Having both triples their fire rate.

• Incubus / Twisted Pair: As the familiars depend on Isaac's fire rate, Incubus and Twisted Pair work normally up to moderately high fire rates around 10. Beyond that, however, Forgotten Lullaby starts to lose effect: at 27.5 fire rate e.g. achievable with Soy Milk there no longer is any improvement and going even higher the trinket becomes detrimental, halving the familiars' damage output at the absolute maximum of 120 fire rate.

• Tainted Lilith: No effect on her special Gello.

• Hushy: No effect on Hushy.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This trinket was originally called Song of the Siren in Antibirth.

• "Forgotten Lullaby" is the title of the Secret Room theme in Mudeth's original soundtrack for the Antibirth mod. Notably, it contains a rearranged snippet of "Sacrificial", the Basement theme from the original Flash game.

fields.description: Improves the fire rate of Isaac's familiars.

Fortune Cookie.title: Fortune Cookie
Fortune Cookie.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.

| + Loot Table | Pickup | Chance 
| Fortune | 69.5%

| Soul Heart | 15%

| Card or Rune | 12%

| Trinket | 3.5%

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Ironically, this item is unaffected by Luck.

• On its own, this item is considerably worse at generating Cards, Runes, and Soul Hearts than Crystal Ball; Fortune Cookie produces 1 per 7.4 charges on average, while Crystal Ball produces 1 per 6 charges guaranteed. However, with 9 Volt, Fortune Cookie produces 1 per 3.7 charges on average, nearly twice as often as Crystal Ball.

• If you include the chance of trinkets generating, then Fortune Cookie will produce 1 per 6.6 charges, or 1 per 3.3 charges with 9 Volt.

• Dice Shard, Emergency Contact, and Cracked Key can be generated by this item.

• Using this item in a room with enemies, spikes, or other hazards can often make it difficult to see what is happening, as nearly half of the player's screen may be covered by a fortune. This can be circumvented by pausing the game and waiting for the fortune to disappear.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a green wisp on the middle ring. Each wisp gives Isaac +0.2 Luck.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Fortune Cookie originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Community Remix, it had a 4 room recharge time and would always give a fortune and drop a card or a soul heart.

• This item is a Fortune Telling Machine counterpart to Portable Slot, which behaves like a Slot Machine.

fields.description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.

Found Soul.title: Found Soul
Found Soul.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Your Soul; Lost Soul]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Summons a Familiar that follows Isaac's exact movements, akin to Jacob and Esau, that flies and shoots spectral tears.

• The ghost uses Isaac's speed, tears, range, shot speed, tear effects, and trinkets, and deals half of Isaac's damage.

• The familiar has collision and can be separated. Holding down the "drop" button keeps the familiar in place.

• The familiar dies after taking any damage, and will respawn on the next floor.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When Isaac places a Bomb, the familiar will drop one as well at no cost.

• The familiar can press Pressure Plates.

• If Found Soul touches a Devil Beggar, Blood Donation Machine, or Confessionals, it will use the machine or beggar once for free before dying.

• Keeping Found Soul alive is crucial for exploration bonus boost in daily runs.

• Although the familiar dies from any damage initially, it is possible for it to obtain health and survive multiple hits with help of effects such as Hollow Heart.

• If Found Soul obtains an empty heart container, it is possible to heal it by collecting a Red Heart. Isaac's heart containers must be full for this to happen.

• [Before Repentance+] If Found Soul is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning Perfection, even if Isaac hasn't been hit.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: Found Soul is capable of copying the effects of most items, including but not limited to:

sections.heading: Active Item Interactions
sections.text: In addition to copying many passive items, Found Soul can utilize the same active item as Isaac, effectively doubling them. Items that are affected by Isaac's damage will scale with Found Soul's damage instead. These include, but are not limited to the following:

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increase the soul's damage to 75% of Isaac's damage. Having both increase its damage to Isaac's damage.

• Azazel / The Forgotten / Tainted Azazel / Tainted Forgotten / Tainted Lilith / Tainted Magdalene / Tainted Samson: The soul uses none of their inherent tear modifiers or special attacks.

• 120 Volt: Electric zaps will scale with Isaac's damage, instead of the soul's.

• Abyss: Using Abyss will have the locusts orbit the soul. If the soul is dropped or dies, all locusts disappear and do not come back when picked back up or when it respawns next floor.

• Anima Sola: Chains two enemies at once. Using the item again will free only one of them.

• Baby-Bender: No homing on the soul.

• Aquarius: The damage from creep is not halved for the soul.

• Bag of Crafting: The soul will swing its own bag alongside Isaac collecting any pickups it hits resulting in pickup disappearance.

• BFFS!: Does not affect the soul.

• Book of the Dead: Bonies will follow the soul. The orbitals will still orbit around Isaac.

• Breath of Life: No effect on the soul.

• Brittle Bones: The soul does not benefit from the tears up.

• Brittle Bones + Hollow Heart: Losing hearts granted to the soul by the trinket will give the soul a tears up for each heart lost.

• Car Battery: Will not double any active used by the soul.

• Dark Arts: The soul will use Dark Arts along with Isaac. Enemies can be marked by both Isaac and the soul. It will gain its own damage boost.

• Dead Sea Scrolls / Metronome: The soul will double only the active effects that it can double.

• Dream Catcher: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.

• Dull Razor: Allows the soul to activate items that would otherwise be useless, such as Old Bandage, Fanny Pack, Varicose Veins etc. It can also be used to dodge damage.

• Empty Heart: The soul will receive an empty heart container every floor; however, the soul cannot collect any Red Hearts, but can receive them via Yum Heart's multiplayer healing or if Isaac collects one while at full red hearts.

• Everything Jar: Regardless of current charges, the soul will always pay out with a poop on every use of the jar.

• Eye of Greed: Coin tears fired still subtract coins.

• Gnawed Leaf: Invincibility is independent of Isaac's movement.

• Guillotine: No head orbital is granted to the soul. Other stats still apply.

• Glowing Hourglass: The soul's health will be reset (so it will die in one hit even if it obtained some health before the rewind.) It will also be revived if it died in the previous room.

• Heartbreak: The ghost gains 2 extra hits per floor and every hit the soul takes will damage all enemies in the room as well. Dropping the trinket and picking it up every time in the room will restore the amount of extra hits, essentially making the Found soul immortal.

• Hollow Heart: The soul receives a bone heart at the start of a floor, but only if alive when entering the floor.

• IBS: The soul itself can never trigger IBS, however when Isaac receives a poop, so does the soul.

• Isaac's Heart: The soul becomes immortal and can not be killed. It will also deal contact damage equal to 4x its damage stat.

• Jar of Wisps: The soul will spawn a single random wisp each time, and the amount spawned do not increment with each use.

• Lemegeton: The soul will get its own Lemegeton wisps orbiting it, but none of them give their respective item effect.

• Lemegeton + Book of Virtues: Wisps spawned by the soul while Isaac has Book of Virtues will be buffed.

• Maggy's Faith: The soul will receive an Eternal Heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to. The Eternal Heart will become a heart container if the soul goes to the next floor with it.

• Magic Fingers: The damage is only applied from the soul's part, meaning this item will always deal less damage while the soul is carried around.

• Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The beam's damage is not halved for the soul.

• Mom's Bracelet: The soul can indeed pick up rocks and throw them, despite lacking sprite work.

• Notched Axe: The soul can swing the axe once, then breaks permanently, unable to be recharged.

• Picking Notched Axe from a pedestal by swapping with another active item or by dropping it with Butter! will refresh the Found Soul single use Notched Axe, allowing for infinite used on the floor.

• Red Key: With proper placement, the soul can open another red room, for free.

• Redemption: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.

• Scissors: The soul will spew its own blood fountain, but no extra head will spawn.

• The Scooper: An extra Peeper familiar is not spawned; however, the soul will benefit from the right eye damage boost.

• Sharp Key: The soul will throw its own key in tandem with Isaac. The throw still costs one key.

• Status Effects: Damage is not halved for the soul.

• Spirit Shackles: The soul will be chained next to the spot it got hit. Proceeding to not get hit again for a short time will revive the soul as normal.

• Sumptorium: The soul produces a blue clot and dies. Can produce other clots if some health was obtained beforehand. The clots will disappear if the soul dies or is dropped; their damage scales with the soul's.

• Super Magnet: The soul will have its own attraction field. No effect on pickups.

• Toxic Shock: No effect.

• Tractor Beam: The soul does not receive a beam, nor are any of its tears affected by Isaac's beam.

• Void / Black Rune: Stat changes from them do not affect the soul.

• Whore of Babylon: Will always be active on the soul.

• Wooden Cross: Both Isaac and the soul will receive a temporary shield; however, when one of them loses it, so does the other.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This trinket is a reference to Lost Soul.

• Found Soul is tied with Soul of Lazarus for the rarest Steam achievement unlocked by a single completion mark.

• Esau Jr. is ahead of these two by 0.1%

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Resuming a Jacob and Esau run with Found Soul equipped in Esau's trinket slot will require a controller to continue. If a controller is available and plugged in, Found Soul can be controlled like a Co-op baby and won't mimic either brother's movements. This effect won't happen if Jacob holds the trinket. If no controller is available, the run is softlocked and cannot be continued.
Bug note: When used together with Azazel's Stump, the soul familiar sometimes keeps Azazel's properties (flight and short brimstone) for a few rooms after Isaac has transformed back to normal. Lil Clot also has this bug.
Bug note: If Sulfur has been used in a room before picking up Found Soul, it will retain Brimstone until dropped/killed, even through rooms.
Bug note: Entering one of the portals created by Card Reading, Lil Portal, and Ventricle Razor causes the familiar to become invisible until Isaac drops and picks up the trinket again. Entering a new floor sometimes also causes this bug.
Bug note: It is possible for both Isaac and the soul to target the same enemy/boss with Suplex! (easier to do on enemies with large hitboxes such as Hush). In this case, the enemy/boss may become invulnerable and/or invisible after the slam. Dropping the trinket or having the soul die does not fix the situation.
Bug note: If Isaac's items are rerolled (via D4 or similar effects) while Found Soul is held, the soul will look like Isaac's detached head or his headless body. Dropping the trinket and picking it up again returns the soul its normal appearance.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that copies Isaac's movements and scales with damage and tears. If it takes damage, it will die and respawn on the next floor.

Fragmented Card.title: Fragmented Card
Fragmented Card.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Torn Card]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Adds an extra Secret Room to all floors generated while holding the trinket.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Only adds a Secret Room, not a Super Secret Room nor an Ultra Secret Room.

• Fragmented Card only needs to be held when entering the floor. The Secret Room will remain after dropping the trinket, even if it hasn't been explored yet.

• Has no effect on floors where Secret Rooms cannot appear naturally, such as all Greed Mode floors, ???, Home and all Ascent floors.

• [Repentance] Cannot appear in Greed Mode.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: One of the secret rooms is revealed on the map. If Isaac has both a golden trinket and the Box, both secret rooms are revealed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Luna: The effects stack, spawning two extra secret rooms on generated floors.

• [Before Repentance+] Golden Trinket / Mom's Box / Fragmented Card: No effect. Only one secret room is added.

• XVIII - The Moon: The Moon will always teleport to an unexplored secret room. If one has already been explored, it will teleport to the other one. If both have been explored, it will teleport randomly in one of the two.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The trinket is a torn card of XVIII - The Moon.

fields.description: Makes two Secret Rooms spawn on each floor.

Fred.title: Fred
Fred.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the enemy; the boss; Mr. Fred] 

Fred is a monster that can be encountered in Chapter 4.

Fred fires an explosive Ipecac shot at Isaac. Fred can also jump out of the ground and towards Isaac and then dive back in, shooting four blood shots in the cardinal directions when it does so. It usually does this after firing an Ipecac shot or if Isaac is far away.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In the original game, the shots that Freds fired when diving back into the ground traveled diagonally instead of in the cardinal directions.

• Freds appear to be babies with the medical condition harlequin ichthyosis.

fields.environment:
Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb / 
boss /
fields.behavior: Hops out of the ground and burrows elsewhere, firing 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions. Occasionally fires red Ipecac shots at Isaac.

Free Lemonade.title: Free Lemonade
Free Lemonade.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a pool of Lemonade similar to the Lemon Party pill effect underneath Isaac.

• The creep deals 8 damage per tick (24 per second) and lasts ~19 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Peep. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns large, yellow wisps on the middle ring. The wisps make small puddles of yellow creep every other shot, which last for 3 seconds and deal 7 damage per tick to enemies that walk over them (56 damage per second).

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Free Lemonade originates from the Antibirth mod.

• The appearance of the item is based off Lemon Mishap from the original Binding of Isaac. When the item was picked up, its appearance would change from a lemon into a glass of lemonade.

• The pickup quote "Party time!" is a reference to the Lemon Party pill as well as the shock website the pill is named after.

fields.description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.

Freezer Baby.title: Freezer Baby
Freezer Baby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Cube Baby]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires icicles once every 0.75 seconds that each do 3.5 damage and have a chance to petrify enemies they hit and freeze enemies they kill.

• Frozen enemies will block enemy shots, and will slide away when walked into by Isaac.

• • After colliding with an obstacle or getting sufficiently shot by Isaac, frozen enemies will explode into a ring of 10 ice tears that can slow and freeze.

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Freezer Baby having [edition alternatives: baseline: 5th; Repentance+: 7th] priority.

• If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by a freezing tear, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Mongo Baby: Will copy Freezer Baby’s tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Freezer Baby originates from the Antibirth mod.

• Freezer Baby's item description is a reference to "Ice Ice Baby", a song by American rapper "Vanilla Ice".

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.

Friend Finder.title: Friend Finder
Friend Finder.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On use, spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to Jacob and Esau.

• Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Currently, there are 21 monsters that can be spawned in:

• Clotty

• Clot

• I.Blob

• Grilled Clotty

• Vis

• Double Vis

• Chubber

• Danny

• Coal Boy

• Gurgle

• Hive

• Nest

• Holy Mulligan

• Drowned Hive

• Bony

• Black Bony

• Holy Bony

• Blaster

• Dople

• Evil Twin

• Maw

• • Blasters cannot attack unless Isaac presses the active item button, in which case they fire at the cursor.

• • Gurgles can turn into Splashers, which can be controlled like normal.

• • Double Vis, Holy Mulligans and Drowned Hives seem to be very rare spawns.

• • Vises do not require charging, but they sometimes fire at Co-Op players automatically.

• • Dople and Evil Twin will not fire opposite of Isaac, unlike what they usually do.

• Certain enemies will have a crosshair to show where they are firing, mainly those with stringed attacks. A Black Bony will only keep the crosshair until it fires all three shots, but a Holy Bony will keep its crosshair for as long as fire keys are held.

• Bullets fired from friendly mobs will still visibly blink as if they're an enemy bullet, and will be highlighted if Bullet Visibility is set to High, despite not harming Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a random wisp.

• Car Battery: Doubles the amount of random friendly monsters spawned.

• Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the fire rate of spawned monsters, if they fire projectiles.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Ace Cards: Monsters spawned by Friend Finder are still affected by Ace Cards.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

• Eraser: If Friend Finder attempts to spawn an erased monster it will simply fail and waste the charge, instead of choosing a different monster.

• Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.

• Saturnus: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.

• The Soul: Projectiles shot from charmed monsters will be repelled by the aura.

• Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or more.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • There is a hidden multiplayer game mode for Co-op that allows a second player to control enemies and bosses in a way similar to Friend Finder, called Possessor.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate friendly enemies.

fields.description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.

Friend Zone.title: Friend Zone
Friend Zone.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a white fly familiar that slowly orbits Isaac and deals 3 damage per tick or 45 damage per second on contact.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This familiar orbits Isaac at a middle-length distance somewhere between Distant Admiration and Forever alone.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A reference to the "friend zone", a phenomenon where one person in a platonic relationship has romantic feelings for the other person and the other one does not, seeing them as "just a friend".

• Friend Zone is very similar in appearance to Best Bud and Lost Fly, making them difficult to distinguish.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Friend Zone is a recolored Obsessed Fan.

fields.description: Spawns a white attack fly that orbits somewhere between Distant Admiration and Forever alone, dealing 45 damage per second.

Friendly Ball.title: Friendly Ball
Friendly Ball.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Once thrown, the Friendly Ball will instantly capture any non-boss enemy it hits, removing them from the room.

• [Repentance] Walking over a Friendly Ball after it captures an enemy will instantly recharge the item.

• The next time the Friendly Ball is thrown, it will release the previously captured enemy as a friendly enemy.

• Released enemies persist between rooms and floors and will follow Isaac until they die.

• Friendly enemies cannot harm Isaac and do not need to be defeated to clear a room.

• If Isaac leaves the room before the monster is released, the monster will stay in the ball until it is thrown again.

• If the Friendly Ball does not capture an enemy, it will simply disappear after a couple seconds being on the ground. The next throw will work the same.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• All enemies that aren't invincible and are not designated as a boss or mini-boss can be captured by the Friendly Ball. This includes enemies summoned from bosses such as Brownie's spawned Dips or The Cage's unique Vises.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] One exception to this is if you capture a Portal, as it can spawn enemies such as Death's Head. [end edition note] 

• It is generally wasteful to use this item on Mulligans and their variants as they will immediately rush towards enemies and try to kill themselves, leaving behind friendly debris.

• If the captured enemy is a Globin variant (besides Black Globins for their lack of regenerative abilities) or a Dark Red Champion, the enemy will regenerate after dying, granting a much longer lifespan.

• Wall Creeps and their variants stick to walls, backing far away from any potential danger they might encounter.

• Stationary enemies that move underground (such as Round Worms or Lumps) work surprisingly well as an ally as they shoot foes from far away and rarely ever get hurt.

• Mom's Hand and Mom's Dead Hand will both one-shot almost all normal enemies and greatly damage most bosses with an incredibly small window for the hands to be hit, making them ideal for capturing.

• Brimstone-capable enemies are very potent as their lasers can cause an obscene amount of damage to both enemies and most bosses.

• If the captured enemy is one that spawns enemies, those enemies will be friendly as well.

• If the ally is immune to damage (such as a Mobile Host while its head is lowered), it will not take contact damage.

• If the captured enemy is a Solid White Champion, it will be completely invincible, as it cannot be killed until the room counts as being cleared, at which point it can be killed by spikes or a Wall Hugger.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] If the captured enemy is a Pulsing Red Champion, it will regenerate the health of other monsters in the room, including friendly ones.

• [Before Afterbirth+] If an enemy that leaves behind a trail of damaging creep is caught, the creep created by the friendly mob will still damage Isaac when he walks over it.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] All creep created by a friendly enemy will only hurt grounded enemies and not the player.

• The ball will only capture one segment of a Grub, one Buttlicker, or one Swarm. However, when releasing a Swarm Fly, a new swarm is generated for it.

• If a Mask + Heart's Heart is caught and then released, a Mask can use the friendly heart to live even if its original heart is destroyed. The room will not be cleared unless the Mask is killed.

• The mask will ignore the friendly heart yet can still damage it. Bait the mask to charge towards the heart to destroy both.

• Friendly enemies that produce explosions do not damage Isaac. This includes enemies that explode on death (such as Boom Fly), as well as enemies that create Ipecac explosions (such as Gurgles).

• On top of that, lit bombs from friendly Mulligoons, Fly Bombs, and even Bombgaggers cannot hurt Isaac.

• The head of Rag Man can be captured by the ball while detached. It will not become a Ragling after being released, and only chases enemies by rolling.

• [Repentance] Captured Bishops will protect Isaac with their shield generation ability, as well as all other friendly enemies. Isaac cannot take any damage while the Bishop is alive, as it will protect him with the shield. Protecting the Bishop can be a powerful defensive tool, especially when playing as The Lost.

• The Bishop will die after protecting Isaac 6 times.

• The shield does not protect against instant death effects such as Suicide King or Plan C. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Captured Cultists will revive killed enemies as friendlies, allowing one to slowly amass an army of friendlies by protecting the Cultist.

• Bosses and degraded bosses can be revived by a friendly Cultist, but will not persist between rooms. [end edition note] 

• Enemies that are spawned by a captured enemy (such as Dips spawned by a Dinga) will persist between rooms as well.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• The Battery: Walking over a captured enemy will double charge the ball. This allows Isaac the ability to release a captured enemy and catch a new one in the same room double charging the ball to release and capture more enemies. Attempting to catch a new enemy while the old one is in the process of spawning will result in the ball phasing through the new enemy and wasting the charge.

• Blood Puppy: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a wisp, all on the middle ring, whenever a friendly enemy dies. Depending on the enemy that dies, the wisp may have a different effect:

• Normal: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they wouldn't spawn any of the other variants listed below.

• Homing: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they were psychic or had homing shots in some way. Wisps' tears are homing.

• Explosive: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they created explosions in some way. Wisps' tears have a 33% chance to explode. Explosive tears deal no extra damage.

• Brimstone: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they fired lasers in some way. Wisps fire Brimstone lasers. The laser does not need to be charged to be fired, and can tick up to 8 times for a total of 20 damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Eraser: If the ball captures an enemy and then another enemy of the same type is erased the next use of Friendly Ball will release a puff of pink smoke wasting the effect.

• [Repentance] Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies. [end edition note] 

• Hive Mind: No effect on captured flies or spiders.

• Skatole or Bursting Sack: Friendly Fly/Spider enemies will be unable to shoot, slowed down, and/or reverted to a weaker form, hindering this item's effectiveness on those enemies.

• Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or higher.

• Void: Walking over a thrown Friendly Ball that captured an enemy will not recharge Void.

• Glowing Hourglass: Will duplicate friendly enemies if used in the same room multiple times.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is a reference to Poké Balls from the Pokémon franchise. Ironically, it doesn't at all resemble the actual Friend Ball in the franchise.

• The Friendly Ball’s design represents Isaac’s eye depicted by the release button and the blue line representing his tears.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Certain monsters will not spawn friendly enemies when defeated:

• Moter

• Swinger

• Dinga

• Black Globin's Body

fields.description: Throwing the ball at a monster instantly kills and captures it. The captured enemy can later be released and will be friendly, fighting for Isaac and persisting between rooms.

Friendship Necklace.title: Friendship Necklace
Friendship Necklace.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Mom's Locket]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Familiars that normally follow Isaac orbit around him instead.

• Does not affect familiars' ability to block shots: if they don't already, they still won't.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket affects the same familiars King Baby affects.

• Familiars unaffected by Friendship Necklace include:

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Each copy increase the speed of orbitals.

• Spin to Win: Familiars made into orbitals by Friendship Necklace can deal contact damage and block enemy shots while Spin to Win is active.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Child Leash: Familiars will orbit much closer to Isaac.

• King Baby: Familiars will orbit King Baby at all times instead of Isaac, even while not firing. King Baby itself is unaffected.

• Lilith + Birthright: Lilith’s Birthright effect overrides Friendship Necklace.

fields.description: Causes familiars to orbit Isaac.

Fruit Cake.title: Fruit Cake
Fruit Cake.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Each tear that Isaac fires gains a random effect. The possible effects are:

The following tear effects when generated by Fruit Cake work differently than that of the base item:

• Eye of Greed: Isaac will not lose coins from this effect occurring.

• Ipecac: There is no associated damage up/poison effect/arcing.

• My Reflection: There is no associated shot speed up.

• Polyphemus: Only the ability to pierce enemies on overkill damage is applied; there is no associated damage bonus with the tear.

• Proptosis : There is no associated damage multiplier, effectively decreasing damage dealt.

• Tiny Planet: There is no associated range up.

[Repentance] The unique tear effects available to some wisps made by Book of Virtues can also be used by Fruit Cake. This can include:

• Drop hearts/coins/cards/runes on kill. The tear must deal the final hit; earlier hits do not flag enemies to drop the consumable on death.

• Teleport enemies to a random location in the room. This cannot affect Bosses.

• Transform enemies into Poop (similarly to E. Coli).

• Transform enemies into random wisps.

Tear effects used in the pool of Fruit Cake do not need their base items unlocked in order to be used. This means that Fruit Cake can occasionally give previews of synergies that are locked.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Dr. Fetus: Bombs pull their effects from bomb modifiers (Bobby-Bomb, Bob's Curse, Bomber Boy, Butt Bombs, Glitter Bombs, Hot Bombs, Mr. Mega, Sad Bombs, Scatter Bombs, Sticky Bombs) as well as tear effects.

• Finger!/Technology 2/Brimstone: Each tick has a random effect, allowing it to rapidly afflict enemies with multiple status effects.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] This also includes the Sulfuric Acid effect to destroy rocks and enter secret rooms. [end edition note] 

• Isaac's Tears/Tammy's Head/Tear Detonator: Each tear will have its own tear effect.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear will cycle through different effects, based on Isaac's tear rate.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] If Isaac stays in one room long enough the Ludovico tear will often fill the room with many stationary Trisagion tears that last until Isaac leaves the room. This combination can easily clear most rooms. [end edition note] 

• Mom's Knife: The benefits of fruit cake still occur but are short lived due to the high damage of Mom's knife.

• Trisagion: Each Trisagion tear only has one effect with each tick having a chance to trigger the same effect.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Fruit Cake has the potential to break rocks and open secret rooms with the effects of Sulfuric Acid, Ipecac, or Terra. However this can be time consuming dependent on Isaac's tear rate and number of tears fired. 

• Avoid shooting walls, obstacles and enemies close to Isaac as a Ipecac tear may explode and damage Isaac. Fire Mind & Explosivo tears can hurt Isaac as well when hitting an enemy. 

• Kidney Stone & Azazel's Rage cause periods of uncontrolled continuous fire that will trigger many effects, potentially damaging Isaac.

• Mom's Eye, Eye Sore, Loki's Horns, Cain's Other Eye: Fire additional tears around Isaac, increasing the risk of self damage. 

• Saturnus, Maw Of The Void, Immaculate Heart, Tiny Planet, My Reflection: Can potentially cause explosions nearby Isaac. 

• Fruit Cake has multiple effects that may spawn coins upon hitting an enemy, this can be beneficial to Keeper & Tainted Keeper to regain health in longer boss fights.

fields.description: Isaac's tears gain a random effect that changes every shot.

Fruity Plum.title: Fruity Plum
Fruity Plum.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a familiar that mimics Baby Plum's attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.

• Fruity Plum will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.

• If there are no enemies, Fruity Plum loosely orbits Isaac.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Since the achievement to unlock explicitly states you must merely defeat Baby Plum, regardless of the method used, sparing Baby Plum and letting her leave counts towards the unlocking of this item.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: The homing effect is applied as normal which drastically improves its damage output.

• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles its contact damage and tear damage. The effect does not stack.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Child Leash: No effect.

• Forgotten Lullaby: Does not increase its fire rate.

• Friendship Necklace: No effect.

• RC Remote: No effect.

fields.description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.

Fun Guy.title: Fun Guy
Fun Guy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fun Guy is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, turning Isaac into a walking mushroom after picking up 3 mushroom-related items.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Grants one full Red Heart container.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list ( [Repentance] with the [code: mushroom] tag).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The name Fun Guy is a slang term for psychedelic Psilocybin mushrooms and a wordplay on "fungi".

• Fun Guy's appearance may be a reference to the character Toad, a humanoid mushroom from the Super Mario franchise.

• When obtaining this transformation with Keeper or Tainted Keeper, it will look different than with any other characters, as the mushroom in it's head will slightly bend at the bottom and it's face will look more scarecrow-ish, making their eyes and mouth get smaller and lower on their face.

fields.description: +1 Red Heart Container.
fields.items: 1up!, Blue Cap, God's Flesh, Magic Mushroom, Mega Mush, Mini Mush, Mucormycosis, Odd Mushroom (Large), Odd Mushroom (Thin), Wavy Cap

GB Bug.title: GB Bug
GB Bug.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, deals 8 damage per tick or 120 damage per second and applies a random status effect to enemies it comes in contact with. The familiar also has a chance to re-roll pickups that it passes over into other pickups, Chests, or items, in an uncleared room only (with at least one enemy alive).

• [Repentance] Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster, trinket, or pickup it hits. It respawns after clearing a room.

• If it cannot reroll an enemy (e.g. a boss), it will deal 8 damage instead.

• Items and opened chests cannot be rerolled.

• Pickups have a 10% chance of becoming chests (see the algorithm).

• • If a chest is rerolled, it has a 28% chance of staying as some kind of a chest.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] GB Bug can block projectiles.

• [Before Repentance] GB Bug does more damage per second than The Peeper, with the added random status chance.

• [Repentance] GB Bug is able to reroll Throwable Bombs into normal consumables. After doing so, the corresponding Bomb Grimace will generate another Throwable Bomb, making it able to generate a potentially large amount of free consumables.

• [Repentance] Rerolled champion enemies will retain their color, unless they reroll into a monster that cannot naturally spawn as a champion.

• [Repentance] Caution is advised as GB Bug can also reroll certain entities such as the hot rock left by a dead Coal Spider adding another enemy to the room. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with GB Bug having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

• [Repentance] While playing Tainted Isaac, GB bug can be dropped and picked back up to respawn it, allowing for infinite rerolls.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blood Puppy: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.

• Guppy's Eye in Chest / Dark Room: Using the 28% chance to stay as a chest, allows you to reroll chests with undesired items into different items.

• King Baby: GB Bug will only throw itself at nearby enemies automatically if a fire button is double tapped while King Baby's effect is active.

• Marked: Does not launch itself automatically or at the crosshair while Isaac is firing.

• The Twins: The familiar can be duplicated even if it hasn’t respawned; by constantly moving to new rooms, GB Bug can constantly respawn, allowing pickups to be rerolled indefinitely.

sections.heading: Algorithm
sections.text:
• A reverse-engineered algorithm used by GB Bug to determine its rerolls is available: local chestPickupVariants = {
PickupVariant.PICKUP_CHEST, -- 50
PickupVariant.PICKUP_BOMBCHEST -- 51
PickupVariant.PICKUP_SPIKEDCHEST -- 52
PickupVariant.PICKUP_ETERNALCHEST -- 53
PickupVariant.PICKUP_MIMICCHEST, -- 54
PickupVariant.PICKUP_OLDCHEST, -- 55
PickupVariant.PICKUP_WOODENCHEST, -- 56
PickupVariant.PICKUP_MEGACHEST, -- 57
PickupVariant.PICKUP_HAUNTEDCHEST, -- 58
PickupVariant.PICKUP_LOCKEDCHEST, -- 60
PickupVariant.PICKUP_REDCHEST, -- 360
PickupVariant.PICKUP_MOMSCHEST, -- 390
}
if (
(contains(chestPickupVariants, pickupVariant) and (pickupSeed:Next() % 5) == 0)
or (pickupSeed:Next() % 10) == 0
) then
local chestVariant
if (pickupSeed:Next() & 3) == 0 then
chestVariant = PickupVariant.PICKUP_LOCKEDCHEST
else
chestVariant = PickupVariant.PICKUP_CHEST
end
pickup:Morph(pickup.Type, chestVariant, 0, true, false, false)
else
pickup:Morph(pickup.Type, 0, 1, true, false, false)
end

• An explanation of the code: rerolling something has a 10% chance of becoming a chest and 90% chance of becoming a random pickup.

• A chest of any kind has an independent 20% extra chance of staying a chest, for a total 28% chance.

• If something is rerolled into a chest, it is a random chest according to standard spawning rules 75% of the time, and a locked chest 25% of the time.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The pre-Repentance quote is a reference to a quote by Phil Fish in Indie Game: The Movie, where he says the same words when a bug is discovered in the game "FEZ" on the first day it is being shown at PAX.

• This item's in-game appearance may be a reference to "Missingno.", a famous bug occurring in the first Pokémon games.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Game breaking bug, right away!; Repentance: Double tap glitch]
fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, applying a random status effect to enemies it hits and has a chance to re-roll pickups it passes over.
[Repentance] Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.

G FUEL!.title: G FUEL!
G FUEL!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: G FUEL! is a promotional item appearing only during special daily runs or with an easter egg seed (GFVE LLLL) activated. It does not exist during normal gameplay.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• A can of G FUEL! is available at the start of every floor. Floors affected by [cu: Labyrinth] will give two cans.

• Some of G FUEL!'s effects depend on how many copies of the item Isaac has:

• Replaces Isaac's tears with various "guns".

• • The first can simply increases damage, tears, and shot speed without replacing tears.

• • The second can replaces Isaac's tears with bullets.

• • The third can changes the firing pattern into two accurate, rapid-fire streams of bullets. Changes Isaac's stats similarly to Soy Milk.

• • The fourth can changes the attack into a buckshot shotgun, shooting a large spread of pellets which bounce on impact with obstacles.

• • The fifth can changes the attack into a slug shotgun, shooting a single high damage projectile that bounces on impact with obstacles.

• • The sixth can changes the attack into a minigun, rapidly shooting bullets with low accuracy. This also pushes Isaac back depending on the firing speed.

• • The seventh can changes the attack into a rocket launcher, shooting explosive rockets that detonate on impact.

• • The eighth can onwards gives Isaac a random weapon from the ones listed above.

• • The ninth can onwards adds random tear effects to bullets.

• Starting with the second copy, speeds up the game every time it's picked up.

• Starting with the fourth copy, non-boss enemies have a chance to multiply, with further copies increasing the number of enemies.

• Each copy increases the amount of screen shake caused by gunfire and enemy explosions.

• Grants +0.2 Speed. Ignores the speed cap. Collecting other speed up items will also break the cap.

• Unlike other items that change speed, G FUEL causes one of Jacob and Esau characters to move faster than the other.

• All explosion sprites are replaced with stock explosion footage. Certain bosses have special explosion animations.

• All enemies explode on death. These explosions do not deal damage and do not destroy objects.

• All consumable spawn animations will be accompanied by explosion sprites as well.

• Enemies grant far more score on death than usual, and the amount is displayed when they die.

• All water and blood in rooms is replaced with a light blue liquid (presumably G Fuel).

• Pressing the "drop" button plays an airhorn sound effect.

• Most "special floor tiles" are replaced with special G Fuel floor tiles.

• Replaces Isaac's nightmares during floor transition with G Fuel-themed versions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• G FUEL! is not a "real" item for nearly every purpose without activating the easter egg, and has no collection page entry. It is not accessible even via Debug Console unless Isaac is in the special seed, in which case the command would be spawn 5.100.-1

• G FUEL!'s tear effects cannot be copied by familiars such as Cain's Other Eye or Found Soul.

• Item pedestals containing G FUEL! are unaffected by any attempt to reroll, duplicate, or remove them, including but not limited to The D6, Eternal D6, and Crooked Penny.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is the first to count as actual product integration, promoting a Binding of Isaac themed energy drink by G Fuel. Other items in the game that resemble real-world products are allusions, jokes and the like.

• However, according to a tweet by Edmund, the item and associated daily run are NOT sponsored, and were simply added in as a joke.

• Edmund previously had a collab with G Fuel with his other game, Super Meat Boy.

• The various "guns" granted by G FUEL! work almost identically to certain weapons in Nuclear Throne, most notably with how the shotgun pellets and slugs bounce off of obstacles.

• The airhorn sound effect that plays when pressing the "drop" button may be a reference to a similar easter egg in Nuclear Throne, where pressing the B key as the character Y.V. triggers an airhorn sound effect.

• Internally, the item is generated on demand by enabling the effect, and inserted into the first glitch item slot which has the ID -1.

• If Isaac has TMTRAINER, the G FUEL! in the starting room will not be glitched further.

• Spawning item -1 will not create G FUEL! if it's not enabled.

• Item -2 also gets assigned and will always be the same glitch item across separate runs.

• When collected, the item is listed as a "temporary" Speed Ball in the Debug Console and can be removed as such.

• Normal Speed Ball is still available while G FUEL! is enabled.

• It is "temporary" in the same sense as Lemegeton item wisps, but has no associated wisp that could be destroyed.

• The effect that the tears gain from the 2nd copy onward replaces the graphic for nail tears spawned by 8 Inch Nails.

• The real-world-product G FUEL tubs feature cameos of modded characters among the horde of enemies:

• Isaac's Tears features Fiend from the Fiend Folio mod.

• Brimstone features Gomorrah from the Sodom And Gomorrah mod.

• MEAT!, YO LISTEN!, PHD, G FUEL! and TMTRAINER are the only ALL CAPS items in the game.

fields.description: Grants various effects based on the amount of G FUEL! obtained. Only appears on certain Daily Challenges or with an easter egg seed.

Gasbag.title: Gasbag
Gasbag.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gasbags are a unique enemy type found only in Corpse. While they are alive, they emit a ring of toxic gas that deals damage to Isaac if he stands in it for too long. Additionally, Gasbags will occasionally spawn a chain of 4 Army Fly to chase Isaac. Gasbags will only spawn flies if there are less than 8 army flies in the room, no matter how many Gasbags there are. The Gasbag's toxic cloud disappears a short time after it dies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Gasbag first appeared in the Antibirth mod where it acted identical but could not spawn flies.

fields.name: Gasbag
fields.environment: Corpse /
fields.behavior: Occasionally summons Army Fly to chase Isaac. Is surrounded by a ring of toxic gas that hurts Isaac if he stands in it for too long.

Gello.title: Gello
Gello.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a demon familiar attached to Isaac by a cord for the current room, floating in the direction Isaac shoots. It automatically fires tears (whenever Isaac is shooting) in the direction of the closest enemy to it, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.

• The item is initially held over Isaac's head until he fires, which launches the familiar in the direction he shoots, dealing 3x Isaac's damage to all enemies it passes through.

• If Isaac has any tear modifier that requires him to charge his shots (i.e. Brimstone), Gello will automatically release its shot every time it is fully charged.

• Gello's tears deal 0.75x Isaac's damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Tainted Lilith attacks in a way nearly identical to this item, except she can recall it and launch it again.

• If used multiple times in the same room, the Gellos will eventually overlap perfectly and appear as one after some movement, but all remain functional. This makes Gello exceptionally powerful in Greed Mode, Boss Rush, and against The Beast.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a red wisp on the middle ring. The wisps will orbit Gello instead of Isaac while it's active.

• Tainted Azazel: Each time Gello starts charging an attack, he will "sneeze" just like Tainted Azazel does, cursing enemies in front of him. This allows Tainted Azazel to keep enemies cursed without needing to come up to a dangerously close distance to them.

• Tainted Lazarus: The familiar persists when switching states.

• Uranus: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide if Isaac is moving, similarly to when kicked by Isaac.

• Lilith / Tainted Lilith: Gello's tears deal 1.0x of Isaac's damage instead.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone / Dr. Fetus / Godhead / The Inner Eye / Ipecac / Mutant Spider / Polyphemus / Proptosis / Tech X: Gello receives a unique appearance, similar to Isaac.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• [Repentance+] Spawns an additional familiar.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Gello is a revenant in Greek mythology who causes infertility, miscarriages, and infant mortality.

• It is implied to be a fetal Incubus.

• Gello is named "umbilical_baby" in the files.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Using ? Card on Gello will still result in the charges being used once Gello is whipped out. The ? Card will be used up as well, despite providing no free use of the item.

fields.description: Spawns a demon familiar for the current room attached to Isaac that moves and fires in the direction Isaac shoots, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.

Gemini.title: Gemini
Gemini.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the boss; the item; Gemini (Item)] 

Gemini is a boss that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] Only in the Basement.

• [Repentance] In the Basement and the Burning Basement. [end edition note] 

Each twin has 140 HP. The large twin is called Contusion and the small twin is called Suture.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Gemini starts as a pair of bosses connected together by an umbilical cord.

• Contusion chases Isaac and periodically charges increasing his speed, but stops to catch his breath afterwards.

• Suture, while attached to Contusion, shoots a projectile towards Isaac if not behind an obstacle.

• If Contusion is killed first, Suture detaches and begins charging furiously at Isaac. He has high momentum and takes extra knock-back from tears, which can cause him to gain speed.

• If Suture is killed first, there is no change to Contusion's behavior.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 7] : Suture shoots homing shots. Contusion will drop a Soul Heart if killed last.

• [Repentance] A soul heart will be dropped, regardless which part dies last.
[bc: 5] : They start separated from each other and have no difference in behavior. However, if Contusion is killed last, it will usually drop a Red Heart or Half Red Heart, but will rarely drop any other type of Heart instead (Soul Heart, Bone Heart, Gold Heart, etc).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Status effects will equally affect both Contusion and Suture even if it was only applied to one of them. This includes effects granting knockback such as Knockout Drops.

• This also applies to Green Champion Gemini, despite the twins being completely separated entities.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Gemini appeared in the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Gemini seems to be an example of a parasitic twin, with Suture being the underdeveloped twin, dependent on Contusion.

• Blighted Ovum is the posthumous version of them, and Steven is the alternate version.

• The Gemini pair is named after the astrological sign of the same name; the symbol of Gemini is a pair of twins.

• The Gemini pair was originally designed to be a boss in Gish and was called Suture Contusion, with the larger twin being Contusion for the boot-shaped dent in his head.

• Contusion is the medical name for a bruise, whereas suture is the medical name for a thread used to close gaping wounds, commonly called stitches.

• The names of the brothers are inspired by a song by The Mars Volta

• The specific lyric comes from "Cicatriz ESP".

• In the Bestiary, Suture is referred to as "Gemini Baby".

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Gemini's cord dots are considered monsters, and each one will turn into a new monster if the D10 is used in the room.
Bug note: To unlock Cellar, Isaac must kill all Basement bosses once. Gemini, however, counts as two depending on which part is killed first.
Bug note: If you Stun Suture at the same time that it tries to shoot Isaac, it will cause the sound effect to loop infinitely until Suture is killed.
Bug note: If Gemini's chain hits Red Poop or Spikes, the chain will disappear but Contusion and Suture will still be joined.

Undefined.title: Undefined
Undefined.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Teleports Isaac to the Treasure Room, the Secret Room, the Super Secret Room or I AM ERROR. There is also a 1% chance of teleporting into a Black Market.

• The chances for each main destination are equal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The choice is made between individual rooms, not by room type, so having multiples of a given room makes the total chance of landing in one of them higher.

• Treasure Rooms under [cu: Labyrinth] .

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Secret Rooms with Fragmented Card.

• [Repentance] Secret and Super Secret Rooms with Luna.

• [Repentance] Red Rooms of valid types created by Red Key.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
• The I AM ERROR room in Cathedral and Sheol will have a beam of light/trap door leading to the next floor, even if Isaac doesn't have The Polaroid or The Negative.

• [Rebirth only] Chest and Dark Room are reset on exiting the I AM ERROR room, which can be done repeatedly as long as the player can gather enough charges to successfully warp to it. This can provide a ridiculous number of items from the golden chests in Chest.

• This makes it possible to kill ??? or The Lamb multiple times. If Isaac has an item that resurrects him as a different character, multiple achievements and items can be unlocked in a single run.

• The Void is also reset and can be cleared repeatedly.

• [Repentance] As no Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms spawn on any floor during the Ascent, this item will only warp Isaac to either the Treasure Room or the I AM ERROR room. This can be a reliable method of gaining many items on the way up to Home, while also allowing the player to skip potentially difficult encounters. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Has no effect when used in Home. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Using Undefined on ??? always sends the player to the I AM ERROR room. The Error room will always contain a trap door, not a lightbeam, so it will always send the player to Sheol.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Creates blue glitched wisps on the middle ring. Wisps fire tears with Playdough Cookie effects.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is a reference to a bug in the original The Binding of Isaac, where exhausting an Item Pool (or rarely simply by chance) would cause an item to spawn whose name and description was listed as "Undefined", and whose sprite would rapidly cycle through the sprites of every other item in the game. Undefined by itself creates no effect, but if it was ever picked up, should the game attempt to spawn an item from an exhausted item pool, the game instead crashed, as it could no longer spawn Undefined. From Rebirth onwards, an exhausted item pool will instead spawn Breakfast, even if the item would normally never spawn from that item pool and/or Breakfast had already been obtained in the run.

• In programming "Undefined" refers to an unknown value.

• Given the Glitch theme of the item and the ability to access Chapters that have not yet been unlocked using I AM ERROR, along with the ability to acquire mass upgrades in The Chest and The Dark Room, it is possible that it was intentionally made into a powerful sequence-breaking item.

• The sprite for Undefined appears to be, fittingly, a glitched and spliced version of other item sprites, with the bottom right part noticeably being the The Compass, the bottom left being the Blood Bag, and the top half being Contract From Below.

fields.name: Undefined
fields.description: Teleports Isaac to the Secret Room, Super Secret Room, Treasure Room, or I AM ERROR.

Unicorn Stump.title: Unicorn Stump
Unicorn Stump.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The invulnerability effect negates all forms of damage, including health loss from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.

• The item is similar to My Little Unicorn, with faster recharge time at the cost of being unable to damage enemies while under its effects.

• [Before Repentance] If another active item is picked up while in the invulnerability state granted by Unicorn Stump, Isaac will return to normal immediately, becoming able to shoot tears and take damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: With some damage source while this item is active, it can be permanently invulnerable inside the room while you have enemies.

• ???'s Only Friend: The fly can still be controlled while invincible.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns an orbital rainbow wisp on the middle ring. Wisps do not deal contact damage and will not take contact damage. When Isaac is invulnerable, wisps become much more vibrant and deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage -5. If Isaac has less than 2.5 damage, the wisps will deal no damage even if Unicorn Stump is active.

• Car Battery: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.

• Mom's Knife: Does contact damage in the same direction it was being held at the time of using the Unicorn Stump, giving a massive amount of free damage by ramming into an enemy.

• Works the same with the Yes Mother? transformation's knife.

• On contact items (Aries, The Virus, etc.): Freely usable in basically every room.

• Orbital Familiars (Cube of Meat, Sacrificial Dagger, etc.): The orbital can be used freely in every single room, making it a great alternative source of damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• The Ludovico Technique: The tear stays in place while Isaac is invincible; although Isaac cannot move the tear, it will continue to damage enemies during his invincibility. This is very useful for stationary enemies.

• Marked: Isaac's tears will still fire, but he will be unable to move the crosshair while invincible.

fields.description: Gives invulnerability and increased speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears.

Universal (Bosses).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Universal
sections.text:
Universal Bosses are those which may appear at the end of floors 1-5 and 7, replacing a boss from the pool for that environment.

• [Repentance] Universal Bosses cannot appear on any of the alternative Chapters added in Repentance.
