Unlocking Super Meat Boy & Super Bandage.title: Unlocking Super Meat Boy & Super Bandage Girl
Unlocking Super Meat Boy & Super Bandage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Note: Any strategy referring to Cube of Meat also works for Ball of Bandages, and the other way around, unless otherwise specified.

sections.heading: With Repentance
sections.text:
Repentance introduced Battery Bums. Using them with one Cube of Meat allows one to easily get the required 3 activations of Lilith's Box of Friends to obtain the achievement.

Repentance also introduced The Twins trinket which allows you to temporarily gain one extra level. This can be used to get the achievement with only a level 3 Super Meat Boy or Super Bandage Girl.

sections.heading: With Afterbirth †
sections.text:
Afterbirth † introduced the Potato Peeler item. Each time this item is used, a Cube of Meat is created (at the cost of one red heart container), meaning that if this item is used 4 times you can get the achievement. This does not apply to the Ball of Bandages.

This is important as if you play Greed Mode as Magdalene, you can easily restart the run until Potato Peeler appears in the shop. Once this occurs, use the item until you have no more heart containers. Since Magdalene starts with four heart containers, you have just enough health to use the Potato Peeler enough to get four Cubes of Meat. Even though you die after using the item four times, the achievement is still granted. 

[Repentance+] If you find Potato Peeler but are looking to obtain a complete Super Bandage Girl, you can find a Ball of Bandages first before using Potato Peeler, as using it with a Ball of Bandages contributes to that instead of Cube of Meat.

[Repentance] Potato Peeler does not work with Box of Friends, limiting Lilith's strategy to sacrificing heart containers, or picking up other Cubes of Meat from Item Pedestals.

sections.heading: With Afterbirth
sections.text: The achievement for creating a Super Meat Boy is much easier with Afterbirth, thanks to the Box of Friends, which Lilith conveniently starts with.

sections.heading: General Strategy
sections.text:
Start as Lilith and do not discard the Box of Friends. Play until you find a Cube of Meat orBall of Bandages.

Then, find a way to use the Box 3 times without leaving the room. There are multiple ways to accomplish this:

• Find a room with two Batteries or use a 48 hour energy pill.

• Find Jera. Then, find a Battery and use the rune to create a second battery. With a fully charged Box of Friends, a single use of the Rune is all you need.

• Do the Boss Rush. Each wave will give 2 charges, easily nabbing you the achievement.

• Use the Habit and/or the Sharp Plug to fully charge the box two more times with enough health.

• Get The Battery and double-charge the box. Then find a way to charge the box one more time (a battery, Habit, Sharp Plug, etc.).

• Get the Car Battery then either find a Battery, charge the Box with the Habit or Sharp Plug, or get a double-charge with The Battery.

• Get Restock then buy 2 Batteries from the Shop.

• Find a shop with a Shop Restock Machine, then donate to the box/ bomb the box to re-roll all items while picking up and using all batteries.

Greed Mode is another easy way to accomplish this, since every wave generates a charge, and a Cube of Meat can be found for sale in the rerollable shops. A Ball of Bandages can spawn in the boss item room in Greedier Mode.

Diplopia is very useful, as it will allow you to pick two Cube of Meat or Ball of Bandages instead of one when finding it, also preventing Conquest or Headless Horseman from ruining your chances of getting a Super Meat Boy/Super Bandage Girl with Book of Revelations.

.

sections.heading: Without Afterbirth
sections.text: Without Afterbirth, the achievement for creating a Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl is significantly more difficult to obtain without performing a specific strategy.

sections.heading: The Book of Revelations Strategy
sections.text:
The most straightforward method to unlock the Meat Boy is restarting the game until obtaining the Book of Revelations on the first level, which can be found in either a Treasure Room or Library. Using it on the current level will increase the chance of one Horseman to appear, based on the current chapter:

• Famine in first or second level of chapter 1.

• Pestilence in first or second level of chapter 2.

• War in first level of chapter 3. (Second level boss is always Mom).

• Death in first level of chapter 4. (Second level boss is always Mom's Heart or It Lives! if unlocked).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The harbingers mentioned above can be replaced by Headless Horseman on any chapter. Although Conquest may appear on Womb I / Utero I , they'll only do so if you unlock them by taking a total of 10 Angel Deals in a save file, so refraining from doing so is advised (until you get a SMB/SBG). These bosses are guaranteed to drop A Pony and the White Pony respectively. If you encounter either of these bosses, it means you will not obtain a Cube of Meat (or Ball of Bandages) for whatever chapter you are on, and you will likely not be able to obtain the achievement in your run.

• Harbingers cannot spawn in a Double Trouble boss room. If the current floor's boss room is a large room, the Book of Revelations cannot increase the chance of a Harbinger to spawn there. This also applies to the Mr. Fred fight in Womb I / Utero I.

• It is recommended to start this run either as Isaac, to reroll the Library in case the Book of Revelations isn't found, or as Cain, because he starts with a key so you can hold R and keep restarting the run until you see a locked door adjacent to your spawn and it is a Library, however, a key will likely be found on the first floor, so playing as Isaac is recommended.

sections.heading: The Blank Card Strategy
sections.text:
This method no longer works in Repentance.

This method involves using the Blank Card item and Jera to create lots of batteries.

• Start as Azazel for ease of fighting to later floors and collecting enough money to buy Blank Card, or Isaac with The D6 unlocked.

• Get the Blank Card and Jera.

• Optionally also get the Starter Deck and Perthro.

• Find a battery pickup on the ground.

• Copy the battery using Blank Card until there are three, at which point Blank Card can produce any number of batteries. You can theoretically do this with 2 batteries, if you use Blank Card while picking up the battery, as it has a chance to be doubled.

• Find a golden chest with an item inside it, since any copy of a chest containing an item will also contain an item; however you can not open it since it can't be copied by Jera after opened.

• Get the Monster Manual using the D20 and/or the The D6, or simply by using Blank Card to copy golden chests again and again.

• Optionally, you could get the Monster Manual using Perthro.

• Use the Monster Manual over and over with the batteries created by the Blank Card. This will eventually create 4 Cubes of Meat/Balls of Bandages.

sections.heading: The Sharp Plug / Pyromaniac Strategy
sections.text:
This method can take up to an hour of in-game time, but compared to the Book of Revelations method, should take significantly fewer runs and thus save a lot of time overall. This method can unlock both Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl in the same run.

• Start as Isaac with The D6 unlocked.

• Get Pyromaniac.

• Hold R to reset the floor until a Treasure Room is adjacent to the starting room. (Or, if it isn't, pick a door and enter the next room. Continue until you see enemies or find the Treasure Room. If you find enemies, reset.)

• If the item inside the Treasure Room is not Pyromaniac, re-roll it. If it still isn't Pyromaniac, reset.

• Get Sharp Plug or Habit from a shop.

• Make sure that you save enough keys so that you can get into every shop.

• Use all re-rolls on the shop.

• If you get Sharp Plug, do not get 9 Volt since it’ll render Sharp Plug useless.

• Get any bomb producing item/synergy. This includes Dr. Fetus, Epic Fetus, Kamikaze!, Anarchist Cookbook, IV Bag + Curse of the Tower/BOGO Bombs + Burnt Penny, etc.

• Use all re-rolls on the treasure room if you haven't found Pyromaniac.

• If you have Habit, make sure to leave at least one source of damage on the floor so that you can damage yourself. (ex: a fire, spikes, or a Stone Grimace.

• If you find a room with green Ipecac-shooting enemies, you can use it to obtain any number of re-rolls. Enter the room, allow the explosions to heal you and charge The D6 to full, then allow the explosions to open the exit.

• After this step is complete you will have infinite re-rolls.

• Get a Sharp Plug from a shop if you got Habit in step 2. (The plug is much faster at recharging the manual in the next step.)

• Get a Monster Manual from a treasure room or library.

• If you can spare an item pedestal, and you have the Sharp Plug, it is highly recommended to obtain The Wafer, which will allow you to charge The D6 once per 1/2 heart instead of once per 2 hearts, effectively quadrupling your efficiency.

• Another way to speed up the progress is to add more item pedestals. If you find a XX - Judgement, save it until you're ready to reroll for the Monster Manual, and then use it in the treasure room. If you can make it pay out with an item, you'll be able to reroll two items per charge.

• Use the manual over and over until you get a Super Meat Boy and/or Super Bandage Girl.

Note that if you find a Monster Manual before finishing the combo, you will have to finish the combo on that floor or reset the game. This is because finding the manual will take it out of the item pool for the remainder of the run. If you find it, you should try to find another activated item in a different room so you can put the Manual down in a safe place and continue rolling with that activated item inside the treasure room.

sections.heading: Sharp Plug / Wafer Strategy
sections.text:
• Start as Isaac with The D6 unlocked.

• Get The Wafer.

• Hold R to reset the floor until a Treasure Room is adjacent to the starting room.

• If the item inside the Treasure Room is not The Wafer, re-roll it. If it still isn't The Wafer, reset.

• Cancer also works as it provides The Wafer's effects after the first instance of damage during a room.

• Get a Sharp Plug from a shop.

• Make sure that you save enough keys so that you can get into every shop.

• Use all re-rolls on the shop.

• Other useful items here are Scapular, Habit.

• Do not get 9 Volt or Isaac's Heart, as they will ruin the sharp plug's ability.

• Complete the game with The Polaroid to go to the chest.

• In the chest, obtain everything else you need.

• Clear the chest and look for another pedestal on which you can place your health pickup.

• Roll the first room to get a health pickup like Yum Heart, Book of Revelations, or Satanic Bible

• Re-roll the pedestal(s) away from your health pickup for the Monster Manual

• Use the manual over and over until you get a Super Meat Boy and/or Super Bandage Girl.

sections.heading: D20 strategy
sections.text:
• Get the D20.

• Hold R to reset the floor until a Treasure Room is adjacent to the starting room.

• Continue playing until you find a 48 Hour Energy or Sharp Plug.

• Obtain the Blank Card.

• Leave 48 Hour Energy outside of the shop.

• Bomb the donation machine 10+ times to get 35+ coins on the ground.

• Reroll coins with the D20.

• Open any chests.

• Take any 48 Hour Energy pills, Jera, and Perthro outside the shop.

• Continue until you have a Blank Card.

• Obtain the Monster Manual

• Use the Blank Card, Jera runes, Energy pills, and/or Sharp Plug with heart pickups to fill a Treasure Room or Library with items

• Use the Blank Card with the Perthro rune and other stuff to get the Monster Manual

• Use the manual over and over until you get a Super Meat Boy and/or Super Bandage Girl.

sections.heading: Maggy's Bow strategy
sections.text:
• Get Maggy's Bow.

• Hold R to reset the floor until a Treasure Room is adjacent to the starting room.

• Visit the shops for The Jar and the Sharp Plug.

• Do not get 9 Volt or Isaac's Heart, as they will ruin the sharp plug's effect.

• Bomb donation machines if you need money, or if you have The Jar, use a Blood Donation Machine or go to a Sacrifice Room

• Play until you find the Monster Manual.

• Use The Jar to fill the room with hearts

• Swap to the Monster Manual and with the Sharp Plug, keep using until you get a Super Meat Boy and/or Super Bandage Girl.

• Use the hearts around to regain the lost health from Sharp Plug.

Uranus.title: Uranus
Uranus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears become icicles that freeze enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.

• Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be frozen.

• Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, obstacle or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.

• These icicles can either slow enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.

• Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.

• [Repentance+] Isaac's tears have a chance to petrify enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Isaac's own tears cannot apply a slowing effect on enemies. This property is only available for the icicle burst after shattering a frozen enemy.

• The on-shatter icicles deal damage equal to 8 + (floor - 1) which is not affected by Isaac's stats.

• These tears do not inherit any of Isaac's tear effects.

• The blue creep left behind ice statues while they're sliding across the room rapidly deals 2 flat damage for 11 ticks per second, resulting in 22 damage per second.

• Ice statues have 10 health points and can be shattered if shot by 10 tears or projectiles.

• Isaac's damage is irrelevant here and each tear shot will deal only 1 point of damage to them.

• Enemies ignore the ice statues when targeting Isaac and they can also destroy them if shot enough times.

• Explosions will shatter the statues immediately.

• Enemies hit by a sliding ice statue receive 35 flat damage which is not affected by Isaac's stats or the current floor.

• Enemies killed by hit of a sliding ice statue or the blue creep will not be frozen.

• Frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, meaning they don't need to be shattered in order for the room to be cleared. If not shattered, they don't disappear until leaving the room.

• Killing enemies by freezing them does not however count as a "kill" for the purposes of activating the on kill effects of certain items and trinkets. Because of this, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will count towards the on kill effects, rendering them quite difficult to use. [edition rnr+] These items and trinkets are: Bat Wing, Berserk!, Charm of the Vampire, Contagion, Eve's Bird Foot, Jumper Cables, Lusty Blood, Red Stew, Samson's Lock, Sigil of Baphomet, Toxic Shock and Vasculitis.

• [Repentance+] Aforementioned items and trinkets now properly trigger upon enemy being frozen.

• Hungry Soul, Infestation 2, Quints, Urn of Souls, Vade Retro still activate their effects, immediately upon enemy being frozen.

• Athame and Jar of Flies will only activate upon enemy's ice statue being shattered.

• Enemies, that were gold-petrified (e.g. by Midas' Touch), don't drop coins upon becoming ice statues.

• Champion enemies that drop consumables won't drop anything until their ice statue is shattered.

• As Tainted Keeper, enemies will drop a coin immediately when frozen.

• As Tainted Magdalene, enemies killed by hug, will drop a Half Red Heart immediately when frozen.

• Using this item in daily-runs is ill-advised as freezing enemies removes a large chunk of exploration bonus.

• If a non-boss enemy dies within 10 ticks (0.33 seconds) after being hit by a freezing tear, it will be frozen regardless of what killed it.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Athame / Maw Of The Void / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The beam will freeze enemies upon death.

• Bob's Rotten Head: Enemies are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.

• Brimstone / Jacob's Ladder / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X: The normally firing laser gets an icy white color and freezes enemies upon death.

• [edition rnr+] Death's List: The list order isn't broken when killing enemies by freezing them off-order.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs will freeze enemies upon death.

• Gello/Tainted Lilith: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide similarly to when kicked by Isaac.

• Suplex!: Provides another method of shattering the ice statues.

• Trisagion: Can help break statues faster due to tears hitting multiple times.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: Damage dealt during the killing blow doesn't provide charge.

• 120 Volt/Technology Zero: No effect on lasers.

• [edition rnr+] Berserk! / Tainted Samson: Kills will freeze the enemies upon their death but they don't count as kills, therefore making it impossible to extend the time by killing enemies with the jawbone.

• [Repentance+] Freezing enemies properly extends effect duration.

• Contagion: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.

• D10: Even though frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, rerolling them into a different enemy will bring them back to life.

• Friendly Ball: Cannot be used to capture frozen enemies.

• Shoop da Whoop!: The beam is unable to freeze enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Uranus originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Uranus used to be overridden if Isaac also obtained Terra.

• Uranus' effects reference the planet Uranus' nature as an ice giant, being composed mainly of water, ammonia, and methane in gas and liquid form.

• [edition rnr+] Jar of Flies used to only add flies, in case enemies' ice statues were shattered by player's tears or bombs.

• [Repentance+] Statues shattered by kicking also add a fly.

fields.description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.

Urn of Souls.title: Urn of Souls
Urn of Souls.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.

• Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.

• The flames destroy enemy projectiles, Poop, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.

• Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Can be fired diagonally, or in any direction if using a gamepad or mouse controls (the latter being enabled in options.ini).

• The Urn can't be used to destroy Shopkeepers, unlike The Candle and Red Candle.

• Multiple Urns share the same charges.

• Bethany can use her soul charges to fuel the Urn. Likewise, Tainted Bethany can use her blood charges.

• Holding two urns with Jacob and Esau won't charge both at the same time, each enemy will drop the same charges as if only one urn was held.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Angelic Prism: Flames can be split into four multi-colored flames.

• Bird's Eye / Ghost Pepper: The urn can emit flames from these items. Ghost Pepper flames are indistinguishable from Urn of Souls flames, but persist on the ground for longer.

• Book of Belial interaction: The stream of fire is replaced with a controllable Brimstone beam that destroys projectiles and deals more damage the longer it's active. The minimum damage is 3.37 + 0.361 × floor, and the maximum damage is 4.2 + 0.45 × floor, which it scales up to over the course of 3 seconds of continuous fire. Souls dropped from enemies are colored red, and the Urn displays a red graphic on the HUD when active.This brimstone will not be affected by any synergies, except side ones such as Angelic Prism, Hemoptysis and Marked.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a wisp in the middle ring for every consecutive second Urn of Souls is fired. The occasional fires shot by the wisps block enemy shots, deal contact damage to enemies, and last for 3 seconds before dissipating. The flames deal 10 damage per tick for the first second they're out, scale down to 5 damage over the next second, and then stay at 5 damage until they dissipate (60-30 damage per second). The damage these fires deal does not increase with BFFS! or scale up on later floors.

• Eye of Greed / Large Zit / Tech.5 / Technology 2: Tears from these items will still shoot as normal while using the urn.

• Guppy / The Mulligan: Fires have a chance to spawn Blue Flies.

• Immaculate Heart: Each individual flame has a chance to cause Immaculate Heart to generate an orbiting tear.

• Lead Pencil: Every 15 flames shot out of the urn will shoot a barrage of Isaac's tears.

• Multidimensional Baby: All flames shot through Multidimensional Baby are doubled, providing a burst of flashing black-and-white tears.

• Tear Detonator: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t grant soul charges.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't grant soul charges.

• Kidney Stone: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.

• Void: No effect when absorbed by Void.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Urn of Souls originates from the Antibirth mod where it was an unimplemented item with the pickup quote “Soul collector”.

• This item is used in Baptism by Fire.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If Isaac is holding fire and has The Ludovico Technique + Technology 2 while pulling out Urn of Souls, another Technology 2 laser is created in the direction being fired that persists until the urn is put away or the room is left.

fields.description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.

Used Diaper.title: Used Diaper
Used Diaper.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a [Before Repentance+] 15% / [Repentance+] 33% chance to gain the Skatole effect in each room. This chance is seeded into the room and isn't affected by Luck.

• [Repentance+] Spawns a blue fly when entering a new combat room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• For a list of what flies are affected and how, see the Skatole page.

• Dropping the trinket will not revert Fly, but will undo the other benefits.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either spawns a second blue fly when entering a new combat room. Having both spawns a total of 3 blue flies.

fields.name: Used Diaper
fields.description: Grants the Skatole effect in some rooms. [Repentance+] Spawns a blue fly when entering a new combat room.

VIII - Justice.title: VIII - Justice
VIII - Justice.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Drops a random type of Heart, Key, Bomb, and Coin pickup on the ground.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The pickups spawned can be of any of their types (if unlocked):

• The coin can be of any value.

• The heart can be of any color.

• The key can be a Golden Key, a Charged Key [Before Repentance] but not a Key Ring.

• The bomb can be double, or even a Troll Bomb.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Some Super Secret Room layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using VIII - Justice in these rooms can force the hearts to be of one specific type.

• Since the bomb can be a troll bomb, it's better to use VIII - Justice next to a tinted rock or a Secret Room's entrance.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns two of each pickup.

• Each pickup can independently be of any type.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : Spawns four of each pickup.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Justice is the eighth card of a Major Arcana set.

• [Repentance] There is one room in the game (in Dross) that contains a guaranteed Justice card (see Gallery). The same room in Downpour has only a 20% chance to contain a Justice card. [end edition note]

fields.name: VIII - Justice
fields.description: Drops a random type of Heart, Key, Bomb, and Coin pickup on the ground.

VIII - Justice?.title: VIII - Justice?
VIII - Justice?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns 2 - 4 Locked Chests.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The spawned Locked Chests have a 0.833% chance to be replaced by Mega Chests if they are unlocked.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns 4-14 Locked Chests.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card: Only 2-7 chests spawn.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • The Left Hand: Turns all spawned chests into Red Chests.

sections.heading: Unlocking Bugs
sections.text:
• If option of Item Description is turned on, game might crash.

• To fix this issue, player can disable Item Description for the duration of the Challenge #43 Cantripped!

fields.name: VIII - Justice?
fields.quote: May your sins come back to torment you
fields.description: Creates 2 to 4 Locked Chests near Isaac.

VII - The Chariot.title: VII - The Chariot
VII - The Chariot.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• For 6 seconds:

• Gives invulnerability

• +0.28 speed

• Removes the ability to shoot tears, replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

• • [Before Repentance] Isaac deals 40 contact damage to enemies, once per second.

• • [Repentance] Isaac deals 20 contact damage to enemies, twice per second.

• • 
• If an enemy is at 40 HP or less, the contact damage is increased to 40 for that enemy.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• VII - The Chariot's effect is identical to My Little Unicorn.

• Ending the current run via opening the end chest while My Little Unicorn is active will cause the credits and main menu music to be sped up. The effect ends upon restarting the game or starting a new run.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • The invulnerability effect negates all forms of damage, including health loss from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars. They can be used for free for the duration of the effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: The effect's length is doubled to 12 seconds.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : The effect is quadrupled to 24 seconds.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Chariot is the seventh card of a Major Arcana set.

• In card divination, The Chariot represents war and triumph, which is represented in game with the high damage and speed granted to Isaac.

fields.name: VII - The Chariot
fields.description: Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

VII - The Chariot?.title: VII - The Chariot?
VII - The Chariot?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Isaac becomes an invincible statue with 4× fire rate for 10 seconds. The statue can no longer move normally, and will only be nudged slightly when pressing a movement key. However, it is still affected by knockback.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Unlike most effects that grant invulnerability, VII - The Chariot? does not negate damage from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Rock Bottom: The fire rate bonus is retained after the card's effect runs out.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • When VII - The Chariot? is activated, the statue has a 0.1% chance to look like Edith, a hidden character from Antibirth that wasn't adapted into Repentance.

fields.name: VII - The Chariot?
fields.description: Isaac becomes an invincible statue with 4× fire rate for 10 seconds. The statue can be nudged slightly by moving and is affected by knockback.

VI - The Lovers.title: VI - The Lovers
VI - The Lovers.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns 2 Red Hearts on the ground near Isaac.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • Some Super Secret Room layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using VI - The Lovers in these rooms can transform the red hearts into other types of hearts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns [Before Repentance] 4 / [Repentance] 3 Red Hearts.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : Spawns [Before Repentance] 8 / [Repentance] 6 Red Hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The Lovers is the sixth card of a Major Arcana set.

fields.name: VI - The Lovers
fields.quote: May you prosper and be in good health
fields.description: Spawns 2 full Red Hearts on the ground.

VI - The Lovers?.title: VI - The Lovers?
VI - The Lovers?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Creates a random item pedestal from the current room's item pool.

• Turns one Red Heart Container or two Soul Hearts into a Broken Heart.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Can cause Isaac to die if he no longer has health after the conversion.

• For the purposes of tracking Heartbreak's effect on The Lost / Tainted Lost, VI - The Lovers? doesn't add any hidden Broken Hearts to their healthbar, allowing them to use the card without penalty.

• While they're functionally very similar, using VI - The Lovers? does not count as a use of Magic Skin, thus not adding or increasing the chance for future items to be replaced with Magic Skin.

• For Keeper / Tainted Keeper, broken hearts will lower the maximum amount of coin hearts he can have. Therefore use of this card on them isn't recommended.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: Removes 2 heart containers or 4 Soul Heart, then adds 2 broken hearts and spawns 2 items.

fields.name: VI - The Lovers?
fields.quote: May your heart shatter to pieces
fields.description: Creates a random item from the current room's item pool. Turns one Red Heart Container or two Soul Hearts into a Broken Heart.

V - The Hierophant.title: V - The Hierophant
V - The Hierophant.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns 2 Soul Hearts on the ground near Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• As the Soul Hearts are spawned on the ground, if the card is used too close to a pit or obstacle, or if there isn’t enough room around Isaac, the hearts can spawn on the other side of the pit or obstacle.

• Since the hearts need to be picked up and are not directly added to Isaac’s HP they will trigger effects such as Soul Locket or Immaculate Conception.

• Some Super Secret Room layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using V - The Hierophant in these rooms can transform the soul hearts into other types of hearts, which may be an unwanted outcome.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns [Before Repentance] 4 / [Repentance] 3 Soul Hearts.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : Spawns [Before Repentance] 8 / [Repentance] 6 soul hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Hierophant is the fifth card of a Major Arcana set.

fields.name: V - The Hierophant
fields.description: Spawns 2 Soul Hearts on the ground.

V - The Hierophant?.title: V - The Hierophant?
V - The Hierophant?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns 2 Bone Hearts on the ground near Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Some Super Secret Room layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using V - The Hierophant? in these rooms can transform the bone hearts into other types of hearts, which may be an unwanted outcome.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns 3 Bone Hearts.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : Spawns 6 bone hearts.

fields.name: V - The Hierophant?
fields.description: Spawns 2 Bone Hearts on the ground.

Vade Retro.title: Vade Retro
Vade Retro.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.

• The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.

• • Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.

• Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.

• Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Ghosts can be moved very slowly by shooting at them.

• Enemies that can be instantly killed include all entities that have the ghost tag in entities2.xml.

• This can even be used to kill Delirium should it transform into a ghost boss, such as The Haunt, while at or below half HP.

• The full list of enemies affected are:

• • Candler

• • Dust

• • Kineti

• • Lil' Haunt

• • Nightwatch (unimplemented)

• • Polty

• • Red Ghost

• • Wizoob

• Plus the following bosses:

• • Clutch

• • The Forsaken

• • The Haunt

• • The Heretic

• • The Rainmaker

• Ghosts that are currently not visible on the screen (e.g. in larger rooms) will not be detonated when using the item.

• Friendly enemies can be killed by the ghosts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Instead of exploding on the spot, souls home in on nearby enemies and explode on contact, similarly to Purgatory. The souls deal 2 × Judas's damage up to 3 times and destroy projectiles.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Ghosts very slowly move and shoot tears in the same direction Isaac is shooting. The ghosts' tears deal 3.5 damage, and are fired once every second.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t leave ghosts.

• E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t leave ghosts.

• Void: When absorbed, enemies no longer leave behind ghosts on death. Retains ghost instant kill effect when void is used.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item's name refers to the Latin phrase "Vade Retro Satana", a phrase commonly uttered during exorcisms which roughly translates to "Stay back, Satan."

• This phrase (and its initials) are commonly engraved around crucifixes or the Saint Benedict Medal.

• The item's sprite directly represents the reverse side of said medal (which carries the phrase).

• This item's effects could be a reference to the Nuclear Throne character Melting, who has a similar activated ability.

• This is further reinforced by the fact that more powerful enemies leave larger ghosts that explode into 3 small blasts; in Nuclear Throne, larger enemies' corpses would explode in a similar fashion.

• The ability to detonate Isaac's ghost is also similar to Melting being able to use his ability one last time after death to explode his own corpse.

• The Exorcist creates red ghosts that are identical to those created by Vade Retro. These ghosts can even be blown up if Isaac has the item.

fields.description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.

Vanishing Twin.title: Vanishing Twin
Vanishing Twin.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a flat, rotating fetus familiar that follows Isaac.

• After entering a Boss Room, the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the boss. Isaac must defeat both bosses.

• The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.

• Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the boss item pool, even if the fight isn't over yet.

• [Repentance+] The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.

• The effect doesn't occur against mini-bosses and end-chapter bosses such as Mom, Mom's Heart, Isaac, Satan, etc.

• The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If Vanishing Twin becomes a clone of a boss with a hardcoded item drop, such as Gish or one of the Harbingers, the second item pedestal will be from the boss item pool instead of the boss' regular drop.

• Managing to defeat the boss before the twin has transformed into it will not prevent the twin from doing the transformation, and the boss fight will continue.

• Obtaining Vanishing Twin in the boss fight itself will not take effect immediately. The boss room must be re-entered in order for the twin to transform.

• On floors with multiple bosses (e.g. The Void) or when getting [cu: Labyrinth] , the twin will only act on the first boss encountered.

• The twin will not transform into bosses that are randomly found in some default room layouts.

• This item has no effect in Greed Mode and will not normally spawn in this game mode.

• If it becomes a clone of Great Gideon, 2 extra waves of enemies are added to the battle, as well as the second Great Gideon also performing attacks.

• If Vanishing Twin turns into Clutch, the clone will immediately enter its second phase due to not having any Clickety Clacks to possess.

• When multiple Rotguts are spawned, only one needs to be entered.

• In true Co-op, the pedestal spawned by Vanishing Twin will have an extra item for each player.

• Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Vanishing Twin having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

• Vanishing Twin does not appear in item pools (and cannot be found normally) from Chapter 4 onwards.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Sacrificial Altar: The twin can be sacrificed normally at any time.

• If sacrificed after it's transformed into a boss, it will still give an item from the sacrifice, but the boss will not disappear and will also not spawn an additional item.

• Satanic Bible: Using it before killing the clone boss will cause it to spawn an item from the Devil Room item pool instead of from the Boss item pool. This item must be purchased just like a normal Devil Deal.

• There's Options: Will spawn an additional item choice for the item spawned by Vanishing Twin.

• Tick: Further lowers the health of both the original boss and its clone.

• Vanishing Twin: Picking up multiple copies of the item will result in multiple clones getting spawned.

• Each boss will have its health reduced down further to 75% of the health of its previous clone.

• Each of the bosses will spawn a separate item.

• Each clone of Great Gideon adds 2 extra waves of enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Will increase the fetus' size, although it has no effect after the transformation happens.

• Box of Friends: No effect.

• IV - The Emperor?: The twin will clone the additional boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. However, this will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the twin won't be active until the next floor.

• Meat Cleaver: No effect on the number of items spawned.

• Tainted Keeper: If playing as Tainted Keeper, the item dropped by the clone boss will cost money.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A Vanishing Twin is a fetus that dies during gestation and is reabsorbed by its twin, hence the appearance of the item.

• The familiar's flat appearance is due to a real life phenomenon known as fetus papyracaeus, where instead of a vanishing twin being physically reabsorbed by the other, the body stays in the womb and gets crushed and flattened by the healthy twin in full term between the fetus' expanding membranes and the uterine walls.

• When encountering C.H.A.D., the original will notably shrink once its clone spawns, due to Vanishing Twin reducing its HP and C.H.A.D.'s HP being linked to its size.

• Vanishing Twin used to not have the "lazarussharedglobal" tag with the lack thereof causing bugs. These bugs would occur when Tainted Lazarus used Flip. If Flip was used after the boss was cloned, it would not drop an additional item. If Flip was used after defeating the boss and gaining the item, it would spawn another item of the current pool on the next flip.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Using IV - The Emperor while in a boss fight will immediately kill the twin boss and spawn the second item for free; the player will only have to fight one boss thereafter.
Bug note: In Double Trouble boss fights, only one of the bosses will get copied, but both of them will get their health lowered down to 75%.
Bug note: The interaction between this item and Great Gideon is unstable — attempting to kill a clone of Great Gideon with Chaos Card will sometimes fail and cause a softlock.
Bug note: When cloning Turdlet, Vanishing Twin will only clone 1 segment of the boss and will stick to it, making a 6-segments Turdlet.
Bug note: Playing as Tainted Lazarus while holding Birthright, if the form not holding Vanishing Twin finishes the Mother's Shadow chase, both forms will have a separate copy of Vanishing Twin, allowing for multiple copies of bosses to be spawned. Flipping will undo the bug.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the Boss Room. Defeating it drops an extra item.

Varicose Veins.title: Varicose Veins
Varicose Veins.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When Isaac gets hit, 10 tears are fired in a circle around him (similar to Tammy's Head).

• Tears spawned on hit have a +25 damage bonus.

• When Isaac gets hit, has a chance to activate the Anemic effect for 2 seconds.

• The effect doesn't seem affected by luck.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / The Wiz: No effect. When Isaac gets damaged, only ten tears will be fired.

• Apple!: Each tear has a chance to fire the razor tear.

• Azazel: Fires ten short-ranged brimstone beams in a circle.

• Anti-Gravity: No effect.

• Chocolate Milk: Fires ten minimally charged tears. Damage of tears is reduced slightly.

• Dr. Fetus: Taking damage releases 10 bombs around Isaac, which often leads to taking damage again.

• Epic Fetus: Fires ten normal tears when taking damage.

• Eye of the Occult: Tears are controllable.

• It Hurts: Two rings of tears are released at once.

• The Ludovico Technique: No effect.

• Marked: No effect.

• Monstro's Lung: Fires ten red tears when taking damage. No other effects.

• Playdough Cookie: Each one of the 10 tears spawned on hit has one of the available random effects applied to it.

• Soy Milk: Fires ten tiny tears when taking damage. Tear damage is only slightly reduced.

• Tainted Azazel: Fires ten brimstone beams in a circle. These beams do not have the damage penalty T. Azazel's attacks have, and can be further boosted by his Hemoptysis sneeze.

• Tech X: No effect.

• Technology: Fires ten lasers in a circle.

• Tractor Beam: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Varicose veins is a medical condition where veins (typically on the extremities) become swollen and more visible. They can also cause aching pain or discomfort.

fields.description: Taking damage releases a ring of 10 high damage tears.

Vasculitis.title: Vasculitis
Vasculitis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.

• The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.

• These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy status effects.

• Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If an enemy is killed while affected by a status effect, the burst tears will inflict the corresponding effect.

• Homing, range and shot speed do not affect Vasculitis.

• Released tears can be difficult to distinguish from enemy shots, especially from enemies which split in to burst shots upon death such as Red Boom Fly and light blue champions.

• [Repentance+] The projectiles are now a unique shape and color to improve visibility.

• All forms of damage will cause an enemy to release tears.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t release tears.

• Burn: Burning enemies release fire mind tears.

• Poison: When a poisoned enemy dies, the released tears are tinted green and will poison other enemies.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t release tears.

• Fire Mind: Not recommended. Vasculitis' tears can explode, with great potential to harm Isaac.

• [Repentance] Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t release tears.

• [Repentance+] Frozen enemies can release tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [edition rnr+] Enemies that are frozen, actually do release tears. However, since these tears are spawned inside of enemies' ice statues, they deal damage to statues and immediately destroy themselves.

• [edition rnr+] If enemy had high enough health, statue may be shattered instantly because of that.

fields.description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.

Vengeful Spirit.title: Vengeful Spirit
Vengeful Spirit.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time.

• Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.

• Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The wisps share the first layer of Book of Virtues wisps, and contribute to filling its cap of 8.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Doubles the wisps' size, on-hit and contact damage.

• Blood Oath: For each half heart of damage taken at the start of the room, a wisp is spawned.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In mythology and folklore, a vengeful spirit is said to be the spirit of a dead person who returns from the afterlife to seek revenge for a cruel, unnatural or unjust death or an improper burial.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room from the one he is currently in (such as by teleporting to the previous room then using it again) will duplicate the wisps. Any extra wisps created from duplication on a filled ring will appear at the entrance of each room Isaac enters and shoot in the direction Isaac is currently shooting.

fields.description: After taking damage, spawns an orbital wisp that lasts for the entire floor, up to a maximum of six. They fire tears but do not block shots.

Ventricle Razor.title: Ventricle Razor
Ventricle Razor.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When used for the first time, Isaac creates a blue portal under where he is standing. The next time he uses the item, he creates an orange portal. Isaac can then walk over either of the portals to teleport instantly to the location of the other one.

• Activating the item more than twice will replace the older of the two portals.

• Upon entering a new floor, the previously placed portals will disappear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The portals can be placed in any room. However, if a portal leads to a room with a negative grid index (i.e. Devil Room, Angel Room, I AM ERROR room, Crawl Space, Boss Rush, Black Market, Mega Satan room, or ??? portal room), Isaac will not be able to enter the portal.

• [Before Repentance] Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be abused to trigger the Blood Donation Machine and Devil Beggar without losing health by placing a portal just next to it, teleporting, and touching the Donation Machine or Beggar in the same move. This trick is particularly useful for The Lost. The teleportation trick can also be used to enter a Curse Room without taking damage.

• [Repentance] Upon teleportation, Isaac is granted with a short invulnerability period which can be used to enter a Curse Room without taking damage. However, it cannot be used to play Blood Donation Machines or similar machines for free. Isaac is also unable to open chests during the animation, meaning Spiked Chests cannot be opened for free.

• When teleporting between different rooms, Isaac will briefly stay invisible at the door before moving to the portals, and can interact with chests near the door. However, opening Spiked Chests this way will still deal damage to Isaac.

• Portals will stay even if the item is dropped or changed.

• It is possible to stack the two portals on top of each other. Entering one will make you hop infinitely as long as you stay on the portals. It creates invincibility at the cost of mobility and almost, but not all tears.

• If [cu: Maze] is active, using portals placed between different rooms may result in a random destination. Two portals in the same room work reliably.

• If room contents are randomized by the curse, it's possible for the portals to end up completely surrounded or even inside rocks or pits. If Isaac can't move to safety, the run can be quit and resumed to be placed at a door.

• [Repentance] On Downpour II, Ventricle Razor cannot be used to teleport between the normal and mirror world. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] This item can be useful to exit Mom's boss room to start the Ascent, as long as you use it at least once before entering the boss room.

• [Repentance] The item only costs 10 cents when found in a Shop.

• This item can be used to steal the rewards from a Challenge Room, a Boss Challenge Room or Boss Rush. This can be done by placing a portal in another room, then taking the rewards from the challenge room. Then, instead of fighting the enemies, use Ventricle Razor to immediately teleport out and keep the rewards.

• When fighting bosses that can drop pickups accompanied by other enemies, Isaac can kill only the boss for the pickups while keeping the other enemies alive, then use Ventricle Razor to teleport out and reset the room. This can be repeated to farm their loots infinitely.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt / Jumper Cables: By swapping to another active item before reentering the room or with Schoolbag, can provide infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving with the portals, and repeating.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a blue/orange wisp that circles the respective portal. Wisps do not fire tears. Wisps do persist if Isaac leaves the room and reenters.

• Charm of the Vampire / Leech: Allows for unlimited healing.

• Gimpy: Allows the possibility to generate unlimited hearts.

• Head of the Keeper: With enough patience, coins can be gathered infinitely.

• Holy Mantle: Can be used to reset the shield at will.

• Kamikaze!: Can be activated without harm while teleporting between portals.

• Tainted Magdalene: She can abuse the invincibility from the stacked portals to let enemies approach her and die in her hugs.

• Tainted Keeper: Leaving and re-entering the room allows for limited coin farming; however, enemies in rooms Tainted Keeper has already visited will eventually stop dropping coins.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: Renders the item conventionally useless except for the unlimited invicibility described above.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Ventricle Razor works normally.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A ventricle is a hollow part in an organ.

• The colors of the portals are a reference to the Portal Gun from the Portal series, whose portals share the same colors and functionality.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Entering one of the portals causes the Found Soul familiar to become invisible until Isaac drops and picks up the trinket again or enters a new floor.

fields.image name: * [edition alternatives: Before Afterbirth+: Afterbirth; Before Repentance: Afterbirth+]
fields.description: Creates up to two portals that remain even if Isaac leaves the room. Upon entering a portal, Isaac is teleported to the other portal.

Venus.title: Venus
Venus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one Red Heart Container.

• Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

• Charms enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • 2Spooky: Overridden by Venus.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Venus originates from the Antibirth mod.

• Venus' effects reference the Roman goddess of love and beauty, Venus.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When using D12 to reroll obstacles; any Movable TNT or Fire Places created within the charm aura will occasionally spawn as charmed for 2 seconds with only the pink tint to indicate the status effect. Corn poops created in the charm aura are unaffected however the Eternal Fly may also become temporarily charmed.

fields.description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.

Vibrant Bulb.title: Vibrant Bulb
Vibrant Bulb.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Increases all stats while Isaac's active item is fully charged:

• +0.25 speed.

• +0.75 range.

• [Before Repentance] +0.50 tear falling speed.

• +0.20 tears.

• +0.10 shot speed.

• +0.50 damage.

• +1 luck.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The trinket creates no effect if Isaac has no active item.

• [Before Repentance] Active items that are reusable indefinitely without a charge bar, such as How to Jump, will allow Vibrant Bulb's effects to be permanent (until the active item is swapped out).

• Vibrant Bulb is slightly less than half as powerful as Dim Bulb; however, its effects are active more often.

• Glowing Hourglass, when used, will not make the Vibrant Bulb inactive and will still provide the bonus until it has one bar of charge.

• Having additional charge beyond full with The Battery does not provide an additional bonus. It does give an advantage however, since using the fully charged item once still provides Vibrant Bulb's effect.

• If two active items are held (Schoolbag), the one currently active must be at full charge for the trinket to take effect (the other one doesn't need to be fully charged).

• [Repentance] Vibrant Bulb produces no effect with active items in consumable slots, e.g. Tainted Apollyon's Abyss or Tainted Bethany's Lemegeton. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If Bethany or Tainted Bethany are holding enough soul/red hearts to charge her current active item, the Vibrant Bulb will be active, even if there are no regular charges. [end edition note] 

• If the active item is fully charged only with soul/blood charges and no regular charges, Vibrant Bulb and Dim Bulb can be both active at the same time if Isaac holds both of the trinkets.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either doubles the stat increases. Having both triples them.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Replacing Isaac's active item with another active item that doesn't have a charge bar won't immediately activate the trinket's effects. The effect will depend on whether or not the previous item had a full charge or not. Furthermore, if the effect is active due to the previous item having a full charge, picking up a different active item that currently has no charge won't disable the effect, and vice-versa.

fields.name: Vibrant Bulb
fields.description: Provides a boost to all stats when Isaac's active item is fully charged.

Virgo.title: Virgo
Virgo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a chance to trigger the Book of Shadows effect upon taking damage, creating a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 10 seconds.

• The activation chance depends on the luck stat and goes up to 100% with 10 Luck.

• Converts all negative pills into positive ones, but does not identify them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The shield negates health loss from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.

• Does not prevent Red Heart container loss from Devil Room deals.

• Bad pills already obtained/dropped will be converted to their "good" counterpart.

• As bad pills will turn into good pills, it is possible for two different colored pills to have the same effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • [Repentance] Celtic Cross / The Polaroid: Virgo can trigger at the same time as Celtic Cross or The Polaroid, cumulating to up to 22 seconds of shield.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • False PHD: Pills can be both good and bad again. Taking bad pills still applies the benefits from False PHD.

fields.description: Adds a chance to give a shield that nullifies all incoming damage for 10 seconds upon taking damage. Also converts bad pills into good pills.

Vis.title: Vis
Vis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Vis are enemies most commonly found in The Depths. They are headless like Hoppers and have their entire torso cut open. When Isaac lines up with the Vis in a cardinal direction, it will fire a Brimstone beam in that direction.

sections.heading: Double Vis
sections.text: Added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original Binding of Isaac, the Double Vis appears similar to the normal Vis but has blood around its openings and a vertical gash in its back. They function identically to regular Vis, but they also fire a Brimstone beam from behind.

sections.heading: Chubber
sections.text:
Chubbers, like Double Vis, were added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac. They look identical to a Vis but have a maggot as their head. Instead of shooting the Brimstone beam that regular Vis and Double Vis have, the Chubber shoots a Charger, similar to the Little Chubby Familiar, which can go through rocks. They can be found in the same locations as Double Vis; however, they are less common. The Charger it shoots does a full heart of damage, will destroy any tears in its way, and has a limited range. Once the Charger has reached this range, it will return to the Chubber.

[Before Repentance] If the Chubber is killed before the Charger has returned to its body, he will still return to the last location and will simply disappear upon touching it. The Charger can still damage Isaac during this time.

Killing the Charger with a Chaos Card will not transform the Chubber into a normal Vis. If the Charger is charmed when being fired, it will not deal damage to the Chubber when returning.

Using the Eraser on a Chubber's Charger will render Chubbers unable to attack for the rest of the run.

sections.heading: Scarred Double Vis
sections.text: The Scarred Double Vis behaves identically to the normal Vis but fires four Brimstone beams in the cardinal directions.

sections.heading: Vis Versa
sections.text: The Vis Versa behaves identically to Vis, but fires a purple homing Brimstone at Isaac instead. In Gehenna, their appearance becomes black instead of white, and their Brimstone becomes red.

sections.heading: Evis
sections.text:
The Evis behaves similarly in movement to Vis and its variants, but launches a string of guts at Isaac instead of Brimstone.

If Isaac is hit, he doesn't immediately take damage, but is instead held by the whip and can't get any further away from the Evis while the cord gradually shrinks as Isaac is pulled in. He can still move at the same radius, but as soon as he gets closer, said radius gets smaller. The cord also has an elastic effect causing Isaac to bounce back closer to the Evis if he attempts to pull away. This lasts until the Evis is killed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• TheBrimstone fired by Vis will damage other non-Vis enemies.

• The Vis and its variations might be the most useful and powerful enemies when they are charmed, spawned by Friendly Ball, or Poke Go, since its Brimstone Laser is very powerful and can very quickly kill enemies and even bosses.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In the original Binding Of Isaac, if a Vis or a Double Vis was a Champion, its Brimstone would be colored.

• Gluttony is a Vis with a head.

• Similarly, Super Gluttony is a Double Vis with a large head.

• • Despite this, both Gluttony and Super Gluttony can be damaged by Vis' Brimstone attacks, while all types of Vis cannot damage each other.

• • [Repentance] Both's updated sprites use the new Vis/Double Vis sprites as well.

• Tainted Lilith's body is a black colored Vis with ribs added when opened.

• The Cage can spawn Vis with a unique coloration but no change to their behavior.

• Their designs are based on the Sisters Vis, which originated from Gish, one of Edmund McMillen's other games.

• "Vis" may potentially serve as an abbreviation for the term "viscera", whereas "Evis" is likely an abbreviation for "eviscerated".

• If a Chubber is a champion, only the Vis part is colored and the Charger stays the same.

• [Repentance] The name "Vis Versa" is a play on the term "vice versa", which is Latin for "the other way around".

• [Repentance] The Vis Versa and Evis both first appeared in the Antibirth mod.

• In Antibirth the Vis Versa could spawn in Dark Room.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If a Vis (or any of its variants) is [Before Afterbirth+] stunned, scared, or [Afterbirth onward] shrunken, it will still attack the player while running away from Isaac.
