sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Breath of Life refers to God breathing life into the soil to create the first human.

• Breath of Life initially had a different animation, almost exactly alike to Chocolate Milk's effect. However, this animation has one frame of Isaac holding his breath that isn't found in Chocolate Milk's sprites. It even has its own .anim2 file, paralleling Chocolate Milk's. The finished effect for Breath of Life is a gradual change of Isaac's skin tone, from perky pink to hold-my-breath blue.

• Depleting the skill's charge turns Isaac a similar color to ???, who is implied to be Isaac after suffocating in his toy chest.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: This item does not work with Broken Remote.
Bug note: Replacing this item with another active item, switching into another active item with Schoolbag, or directly removing it via debug console while holding the active item key causes Isaac to take damage, even if the charge bar isn't depleted at all.

fields.description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. [Repentance] Isaac creates beams of light when touching enemies while invulnerable, and creates a powerful 4-way beam if blocking damage exactly as the invincibility starts.

Brimstone.title: Brimstone
Brimstone.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is piercing and spectral, dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.

• The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.

• • These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.

• • [Before Repentance] Brimstone ticks 13 times over the course of 0.9 seconds (54 frames).

• • [Repentance] Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).

• \text{Charge Time (s)} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate}}

• [Repentance] Starting from 15.00 fire rate, the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.

• • \text{Damage per Tick} = \frac{6 \times \text{Damage}}{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} = \frac{\text{Damage} \times \text{Fire Rate}}{5}

• Tears down: [Before Repentance] Tear Delay × 3 / [Repentance] Fire Rate ÷ 3.

• Contributes to the Leviathan transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Brimstone is a special item.

• Azazel starts the game with a short-ranged, slower-charging version of Brimstone. Without the long-range version, his mini-brimstone won't have enough length to use any homing items.

• [Afterbirth onward] His Brimstone's shorter range can be increased with range-increasing items or pills.

• Multi-shot effects like 20/20 will increase the number of beams accordingly, with exceptions listed below.

• Although extremely unlikely, Isaac can shoot a total of 16 blood beams at a time via multi-shot items. If the number of blood beams would exceed this number, the beams' span will instead widen.

• [Repentance] Tainted Azazel has a full-range, but thinner beam whose damage is halved unless enemies are cursed by his inherent Hemoptysis sneeze. [end edition note] 

• The beam will apply Tear effects and does so frequently thanks to its high tick rate.

• Any item that grants homing tears: will cause the beam to make sharp turns and even loops to hit enemies, which is extremely powerful. Azazel's mini-brimstone does not home unless he has a high range stat.

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight Black Hearts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fires a spread of 2/3/4 Brimstone beams.

• Despite the fire rate penalty caused by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, the overall DPS increase is more significant compared to 20/20. [Repentance] However, if combined, 20/20 negates the fire rate penalty of the aforementioned items, which results in enormous damage output.

• Almond Milk: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts indefinitely as long as the fire key is held. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls. The beam will also gain random worm trinket effects.

• Increasing the tears stat will increase the damage and width of Brimstone as well.

• • Damage per Tick = (Damage × Fire Rate) ÷ 5

• Azazel / Tainted Azazel: Picking up Brimstone with him will give him the regular version.

• Apple! / Euthanasia / Tough Love: The beam can gain the damage multiplier from each of the items, although there is no visual difference. The bonus applies for the whole beam and not on a per-tick basis. Euthanasia loses its instant kill ability, however.

• [Repentance] The bonus applies randomly on every tick of the beam, including the insta-kill ability from Euthanasia.

• Anti-Gravity: An orb of energy expands, then shrinks while firing the beam after a delay. The orb still hurts enemies if they touch it. Isaac can start charging a new shot immediately after releasing the fire key without canceling the first shot, effectively allowing for a faster firing rate. It makes it harder to hit enemies with Azazel as the beam does not increase in range. [Repentance] Size and damage of the beams no longer scales with fire rate, nor is it possible to sustain a perpetual beam at above 15 fire rate.

• [Repentance] Anti-Gravity + Soy Milk / Almond Milk: Allows auto-firing upon full charge, but without permanent beam uptime.

• [edition anr] Anti-Gravity + Incubus: Isaac will fire Brimstone orbs, while Incubus will fire regular Brimstone beams.

• • [Repentance] Both Isaac and Incubus fire Brimstone orbs.

• Brain Worm: The beam will curve 90 degrees in order to attack opponents, effectively acting as a stronger form of homing. Very strong against multi-segment bosses such as Pin or Mother.

• Brimstone:

• [Before Repentance] Additional copies of this item, such as from Diplopia / Crooked Penny, adds another beam, with no increase in charge time.

• [Repentance] The first additional copy of this item grants a 1.2× damage multiplier and +1 damage and doubles the beam's width. Further copies will only grant +1 damage.

• • If combined with Azazel's Birthright effect, the laser beam will be 4× wider.

• • The bigger beam granted by double Brimstone synergizes with other items as expected.

• Chocolate Milk: Brimstone laser takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point. Width and damage of the laser increases with charge, from 25% damage and 50% width at minimum charge to 250% damage and 160% width at maximum charge.

• Continuum: Brimstone laser travels through the wall and appears out the other side once.

• Continuum + Rubber Cement: Instead of Continuum being overridden, the beam is reflected the second time it hits the wall. This results in it potentially overlapping with itself a total of three times.

• Cricket's Body: Spawns split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the beam hits.

• C Section: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the Brimstone beam.

• C Section + Soy Milk / Almond Milk: Small fetuses fire continuously alongside the beam.

• C Section + The Ludovico Technique: Fetus tears no longer fire with the Brimstone circle, even on doing damage.

• Dead Eye: The damage multiplier that was gained before picking up Brimstone will now be permanent. However, saving and quitting the run will result in this damage multiplier being permanently lost (which is a bug).

• Dataminer: Dataminer can be used to underflow Isaac's tears to immediately bring it to 120, maxing out Brimstone's width and damage via tears.

• Epic Fetus: Adds a Brimstone Sad Bombs effect: missile explosions shoot ten beams in all directions, massively increasing damage and area of effect.

• Explosivo / Sinus Infection: The beam has a chance to stick tears to enemies on every other tick.

• [Repentance] Eye of the Occult: Creates a controllable crosshair similar to Marked. Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam curves towards the crosshair and then attempts to hit the wall Isaac is facing. [end edition note] 

• Eye of the Occult + Tech.5 / Technology 2: Tech.5 and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own.

• Guppy: Blue Flies are spawned at a rate of approximately one blue fly per tick ( [Repentance] every other tick) of damage for each enemy it hits, up to 13 flies. The spawned blue flies will also move to attack the targeted enemy immediately.

• Haemolacria: +20 Tear Delay after Haemolacria's tears down. Tears burst into 4-7 Brimstone beams that do Isaac's damage per tick.

• Azazel / Tainted Azazel: Overrides these characters' Brimstone. Tears do not burst into Brimstone beams.

• [Repentance] Double Brimstone: Grants +1 Damage but not the 1.2× damage multiplier. The width of the beams doubles.

• Haemolacria + Chocolate Milk: The Brimstone beams deal full damage regardless of charge.

• [Repentance] Haemolacria + Technology: The lasers coil the beams. This is purely visual and does not grant a 1.5× damage multiplier.

• Head of the Keeper: Makes the laser yellow and each tick has a chance to drop a coin.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage Brimstone deals to 2× and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to Brimstone under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Holy Light: Every tick of the beam has a chance of summoning a beam of light.

• Hook Worm: Beam shifts left to right while firing straight and forms angles that constantly flatten and expand, effectively increasing its width.

• Jacob's Ladder: Upon hitting an enemy, wall, or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.

• Lead Pencil: Lead Pencil triggers approximately every 2 seconds as the beam is fired (charge time is not counted).

• Loki's Horns: Adds a chance to shoot a beam from all four cardinal directions, similarly to Head of Krampus's effect.

• Lost Contact: Beam destroys projectiles, although only during its damage tick interval. The projectiles are not instantly destroyed when they touch the beam.

• The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico Technique has priority. The beam forms a large ring that is controllable and does not need to be charged. The damage is dealt 15 times per second, unaffected by Tears. Enemies inside the ring without touching it are not hurt.

• The Ludovico Technique + Brimstone same size and damage output multiplier as 2 copies of Brimstone, but applied to the laser ring.

• The Ludovico Technique + multi-shot effect: No effect.

• The Ludovico Technique + Apple! / Holy Light / Other tear effects: no effect.

• The Ludovico Technique + C Section: Disables C Section. Fetuses no longer spawn.

• The Ludovico Technique + Incubus:

• • [Before Repentance] Incubus' Brimstone laser is not affected by Ludovico Technique.

• • [Repentance] Adds a smaller controllable laser ring in addition to the main one.

• [Repentance] The Ludovico Technique + Twisted Pair: Adds 2 even smaller controllable laser rings in addition to the main one.

• The Ludovico Technique + A Lump of Coal: The ring increases in diameter when Isaac is further; 100% when he is on the center, 1.25× when he is 12.5 tiles of distance away.

• • [Before Repentance] The damage increases with distance but is reduced while Isaac is in the ring.

• • [Repentance] The damage increases 20% per tile of distance.

• The Ludovico Technique + Mom's Knife: Overrides Brimstone.

• The Ludovico Technique + Proptosis: The ring deals 1.5× Isaac's Damage at its largest, and 50% at its smallest. The ring increases in diameter when Isaac is closer; 1.25× when he is on the center, 100% when he is 12.5 tiles of distance away.

• A Lump of Coal: The beam gradually increases in size and damage the farther it travels, with the damage increasing on a multiplier that is +20% per tile of distance. This allows for a huge damage increase from longer distances.

• Marked: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. Fires at the direction of the crosshair.

• Mom's Eye: Adds a chance to shoot a beam from the back of Isaac's head.

• Mom's Knife: Mom's Knife has priority. Does not apply Brimstone's tears down. Adds a small barrage of knives after the main knife is fired, with each knife doing [Before Repentance] 80% of / [Repentance] 2× Isaac's tear damage.

• The barrage of knives goes all the way across the screen and does not return.

• Charge amount increases the barrage size; 2-4 knives at 0%, 8-10 knives 100%.

• This effect does not work with Azazel or Tainted Azazel's versions of Brimstone.

• Mom's Wig: Holding down a fire button to charge the attack very rapidly rolls the probability to spawn Blue Spiders; releasing to fire the beam, however, does not.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The blue spiders only spawn while the beam is firing.

• Monstro's Lung: Brimstone has priority. Does not apply Monstro's Lung's tears down. Fires 3-5 additional beams in random directions around Isaac. This effect also applies to Azazel and Tainted Azazel's Brimstone.

• [Before Repentance] Charging a new Brimstone beam removes the original from in front of Isaac, but not the additional ones added by Monstro's Lung.

• Multidimensional Baby: If a brimstone laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.

• My Reflection: Makes the beam curve when moving. It has the same effect on Azazel's mini-brimstone but doubles the range.

• [Repentance] Makes the beam shoot from the back. An oval beam is shot from the front instead.

• Mucormycosis: The beam has 25% chance to spawn spore to enemies on every other tick.

• Mysterious Liquid: Leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the beam hits, on every other tick. Azazel's Brimstone leaves creeps at the end of its range.

• Ocular Rift: Rifts may appear where the beam hits rocks, walls, or enemies.

• Ouroboros Worm: The beam will make large loops on itself. The homing is present, but unreliable.

• The Parasite: Spawns two perpendicular beams on the first enemy or obstacle the beam hits.

• [Repentance+] Also spawns small split tears.

• Rotten Tomato: Each tick of the beam's damage can mark enemies.

• Rubber Cement: Beams bounce off of walls once, creating a second beam that deals [Before Repentance] half/ [Repentance] full damage.

• [Afterbirth only] If Azazel's mini Brimstone beam bounces off a wall, it effectively becomes a full-length Brimstone beam, but it will still only deal half damage.

• • [Afterbirth+ onward] Azazel's Brimstone no longer becomes a full length beam after bouncing, instead bouncing as a regular mini-Brimstone.

• Soy Milk: The Brimstone beam bounces off the wall at a perpendicular angle to where the beam was fired.

• Sad Bombs: Upon exploding, bombs release ten beams in all directions.

• [Repentance] Brimstone does not benefit from Sad Bombs' flat damage bonus.

• Soy Milk: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts indefinitely as long as the fire key is held. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls.

• Increasing tears will also increase damage.

• • Damage per Tick = Damage × Fire Rate / 5

• Soy Milk + Chocolate Milk: The beam does 25% more damage. Does not increase Isaac's damage stat itself.

• Strange Attractor: Enemies are attracted towards the beam, improving its consistency. Consumables will also be moved by the beam.

• Sulfur: Grants a larger beam with a 1.2× damage multiplier and +1 damage (same effect as picking up a second Brimstone).

• Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The beam has a chance to destroy rocks every tick. The laser will not destroy sealed doors or open secret rooms.

• [Repentance+] The beam can now open doors.

• Tammy's Head: Shoots ten beams in all directions. Given the item's single room charge, this makes for an extremely powerful synergy.

• [Repentance] Brimstone does not benefit from Tammy's Head's flat damage bonus.

• Tech.5: Tech.5 fires normally while charging Brimstone.

• Technology: The Technology laser coils around the Brimstone beam, granting a 1.5x damage multiplier (it stacks with other similar multipliers like Cricket's Head or Magic Mushroom).

• [Repentance] Technology's damage multiplier will be overridden if Isaac has the powered up version (from picking up Brimstone twice or using Sulfur with Brimstone); this can decrease Isaac's damage.

• Technology 2: Both fire normally; the Technology laser fires while charging Brimstone.

• Tech X: Tech X has priority. Does not apply Brimstone's tears down. Fires a Brimstone ring. This Brimstone ring is larger than the laser ring and has a much wider hitbox.

• [Repentance] Double Brimstone: Further increases the width of the ring, and grants +1 Damage.

• Tech X + Azazel:

• • [Before Afterbirth+] Overridden by Azazel's Brimstone.

• • [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Overrides Azazel's Brimstone. This works quite well with Azazel's good initial damage stat and also negates his initial range penalty.

• • [Repentance] Applies 35% damage penalty and fires a Brimstone ring instead of Tech X ring. If combined with Brimstone, the damage penalty is negated.

• • 
• The same applies to Tainted Azazel.

• Tech X + Homing Shots: The ring bends itself to hit enemies if they are nearby.

• [Before Repentance] Tech X + Mom's Knife: Mom's Knife and a Mom's Knife + Brimstone barrage are shot alongside the rings.

• [Before Repentance] Tech X + Technology: The 1.5× damage multiplier from Brimstone + Technology is lost, but the laser fires while charging the Brimstone ring.

• • [Repentance] Fires a Brimstone ring coiled by a laser. The 1.5× damage multiplier from Brimstone + Technology is retained.

• Tiny Planet: The beam will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.

• [Repentance] Tiny Planet + My Reflection: The beam will first wrap around Isaac, form an oval beam in a longer range, then shoot backward. Interestingly enough, the beam will look like a G clef symbol.

• Uranus: The beam will freeze any enemies killed by it, so long as they are not immune to the freeze effect.

• Wiggle Worm: Beam becomes wavy while firing straight, effectively increasing its width.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
Overridden by Brimstone:

• 20/20

• Cursed Eye

• Evil Eye

• Eye of Belial

• Explosivo

• Flat Stone

• Head of the Keeper

• Holy Light

• Jacob's Ladder

• Kidney Stone

• Lachryphagy

• Lead Pencil

• Monstro's Lung

• Mysterious Liquid

• Neptunus

• The Parasite

• Parasitoid

• Pop!

• Pupula Duplex

• Rubber Cement

• Sinus Infection

• Tech.5, unless using Azazel, in which case it will fire normally while charging Brimstone

• Technology

• Technology Zero

• Trisagion
Only stat effects are applied; otherwise overridden by Brimstone:

• Compound Fracture

• Continuum

• Cricket's Body

• Death's Touch

• Marked

• My Reflection

• Sulfuric Acid

• Technology 2
Other interactions:

• 8 Inch Nails: Beams gain knockback, pushing enemies away in the direction they travel but not out of their path. This increases its consistency.

• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Brimstone, it turns into a larger gray locust, but otherwise acts like normal locusts created by Abyss.

• Bird's Eye: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing.

• Chocolate Milk: Reduces Isaac's tear delay by 20%. Does not increase damage.

• Dr. Fetus: Overrides Brimstone.

• [edition anr] Isaac continuously fires bombs while charging the beam.

• Epic Fetus: Overrides Brimstone.

• Epiphora: Effect only activates when holding charge in a specific direction, and deactivates when the charge is released, effectively making Epiphora useless unless Isaac has exceedingly high tear delay.

• Fire Mind: The beam will not cause explosions, but will still set enemies on fire.

• The Forgotten: The charged attack will spawn a Brimstone ball that will float in front of The Forgotten for a few seconds before disappearing. The Forgotten will still melee attack while performing this action.

• Ghost Pepper: The flames can still shoot from Isaac while holding the fire button.

• [Repentance] Has a chance to shoot flames for every other tick while the beam is being fired.

• Godhead: Homing and stat bonuses apply, but the beam does not have a damaging aura.

• Ipecac: Does not apply Ipecac's stat changes. The beam poisons enemies.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Isaac shoots Ipecac tears while charging Brimstone. Stat changes from both items are applied as normal, meaning that Ipecac fires slower and Brimstone charges slower, but Brimstone deals drastically increased damage.

• [Repentance] Applies +2 flat damage, instead of Ipecac's damage up. Does not apply Ipecac's tears down. The beam explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The beam gains a poison effect. The explosions do not occur when the beam narrows, meaning that they occur only twice per shot without Soy Milk / Almond Milk. The beam and its explosions poison enemies. The Ladder, when placed, will trigger the Ipecac-Brimstone explosions. (possibly a bug)

• • Ipecac + Haemolacria: The flat damage bonus is +40 instead of +2. Tears will explode into multiple brimstone beams, each of which explodes and has a chance to hit Isaac. [end edition note] 

• Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears, but nearly instantly charges when charging Brimstone.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Fires normal tears. Charges at the same rate as Isaac's fire rate while charging Brimstone.

• [Repentance] Fires normal tears. Charges when firing Brimstone.

• Knockout Drops: Gives the lasers high knockback.

• Lachryphagy: Brimstone's range is lowered, but Lachryphagy tears will form at the end of the beam, which can be fed.

• Large Zit: Creep shots will still be fired occasionally while holding the fire button.

• Lodestone: Changes the beam to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The beams are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.

• Number One: Although Number One is otherwise purely beneficial with standard Brimstone, Azazel's range is severely affected.

• Playdough Cookie: Brimstone will start cycling through colors and applies the standard chance of tear-effect on hit, with the homing effect occurring intermittently.

• Pop!: Brimstone has shorter range, a bit longer than the default range of Azazel's mini-Brimstone, and it is not affected by range. The beam fires Pop! tears at the end, which are piercing.

• Proptosis: Does not apply distance penalty.

• [edition anr] The beam deals 2× Isaac's Damage, which is already doubled from the item's effect, at point blank-range. The damage quickly drops further along the beam, at about 0.8× per tile of distance.

• [Repentance] The beam deals 6× Isaac's Damage at point-blank range. Decreases 13.3% of the damage per tile of distance, to the minimum of 0.1 point of damage at 7.5 tiles of distance.

• Spirit Sword: Overrides Brimstone.

• Tainted Samson: Greatly decreases attack speed for Samson's rage mode melee attack and replaces the thrown jawbone with a large laser sphere (similarly to The Forgotten).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The term "brimstone" (burn stone) comes from the King James Bible's mention of burning sulfur. It is used in the phrase "fire and brimstone" to describe the torments of hell. While solid sulfur is yellow, molten sulfur is blood red.

• Brimstone's item icon originally comes from the alchemical symbol for black sulfur, referred to as the Leviathan Cross. It was later adopted by Anton LaVey in The Satanic Bible to represent hell and is now often associated with Satanism.

• [Repentance] Ironically enough, prior to update v1.7.5, Brimstone was changed such that it didn't contribute to the Leviathan transformation. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Brimstone has the same appearance of The Pact, but with big, curved horns and slightly less angry eyes.

• Most items that change tear color will also give Brimstone an exotic appearance, but they do not combine and only one color effect is shown.

• [Repentance] Brimstone is one of the few items that will give Isaac a unique costume when two copies are acquired, along with Guppy's Eye and Glass Eye.

• The ram horns gained from picking up Brimstone were added as a cosmetic item to Team Fortress 2 to promote The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth. If the game was purchased before the 10th of December, players were awarded the item in genuine quality.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Picking up Brimstone before picking up Scorpio will not change the beam's color. Picking up Scorpio before Brimstone, however, will properly change it to green.
Bug note: When having Brimstone + My Reflection and facing towards an east/west wall, standing directly in front of it will make Isaac shoot in reverse — the front-facing oval Brimstone beam will shoot from the back, and the back-facing beam will shoot from the front.

fields.description: Tears are replaced with a blood laser beam that pierces through all enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period.

Brimstone Bombs.title: Brimstone Bombs
Brimstone Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.

• Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions.

• Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.

• Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.

• The lasers cannot damage Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if Hornfel is killed in his second phase. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Fallen. [end edition note] 

• The lasers created by Brimstone Bombs can push other bombs, including Troll Bombs and bombs placed by Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BBF / Bob's Brain: Inherits the effect in full, firing lasers every time they explode.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Attacks have a small chance to trigger this effect. Chance goes up to 100% at 30 luck.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone lasers deal to 19 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone lasers under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Guppy / The Mulligan: The lasers can create Blue Flies when they deal damage.

• Kamikaze!: Activating Kamikaze! sends Brimstone lasers in all 4 directions.

• Red Locusts / Scatter Bombs: Explosions made by the red locusts and tiny bombs create thinner lasers that deal 4.8 damage per tick instead of 8.

• Multidimensional Baby: Placing Multidimensional Baby in front of the beam will transform it into two black-and-white beams.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bomber Boy: Only the center explosion will fire lasers.

• Anarchist Cookbook: The lasers fired by the troll bombs will push other troll bombs around, likely to the edges of the room.

fields.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.

Brittle Bones.title: Brittle Bones
Brittle Bones.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Compound Fracture]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 6 empty Bone Hearts.

• Removes all current Red Heart. Does not remove existing Bone Hearts, but does empty them.

• Upon losing a Bone Heart, including ones acquired from other sources, Isaac fires a ring of 8 bones that split into more bones.

• [Before Repentance] Each Bone Heart lost adds a permanent +0.5 tears up.

• [Repentance] Each Bone Heart lost adds a permanent +0.4 fire rate, which can break the tear fire rate cap.

• Each bone does twice Isaac's damage plus a flat 22 damage; split bones do half this amount.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Frail. [end edition note] 

• If Brittle Bones is removed from Isaac's inventory, its tear upgrades will not be removed but losing further Bone Hearts will no longer have an effect.

• Picking this item up as a character unable to gain Bone Hearts will grant the stats equivalent to one Bone Heart breaking.

• Keeper [Repentance] (and Tainted Keeper) [end edition note] will also gain 24 Blue Flies.

• [Repentance] The tears up bonuses gained through this item will persist in the escape sequence of Mines II. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Losing Bone Hearts not from taking damage (e. g. through a Devil Deal or if a Bone Heart is replaced with a Broken Heart) will not give the tears up effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Empty Vessel: The empty Bone Hearts will trigger Empty Vessel's effects.

• XIX - The Sun?: Using the card before picking up Brittle Bones allows Isaac to keep the heart containers since they will be temporarily converted to Bone Hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Genesis: Removes the tear upgrades upon use.

• Found Soul: The soul does not benefit from the tears up granted to Isaac. However, it will receive a fire rate increase if it somehow receives Bone Hearts and breaks them.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • "Everything hurts" may be a reference to an achievement of the same name from the video game Nuclear Throne.

fields.description: Replaces all Red Heart with 6 empty Bone Hearts. [Before Repentance] Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a tears up. [Repentance] Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.
fields.tags: [edition alternatives: baseline: nolostbr; Repentance+: offensive tearsup]

Broken Ankh.title: Broken Ankh
Broken Ankh.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • When held, Isaac has a 22.22% chance to be revived as ??? in the previous room. Can occur multiple times in the same run.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Resurrection items activate in a set order. Broken Ankh is [Before Repentance] 7th / [Repentance] 9th in this order after Soul of Lazarus, 1up!, Dead Cat, Lazarus' inherent extra life ( [Repentance] swap the order of the previous two), Inner Child, Guppy's Collar, Lazarus' Rags, and Ankh.

• This trinket isn't affected by Luck.

• Unlike Guppy's Collar, Broken Ankh will not display an extra life and question mark next to Isaac's hearts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increases chance to be revived as ??? to 33%. Having both to 50%.

• Tainted ???: Revived as Tainted ??? instead of ???.

fields.description: When held, Isaac has a 22.22% chance to be revived as ??? in the most recent non-hostile room. Can occur multiple times in the same run.

Broken Glass Cannon.title: Broken Glass Cannon
Broken Glass Cannon.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding Glass Cannon. It begins with no charges.

• Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] Eden can start with this item.

• Charging this item does not count as using it. Items and trinkets that activate on active item use (such as Broken Remote) do not activate when charging this item.

• If the player manages to obtain a usable fully charged Broken Glass Cannon, it will turn into Glass Cannon on use. This use counts as a use for items and trinkets that activate on active item use.

• Clearing a room with this fully charged Broken Glass Cannon will also turn it into Glass Cannon. This does not count as a use.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item ID used to be assigned to Tonsil.

• Broken Glass Cannon is one of the three activated items, alongside Alabaster Box and Eden's Soul, that:

• Has no charges upon pickup rather than full.

• Needs to be charged AND disappears upon use.

fields.description: Begins with no charges and turns into Glass Cannon when used. Only acquired by taking damage while holding Glass Cannon.

Broken Glasses.title: Broken Glasses
Broken Glasses.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• 50% chance of adding an extra blind item in Treasure Rooms.

• When one of the items is taken, the other disappears.

• The extra blind items in Downpour, Dross, Mines, Ashpit, Mausoleum, and Gehenna (and Corpse if Bloody Crown is held) have a 50% chance to be revealed instead.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The effect includes instances where pedestal items would be replaced with something else, such as the Pica Run challenge. If there is not a blind equivalent, both items will simply be shown.

• Its effect can work on the same floor it was picked up on if the Treasure Room hasn't been entered yet.

• Works in both Treasure Rooms in [mode: greed] Greed mode.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: The chance to add a blind item in Treasure rooms is now 100%. The chance to reveal the blind item in the alt path Treasure rooms is now 100%.

• Damocles: An additional visible item will be generated from the blind item.

• Devil's Crown: Both items can be taken, but still need to be paid for, and one will remain blind if not on the alt path.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Horse Shoe: The second item will always be blind if not on the alt path.

• This doesn't apply to More Options.

fields.description: Gives a 50% chance to add a '?' item to Treasure Rooms. Only one item can be taken. The extra items on the alt path are revealed instead.

Broken Magnet.title: Broken Magnet
Broken Magnet.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the Broken Magnet trinket; a related item; Magneto; a similar item; Strange Attractor; a similar trinket; Super Magnet]

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Pulls all types of coins towards Isaac. Ignores all other pickups.

• Also affects the vanishing coins of Tainted Keeper.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Additionally pulls in Keys and Bombs. Hearts are also pulled if Isaac can pick them up.

• While playing as Tainted ???, poop pickups won't be attracted.

fields.description: Pulls coins towards Isaac, but ignores other pickups.

Broken Modem.title: Broken Modem
Broken Modem.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Enemies, enemy shots, tears and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals.

• The frequency of the effect depends on Isaac's luck.

• [Repentance] Frozen enemy shots will disappear, but are still able to inflict damage if touched.

• Room clear rewards have a 25% chance to spawn a duplicate, except for chests, pills, or cards.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If Isaac exits the room before the glitching animation is completed on the drop, it will not be duplicated.

• Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and their projectiles.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • [Repentance] Magneto + Options?: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Contract From Below: Broken Modem has an independent chance to duplicate each item spawned by Contract From Below.

• Options?: Chests that were an alternative reward can be duplicated. The two chests contain different items.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Broken Modem is based on this Steam Workshop item by freeze.

• Broken Modem is a reference to an internet modem/box. Since the internet box is broken, there is a large amount of lag, as the client (player) computer is having trouble getting the data from the host server over the stuttering internet. This shows itself in the item through the following effects:

• The client computer has trouble getting the inputs of other players over the broken internet, meaning the other clients freeze in place and look like they aren't moving, as the computer isn't getting the inputs fast enough to show them. (slows enemies, items, and tears)

• The client computer gets the host's or other clients' inputs twice, as the client computer can't send the acceptance trigger to the host server fast enough. (double items)

fields.description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.

Broken Padlock.title: Broken Padlock
Broken Padlock.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Doors and Chests that require a pickup to open can be opened with explosions.

• Key Blocks can be destroyed with explosions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Broken Padlock cannot open:

• Challenge Room doors (neither Normal Challenge Room nor Boss Challenge Room), the golden door that leads to Mega Satan, or the flesh door to Mom's Heart in Mausoleum/Gehenna.

• Haunted Chests and Mom's Chest.

• Doors that require two keys (Vault and Dice Room) only require one bomb to open.

• Mega Chests require multiple explosions in order to be opened, just as when using keys.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Challenge rooms, arcades and Mega Satan door can be opened with bombs. Allows to open boss rooms with bombs as well if Isaac has both Golden Trinket and Mom's Box.

• Notched Axe: Allows the Notched Axe to open locked chests and doors. The opening of chests does not use durability; however, when opening locked doors, only every other door does not use durability for the first four doors opened on the current floor. If Isaac uses the axe's durability or puts away the axe, the other door uses durability to open.

Broken Shovel.title: Broken Shovel
Broken Shovel.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Broken Shovel is a name shared by two separate items added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †.

Together they form Mom's Shovel, which is used in the process to unlock The Forgotten.

sections.heading: Activated Collectible
sections.text:
The first piece of the Broken Shovel is an activated item. It is acquired by defeating the first floor boss in under a minute (both bosses if [cu: Labyrinth] is in effect), navigating back to the starting room, and bombing the floor. The Lamb must have been defeated at least once with any character for the bomb explosion to reveal Broken Shovel. After having defeated the boss below the 1 minute cutoff, using the Sacrifice Room for the first time on that floor while having no Bombs will always reward Isaac with one rather than its normal payout.

It is the first part required to create Mom's Shovel.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While held, 1–2 Mom's feet will stomp randomly every few seconds, targeting Isaac. They will try to stomp Isaac's current position, so they will always miss if he is constantly moving. Each stomp deals a full Heart of damage.

• [Repentance] The stomps will not blow up Slot Machines or kill Beggars. They will still destroy Shopkeepers, open Bomb Chests, break Obstacles, and open doors.

• Upon activation, stomps will pause until entering another room.

• If used during the Boss Rush or in a Challenge Room / Boss Challenge Room, stomping will be paused for that wave of enemies only.

• The item's stomps cease while battling Mom.

• While held, removes the twenty-minute time limit on the Boss Rush door; the entrance to the next floor will be sealed until Boss Rush is completed (including those created by We Need To Go Deeper! and other methods).

• If the Boss Rush is left prematurely through any means after starting it, entering it again will immediately restart Boss Rush, even without picking up another item.

• Prevents The Polaroid from appearing after defeating Mom. Only The Negative will appear after the boss fight. After completing Boss Rush, Isaac is likewise forced to travel down to Sheol.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Mom's foot will still target Isaac even if he has the Punching Bag or Lost Fly.

• It is impossible to obtain Broken Shovel during a RERUN.

• The Broken Shovel will disappear if left behind in a room. Leaving and re-entering a room with it left on a pedestal will cause it to disappear. If the Shovel has been knocked down but not touched, it will remain in the room.

• The knocked down Shovel will work as a pickup and can be duplicated, rerolled or turned into a fly.

• [Repentance] Though it is possible to obtain the Broken Shovel during a Victory Lap, The Forgotten cannot be unlocked during a Victory Lap.

• [Repentance] While either of Jacob and Esau holds this item, the feet will only target the brother who is holding it. The feet will still damage both of them. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Regardless of which character holds the item, feet will target both Tainted Lazarus' forms. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Mama Mega!'s explosion will knock the Broken Shovel down.

• Myosotis may spawn Broken Shovel on the next floor when knocked down but not taken.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Creates a tiny ghost wisp on the middle ring, which resembles The Soul. These wisps' tears have a 10% chance of invoking II - The High Priestess on enemies.

• Car Battery: Prevents all stomping from occurring for two waves of a Boss Rush or Challenge Room / Boss Challenge Room. As each wave of Boss Rush restores 2 charges, this allows Isaac to be free from stomping for its entire duration.

• If used in a normal room, the effect does not carry over to the next room.

• Moving Box: Can be used to pick up the Broken Shovel without causing Mom's Foot to stomp down at all.

sections.heading: Tips for Obtaining
sections.text:
• Characters with good starting stats such as Cain, Judas, or Azazel are excellent for blazing through the first floor with time to spare.

• [Repentance] Tainted Magdalene ability to rapidly regenerate health in almost any circumstance makes this challenge much easier, and due to how Tainted Magdalene is played, the constant i-frames generated through hugging enemies is useful for negating the full heart damage from the stomps, the stomps also acting as extra damage when fighting bosses. [end edition note] 

• Avoid wasting time for pickups, items, or any unnecessary rooms while progressing to the Boss Room. They can be returned to after clearing the rest of the floor and killing the boss.

• There is no time limit on claiming the shovel, as long as the floor boss was killed within the time limit. Obtaining it can wait until Isaac is ready to move on to the next floor.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Look for items such as Host Hat to negate the stomp damage, or for damage/tear-increasing items to kill enemies quicker; conversely, when running into a mini-boss, getting [cu: Maze] or [cu: Labyrinth] , or encountering poor floor generation such as multiple large rooms and dead ends, restarting may be a better choice.

• [Repentance] Stomp damage can no longer be negated.

• If the criteria for Broken Shovel to appear are not met and there is ambiguity as to whether it is obtainable, look for a large, faint shadow of the shovel covering the starting room; if it is not there, the Shovel cannot be obtained.

• A legitimate strategy may be restarting repeatedly until one gets a godlike item, such as Tech X, The Ludovico Technique (as Azazel), or other personally preferred Quality 4s in the first room, since it really isn't very possible to think up a sufficient build on the fly as you have to focus on dodging Mom at all times.

sections.heading: Passive Collectible
sections.text: The second Broken Shovel piece can be acquired by completing Boss Rush while holding the first half of Broken Shovel.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Replaces the Broken Shovel active item with Mom's Shovel, ceasing the stomps from Mom's feet.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The first Broken Shovel piece has to be in the active item slot when the second piece is picked up in order to obtain Mom's Shovel. If the second piece is picked up without the first piece, it will be added as a passive item and won't become Mom's Shovel even if the first piece is picked up afterward.

• [Repentance] If either of Jacob and Esau holds the first Broken Shovel piece, that same brother must pick up the second piece. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Regardless of which Tainted Lazarus form holds the first Broken Shovel piece, the form that picks up the second piece will receive Mom's Shovel, and the first piece will be removed. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Tips for Obtaining
sections.text:
• Make sure to keep moving; stopping for even a few seconds will increase the chance a foot hits Isaac.

• Items that give flight are even more helpful than usual as Isaac will not need to worry about navigating around obstacles to avoid a stomp. Any means of temporary (or even permanent) invulnerability has obvious merit as well.

• If an active item is offered in Boss Rush, it can be held for the duration of the fight; however, the Broken Shovel must be picked up before the last wave ends for the second half of Broken Shovel to appear.

• If There's Options is held and Boss Rush is completed, an additional pedestal item will appear. Be careful not to pick up this other item, as doing so will cause Broken Shovel to disappear.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Forgotten, Bone Heart]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Broken Shovels were added in Booster Pack#5, after the initial release of the DLC.

• The Broken Shovels, Dogma, The Polaroid and The Negative are the only Quest Items to not be Quality 0.

Broken Watch.title: Broken Watch
Broken Watch.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the broken watch; the normal version of this item; Stop Watch]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Every 4th newly discovered room, slows all enemies and their attacks down to half their normal speed, but has a ~13% chance of speeding them up by 40% instead.

• The effect is lost upon leaving the room, and not gained again if re-entering it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The effect is lost upon exiting and continuing the run. This can be used when the speed up chance is hit when fighting a Boss.

• [Before Repentance] Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.

• The player can abuse the Broken Watch to have the Broken Stopwatch trigger during any difficult boss fight by making sure that the fight is the fourth room since the last time the effect activated.

• For example, if the third undiscovered room was the Mom boss fight, Boss Rush will be the fourth undiscovered room, resulting in it being slowed down. This necessitates skipping the Devil Room or Angel Room, however.

• To trigger the effects of Broken Watch during the The Beast fight and do not have either the Red Key or a Cracked Key, you have to clear 1 room after the effect has activated, then explore every room in Home. Otherwise, after the effect has activated in a room, immediately go to Home and explore every room. [end edition note] 

• There is also the 13% risk of the room being sped up, so this strategy can rarely backfire.

• If the slow effect triggers when entering The Boss Rush or The Beast boss area, it will be active for the entire Boss Rush/all four Horsemen and the Beast. This is also true of the speed effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Glowing Hourglass: The Glowing Hourglass does not reset the entered room counter: using it in a room where the Broken Watch is active and immediately returning without visiting other new rooms will not trigger the effect again.

• Lil Clot / Sumptorium / Tainted Eve: Clots are moving and firing at normal speeds when a room is sped up. This can be extra hurtful as Tainted Eve, since the clots will not move in sync with her.

• [Rebirth only] Stop Watch: Overrides Broken Watch; the speed-up effect will not occur.

• [Afterbirth onward] Both the slow effect and the rarer speed up can trigger at the start of a room.

• • [Before Repentance] This results in enemies being slowed to around 71.8% of their original speed.

• • [Repentance] This results in enemies being sped up by 12%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Stop Watch is the repaired version of this item, and thus functions differently.

• When the slow effect is activated, the background music is also slowed down to 70% of the original speed of the music.

• When the speed effect is activated, the background music is sped up by x1.428571428 (Or 1 3/7).

sections.heading: Synergies

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns brown wisps on the middle ring. These wisps shoot 3 times faster with 1/3rd of the damage of an average wisp. The wisps automatically shoot at nearby enemies instead of in the direction Isaac shoots. The wisps do not persist between rooms.

Brownie.title: Brownie
Brownie.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Brownie is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth that can appear in all environments of chapter 3 (Depths, Necropolis, Dank Depths).

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
Brownie remains stationary and performs the following attacks:

• Each time Brownie takes enough damage, he spawns a single Brownie Corn; if Brownie takes a lot of damage in a single instance, the Brownie Corns are spawned together in a group.

• Occasionally spawns a group 5-8 Brownie Corns upon taking damage.

• While moving during some attacks, he crushes any Brownie Corns in his path, regaining 3 HP for each.

• Farts, pushing away Isaac and knocking back any Brownie Corns if they are too close.

• Spins a short distance across the room, bouncing off walls and finishing with a fart.

• Sometimes leaves slippery brown creep and a Corn Mine in his path.

• Slides across the room, bouncing off walls, while leaving a trail of slippery Brown Creep, continuously spawning Corn Mines, and occasionally shooting corny projectiles towards Isaac. Finishes this attack with a fart.

• The Corn Mines' corn projectiles and gas can damage and poison Brownie. While poisoned, he leaves damaging green creep instead of Brown Creep.

• Twirls and jumps 4-6 times around the room, creating a puddle of Brown Creep every time he lands and tossing corny projectiles in random directions.

• Brownie can sometimes directly chain into this attack from his spinning and sliding attacks instead of finishing them with farts.
Brownie's expression when idle changes as he gets damaged by Isaac – going from happy to grumpy. This appears to have a correlation with how aggressive he is in performing attacks, chaining attacks, and how many corny projectiles are released in his attacks.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text: • When Brownie reaches around 25% health, he degrades into a 75 HP Dangle that behaves regularly.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text: [bc: 18] : Spawns up to 3 Chargers at once instead of Brownie Corns and creates black creep instead of Brown Creep. The Corn Mines that he spawns ( [Before Repentance] and his corny projectiles) are also black. Brownie still leaves Green Creep when poisoned. When at low health, he becomes 2 Dank Squirts instead of a weakened Dangle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Brownie may be paired along with regular Dips in a Boss Room.

• If a Butt Bombs Bomb goes off in the same room as Brownie, it heals him.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Butt Bombs effect on Dr. Fetus or Epic Fetus does not heal Brownie.

• [Repentance] The skeleton version of Tainted Forgotten in the Hot Potato challenge does heal Brownie. Thus, butt bombs should be skipped to avoid a potential softlock.

• Flush! kills Brownie instantly and causes him to leave behind 6 Brownie Corns.

• If Brownie is inflicted by any status effect, he leaves a creep with that same effect (e.g. Spider Bite gives him white creep if he's affected).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Brownie is the name of a character and boss in Super Meat Boy, a game by Edmund McMillen (the creator of The Binding of Isaac).

• In the versus screen, there is a smiling face next to Brownie's name.

• The Black Champion version of Brownie acts slightly similar to the Dank Squirt and may, therefore, be a "dank" or meconium version of Brownie.

• During the DLC's release, the Black Champion version of Brownie was able to spawn up to 11 Drowned Chargers at once instead of regular Chargers, at a higher rate. It was nerfed in an update shortly after since the damage from the large amounts of Drowned Chargers was unavoidable.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Brownie can be found in The Void, even before being unlocked. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Brownie was given a "voice" in Repentance which he shares with Clog. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Bug
sections.text: Bug note: Rarely, Brownie will slide around the room incredibly quickly, resulting in unavoidable damage.

Buddy in a Box.title: Buddy in a Box
Buddy in a Box.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a familiar with random tear effects, fire rate, and damage.

• The familiar's damage scales from ~2-6, and tear delay scales from ~12-30.

• The familiar takes the appearance of a random co-op baby.

• The familiar is randomized upon entering a new floor.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Each familiar has 50% chance to have tear effects. If it has tear effects, its tears always have one guaranteed effect and 1 effect with a chance.

• The guaranteed effects are: 

• The effects with a chance are: 

• The familiar's tear appearance isn't linked to the normal effect such tears would have.

• For instance, piercing-looking tears might not go through enemies and Sinus Infection tears might not stick, while tears that do not look like Compound Fracture tears can still split on hit.

• Some tear effects like Proptosis and Tiny Planet do not have their associated stat boosts and thus are very ineffective.

• Familiars will not do contact damage.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Buddy in a Box having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

sections.heading: Interactions

sections.heading: Trivia

Spindown Dice.title: Spindown Dice
Spindown Dice.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Rerolls all pedestal items in a room by decreasing their internal ID number by one until a valid item is rolled. This effect occurs per item and is independent of any other items in the room.

• Unlockable items will be skipped if they are not unlocked.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• A list of items sorted by item ID can be found here (helpful for finding Spindown targets at a glance.)

• Hidden items will always be skipped, including:

• Recall

• Hold

• The passive version of Damocles created by usage of Damocles (the one with item ID "656").

• The passive version of The Book of Belial created by Birthright effect of Judas / Black Judas (the one with item ID "59").

• Items created by using Spindown Dice are not considered "normally generated" and can be encountered again in their normal pools if they were not picked up.

• Spindown Dice ignores all effects that prevent certain items from spawning, such as through item quality thresholds (e.g. Sacred Orb), Item Tags or other effects such as from NO!.

• This makes the item especially valuable for Tainted Lost, as many helpful items cannot naturally spawn for him otherwise.

• If used in a Challenge or Daily Challenge, Spindown Dice will skip over items with the "nochallenge" and "nodaily" tags, respectively.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A spindown die is a type of die used as a life counter for Magic: The Gathering or for various other uses across card and board games. It is a D20 with the numbers laid out in a sequential pattern, to allow for the face-up number to be changed easily when a player's life goes up or down.

• The item's color scheme matches the D8 die included in The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls card game, which is used as a spindown die to keep track of an enemy's health.

• Spindown Dice is the only dice item that cannot be copied by the D infinity.

• It is arguable that Spindown Dice is not necessarily a dice item, since its effect does not involve random generation.

• Spindown Dice itself will be rerolled into Anima Sola, while Hypercoagulation rerolls into it.

• Using Spindown Dice on Smart Fly rerolls into Clear Rune, which is the only Repentance added item to reroll from a Rebirth one. This is due to the item taking up a previously unused item id.

• Two items are impossible to obtain with Spindown Dice:

• Mom's Ring, as it has the highest ID of all items (without mods taking a higher number, etc).

• Strawman, due to Dad's Note having immunity to being rerolled.

• • Even with Car Battery, Sausage will still spin down into Dad's Note

• Defeating Delirium as most tainted characters will unlock an item that is similar to their gameplay characteristic. However, Tainted Isaac's passive ability to have multiple items cycle on an item pedestal (Glitched Crown) is unlocked through defeating The Beast instead.

fields.description: Reduces the internal ID number of all items in the room by one, turning them into the item with that number.

Spirit Shackles.title: Spirit Shackles
Spirit Shackles.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling The Soul, with half a heart. The ghost has flight, spectral tears, and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.

• Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.

• After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When the effect is ready, the chains on Isaac's costume are light blue. When they are drained and cannot protect from death, they are grey.

• The Soul form functions near identically to when playing as the The Forgotten.

• If Isaac has any red heart containers, the ghost form will always spawn with half a red heart. If he has no heart containers, he will always spawn with half a Soul Heart.

• The Forgotten will spawn with an empty Bone Heart.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper will spawn with one coin heart container.

• Recharging Soul Shackles will always consume a full Soul Heart if possible, even though a half Soul Heart can still charge the item.

• Blended Hearts will only recharge the item if the Blended Heart would give Isaac soul health.

• Items that add Soul/Black Hearts directly to Isaac’s health (Rosary, Guppy's Paw, Satanic Bible etc.) will recharge Spirit Shackles and give one less Soul Heart. 

• Spirit Shackles can be recharged by picking up Soul Hearts while in the ghostly form, but it cannot re-activate until its effect ends.

• If Isaac leaves the room while in ghost form, he will not be chained to anything and can move freely. He will also come back to life at his current location rather than where his body was left.

• Isaac can be trapped if he's in the middle of a pile of rocks when this happens. This can be fixed by quitting, then continuing the run.

• Spirit Shackles is not considered a respawn item as Isaac does not actually "die", and will activate prior to all other respawn effects.

• If Isaac dies while in ghost form and is brought back to life by a respawn item, he will respawn, unshackled, in ghost form for the remainder of the duration.

• Spirit Shackles cannot activate in the Mirrored World, nor can the ghost form given by it be used to enter the Mirrored World.

• Spirit Shackles will trigger if a fatal Devil Deal is taken.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Found Soul: Spirit Shackles activates for Found Soul, functioning as normal. However, it cannot be recharged, and can only be activated again after Found Soul dies and respawns.

• The Lost: Effectively acts as a rechargeable extra life, granting additional defensive measures on top of his inherent Holy Mantle and granting a use to normally useless Soul Hearts.

• Magic Skin: When all hearts are converted to Broken Hearts, Isaac will be revived with half a soul heart, allowing many more uses with low health.

• Scapular: Can activate at the same time. When this happens, the soul heart granted by Scapular will immediately charge Spirit Shackles.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Ankh / Broken Ankh / Judas' Shadow: Soul hearts given on respawn cannot recharge Spirit Shackles.

• Bethany: Soul charges cannot be used to recharge Spirit Shackles. Picking up soul hearts recharges it as normal.

• Damocles / Plan C / Suicide King: Ignores Spirit Shackles and fully kills Isaac.

• The Forgotten: Spirit Shackles can activate for both characters. They can toggle between The Forgotten and The Soul as normal while it's active, and the form that didn't "die" will have their normal health. Toggling from The Forgotten to The Soul will also create another body of The Forgotten that The Soul will be chained to in addition to the original body.

• Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: The character that has Spirit Shackles must die for it to activate; if the other character dies, it will not activate. Only the character that has Spirit Shackles can recharge it.

• In the case of Jacob and Esau, the brother that has Spirit Shackles will be chained to their dead body, while the one that doesn't can move freely. If either brother dies while Spirit Shackles is active, the other dies with them as normal.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: As Hearts cannot spawn or be collected, Spirit Shackles can only be recharged from effects that add Soul Hearts to health directly.

• Tainted Forgotten: The ghost will spawn from Tainted Forgotten instead of Tainted Soul; it will be invulnerable, unable to move, and use the bone club instead of Tainted Forgotten. It can also be thrown, but will rapidly return to Tainted Forgotten due to being chained to them. Tainted Soul is unaffected, and can take damage as normal.

• Tainted Jacob: will not activate during Lost Form, or when killed by Dark Esau.

fields.description: On taking fatal damage, instead of dying, Isaac's ghost is chained to his dead body, and he can continue to fight with 1/2 of a heart, returning to life after 10 seconds. After it activates, it must be recharged by gaining a Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source.

Spirit Sword.title: Spirit Sword
Spirit Sword.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Replaces Isaac's tears with a sword he can swing in front of him.

• The swing does 3x Isaac's damage +3.5 and deals knockback to both enemies and Isaac if it hits.

• The sword can be swung as rapidly as the fire button can be tapped.

• The sword swing can collect pickups and open chests.

• If Isaac's total health is equal to or greater than his number of Red Heart (same rule as regular Challenge Rooms), the sword fires a projectile when swung.

• The projectile deals damage equal to Isaac's damage +2, and has a cooldown equal to 2x Isaac's normal tear rate.

• Holding an attack button charges a spin attack, ready when the sword flashes, which damages all enemies around Isaac. It also deflects enemy projectiles, which can damage enemies who get hit, and launches a projectile with higher shot speed regardless of Isaac's current health.

• The circular swing deals 8x Isaac's damage +10, and the projectile created from it deals 4x Isaac's damage +4. It can also collect pickups and open chests.

• The charge time is based on Isaac's tears stat, at ~4x Isaac's normal tear rate.

• While charging, the sword will damage the first enemy that contacts it. This will cancel the spin attack.

• Swinging the sword normally while performing the circular swing cancels it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Unlike most charge attacks, the direction of the attack can't be changed by pressing and holding a different attack button then releasing the old one. Instead, it will stay pointing the same direction until all attack buttons are released, either doing nothing or using the spin attack, or the sword touches and damages an enemy, dealing sword slash damage.

• Spirit Sword can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.

• Range upgrades move the hitbox of the sword forwards, including the spin attack. Enough range upgrades can leave a large blind spot directly in front of the sword.

• Only the projectile and spin attack are affected by tear rate, not the normal sword swing, meaning that items that increase damage but decrease tear rate, such as Polyphemus and Eve's Mascara, are much more effective when only using the swing. Additionally, items that do the inverse, such as Soy Milk and Almond Milk; are not as effective when only using the swing.

• Spirit Sword will deflect Mother's Fistula attack and will send it right back at her, entering a short sequence that allows to deal bonus damage, if executed correctly; see this page for more details.

• Spirit Sword is overridden by the Blindfolded effect, as seen while playing as Lilith or in challenges like Cat Got Your Tongue.

• Having 30 or more tear rate performs the swing attack automatically.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20/Keeper/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider/Conjoined: Isaac spins one additional time for each extra tear, firing extra projectiles on each spin. No effect on the normal swing.

• Cain's Other Eye: The eye holds its own sword that slashes in random directions whenever Isaac attacks.

• C Section: C Section has priority. Fetuses hold small swords and perform the charged spin attack as they travel.

• Cricket's Body: The fired projectile will burst into multiple swords.

• Decap Attack: The body holds the sword while the head will only block projectiles.

• Euthanasia: Each swing of the sword has a chance to do 3x damage and instantly kill a non-boss enemy, causing a tear explosion.

• Evil Eye: The fired eyes swing a miniature Sword instead of tears.

• Eye Sore: Random chance to swing extra swords in random directions.

• Haemolacria: Sword becomes larger. The projectile is now fired in an arc and splits on collision with enemies and obstacles.

• Haemolacria + Brimstone: Arcing sword beams burst into Brimstone lasers in random directions.

• Holy Light: Both the sword swing and the projectile can trigger Holy Light.

• Homing tears (e.g. Spoon Bender): The projectile will be homing.

• Isaac's Tears: The item fires normal tears but can be charged as fast as the sword can be swung. Doing a spin attack will fully charge Isaac's Tears.

• Lachryphagy: The fired projectiles will combine and split.

• Loki's Horns: Random chance upon swinging to have a sword in all 4 cardinal directions. Performing a spin attack when this occurs results in a 4-way spin.

• Lost Contact: Sword swings reflect projectiles.

• Maw Of The Void: An additional ring will appear upon fully charging it. Spin is delayed by a bit.

• Mom's Eye: An additional sword is added to Isaac's back, and can be swung as normal.

• Mom's Knife: When doing the spin attack, Isaac throws the sword a short distance, which spins as it travels.

• Mom's Knife + Technology: A technology laser connects Isaac and the sword while it's being thrown.

• Mom's Knife + Brimstone: Launches a barrage of knives from Isaac's mouth after doing the spin attack.

• Mom's Knife + Tech X: Full charge launches a sword surrounded by Tech X that swings back to Isaac.

• My Reflection: The fired projectile will return to Isaac.

• Pointy Rib/Finger!: When doing a spin attack, the familiar will spin with the sword.

• Polyphemus: The sword and fired projectile become gigantic. Charge time is increased, but swing rate remains the same. Swings will also shake the screen.

• Proptosis: The swing attack deals 9x Isaac's damage instead of 3x. Fired projectiles behave as expected.

• Rubber Cement: The fired projectile bounces.

• Technology: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.

• Technology 2: Laser fires when the sword is being swung or charged.

• Trisagion: The fired projectile is a Trisagion blast.

• The Wiz: Beams and sword swings are fired straight instead of diagonally. Isaac spins an additional time on a charged attack.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
Overridden by Spirit Sword:

• Brimstone

• Cursed Eye

• Dr. Fetus

• Epic Fetus

• Kidney Stone

• The Ludovico Technique

• Monstro's Lung

• Neptunus

Other interactions:

• Anti-Gravity: Sword beams are affected normally by Anti-Gravity. Regular sword swipes are unaffected, but spin attacks freeze for a short time before firing.

• Blood Clot/Chemical Peel: Sword swing has a 50% chance to become red and deal increased damage.

• Chocolate Milk: Increased knockback when fully charged, no effect on the regular sword swings.

• Death's Touch: Visual effect overridden by Spirit Sword including the ranged attack.

• Explosivo: The sword swing has a chance to stick Explosivo shots to enemies it hits. The beam can stick to enemies and explode.

• Eye of the Occult: The projectile can be controlled.

• Fire Mind: Sword strikes and beams can burn enemies, and beams have a chance to explode.

• The Forgotten: Spirit Sword will only work with The Soul, no changes to The Forgotten.

• Gello/Tainted Lilith: The sword is held by the fetus.

• Godhead: The fired projectile receives Godhead effects. No effect on the swing aside from stat changes.

• Incubus: Incubus tears are replaced with a sword, identical to Isaac.

• Ipecac: Sword beams are exploding shots that deal Isaac's damage. Does not apply Ipecac's +40 damage modifier to beams or sword swings.

• Jacob's Ladder: Both the sword shots and sword swings create electricity.

• Jacob and Esau: Knockback from the sword will separate the brother carrying the sword from the other.

• Marked/Tractor Beam: Overridden by Spirit Sword. Stat upgrades still apply.

• Mysterious Liquid: The charged sword attack spawns creep, the projectiles do not / [dlc_: r+] projectiles spawn creep as well.

• Parasitoid: The sword projectiles can still spawn flies and spiders, but the swings themselves won't / [Repentance+] the swings can now leave slowing creep and spawn flies and spiders.

• Playdough Cookie: Every sword swing gains a different color and effect based on that color.

• Pupula Duplex: No effect.

• Sinus Infection: The sword swing has a chance to stick boogers to enemies it hits. The beam can stick to enemies.

• Sulfur: Overridden by Spirit Sword. Damage up on second and subsequent uses while in the same room still applies.

• Tainted Forgotten: No effect.

• Tech.5: Fires as normal while charging and swinging the sword.

• Technology Zero: Sword shots are connected with electricity, swings are unaffected.

• Terra/Sulfuric Acid: Only the sword's beams can destroy rocks.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Spirit Sword is from the Antibirth mod. It was available from the start.

• The item's name is a reference to the Sword of the Spirit, one of the many armaments that make up the Armor of God. This is further supported by the fact that it is an Angel Room item.

• The function of this item mimics the Swords in many The Legend of Zelda games, particularly those that play top-to-bottom, such as A Link to the Past.

• The sword's name is likely an homage to the Master Sword, which first appeared in A Link to the Past.

• The sword becoming a lightsaber when combined with Technology is a reference to Star Wars.

• This item is used in Isaac's Awakening.

• Spirit Sword is the only item in the game that can override Epic Fetus.

• Although this item is normally only available in the Angel Room, it can be found as one of the Nintendo-themed Treasure Room items in the 6th of December's Daily Run, which is an homage to the late CEO of Nintendo, Satoru Iwata.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: When reaching 30.00 Tear Rate or higher, Spirit Sword will continuously use the spin attack, only stopped by holding down a fire key. This is likely due to the fact that starting at 30.00 Tear Rate, the internal number is "0", and begins to go negative beyond that.
Bug note: In waterlogged rooms, the reflection of the sword swings in the opposite direction of the actual sword, when it should swing in the same direction.

fields.description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart.

Spirit of the Night.title: Spirit of the Night
Spirit of the Night.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Notes

Spitty.title: Spitty
Spitty.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Spitties are maggot-like monsters introduced in the vanilla content of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth, and can be only encountered in Chapter 2.

They are much fatter than other maggot forms, possess a face like Chargers, but have only half health of a Charger. They spit a blood shot ahead of them while slowly crawling along aimlessly. They have a slow firing rate, and because they ignore Isaac, their shots are easy to avoid.

They also can be summoned by other monsters and bosses, such as the Grub, Pestilence, and Chub's orange champion variant.

[Before Repentance] Oddly enough, they do one full heart of contact damage, despite Chargers and even Conjoined Spitties doing half heart damage.

sections.heading: Conjoined Spitty
sections.text: Conjoined Spitties are very similar to Spitties, but they have 80% more health and have 2 heads, 1 added on the back of its body, so they shoot forward and backward simultaneously.

sections.heading: Tainted Spitty
sections.text:
Tainted Spitties are exclusive to the Ascent to Home. They are much larger and tankier versions of regular Spitties that also move and spit faster.

They shoot blood shots out of their backs and occasionally spit out a line full of shots. Upon death, they shoot out a ring of blood shots.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Spitties first appear in the original Binding of Isaac.

• Oddly enough, Spitties were misspelled as "spities" in the ending credits.

• Tainted Spitties bear striking resemblance to the second phase of Rotgut, named Gus.

Spoon Bender.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects

sections.heading: Notes

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Spoon Bender it turns into a purple locust that homes in on enemies while it is charging forward.

• Aquarius: Trail of creep is purple and homes in on enemies.

• Azazel / Brimstone / Tainted Azazel / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X: Beams curve toward enemies.

• Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Tears and split tears are homing.

• Dr. Fetus: The bombs slide towards enemies.

• Marked: Tears will travel in the direction of the cross-hairs until close enough to home in on an enemy.

• Mom's Knife: The knife curves towards enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Tears can track enemies while frozen in place, once one comes close enough.

• Epic Fetus: Cursor slides towards enemies.

• Eye of the Occult: Tears home in on enemies when not being maneuvered.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear will attempt to home towards a single target, even if it hits a different enemy on its way there, making it difficult to control.

• [Repentance] The changes to homing tears make it nearly impossible to maintain control of the shot while it's near an enemy.

• Technology Zero: The electricity is unaffected.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Baby-Bender]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Edmund McMillen has stated in his first post-Repentance Isaac Lore Stream that Spoon Bender is directly inspired by the stage magic of illusionist Uri Geller, more specifically the act of 'spoon bending' which was one of Geller's trademark tricks.

• McMillen describes Geller as a 'scam artist', so it can be gathered that this reference was not born out of appreciation.

• Spoon Bender may also be a reference to The Matrix.

• This item is used in Computer Savvy.

• According to a Twitter post from Tyrone Rodriguez, the Brimstone + Spoon Bender synergy was modeled after the Plasma Laser, first introduced in the video game Raiden II.

• [Repentance] Isaac's new appearance with Spoon Bender now bears more resemblance to Psychic Horfs and Psychic Maws.

• It also resembles Isaac's sprite from the original game.
