Sprinkler.title: Sprinkler
Sprinkler.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Upon use, creates a stationary sprinkler that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Sprinkler's rate of fire and rotation speed depends on Isaac's tears stat.

• Sprinkler does not do contact damage.

• It is counted as an obstacle and will block some enemies movement, e.g.: Chub.

sections.heading: No Effect
sections.text: The following tear effects do not apply to/are not copied by Sprinklers, although direct stat changes are applied (probably not exhaustive; needs testing):

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: The sprinkler fires multiple tears simultaneously.

• Anti-Gravity: Sprinkler tears are affected only while Isaac is firing, and are released at the same time Isaac releases the fire button.

• Baby-Bender: The sprinkler will shoot homing tears.

• Blood Clot / Chemical Peel: The sprinkler will fire either normal tears or tears with the items' effects depending on which tear Isaac fired last.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns spinning eyeball wisps on the middle ring. The wisps fire 3 times faster than average, and fire in a spiral pattern similar to Sprinkler.

• Brimstone/Azazel: The sprinkler fires somewhat short-ranged Brimstone lasers instead of tears.

• Camo Undies: Isaac stays camouflaged after placing the sprinkler.

• Car Battery: Spawns two sprinklers on top of each other.

• Chocolate Milk: The size and damage of the sprinkler's tears depend on Isaac's current charge amount.

• Dead Eye: Sprinklers increase the damage multiplier when hitting an enemy, and do not reduce it when they miss.

• Kidney Stone: Sprinklers will fire a barrage of tears whenever Isaac does, but will not fire the stone.

• Lead Pencil: Sprinkler tears count for activation of the Lead Pencil effect. The tear burst may fire from the sprinkler or Isaac.

• Loki's Horns: The sprinkler has four eyes and simultaneously fires tears in four directions.

• Mom's Eye: The sprinkler has two eyes and simultaneously fires tears forwards and backward.

• Mom's Knife: The sprinkler fires knives instead of tears. The knives fire straight outwards, deal [Before Repentance] double / [Repentance] 1.5x Isaac's tear damage and do not return.

• [Repentance] Mom's Knife + BFFS! The knives deal triple Isaac's tear damage.

• Monstro's Lung: The sprinkler fires disorganized clusters of tears.

• Star of Bethlehem: When Isaac is in the aura, the Sprinkler will rotate faster and its tears will be affected by the Star of Bethlehem. The Sprinkler does not need to be in the aura for this to work, just Isaac.

• Tech X: The sprinkler fires laser rings that are smaller than the central spark and have a correspondingly small hit area, which deal 100% of Isaac's damage.

• Technology: The sprinkler fires lasers instead of tears.

• Tiny Planet: Tears will travel toward and orbit Isaac, wherever he is in the room.

• Tractor Beam: The sprinkler's tears will not fire from the sprinkler itself, and will simply appear within the beam.

• Trisagion: Sprinklers will shoot beams.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Sprinkler increases in size but does not do extra damage.

• Dr. Fetus: The sprinkler fires bombs which can damage Isaac.

• Epic Fetus: The sprinkler fires crosshairs; missiles will strike the crosshairs after a short delay. This can damage Isaac.

• Eye of the Occult: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.

• Ipecac: The sprinkler fires explosive shots which can damage Isaac.

• Ipecac + Dr. Fetus: The bombs fired by the sprinkler will not damage Isaac.

• The Ludovico Technique / Spirit Sword: The sprinkler will not fire tears at all.

• My Reflection: Tears fired from the sprinkler will boomerang towards Isaac instead of the sprinkler.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Sprinkler is based on this Steam Workshop item by Kieran and Stewartisme.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When switching to another active item via Schoolbag, sprinklers in the room will disappear.

fields.description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

Stage HP.title: Stage HP
Stage HP.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stage HP is a feature of some enemies, granting them extra health the higher the stage number they're encountered in is.

sections.heading: Calculation
sections.text:
The formula for an enemy's total health (HP) is

\mathit{HP} = \mathit{Base HP} + \left(\mathrm{min}(4, \mathit{Stage}) + 0.8 \times \mathrm{bound}(0, \mathit{Stage} - 5, 5)\right) \times \mathit{Stage HP}

where Base HP and Stage HP are the defined HP values for the given enemy and displayed in the enemies' pages, Stage is the current stage number as defined internally by the game, and min and bound are functions that take the smaller of two values or bound the middle value between the two others, respectively.

In practice, this means that the enemy gains Stage HP extra health for the first 4 stages, gains nothing for stage 5, and then 4/5ths of Stage HP for each stage up to stage 10, after which their health stops increasing.

Chapters map to stage numbers as follows:

| Stage number | Normal Mode | [Afterbirth onward] Greed Mode 
| 1 | Basement / Cellar / Burning Basement / Downpour / Dross I | Basement / Cellar / Burning Basement

| 2 | Basement / Cellar / Burning Basement / Downpour / Dross II | Caves / Catacombs / Flooded Caves

| 3 | Caves / Catacombs / Flooded Caves / Mines / Ashpit I | Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths

| 4 | Caves / Catacombs / Flooded Caves / Mines / Ashpit II | Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb

| 5 | Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths / Mausoleum / Gehenna I | Sheol

| 6 | Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths / Mausoleum / Gehenna II | The Shop

| 7 | Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb / Corpse I | Ultra Greed

| 8 | Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb / Corpse II | -

| 9 | ??? | -

| 10 | Cathedral / Sheol | -

| 11 | Chest / Dark Room | -

| 12 | The Void | -

| 13 | Home | -

sections.heading: Example
sections.text:
Consider a Dip with 3 base HP and 1 stage HP.

• Basement I, i.e. stage 1: HP = 3 + (min(4, 1) + 0.8 × bound(0, 1 - 5, 5)) × 1 = 3 + (1 + 0.8 × 0) × 1 = 4

• Womb II, i.e. stage 8: HP = 3 + (min(4, 8) + 0.8 × bound(0, 8 - 5, 5)) × 1 = 3 + (4 + 0.8 × 3) × 1 = 9.4

• The Void, i.e. stage 12: HP = 3 + (min(4, 12) + 0.8 × bound(0, 12 - 5, 5)) × 1 = 3 + (4 + 0.8 × 5) × 1 = 11

Star of Bethlehem.title: Star of Bethlehem
Star of Bethlehem.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Eden's Soul]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels toward the Boss Room, fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.

• The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a [Before Repentance+] 1.8× / [Repentance+] 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5× fire rate multiplier, and homing tears. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to Cone Head's effect except with a higher chance.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• In The Void, the familiar will travel to the boss room that contains Delirium.

• In Greed Mode, the star will travel directly to the position where Isaac spawns upon entering a new floor.

• On the last floor, it will move to the upper part of Ultra Greed's room.

• Once the star settles down in the boss room, the damage preventing aura can be used to play Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars for free, provided they are spawned via XIV - Temperance or XX - Judgement cards, respectively.

• The star may travel through Secret Rooms and Curse Rooms on its path to the boss room.

• The star will travel through Red Rooms if they create an optimal path to the boss room.

• The star can backtrack into rooms it already went into if a more optimal path is created by a Red Room.

• During the Ascent, the star will linger in the boss room of each floor, and will not progress backwards through the stage.

• The star will travel through the hole to the Mother fight and be present in the fight. It will be centered on the top half of the room, and will not move when the arena expands.

• The star will be present against Dogma, but does not follow for The Beast.

• If the door to Mega Satan is opened, the Star of Bethlehem will enter it instead of the boss room containing ??? or The Lamb.

• The Star will move backwards towards Mega Satan's door if the door is opened later during the floor (such as by using Dad's Key).

• For Tainted Forgotten, the bonuses from the star are only applied if Tainted Forgotten is within its aura, not Tainted Soul.

• If either Tainted Lazarus or Dead Tainted Lazarus have picked up the star, the familiar will spawn in the room where the character holding it becomes active, which may not be the starting room. It will only move while the character holding it is active, effectively making it take twice as long to travel to the boss room unless Tainted Lazarus also has Birthright.

• During Backasswards, the star acts as usual; originating in the starting room and gradually moving towards the boss room.

• The star will be copied in the Mirrored World and will simultaneously travel in both worlds.

• Entering and leaving the Knife Piece 2 area will reset the star and make it reappear in the room with the minecart.

• The star exhibits a "rubber banding" effect in its movement. If it is in a room that is closer to the Boss Room than the one Isaac is in, it will move slower; if the opposite is true, it will move faster.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blood Rights/IV Bag/Kamikaze!/Razor Blade: The aura has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.

• Rock Bottom: Isaac will keep the stat upgrades even after leaving the aura. However, it won't keep the homing effect outside of the aura.

• Sprinkler: The tears that the Sprinkler shoots will also be buffed, along with its rotation speed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The star appears larger, but the aura's size does not increase and neither do the stat gains.

• Adrenaline: Isaac's damage before Adrenaline's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased by 1.5×.

• Bloody Lust: Isaac's damage before Bloody Lust's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased by 1.5×.

• Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier from the aura does not stack with white poop.

• Immaculate Heart: The damage multiplier [Before Repentance+] is reduced to 1.5× while in the aura / [Repentance+] does not stack.

• Ipecac: Isaac's damage before Ipecac's flat damage increase is increased by 1.2×, then damage after is increased 1.5×.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is a reference to the Star of Bethlehem, which appears in the Nativity story of the Gospel of Matthew, signifying the birth of Jesus.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If Isaac uses Pause, the light aura will be stuck in the last position before Pause was used even if the familiar continues without it. This is only a visual glitch, Isaac still has to be near the star to receive its benefits. If Pause’s effect ends the light instantly disappears and respawns back around the star again. The light will still fade when the star leaves the room.
Bug note: The speed of Star of Bethlehem is increased when Isaac is in an off-grid room.

fields.description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the Boss Room, giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.

Starter Deck.title: Starter Deck
Starter Deck.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Allows Isaac to carry two cards, runes, or soul stones at once. Cycle through cards by pressing [plat: PC] the Control key, [plat: PS4, PS5] R2, [plat: XboxOne] RT, or [plat: Switch, 3DS] ZR.

• Replaces all pills with cards, runes, or soul stones. Pills already on the ground will be converted to a card, rune or soul stone upon picking up Starter Deck.

• Spawns a random card.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When picking up Starter Deck in a shop that has a pill for purchase, the pill can still be purchased and used. If the pill is dropped, it will be turned into a card.

• Picking up 2 Starter Decks won't allow you to carry 3 cards at once.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Acid Baby: Spawns cards or runes instead of pills. Using cards or runes will not trigger the room-wide poisoning effect.

• [Before Repentance] Caffeine Pill: A pill drops normally, but if it is picked up and dropped, or left on the ground while visiting other rooms, it becomes a card.

• Little Baggy: Overrides the effect of Little Baggy (switch from receiving only pills to only cards).

• [Repentance] Having both items allow both cards and pills to appear again.

• • Picking up Little Baggy while already holding Starter Deck will turn any held cards or [Before Repentance] runes into pills for one time.

• Mom's Bottle of Pills: Gives a card instead of a pill, essentially becoming equivalent to a Deck of Cards.

• XIV - Temperance?: Forces Isaac to eat pills even with Starter Deck.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Starter Deck will paint a five-color pentagram on Isaac's head, which is a reference to the Magic: The Gathering logo.

• This item is used in It's in the Cards.

• [Repentance] Starter Deck also appears in Cantripped! with a unique function of increasing the number of item cards that Tainted Cain can carry at once. It replaces all Boss Room items in this challenge.

fields.description: Isaac can hold 2 cards at once and all pills are replaced by cards.

Status Effects.title: Status Effects
Status Effects.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: effects which can be inflicted on monsters; the different kinds of effects which Isaac's primary weapon can have; Tear Effects] 

Status effects are special effects that can be inflicted on an enemy from a variety of sources, such as tears, Bombs, and items. Each status effect has a color and/or symbol/effect associated with them for easy identification. These colorations are not to be confused with champions. Status effects are often temporary, but can become permanent in certain circumstances.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
| Effect | Appearance | Description 
| Burn | | [Rebirth only] Afflicted enemies take 4 to 6 fire damage over time. Afflicted enemies will be tinted orange for the duration and have a fire symbol above them. [end edition note] 
[Afterbirth onward] Afflicted enemies will sustain double Isaac's tear damage over time. Afflicted enemies will be tinted orange for the duration and have a fire symbol above them.

| Charm | | Afflicted enemies will temporarily fight on Isaac's side, running toward and/or shooting at other enemies and damaging them for 25% of their maximum HP per touch, 5 damage with half-heart-dealing projectiles, and 10 with full-heart-dealing projectiles. If no other enemies are in the room, a charmed enemy will instead run towards Isaac. (Charmed enemies can still hurt Isaac.) Afflicted enemies will be tinted pink for the duration and have a heart symbol above them. Most enemies with ranged attacks will not fire them (but can damage other enemies with them if they do — see the above "monster infighting" damage description).
[Afterbirth+ onward] Charmed enemies will prioritize non-charmed enemies and won't target invincible enemies. Charmed Portals will also spawn friendly enemies.

| Confusion/Concussion | | Afflicted enemies are slowed and walk around randomly. While confused, most non-boss enemies will be unable to attack. Bosses will have randomized movement, but will still be able to fire projectiles at Isaac. Afflicted enemies will be tinted pale gray and have stars above them.

| Fear | | Afflicted enemies are scared of Isaac and will run away from him. While scared, most non-boss enemies will be unable to attack or charge towards Isaac. Bosses will run away from Isaac, but will still be able to shoot projectiles at him. Afflicted enemies will be tinted purple and have a skull symbol above them.

| Petrified | | Afflicted enemies are stopped in place. They cannot move or attack, but will still deal contact damage. Afflicted enemies will be shaded brown-gray as if turned to stone (unless petrified by Midas' Touch, in which case they will be shaded gold).

| Poison | | [Rebirth only] Afflicted enemies sustain 4 to 6 damage over time. Afflicted enemies will be tinted green and have a bubbly effect surrounding them. [end edition note] 
[Afterbirth onward] Afflicted enemies will sustain double Isaac's tear damage over time. Afflicted enemies will be tinted green and have a bubbly effect surrounding them.

| Slow | | Afflicted enemies are slowed down to approximately 51.3% of their original speed. Any projectiles they shoot will also be slowed down to the same amount. Attacks that end when the enemy runs out of momentum, such as the charging attacks of Gurdy Jr. and Dingle, will be vastly shortened in duration. Depending on the item that triggers the slow effect, afflicted enemies will be tinted black or white with a snail icon above them.
[Before Repentance] Slowed projectiles will lose momentum much more quickly, greatly reducing their total range. [end edition note]

| [Afterbirth onward] 
Friendly | | Afflicted enemies are permanently charmed and will fight on Isaac's side until they die. Most enemies under this effect will follow Isaac across rooms, like a familiar. Friendly enemies cannot hurt Isaac, but many of them will still chase and "attack" Isaac in a room with no enemies. Enemies spawned from afflicted enemies will also be friendly. Friendly enemies are slightly tinted gray, and have heart symbols above their head.

| [Afterbirth onward] 
Shrink | | Afflicted enemies are shrunken and will run away from Isaac. Isaac can walk over shrunken enemies to kill them.

| [Afterbirth+ onward] 
Bleed | | [Before Repentance] Afflicted enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. [end edition note] 
[Repentance] Afflicted enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies. [end edition note]

| [Repentance] 
Bait | | Afflicted enemies will be attacked by other enemies, functioning like a reverse charm effect. Afflicted enemies are tinted red.

| [Repentance] 
Chained | | Afflicted enemies are chained in place, preventing them from taking any action.

| [Repentance] 
Frozen | | Enemies that are killed by items that can inflict Frozen become ice statues on death that block both Isaac's tears and enemy shots. Ice statues can also be pushed by Isaac, causing them to slide, leaving damaging blue creep (which deals 22 damage per second), until they hit an obstacle or enemy, dealing 35 damage to enemies they collide with. After an ice statue blocks 10 shots or collides with something while sliding, it shatters into a ring of 10 icicles which slow and deal 8 + (floor − 1) damage to enemies they hit. Enemies that are killed by these icicles also become ice statues. Frozen enemies will not trigger any of their on-death effects, such as exploding or splitting.
[Before Repentance+] On-kill effects from items such as Charm of the Vampire and Lusty Blood are not triggered when enemies are frozen.

| [Repentance] 
Magnetized | | Afflicted enemies attract tears/projectiles, pickups, and other enemies. Enemy shots attracted by this effect can damage other enemies.

| [Repentance] 
Brimstone Curse | | Effect exclusively applied by Tainted Azazel and Hemoptysis. Cursed enemies take more damage from Brimstone and Brimstone-like effects. On death, cursed enemies explode, spreading the effect to nearby enemies. Enemies spawned/created from cursed enemies will also be cursed.

| [Repentance] 
Weaken | | Effect exclusively applied by XI - Strength?. Afficted enemies are slowed slightly and take 2x damage from all sources. Enemies also have their damage reduced to half a heart, even on the Womb stages and beyond.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Host-type enemies will take burn and poison damage even if their skull is down, and all status effects can be applied by tears even if their skulls are down.

• If a Host-type enemy is petrified, they will take damage regardless of if they are vulnerable or not.

• After a boss or mini-boss has had a status effect applied on them, they will receive immunity against all status effects for 8 seconds. This means that no other status effect can be applied to that enemy during this period.

• Slow effects and [Repentance] Brimstone Curse are the exceptions to this rule.

• Abyss can create locusts that apply various status effects on enemies depending on the item consumed.

Steam Sale.title: Steam Sale
Steam Sale.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Halves the price of all purchasable items and pickups.

• Items on sale for an odd amount will have their price rounded down (ie; 15 cost items will cost 7).

• Most Pickups have their price reduced to 3. [Repentance] This includes Grab Bags, which are normally sold for 7. [end edition note] 

• Red Hearts have their price reduced to 2.

• [Repentance] Prevents shops from having natural discounts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can drop from killing Greed, as well as a 1% chance to drop from destroying Shopkeepers.

• It can also drop from killing Super Greed, if A Quarter is not yet unlocked.

• [Before Repentance] Multiple Steam Sales can be obtained via each of the normal drop methods.

• [Rebirth only] Multiple Steam Sales have no effect.

• [edition anr] After obtaining 2 Steam Sales, all shop prices are set to 0 coins.

• [Repentance] Multiple Steam Sales only further reduce prices, with each additional copy lowering prices less.

• The price is lowered to \frac{price}{n+1}, where n is the number of Steam Sales. For example, an item with 3 Steam Sales would cost 15 \over 4 pennies, which is rounded up to 4.

• [Afterbirth only] Steam Sale will cause the Deals with the Devil not to convert the type of required heart automatically.

• [Repentance] Steam Sale's quality is treated as 3 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Adoption Papers: Both of the discounts stack, selling familiars for 5 cents.

• Coupon: The discounts stack.

• [edition anr] Diplopia: Can be used to create two Steam Sales, reducing the price of all items in the shop to 0.

• Diplopia + Restock or Greed mode: Restock will allow shop items to replenish indefinitely, so by having multiple Steam Sales by the methods above, infinite items may be purchased. Be careful not to pick up Missing No., which will remove the Steam Sales and will likely replace many items with Breakfast. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Each additional Steam Sale will further reduce the price of all items in the shop, down to a minimum of 1 cent. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • A Pound of Flesh: Devil Deals and Black Markets will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is called Steamy Sale on the PS Vita and Xbox One versions, as well as in the card game The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls, most likely due to fear of copyright issues.

• This was also the case on the PS4 and Switch versions but was later reverted to Steam Sale in Booster Pack #5.

• Steam Sale refers to the platform of Steam and its reputation for giving generous sales.

fields.description: Reduces all Shop prices by 50%, rounded down to 7 coins for an item, rounded up to 2-3 coins for a pickup.

Steven.title: Steven
Steven.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the boss; the damage item; Steven (Item); the familiar item; Little Steven] 

Steven is a boss that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] Only in the Basement.

• [Repentance] In the Basement and the Burning Basement.
Each Steven has 140 HP.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Phase 1

• Big Steven chases Isaac and periodically charges increasing its speed, but stopping to catch his breath afterwards.

• Steven Baby shoots a projectile towards Isaac if not behind an obstacle.

Phase 2
If Big Steven reaches 50% HP, they separate:

• Big Steven continues the same patterns.

• Steven Baby begins charging furiously at Isaac.

• Both, when killed shoot out projectiles in all directions.

• [Before Repentance] 8 projectiles each.

• [Repentance] Big Steven: Two rows of 8 slow-moving projectiles that travel over obstacles and off-screen which also deal a whole heart of damage. Small Steven: unchanged.
Small Steven can be targeted and killed first with no change to either Steven's behavior.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Steven is much less common than his counterpart, spawning only 1/4th as often.

• Steven's arena will always look the same as Gemini's.

• If already in possession of Steven or Little Steven, the other item will be dropped. If Isaac has both, a normal boss room reward is generated.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Little Steven]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Steven appeared in the original Binding of Isaac.

• He is a rare alternative to Gemini.

• Steven originated from the 2009 flash game Time Fcuk, which was created by Edmund McMillen.

• [Afterbirth onward] Steven can appear in Greed Mode prior to his prerequisites being completed.

• As they appear in Time Fcuk and on the boss art, Big Steven and Steven Baby have the back of their heads attached. However, their attachment does not appear this way in-game. This is likely due to Big and Small Steven having the same function of how Contusion and Suture are conjoined, only without the long cord holding them together.

• According to Edmund McMillen, Steven is connected to Isaac.

• Steven also appears in The End is Nigh, another game created by Edmund McMillen.

• One of the images that can appear before the start of a new run states: "GET IN THE BOX", which is Steven's unofficial catchphrase from Time Fcuk.

• It is also likely an allusion to both Time Fcuk and The Binding Of Isaac taking place inside some form of box.

• [Repentance] Big Steven's appearance as one of Delirium's forms shares the appearance of Ash, the main protagonist of The End is Nigh.

• [Repentance] Steven Baby's projectiles have a completely unique visual design while Big Steven's death projectiles have both unique visuals and behaviour.

• These new designs were made to coincide with Edmund's project Øuroboros, which also features Steven; teased in 2016.

• In the Bestiary, Little Steven is referred to as "Steven Baby".

sections.heading: [edition nar] Tips
sections.text:
Finding Steven for the collection page can be difficult, as the boss Steven rarely appears and has a high chance to drop Little Steven instead of Steven. The following method can be used to obtain Steven.

• Make sure Steven is unlocked.

• Play as Azazel.

• His fly ability and his version of Brimstone grants fast progress.

• Restart until Basement [Repentance] or Burning Basement appears.

• Rush to the Boss Room.

• The given 0 - The Fool can return Azazel instantly to the start if he went a wrong way.

• By using Black Hearts, slow rooms can be cleared quickly.

• Skipping any special rooms (such as Treasure Rooms or Curse Rooms) and leaving any pickups behind allow faster rushing.

• The process is repeated until Steven is found as the first boss and until he drops Steven

• Alternatively, Steven is guaranteed to appear if Spindown Dice is used on Pentagram.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This item is more likely to be dropped by Steven if Little Steven has already been picked up.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Steven originated from the 2009 flash game Time Fcuk, which was created by Edmund McMillen.

• Steven is the only damage upgrade that has no additional stat increases or secondary effects.

Stitches.title: Stitches
Stitches.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While held, spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.

• Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).

• If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.

• If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.

• Teleporting next to a Fire Place will put it out, including blue fires.

• Teleporting on top of Shopkeepers will destroy them.

• Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an Angel Room will not break it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Because of the brief immunity after teleporting, Isaac can move in and out of Curse Rooms and open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests free of charge.

• You may also use the immunity frames in greed mode to press the button disabling the waves without taking damage.

• Teleporting on top of an enemy is somewhat risky, as you might take damage from it if you don't move out of harm's way fast enough.

• If timed correctly, the brief immunity can be used to ignore on-hit explosive damage from enemies such as the Kamikaze Leech.

• The familiar can move through any obstacles that can be bypassed with Flight, allowing Isaac to reach otherwise blocked off locations.

• Crawl Space that have an item enclosed by walls can be accessed by teleporting to it with Stitches.

• The familiar is able to be squeezed in between the gap of two diagonally adjacent Key Blocks, allowing the reaching of blocked off items without the expenditure of a key.

• While playing as Jacob and Esau, it will only teleport the character who holds the item (if Jacob was holding Stitches and used it, Jacob will swap places with Stitches whilst Esau will stay put).

• While playing as Tainted Forgotten, it will only teleport the body of the Forgotten. Telefrag damage is done to the new location of the body but immunity frames are given to the soul.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 9 Volt: Halves Stitches' charge time.

• BFFS!: On teleport, fires 8 tears outwards at Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects and deal Isaac's damage. Stitches' teleport-on-enemy damage is increased to 3 + 2x Isaac's damage.

• Book of Belial interaction: Creates a shadowy line similar to Dark Arts between Judas and the familiar. Enemies caught in the line take damage equal to 2 × Judas' damage, plus a flat 3.

• Book of Virtues interaction: When Isaac teleports, he leaves behind a stationary wisp that fires tears in the same direction Isaac does. Up to 6 of these wisps can exist at a time. The wisps do not persist between rooms.

• Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: Can poison enemies during the brief immunity granted after teleporting.

• Midas' Touch: Enemies that survive being teleported onto will immediately turn into gold due to contact with Isaac. Thanks to the brief immunity, Isaac will not be harmed by this.

• Panic Button: As long as Stitches is charged, Isaac will teleport right before getting hit, negating damage. This can effectively be used as a 3-second-recharge Holy Mantle.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc. It will deal telefrag damage in both places (where Stitches is and where Isaac was).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Stitches originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Stitches slowly moved diagonally instead of being controllable, similarly to The Peeper familiar.

fields.description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.

Betrayal.title: Betrayal
Betrayal.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Upon taking damage, all enemies in the room are charmed.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] It won't trigger if there are less than 2 enemies in the room.

• [Repentance] Enemies are able to damage each other with projectiles. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] This item is extremely strong against the second and third phase of ???, as its own eternal flies become charmed and deal massive damage to the boss, often killing it after even just two uses.

• [Repentance] The initial effect only affects projectiles. Enemies will not deal contact damage to each other, unless hit by a projectile, at which point they will deal contact damage to their attacker.

• [Repentance] Charmed and friendly enemies can trigger the item.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This is a reference to Judas betraying Jesus after the Last Supper, leading to Jesus' death by crucifixion.

• [Repentance] Betrayal's updated behavior bears a similarity to the monster infighting mechanic from the Doom series, Heretic, and Hexen, which similarly causes enemies struck by another enemy's attack to prioritize attacking that monster over the player character.

Big Chubby.title: Big Chubby
Big Chubby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, dealing 2.7 damage per tick or 40.5 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

• The familiar's charging speed is very slow, unlike its counterpart Little Chubby.

• The familiar blocks enemy shots.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Matriarch. [end edition note] 

• Big Chubby takes 6 seconds to travel the other end of normal-sized rooms.

• Big Chubby will travel forward until hitting an obstacle or wall.

• Big Chubby will continue to travel forward between rooms.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Big Chubby having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Duct Tape: Big Chubby stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Big Chubby was originally an unofficial item which was supposed to showcase the modding capabilities of Afterbirth+ in the PAX 2016 livestream. However, all items included in the demo were later added to the final game.

• The way Big Chubby moves resembles Pac-man.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, blocking shots and dealing 40.5 damage per second on contact.

Big Fan.title: Big Fan
Big Fan.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.

• Reduces the rotation speed of all of Isaac's orbitals. [Before Afterbirth+] This excludes Pretty Flies.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Big Fan orbits independently rather than occupying one of the three defense orbital slots.

• [Repentance] Pretty Fly Horse Pills spawn a Big Fan without granting it as an item. These Big Fans spin at normal pace and don't affect rotation speed of other orbitals. 

• Unlike regular Pretty Fly, there is no limit to how many familiars can be spawned this way.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Big Fan becomes visually larger and deals more damage.

• Guillotine: Reduces the head's rotation speed, making it easier to aim.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Friendship Necklace: No effect.

• Guardian Angel: Overrides Guardian Angel's speed boost. If Guardian Angel was obtained first, it will retain its own increased speed. If Big Fan was obtained first, Guardian Angel will be slower.

• Psy Fly: Rotates slower, but moves at full speed while blocking incoming projectiles.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Big Fan looks like a mixture of a Boom Fly and Gluttony.

fields.description: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.

Big Horn.title: Big Horn
Big Horn.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Big Horn is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth † that can appear in all environments of Chapter 2 (Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves).

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Big Horn alternates between attacking with his arms and his head.

Big Horn spawns 2 or 3 small holes; one of his arms has a chance of appearing from each hole. Each arm can perform the following attacks either by itself or in conjunction with another arm:

• Throws a Troll Bomb towards Isaac.

• Throws 3 Troll Bombs in a spread towards Isaac.

• Every Troll Bomb has a chance of being a Hot Bombs Bomb or a Mega Troll Bomb.

• [Repentance] If the area is Flooded, instead of Hot Bombs, he will send out Sad Bombs.

• If Big Horn tosses a bomb into one of the empty holes, Big Horn’s hand appears out of that hole and tosses out the same type of bomb.

• Quickly slaps the ground 3 times with an empty hand while traveling towards Isaac.

• This attack can kill any Dark Balls it touches.

• [Before Repentance] If a hole is empty, there is an extremely rare chance to spawn a low-health version of Little Horn.

• [Repentance] Holds up a Little Horn in his palm which spits out 3 small homing Dark Balls in quick succession.

• If Big Horn dies while performing this attack, Little Horn hops off the hand and continues the fight, but with low health.

Big Horn's head can perform the following attacks after appearing from a large hole:

• Spits out a large Dark Ball beneath him that homes in on Isaac.

• Spits out two large Dark Balls beneath him that travel diagonally, bouncing when colliding with walls or Isaac's tears. These do not home.

• Occasionally spits out 3 Dark Balls; 2 homing and 1 non-homing.

• [Before Repentance] The Dark Balls can hit and damage Big Horn, destroying themselves in the process.

• After spawning a Dark Ball, there is a very small window where Bombs can be kicked into his mouth. If fed a Bomb, Big Horn is temporarily stunned, and plays a unique animation, during which he takes 20% more damage.

• [Repentance] Additionally, the Bomb also explodes in his mouth, dealing considerable damage.

• Big Horn's head occasionally pauses and returns into the hole without attacking.

• This always occurs at the start of the battle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The Hot Bombs ( [Repentance] and Sad Bombs) he throws are not affected by Safety Scissors.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Big Horn appears to be an adult version of Little Horn.

• Upon defeat, Big Horn frowns and retreats into his hole. He does not explode into blood upon defeat.

• Big Horn's hands also have a death animation, which only plays if Big Horn is killed while they're on-screen. The hands briefly shake and retreat into the holes.

• Big Horn had a teaser on Twitter by Tyrone Rodriguez.

• During the versus screen, Big Horn will growl despite the battle not starting yet. Big Horn is one of seven ( [Repentance] 5) bosses that can be heard during the versus screen, the other six ( [Repentance] 4) being The Stain, The Forsaken, Mom, [Before Repentance] Mom's Heart, [Before Repentance] It Lives!, and Mother.

• [Repentance] Big Horn's hand makes an appearance in the effects of the Item Little Horn. His hand appears grabbing and crushing any monsters and performing the slap attack on Bosses.

• His hand also appeared from a pit to pull down Dark Esau when he was killed, prior to patch v1.7.5. [end edition note] 

• Big Horn's unique stun animation might be a reference to Nintendo's Punch Out series.

• Similar to Little Horn, who was based on the fourth beast's "little horn" from the seventh chapter of the Book of Daniel, it is possible that Big Horn is based on the four-horned goat's little horn from the eighth chapter of the same book, where it mentions that the horn will grow extraordinarily into a great horn and triggers the apocalypse.

• [Repentance] Blighted Ovum, Big Horn, Triachnid, Isaac and ??? are the only bosses whose portraits were completely changed in Repentance (beyond simply adding more detail). Of these, only Triachnid, Isaac, and ??? didn't receive new sprites.

Binge Eater.title: Binge Eater
Binge Eater.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac.

• Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.

• Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 Damage boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.

• Affected food items heal 3 Red Hearts instead of 2.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Food items that Binge Eater affects and can cycle between, and their bonuses, include:

• Breakfast: +0.2 Shot Speed, +2.5 Range.

• Dessert: +1.0 Damage, +0.2 Shot Speed.

• Dinner: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.

• Lunch: +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range.

• Midnight Snack: +1.0 Damage, +1.0 Luck.

• Rotten Meat: +1.0 Damage, +2.5 Range.

• A Snack: +0.2 Shot Speed, +1.0 Luck.

• Supper: +0.5 Tears, +1.0 Luck.

• All Food items that Isaac has collected before picking up Binge Eater will provide their respective stats, including the -0.03 speed down for each item, but excluding the temporary damage up and extra healing.

• The temporary Damage boost cannot be stacked, and picking up additional food items resets it to +3.6.

• Has no effect on certain items that are required to progress through the game, such as The Polaroid, Knife Piece 1, or Dad's Note.

• No bonuses are granted from other items alluded to be edible, such as MEAT!.

• Removing collected food items or Binge Eater itself will also remove associated stat bonuses.

• Because this affects items in Devil Rooms and all of them cost 1 Red Heart Container, Devil Deals can be used as free stat upgrades.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Crooked Penny / Diplopia: If an item pedestal is copied while the original item is revealed, it will create an identical cycling pedestal of the same two items. If an item pedestal is copied when the food item is revealed, it will create a non-switching pedestal of the food item only.

• A Pound of Flesh: Food items in Shops cost 1 Red Heart Container, much like with Devil Deals. If Isaac also has Restock, he is able to gain infinite stats this way.

• Death Certificate: Has no effect on the items in the generated areas.

• Glitched Crown: The food item is added to the end of the cycle for a total of 6 items per pedestal.

• Sacred Orb: The food item is not re-rolled.

• Jacob and Esau: Items will swap between the initial item and food item as normal, but only the brother who picked up Binge Eater gets the additional stat bonuses.

• Tainted Isaac / Isaac's Birthright: The food item will cycle alongside the original 2 granted by the character, resulting in a total of 3 items per pedestal.

• Tainted Lazarus: In a Devil Room, Tainted Lazarus is effectively able to give items to his inactive form for free by picking up a food item. This will remove one heart container, and then instantly restore it. The mirrored Devil items will remain however, meaning he can use Flip and pick them up as his alternate form for no cost.

• Tainted Bethany: On pick-up, grants 12 blood charges. Increases blood charges gained from food items from 4 to 6.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The costume given by this item is identical to Bucket of Lard and Belly Jelly.

• Binge Eater's sprite consists of (clockwise, starting on the left) Dinner, Dessert, Breakfast, Lunch, Raw Liver and Rotten Meat.

• Among these, Raw Liver is the only item Binge Eater can't cycle into.

• The name “Binge Eater” could be a reference to the eating disorder known as “Binge Eating Disorder”, in which a person eats an unusually large amount of food in one sitting, causing distress and a feeling of lack of control.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Binge Eater can affect Key Piece 1, Key Piece 2, Broken Shovel 1, Broken Shovel 2, and Mom's Shovel.

fields.description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.

Binky.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one Soul Heart.

• +0.75 tears.

• Decreases Isaac's size.

• Increases the pitch of Isaac's voice.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Memories...; Repentance: Tears up]

Bird's Eye.title: Bird's Eye
Bird's Eye.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by Red Candle.

• Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.

• Fires deal 4× Isaac's damage at full durability, 3× Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2× Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11× Isaac's damage per fire.

• Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using The Poop or when generating a bomb with No. 2.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Singe. [end edition note] 

• The chance to shoot fires depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 12 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},50\%)

• At base luck (0), the chance is 8.33%, maxing out at 50% at 10 luck.

• Flames will destroy Shopkeepers.

• The size of the flames depends on Isaac's tears size.

• Converts enemies into their fire-like variations, such as a Clotty into a Grilled Clotty.

• A Clotty won't be converted if it's in a wet room, such as those found in the Flooded Caves or the one created by an item such as Flush!

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Butter Bean / Wait What? /The Black Bean / Mega Bean: Spawn a fire upon activation.

• Chocolate Milk: As each flame's damage is unaffected by the charge of each tear, a flame-thrower-like effect with very high damage can be achieved with a decent luck stat and rapidly fired low-charge tears.

• Contagion: Creates a fire behind Isaac for each enemy that produces a gas cloud on death.

• Farting Baby: Farts have a chance to spawn a fire.

• Ghost Pepper: Changes the activation rate to \frac1 { 8 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.

• Monstro's Lung: When releasing the tear barrage, multiple fires are fired.

• Mucormycosis: When a mucormyosis spore explodes, Isaac has a chance to spawn a fire

• The Poop: Creates a fire behind Isaac.

• Proptosis: Size and damage of fires is increased but does not decrease with range.

• Pupula Duplex: The fires and their hitbox get a lot bigger.

• Urn of Souls: Causes the Urn to emit Bird's Eye's red flames in addition to its regular flames.

• Tear-copying Familiars like Incubus / Lil Clot / Evil Eye: Don't shoot fires, but make Isaac shoot fires more often.

• Lil Dumpy: Every time Lil Dumpy farts, Isaac emits a flame too.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing and with high luck will spawn four fires.

• The Ludovico Technique: Will occasionally shoot fire from Isaac toward the floating tear.

• 20/20/Mutant Spider/The Inner Eye: Only one fire spawns at a time.

• Bird's Eye: No effect. Will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Ghost Pepper.

• Dr. Fetus / Tech X / Technology: fires spawn when firing.

• Epic Fetus: Fires spawn when moving the crosshair and are launched in the direction of the crosshair similarly to Marked.

• Homing Tears: Fires aren't homing.

• IBS: Not Recommended. Farts caused by IBS release flames, which will automatically detonate the toxic cloud and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. Similarly, stinky poops can explode while held by Isaac if he happens to be near flames when IBS activates

• Ipecac: Fires spawn as normal, but can be hit by ipecac tears, making them especially dangerous.

• A Lump of Coal: No effect on fires.

• Mom's Knife: Fires spawn occasionally when fired.

• Sprinkler: No effect. Sprinkler doesn't shoot fires.

• Jupiter: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bird's Eye is from the Antibirth mod.

• Bird's eye chili is a chili pepper that is a cultivar of the species Capsicum annuum, commonly found in Southeast Asia.

• Proptosis used to have no effect on the fires.

fields.description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.

Bird Cage.title: Bird Cage
Bird Cage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.

• Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like Dead Bird, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.

• Bird Cage does 45 damage to enemies it lands on and 10 damage per rock wave that hits enemies, then does 3 contact damage per tick while chasing enemies (~6.43 damage per second). The rock waves can destroy obstacles.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Cage. [end edition note] 

• If damage is taken in a room with no enemies, the familiar will directly go to the flying phase without performing the jump attack.

• Contact damage can be dealt to nearby enemies even when the familiar jumps off of Isaac's head.

• Bird Cage's jump can be carried over to another room mid-jump to create a rock line there instead. The direction of the line is preserved from how it would be in the original room.

• While the familiar is sitting on Isaac's head, it can be affected by certain character appearances. For example, it will appear fully black if obtained by Tainted Judas.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Spawns 4 rock waves in an X pattern and doubles contact damage. Damage of the jump and the rock waves is unaffected.

• Sacrificial Altar: Can be used after the familiar has jumped.

• Spin to Win: Boosts the familiar's damage while spinning, although has no effect on its speed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bird Cage: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit and won't make more than one familiar appear.

• Box of Friends: Immediately makes the familiar jump, leaving a ghost copy on Isaac's head until he takes damage. This has no benefit to the damage dealt and will not spawn more than one familiar.

• The Twins: If Bird Cage was active in a previous room and it was chosen by the trinket, it skips the jump and enters its flying phase. Behavior otherwise identical to that with Box of Friends.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bird Cage is from the Antibirth mod.

• The item's name is a pun: the familiar resembles The Cage, and it functions like Dead Bird, thus making it a "Bird" version of the Cage.

fields.description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird.

Birthright.title: Birthright
Birthright.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a passive ability that varies from character to character. The effect typically enhances/magnifies the character's special traits or helps mitigate some of their downsides.

| Character | Pickup Quote | Effect 
| Isaac | More options | All new item pedestals cycle between two options. Previously-seen items are unaffected.

| Tainted Isaac | Inventory up | Allows up to 12 passive items to be carried at a time. Does not consume a slot itself.

| Magdalene | Limit breaker + HP up | Adds 1 full Red Heart container. Increases the maximum heart limit to 18.

| Tainted Magdalene | HP up! | Adds 1 full red Heart Container. Increases the number of non-draining hearts to 3.

| Cain | Better arcades + luck up | +1 Luck. Every floor, except for ???, Chest, Dark Room, The Void, and Home, has a very high chance to contain an upgraded Arcade that generally contains more Machines. This includes odd-numbered floors, Cathedral, and Sheol. Arcades will appear even if Cain is not holding at least 5 Coins. Arcades will still not spawn in Greed Mode.

| Tainted Cain | Salvage | The amount of pickups dropped from collecting an item is doubled.

| Judas | Belial incarnate | The Book of Belial becomes a passive item that can be held beneath other active items, similar to Book of Virtues. May stack with Book of Virtues. If Judas is not currently holding The Book of Belial, he receives it. The damage boost received from The Book of Belial scales with the amount of charges the active item above it has; may not work with one-time-use items, items with unlimited use, timed recharges, or items that do not follow normal room charge rules (Isaac's Tears, etc). Has special interactions with certain items — see The Book of Belial for more information.

| Black Judas

| Tainted Judas | Extended darkness | Increases the range in which Dark Arts hits enemies and tears.

| ??? | Stronger spirit | Doubles the amount of Soul Hearts gained from HP up items.

| Tainted ??? | Poop up | Increases the maximum number of poop pickups that can be carried to 29.

| Eve | Forever cursed | Whore of Babylon is active regardless of health and Dead Bird is active without taking damage.

| Tainted Eve | Coagulate | Red Heart Clots now spawn temporary Half Red Hearts on death that last for two seconds before disappearing. Clots spawned from other types of hearts will not drop hearts.

| Samson | Rage up | Bloody Lust can grant 4 more Damage boosts at +0.2 intervals, for a new maximum total of +14.0.

| Tainted Samson | Unstoppable force | The berserk timer gains 3 seconds instead of 1 when Tainted Samson kills an enemy.

| Azazel | Wide breath | Azazel's Brimstone beam becomes much wider like Mega Blast, with 2× larger collision area. No effect on damage.

| Tainted Azazel | Stronger sneeze | Doubles the size of Tainted Azazel's Hemoptysis sneeze attack.

| Lazarus | Come back stronger | No direct effect. The item is triggered if Lazarus dies and becomes Lazarus Risen.

| Lazarus Risen | Temporary DMG up | Grants a +7.2 Damage bonus that fades by 0.12 per second. Until the effect completely fades, killing an enemy restores 0.07 damage to the bonus.

| Tainted Lazarus | Superposition | The non-active form of Tainted Lazarus and their familiars will appear in ghostly form, being completely immune to damage and dealing 25% damage (including tear effects such as Holy Light). Holding down the "drop" key allows the active form to move independently of the other form, similar to Jacob and Esau. Using Flip will cause the two characters to switch states while maintaining positions. Both characters receive the Birthright effect when one character collects it. Likewise both characters will benefit from passive global effects such as Restock or Petrified Poop regardless of who is the active form.

| Dead Tainted Lazarus

| Eden | ??? | Creates 3 random items from random item pools. Only one can be taken. Ignores item weight and can spawn items that have already been taken during the run. Can also spawn multiples of the same item, if they exist in multiple item pools.

| Tainted Eden | Eternal | Items gained before Birthright will not be re-rolled, neither by taking damage, nor by items such as D4 and Missing No.. Items gained afterwards will still be affected.

| The Lost | Better destiny | Prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing. This automatically re-rolls most items that aren't beneficial to The Lost, namely ones that only give health, flight, and/or spectral tears or activate upon taking damage.

| Tainted Lost | Extra life | Grants an extra life that revives Tainted Lost in the same room and deals 200 damage to nearby enemies. It can hit the same enemy up to 4 times.

| Lilith | Offensive Formation | Most familiars that normally follow Lilith, including Lilith's innate Incubus, will always be positioned in front of Lilith, creating a stack, facing whatever direction she was shooting. Non-attacking familiars (The Relic, Farting Baby, etc.) will follow Lilith's most recently acquired attacking familiar instead; if the most recent familiar is throwable like Holy Water, familiars following it will also be launched with it. If Lilith has King Baby, it will always be positioned directly in front of Lilith with all other affected familiars forming a semi-circle around it, and will behave normally otherwise. Dry Baby is considered an "attacking familiar" and will be within the stack. Lil Portal and Jaw Bone are exempt and behave normally.

| Tainted Lilith | Conjoined | Familiars that normally follow Tainted Lilith will instead act like and stack on top of her Gello familiar, disappearing inside of her while she's not firing and swinging out when she attacks. The melee attack gains a flat +3 damage bonus per familiar (regardless of damage multipliers) and if those familiars can shoot, they do so along with the Gello familiar. The Gello familiar gains the properties of King Baby, causing attached familiars to automatically aim and shoot at enemies. Familiars like Jaw Bone or Holy Water still function, but they are bound to the Gello familiar rather than their normal means of movement.

| Keeper | Coin up | Adds one Coin Heart and raises Keeper's maximum Coin Heart limit to 4.

| Tainted Keeper | Money money money | Strongly attracts the coins dropped by killed enemies from a short distance. No effect on other coins.

| Apollyon | Regurgitate | Using Void has a 10% chance to spawn one previously destroyed passive item (while keeping the bonus stats). Each absorbed passive item has an equal chance to be spawned. Spawned items can be spawned again even if they are not reabsorbed. Absorbing duplicates of the same item will make it more likely to be spawned, as each duplicate counts as a separate item and thus has its own chance to be spawned. Birthright has no effect if Void is not held.

| Tainted Apollyon | Torment | Holding down the fire button causes Abyss locusts to continuously damage enemies instead of returning.

| The Forgotten | Unchained | The Soul is unchained and free to move. It can move to different rooms, leaving The Forgotten behind, and switching back teleports The Soul back to The Forgotten.

| Tainted Forgotten | Recall | Tainted Soul is given Recall, an unlimited-use active item, in their pocket active slot. When used, Recall pulls Tainted Forgotten into Tainted Soul's hands automatically from a distance, dealing damage to enemies as it travels.

| Bethany | Conserve your faith | Activating an item using Soul Charges is free 50% of the time.

| Tainted Bethany | Artifact | Spawns four Lemegeton wisps of items with a quality of 3 or higher. These wisps are much larger and have much higher HP than normal wisps.

| Jacob and Esau | What's yours is mine | The character who picks up Birthright gains copies of the three most recent passive items from the other.

| Tainted Jacob | It's not yours | Dark Esau splits into two. Both Esaus will always charge at the same time, and one will not charge if the other is not in position. Using Anima Sola chains both Dark Esaus at once and forces them together into one spot. Subsequent uses release each Dark Esau one at a time. Anima Sola's recharge time is reduced to 10 seconds, and chain duration is increased to 6.67 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Birthright effects are stackable when playing as Tainted Lost and Tainted Bethany.

• Each additional copy of Birthright for Magdalene, Tainted Magdalene, and Keeper will add another heart container; however, their respective health caps will not be raised any further. Cain will also gain +1 Luck for each copy of Birthright.

• When Magdalene or Keeper enter the area in which Knife Piece 2 can be acquired, all hearts above the usual cap are removed and are not restored upon leaving the area. Additional hearts can be regained afterwards.

• While playing as Tainted Cain in Greed Mode, purchasing an on-sale item over and over while having Birthright results in almost infinite consumables.

• If The Soul enters a new floor with Birthright, swapping back to The Forgotten will cause him to appear at The Soul's current location.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Sacrificial Altar + Tainted Eve: Clots won't drop half red hearts after getting sacrificed.

The following familiars are unaffected by Lilith's and Tainted Lilith's Birthrights:

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Birthright is from the Antibirth mod.

• Before Antibirth the item originated from the Binding of Isaac: Community Remix mod, where it was known as 'Soul Script'.

• This item's name, description, and unlock requirement are a reference to the biblical story of Jacob and Esau, in which Esau trades his birthrights to Jacob in exchange for stew.

• When Tainted Jacob picks up Birthright, Dark Esau, a representation of his own rage, seemingly becomes only angrier and doubles in power.

• • Birthright's effect doubling Dark Esau's power, instead of Tainted Jacob's, and the quote "it's not yours", further reflects the fact that it was originally his.

• Prior to patch V1.7.6, Tainted Jacob's Birthright pickup quote was "There is no escape".

• Tainted Keeper's pickup quote could be based off the song Money, Money, Money, by the band ABBA.

• Eden's Birthright could be a reference to how Eden functions in the card game The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls, as Eden starts the game by drawing 3 treasure cards and selecting one to keep permanently while the other two are discarded.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Playing as Keeper, having more than 3 HP, and entering the area in which Knife Piece 2 can be acquired will remove the fourth HP (can be increased back to 4 HP after)
Bug note: Playing as Magdalene, having more than 12 hearts, and entering the area in which Knife Piece 2 can be acquired will completely remove all hearts above 12.
Bug note: Playing as Tainted Lazarus, Picking up Birthright and using Flip at the same time as the other form appears will cause the other form to be in a bugged state where he acts significantly faster than intended. Restarting the game will undo the effects.

fields.description: Grants a character-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.

Bishop.title: Bishop
Bishop.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Bishops are stationary enemies added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance. They appear only in Mausoleum and Cathedral.

While a Bishop is alive in the current room, all other enemies that aren't Bishops will be given shields, protecting them from all damage taken; all Bishops in the room must be killed for the other enemies to take damage as normal. Additionally, when Bishops take damage, they have a 66% chance to retaliate by firing shots in the cardinal directions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Petrified Bishops cannot protect anything.

• Feared or Confused Bishops only have a 50% chance for their protection to work.

• Charmed or Friendly Bishops protect Isaac from all damage, but take 3.5 Damage each time they do so.

• To prevent softlocks, Bishops cannot be healed by Pulsing Red Champions.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In Antibirth, Bishop's robes had a purple color, didn't shoot tears after taking damage, had a base hp of 5, and could appear in Chest.

Black Candle.title: Black Candle
Black Candle.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants immunity to floor curses.

• Will immediately remove any curses on the current floor except [curse: labyrinth] .

• Grants a Black Heart upon pickup.

• Increases chance for a Devil Room / Angel Room to open by 15%.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Picking up this item during Cursed! will not remove the [curse: cursed] .

• Picking up this item during Pitch Black will not remove the [curse: darkness] or [curse: unknown] .

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Picking up this item during Ultra Hard will not remove any of the curses. [end edition note] 

• Picking up this item while under the effect of an Amnesia pill or ??? pill will remove the effect of the pill. However, the item does not negate the effects of Amnesia or ??? pills used after picking up this item.

• Picking up this item can affect whether Floor Generation chooses between 2 or 3 added rooms in Hard mode which can cause room content to change for affected floors.

• [Repentance] Picking up this item does not make the second item in alt floor treasure rooms visible.

• [Repentance] Doesn't remove [curse: darkness] afflicted by XIX - The Sun?, no matter if Black Candle was picked up before or after using the card.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Black Feather: Grants a damage boost.

• [Afterbirth onward] Cursed Eye: Removes teleportation effect of Cursed Eye.

• Cursed Penny: Prevents the teleport effect from triggering for all coins except the still-stuck Sticky Nickel.

fields.description: Prevents curses. Grants one Black Heart. Increases the chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room to appear.

Black Feather.title: Black Feather
Black Feather.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Increases Isaac's Damage by a set amount for each of the following items or trinkets he possesses:

• [Before Repentance] +0.2 Damage for each item or trinket possessed.

• [Repentance] +0.5 Damage for each item or trinket possessed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Having more than one of the same item (i.e. using Diplopia and/or, in the case of trinkets, Smelter or Mom's Purse) will increase Isaac's damage for each copy.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Mom's Box: Grants +0.4 damage for each evil item and trinket.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either grants +1 damage for each evil item and trinket. Having both grants +1.5 damage for each.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Most items that are affected by Black Feather contain the phrase "Evil up" or "Sin up" in their description. The only exception is Goat Head, [Repentance+] The Mark and [Repentance+] The Pact.

fields.description: Increases Isaac's Damage for each 'evil' item or trinket he possesses.

Black Hole.title: Black Hole
Black Hole.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, Isaac throws a black hole that lands on the ground and forcefully sucks in enemies and their shots, which lasts for about 6 seconds.

• It deals 0.4 damage per tick very rapidly to enemies in the area, for a maximum of 6 damage per second.

• Isaac and pickups are slightly sucked towards the black hole.

• Nearby obstacles are occasionally destroyed by the black hole.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Black Hole cannot free Sticky Nickels, kill Shopkeepers, or destroy Angels Statues.

• Black Hole has the strongest pulling effect in the game, and will override the pulling force of Strange Attractor, Super Magnet, Ocular Rift, and Lodestone.

• Black Hole can't open Secret Room and Super Secret Rooms regardless of placement, despite crushing obstacles.

• Black Hole does not suck in stationary or invincible enemies.

• Black Hole will not suck in the following bosses, although they can still take damage from the black hole and their shots are affected by it:

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns black wisps on the middle ring. Wisps' tears have the Strange Attractor effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Gnawed Leaf: The black hole does not pull Isaac in while he is a statue.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Black Hole is based on this Steam Workshop item by Custom Phase.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Falling into a Pitfall while the Black Hole is active will result in Isaac becoming headless, immobile and invulnerable, softlocking the run until it is quit and resumed.

fields.name: Black Hole
fields.description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.

Goat.title: Goat
Goat.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Goats are an enemy added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance.

Goats usually spawn in large groups and perform attacks depending on the number of other Goats around. When there is only 1 Goat it will chase Isaac and charge, attempting to ram him, if he is to his either side. If there are 2 Goats, one will perform the charge attack, the other will stop when near Isaac to shoot two blood shots in a spread followed by three blood shots in a spread in succession, similar to Krampus. Only 2 Goats can actively attack at one time and all other Goats will attempt to stay away from Isaac but can switch places with an active Goat if Isaac draws near to it.

sections.heading: Black Goat
sections.text: Black Goats act the same as Goats, but shoot three blood shots in a spread followed by four blood shots in a spread in succession, identical to Krampus. Additionally, they also gain the ability to shoot thin Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions. When one Black Goat performs a Brimstone attack all other Black Goats mimic it and perform the attack even if they were passive and not one of the 2 active goats. If there is only one Black Goat, it still retains the Brimstone in addition to its ramming attack.

Spider.title: Spider
Spider.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Spiders are arachnid enemies that can be commonly found in most chapters. They move quickly and will go in all directions randomly, making them unpredictable. However, if they have a direct line of sight on Isaac, and are close enough, they will move towards him. They are also able to fit through small diagonal gaps.

sections.heading: Big Spider
sections.text:
Big Spiders look like regular Spiders, but with a large black abdomen attached. They behave in the same way as the regular Spiders, having the same movement speed and erratic behavior. However, they have over triple the health of regular Spiders, and upon death, they will split into two regular Spiders. 

Alternatively, if a Big Spider's health is dropped to -20 or less in one instance (i.e., by using a Bomb), it will spawn nothing on death.

sections.heading: Swarm Spider
sections.text:
Swarm Spiders act much like normal Spiders but are much smaller and tend to come in much larger groups. They also hop and flash a bright yellow.

They are spawned by Eggy in large number when one dies.

Swarm Spiders cannot be damaged by Fire Places.

sections.heading: Strider
sections.text:
Striders are a type of spider that can only spawn in Downpour and special rooms in Dross. They glide on the water towards Isaac in short bursts and can swim across flooded gaps.

Striders replace all Spider spawns in the Downpour and Dross stages.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth onward] The following spiders will not attack Isaac, deal contact damage or actively spawn enemies if he has Bursting Sack:

• Spider, Big Spider, Level 2 Spider, Ticking Spider, Baby Long Legs, Small Baby Long Legs, Crazy Long Legs and Small Crazy Long Legs.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Spiders and Big Spiders no longer blink red when neutral due to it.

• [Repentance] Swarm Spiders no longer blink yellow when neutral due to it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The original Spider and Big Spider were first added to the original The Binding of Isaac game's DLC - Wrath of the Lamb.

• [Repentance] Striders are from the Antibirth mod. [end edition note] 

• Striders are named after the family Gerridae, also known as water striders.

• Swarm Spiders have the lowest Stage HP among all entities in the game by far. It takes until Caves I (etc.) before they have more than 5 HP, and then until Sheol / Cathedral before they have more than 6 HP.
