IBS.title: IBS
IBS.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: After dealing 40 + 13.33 \times (stageNumber - 1) damage to an enemy, Isaac begins to flash red. Releasing the fire button gives the effect of one of Tainted ???'s unique poops.

sections.heading: Throwable
sections.text:
Holds up one of the following types of poop, which he can throw with the fire buttons. All thrown poops deal 15 damage to enemies they hit when thrown (up to 3 times in the case of stone poop).

| Icon | ID | Name | Description 
| | 245.0 | Poop | A normal Poop, the same as those found in any run.

| | 245.12 | Corn Poop | Spawns a blue fly every two seconds. Each corn poop can have up to 3 blue flies out at a time, and the blue flies will circle the corn poop while inactive. The blue flies automatically seek out enemies that are near the player; they will not automatically seek out enemies near the corn poop.

| | 245.13 | Flaming Poop | Leaves behind a fire that damages enemies and blocks enemy shots. The fire lasts 5 seconds and can block five shots and/or deal three ticks of contact damage before disappearing (the first hit will deal 16.5 damage, the second and third will deal 11). While held, it can be used to destroy Shopkeepers by walking into or throwing the poop at them, although only in the room its used; the flame will extinguish if the room is exited.

| | 245.14 | Stinky Poop | Constantly emits a toxic cloud that deals 3.5 damage per tick to nearby enemies (10.5 damage per second). If an explosion or fire hits the cloud, it also explodes, dealing 15 damage to anything caught in the blast. When the poop is destroyed, it spawns a larger toxic cloud that can't explode and goes away after 5 seconds. If held, it can be used to poison enemies with the poison clouds while walking.

| | 245.15 | Black Poop | Continuously creates slowing black creep and, when destroyed, deals 10 damage to and confuses all enemies in the room. The poop will continue to create slowing creep even after it's destroyed.

| | 245.15 | White Poop | Acts the same as a poop created by Hallowed Ground. Tainted ??? also gains the poop's effects while holding it.

| | 245.11 | Stone Poop | Very resistant to damage and deals extra damage when thrown. It can hit multiple enemies when thrown, unlike all other poop types. It can stand several enemy hits, serving as a wall against bullets.

| | | Bomb | Explodes after 1.5 seconds even if Tainted ??? doesn't throw it. This bomb looks like one from Butt Bombs, but will not have its unique effect. It will, however, use most of Tainted ???'s bomb synergies except for Mr. Mega, Rocket in a Jar, Ring Cap, and Short Fuse.

sections.heading: Non-Throwable
sections.text:
| Icon | Name | Description 
| | Fart | Deals 5 damage and poisons nearby enemies while pushing them and their bullets back and spawning a toxic cloud. If an explosion or fire hits the cloud, it also explodes, dealing 15 damage to anything caught in the blast. Reflected bullets can damage enemies, similarly to Butter Bean.

| | Explosive Diarrhea | Drop 5 live bombs over time, similarly to the Explosive Diarrhea pill. These bombs will use Tainted ???'s bomb synergies.

| | Brown Creep | Create a trail of brown creep that deals 1.5x Tainted ???'s damage to enemies per tick (15x Tainted ???'s damage per second). Standing on this creep gives Tainted ??? +1 damage, +1.5 tears fired per second, and other effects, depending on what's in contact with it. This creep persists indefinitely. When in contact with:
Black Poop: the creep also slows enemies and gives Tainted ??? slowing tears.

Toxic cloud from Stinky poop: the creep poisons enemies and gives Tainted ??? poison tears.

Flaming Poop: the creep burns enemies and gives Tainted ??? Fire Mind.

White Poop & its Aura: the creep grants homing and triples Tainted ???'s fire rate and damage.

Stone Poop: the creep will keep all the extra effects of other poops, even if they are destroyed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The effect can only trigger once per 3 seconds.

• If IBS triggers while Isaac is charging a shot (with items such as Brimstone, Monstro's Lung, Chocolate Milk, etc.), the charged shot will only fire after IBS's effect activates. In the case of thrown poops, the charged shot only fires after Isaac throws the poop IBS gives him.

• Poops spawned by IBS can give pickups.

• If Isaac is currently holding a poop, IBS cannot activate until he throws it.

• Isaac can carry poop he is holding between rooms.

• If Isaac takes damage while holding a poop/bomb, he will drop it where he is standing.

• If Isaac hits an enemy with a thrown poop, it will immediately break.

• [Repentance+] Contributes to the Oh Crap transformation.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• IBS stands for Irritable Bowel Syndrome.

• This item was added after Edmund stated on Twitter that Isaac has IBS.

• In other tweets, Edmund has stated that he himself has IBS in real life.

fields.description: Causes Isaac to throw poop, create buffing creep, or drop bombs while fighting enemies.

III - The Empress.title: III - The Empress
III - The Empress.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Triggers the Whore of Babylon effect (+1.5 Damage, +0.3 Speed) for the current room, regardless of Isaac's total health.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• III - The Empress effect can be stacked with itself.

• The damage bonus is the number of uses squared, e.g. +1.5 × 4 × 4 damage for using the card via a Blank Card, with Tarot Cloth and Car Battery equipped.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • Since this effect only lasts for a room, it is preferably used against a boss.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Doubles the speed increase and quadruples the damage increase.

• Whore of Babylon: The effect stacks with each other, as they are the same.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Empress is the third card of a Major Arcana set.

fields.name: III - The Empress
fields.description: Triggers the Whore of Babylon effect (+1.5 Damage, +0.3 Speed) for the current room, regardless of Isaac's total health.

III - The Empress?.title: III - The Empress?
III - The Empress?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 2 temporary Red Heart Containers, +1.5 Fire Rate, and -0.1 Speed for one minute.

• Visually grants Magdalene's hairstyle while the effect is active.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The effect does not stack with itself.

• The card's effect persists in the Knife Piece 2 abandoned area.

• The temporary heart containers granted by III - The Empress? can be spent for purposes such as devil deals and Potato Peeler, and doing so will not affect Isaac's permanent containers after the effect runs out.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: Adds a total of three temporary heart containers.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• III - The Empress? will display a pop up saying "The morning sun has vanquished the horrible night", a reference to Castlevania II: Simon's Quest when night turns to day.

• This is also a reference to Whore of Babylon's (and by extension III - The Empress') pop up being the day to night message in said game.

fields.name: III - The Empress?
fields.description: Grants 2 temporary Red Heart Containers, +1.5 Fire Rate, and -0.1 Speed for one minute, along with Magdalene's hairstyle. The effect does not stack with itself.

II - The High Priestess.title: II - The High Priestess
II - The High Priestess.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Mom's dismembered leg stomps on the enemy with the most health, dealing 300 damage and destroying obstacles in the area.

• If used in an empty room or during the Mom fight, the foot stomps Isaac instead, dealing a full heart of damage.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Isaac can move to avoid the stomp.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The stomp is considered to be an explosion.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac can thus be immune to it with Host Hat or Pyromaniac

• [Repentance] Although it remains an explosion for other purposes, these items no longer protect Isaac against the stomp.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Since the foot is an explosion, it can be used as a substitute for Bombs.

• It can break rocks and open doors to Secret Rooms. [Repentance] However, unlike bombs, it cannot destroy machines and Beggars.

• In a room containing no enemies and a Shopkeeper, the foot will target it instead of Isaac.

• The foot deals 300 damage, enough to heavily weaken or even kill some bosses.

• All Chapter 1 bosses can be one shot from full health with one use of II - The High Priestess (except The Fallen for its two phases).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Another foot strikes down shortly after the first.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : No extra effect, only two feet are spawned.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: No effect.

• Stop Watch: Even though it's not visible, it makes the foot stomp twice, dealing 600 damage.

• Stop Watch + Tarot Cloth: A maximum of 1200 damage can be dealt.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The High Priestess is the second card of a Major Arcana set.

• The High Priestess, or The Popess, in most of her depictions is a reference to Pope Joan, a woman that became Pope by disguising herself as a man.

fields.name: II - The High Priestess
fields.description: Mom's dismembered leg stomps on the enemy with the most health, dealing 300 damage and destroying obstacles in the area. If used in an empty room or during the Mom fight, stomps Isaac instead. [Afterbirth+ onward] Isaac can move to avoid the stomp.

II - The High Priestess?.title: II - The High Priestess?
II - The High Priestess?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Mom's leg starts stomping down repeatedly, targeting Isaac, for one minute.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This card's effect is nearly identical to Broken Shovel 1's.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • If lacking bombs, II - The High Priestess? may be used to open secret rooms and destroy obstacles. It is however recommended to do so after a floor is cleared, as it can make dodging during combat more difficult.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: No effect.

• Broken Shovel 1: II - The High Priestess? does not stack with the Broken Shovel's effect. The stomp frequency remains the same.

fields.name: II - The High Priestess?
fields.description: Mom's leg starts stomping down repeatedly, targeting Isaac, for one minute, like holding Broken Shovel 1.

IV - The Emperor.title: IV - The Emperor
IV - The Emperor.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Teleports Isaac into the Boss Room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Using IV - The Emperor on a floor that doesn't have a Boss Room will teleport Isaac to a random room.

• Using IV - The Emperor in The Void will always teleport you to a random unexplored boss room in priority.

• On a [curse: labyrinth] floor, IV - The Emperor will usually teleport Isaac to the second boss room; however, it is possible to be teleported to the first one instead.

• When [curse: Maze] is active, using this card can teleport Isaac to a random room instead.

• IV - The Emperor cannot appear in greed mode.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • Once the boss is defeated, or when one is ready to face the boss, IV - The Emperor can be used to escape dangerous rooms like Curse Rooms and Challenge Rooms.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: If the boss has not yet been defeated, grants a Soul Heart on top of teleporting Isaac.

• Tarot Cloth + Blank Card + Car Battery : Grants 2 soul hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Sol: Using this card to defeat the boss earlier can allow more utilization of Sol’s stat boost, curse removal, and mapping, for the remainder of the floor.

• Tarot Cloth: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Emperor is the fourth card of a Major Arcana set.

fields.name: IV - The Emperor
fields.description: Teleports Isaac into the Boss Room.

IV - The Emperor?.title: IV - The Emperor?
IV - The Emperor?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Teleports Isaac into an extra Boss Room from the boss pool two floors deeper than the current floor (but never a final boss). The boss will drop a reward. Exiting the room returns Isaac to where he used the card.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Using IV - The Emperor? in Womb / Utero/ Scarred Womb / Corpse I or II will teleport Isaac to a boss fight from the current boss pool.

• Using it in Sheol / Cathedral / Dark Room / Chest / The Void / Home will teleport Isaac to a random room.

• Using it in ??? will teleport Isaac to a boss fight from the Womb boss pool.

• Using it in an I AM ERROR room or a Black Market will take Isaac to the last room he was in when exited, allowing him to further explore the floor.

• Using IV - The Emperor? again on the same floor after defeating the boss it spawns takes Isaac back to the same cleared Boss room.

• If IV - The Emperor? is used in Chapter 3 (i.e. Depths), the Chapter 4 boss will only deal regular damage to Isaac, rather than the whole heart damage penalty of the chapter.

• This is one of the few situations where bosses such as It Lives! dealing a whole heart of projectile damage, or Daddy Long Legs dealing a whole heart of contact damage takes effect.

• Devil Rooms / Angel Rooms do not appear from the extra boss rooms.

• IV - The Emperor? cannot spawn in greed mode.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• IV - The Emperor? can be used to steal an item from Boss Rush without going through the waves. After taking the item, using the card and defeating the extra boss, leaving the room will lead Isaac to the regular, locked Mom boss room. [end edition note] 

• Challenge Rooms / Boss Challenge Rooms can also be stolen from. Returning to the room after defeating the extra boss will make the room inactive (until another element is interacted with).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blanket: A shield is granted upon teleporting to the extra boss room.

• Hairpin: The currently held active item is fully charged the first time the extra boss room is teleported to. The normal boss room also charges the active item.

• There's Options: The extra boss room's reward will be two choice pedestals.

• Tick: Heals 1 Red Heart upon teleporting to the extra boss room. The normal boss room also provides healing.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: No effect.

• Book of Revelations: Does not guarantee the extra boss to be a harbinger.

• Satanic Bible: The extra boss room's reward is also transformed into a devil deal.

• Sol: Defeating the extra boss will not activate Sol's effect.

• Vanishing Twin: The twin will clone the extra boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. The vanishing twin familiar is consumed and will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the familiar won't respawn until the next floor.

fields.name: IV - The Emperor?
fields.quote: May you find a worthy opponent
fields.description: Teleports Isaac into an extra Boss Room from the boss pool two floors deeper than the current floor (but never a final boss). The boss will drop a reward. Exiting the room returns Isaac to where he used the card.

IV Bag.title: IV Bag
IV Bag.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, causes Isaac to lose half a heart of health (or a full heart in Chapter 4 onward) while spawning coins.

• [Before Repentance] Each use pays out with 1-2 coins.

• [Repentance] Each use pays out with 1-2 coins on Normal mode or 1 coin on Hard mode.

• IV Bag takes Red Hearts before other heart types.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can be found when causing a [machine: Blood Donation Machine] to explode by donating Hearts to it.

• This effect is counted as inflicted damage for items that spawn pickups upon said inflicted damage, such as Gimpy or Fanny Pack, but does not decrease the chance of encountering the Devil Room / Angel Room.

• Can be used before taking damage (getting hit, walking over spikes, going through a Curse Room, etc.) to grant coins without inflicting extra damage.

• [Before Repentance] Also allows Isaac to avoid damage taken by using a [machine: Blood Donation Machine] or [machine: Devil Beggar] .

• Using this item as The Lost or while in the Lost form after touching the White Fire Place kills Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Gives a temporary +0.66 damage up with each use.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps in the outer ring, resembling coins. The wisps only have one health.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's Heart: Can be used without taking damage, resulting in an infinite amount of coins.

• [Afterbirth onward] Isaac still takes damage from this during The Guardian. [end edition note] 

• PHD:

• [Before Repentance] Increases each payout to 2-3 coins.

• [Repentance] Increases each payout to 2-3 coins on Normal mode and 2 on Hard mode.

• Portable Slot: Can be alternated between to gain ridiculous amounts of pickups from only a few initial coins or hearts.

• [Before Repentance] Scapular: Allows for infinite coins once Isaac is at half a red heart (or full red heart in Chapter 4 onward) by moving between rooms to reset Scapular's effect.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Spawns 0-1 coins instead.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Invulnerability and shields can't be used to prevent damage from IV Bag, even if it normally prevents damage from a Blood Donation Machine.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Cracked Dice: Rerolls the coins generated by IV bag, and can be used to generate unlimited pickups and items.

• [Afterbirth onward] Holy Mantle and similar items: IV Bag ignores the shield's protection, resulting in Isaac taking damage regardless.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • A glitch in the original The Binding of Isaac existed where the player could leave a room and activate the item during the invincibility frames offered during recovery of using the items, effectively spawning infinite coins.

fields.description: Damages Isaac and spawns a random amount of coins, similar to a Blood Donation Machine.

IX - The Hermit.title: IX - The Hermit
IX - The Hermit.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Teleports Isaac to the Shop.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Using IX - The Hermit on a floor that doesn't have a Shop will teleport Isaac to a random room.

• When [curse: Maze] is active, using this card can teleport Isaac to a random room instead.

• IX - The Hermit cannot appear in greed mode.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• IX - The Hermit allows to access the shop without using a key.

• IX - The Hermit can be used to escape any room that locks down after taking its contents, like Challenge Rooms or Boss Rush, effectively "stealing" its contents without facing the imposed challenge.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: Prevents Greed / Super Greed from spawning in the shop. If Greed was already defeated in the shop, using the card turns it into a normal shop (Does not create a working shop in the Mirrored World).

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Hermit is the ninth card of a Major Arcana set.

• [Repentance] There is one room in the game (in Dross) that contains a guaranteed Hermit card (see Gallery). [end edition note]

fields.name: IX - The Hermit

sections.text:
• For maximum profit, any card, rune, pill or trinket should be gathered to the same room before using IX - The Hermit?.

• Since cheap or discounted shop items are still converted to the full 15 cents, this can be used to generate profit.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: Spawns 1 additional Penny.

• Moving Box: Allows for transport of items and pickups to the same room. Making more money from one use of IX - The Hermit?.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dad's Note: Not affected by IX - The Hermit?. If the room only has Dad's Note, a Penny will spawn.

• Tainted ???: Poop pickups can't be sold.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • IX - The Hermit?'s effect is based directly on the Rune of Fehu from Antibirth. No other Antibirth rune was adapted into Repentance.

fields.name: IX - The Hermit?
fields.quote: May you see the value of all things in life
fields.description: Turns items, trinkets, and pickups in the room into coins. If there is nothing to sell, drops a Penny.

Ice Cube.title: Ice Cube
Ice Cube.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Cube Baby]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon entering a room, each enemy has a 20% chance to be petrified for 4 seconds. Enemies that have been petrified by Ice Cube are frozen when killed, [Before Repentance+] including those killed up to 2 seconds after the petrifaction effect ends.

• The chance for enemies to be petrified increases with luck, reaching 100% at 40 Luck.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Enemies spawned in waves are not petrified.

• Bosses can be petrified, but cannot be frozen.

• Every room has a predetermined set of enemies that are going to be petrified. Re-entering the room will not change this, similarly to Champion enemies.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increase the base chance to petrify enemies upon entering a room to 33%. Having both increase the base chance to 50%.

• Second Hand: Extends the time period that allows for enemies to be frozen after the petrifaction effect ends from 2 to 6 seconds.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The reason Ice Cube is unlocked by completing Pica Run is probably due to pagophagia (the desire to eat ice), a common example of pica.

fields.description: Adds a chance to petrify enemies when entering the room. Killing the petrified enemy freezes it.

Immaculate Conception.title: Immaculate Conception
Immaculate Conception.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon picking up 15 heart pickups, Isaac gains a permanent angelic familiar and generates a Soul Heart drop. Possible familiars include:

• Holy Water

• Guardian Angel

• Sworn Protector

• The Relic

• Seraphim

• All five familiars will spawn in a random order.

• Isaac will look progressively more pregnant as he collects heart pickups.

• The familiars spawned by Immaculate Conception will not contribute to transformations, such as Conjoined, nor do they count towards the collection page.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• After all five familiars have been spawned, a Soul Heart will still drop every 15 hearts collected.

• All types of hearts except Gold Hearts and Blended Hearts count.

• Items that directly add health such as Yum Heart, Book of Revelations, Satanic Bible, and The Nail do not count towards spawning a familiar.

• The Lost can pick up Soul Hearts and Black Hearts despite having no health and thus can activate Immaculate Conception.

• [Before Repentance+] Keeper and Tainted Keeper cannot encounter hearts, thus the item is useless for them. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] Healing Keeper and Tainted Keeper with coins counts for Immaculate conception. [end edition note] 

• As the short-lived Half Red Hearts dropped by Tainted Magdalene also count, it is an excellent choice for her since she will constantly be picking up hearts and gain all five familiars quickly.

• Familiars spawned by the item do not affect item pools, so multiple copies of one familiar can be obtained. For example, a second Seraphim can be purchased after Immaculate Conception spawns one.

• As with Cambion Conception, if this item is removed in any way (such as with a XVII - The Stars?), the familiars from Cambion Conception will be removed upon updating familiars, including picking up items that don't add familiars but update its cache, such as Brimstone.

• If the item is re-obtained after being removed (e.g. by dropping the item as Tainted Isaac), any familiars that were removed will return once familiars are updated.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Hypercoagulation: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.

• The Jar: Hearts collected in the jar do not count towards activation.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is the angelic counterpart to Cambion Conception.

• Immaculate Conception refers to the Catholic teaching that the conception of the Virgin Mary was free from original sin.

fields.description: Upon picking up a certain amount of health, spawn a permanent angelic familiar.

Immaculate Heart.title: Immaculate Heart
Immaculate Heart.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Sacred Heart]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac will frequently fire extra spectral tears that orbit around him until they hit the ground, similar to Tiny Planet. These tears mimic Isaac's in most cases.

• x1.2 damage multiplier. This multiplier does not stack with multiple Immaculate Hearts.

• Adds one Red Heart Container and fully replenishes Isaac's health.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The tears cannot push active Bombs and Troll Bombs.

• The tears can extinguish Fire Places and set off TNT.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Angelic Prism: The extra tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.

• Chemical Peel: Some of the orbiting tears will gain Chemical Peel's 2 flat damage bonus.

• Chocolate Milk: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.

• Death's Touch: Death's Touch tear modification will also affect the orbiting tears.

• Eye of Belial: Orbiting tears get piercing and homing on nearby enemies on contact, and return orbiting after no targets left.

• Haemolacria: The orbiting tears will be affected by Haemolacria but the tears created upon hit will not orbit.

• Lachryphagy: Lachryphagy will affect the orbiting tears and become bigger when in contact with other tears. The Lachryphagy tears will split upon hit and the split shots will orbit around the point where the original tear had split.

• The Ludovico Technique: Isaac will frequently shoot tears that orbit around him, even without pressing any fire buttons.

• Monstro's Lung: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.

• Urn of Souls: Each individual flame shot from the Urn has a chance to spawn an orbiting tear.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Tears will orbit very close and fast around Isaac's body, and return to normal orbit once he stops firing.

• Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.

• Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

• Eye of the Occult: Orbiting tears cannot be controlled.

• Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier does not stack with that from a white poop.

• Incubus: The orbiting tears will orbit whoever fired it, whether it be Isaac or the Incubus.

• Ipecac: Orbiting tears explode.

• Tainted Bethany: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.

• Technology 2: The laser does not contribute in generating orbiting tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Immaculate Heart originates from the Antibirth mod.

• The Immaculate Heart of Mary is a Catholic devotion, which represents purity, love, and compassion of Mary.

fields.description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.

Incubus.title: Incubus
Incubus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).

• [Before Repentance] Incubus' tears ignore Isaac's range and shot speed.

• [Repentance] Incubus' damage is reduced by 25% when playing as characters other than Lilith and Tainted Lilith.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Conjoined transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Lilith's starting Incubus is technically not a collected item but an intrinsic part of the character, and is removed if an item such as Ankh or Clicker are used to become a different character. As such, playing as Lilith will not add Incubus to the collection page, nor does her personal Incubus count towards the Conjoined transformation.

• Incubus is one of the familiars that can be spawned by Cambion Conception. However, receiving one in this way does not count towards Conjoined.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Incubus having 2nd priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Azazel / Brimstone: Fires a full-length Brimstone laser that can be charged while still firing the previous laser, allowing it to fire more rapidly than normal.

• The laser fired by Incubus has the same width as Lil Brimstone's.

• [Repentance] When playing as Azazel, Incubus' Brimstone laser has the same range as him.

• [Repentance] Multiple copies of Brimstone will not grant Incubus the mega brimstone effect.

• [Repentance] Berserk! / The Forgotten / Spirit Sword: Incubus will carry the respective melee weapon, using it exactly like Isaac. [end edition note] 

• BFFS!: Shoots tears that do [edition alternatives: baseline: 2x; Repentance: 1.5x (2x as Lilith)] Isaac's damage.

• Cursed Eye: A burst of 3 tears is fired at the regular tear delay without needing to charge.

• [Repentance] Incubus now charges and fires a burst of up to 5 tears just as Isaac would.

• Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the fire rate of Incubus. This notably makes it fire and charge-attack faster than Isaac does.

• Immaculate Heart: Incubus can create its own orbiting tears, which will orbit the Incubus that created it, and not Isaac.

• Technology 2: Incubus can fire the Technology 2 laser too.

• Tractor Beam: The Incubus tears will follow the beam. This makes it seem as if the tears come directly from Isaac, even if blindfolded.

• [edition anr] Tractor Beam + Monstro's Lung: Also allows the Incubus tears to follow the beam.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
No effect on Incubus:

• Bird's Eye

• Cursed Eye

• Epic Fetus

• Evil Eye

• Eye of Greed

• Ghost Pepper

• Large Zit

• Loki's Horns

• Maw Of The Void

• Mom's Eye

• R U a Wizard?

• Tech.5
Only stat effects are applied; otherwise no effect on Incubus:

• Analog Stick

• Eye Drops

• Marked

• Maw Of The Void

• Technology 2

• Tractor Beam
Other interactions:

• [Before Repentance] Dead Eye: Only Isaac's tears affect the damage multiplier.

• Dr. Fetus: A dangerous combination, since familiars naturally stay behind the character, and the character's movement may block the bomb, which causes self-damage easily.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] The Forgotten: Fires bone tears like Compound Fracture without the splitting effect. Reverts to normal tears when switching to The Soul. [end edition note] 

• Flat Stone: The effective range of Incubus' tears is roughly doubled, with a single bounce in the middle of the flight.

• Guillotine: Incubus will fire tears in relative position to its body depending on where Isaac's head is currently.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's Tears: The item is recharged by Isaac's tears, not Incubus'. This item works with Lilith.

• [Repentance] Incubus' tears contribute to the item charge.

• Kidney Stone: Incubus ignores the range down from this item, and will fire the tear barrage but not the stone.

• [Repentance] Incubus is still able to fire tears while Kidney Stone is charging.

• The Ludovico Technique: Incubus' tears become piercing and spectral but otherwise fires normal tears.

• My Reflection: Since Incubus ignores shot speed the tears turn back very quickly, greatly reducing effective range.

• Tech X: Incubus shoots small, fixed-size Tech X laser rings, with a very slightly longer minimum charge than Isaac.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In folklore, incubi are evil spirits said to descend upon sleeping people, specifically ones fabled to have sexual intercourse with women during their sleep, or, more simply put, the male version of a succubus.

• If playing with a controller, you will notice the shooting deadzone for the incubus is smaller than Isaac's.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires copies of Isaac's tears with reduced size (or width for some special attacks).

Infamy.title: Infamy
Infamy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Enemy shots that hit Isaac have a 50% chance to be blocked.

• After effectively blocking a projectile, Isaac will briefly flash blue. Isaac in this state can still take damage from another projectile.

• Can block:

• • Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), but their lines of fire harm Isaac.

• • Fire projectiles (e.g. from Mega Satan).

• • Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti.

• Does not block:

• • Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle).

• • Lasers or beams.

• • Lines of fire from fireballs.

• • Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Mask of Infamy. [end edition note] 

• Although the mask is seen only on Isaac's face, projectiles still have a 50% chance to be blocked from any direction.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Cone Head: Blocking effect from either item can occur.

• This leaves Isaac 60% chance to negate tears.

• Holy Card / Holy Mantle: Infamy's chance of blocking projectiles is applied before the shield, allowing the shield to be saved.

• Host Hat: Infamy's blocking effect is applied first. Host Hat does not fire tears when a tear is blocked by Infamy.

• This leaves Isaac 60% chance to negate tears in any way.

• Infamy: Additional copies of this item, such as from Diplopia / Crooked Penny, have no effect.

• Metal Plate: Infamy's blocking effect is applied first. Tears blocked by Infamy are not reflected by Metal Plate.

• This leaves Isaac 62.5% chance to negate tears in any way.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the Mask of Infamy boss.

• This item is used in The Tank.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Damage reduction; Repentance: Blocks damage... sometimes]
fields.description: Gives Isaac a 50% chance to block projectiles coming from any direction.

Infestation.title: Infestation
Infestation.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] 1-3 Blue Flies spawn whenever Isaac takes damage.

• [Repentance] 2-6 Blue Flies spawn whenever Isaac takes damage.

• [Repentance+] Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Husk. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Fish Tail: Doubles number of flies spawned.

• Hive Mind: Flies are bigger and deal double damage.

fields.image name: * [edition alternatives: Before Afterbirth+: Rebirth; Before Repentance: Afterbirth+]
fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: They grow inside; Repentance: Fly revenge]
fields.description:
[Before Repentance] 1-3 Blue Flies randomly spawn every time Isaac gets hit.
[Repentance] 2-6 Blue Flies randomly spawn every time Isaac gets hit.

Infestation 2.title: Infestation 2
Infestation 2.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns an allied Blue Spider from each enemy that is killed.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Enemies do not spawn Blue Spiders when killed by anything not controlled by Isaac (environmental hazards, charmed enemies, death upon clearing room, etc).

• Enemies do not spawn Blue Spiders when killed by Blue Spiders.

• Blue Flies can also spawn Blue Spiders.

• Enemies killed by familiars will spawn Blue Spiders.

• [Before Repentance] Destroyed Shopkeepers will spawn Blue Spiders.

• Destroying normally invulnerable enemies such as Poky will spawn Blue Spiders.

• [Before Repentance] Killing Pin will give one Blue Spider for each of his segments.

• Dark Balls spawned by Little Horn can also drop Blue Spiders upon death.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t spawn spiders.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn spiders.

• Jar of Flies: Blue Flies spawned by Jar of Flies spawn Blue Spiders, and Blue Spiders spawned by Infestation 2 grant extra flies for Jar of Flies

fields.description: Spawns allied Blue Spiders from killed enemies.

Inner Child.title: Inner Child
Inner Child.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.

• If Isaac doesn't have any Red Heart Containers, he will respawn with a Half Soul Heart instead of a Half Red Heart.

• When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Resurrection items activate in a set order. Inner Child is 5th in this order after Soul of Lazarus, 1up!, Lazarus' inherent extra life, and Dead Cat.

• Once this item has been unlocked, if the current character's Tainted version was already unlocked or the current character is a Tainted character, it is guaranteed to spawn in the hidden closet in Home.

• This item will appear even if Inner Child had been obtained earlier in the run, allowing Isaac to have two copies of the item.

• Despite being hard-coded not to appear anywhere else for him, this specific occurrence of Inner Child will still spawn for Tainted Lost.

• If this item is obtained in Home, a viable strategy is to intentionally die towards the end of the fight with Dogma. Isaac will be respawned with the size down and Speed up, and these effects will carry over to the Beast fight along with the healing provided by Dogma, making Isaac much harder to hit for the fight. 

• • If Isaac's health consists of only Red Hearts, a safer strategy may be to use bombs to die in the starting room of Home to trigger the item's effects and then use the bed in that room to recover all Red Hearts back.

• The size down from being revived by Inner Child is the same as if Isaac had collected Pluto.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Inner Child is a concept in popular psychology that there exists an "inner child" in every sub-conscious that contains memories of pain and trauma in youth.

• Specifically, Inner Child spawning in the Home closet may be a reference to the trauma seen in the Ending 21 (Mother's Ending) – where Mom throws Isaac into a closet.

• In the reverse, perhaps the ending is also allegorical rather than historical: Mom's constant abuse "threw" Isaac's inner child into a closet.

• This is one of the very few items without the offensive tag that Tainted Lost can obtain without the use of Spindown Dice.

fields.description: Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.

Ipecac.title: Ipecac
Ipecac.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Rubber Cement]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Replaces tears with explosive and poisoning projectiles fired in an arc.

• [Before Repentance] Tears down − (Delay × 2) + 10

• [Repentance] 1/3 Fire Rate

• [Before Repentance] Tear Falling Speed is set to 13.

• [Repentance] 0.8× range multiplier.

• [Repentance] 0.8× shot speed multiplier.

• +40 flat damage (See Effective Damage)

• Tear size multiplier: 0.4×

• Contributes to the Bob transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Enemies within the blast radius of an Ipecac explosion will also be poisoned.

• The damage boost mitigates the very small tear size multiplier.

• Ipecac's damage bonus does not apply to Burn or Poison fully; only [Before Repentance] +4/ [Repentance] +2 is applied to their damage per tick.

• Character damage multipliers do not apply to Ipecac's flat bonus.

• Since explosions that deal less than 85 damage hurt Isaac for half a heart, Ipecac shots usually hurt Isaac for half a heart.

• Self-damage is increased to a full heart with 85 or higher damage stat.

• If Isaac's damage is above [Before Repentance] 100 / [Repentance] 166, Ipecac's explosions will shake the screen. This is just a visual effect.

• [Repentance] A big enough tear size (~827 damage with no other tear size modifiers) will cause the explosion sound to change to the one used by Mama Mega!.

• [Repentance] The height of the shots scales with range. At base stats, Ipecac shots won't be able to fly over obstacles, but the more range ups Isaac gets, the higher shots will be launched.

• [Repentance] It is possible that with low shot speed and high range/tear height, Isaac won't be able to hit obstacles up close with Ipecac shots.

• [Before Repentance] The range of the explosion is a circle roughly 3 blocks in diameter, regardless of damage.

• As Ipecac's explosion range does not scale with tear size, with enough tear size increasing items (e.g. Death's Touch), it can become nearly impossible to hit enemies with Ipecac's explosions.

• [Repentance] Ipecac's explosion range increases with tear size.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Ipecac it turns into a larger slow moving green locust that deals x1.5 Isaac’s damage per tick and poisons enemies.

• Brain Worm: The Ipecac tears will snap 90 degrees and rain down at nearby enemy should the shot miss, completely eliminating the shortcoming of having too much range and causing Ipecac tears to fly over enemy's head, missing them.

• [Afterbirth only] Brimstone / Azazel: No explosive beam or stat change. Beam poisons enemies. [end edition note] 

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Isaac shoots Ipecac tears while charging Brimstone. Both Brimstone and Ipecac shots modify Isaac's damage and tear delay stat, meaning that Ipecac fires slower and Brimstone charges slower, but Brimstone does an extra 40*13 damage. Take care to pre-charge Brimstone so that the Ipecac shot is on cooldown as Isaac enters a room.

• [Repentance] Blood beam now does poison damage and will explode on connection with an enemy which can damage the character if close enough. The character doesn't gain the Damage Up or Tears Down effects. The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2, but Isaac's tear rate stat is not modified. The beam explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur when the beam narrows, meaning that they occur only twice per shot without Soy Milk / Almond Milk. The beam and its explosions poison enemies.

• Cricket's Body: The main tear splits into four explosive splash tears. The splash tears can still damage Isaac.

• [Repentance] Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Cricket's Body's own x0.8 range multiplier.

• C Section: The fetuses explode once they touch an enemy, poisoning and dealing damage equal to Isaac's Damage.

• Dr. Fetus: Bombs explode on contact, do no damage to Isaac and become Bob's Curse bombs.

• [Before Repentance] The damage is massively increased, as the +40 damage from Ipecac is run through the damage multiplier of Dr. Fetus.

• [Repentance] The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. Bombs leave a poison cloud that damages enemies. With Jacob and Esau only the character with the items is immune to the explosions.

• Dr. Fetus + Monstro's Lung: Renders Isaac no longer immune to his shots. [Repentance] The flat damage bonus is increased back to +40.

• Dr. Fetus + Sad Bombs: Isaac is not immune to the explosive shots created by the Sad Bombs' effect.

• Epic Fetus: Missiles turn green and are poisonous. Damage greatly increases as the flat damage bonus stacks with Epic Fetus' explosive multiplier.

• Flat Stone: The Ipecac shots cause full-damage explosions instead of lesser splash damage when they bounce off the floor, though they can also harm Isaac.

• [Repentance] Each bounce creates an explosion that deals half Isaac's damage as well as dealing the regular splash damage. The bounce explosion radius is slightly larger than the splash radius.

• The Forgotten: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. Melee attacks become poisonous and explosive; he cannot be hurt by the blasts but is pushed back by them. The explosions deal 1.5x damage. The charged throwing attack is only poisonous. The Soul uses Ipecac as normal.

• [Repentance] The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The thrown bone club can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.8x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged, and do no self-damage.

• [Repentance] When the skeleton form has Technology, the thrown bone club constantly explodes and deals damage to The Forgotten.

• Haemolacria: Tear delay is increased by 1/3 compared to either of the items on their own, but Isaac now fires Ipecac shots that release poisonous, high-damage but non-explosive split tears on impact.

• [Repentance] Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does not stack with Haemolacria's own x0.8 range multiplier.

• The Ludovico Technique: Tear damage is increased by 4, explodes when killing an enemy, and comes back to Isaac.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] +4 flat damage bonus, no explosion.

• [Repentance] +2 flat damage bonus, no explosion.

• Maw Of The Void: The ring becomes poisonous and explodes on the first enemy or obstacle contact it hits every other tick, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's Damage. The explosions do not occur for the first four ticks.

• Mom's Knife: Knife turns green, may poison enemies, and removes Ipecac's damage increase.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Also adds +4 flat damage bonus.

• [Repentance] Also adds +2 flat damage bonus. The thrown knife can explode once on enemy contact while being sent out, but not while returning. These explosions deal from 10 + 2.1x to 10 + 6x Damage based on how much the attack is charged.

• Monstro's Lung: Isaac fires a barrage of Ipecac shots, with no increase in charge time compared to Monstro's Lung alone.

• [Repentance] Charge time increases by 3x.

• Montezuma's Revenge: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.

• Mysterious Liquid: Leaves a massive pool of creep on the floor on impact.

• The Parasite: The Ipecac tear will spawn two smaller explosive tears when it collides with a solid object, but not with an enemy. These tears can spawn tears on their own as well, potentially leading to huge chain reactions.

• Revelation: The laser gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The laser explodes on the first enemy or obstacle it hits every other tick. The explosions occur 8 times and deal 10 + twice of the laser's damage.

• Tech X: The flat damage bonus is reduced to +4. The laser ring becomes poisonous.

• [Repentance] The flat damage bonus is reduced to +2. The laser ring becomes poisonous and explodes every other tick on contact, deal 10 + twice of the ring's damage. Knockback from the blasts will push enemies along the path of the ring, prolonging damage. The ring will not open Secret Rooms if the entrance is on the bottom wall since the ring will never explode against the bottom wall.

• Technology: Removes the flat damage bonus, poisonous laser.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] +4 flat damage bonus, poisonous laser.

• [Repentance] +2 flat damage bonus, poisonous laser that explodes on enemy or obstacle contact, deal 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Keeps Ipecac's stats other than damage.

• • Note: This combination is not advised if the player has the Multidimensional Baby familiar. When the ipecac technology laser passes through the Multidimensional Baby, it instantly explodes, damaging the player and likely being fatal for the run. [end edition note] 

• Trisagion: Trisagion blasts do not explode on hit. The explosion happen once the blast runs out of range or hits a wall and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.

• [Repentance] Trisagion blasts are poisonous and explode upon impact with an enemy or obstacle, dealing 10 + twice of the blast's damage. When the base of the blast reaches an enemy or obstacle, it explodes and deals damage equal to Isaac's Damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 120 Volt: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.

• Crown Of Light / Polyphemus / Proptosis / Sacred Heart / Bloody Lust: The damage multipliers from these items do not apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, resulting in much lower damage increase than expected.

• Chocolate Milk: Charged up Ipecac deals expectedly high damage. Rapid-fire can be used against weaker enemies or to clear obstacles when necessary.

• Cricket's Head / Eve's Mascara / Magic Mushroom: The damage multipliers from these items apply to Ipecac's +40 bonus, unlike others.

• Death's Touch: Although damage is increased, the tears' hitboxes also grow larger, which may be detrimental.

• Fire Mind: Due to the nature of the Ipecac, all shots will have a 100% chance of leaving a fire at the center of the explosion. [Before Repentance] It will also no longer leave behind green creep and the explosion will be of normal color instead of green.

• Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, instead of the expected +20.

• Ghost Pepper: If a fire is generated at the same time as an Ipecac shot, the Ipecac shot will explode instantly.

• Glass Cannon: As the Glass Cannon tears are so large, even a modest damage increase or a single tear size increasing item is likely to render the tear unable to damage enemies.

• Holy Light: A beam of light will spawn on top of any enemy within the explosion's radius.

• Jacob's Ladder: The sparks spawn only when they hit a wall.

• Little Horn: If an Ipecac shot has the Little Horn effect, after destroying an enemy, it loses its explosive property and effectively is just a normal Little Horn tear.

• Lost Contact: Ipecac shots will explode on contact with enemy shots.

• Mom's Eye / Loki's Horns: Occasionally shoots backwards or in all 4 directions, with high risk of self-damage.

• Number One: Not recommended. Unlike other similar items, Ipecac's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Number One's own x0.8 range multiplier, making self-damage more likely.

• Parasitoid: Only extra range applies on egg sack tears and they will not spawn flies or spiders.

• Piercing tears: Tears will still explode on enemy contact, nullifying piercing.

• Rubber Cement: Tears will bounce off walls and rocks and won't explode until they hit the ground. Not recommended, as self-damage is likely.

• Spectral tears: Ipecac shots no longer explode on contact with obstacles or walls, making accidental self-damage less likely but more difficult to open doors.

• Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten's melee attacks will explode. Tainted Soul is immune only to those explosions, so any further explosions caused by synergies will damage it.

• Technology 2: The +40 damage bonus is not affected by the Technology 2 multiplier, making the laser very high powered, but only every other Ipecac shot is fired.

• Technology Zero: High fire rate needed for explosive shots to be connected.

• Tiny Planet: Ipecac tears orbit around Isaac for a very long time. They land far enough to not cause self-damage, but that can be relied on only if Isaac is not moving and do not hit enemies.

• Tractor Beam: The Ipecac tear will travel in an arc along the beam, even if Isaac is moving forward as well. When Isaac changes direction, the tear will snap to the beam, making it very easy to accidentally hit close objects blocking its new path.

• Brimstone + Monstro's Lung: The erratically fired lasers can easily hit rocks or enemies near Isaac, damaging him. This affect is worsened by Azazel's need to be close to enemies to damage them. Be wary of this synergy without explosion immunity.

Isaac.title: Isaac
Isaac.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the character; the boss of The Cathedral; Isaac (Boss)] 
Isaac is the main character of the series, returning from the original The Binding of Isaac from 2011. He is the only character unlocked by default.

Isaac starts with three Red Heart containers and one Bomb. He will also start with The D6 once it is unlocked (after defeating Isaac as ???).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Isaac is the basic character, with average stats. Unlocking The D6 is invaluable for him as it allows him to see many more items. See The D6's article for detailed tips.

• [Before Repentance] The D6 that Isaac can start with does not increase the special item counter.

sections.heading: Item Interactions
sections.text: • Birthright: All new item pedestals cycle between two options. Previously seen items are unaffected.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Isaac's Head, Lost Baby, Mom's Knife, Isaac's Tears, Missing Poster, The D20, Lil' Chest, D1, Fart Baby, Cry Baby, D infinity, Meat Cleaver, Options?, The Broken, Buddy Baby]

sections.heading: Unlockable Starting Items
sections.text: • [achievement unlock: The D6] - Start with The D6

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Isaac is a reference to the biblical story of the binding of Isaac, in which Abraham is commanded by God to sacrifice his only son, Isaac, to prove his loyalty and love.

• "Then God said, 'Take your son, your only son, whom you love — Isaac — and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you.'" (Genesis 22:2)

• Isaac's dad is also a reference to this story, as his name is Abraham.

• Isaac's in-game ability to replace items on pedestals (via The D6, Glitched Crown / Tainted Isaac, or Birthright) could reference how, in the Bible, Isaac was replaced by a lamb on the sacrificial pedestal.

• In a response to TBoI YouTuber Sinvicta of whether there was any concept art of what Isaac's original design was, Edmund McMillen confirmed that Isaac's design was originally one of an Octorok while showing very similar features of how the gameplay would be modeled by posting an old concept art.

• Edmund has stated that Isaac is left-handed, but in the opening cutscene, Isaac is holding a pencil with his right hand.

• This could be a reference to the Catholic bias against left-handedness, stemming from Matthew 25:33 proclaiming that God will put those deserving to ascend to Heaven on his right-hand side and put those deserving to descend to Hell on his left-hand side. Isaac's mother could have forced him to work right-handed. The general practice of forcing left-handed people to use their right hands having also been a practice for a long time, with the acceptance of left-handed people only starting to show in 1971.

• Contrary to previous theories made about Isaac, he does not have a sister.

• Isaac is bald because his mother shaved his head. This could be a reference to the "Nazarite Vow" in Numbers 6:1–21.

• Isaac's natural hair color is strawberry blonde.

• Isaac has Irritable Bowel Syndrome.

• Isaac's dad is a handyman.

• Isaac's full name is Isaac Moriah, and he is 5 years old.

• This is in reference to Mount Moriah, the place where Abraham takes his son Isaac to be sacrificed, in the Book of Genesis.

• Isaac's racial background is White/Hispanic.

• By around the events of The Binding of Isaac, Isaac was already homeschooled.

• Edmund McMillen confirmed that Isaac's status is deceased.

• Isaac is circumcised. This was confirmed by Edmund McMillen during a YouTube stream.

• Isaac's voiceover in Rebirth was done by Tallulah Bossi, Matthias Bossi (Member of Ridiculon and voice of Dad/Narrator) and Carla Kihlstedt's (Musician and voice of Mom) daughter. For Repentance, the voice was done by their son, Viggo Bossi.

• Isaac is gender-confused and genderfluid.

• On the Unboxing Of Isaac stream #5, Edmund McMillen stated that Isaac is at least taller than 3 apples.

• More specifically, Isaac is 3.3 feet tall and weighs 43 pounds.

• Isaac has Dissociative Identity Disorder.

• Edmund McMillen has stated that Isaac has Dyslexia and Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder.

• Edmund has also stated that Isaac also has an Anxiety Disorder.

Isaac (Boss).title: Isaac (Boss)
Isaac (Boss).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the boss; the character; Isaac] 

Isaac is the boss of the Cathedral, and the final boss of Ending 13.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Isaac lies on the ground in the middle of the room and does not begin attacking until he takes damage.

During all three of Isaac's phases, he continuously shoots multiple projectiles in the player's direction at fixed intervals when not performing other attacks. After taking enough damage, he begins to shoot double projectiles and triple projectiles.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
Isaac remains stationary on the ground and performs the following attacks:

• Shoots 10 lines of projectiles in every direction.

• Shoots 8 groups of projectiles that curve back towards him.

• Shoots 8 groups of long-range spinning projectiles along with 10 slightly curved lines of shorter-range projectiles in every direction.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
Isaac stands up but remains stationary and performs the following attack:

• Isaac alternates between two projectile patterns:

• Shoots 4 projectiles in a cross pattern, which splits into four short-ranged projectiles after a short time, similar to Cricket's Body.

• Shoots 8 projectiles in all directions.
Independently of his projectile attack:

• Summons Angelic Baby in a pair.

• Summons 2 Crack the Sky beams at random locations.

sections.heading: Phase 3
sections.text:
Isaac grows a pair of angelic wings and is no longer stationary, moving towards where the player is predicted to go with short dashes. During which he also performs the following attacks:

• Teleports off-screen and summons Crack the Sky beams to cover the screen, starting from one of the top corners to the opposite bottom corner. After teleporting back on-screen, he shoots the 10 lines of projectiles from the first phase. He always performs this attack at the start of this phase and repeats this process every time he takes 200 damage.

• [Repentance] Shadows indicate ahead of time where the beams strike.

• Can perform all projectile patterns from the first phase.

sections.heading: Damage Scaling
sections.text:
Damage scaling is a mechanic introduced in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth to provide a more challenging experience to players, enabling some enemies to retaliate against high damage attacks by deploying an "armor" of a sort to greatly reduce the amount of damage taken. Further details and an in-depth explanation may be found here.

[Repentance+] Isaac has damage scaling.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Every time Isaac is defeated, the current savefile's image changes until The Polaroid is unlocked.

• Isaac does not begin attacking until he has been damaged. This can be exploited to make the fight much easier by dealing large amounts of damage in the first hit. Methods of doing this include saving up a large amount of tears with Anti-Gravity, waiting for Kidney Stone to activate before shooting Isaac, or placing multiple bombs and detonating them all at once with Remote Detonator. Glass Cannon can also provide a high-damage initial shot, but doing this is extremely risky due to Glass Cannon's additional effect of reducing health to one half-heart.

• [Repentance] Glass Cannon no longer reduces health on use, so it can be used against Isaac much more effectively.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Isaac was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Isaac, along with ???, teleport away upon defeat and do not "die".

• Isaac's expression as he changes phases during the fight goes from somber and scared, to him smiling in his third phase. This could indicate that Isaac has made peace with himself.

• The music that plays during this boss fight is titled Infanticide. The term infanticide refers to the act of killing an infant or newborn.

• In the original Wrath of the Lamb DLC, the song was My Innermost Apocalypse.

• During his first phase, Isaac makes the same crying sound as Mulligans. This also applies to ???.

• [Repentance] Isaac and ???'s boss portraits were changed to match the appearance of the characters on the transition screen between levels. This was also the case in the original Flash game.

• Blighted Ovum, Big Horn, Triachnid, Isaac, and ??? are the only bosses whose portraits were completely changed in Repentance. Of these, only Triachnid, Isaac, and ??? didn't receive new sprites.

Number One.title: Number One
Number One.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +1.5 tears.

• [Before Repentance] -17.62 range.

• [Repentance] -1.5 range and -20% range multiplier. Will not decrease range below 4.00.

• [Before Repentance] +0.76 tear falling speed.

• Tears turn yellow and are fired from Isaac's lower body rather than his head.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item can be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents. [end edition note] 

• Number One doesn't increase the tear rate cap, meaning picking it up with tears capped (normally 5.0) will just decrease range with no benefit.

• [Repentance] Multiple copies of Number One, (such as those made by Diplopia), will not cause the negative range multiplier to stack.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Number One it turns into a yellow locust that is faster, deals damage quicker, but has a limited range.

• Brimstone / Tainted Azazel: The laser turns yellow and charges at a much faster rate with no decrease to the range.

• Epic Fetus: Increases fire-rate with no decrease in range. Explosive clouds are now yellow.

• Incubus: The Incubus fires at a much faster rate with no decrease to the range.

• [Repentance] : Incubus' range decreases like normal.

• The Ludovico Technique: Turns tear yellow and allows it to be moved much faster.

• Number One: Gives an additional fire rate bonus without further reducing range.

• Pop!: Eyeball tears are yellow, can be fired much quicker, and does not affect their airtime.

• Technology: The laser turns yellow and Technology's firing rate is greatly increased with no decrease to the range.

• Tech X: Laser turns yellow, charge time is greatly decreased, and no decrease to the range.

• Tiny Planet: Tears travel a slightly smaller distance but can be fired much quicker.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel: Lowers range, reduces charge time.

• Compound Fracture / The Parasite: Tears often disappear before being able to split. Split tears also only travel a very short distance.

• Cricket's Body: Tears disappear very quickly after being fired, and split tears barely travel at all.

• [Repentance] Not recommended. Number One's x0.8 range multiplier stacks with Cricket's Body's own x0.8 range multiplier, thus drastically reducing range.

• Dr. Fetus: Not recommended. Makes bombs travel distance very short. The extremely reduced range can turn simple rooms into a challenge and self-damage a constant concern.

• Haemolacria: Does not affect the main tear; however, burst tears travel significantly less far.

• [Repentance] Not recommended. Number One's x0.8 range multiplier stacks with Haemolacria's own x0.8 range multiplier, thus drastically reducing range.

• Ipecac: Increases fire rate moderately, and decreases range only slightly.

• [Repentance] Not recommended. Number One's x0.8 range multiplier does stack with Ipecac's own x0.8 range multiplier, making self-damage more likely.

• Kidney Stone: The stone is not affected by short range, otherwise the combo behaves as expected. [Before Repentance] Number One's range penalty overrides Kidney Stone's.

• A Lump of Coal: Tears still increase in size and damage as they travel; however, the short-ranged distance limits tear size and damage.

• Marked: Tears become orange. The firing rate is increased, Marked's effect is unaffected but the range is reduced.

• Mom's Knife: The knife turns yellow and the maximum range is significantly reduced.

• [Before Repentance] Monstro's Lung / Lead Pencil: Not recommended. Tear barrage disappears very close to Isaac.

• [Repentance] Range is more forgiving.

• Proptosis: Not recommended. Tears disappear after traveling a very short distance.

• [Repentance] This is now fixed and works as expected.

• Rubber Cement: Tears often disappear before being able to bounce off walls.

• Tooth Picks: Tears become orange.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Number One" is a euphemism for urination and mirrors No. 2 being an euphemism for defecation.

• This is why the tears fired after collecting this item are no longer fired from the head, but the lower waist.

• In the original Binding of Isaac, Number One had the effect of turning all future Range Down pills into Range Up pills. This was presumably designed to reduce the risk of players being stuck in situations where their range would become too low to clear certain rooms. However, in Rebirth, Number One no longer has this effect, and will not turn Range Down pills into Range Up pills.

• This item is used in High Brow.

• [Before Afterbirth+] The firing animation of Number One is a little different from what it looks like in the original Binding of Isaac.

fields.description: Grants +1.5 tears, but severely reduces range.

Obsessed Fan.title: Obsessed Fan
Obsessed Fan.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.text: [distinguish visual: Psy Fly]

Ocular Rift.title: Ocular Rift
Ocular Rift.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which damage nearby enemies and pull in enemies, pickups, and tears/shots from all sources for 2 seconds.

• Rifts deal half of the tear's damage twice each tick (3x its damage per second), and enemy shots pulled into the rift will damage other enemies.

• The size of the rift increases with Isaac's damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire a rift tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 20 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},20\%)

• At base Luck (0), the chance is 5%, maxing out at 20% at 15 Luck.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text:
• Rift tears can be used to move pickups that might be located behind spikes.

• Placement of the rifts is easier with items which provide a degree of control over tears, e.g. Eye of the Occult.

• Because the pull of Ocular Rift affects enemy shots, it can be used defensively to dismantle the curtains of bullets that Isaac would otherwise have to dodge. This is especially useful for bosses like Hush and Delirium.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Brimstone: Rifts may appear where a brimstone beam hits rock, walls or enemies.

• The Parasite / Compound Fracture: Causes many smaller rifts to also spawn.

• The Ludovico Technique: Each tick of damage has chance of creating rift, which will be slightly bigger in size.

• Tech X: Rifts may appear where a laser ring hits rock, walls or enemies.

• Technology / Technology 2: Rifts may appear where a laser hits rock, walls or enemies.

• Trisagion: May spawn a line of rifts where the laser travels.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Epic Fetus: Overridden by Epic Fetus.

• Mom's Knife: Overridden by Mom's Knife.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In Antibirth, this item was called Oculus Rift, a reference to the virtual reality headset brand of the same name; this potentially was changed due to copyright issues.

• Its tear chance would also directly scale with Luck, being 100% at 13 Luck.

• This item´s description is likely a reference to a quote by the philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche which goes "Stare long enough at the abyss and it will stare back at you"

fields.description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.

Odd Mushroom (Thin).title: Odd Mushroom (Thin)
Odd Mushroom (Thin).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the small odd mushroom; the larger mushroom; Odd Mushroom (Large)]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] +1.7 tears.

• Additional copies only grant +0.7 tears.

• [Repentance+] +1.7 fire rate.

• Additional copies only grant +0.7 fire rate.

• +0.3 speed.

• -0.4 damage.

• x0.9 total damage up multiplier.

• This penalty is not a total damage multiplier and applies only to certain "standard" damage ups, the specific details are available in the damage order list.

• Decreases Isaac's size.

• Contributes to the Fun Guy transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• There are two collectible items in the game named Odd Mushroom; they can be told apart from the sprites.

• This item's damage multiplier works differently than other items in the game: instead of directly multiplying the damage stat, it multiplies the total added damage from other items. As a result, flat damage upgrades aren't affected by Odd Mushroom.

• Multiple copies of the item will grant a speed and fire rate boost with no additional decrease in damage.

• Despite only the head part gets smaller visually, Isaac's size also gets smaller. Isaac can walk between some gaps while only the body stays the same size if enough copies of the item are taken.

• [Repentance+] Since the damage penalty doesn't apply to everything and the item grants a straight fire rate bonus instead of tears, it is often an upgrade to total damage output. Some combinations of high tears/fire rate with few or no damage ups will result in DPS down.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Fire rate up; Repentance: Tears up + damage down]
fields.description:
[Before Repentance+] +1.7 tears, +0.3 speed, slightly reduces damage.
[Repentance+] +1.7 fire rate, +0.3 speed, slightly reduces damage.

sections.text:
• In an uncleared room, Isaac has 1/15 chance every 30 seconds to use the effect of The Poop.

• [Before Repentance] Despite being poop-themed, Skatole, Butt Bombs, and No. 2 do not count towards the transformation.

• [edition rnr+] Despite being poop-themed, IBS does not count towards the transformation. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Poop created with Flush! and E. Coli do not heal Isaac when he has this transformation.

• Oh Crap! is useless for any character that cannot have Red Heart Containers such as ???, The Lost, Black Judas, Keeper, Tainted ???, Tainted Keeper, Tainted Judas, and Tainted Lost.

• Tainted Bethany will get blood charges for destroying poops.

• [Repentance] The Scat Man and High Brow challenges start with this transformation.

fields.description: Whenever a pile of poop is destroyed, restores half of a red heart.

Old Bandage.title: Old Bandage
Old Bandage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants an empty Red Heart container.

• If the character cannot hold red heart containers they will simply be given a normal HP up.

• Adds a chance of dropping a Red Heart after taking damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.3 \right \rfloor},50\%)

• At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 50% at 26.67 luck.

• [Repentance] The chance for Old Bandage to spawn a Red Heart depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: 20\% + (\mathit{Luck}\ * 1\%)

• This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 luck, minimizes at 0% at -20 luck, and maximizes at 100% at 80 luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blood Oath: For each half heart damaged by Blood Oath, Old Bandage has a chance to drop a heart. Synergy further improves with luck.

• IV Bag + Humbleing Bundle / Maggy's Bow: The damage from IV Bag has a chance to spawn 2 hearts, which can be picked up to create further coins and possibly even heal hearts with enough Luck.

• [Repentance] Humbleing Bundle only has a 50% chance to double the hearts dropped, but Old Bandage may still drop 1 heart.

fields.description: Grants an empty Red Heart container. Adds a chance of dropping a Red Heart after taking damage.

Old Capacitor.title: Old Capacitor
Old Capacitor.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Adds a high chance to spawn a Lil' Battery when clearing a room, independent of the room's original drop.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The exact chance for a battery dropping is \min(20\% + (3\% * \mathit{Luck}) , 33\%).

• This means that the chance starts at 20% at 0 Luck, minimizes at 0% at -6.67 Luck, and maximizes at 33% at 4.34 Luck.

• This trinket can be dropped whenever the active item needs recharging, then picked up again once the item is fully charged. For active items that aren't used every time they're recharged (such as the D6), using the trinket this way can generate many free batteries each floor.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: The chance for a battery dropping is always 33%.

• 4.5 Volt: Since 4.5 Volt also makes it so that active items don't charge when clearing rooms, this trinket can be picked up with no downside.

• Dim Bulb : Since items do not automatically recharge upon being used, being able to hold both Old Capacitor and Dim Bulb together will allow the latter's effects to be constantly active, while the batteries allow control over when exactly to charge active items.

• Jacob's Ladder / 120 Volt: Allows zaps to arc on the same enemy multiple times.

• Options?: Also offers alternate rewards for the extra batteries.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Old Capacitor is from the Antibirth mod.

• The pickup quote is a reference to an old joke game by LeatherIceCream, one of the Antibirth devs, where he makes a Don't Starve dating sim which he titled "Voltage Voltage Starving".

fields.description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Adds a chance to spawn a Lil' Battery when clearing a room, independent of the room's original drop.

One Tooth.title: One Tooth
One Tooth.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: One Tooths slowly fly towards Isaac, charging at random intervals at considerably higher speed. They will shy away from Isaac if directly approached.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Two One Tooths will spawn in the secret crawlspace created by killing Great Gideon using a Chaos Card.

sections.heading: Fat Bat
sections.text: Fat Bats move slower than a One Tooth but have more health. Fat Bats try to align themselves diagonally to Isaac, giving them a tendency to avoid his shots. They will try to shoot at Isaac once they are diagonally aligned.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Fat Bats were first revealed for the Afterbirth DLC in a Binding of Isaac official website post.
