Oob.title: Oob
Oob.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Oob will float slowly around the room randomly and occasionally spawn a Brain. If Isaac lines up horizontal to it, it charges quickly covering the room once.

sections.heading: Black Maw
sections.text:
Black Maws behave like Oob but spawns Leeches instead. If Isaac lines up horizontal to it, it very quickly charges in his direction and then doubles back, charging back to its original position. It explodes upon death.

While in normal rooms Black Maws will generally charge off-screen before returning, in long horizontal rooms they can charge a random distance before returning rather than having to fly out of the room first, this can also happen if they make contact with another enemy.

Unlike the Oob, Black Maws can still summon Leeches regardless of whether they are over an obstruction or not, due to the fact that Leeches can fly.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Oob and Black Maw are both enemies from one of Edmund McMillen's previous games named Super Meat Boy.

• Oobs have a different, but a somewhat similiar design. These extremely slowly float towards Meat Boy, but become much faster when Meat Boy is close enough to them.

• In Super Meat Boy, Black Maws work like a homing projectile that breaks into 9 smaller projectiles on impact. They appear from a black hole.

• Oobs and Black Maws are the only non-boss enemies that can charge off-screen.

• Black Maws specifically are also the only monsters that double back after charging off-screen, making them unique.

• [Before Repentance] Rerolling Gaping Maws with D10 always turns them into Oobs.

• Black Maws look surprisingly similar to the xenomorph's mouths from the Alien movies, but this could also be a coincidence.

• It also slightly resembles a sperm cell.

• [Before Repentance] Oobs have the highest health of any non-boss enemy.

• Oob's name is "boo" backwards.

Options?.title: Options?
Options?.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: an item affecting room clear rewards; a similar item affecting Boss rewards; There's Options; a similar item affecting Treasure Rooms; More Options]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• At 0 Luck and with no other modifiers, reduces the chance for a room clear to give no reward from 22% to 16%.

• Whenever a room clear reward spawns, a different alternative reward is spawned next to it. Picking up either reward causes the other to disappear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If one of the rewards is a troll bomb, picking up the other reward will not make the troll bomb disappear. Likewise, the other reward will not disappear if the troll bomb blows up.

• If one of the consumables generated by this effect is a heart, converting it with Apple of Sodom or Keeper will not cause the other consumable to disappear.

• If one of the consumables generated is a Haunted Chest and is picked up and thrown by the Polty (thus opening it), picking up the contents of the chest will not make the other consumable disappear, and taking the other consumable will only make the opened chest disappear.

• Killing the Polty after it awakens but before it can properly pick up the chest will result in the other reward disappearing, however.

• If one of the consumables is a Bomb Chest, blowing it up and picking up its contents will not make the other consumable disappear, and taking the other consumable will only make the opened chest disappear.

• However, this doesn't apply if the Bomb Chest has an item in it. Taking the other consumable will cause the Stone Chest item to disappear and vice versa.

• Unlike item-based Options effects like There's Options, it is not possible to take both consumables as Jacob and Esau, with Strawman, or in True Co-op. One consumable will always disappear even if both are collected at the same time.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Broken Padlock: Bombing any chest spawned by Options?, including the ones not requiring keys, allows picking up the contents of the chest without the other reward disappearing, unless the empty chest is touched. This can be easily avoided by simply exiting and reentering the room.

• Contract From Below: Spawns a second set of consumables. The "Options?" consumable is not guaranteed to be the same for each copy of the original consumable. Each pair of consumables functions independently for "Options?", meaning Isaac can pick up one of the first two rewards and one of the second two rewards.

• Deep Pockets/Old Capacitor: Every extra coin or battery generated will have its own alternative reward.

• Equality!: While Equality! is active, both rewards can be collected without the other despawning. Options? also makes Equality! easier to keep active.

• Guppy's Eye: Takes the guesswork out of choosing between a chest/sack and a pickup by allowing you to see what the chest/sack will give.

• Guppy's Tail: Gives a choice between a golden chest and something else in case Isaac is low on keys.

• Magneto: Opening a chest does not make the other reward disappear. Picking up the other reward afterwards will only remove the empty chest, and picking up the contents of the chest will not make the other reward disappear, letting Isaac take both rewards. This does not apply to chests with items in them, which disappear or make the other reward disappear as normal. Touching a chest will still make the other reward disappear.

• Magneto + Broken Modem: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item.

• Safety Scissors: If a Troll Bomb/Mega Troll Bomb/Golden Troll Bomb is turned into another form of bomb, it can be picked up without causing the other reward to despawn.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bag of Crafting: Only one of the rewards can be grabbed.

• Broken Modem: If the room drops are doubled, only the original set is affected by "Options?"; both consumables of the duplicate set can be collected.

• Caution should be approached if you take this item and Magneto when you're in Chest or Dark Room, as there's a chance the chest will "glitch" out via Broken Modem and opening it during the "glitching" will turn the item into a glitched item, as if it was spawned by TMTRAINER.

• Bum Friend, Bumbo, Dark Bum, Key Bum, and the familiar gained from the Super Bum transformation will cause other items to disappear when they take their respective pickups.

• D20: Can re-roll both pickups created by Options?, but only one can still be taken.

• Glyph of Balance: Only one of the rewards is modified by the Glyph.

• Moving Box: One of the pickups will disappear when using Moving Box.

• IX - The Hermit?: Only one of the rewards will be "sold".

fields.description: If a room gives a reward when cleared, there will be two different rewards to chose from. Taking one causes the other to disappear.

Orphan Socks.title: Orphan Socks
Orphan Socks.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.

• Isaac becomes immune to spikes and creep.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Does not prevent damage from Curse Room doors, Spiked Chests, or spiked rocks, but does protect against spiked rock bridges.

• Does not prevent use of a Sacrifice Room.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • A Pound of Flesh: Does not offer immunity against spikes placed around pickups.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Orphan socks refer to socks that are missing their matching pair.

• Orphan Socks originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Antibirth, it would allow Isaac to only take damage from Curse Room doors via exiting them, similar to flight, and give Magdalene immunity altogether in Cursed!.

• In Community Remix, it was instead called The Socks.

• The "your feet feel stronger" part of the description is exactly the same as the description of Callus, which gives Isaac immunity to spikes and creep.

• Orphan Socks is the rarest item that can be acquired from a Locked Chest, along with Lead Pencil.

fields.quote: Speed up + your feet feel stronger
fields.description: Prevents creep and floor spikes from damaging Isaac. Also gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.

Ouija Board.title: Ouija Board
Ouija Board.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Grants spectral tears that travel through obstacles (but not enemies) instead of breaking on impact with them.

• [Repentance] +0.5 tears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • The Parasite: When tears pass through solid objects, they will split, resulting in many tears shooting out from every rock the original tear passed through.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel/Brimstone/Tainted Azazel: The beam becomes translucent, but spectral has no effect.

• Dr. Fetus: Bombs will become translucent and pass through objects.

• Epic Fetus: Spectral has no effect.

• The Forgotten: Spectral provides no benefit for both characters, as the bone club can hit through obstacles and The Soul has spectral tears passively. [end edition note] 

• The exception is with any synergy on The Forgotten that creates normal tears.

• The Lost: Spectral provides no benefit, as The Lost starts with spectral tears by default.

• Mom's Knife: The knife becomes translucent, but spectral has no effect.

• Technology/Technology 2: Allows the laser to go through objects.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A Ouija Board is a flat board marked with the letters of the alphabet, the numbers 0–9, the words "yes", "no", "hello" (occasionally), and "goodbye", along with various symbols and graphics. It's believed to be a "spirit communicator" allowing you to talk with spirits.

• Isaac's expression seems to be from the film "The Ring" after a victim has been killed after 7 days.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Spectral tears; Repentance: Spectral tears + tears up]
fields.description: Grants spectral tears that travel through obstacles (but not enemies). [Repentance] +0.5 tears.

Ouroboros Worm.title: Ouroboros Worm
Ouroboros Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Tears travel in a large spiral pattern.

• Grants spectral tears.

• [Before Repentance] +4.0 range, +2.0 tear falling speed.

• [Repentance] +1.5 range, +0.4 tears.

• A luck-based chance for a homing shot, reaching 100% at 9 luck.

• The homing shots are not different in appearance.

• The homing does not override the spiral pattern, meaning tears stay unreliable.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Pin, Larry Jr., The Hollow or Scolex. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] While in the Mirrored World, the spiral pattern will also be mirrored.

• This also applies to the Ring Worm trinket.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Mom's Box: Doubles the range increase.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either makes the spiral pattern larger and doubles the stat increase. Having both makes the pattern even larger and triples the stat increase.

• Aquarius: Creep has a chance to be homing.

• Dr. Fetus: Since the bombs don't follow the spiral pattern, only the extra range, spectral bombs, and chance for a homing bomb apply.

• Tractor Beam: The tears follow a straight path, ignoring the spiral pattern; the tears also stall at a specific point, giving a greater chance to land tears.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Azazel / Brimstone / Technology / Technology 2: The spiral effect is overidden. All other effects still apply.

• [Repentance] The laser is shot in a spiral pattern. Homing does take effect, but is hardly noticeable.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear spirals around in a difficult to control manner, with the added homing chance further complicating things.

• Mom's Knife: Overrides Ouroboros Worm.

• [Repentance] Works as intended. The homing, however, is questionable.

• Proptosis: The curious pattern allows dealing full damage from a safer range.

• Tainted Azazel: His Brimstone laser is shot in a spiral pattern. Homing does take effect, but is hardly noticeable.

• Tech X: Overrides Ouroboros Worm.

• [Repentance] Tech X now inherits the homing chance benefit, without being affected by the pattern.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This trinket is a reference to Øuroboros, which was a prototype of the game "The End is Nigh" by Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel.

• The Ouroboros is an ancient symbol, showing a serpent or dragon eating its tail.

fields.name: Ouroboros Worm
fields.description: Tears travel in a large spiral pattern and gain spectral, with a small chance to gain homing. [Repentance] Also adds +0.4 Tears.

PHD.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Bad pills already obtained/dropped will be converted to their "good" counterparts.

• If PHD is lost in any way, such as rerolling by the D4 or a Dice Room, or dropping it as Tainted Isaac, pills will remain fully identified, but negative pills will not be converted.

• Rerolling an owned passive item into PHD through effects such as D4 will not identify pills, but will convert negative pills into positive ones.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Performing a RERUN with a character that held PHD will still prevent negative pills from spawning, but will no longer identify pills until used.

• As bad pills will turn into good pills, it is possible for two different colored pills to have the same effect.

• Multiple copies of PHD will not yield more coins when using a Blood Donation Machine or IV Bag.

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight pills.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• False PHD: Pills can both be good or bad again. Taking a bad pill still applies the benefits from False PHD.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Blood Donation Machines will not produce more coins and they will still have a chance to fail.

• Jacob and Esau: Pills will be identified for both characters, but pills with negative effects will only have their effects reversed when used by the character holding PHD.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• PHD stands for Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) and it's the most common degree at the highest academic level awarded following a course of study. Doctorates can be in any study, in Isaac's case, medicine.

• MEAT!, YO LISTEN!, PHD, G FUEL!, and TMTRAINER are the only ALL CAPS items in the game.

fields.description: Converts all bad pills into good pills, spawns one pill pickup, and identifies all pills. Restores two Red Hearts and increases the payout of Blood Donation Machines.

PJs.title: PJs
PJs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants four Soul Hearts.

• Heals 12 Hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The outfit's color is similar to the outfit of Pajama Sam, a character who also wears pajamas. Wearing the Blanket further matches the outfit if worn together.

• This item is part of a set of bedtime-themed items, including Binky, Blanket, Mr. Dolly, and Night Light.

• Picking this item up instantly unlocks Lazarus if he isn't unlocked, due to PJs instantly granting the 4 required Soul Hearts.

fields.description: Grants 4 Soul Hearts and fully restores Isaac's health.

Pageant Boy.title: Pageant Boy
Pageant Boy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns seven coins around Isaac.

• These coins may be any normal type with their respective usual chances: Penny, Nickels, Dimes, Lucky Penny, Sticky Nickels or Golden Penny.

• Denomination of coins that spawn is not affected by luck.

• [Repentance+] Spawns one of the following trinkets: Blessed Penny, Bloody Penny, Burnt Penny, Butt Penny, Charged Penny, Counterfeit Penny, Cursed Penny, Flat Penny and Rotten Penny.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Nuh Uh!: On the low chance this item spawns in Womb or Corpse, coins dropped will instead be replaced by drops from Nuh Uh!'s drop table.

fields.description: Spawns seven random coins around Isaac [Repentance+] and a random penny trinket.

Pandora's Box.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Floors affected by [cu: Labyrinth] are counted as the first floor by Pandora's Box.

• [Afterbirth onward] When playing Greed Mode, the normal Devil Room item pool is still used in Sheol, instead of the Greed Mode Devil Room item pool.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] In Greed Mode, it will always generate its 2nd floor drops for each Chapter that is before the Womb, such as 20 pennies in the Depths, etc. [end edition note] 

• The Womb is the exception, generating its 1st floor drop: 2 Boss Room items.

• [Repentance] Ascent floors give the rewards of their regular floors.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: In addition to the item's expected reward, spawns one of the following demonic familiars: Blood Puppy, Dark Bum, Demon Baby, Incubus, Lil Abaddon, Lil Brimstone, Succubus, or Twisted Pair.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns floor - 1 regular wisps with no unique effect, up to a maximum of 8. No wisps are spawned on the first floor.

• Strange Key: Instead of its normal effect, Pandora's Box spawns six items from a set of item pools. Both items are consumed.

• This will prevent unlocking Moving Box if it hasn't already been unlocked, when used in Dark Room.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• ? Card:

• [edition anr] Will consume both the card and Pandora's Box, but nothing will happen, wasting both of them.

• [Repentance] Will activate Pandora's Box without consuming it, allowing for multiple activations.

• [Repentance] If Isaac is holding Strange Key, using the ? Card will consume the card and trinket, spawning 6 items, but Pandora's Box will not be consumed.

• Void After Pandora's Box is absorbed by Void, using Void again while holding Strange Key will spawn 6 items. Strange key will be consumed.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Moving Box]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In Greek legend, Pandora's Box is a jar containing all of the evils of the world. It was given to the first woman created, who, in her curiosity, opened it, releasing every evil unto the land. Once the evils were released, the only thing that remained was Elpis, the Spirit of Hope.

• Pandora's Box, along with Strange Key, is likely a reference to David Lynch's 2001 film Mulholland Drive.

• The rewards for Greed Mode changed in patch v1.06.J168; the rewards given in Caves are instead given in Basement, and so on.

• Despite Pandora’s Box’s sprite depicting a keylock, the item does not require a key to open.

• Pandora's Box is named Blue Box both in the game files and on Edmund McMillen's development notes, as it was likely an early name for the item.

• Paradoxically, Box of Friends' sprite in the game files is named Pandora’s Box, despite the fact it was added to the game after Pandora's Box.

fields.description: Spawns specific pickups or items depending on the floor it is used on. Disappears after use.

Panic Button.title: Panic Button
Panic Button.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Activates Isaac's active item just before damage would be taken.

• This still uses the item's charges, so if the item is not charged, the trinket will do nothing.

• Single-use items will be consumed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Panic Button will attempt to use the item 2-3 times per tick as damage is incoming. This may cause some unlimited use items to trigger multiple times before one damage instance.

• Some items will be activated after respawning if Isaac is killed by the incoming damage, including Guppy's Paw and Mega Blast.

• Taking damage from explosions, enemy creep, spikes and spike rocks, Spiked Chest and Mimic Chest, some attack from above (for example, the stomp attacks from Mom and Satan), Whipper and their variants, brimstone lasers (including angel lasers), or electric lasers, will not trigger the effect as those are instantaneous.

• Self-damage sources also won't trigger the trinket. This includes items, machines, and damaging doors.

• Does not activate items in a consumable slot (such as Tainted Bethany's Lemegeton or dice items granted by Dice Bag).

• Will activate when touching Dark Esau while playing as Tainted Jacob, despite Dark Esau not technically dealing damage.

• This effect still occurs even whilst he is chained by Anima Sola, when he deals no contact damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either gives 10% chance to not deplete the item's charge when it's activated. Having both increases the chance to 20%.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Any self-damaging item: Self-damage occurs before enemy damage, making it almost impossible to lose Devil/Angel Room chances.

• For self-damaging items that deals only half a heart damage (such as Kamikaze!), before chapter 4, it will also reduce enemy damage to half a heart, similarly to The Wafer.

• Blank Card with VII - The Chariot / VII - The Chariot?: Activate their respective effects without consuming it.

• Blood Rights: Triggers the effect on hit, at the cost of a full-heart of damage on the first hit and half-heart damage on subsequent hits in the same room.

• Book of Shadows: Activates the item, giving Isaac the shield effect for 10 seconds.

• Bursting Sack: Even though the neutral spiders can't possibly hurt Isaac, the trinket still activates when contact is made with them.

• Butter Bean / Wait What?: Isaac farts before being hit, knocking back enemies and projectiles.

• Clear Rune with Algiz / Blank Rune / Rune Shard / Soul of Judas: Activate their respective effects without consuming it.

• Dark Arts: Unlike many other items on this list, Dark Arts can be used to negate damage more than once per room, making it an excellent defensive item to use with Panic Button. Note that this does not work while playing asTainted Judas.

• Damocles: Not recommended. Damocles will activate right before Isaac takes damage, guaranteeing Damocles will fall later in the run.

• Dull Razor: Activates the item and gives Isaac invincibility frames before being hit. If combined with 9 Volt or AAA Battery, works every room, just like Holy Mantle. If combined with The Battery, Habit, and Car Battery it will make Isaac almost invincible.

• Glowing Hourglass: Rewind time to the previous room.

• Holy Mantle: Does not stop the trinket from activating.

• The Lost can die this way should he carry self-damaging items at the time of the hit.

• How to Jump: Makes Isaac immune to contact and tear damage while moving.

• IV Bag: Upon getting hit, activates the IV Bag instead, causing self-damage and producing money.

• Kamikaze!: Causes a highly-damaging explosion to occur every time Isaac is hit.

• My Little Unicorn: Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

• Razor Blade: Isaac gains a damage boost every time he's hit, acting similarly to Red Patch, at the cost of a full-heart of damage on the first hit and half-heart damage on subsequent hits in the same room.

• Stitches: Isaac will teleport before damage is taken, making him much harder to hit.

• Tainted Forgotten: Triggers his active item whenever the body touches something that would damage the Tainted Soul, regardless of damage taken.

• Suplex!: As long as Suplex! is fully charged, damage can be dodged by the grab.

• Telekinesis: Automatically blocks any incoming shots, but the push is not strong enough to prevent contact damage.

• The Gamekid: Turns the character into a Pac-Man-like creature for 6.5 seconds and provides invulnerability, inflicts fear on all enemies, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

• Unicorn Stump: Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears while the effect is active.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Spin to Win Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room.

fields.description: Activates Isaac's active item just before he takes damage.

Papa Fly.title: Papa Fly
Papa Fly.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a blue fly familiar that will follow Isaac's movement with a 1-second delay and fires tears at nearby enemies.

• [Repentance] Papa fly follows Isaac on a 0.66 second delay instead.

• Papa Fly's tears deal Isaac's damage, and are fired once per second.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Since Papa Fly's damage scales off of Isaac's own damage, any item that provides a massive damage increase (such as Ipecac or Polyphemus) will prove benefitial.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Papa Fly is a blue tinted Pooter.

fields.name: Papa Fly
fields.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 3 second delay, firing tears at nearby enemies.

Paper Clip.title: Paper Clip
Paper Clip.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Allows Isaac to unlock Locked Chests without using Keys.

• Locked doors, key blocks, and Mega Chests still require keys.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• In addition to regular trinket drop sources, Paper Clip can be obtained as a possible reward from Key Masters.

• [Afterbirth onward] Cain starts with this trinket after donating 68 coins to the Greed Donation Machine.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Allows to open locked blocks without using a key. 

• Additionally allows to open locked doors without using a key if Isaac has both Golden Trinket and Mom's Box.

• Pay To Play: Golden Chests no longer cost a coin to open.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Mom's Locket: Renders Mom's Locket less effective as the trinket requires a key to be consumed by the lock in order to heal Isaac.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The pickup quote of this item is a reference to an infamous line from the first Resident Evil game.

• [Repentance] Paper Clip is the only Beggar payout (coming from the Key Master) that is not a passive/active item. While Rotten Beggars and Battery Bums can also pay with trinkets, they do so as random drops, rather than payout. [end edition note]

fields.description: Locked Chests can be opened without using a Key.

Para-Bite.title: Para-Bite
Para-Bite.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Para-Bite is a monster introduced in the vanilla content of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth. They can be only encountered in Chapter 4.

It will move around the room until Isaac appears in its line of sight, prompting it to charge towards him and can deal a full heart of contact damage. They're also able to move underground and pop up in a different location, although they cannot spawn right under Isaac.

sections.heading: Scarred Para-Bite
sections.text:
Scarred Para-Bites are a variant of Para-Bites added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth DLC.

They behave similarly to regular Para-Bites and occasionally fire a short-ranged blood shot towards Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Magenta Champion Scarred Para-Bites will shoot two blood shots at different intervals.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Para-Bite first appeared in the original Flash version of The Binding of Isaac.

• The name Para-Bite is a portmanteau of the words parasite and bite, with parasite meaning an organism that lives in or on another organism and benefits from it at the host's expense.

• The Para-Bite's sprite was based off of a character from an old comic Edmund made, whose name was Longits.

• The attack pattern of the Para-Bite was based off of an enemy in the Zelda series.

Bum Friend.title: Bum Friend
Bum Friend.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac and picks up coins on the ground.

• After picking up 6 coins, Bum Friend will return to Isaac and drop a pickup.

• After that, Bum Friend has a 67% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 3 coins and a 33% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 4 coins.

• Contributes to the Super Bum transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth onward] Bum Friend cannot pick up Sticky Nickels. [end edition note] 

• [Afterbirth onward] Bum Friend can pick up Lucky Penny, but it will simply count as a regular Penny and will not grant luck. [end edition note] 

• [edition anr] From a scoring perspective, Pennies that Bum Friend picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs. [end edition note] 

• Bum Friend does not join the line of familiars that follow behind Isaac.

• Not recommended for Keeper as it will make it harder to regain health due to the Keeper healing via coins.

sections.heading: Drops
sections.text:
• Bum Friend can drop:

• Red Hearts

• Bombs

• Keys

• Cards and Runes

• Pills

• Trinkets

• [Repentance] Lil' Battery

• [Repentance] Items from the Beggar (only if Bum Friend collects at least 10c worth of coins before payout)

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: All future drops will happen every 3 coins. If the next scheduled drop at the moment of acquiring BFFS! requires more than 3 coins, the amount will not be lowered.

• Mitre: Red Hearts that Bum drops can be converted into Soul Hearts.

• King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.

• Chaos: Bum Friend's item pedestals will be affected by Chaos, spawning an item from a random pool.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is the Beggar counterpart of Dark Bum and Key Bum.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If hit by an explosion before finishing collection on the room, Bum Friend may freeze in place.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that picks up Penny for himself, giving random pickups in return. [Repentance] Can spawn items from the Beggar item pool.

Bumbo.title: Bumbo
Bumbo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby coins. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected.
Level 1 (0-5 coins): Bumbo just collects coins to level up.
Level 2 (6-11 coins): Bumbo occasionally drops a pickup, trinket, chest or pedestal item after a room clear.
Level 3 (12-23 coins): Bumbo now fires tears that deal 3.5 damage in the same direction Isaac does. Bumbo's tears have a chance to drop a coin if they hit an enemy.
Level 4 (24+ coins): Bumbo no longer fires tears and instead chases enemies slowly and deals contact damage (2.5 per tick, or [Before Repentance] 37.5 per second/ [Repentance] 10.7 per second). Bumbo will occasionally drop Bombs while chasing enemies or coins.

• After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to Bum Friend.

• Bumbo can also drop items from the current room's Item Pool.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Level 1-3 Bumbo can fly over pits and obstacles, despite having limbs at level 2 and 3 that serve him as legs.

• If Bumbo consumes an absurd amount of coins while level four, Bumbo can become level one again (Unsure if bug, likely a buffer overflow)

• If Level 4 Bumbo targets Mega Satan's head, Bumbo will attempt to "chase" him the entire fight by standing in the middle of the room.

• Level 4 Bumbo's bombs are unaffected by Isaac's bomb synergies.

• Bumbo cannot pick up Sticky Nickels and will hover over them. Level 4 Bumbo can eventually bomb the Sticky Nickel to free it.

• Bumbo will pick up Lucky Penny, without additional benefit to evolution or drops.

• If Bumbo drops a pedestal item, it will be pulled from the current room's item pool.

• In a RERUN, Bumbo's level is reset.

• Level 4 Bumbo can target charmed enemies and will try to follow them around to no effect. This prevents him from picking up coins until the target is changed.

• [Repentance] There is a boss that resembles Bumbo level 4 named Bumbino. [end edition note] 

• [edition anr] From a scoring perspective, Coins that Bumbo picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • BFFS!: Doubles both the contact and shot damage, when applicable.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Box of Friends: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.

• Keeper: Not recommended, as the coins Bumbo collects could have been used to heal Keeper.

• Tainted Keeper: Due to the large influx of coins spawned, it's technically possible to sustain Bumbo while also maintaining a good level of wealth and health.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bumbo is the main character of his own game, The Legend of Bum-Bo, designed by Edmund McMillen.

• The name is a play on the word bum and Rambo.

• Bumbo Level 1 looks similar to Bum Friend's head.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Bumbo's level can be reset after the sequence of obtaining Knife Piece 2 in Ashpit/Mines II.

fields.description: Spawns a beggar familiar which picks up any nearby coins, leveling up after collecting several coins. At level 2, Bumbo gains a body. At level 3, it begins to fire tears. At level 4, Bumbo follows enemies and gains contact damage.

Burnt Penny.title: Burnt Penny
Burnt Penny.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a chance to drop a Bomb when money is collected.

• [Before Repentance] 50% chance.

• [Repentance] The chance is based on the coin's worth:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 25.00%

| Double Penny | 43.75%

| Nickel | 76.27%

| Dime | 94.37%

[end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Bombs may be any normal type with their respective usual chances.

• [Repentance] Only regular Bombs can spawn normally, but Double Bombs can spawn with certain synergies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket can be found from destroying TNT barrels and Special Shopkeepers

• [Repentance] It can also spawn in a rare room with fires found in Depths.

• Can show up in the Beans! challenge, without being unlocked.

• Can always appear in a specific room layout, even prior to unlocking it.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BOGO Bombs/Humbleing Bundle: All normal Bombs spawned by the trinket become Double Bombs.

• [Repentance] Humbleing Bundle: All normal Bombs spawned by the trinket get a 50% chance to turn into Double Bombs. [end edition note] 

• Tainted Keeper: The trinket works with the temporary coins spawned from defeating enemies, effectively turning it into an infinite Bomb generator.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Increases the chances to:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 50.00%

| Double Penny | 75.00%

| Nickel | 96.88%

| Dime | 99.90%

• Golden Trinket + Mom's Box: Increases the chances to:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 75.00%

| Double Penny | 93.75%

| Nickel | 99.90%

| Dime | 99.99%

fields.description: Gives a chance to drop a Bomb when a coin is collected.

Bursting Sack.title: Bursting Sack
Bursting Sack.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Certain spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac, nor actively spawn other enemies. Spiders that are spawned from enemies that are not affected by Bursting Sack will also remain neutral.

• Affected spider enemies that deal no damage to Isaac whatsoever include: Baby Long Legs, Big Spider, Crazy Long Legs, Level 2 Spider, Small Baby Long Legs, Small Crazy Long Legs and Spider.

• • [Repentance] Also: Rock Spider, Strider, Swarm Spider, Tinted Rock Spider and Trite.

• • 
• Swarm Spiders don't blink yellow when Isaac has the item.

• • 
• Trites will still uselessly try to target Isaac.

• • [Afterbirth+ onward] Spiders and Big Spiders don't blink red when Isaac has the item.

• [Before Repentance] Unaffected spider enemies include: Blind Creep, Blister, Rage Creep, Ragling, Rag Man's Ragling, The Thing, Trite and Wall Creep.

• [Repentance] Affected enemies that deal no contact damage but can still damage Isaac through other methods include: Blind Creep, Blister, Migraine, Rage Creep, Ragling, Rag Man's Ragling, Soy Creep, Tainted Soy Creep, The Thing, Ticking Spider, and Wall Creep.

• • Except for Ticking Spiders, Migraines, and Blind Creeps, all other spiders will still uselessly try to target Isaac for contact damage.

• [Repentance] Coal Spiders aren't aggressive to Isaac, but will still deal contact damage.

• [Repentance] Twitchy are not counted as "spider" enemies and are unaffected by this item.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] If either one of Jacob and Esau holds Bursting Sack, both gain the benefits.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is similar to Skatole, only affecting spiders instead of flies.

• Befitting the name, this item's appearance is similar to a bursting Sack.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Spider enemies that are neutralized by Bursting Sack cannot be poisoned by contact via The Virus, Serpent's Kiss, or turned into gold via Midas' Touch. They also become immune to contact damage from My Little Unicorn, The Gamekid, and The Nail, but not the damage from Midas' Touch or Little Horn.

fields.description: Spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac.

Butt Bombs.title: Butt Bombs
Butt Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives the player 5 Bombs.

• Bombs now cloud up the screen on detonation, briefly confusing and dealing 10 damage to all enemies in the room.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Oh Crap transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item can be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Colostomia. [end edition note] 

• [Afterbirth onward] Butt Bombs heal Turdlings, Dingle, Dangle, Brownie and Clog by 25% of their maximum HP.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The Butt Bomb effect on Dr. Fetus or Epic Fetus does not cause healing, but normal bombs still do. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in High Brow, Beans!, and Scat Man.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Although Bob's Rotten Head works normally with Butt Bombs, and Bomber Boy has no effect with it, their combination drops the explosion damage by 50%.

fields.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs now cloud up the screen, briefly damaging and confusing all enemies.

Butt Penny.title: Butt Penny
Butt Penny.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon picking up a coin, Isaac farts, knocking back nearby enemies [Repentance] and projectiles.

• [Before Repentance] The fart does not deal any damage or inflict poison.

• • [Repentance] The fart inflicts poison.

• 20% chance for a coin to drop from Poops, in addition to its normal drop chances.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This trinket can be found by destroying Special Shopkeepers, and [Repentance] buckets in Dross. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Destroyed poops are 30% more likely to drop coin.

• Dirty Mind: Grants a chance to spawn a Dip each time a coin is picked up.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Grants poops made from enemies a chance to drop pickups.

• Gigante Bean: The size of the fart is drastically increased.

• IBS / Tainted ???: Thrown poops gain the chance of dropping a coin on being destroyed.

• IV Bag / Piggy Bank / Swallowed Penny: Pennies dropped can be used either defensively to deflect enemies [Repentance] and projectiles, or offensively to poison.

• The Poop / Mysterious Candy: Allows Isaac to slowly farm coins over time.

• Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye : Isaac farts flames whenever he picks up coins.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• E. Coli / Flush!: Poops made from enemies do not drop pickups.

• Tainted Keeper: All coins dropped from enemies trigger the effect, helping in defending Keeper or damaging nearby enemies, though the knockback could make collecting coins more difficult were there a lot of them dropped close to each other.

fields.description: Isaac will fart when he picks up a coin. Coins have a higher chance to drop from Poops.

Butter!.title: Butter!
Butter!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Using an active item will drop it onto a pedestal on the ground.

• When Isaac takes damage, there is a 2% chance one of Isaac's passive items will drop on the ground.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] Butter! can sometimes spawn within the special bedroom created by Lil Portal. [end edition note] 

• Single-use Active items do not drop and are consumed as normal.

• Tainted characters with active items in their consumable slots can drop them from getting hit, however they will only be able to pick it back up into the active item slot.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Adds 2% more chance to drop one of Isaac's passive items per copy.

• Blank Card / Clear Rune: When dropped upon usage, their recharge times are reset to 4, allowing to use more expensive cards and runes much more frequently.

• Esau Jr.: Using Esau Jr. while holding Butter! will spawn another copy of Esau Jr.

• Void: Items that are normally unusable when holding Butter! can still activate their effects if absorbed by Void.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues: The item on top of Book of Virtues will be dropped on the ground, but the book itself cannot be dropped from using it, nor form taking damage.

• Damocles: Dropped active items will not cause extra item pedestals to spawn, nor can getting hit cause Isaac to drop an activated Damocles.

• Glowing Hourglass: Glowing hourglass functions as normal.

• How to Jump: Isaac animates a jump but his movement remains normal and he cannot go over any obstacles.

• [Repentance] A normal jump is made before dropping the item.

• Mama Mega! + Golden Bomb: Since Mama Mega is not consumed if Isaac has a golden bomb, it will be dropped after activation.

• Metronome: Effect from the Metronome is immediately canceled beyond the gain of hearts, coins, bombs, or keys. Visual effects may persist until leaving the room.

• [Repentance] Granted item effects will last until leaving the room.

• Missing No.: Butter! can get rid of Missing No..

• Notched Axe: Notched Axe is dropped when the charge bar is empty.

• The Pinking Shears: The flight granted by The Pinking Shears persists, but the body familiar is immediately canceled.

• [Repentance] The familiar remains.

• Razor Blade: Deals damage to Isaac as normal but does not increase damage for the current room.

• [Repentance] Does increase damage.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Butter! allows the transportation of active item pedestal from room to room. On its own this ability is useless, but can be used to set up plays involving room-wide pedestal effects; after gathering all available active item pedestal in a single room, Isaac can then:

• Use The D6, Dice Shard, Cracked Dice etc., to re-roll every single item pedestal in the room.

• Use Void, Black Rune, or Abyss to consume all pedestal for their respective benefits.

• Use Diplopia (or more riskily Crooked Penny) to double all item pedestals before doing any of the above.

• Isaac can also damage himself to try to fish for the 2% chance of dropping a passive item in the same room as well.

sections.heading: No Effect
sections.text: Butter! will immediately cancel the effects of and discharge these active items when dropped, unless they are consumed with Void.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Butter! was made by Florian Himsl (developer and programmer of the original The Binding of Isaac game).

• Butter!'s effect may be a reference to the English slang "butterfingers," which is used to describe a person who has difficulty holding or catching things.

fields.description: Using an active item will drop it onto a pedestal on the ground. Taking damage may result in dropping an owned passive item.

Butter Bean.title: Butter Bean
Butter Bean.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies.

• [Afterbirth onward] Projectiles are also deflected.

• • [Repentance] Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.

• • [Repentance] The deflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] If Isaac swaps Butter Bean for a different active item, then picks up Butter Bean again, it has a 10% chance to transform into Wait What?.

• [Repentance] When a run is started, the game has a 5% chance to replace Butter Bean with Wait What? in item pools. Both items are generally not available in the same run.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bird's Eye/Ghost Pepper: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Butter Bean. Two flames will be shot if Isaac also has Car Battery.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns white wisps on the inner ring. The wisps do not shoot tears, have only 1 health each, release farts that knockback upon death, and cannot be carried across rooms.

• Panic Button: Activates Butter Bean upon taking damage. If the damage was from a projectile that Butter Bean can knock away, it will be negated.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Butter Bean's sprite is exactly identical to Wait What?, making them the two only items in the game with the same sprite.

fields.description: Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies [Afterbirth onward] and projectiles. [Repentance] Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.

Buttlicker.title: Buttlicker
Buttlicker.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Buttlickers are monsters that wander around randomly in straight lines similar to Larry Jr..
They most often spawn attached to other Buttlickers in chains of up to 5. When one Buttlicker in the chain is destroyed, the other Buttlickers separate from each other and continue to move in random directions.

Similar to Larry Jr., Buttlickers can destroy Poop on contact.

sections.heading: Butt Slicker
sections.text:
Butt Slickers when encountered individually, act identically to Buttlickers, but unlike their counterparts they can group together and stick to other Butt Slickers. When grouped together they begin to drag themselves towards Isaac. Upon killing a Butt Slicker within a group, it creates a pool of slowing black creep and shoots out black projectiles; the amount of projectiles released and the size of the pool of Black Creep is determined by the amount of Butt Slickers attached. All other Butt Slickers will scatter and temporarily leave trails of Black Creep when this occurs.

Killing a Butt Slicker in a group of 2 or 3 will create a small pool of Black Creep and 4 projectiles in the cardinal directions while killing one in a group of 4 or more creates a large pool of Black Creep and 8 projectiles in the cardinal and diagonal directions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Any status effect inflicted on a Buttlicker (poison, etc) will also spread to any other Buttlickers attached to it if in a chain.

• Charming a chain of Buttlickers will cause it to chase Isaac if no other enemies are in the room. However, if Isaac kills a Buttlicker in the middle of the chain and then charms them, the Buttlickers will attack each other.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Buttlickers were first implemented in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, destroying any Buttlicker in a chain would cause all Buttlickers to separate and move independently. This does not happen in Rebirth.

• This is possibly a reference to the movie "Human Centipede".

C.H.A.D..title: C.H.A.D.
C.H.A.D..attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: C.H.A.D. is a boss that can appear in the Caves and the Flooded Caves.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
C.H.A.D. moves randomly around the room in cardinal directions and can perform the following attacks:

• C.H.A.D. charges at Isaac whenever he lines up with one of his cardinal directions.

• Like Chub, C.H.A.D. eats any Bombs dropped in his path; stunning him for a moment before dealing considerable damage.

• Spawns 1-2 Suckers.

• As he gets damaged, C.H.A.D. gradually shrinks in size and increases in speed and attack frequency.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Little C.H.A.D.]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] C.H.A.D is much less common than his counterpart, spawning only 1/4th as often.

• C.H.A.D can spawn alongside 2 Boils or 2 Red Boom Fly.

• Each segment of C.H.A.D. can be individually damaged, so a single piercing tear could hit C.H.A.D. multiple times.

• [Repentance] Piercing shots no longer damage segmented enemies multiple times per attack.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• C.H.A.D. appeared in the original The Binding of Isaac.

• He is a rare alternative to Chub.

• C.H.A.D. is a cameo from Super Meat Boy, a game by Edmund McMillen.

• In Super Meat Boy, he is the boss of Chapter 2: The Hospital.

• When defeated in Super Meat Boy, C.H.A.D. would shrink to a smaller version of himself. Him getting smaller during the fight in Rebirth and the item Little C.H.A.D. are allusions to this.

• The name C.H.A.D. is a reference to the 1984 horror film C.H.U.D., confirmed by Edmund.

• Despite C.H.A.D. normally being speculated to stand for "Cute, Huge and Deadly," Edmund McMillen had confirmed that it doesn't stand for that phrase.

• When asked what it does stand for, Edmund jokingly replied that he can't legally say.

• C.H.A.D.'s secret for unlocking him says "In the Depths" even though he is found in The Caves.

• [plat: PS4, Vita] Even though C.H.A.D is unlocked by accomplishing "Something Cute", its PSN Trophy icon features Chub.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Using the Emergency Contact on C.H.A.D. then killing him while he is held will crash the game.
Bug note: Killing C.H.A.D. for the first time using Tainted Lost will not unlock Little C.H.A.D.
