Mr. Mega.title: Mr. Mega
Mr. Mega.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 5 Bombs.

• Gives all of Isaac's bombs increased damage and blast radius.

• [Before Repentance] Mr. Mega bombs deal 110 damage instead of 60.

• [Repentance] Mr. Mega bombs deal 185 damage instead of 100.

• When bombs explode, the screen will shake.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can drop from killing Super Wrath. [Before Repentance] Super Wrath can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• Stacking multiple copies of Mr. Mega doesn't increase bomb damage.

• [Repentance+] This item can be crafted by Bag of Crafting with eight Bombs. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bob's Brain: Increases damage [Before Repentance] from 60 to 145 [Repentance] from 100 to 150.

• Dr. Fetus: Adds 25 flat damage to bomb explosions.

• Ghost Bombs: Ghosts appear larger and do extra damage only upon exploding.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anarchist Cookbook: No effect.

• Bob's Rotten Head: No effect.

• Epic Fetus: No effect.

• No. 2 / Curse of the Tower: Not affected by Mr. Mega.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Suicide King and Blue Bomber.

• The cosmetic effect that Mr. Mega gives to Isaac is similar to Wrath.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Blast Damage; Repentance: Bigger boom]
fields.description: +5 Bombs. Increases the size, blast radius, and damage of Isaac's bombs.

Mucormycosis.title: Mucormycosis
Mucormycosis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a 25% chance to shoot a spore that, in addition to dealing damage, will stick to enemies.

• The chance is not affected by Luck.

• Spores will explode 2.5 seconds after sticking to an enemy, dealing 5 damage to and poisoning nearby enemies and firing four more spores in a cross pattern.

• Spores produced from Isaac's spores have homing.

• The spore effects will not damage Isaac.

• Contributes to the Fun Guy transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Items that deal continuous damage such as Brimstone, and Technology 2 will apply spores to enemies as well, despite the absence of tears.

• Spores can stick to Frozen enemies, and will act normally.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bird's Eye / Ghost Pepper / Gigante Bean: Spore explosions are considered farts, meaning Isaac will occasionally spawn fires when a spore bursts if he has either pepper, and Gigante Bean will increase their size.

• C Section: Some fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then burst.

• Godhead: Godhead's aura expands as the spore tear grows on enemies.

• Lodestone: Magnetized enemies draw other enemies to them, greatly increasing the chance that spores spread to other enemies.

• Lost Contact: Stuck tears will block projectiles shot by attached enemies, crippling or even stopping their ability to shoot projectiles entirely.

• My Reflection: The mini-spores generated by the spore explosions are affected by My Reflection.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Mom's Knife: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mucormycosis originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Antibirth, this item would create a poison fart cloud on every kill, similar to Contagion. The Mucormycosis fart clouds could also knock Isaac away and potentially into hazards.

• In Community Remix, it would trigger a room-wide poison effect, similar to Toxic Shock, but only with a 1/11 chance after killing an enemy.

• Mucormycosis is a fungal infection caused by fungi in the order Mucorales.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: During the Ultra Greed fight if a spore attaches to an Ultra Greed coin enemy, it may make the coins movement erratic and cause it to bounce around the room uncontrollably.

fields.description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire spore tears that stick to enemies and blow up after a few seconds, dealing damage and poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores.

Multidimensional Baby.title: Multidimensional Baby
Multidimensional Baby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's path with a 2-second delay.

• [Repentance] The delay is 0.66 seconds instead.

• When a friendly tear passes through Multidimensional Baby, the tear splits into two parallel tears that gain a 1.33x shot speed boost, [Before Repentance] x1.5 range / [Repentance] x1.5 tear height (which also increases effective range), and also a visual black and white flashing effect.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• It is possible to crash the game when combining this item with rapid-fire or multi-shot laser tears.

• Duplicated tears will deal the same damage as Isaac's tears.

• If other familiars that move with a similar pattern such as Shade have been collected before the Baby, it will follow them instead with further delay.

• Standing perfectly still with the Multidimensional Baby inside of Isaac will activate its effect, as the tears will pass through it as they spawn.

• This does not work with attacks such as Brimstone, as it is fired in front of Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Brimstone: If a brimstone laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.

• Azazel's short-ranged Brimstone attack will also be "fired again" from the baby, increasing the range.

• Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will duplicate and their split tears will duplicate. Half of the tears fired through Multidimensional Baby retain The Parasite's look and the other half have the flashing appearance.

• Duct Tape: If properly positioned, Isaac's tears will always be doubled.

• Haemolacria: Haemolacria shots will be duplicated and more burst tears will spawn. Burst tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will also be duplicated.

• [Repentance] Papa Fly: Papa Fly will always shoot two shots due to both familiars having the same movement delay.

• Revelation: If a revelation laser is shot through the baby, it will double the laser.

• Shooting familiars: Duplicates familiar's tears.

• Sprinkler: Tears fired by the sprinkler can be duplicated.

• Technology: When the laser passes through Multidimensional Baby, it doubles the laser.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• ???'s Soul/Abel/Cain's Other Eye: Familiar tears will be duplicated if they pass through the baby. However, due to their independent movement pattern, it can be hard to achieve duplication.

• Anti-Gravity: Multidimensional Baby will travel the same path as the Anti-Gravity tears, easily doubling any stationary shots. Any moving tears that hit it will produce a normal moving copy, however stationary tears will spawn a copy that will eventually fall to the ground even after the direction is released.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Stationary duplicated tears will release normally.

• Baby-Bender: No effect as Multidimensional Baby only duplicates Isaac's tears.

• BFFS!: The baby is larger, but tears shot through it will not do more damage.

• Box of Friends: Each copy of Multidimensional Baby follows the previous copy with a 2-second ( [Repentance] 0.66-second) delay. Tears shot through multiple babies will only be duplicated once.

• Compound Fracture: Tears that pass through Multidimensional Baby will be duplicated and cosmetically look like normal tears. Bone shards will not duplicate unless they pass through Multidimensional Baby separately.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Tech X / Trisagion: No effect.

• Eye of the Occult: Makes it more easy to use Multidimensional Baby, as Isaac can simply stand while the familiar stays on top of him.

• Lachryphagy: Duplicates tears, which tend to merge after traveling a certain distance, making it easier to feed tears. Burst tears can only be duplicated if the tear they come from didn't pass through the baby already.

• Lil Brimstone/Robo-Baby 2.0: Familiar lasers that pass through the baby will not be duplicated.

• The Ludovico Technique: Spawns another tear that will slowly follow Isaac but cannot be controlled.

• [Repentance] Spawns a stationary tear where Multidimensional Baby first appeared in the room. The tear does not follow Isaac.

• Mom's Bracelet: Throwing any obstacles through Multidimensional Baby will transform it into two 40 damage tears. Throwing obstacles that can drop pickups like mushrooms through Multidimensional Baby will cease the possibility of anything dropping from such tears. Crawl spaces, though, appear right after picking up an obstacle.

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife: No effect.

• [Repentance] Fired knife is doubled when passing through Multidimensional Baby. No effect on held knife and returning knife.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The way the tear splits resembles stimulated light emission.

• In the initial release of The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, the flashing effect that Multidimensional Baby gave tears was much more intense, and made some players feel nauseous. This was changed in version v1.06.0052.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Can double Best Friend when it passes through.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that will follow Isaac's movements on a 2.5-second delay. Tears that pass through the baby will be doubled and increase in speed.

Mutant Spider.title: Mutant Spider
Mutant Spider.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac fires 4 tears at the same time.

• [Before Repentance] Tears down: (Delay * 2.1) + 3.

• [Repentance] Tears fired per second * 0.42.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Mutant Spider is a special item.

• [Afterbirth onward] The maximum number of tears per volley that can be reached by combining and/or duplicating 20/20, The Inner Eye, Mutant Spider and The Wiz is 16. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] 20/20: Shoots 6 tears.

• [Repentance] Removes the fire rate penalty while reducing damage to 80%. Additional copies will add one additional tear with no further change to damage/fire rate.

• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Mutant Spider it creates four locusts instead of one.

• Brimstone: Shoots 4 beams at once.

• [Before Repentance] Cursed Eye: Shoots 4 shots out of each eye, for a total of 16 tears when fully charged.

• Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Replaces the single missile strike with a barrage of four consecutive missiles.

• [edition anr] The Inner Eye: Shoots 7 tears with no further decrease in fire rate.

• [Repentance] Shoots 5 tears with no further decrease in fire rate.

• Libra: Negates the firing rate reduction effect.

• Monstro's Lung: Adds 7 tears to the barrage with a significant decrease in fire rate.

• [edition anr] Mutant Spider: Fires 8 tears with no further decrease in fire rate.

• [Repentance] Each copy of the item adds +2 tears, up to the maximum of 16.

• Polyphemus: Tear rate is not lowered further. Damage is increased by a flat +5 instead of normal Polyphemus boost.

• Tractor Beam: All tears are fired along the beam.

• The Wiz: Four shots are fired in each direction.

• [Repentance] : Three shots are fired in each direction.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Before Afterbirth+] 20/20: Overridden by Mutant Spider.

• Keeper: Fires [Before Repentance] 7 / [Repentance] 5 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.

• Tainted Keeper: Fires 6 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear gains 3 orbiting tears.

• Loki's Horns: Only occasionally fires one tear in the other three directions.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Mom's Eye: No effect.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Fires three shots out of each eye.

• Pupula Duplex + Lachryphagy: The four shots instantly fuse and burst.

• Sad Bombs / Varicose Veins / It Hurts: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• It might be a nod to Spiderman and the general trope of gaining superpowers by being bitten by a radiative animal.

• This item is often called "Quad Shot" by the community instead of Mutant Spider.

fields.description: Isaac shoots four tears at once with lower fire rate.

Mushroom (Disambiguation).title: Mushroom (Disambiguation)
Mushroom (Disambiguation).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Mushroom may refer to:

sections.heading: Items
sections.text:
• 1up!, passively grants an extra life.

• Blue Cap, passively grants increased health and tears, while decreasing shot speed.

• Magic Mushroom, passively grants increases to several attributes.

• Mini Mush, passively grants increased speed and shot height, while decreasing range and character size.

• Odd Mushroom (Large), passively grants increases to several attributes, while decreasing speed.

• Odd Mushroom (Thin), passively grants increased speed and tears, while decreasing damage.

• God's Flesh, passively causes shots to shrink some enemies.

• Mega Mush, an active item that gigantifies the character for 30 seconds, persisting between rooms and floors.

• Wavy Cap, an active item that increase the fire rate, but distorts the screen and background music.

sections.heading: Obstacles
sections.text: • Mushroom (Obstacle), a destructible obstacle commonly found in Chapter 2 and the Secret Room.

sections.heading: Trinkets
sections.text: • Liberty Cap, a trinket which may grant the effects of either Mini Mush, Odd Mushroom (Large), Odd Mushroom (Thin), or The Compass for the current room upon entering.

sections.heading: Enemies
sections.text: • [Afterbirth+ onward] Mushroom, a monster that resembles a mushroom.

sections.heading: Transformations
sections.text: • [Afterbirth onward] Fun Guy, a walking Mushroom that grants a red heart container.

TNT.title: TNT
TNT.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
• Blocks movement.

• Can be destroyed by tears, explosions, stomping effects (such as Thunder Thighs), or certain effects that grant invulnerability (such as The Gamekid and My Little Unicorn).

• Explodes when destroyed.

• Small chance to drop a Match Stick or a Burnt Penny when destroyed.

sections.heading: [Afterbirth onward] Movable TNT
sections.text:
• Can be pushed around by Isaac and enemies.

• Can be destroyed by tears, explosions, or stompy effects.

• Unlike normal TNT, it cannot be destroyed by invulnerability effects and Hagalaz.

• Explodes when destroyed.

• Occasionally replaces normal TNT.

• Can be spawned with Mine Crafter.

• [Repentance] Moveable TNT spawned by Mine Crafter takes a unique cubic appearance.

• Will explode when pushed into a Fire Place, a Spiked Rock, or a Red Poop.
[end edition note]

Chocolate Milk.title: Chocolate Milk
Chocolate Milk.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.

• Tear damage scales from approximately 10% damage at a minimum charge to 400% damage at full charge.

• • The minimum charge damage increases as Isaac's fire rate increases.

• [Before Repentance] Tear delay: ×2.5.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Repeatedly pressing a key to fire allows Isaac to fire as quickly as the key is pressed, up to the equivalent of a maxed tears stat. This is not generally recommended, as overall damage per second is greatly reduced.

• Rapid-fire can be useful for dealing with low-health enemies or for quickly destroying obstacles like poops or fireplaces, for whom DPS is less relevant, or chance-based tear effects.

• Having multiple instances of Chocolate Milk has no effect.

• [Repentance] At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed. Higher fire rate results in higher tear damage. At 120.00 fire rate, tears deal 4× Isaac's damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fires multiple charged shots.

• Cricket's Body / The Parasite / Compound Fracture: Since split tears tend to hit the same target the main tear hits, this can allow for much higher damage.

• The Forgotten: When charging the club, instead of being thrown, the club grows bigger in size and damage.

• Tainted Azazel: The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Sneezing on enemies fills half the charge meter and can be immediately released for high damage.

• Explosivo: Firing quickly generates a lot of explosive tears, which leads to a much higher damage than firing tears alone.

• Godhead: Charging the shots increases the size and damage of the aura.

• [Repentance] Charging the shots increases the size of the aura, but not its damage.

• Guppy: Firing quickly generates lots of Blue Flies, which can lead to much higher damage than firing tears alone.

• Haemolacria: Increased tear delay. Completely charged shots and their burst tears are larger and deal higher damage than normal. Chocolate Milk also allows low-damage Haemolacria shots to be fired rapidly.

• Haemolacria + Tech X: rings are created where the Haemolacria shot splashes. The Tech X rings do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.

• Haemolacria + Brimstone: Haemolacria bursts into 4-7 brimstone beams that do full damage even on minimum charge shots that were fired rapidly.

• Immaculate Heart: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.

• Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye: Fires' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to fire full damage flames frequently.

• Parasitoid / The Mulligan: Flies and spiders generated deal full damage regardless of charge, allowing Isaac to shoot low damage tears to generate flies and spiders rapidly which do full damage.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's Tears / Sad Bombs / Tammy's Head: The size and damage of all generated tears correspond to the current charge level of Chocolate Milk. Isaac's Tears will nearly instantly recharge while charging a Chocolate Milk shot.

• [Repentance] Charge level does not affect generated tears. Isaac's Tears recharge only when a shot is fired.

• Ipecac: Increased tear delay. Charged shots deal massively increased damage, as the +40 damage from Ipecac is run through the damage multiplier of Chocolate Milk. It also allows low-damage Ipecac shots to be fired rapidly.

• Lachryphagy: Rapidly firing small, uncharged tears can cause the fed tear to grow into a gigantic tear that will still deal fairly low damage while feeding tears with charged tears will result in higher-damage tears.

• [Repentance] Charged and uncharged fed tears deal similar damage.

• Mom's Wig: Spiders rapidly spawn while charging.

• [Repentance] Spiders spawn only when a shot is fired.

• Monstro's Lung: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%, allowing Monstro's Lung to charge faster. Each tear from Monstro's Lung is also a charged Chocolate Milk shot, massively increasing damage.

• [Repentance] Tear damage, along with the number of tears fired is dependent on charge time.

• Polyphemus: Increased tear delay. Massively increases the damage of each shot, and charged tears decay in damage much slower as they pierce as a result.

• Sinus Infection: Booger damage is influenced by the damage of the individual tear, so fully-charged Chocolate Milk shots can result in very potent damage over time.

• Technology 2: Damage dealt by the laser is equal to Isaac's current charge, leading to constant high damage from a safe distance.

• [Repentance] The laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage regardless of charge, tears are affected by Chocolate Milk as normal.

• Trisagion: Fully charged beams deal four times normal damage. Trisagion's shots are colored brown.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: No effect, but retains the reduced tear delay.

• Azazel / Brimstone: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.

• [Repentance] The beam takes longer to fully charge, but can be released at any point during its charge. Width and damage of the beam increases at higher charges; width scales from 50% at minimum charge to 160% at maximum charge, while damage scales from 25% at minimum charge to 250% at maximum charge.

• C Section: Overrides Chocolate Milk.

• Cursed Eye: The charge bar only indicates the current charge for Chocolate Milk, not for Cursed Eye; the latter's charge is determined by the eye's glow. If charged until Cursed Eye fully glows, Isaac fires one Chocolate Milk shot, followed by up to three minimal power ones.

• [Repentance] Cursed Eye takes longer to charge, but low damage shots can be fired rapidly. If fully charged, Isaac fires five Chocolate Milk shots.

• Dr. Fetus: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Bombs can't be charged.

• Epic Fetus: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Missiles can't be charged.

• The Ludovico Technique: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. The tear can't be charged.

• [Repentance] Overrides Chocolate Milk.

• Mom's Knife: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.

• Marked: Isaac will automatically charge his shots. Fire rate increases when the crosshair is closer to Isaac, and damage increases when the crosshair is farther from Isaac.

• Mega Blast: Firing the Mega Blast beam while Chocolate Milk charges preserve the charge, but does not increase the beam's damage.

• Neptunus: Overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.

• Neptunus + Kidney Stone: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.

• Soy Milk: Overrides Chocolate Milk, but Isaac gains a flat +1 damage bonus after the Soy Milk damage penalty.

• [Repentance] Shoots moderately charged shots at a quick pace with no increase in damage.

• Sprinkler: The size and damage of the sprinkler's tears depend on Isaac's current charge amount.

• [Repentance] No effect on Sprinkler.

• Technology: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Lasers can't be charged.

• [Repentance] Lasers can be charged, dealing up to 4× damage when fully charged. Low-damage lasers can also be fired rapidly.

• • At 30.00 fire rate or above, charging is no longer needed and lasers deal 4× damage.

• Tech X: Reduces Isaac's current tear delay by 20%. Doesn't increase damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • [Afterbirth onward] This item is used in Onan's Streak. [end edition note]

fields.description: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.

Chub.title: Chub
Chub.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Chub is a boss that can appear in the Caves and the Flooded Caves.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Chub moves randomly around the room in cardinal directions and can perform the following attacks:

• Charges at Isaac whenever she lines up with one of her cardinal directions.

• Chub eats any Bombs dropped in her path; stunning her for a moment before dealing considerable damage.

• Spawns 1-2 Chargers, up to a maximum of 5 (occasionally 6 if she spawns 2 while there are 4 alive).

• Chub's charge attack can damage and kill any Chargers.
Chub deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 7] : 15% larger and slower than normal, with 25% more HP (437.5). Spawns [Before Repentance] Black/ [Repentance] Orange-coloured Boils instead of Chargers. Despite the different color, they behave exactly like normal Boils. (Note that this actually looks green in-game, but internally it is labeled as blue. This is because yellow mixes with blue to cause green.)
[bc: 6] : 15% smaller and faster than normal, with 15% less HP (297.5). Spawns Spitty instead of Chargers.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Chub is often paired with Chargers in the boss room.

• [Afterbirth onward] She can also be paired with Drowned Chargers. [end edition note] 

• When using Dr. Fetus' bomb combined with a shot type that passes through enemies, Chub will not eat the bomb.

• Each segment of Chub can be individually damaged, so a single piercing tear could hit Chub multiple times.

• [Repentance] Piercing shots no longer damage segmented enemies multiple times per attack.

• Chub will eat Troll Bombs (such as those set by other bosses) just like bombs dropped by Isaac.

• Best Friend can damage Chub if eaten, similar to a bomb.

• Meat Cleaver can instantly kill Chub.

• Chub can spawn without the last segment.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Chub appeared in the original Binding of Isaac.

• Sometimes, in the original game, Chub would spawn with only two segments, preventing her from spawning anything. This can also happen in Repentance.

• Carrion Queen is the posthumous version of her, and C.H.A.D. is the alternate version.

• She is the boss version of the Chargers.

• Chub is one of four bosses to have its posthumous version in the same chapter, the other cases being Gemini having Blighted Ovum in chapter 1, [Afterbirth onward] Polycephalus having The Stain in chapter 2 [end edition note] [Repentance] and the Tuff Twins having The Shell in Chapter 2.5 [end edition note] .

• However, Chub doesn't appear in the same environment as Carrion Queen, who appears in the Catacombs while Chub appears in The Caves and the [Afterbirth onward] Flooded Caves.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Prior to Booster Pack #5, Chub could spawn Drowned Chargers if she was fought in the Flooded Caves. 

• Chub is female.

• Chub may also be a reference to the Dodongos from The Legend of Zelda, which Link had to toss bombs into their mouths to kill. This is supported by the Rules Card's display of "CHUB DISLIKES SMOKE", a reference to "DODONGO DISLIKES SMOKE" from the original Legend of Zelda.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The Matriarch is a boss from Booster Pack #5 that is simultaneously based on Chub, Fistula, and Fistuloid. When at low HP, she will split into a medium-sized Fistula, two small Fistulas, a Fistuloid and Chub. [end edition note] 

• Unlike the usual pattern, if the Chub from The Matriarch eats a bomb, she'll spit it back at the player.

• Chub is one of the four bosses that can be spawned by It Lives!, the other three being Fistula, Polycephalus, and Teratoma.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If Chub is killed while frozen by Mom's Contacts, only the part to receive the last shot will die.
Bug note: Chub's last part can be temporarily disconnected with Anima Sola.

Circle of Protection.title: Circle of Protection
Circle of Protection.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo.

• Once per second, the halo deals Isaac's Damage to all enemies currently inside it.

• Each enemy shot has a 30% chance to be reflected by the halo.

• • The chance is predetermined, and not affected by how long it is exposed by the halo.

• • The reflectable tears are reflected once they touch the middle line of the halo, and is converted into friendly purple homing tears that have Isaac's Damage and no other tear modifiers.

• • [Repentance] Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) do not create the projectiles once reflected. [end edition note] 

• • Can reflect:

• • 
• Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle), which do not explode once reflected.

• • 
• [Repentance] Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), which do not create lines of fire once reflected. [end edition note] 

• • 
• Fire projectiles (e.g. from Mega Satan).

• • 
• [Repentance] Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti. [end edition note] 

• • Does not reflect:

• • 
• Lasers or beams.

• • 
• [Repentance] Lines of fire from fireballs.

• • 
• [Repentance] Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Circle of Protection: Multiple copies of this item through sources such as Diplopia or Crooked Penny has no effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Circle of Protection is based on a cycle of Magic: the Gathering cards of the same name, which similarly provide defensive effects to their wielder.

• Circle of Protection's in-game icon may be based on the band A Perfect Circle's logo. The pickup quote is also similar to the lyrics of their song Pet.

fields.description: Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo that occasionally deals Isaac's tear damage to enemies inside it, and can convert enemy shots into friendly homing tears.

Clear Rune.title: Clear Rune
Clear Rune.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Blank Rune]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, copies the effects of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac.

• Drops one random rune upon being picked up for the first time.

sections.heading: Recharge time
sections.text:
This is a list of the following recharge times the item can have, depending on the consumable it mimicked last:

• 1 room:

• Rune Shard

• Soul of Lazarus

• 2 rooms:

• Ansuz

• Berkano

• Hagalaz

• Soul of Judas

• 3 rooms:

• Blank Rune

• Soul of ???

• Soul of Judas

• Soul of the Lost

• Soul of Magdalene

• 4 rooms:

• Berkano

• Black Rune

• Algiz

• Ehwaz

• Perthro

• Soul of Eden

• Soul of Eve

• Soul of the Forgotten

• Soul of Isaac

• Soul of Jacob and Esau

• 6 rooms:

• Dagaz

• Soul of Apollyon

• Soul of Azazel

• Soul of Bethany

• Soul of Cain

• Soul of Samson

• 12 rooms:

• Jera

• Soul of the Keeper

• Soul of Lilith

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns purple glowing rune wisps on the middle ring. The wisps spawn random Runes/Soul Stones when destroyed, and enemies killed by the wisps' tears have a 15% chance to drop a Rune/Soul Stone. A wisp is given even if Isaac is not holding a rune when the item is used.

• Car Battery: Essentially uses the rune or soul stone twice.

• Jera: Allows Isaac to copy pickups with every use. This combination can double Lil' Battery, which can both circumvent the rune's high charge time and allow for game-breaking combos with repeated use of the synergy.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Tarot Cloth: No effect.

• Void: If Void absorbs both Clear Rune and a consumable-producing item like Mom's Bottle of Pills the latter takes effect first, shifting any held rune out of the primary consumable slot and rendering the Clear Rune effect useless.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a Rune counterpart to Blank Card and Placebo.

• This item's unlock method is likely a nod to its similar functionality to Blank Card but Clear Rune being unable to follow the same naming convention due to Blank Rune already existing.

• Despite being introduced in the Repentance DLC, Clear Rune's place in the Collection Menu is on Page 3, along with other Rebirth items. This is due to the item taking up a previously unused item id. This also means that this item needs to be unlocked and picked up in a normal run to get both !Platinum God! and The Real Platinum God achievements.

fields.description: Copies the effect of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the rune. Drops a random rune when first picked up.

Clicker.title: Clicker
Clicker.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Upon use, transforms Isaac into a random character and [Before Repentance+] removes the last item collected (not including Clicker) or gulped trinket.

• [Repentance+] Now has a 50% chance to remove the last item collected or gulped trinket.

• All stat changes of the new character are applied.

• [Repentance] Non-tainted characters can only transform into other non-tainted characters, and tainted characters can only transform into other tainted characters.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Clicker can only transform Isaac into characters that have already been unlocked, along with Black Judas and Lazarus Risen, who are counted as separate from Judas and Lazarus respectively. The Forgotten and The Soul, Jacob and Esau, Tainted Lazarus and Dead Tainted Lazarus, Tainted Forgotten and Tainted Soul are all counted as inherently linked dual-characters.

• Ankh, Lazarus' Rags, Missing Poster, or Judas' Shadow can allow a tainted character to become ???, Lazarus, The Lost, or Black Judas (besides their respective tainted forms) allowing the Clicker to transform them into other non-tainted characters. There is no way for a non-tainted character to become a tainted character.

• [Before Repentance] It is possible for the Clicker to choose the same character as the one that is already being played as, making it seem like the item created no effect at all.

• Transforming into a new character does not grant Isaac the starting items of the new character unless they are inherent to the character. For example, transforming into Cain does not grant Lucky Foot.

• Changing characters can adversely affect health.

• All Red Heart containers will be lost, and all Bone Heart containers will be emptied when changing into ???, [Repentance] Black Judas, Tainted ???, Tainted Judas, or Tainted Forgotten. They will gain a Half Soul Heart if they would otherwise have no health.

• All health will be lost when changing into The Lost. Changing from The Lost to any other character will leave them with a Half Soul Heart.

• [Before Repentance] Keeper will always start with 2 Coin Heart containers. Bone and Half Soul/Black Hearts will be rounded up to 1 or 2 filled coins. Red Hearts are not rounded, which allows him to have half Coin Hearts. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.

• • [Repentance] All Red Heart containers are converted to Coin Heart containers when transforming into Keeper, with a minimum of 2 and up to a maximum of 3. Only red hearts will determine if the coin heart containers are filled or not, and Soul/Black hearts will be converted into blue flies. One coin heart container will be filled if he would otherwise have no health. Changing from Keeper to any other character will turn his Coin Hearts into Red Hearts.

• Changing into The Forgotten will not affect The Soul's health. Red Hearts are converted into Bone Hearts. Soul/Black Hearts will be lost. He will gain an empty Bone Heart if he would otherwise have no health.

• [Repentance] All soul hearts will be converted to soul charges when changing into Bethany. She will gain one full Red Heart container if she would otherwise have no health. Changing from Bethany to any other character will convert her soul charges into soul hearts.

• [Repentance] Heart Containers will be divided evenly and split up when changing into Jacob and Esau. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined health.

• Activating Clicker typically only consumes passive items, but with Schoolbag, it can consume the item in the other activated item slot if that item was the most recently collected.

• Similarly to items such as Ankh, Lazarus' Rags, or Judas' Shadow any completion marks obtained will correspond with the character the Clicker turns you into.

• Tainted Cain can craft the Clicker and other useful items and then use Clicker to change characters. In this way, runs started as Tainted Cain can be useful to complete other characters' completion marks, even when Tainted Cain's own completion marks are finished. Although Clicker will only turn tainted characters into other tainted characters, Tainted Cain can also craft Ankh, Lazarus' Rags, or Judas' Shadow and die to become a non-tainted character then use the Clicker to change into other non-tainted characters.

• [Before Repentance] Removed items still count towards transformations.

• Changing into Eden or Tainted Eden will not use tokens. Additionally, both Eden's base stats will be the same as Isaac's if he wasn't the character selected at the start of the run.

• Changing from Eden or Tainted Eden will leave the Luck stat decimal. If the character the Clicker turns you into has base luck stat different from 0, Luck will change by a whole number (e. g. turning into Keeper will decrease your base luck by 2 instead of setting it to -2.00).

• Changing into Jacob and Esau will randomly distribute items between the two. Changing from Jacob and Esau to any other character will leave them with Jacob and Esau's combined items. Changing into Jacob and Esau will drop the currently held consumables like pills, cards etc. on the floor, but will keep trinkets. Esau's consumables and trinkets will always be dropped on the ground when changing to a different character. Jacob's consumables and trinkets will be transferred to the new character.

• Changing into Tainted Isaac will remove every passive item except the 8 oldest items Isaac holds.

• Changing into Tainted Lazarus will give every passive item to only one of the forms.

• Changing into Dead Tainted Lazarus will remove the auto-swap affect.

• Changing from Tainted Lazarus into another character will only keep the items of the form that used Clicker.

• [Before Repentance] If Dead Cat was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will remove individual lives instead of the entire item.

• [Before Repentance] If Halo of Flies was the last item to be picked up, Clicker will only remove one fly at a time (including Pretty Flies obtained from pills and Slot Machines) instead of the entire item.

• In [mode: greed; greedier] Greed Mode, changing character using Clicker will update the Jam Chance of the Greed Donation Machine to the corresponding character chosen by Clicker.

• This can be useful for maxing out the coin counter of the machine, and obtaining unlocks while using a single character (like Lilith or Judas) to make the process easier and faster, and only changing characters at the end of the run.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Replaces the most recently acquired item with Pentagram instead of removing it. Birthright's effects will also change to that of the character transformed into.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a random wisp.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: Isaac will transform twice and have the last two picked up items removed.

• Rock Bottom: Stat upgrades given by removed items are retained, and the best stats of each character you turn into are retained, possibly creating some powerful characters, like Tainted Keeper with all the Berserk stats of Tainted Samson.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Clicker is a TV remote, and the static overlay when the item is used references when a channel is switched.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If Lazarus dies, becomes Lazarus Risen, and then uses Clicker to become another character, the character can have Lazarus' hair and freckles. This also works with reviving items such as Ankh.
Bug note: If Clicker is used in The Soul form of The Forgotten, it is possible to be turned into another Forgotten. Both Forgottens have independent health bars and can be swapped between, but no Soul form exists anymore. Turning into any other character does not cause the bug.
Bug note: If the player only had empty heart containers before changing to Bethany, doing so kills her instantly.
Bug note: If Clicker is used as Tainted Lazarus while holding Birthright, the active form will click to another character, but the other form will still be in its ghostly form due to the effects of Birthright. Clearing rooms will alternate between the activity of the ghostly form, switching it's vulnerability and health from the main character, and placing clicker in the pocket item slot. Exiting and re-entering the game during this will cause a softlock unless the player has a second controller, which if not available, will make the player unable to continue the run.
Bug note: If Clicker is used as any character that has half of red heart, then when becoming a Keeper / Tainted Keeper, it will visually seem like he has half of the coin heart. After exiting the menu, half of the coin will turn into a full coin heart. If the character had an eternal or golden heart before using the clicker, it will be fully transferred to the keepers and will work as on regular characters, with the only difference being that the eternal heart will not provide additional protection from one hit.
Bug note: Transforming Jacob and Esau to The Lost or Keeper triggers a golden heart explosion, even if there wasn't any in the health bar.

fields.description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has [Before Repentance+] 100% / [Repentance] 50% chance to remove the last item collected.
fields.tags: [edition alternatives: baseline: nolostbr nochallenge nodaily; Repentance+: nolostbr nochallenge]

Cod Worm.title: Cod Worm
Cod Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A Cod Worm is a special variant of the Para-Bite in an immobile shell that can be found in Chapter 4. It was introduced in the vanilla content of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth.

Instead of chasing Isaac like the regular Para-Bites, the Cod Worm stays in its shell and will spew a burst of blood shots if shot at. After some time, it will reveal itself and become vulnerable to attacks.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A cod worm is an aquatic parasite of marine fish.

• Cod worm has a resemblance to the Pokémon Shuckle.

• Prior to Booster Pack #5, if a Cod Worm was killed before enemies finished spawning, the Cod Worm would die, even in its invincible form.

fields.environment: Womb / Utero / Scarred Womb /
fields.behavior: Stationary enemy that hides in a shell and spews a burst of blood shots if shot at. Only vulnerable when it pops its head out.

Collection Page.title: Collection Page
Collection Page.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Collection Page can be found under "Items" In the "Stats" menu. It shows all the items that have ever been picked up on that save file.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The following will NOT count as picking up items and therefore doesn't add entries to the collection grid:

• [Before Repentance] Items which are intrinsic to a character and can't be rerolled.

• Any item interaction during seeded runs.

• • [Afterbirth onward] Certain special seeds do not disable the addition of entries.

• • [Afterbirth onward] Daily runs count as seeded runs.

• Any item interaction during challenge runs.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Any item interaction during Victory Laps.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Temporary items granted by Metronome. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Item wisps created with Lemegeton. [end edition note] 

• Afterbirth changed the grid size of pages from 10x10 to 20x6.

• Gaining items via re-rolls (such as Missing No. and D100) counts towards the collection grid, even if the items have not been unlocked yet.

• Trinkets are not on the collection grid, [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] except for Tonsil. [end edition note]

Compost.title: Compost
Compost.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, converts pickups within the current room to Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.

• Doubles Isaac's current amount of Blue Flies and Spiders.

• If Isaac has no Blue Flies or Spiders, spawns one Blue Fly or Spider.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop

• Does not work on Troll Bombs or Mega Troll Bombs.

• One character using it does not seem to double the spiders/flies for other characters. It only seems to double the ones following the character using the item.

• [Repentance] Locusts will not be doubled by Compost.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a wisp in the middle ring if Compost destroys at least one pickup, and the wisp's health will be equal to the number of pickups converted to Blue Flies/Spiders. If Isaac hits the blue fly cap of 64 as a result of using Compost, all but one of Isaac's wisps will despawn.

• Car Battery: Spawns 2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders for each pickup removed, quadruples the current amount and spawns two if there is none.

• Fish Tail: Isaac will gain twice as many flies per use, meaning each fly will be tripled.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Compost is organic matter that has been decomposed and recycled as fertilizer.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: When using the item and obtaining an item (cards/pills/items) at the same time it will make the picked-up item disappear.
Bug note: The game incorrectly tracks Tainted Lazarus's number of blue flies and spiders after flipping between forms. This often results in compost becoming unable to double his spiders/flies.

fields.description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.

Compound Fracture.title: Compound Fracture
Compound Fracture.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Brittle Bones]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 shards upon hitting an obstacle or enemy, which each deal 50% of Isaac's Damage.

• Unlike The Parasite, there is no damage minimum on splitting, but the tears can also split only once.

• The shards have a fixed size, about the same as a 3.5 damage tear, regardless of their Damage.

• +1.5 Range.

• [Before Repentance] +1.0 Tear Falling Speed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item can be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Pile. [end edition note] 

• Unlike The Parasite and Cricket's Body, Compound Fracture is overriden by most tear replacing items instead of having a synergy, making the item less versatile than those.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bob's Rotten Head: The bomb will break into 1-3 more bombs which are launched in random directions from the point of impact.

• C Section: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.

• Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Each tear splits into more tears, which will all shatter.

• Haemolacria: Tears will sometimes burst into smaller tears when hitting obstacles or enemies. These smaller tears are miniature versions of Haemolacria tears, which will burst when hitting the ground.

• Ipecac: If the bone tear hits a wall or an obstacle, it will split into explosive half-damage shards. Hits on enemies and the floor behave as normal Ipecac.

• The Ludovico Technique: Tear turns into a spinning bone that rapidly spews out smaller bone shots on contact with enemies.

• Kidney Stone: First bullet shatters into smaller kidney stone bullets.

• Spectral tears: Bones pass through obstacles and generate shards for each obstacle they pass through, which can result in many shards being generated from a single bone.

• Technology Zero: The bone fragments will be connected by the electric current.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Bone tears will hover until released but bone shards will travel normally.

• Brimstone / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Technology / Tech X: Overrides Compound Fracture.

• Flat Stone: Bone tears will bounce when they are fired, however, bone shards will not bounce when they travel.

• The Forgotten: Smaller bone shots appear whenever an enemy is hit with the melee attack. [Before Repentance] The bone toss is unaffected.

• [Repentance] Bone toss attack also creates bone tears.

• Lachryphagy: Bone tears can be fed and will burst into split tears. Bone tears will burst into bone shards when hitting obstacles or enemies which can also be fed and burst into split tears and bone shards yet again. When bone shards are fed, they turn back into bone tears which can repeat this process again and again.

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife: Overrides Compound Fracture.

• [Repentance] Knife will occasionally spawn bone fragments.

• [Before Repentance] Rubber Cement: Tears turn to bones, but bones do not shatter.

• [Repentance] Tears hitting enemies will both shatter and bounce simultaneously.

• Technology 2: The laser is not affected, but bone tears still shoot from Isaac's left eye.

• Tractor Beam: Bone tears will not burst into bone shards when fired at obstacles, however, bone tears will burst into bone shards when fired at enemies.

• Trisagion: Beams will only burst when hitting obstacles.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The item is a reference to a compound fracture, a medical condition where a bone breaks and is exposed through the skin.

fields.description: Increases Range. Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 bone shards upon hitting an enemy or obstacle.

Cone Head.title: Cone Head
Cone Head.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a Soul Heart.

• Any damage dealt to Isaac has a 20% chance to be ignored.

• This includes damage through tears, contact, explosions, Curse Room, Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, and Bad Trip pills.

• • Contact damage with enemies is difficult to avoid, as the damage negation does not provide invincibility frames.

• Isaac flashes briefly blue when damage is negated. The flash can occur even while invincible from taking a hit or using an invincibility effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blood Rights/IV Bag/Kamikaze!/Razor Blade: Has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.

• Hallowed Ground / Host Hat / Infamy / Belly Jelly / Metal Plate / Star of Bethlehem: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.

• Holy Mantle: Cone Head's chance of blocking damage is applied before the Holy Mantle, allowing the Holy Mantle shield to be saved.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Dull Razor: Damage prevention will prevent on-damage effects from occurring.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The item is a reference to the recurring Saturday Night Live sketch, The Coneheads.

fields.description: Grants a Soul Heart. Gives Isaac a chance to ignore any damage taken.

Conjoined.title: Conjoined
Conjoined.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Conjoined is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, grows two tumor faces from Isaac's cheeks after picking up 3 baby familiar items.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac fires tears from the tumor faces simultaneously and diagonally (similar to the effect of The Wiz), while continuing to shoot forwards.

• -0.3 damage and tears.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list ( [Repentance] with the [code: baby] tag).

sections.heading: Passive Collectibles
sections.text:
[collectible rows: Brother Bobby, Harlequin Baby, Headless Baby, Little Steven, Mongo Baby, Rotten Baby, Sister Maggy] 
[collectible rows: Abel, Acid Baby, Boiled Baby, Buddy in a Box, Cube Baby, Demon Baby, Dry Baby, Farting Baby, Freezer Baby, Ghost Baby, Guardian Angel, Incubus, King Baby, Lil Abaddon, Lil Brimstone, Lil Loki, Multidimensional Baby, Quints, Rainbow Baby, Robo-Baby, Robo-Baby 2.0, Seraphim, Sworn Protector, Twisted Pair] 
[collectible rows: Lil Delirium] 
|}

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Isaac starts with this transformation in The Family Man challenge, but due to the challenge's blindfolded property, it's useless without Incubus.

• Little Gish, Lil Monstro, Lil Delirium, and Lilith's Incubus do not contribute toward the transformation.

• Familiars obtained from Cambion Conception, Immaculate Conception or Monster Manual do not contribute toward the transformation.

• [Repentance] Familiars obtained from Soul of Lilith contribute toward the transformation. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Using Sacrificial Altar can remove Conjoined if it lowers the number of familiars below 3. [end edition note]

fields.description: Adds two tumors that fire diagonally from Isaac's head. -0.3 Damage, -0.3 Tears.

A Lump of Coal.title: A Lump of Coal
A Lump of Coal.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Tears gain a flat damage bonus of about +0.5-0.6 per tile of distance traveled, unaffected by all multipliers. There is no upper limit to the bonus.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can be found as a drop from killing Krampus [Afterbirth+ onward] or a possible payout of Mystery Gift.

• Both Krampus and Mystery Gift can drop this item, even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• The item has somewhat of an opposite effect of the item Proptosis, which makes Isaac deal more damage at close range. Proptosis is based on a shrinking multiplier instead of an increasing flat bonus, however.

• Multiple instances of A Lump of Coal grants no additional effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Godhead:

• [Before Repentance] Tears' auras will increase in size and damage the farther they travel.

• [Repentance] Tears' auras will increase in size the farther they travel. The damage of the auras is unaffected.

• Hook Worm: The movement pattern increases Coal's damage at the same effective distance.

• The Ludovico Technique: Increases the tear's damage and size the farther the tear is from Isaac.

• My Reflection: Hitting enemies with tears that initially missed will grant possibly considerable extra damage.

• Pop!: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.

• Soy Milk: Coal's flat damage increase is not affected by Soy Milk's multiplier, so tears gain the full benefit from Coal.

• Tiny Planet: The movement pattern allows much longer airtime and reasonably easy way to hit enemies with the powered-up tears.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Despite the tears visually growing while they hover, they will still only deal bonus damage based strictly on how far they travel. If the enemy hits the tears by running into them, Coal will add no damage.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Tears no longer grow while hovering.

• Athame:

• [Before Afterbirth+] Damage of the Athame ring is halved.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The ring deals normal damage.

• Brimstone:

• [Rebirth only] +2 flat damage.

• [Afterbirth onward] Beam will gradually increase in size and damage the farther it travels, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.

• Brimstone + The Ludovico Technique: Makes the Brimstone circle widen and deal damage based on how far away it is from your character. [Before Repentance] While Isaac is in the center of the circle, the damage is reduced to about 50% (unlike normal Coal effects).

• C Section: Just as expected, fetuses deal more damage a tick the longer they travel.

• Dr. Fetus: No benefit though the bombs appear darker.

• Epic Fetus: No benefit.

• Lachryphagy: Tears will grow until they burst, though their actual damage bonus is only based on distance traveled. Burst tears will also grow as they travel.

• A Lump of Coal: No benefit from an additional Lump.

• Maw Of The Void:

• [Before Afterbirth+] Damage of the Maw ring is halved.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The ring deals normal damage.

• Mom's Knife: No benefit. The Knife becomes a very dark brown.

• Proptosis:

• [Before Repentance] The damage of the tears decreases at about the same rate it increases, resulting in them dealing approximately the same damage at any range.

• [Repentance] : Slightly increases the range and damage of Proptosis tears.

• Ring Worm / Ouroboros Worm: The peculiar movement patterns result in overall less damage from the same effective distance.

• Technology / Technology 2:

• [Rebirth only] No benefit.

• [Afterbirth onward] Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.

• Tech X: The laser ring will grow as the ring distances itself from the player, but will shrink as the player approaches it. Damage increases the further away the enemy is.

• [Repentance] The damage increase per tile is significantly lower.

• Trisagion: The damage of the blasts is increased by a negligible amount and will be increased further if Isaac has an item that extends the length of the beams such as My Reflection.

• [Repentance] The damage of the blasts will not be increased unless Isaac has an item that extends the length of the beams such as My Reflection.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In Western culture, children are commonly told that if they behave badly during the year, they will receive a piece of coal for Christmas.

• This makes A Lump of Coal a fitting item for Krampus to drop, based on his origins.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: In Greed Mode, if Isaac picks upA Lump of Coal in a Silver Treasure Room and then fights Krampus,A Lump of Coal may still drop after the fight. Since this item's effect does not stack with itself, this will give Isaac a useless item.

fields.description: The more distance tears travel, the more damage they will do.

Danny.title: Danny
Danny.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the monster found in Mines] 
Dannies are an enemy added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance. They are exclusive to Mines and Ashpit.

They walk towards Isaac, periodically spitting a burst of rocks towards him, up to two of which may be Rock Spiders. Their rock bursts cannot spawn Rock Spiders if the two it spawned are still alive. Dannies have a long cooldown between rock bursts, but are more likely to use it soon after Isaac enters the room.

sections.heading: Coal Boy
sections.text: Coal Boys appear in the Mines and Ashpit. They walk towards Isaac, periodically spitting four hot coals towards him, one of which may be a Coal Spider. Hot coals linger and can hurt Isaac, but disappear after ~15 seconds, and disappear faster if they take damage. Coal Boys cannot summon coal spiders if the one it spawned is still alive. Coal Boys have a six second cooldown between coal spits, but are more likely to use it soon after Isaac enters the room.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Dannies and Coal Boys originate from the Antibirth mod.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the enemy; the item; Lil Haunt; the boss; The Haunt] 

Lil' Haunts are ghost enemies that slightly mimic the movements of Isaac, which allows them to "chase" him if Isaac constantly tries running away from them. Occasionally, they stop to spew blood shots towards the location Isaac will be in if he doesn't stop moving; this did not have an animation up till Repentance, making it difficult to telegraph.

Three Lil' Haunts circle The Haunt in its first phase. The first one charges at Isaac, and after the first is killed, the second and third charge at Isaac. The Black Champion Haunt will be circled by two Lil' Haunts, and The Pink Champion Haunt will only be circled by one.

Lil Portal.title: Lil Portal
Lil Portal.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the item; the enemy; Portal; the chapter; The Void]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies.

• [Repentance+] The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping.

• The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into blue flies and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage.

• [Before Repentance+] When the familiar consumes 4 pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to an unexplored room on the current floor and its damage bonus is reset.

• [Repentance+] When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple Clean Bedroom and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor.

• The room contains a random Chest in the top left corner, a chance for a random battery in the bottom left corner, and a chance of Dice Shard, Soul of Eden, Butter!, or Moving Box, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered.

• This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal.

• [Before Repentance+] Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 + 2 * (consumables destroyed) and ticks up to 10 times per second.

• [Repentance+] Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.

• There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Lil Portal doesn't consume pickups or damage enemies it passes over while trailing behind Isaac; it only does so while being launched.

• Lil Portal doesn't consume poop pickups when playing as Tainted ???.

• [Before Repentance+] The portal cannot lead to the Devil Room, Angel Room, Ultra Secret Room, entrance to the alt-path, Black Market, I AM ERROR Room, or Mega Satan fight.

• In the Mirrored World, the Ultra Secret Room is accessible via the portal.

• [Before Repentance+] The room portals take Isaac to is determined at the time they're created; if Isaac clears the room the portal would take him to, he will still be taken to that room if he uses it.

• [Before Repentance+] If every room has been explored, portals summoned by the familiar will do nothing and Isaac will jump up and down in them. This effect appears to be cosmetic only, but it will provide brief invincibility frames equivalent to two Ventricle Razor portals stacked on top of one another. Same effect occurs if a portal is summoned in rooms that don't appear on map, as Mom's Heart room in Mausoleum/Gehenna II.

• [Before Repentance+] Portals can lead to Curse Rooms, forcing Isaac to take damage in order to leave.

• [Before Repentance+] Secret Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms can be entered for free by making a portal after all other rooms on the floor are cleared.

• [Repentance+] A trapdoor created in the Lil Portal bedroom with We Need To Go Deeper! or Ehwaz will always lead to the I AM ERROR room.

• A Crawl Space can be made as normal, but leaving the Crawl Space takes Isaac to the room the portal was created in, rather than the Lil Portal bedroom.

• Unlike other changes to the room, all trapdoors will disappear on the next floor.

• If Lil Portal consumes enough pickups to create a portal, but Isaac enters a trapdoor which leads to the next floor before the portal spawns, then Lil portal will instead spawn a portal on the next floor.

• Portals will persist after Isaac uses them or leaves the room, and will always lead to the same room.

• Portals do not respect pathing rules, and can spawn on single-tile walkways and in front of doors, forcing Isaac to use them and preventing him from leaving the room through that door. This can cause a softlock depending on what door it blocks and where the portal leads.

• • As Isaac cannot enter a portal while in another animation, picking up a trinket/consumable, or taking damage will allow him to pass over the portal.

• • Alternatively if the player has items like Pluto or has consumed enough "One Makes You Small" Pills then it is possible to avoid being softlocked as pushing up against walls of any kind will still allow passage through doors and with enough speed, pitfalls and obstacles as well.

• [edition rnr+] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Portal having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

• [Repentance+] Lil Portal has the fourth-highest priority.

• If Lil Portal consumes a Golden Penny, the penny will still reappear.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • [Repentance+] R Key: The special room's contents will be reset after using R Key.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The portal spawned by Lil Portal bears a close resemblance to the Lil Portal enemies.

• [Repentance+] Internally, the special room Lil Portal leads to is just a copy of the default starting room with customized look and contents. 

• Lil Portal also does not 'teleport' Isaac to another room location, the special room is generated overtop of the current room.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If a portal is reencountered during the ascent, such as in a previously completed boss room, the game may crash if the destination the portal originally connected to no longer exists in the now altered floor layout.
Bug note: A portal can be created next to a door which can block off an entire section of the map and cause a soft lock.
Bug note: Lil Portal's shots cannot be angled.
Bug note: Entering one of the portals causes the Found Soul familiar to become invisible until Isaac drops and picks up the trinket again or enters a new floor.
Bug note: Activating Glowing Hourglass twice after Lil Portal consumed the last forth pickup will make him drop a portal while the pickups will stay untouched in the room. If you wont move after a second Glowing Hourglass activation Lil Portal will drop a portal right at the entrance, which will block it and may cause a softlock.
Bug note: Entering a portal created while fighting The Beast can result in a softlock.

Lil Spewer.title: Lil Spewer
Lil Spewer.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a random pill.

• Spawns a small Spewer familiar that charges up and fires different types of creep.

• The familiar and his creep change randomly when Isaac uses a pill.

• Possible creep includes:

• A line of damaging green creep that deals 0.4 damage per tick (12 damage per second).

• A long line of slowing black creep.

• A line of short-lasting, damaging red creep, with a larger puddle of creep at the end that lasts longer. The creep will deal 1.2 damage per tick (36 damage per second).

• A short-ranged cone of damaging yellow creep that grows larger and deals more damage the further it travels. It deals 2 damage per tick at the lowest range, and increases to 15.2 damage per tick at the furthest (~6-47 damage per second, based on range).

• A large ring of long-lasting slowing white creep.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Blastocyst. [end edition note] 

• Lil Spewer always starts with green creep.

• The familiar does not do contact damage.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Spewer having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

• The Ipecac shot created by Torn Card works for unlocking the Lil Spewer achievement.

• The explosive shots from the wisps summoned by Bob's Rotten Head and the Book of Virtues count for the Lil Spewer achievement

• Dying to an Ipecac shot with Brimstone does not unlock Lil Spewer.

• [Repentance] The same applies to Sulfur.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: Has no effect on Lil Spewer.

• BFFS!: Increases Lil Spewer's size and creep pool length (but has no effect on damage).

• Box of Friends: Creates a random spewer rather than copying the current one.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Lil Spewer is based on this Steam Workshop item by Strawrat and CupertinoEffect.

• The item originates from Edmund Mcmillen's previous game of the same name, in which Spewer could consume pills to give his vomit different effects.

• Lil Spewer was first revealed in a tweet made by Edmund McMillen as an official item for Booster Pack 5.

• In his black form, Lil Spewer resembles Gish, who creates similarly-slowing black creep.

• In his red form, Lil Spewer has a similar appearance to Super Meat Boy, from the Edmund McMillen game of the same name. In his title, Super Meat Boy also creates blood (the intended resemblance of red creep).

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Trisagion makes Lil Spewer achievement impossible to obtain via a suicide with Bob's Rotten Head or Ipecac.

fields.name: Lil Spewer
fields.description: Drops a random pill, and spawns a familiar that charges up and fires creep. Using pills changes the creep type.

Linger Bean.title: Linger Bean
Linger Bean.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Firing without a pause for [Before Repentance+] 7.5 seconds / [Repentance+] 4 seconds creates a small brown cloud that damages enemies who walk through it.

• [Before Repentance+] The damage is equal to Isaac's base tear damage, dealt roughly 5 times per second.

• • The clouds last for 15 seconds, meaning a maximum of two can be active at any given time.

• [Repentance+] The damage starts equal to Isaac's tear damage, dealt roughly 5 times per second. The damage will gradually decrease, while the cloud gradually increases in area size.

• • Each cloud lasts for 10 seconds; the damage decreases to around 43% for the duration of the cloud.

• The clouds can be moved by shooting them.

• Changing firing direction is allowed, but any pause in holding a fire button or taking damage resets the timer.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] The visual size of the cloud is not accurate, as the actual hitbox is much bigger than how it appears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Gigante Bean: The clouds will be larger, increasing the range drastically. The damage is unaffected.

fields.description: Constantly shooting causes Isaac to release gas clouds that can be pushed by his tears and damage nearby enemies. [Repentance+] The cloud will gradually increase in size, while the damage it does gradually decreases.

Little Baggy.title: Little Baggy
Little Baggy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Allows Isaac to carry two pills. Tapping the Drop button will cause a cycle through the two pills.

• Spawns a random pill.

• [Before Repentance] Changes all card and rune drops into pills.

• [Repentance] Changes all card drops into pills. Existing runes will not be converted, but new runes will only appear through forced drops (such as from Mom's Ring or Clear Rune).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Any Tarot card or rune held when picking this item up will change into a pill.

• [edition anr] Dice Shard counts as a card and will be converted. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If playing as Jacob and Esau, if one character picks up Little Baggy while the other character holds a card, that card will remain until used or dropped.

• [Repentance] Blowing up the skull marked with a small "X" in Depths will drop Telepills instead of 0 - The Fool.

• If The Fool has already been generated, the generated pill will not be guaranteed to be a Telepills.

• [Repentance] Tainted Characters who have an active item in the consumable slot will be allowed a third slot for pills.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blank Card: All cards are replaced by pills, rendering Blank Card useless unless Isaac also has Starter Deck.

• Crystal Ball: Generates pills instead of cards upon use.

• Deck of Cards: The item becomes functionally identical to Mom's Bottle of Pills.

• [Repentance] During multiplayer, if Little Baggy is held by one player, other players can still spawn cards using Deck of Cards. Dropping the card will convert it into a pill.

• False PHD: Since all cards turn to pills, there is potential for a lot of damage ups.

• Lucky Foot: Most negative pills will be converted to their positive counterparts.

• PHD/Virgo: Most negative pills will be converted to their positive counterparts.

• [Before Repentance] Starter Deck: Overrides Little Baggy. Pills may still be for sale in shops, but dropping them turns them into cards.

• [Repentance] Having both items allows both cards and pills to appear again.

• • Picking up Starter Deck while already holding Little Baggy will turn any held pills into cards.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Patch V1.7.5 stated that "Little Baggy no longer affects pocket items that are neither pills nor cards (such as runes)", even though that is not the case.

fields.description: Isaac can hold 2 pills at once and all cards and runes are replaced by pills.

Little Chubby.title: Little Chubby
Little Chubby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a Charger familiar that charges across the room when Isaac shoots, dealing damage to any enemies in its path until it hits an obstacle or wall.

• For Little Chubby to recharge, it must first get back to Isaac. Therefore, running away from Little Chubby after firing it will extend the time required to recharge it.

• The enemy Chubber can attack like this item, but they have limited range.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Little Chubby having [Before Repentance+] 5th / [Repentance+] 7th priority.

• The following types of flies are instantly killed when they come in contact with the familiar:

• Army Fly

• Attack Fly

• Dart Fly

• Fly

• Hush Fly

• Moter

• Pooter

• Ring Fly

• Super Pooter

• Swarm

Little Horn.title: Little Horn
Little Horn.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the boss; the item; Little Horn (Item)] 

Little Horn is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth that can appear in all environments of Chapter 1 (Basement, Cellar, Burning Basement).

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Little Horn constantly tries to evade Isaac by moving away from him while performing the following attacks:

• Creates and jumps into a Pitfall and pops up elsewhere.

• Creates 3 to 5 Teleport Pitfall that move outwards.

• Creates a regular Pitfall under himself that lasts for several seconds.

• Throws a Troll Bomb or a Mega Troll Bomb into a created Pitfall underneath himself. The bomb then pops up near Isaac's position.

• Jumps into a Pitfall and appears elsewhere while leaving a Troll Bomb in his place; repeats this process 3-5 times.

• Spawns a Dark Ball.
[Repentance] Little Horn takes reduced damage (25 instead of 100) from his own bombs. Bombs from other sources still do full damage.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 18] : Does not attack with Pits, Troll Bombs, or Mega Troll Bombs, but fires Dark Balls more frequently. This version can still do the chain teleport attack, but doesn't spawn any Troll Bombs.
[bc: 6] : Spits out an orange Troll Bomb instead of a Dark Ball. This Troll Bomb deals contact damage and leaves a patch of fire similar to Hot Bombs that cannot damage him. He also throws these special Troll Bombs into burning Pitfalls instead of normal ones, and spawns them during the chain teleport attack. He loses 1 HP whenever he spits out a bomb. Does not attack with Mega Troll Bombs.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Gnawed Leaf can make the battle easier, as Little Horn will damage himself with his bombs over time. Isaac can still fall into the pits and be transported around the screen, and will appear to suffer damage, but no actual loss of HP will occur if he is in statue form when he falls in.

• The Dark Balls that Little Horn spawns can appear in Closets in the Caves and the Flooded Caves. They also appear in a room with Little Horn in the Chest.

• If Isaac has the Safety Scissors, he can acquire maximum bombs from the fight at fairly little risk since the bombs Little Horn spawns will turn into bomb pickups and all his hole attacks are easy to dodge.

• Little Horn's Dark Ball is considered a monster. Killing it will activate items such as Charm of the Vampire, Infestation 2, and Jar of Flies.

• Occasionally, a Pitfall that Little Horn summons will not vanish after defeating the boss. The Pitfall is still active and can damage Isaac, even if it does not actively chase the player.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Fast Bombs]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Little Horn is referred to as male by Edmund.

• Little Horn is the name of a boss from Super Meat Boy, one of Edmund McMillen's previous games.

• Little Horn was created due to Edmund's love for Loki's design. (Despite him saying Little Horn is a Caves Boss, he is currently a Chapter 1 boss.)

• The name "Little Horn" comes from the Book of Daniel, where it refers to the Antichrist.

• Upon defeat, Little Horn's eyes glow red, then he retreats inside his hole. He does not explode into blood, unlike many other bosses. 

• Little Horn appears to be a baby version of Big Horn.

• [Repentance] Big Horn holds up Little Horn as part of one of his attacks.
