Lusty Blood.title: Lusty Blood
Lusty Blood.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Bloody Lust]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Each time an enemy is killed, Isaac gains a damage boost for the current room.

• Each kill increases damage by 0.5, up to a maximum of 5 damage after 10 kills.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Some summoned enemies like Rag Man's Raglings do not trigger the effect when killed.

• Mr. Maw does not trigger the effects of Lusty Blood, even after splitting.

• Blowing up a Shopkeeper will grant Isaac a damage bonus as well.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Meat Cleaver: Both of the smaller enemies produced by Meat Cleaver add to the damage bonus, allowing rooms with few enemies to grant much more damage.

• Samson's Lock: Both the item and the trinket stack, granting 1 damage per kill. With 100% proc rate on the Lock, Isaac may gain up to 10 damage after 10 kills.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t count towards the Lusty Blood counter.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't count towards the Lusty Blood counter.

• [Repentance] Freeze Effects: Enemies that are frozen don't count towards the Lusty Blood counter.

• Because of this interaction, when Isaac has Uranus, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will increment Lusty Blood's counter, thus rendering Lusty Blood quite difficult to use.

• [Repentance+] Frozen enemies do increase damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Lusty Blood has the same effect as Bloody Lust from the original The Binding of Isaac.

fields.description: Isaac's damage increases for the current room each time he kills an enemy.

Maggot.title: Maggot
Maggot.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A Maggot is a type of monster introduced in the vanilla content of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth. They can be commonly found in Chapter 2. [Afterbirth onward] They can also be found wandering about within libraries.

As their name suggests, they're blind, white insect maggots that lack any appendages. They crawl around the room slowly and aimlessly, but will deal damage upon full contact.

sections.heading: Small Maggot
sections.text:
Small Maggots are a type of Maggots added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance DLC. They can be exclusively found in Corpse.

They are quite similar to regular Maggots but are variants that are very small in size. Shortly after spawning, they very slowly crawl towards Isaac. They are primarily spawned by Pustules, Level 2 Horfs , and Corpse's bosses.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Maggots first appear in the original Flash version of The Binding of Isaac.

• [Repentance] Small Maggots originate from the Antibirth mod.

Maggy's Bow.title: Maggy's Bow
Maggy's Bow.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds one Red Heart Container.

• [Repentance] Heals 1 additional Red Heart

• Red Hearts heal double their value. A Half Red Heart replenishes one Red Heart, a Red Heart or Scared Heart replenishes two Red Hearts, and a Double Heart replenishes four Red Hearts. Blended Hearts either replenish two Red Hearts or replenish one Red Heart and add one Soul Heart, depending on how many empty Red Heart Containers Isaac has.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Has no effect on Rotten Hearts. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Candy Heart: Doubles the stat boosts from any picked up Heart. Half Red Hearts give two boosts, full Red Hearts give four, and Double Red Hearts give eight.

• IV Bag + Old Bandage + Humbleing Bundle / Maggy's Bow: The damage from IV Bag has a chance to spawn 2 hearts, which can be picked up to create further coins and possibly even heal hearts with enough Luck.

• [Repentance] Humbleing Bundle only has a 50% chance to double the hearts dropped, but Old Bandage may still drop 1 heart.

• Tainted Bethany: Doubles all blood charges gained from Red Hearts.

• The Jar: Allows for generation of infinite Red Hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 0 - The Fool?: Due to doubled healing, extra hearts will be left on the ground to be used for later.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: No effect.

• Yum Heart: No effect; will still only replenish one full Red Heart.

fields.description: Gives one Red Heart Container and doubles the healing provided by Red Hearts. [Repentance] Also heals 1 Red Heart when obtained.

Maggy's Faith.title: Maggy's Faith
Maggy's Faith.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Gives an Eternal Heart at the start of every floor.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The eternal heart is added directly to Isaac's heart containers, as opposed to appearing as a pickup.

• The effect will also be triggered when the floor is reset (for example, with Forget Me Now).

• Eden will not be given the eternal heart on the first floor if they start with this trinket.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] When held as The Forgotten, the eternal heart will be given to whichever character is being controlled when entering the next floor. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] When going though the Ascent, eternal hearts will be given for each floor traveled up.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket/Maggy's Faith/Mom's Box: Each effect/trinket copy stacks granting one additional eternal heart at the start of every floor with every pair of eternal hearts granted immediately giving Isaac a heart container.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Maggy's Faith is most likely a reference to Mary Magdalene's faith in Jesus. Mary was said to be one Jesus trusted most and she stayed with Him past the abandonment of His disciples, as well as being the first person He showed Himself to after His resurrection.

• It may also be a reference to Mom, with her name being revealed to be Maggy during the Ascent sequence.

• "Faith's reward" may constitute a contraction of the adage "Faith is its own reward", although use of the word 'faith' in the game is conflicted, as it also used in the quote for the Rosary Bead, in reference to Angel Rooms.

• [Repentance] This trinket is used in Baptism by Fire (challenge #38).

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When held as Keeper, blue flies will not be spawned instead of the eternal heart, making the trinket useless.

Magic Fingers.title: Magic Fingers
Magic Fingers.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, consumes one Penny to deal damage to all enemies in the room.

• [Before Repentance] Damage dealt is equal to twice Isaac's damage.

• [Repentance] Damage dealt is twice Isaac's damage +10.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop.

• This item becomes more valuable once Shops stop appearing.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Also has a chance to invoke the effect of Golden Razor.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps in the inner ring, looking like coins. The wisps have a chance to drop coins when destroyed.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's Heart + Schoolbag + IV Bag: Allows for effectively infinite uses by switching to IV Bag when low on money, with Isaac's Heart preventing it from lowering the player's health. [end edition note] 

• Mysterious Candy: Allows for effectively infinite uses with extreme patience - efficiency can be greatly increased with Petrified Poop.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Ipecac: Damage boost is mostly ignored.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The name is a reference to 'Magic Fingers' vibrating beds that could be found in hotels and motels during the mid-to-late 20th century. A person would insert coins into a slot on the device, which would cause pleasant vibrations in their beds for a certain amount of time. The device came to have connotations with sleaziness, as they were associated with seedy overnight locations where one-night stands and such were known to occur.

Magic Mushroom.title: Magic Mushroom
Magic Mushroom.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Grants Isaac one Red Heart Container.

• +0.3 Damage.

• x1.5 damage multiplier.

• [Before Repentance] +5.25 Range.

• [Repentance] +2.5 Range.

• +0.3 Speed.

• [Before Repentance] +0.5 Tear Falling Speed.

• Restores all Health.

• Isaac grows in size.

• Contributes to the Fun Guy transformation.

• Contributes to the Stompy transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can rarely drop from destroying mushrooms.

• The x1.5 damage multiplier does not stack with the x1.5 damage multiplier from Cricket's Head, from the combination of The Book of Belial and Blood of the Martyr, or itself (by using an item such as Diplopia, for example). However, it will stack with any other multipliers, such as Sacred Heart.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Haemolacria: Both 1.5x damage multipliers stack as expected.

• Tainted Bethany: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Huge Growth]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Magic Mushroom does not give a Tears, Luck, or Shot Speed increase despite its quote saying 'All Stats Up!'.

• This item and its effects are a reference to the Super Mushroom from the Super Mario Brothers video game franchise.

• This item's sprite resembles to the mushroom species Amanita muscaria, fly agaric.

• 'Magic mushrooms' is a colloquial term for hallucinogenic mushrooms containing psilocybin. Fly agaric is hallucinogenic, although it does not contain psilocybin and is not considered a "magic mushroom".

• [Afterbirth+ onward] This item is one of the only two ( [Repentance] five/ [Repentance+] six) in the game that work towards 2 transformations (Stompy and Fun Guy), the other ones being The Bible, Hive Mind, Parasitoid, Skatole, [Repentance+] and The Necronomicon.

• This item shares a retro pickup sound effect with 1up!.

• Magic Mushroom, along with 1up!, Mini Mush, Super Bandage, and Mega Mush is one of the few items that make a unique sound upon pickup.

Magic Skin.title: Magic Skin
Magic Skin.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, spawns an item pedestal from the current room's item pool.

• Consumes one of Isaac's heart containers, one Bone Heart, or two Soul Hearts, replaced by a broken heart container.

• The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.

• After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.

• The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.

• The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.

• If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.

• Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.

• If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Scourge. [end edition note] 

• For most characters, the limit of broken hearts before Magic Skin disappears is 12.

• If using Magdalene with Birthright, Magic Skin will not disappear until you have 18 or more broken heart containers.

• The Lost and Tainted Lost will be able to use the item once, after which it disappears. The item's chance of replacing later items does not trigger, making it similar to Mystery Gift.

• • An extra item cannot be spawned when used with Car Battery.

• • Temporary The Lost forms from the White Fire Place in Downpour II/Dross II, or by using the Soul of the Lost, have no effect. A heart container is still replaced by a broken heart container, and Magic Skin does not disappear and will still replace future pedestal items if dropped. If Isaac runs out of health in this way as The Lost, he dies immediately.

• Keeper and Tainted Keeper gain a broken coin container which are functionally identical to broken hearts. Keeper can use it up to 3 times, and Tainted Keeper can use it up to 2 times before Magic Skin disappears.

• • If they have Deep Pockets and Greed's Gullet, or Mother's Kiss, they can use it more than 2~3 times.

• • Although they can have 13 or more coin hearts under some conditions, they can only have a maximum of 12 broken coin heart containers. They will die only once all coin hearts are gone, causing Magic Skin to disappear.

• If either The Forgotten or The Soul has 6 broken hearts by using Magic Skin, this item will disappear and they will instantly die. However, swapping characters right after one of them reaches 6 broken hearts can prevent them from dying, but permanently disable the one using it.

• Reaching the broken heart limit by using ? Card or Wild Card won't cause Magic Skin to disappear.

• Tainted Lazarus is able to find Magic Skin while Dead Tainted Lazarus is carrying it, and vice versa.

• Heartbreak or VI - The Lovers? will add broken hearts, lessening maximum use of Magic Skin.

• Broken heart containers can be removed by donating to a Confessional.

• In Treasure Rooms with a blind item, if the known item is Magic Skin, it is almost guaranteed the blind item is not.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Grants a permanent +0.5 damage up on use in addition to the temporary +4 damage up given to it by Birthright. This bonus is not lost if the broken hearts are removed.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns pink wisps in the inner ring, looking like skin. Wisps have a large amount of health and fire piercing tears.

• Car Battery: Spawns 2 items and adds 2 broken hearts (removing 2 heart containers or 4 soul hearts) with each use. Two broken hearts are added regardless of Isaac's remaining health. If Isaac already has 11 broken hearts and uses Magic Skin, it will only be used once.

• Damocles: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.

• Esau Jr.: Since Esau Jr.'s health is separate from Isaac's, one character can use Magic Skin at no cost to the other. Future items will still be replaced when playing as the character that hasn't used Magic Skin.

• Schoolbag: Isaac can keep Magic Skin in the inactive slot to prevent its respawning while still being able to use another active item.

• Spindown Dice: Using Spindown Dice on Magic Skin 6 times turns it into R Key.

• Spindown Dice + Schoolbag: Allows Isaac to keep Spindown Dice between runs, allowing a theoretically infinite run with enough luck.

• • Restock: If Isaac can find a Battery in the shop, as long as one has enough coins, runs can actually be infinite.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Alabaster Box: Magic Skin can use Soul hearts from the box, and will prioritize them over those in health.

• Binge Eater: Will still offer a food item even if Magic Skin replaced an item.

• Dream Catcher: If Magic Skin has replaced the item in the Treasure Room, it will be shown in the dream sequence.

• Holding Magic Skin or having a pedestal with it on the same floor can cause the item in the Treasure Room to not be replaced by Magic Skin.

• Genesis: Removes all broken hearts as well as items. Magic Skin can still replace items in the Genesis room.

• Glowing Hourglass: Recovers a broken heart when used after using Magic Skin. Using Magic Skin in the same type of room will spawn the same item, it must be used in a different room type first to spawn a different item in the previous room type.

• Lemegeton: Magic Skin can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run. As long as Isaac has this flame, Magic Skin will not respawn/replace items.

• Metronome: Getting Magic Skin from Metronome has a chance to instantly apply the item replacement and spawn Magic Skin as an item pedestal.

• Mystery Gift: Does not replace A Lump of Coal or The Poop.

• NO!: Does not prevent Magic Skin from replacing items, despite it being an active item.

• Tainted Eden: Broken hearts persist even after Magic Skin is rerolled.

• TMTRAINER: Prevents Magic Skin from replacing items, since future Magic Skins will be glitched.

• R Key: Magic Skin still replaces items after using R Key.

• Void: Absorbing Magic Skin does not prevent future items from being replaced, including items spawned by the absorbed Magic Skin. Additional Magic Skins can be absorbed, allowing multiple items to be spawned per use at the cost of adding more broken hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Magic Skin originates from the Antibirth mod.

• The item is a reference to the 1831 book by French novelist Honoré de Balzac called La Peau de chagrin, known in English as The Wild Ass's Skin. In the story, the main character finds a talisman made of donkey skin that grants wishes, but each wish causes the talisman to become smaller, as well as his lifetime. He attempts to get rid of the skin, but it always finds a way to return to him.

• The item's pickup quote, "All your desires fulfilled", is the first sentence written on the skin in the novel.

• This also may be a reference to the goatskin Jacob uses to trick his father Isaac into thinking he was Esau, thus giving him his blessing along with the divine right God had promised Abraham (Isaac's father), which included inheriting the promised land and having his bloodline bring forth the Messiah.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Reviving as ??? via the Ankh (or 1up! while already ???), or Black Judas via Judas' Shadow will force Isaac into their default starting health of 3 soul/2 black hearts respectively, regardless of the amount of broken hearts. If there are more than 12 total, any excess normal hearts are lost from picking up any item or activating an effect that updates Isaac's health. The extra hearts can be lost to damage as normal, however.
Bug note: Magic Skin's item-replacing effect can also apply to Modeling Clay. If modeling clay replicates Magic Skin, it will have no effect.

fields.description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.

Magneto.title: Magneto
Magneto.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the Magneto item; a similar item; Strange Attractor; a related trinket; Broken Magnet]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Pickups (e.g. hearts, coins, keys, bombs, etc.) are attracted to Isaac.

• The attraction enables the item to pass/fly over pits or rocks, but not through Key Blocks.

• Red Heart are only attracted if Isaac could pick them up with his existing Red Heart containers.

• Lil' Battery act similarly to hearts in that they will only be attracted to Isaac if his active item isn't fully charged.

• Chests roughly 2 or fewer tiles away from Isaac open automatically. Spiked Chests are opened without damaging Isaac. Locked Chests and Bomb Chests are not opened and still require a key/bomb, though Locked chests will be opened from a distance if Isaac possesses the Paper Clip.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Magneto can attract Scared Hearts, but they still run away from Isaac.

• Grab Bags are not attracted by Magneto.

• [Repentance] They are also not opened by Magneto.

• [Repentance] If Magneto opens the chests in Challenge Rooms, the waves won't start spawning unless you touch the empty chests, nor will the way out be closed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Hypercoagulation: Magneto cuts the momentum of the hearts, allowing for easy pickup and, in turn, making Isaac very tough to kill.

• Options?: If a chest is presented as a choice and opened by Magneto, the other reward won't disappear unless the empty chest is then touched. Chests with items disappear or make the other reward disappear, though.

• [Repentance] Options? + Broken Modem: If Broken Modem duplicates a chest that was spawned by Options?, using Magneto to immediately open the chest while in its glitched form will create a TMTRAINER item if the chest contained an item. [end edition note] 

• Tainted Magdalene/Tainted Keeper: Attracts hearts and coins dropped by enemies, allowing for easier survival and/or coin-gathering, respectively.

• Tainted ???: Poop pickups are not attracted.

• Paper Clip: Allows locked chests to be opened from a short distance.

• Broken Magnet: Does not increase the pull speed of coins.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item's name may be a reference to the X-Men villain, Magneto.

• This item's coloration and placement on Isaac's head may be a nod to Magnet Man, a villain from Mega Man 3.

• Despite what the description says, Magneto will not attract passive or active items.

• Broken Magnet appears to be half of this item, and indeed retains part of its function.

fields.description: Pulls pickups towards Isaac.

Mama Gurdy.title: Mama Gurdy
Mama Gurdy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Mama Gurdy is a boss that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] In all environments of Chapter 4 (Womb, Utero, Scarred Womb).

• [Repentance] Only in the Womb and the Scarred Womb.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Mama Gurdy resides inside the wall at the top of the room. She has four attacks:

• Creates temporary spikes in the boss room in random locations.

• These spikes can spawn under Isaac but have a small delay before they can deal damage.

• Spews a volley of large orange projectiles towards the bottom of the room, leaving slowing Orange Creep.

• Shoots 3, 4, or 7 waves of 5 spread projectiles at Isaac's location.

• Shoots a burst of disorganized projectiles at Isaac.

• Occasionally retreats upwards off-screen before executing her spike attack. Performs her orange projectile attack immediately upon re-entering the screen.
Mama Gurdy deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mama Gurdy appears to be the final stage of the "Gurdy" boss line, with the first stage as Gurglings, second as Gurdy Jr., and third as Gurdy.

• Mama Gurdy is the only boss with boss art that doesn't directly display them, showing only a hand.

• She is also one of the only bosses not appearing as a degraded boss.

• Mother, the final boss of Corpse, appears to be a postmortem version of Mama Gurdy.

Mama Mega!.title: Mama Mega!
Mama Mega!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, destroys all obstacles in the current room and deals 200 damage to every enemy (including bosses). This effect also applies to every room for the remainder of the floor.

• [Repentance] Also destroys all Machines, Beggars, Shopkeepers, and Fire Places.

• [Repentance] Also destroys all obstacles in rooms that have already been cleared.

• [Repentance] Will destroy Donation Machines as well, reducing donated coin count and removing them for the rest of the run.

• Opens all Secret Room and Super Secret Room doors on the current floor.

• Mama Mega! opens the paths to Boss Rush and the ??? even after the time limits expire.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• While Mama Mega! opens the paths to Boss Rush and the ??? after the time limits expire, there are still some things to be aware of:

• The Boss does not need to be defeated before entering these doors.

• It will also open the Boss Rush / ??? entrance room door if it is activated after Mom or Mom's Heart / It Lives! has already been defeated.

• Leaving the Boss Room (via teleport or entering a Devil Room/Angel Room) will close the doors.

• Leaving the Boss Rush room or ??? entrance room will also close the doors.

• Does not open the Boss Rush door from the inside.

• [Repentance] Does not open a path to ??? if used in the room on the other side of the flesh door in Mausoleum / Gehenna II. [end edition note] 

• Entering a room with an angel statue while the effect is active automatically initiates a fight with an Angel.

• Does not kill enemies that are immune to damage while entering the room, such as Lil' Haunts.

• If used before the Ultra Greed fight begins, it will deal no damage to Ultra Greed, as he is invulnerable for the first few seconds upon first entering his room. However, it will still break obstacles as usual.

• When used in Greed mode, it will only activate once for the main room (as opposed to once per wave, in a similar fashion to a standard run). Therefore, its damage potential is maximized if used after all the monster waves have spawned for the current floor.

• Does not open the door to Mega Satan in Dark Room or Chest, nor does it open [Repentance] the flesh door at the end of Mausoleum / Gehenna II [end edition note] .

• [Repentance] If used in Downpour / Dross II, the entrance to the Mirrored World will be destroyed, making it inaccessible.

• If used in the Mirrored World, it will destroy the exit, which, on top of making it impossible to leave, will then cause Isaac to take damage and die. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Only works on a single floor of the Ascent. [end edition note] 

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight Giga Bombs, or six Bombs and two Golden Bombs.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Summons 8 wisps in the middle ring on use. The wisps summon Golden Troll Bombs when destroyed.

• Mama Mega! + Safety Scissors: Allows for infinite uses of Mama Mega! after finding a Golden Bomb or ? Card, as the extinguished Golden Troll Bombs will turn into Golden Bombs.

• • Bag of Crafting: The infinite golden bombs created can be used to easily craft high quality items.

• Broken Padlock: Mama Mega!'s blast will also open locks.

• Golden Bomb: While holding a golden bomb, Mama Mega! can be used once on that floor without consuming it, using it a second time consumes it as normal. It may be used again for free on another floor if yet another golden bomb is collected, and so on. [Repentance] Using Mama Mega once will remove the golden bomb from Isaac's consumables. Mama Mega! also receives a unique golden sprite in the HUD.

• Schoolbag + Everything Jar: Reliable source of Golden Bombs for the above use.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Void: Can't be consumed by Void.

• [Repentance] If consumed by Void, the Mama Mega! effect will be activated once only, the next time Void is activated.

• ? Card: Mama Mega! will be activated and consumed.

• [Repentance] Mama Mega!'s effect can be activated through the card without consuming the actual item.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Repentance] The visual effect has been changed from a simple screen flash and shake to a massive shockwave on entering each room.

• [Repentance] Mama Mega!'s effect is one of the only [Before Repentance+] two / [Repentance+] three ways a Bomb Bum can be destroyed.

• Mama Mega! may be a reference to the GBU-43, known colliqually as the mother of all bombs due to its massive payload.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Mama Mega! can break the door to the Knife Piece 2 room. If Isaac leaves this room before the intro animation of Mother's Shadow finishes and then enters it again, another Mother's Shadow will be generated.
Bug note: Mama Mega! cannot be used to open the doors to Boss Rush / ???.

fields.description: Deals immense damage to all enemies, opens all bombable doors, and destroys all obstacles in the room. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor.

Parasitoid.title: Parasitoid
Parasitoid.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a chance to fire an egg sack which spawns slowing creep. If an egg sack hits an enemy, 1-2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders are spawned.

• Egg sack tears have [Before Repentance] x2 range/ [Repentance] x2 tear height (which also increases effective range).

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to shoot egg sacs depends on the luck stat and is based on this formula: min(\frac1 { 7 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}, 50\%)

• At base luck (0), the chance is 14.29%, maxing out at 50% at 5 luck.

• Egg sacks will also spawn blue flies or spiders if they hit Fire Places or invincible enemies like Death's Head and Stoney.

• It is possible to create a large number of Spiders and Flies by repeatedly shooting a closed Host.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• C Section: Parasitoid fetuses spawn spiders/flies and slowing creep with every hit on an enemy.

• Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: When egg sacks are fired, they will split into smaller egg sacks. Split egg sacks from The Parasite will not look like egg sacks.

• Cupid's Arrow: Egg sacks will apply their effect to every enemy hit.

• Fire Mind / Explosivo : If the explosion effect triggers on an egg sack, it will produce a much larger pool of slowing creep.

• Hive Mind: Flies and spiders are bigger and deal double damage.

• Technology 2: Rapid damage ticks can cause a large amount of flies and spiders to spawn.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
Overrides Parasitoid:

• Azazel

• Brimstone

• Dr. Fetus

• Epic Fetus

• Mom's Knife

• Technology

• Tech X

• Trisagion
Other interactions:

• Dr. Fetus: Bomb explosions have a chance of leaving the slowing creep in a larger pool than egg sack tears, however the egg sack bombs can't spawn Blue Flies / Blue Spiders.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs can now spawn Blue Flies / Blue Spiders.

• Fish Tail: The duplicated flies will spawn on top of the enemy and deal damage immediately.

• Haemolacria: Tears retain Haemolacria appearance and only the main tear can spawn flies or spiders when damaging enemies / [Repentance+] smaller tears can now leave slowing creep and spawn flies and spiders.

• Ipecac: Only extra range applies on egg sack tears and they will not spawn flies or spiders.

• Montezuma's Revenge/Revelation: No effect.

• Spirit Sword: The sword projectiles can still spawn flies and spiders, but the swings themselves won't / [Repentance+] the swings can now leave slowing creep and spawn flies and spiders.

• Tech.5/Technology 2: Lasers are unaffected.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Parasitoid is a term for when insects' larvae live inside their hosts as a parasite before eventually killing the host.

• [Repentance] Parasitoid is one of the only five ( [Repentance+] six) items that count towards 2 transformations (Beelzebub and Spider Baby), the other ones being Magic Mushroom, The Bible, Hive Mind, Skatole, [Repentance+] and The Necronomicon.

fields.description: Adds a chance to fire an egg sack which creates slowing creep and spawns 1-2 Blue Flies or Blue Spiders upon hitting an enemy.

Paschal Candle.title: Paschal Candle
Paschal Candle.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Gives Isaac a candle familiar that grants a Fire Rate bonus of +0.4 for each room cleared in a row without taking damage, which stacks up to 5 times (Max. +2 Fire Rate), represented by how brightly the flame burns. Starts at 1 stack, and resets to zero if damage is taken.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Fire Rate bonus can exceed the normal Fire Rate cap.

• Any self-damage, such as from Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, the Bad Trip pill, spiked chests, and self-damaging items such as IV Bag, won't reset the bonus.

• Clearing waves in Greed Mode will give the candle charges as if you cleared rooms.

• Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Paschal Candle having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Holy Mantle / any similar item: The flame is not snuffed out when damage is negated by the shield.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The candle appears larger, but otherwise does not change.

• Paschal Candle: No extra familiars or stat boosts are granted from copies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Repentance] When lit, the candle will glow slightly in [curse: Darkness] making its position always visible. The more stacks it has, the brighter the glow.

• Paschal Candle originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, the tears ups would stack 6 times.

• A Paschal candle is a large, white candle used in liturgies in Western Christianity.

fields.description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.

Pause.title: Pause
Pause.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Stops all enemies including bosses until a fire button is pressed.

• This does not affect troll bombs.

• Touching frozen enemies will still damage Isaac.

• Co-op babies can fire without ending the effect.

• Stops Red Fire Places/Purple Fire Places from shooting projectiles.

• Bosses will resume their actions after 30 seconds have passed, while non-boss enemies (except Lil' Haunt) are still paused.

• • [Repentance] All enemies resume actions after 30 seconds

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• New enemies generated during Pause being active will not be frozen and act normally. This applies for spawn-upon-death effects such as Attack Fly created by a Moter, or a Boss that stopped becoming frozen and began summoning enemies.

• Damage against paused multi-segmented bosses works unpredictably, most notably allowing you to damage Scolex on normally invulnerable parts.

• The health bars of multi-segmented bosses may not be updated properly, making it seem as if they died without running out of health.

• Reducing a boss to zero health whilst they are paused will initiate their death animation but they will not die until a fire button is pressed or the 30 second timer has lapsed.

• The Forgotten's Soul will be able to extend far past the normal limits of the chain when activated while The Soul is out.

• [Repentance] Pausing in the room before entering the minecart in the Mines causes the minecart to freeze, trapping the player inside of it until they exit to the main menu. [end edition note] 

• Using Dark Arts will not stop the effect.

• Pausing in Boss Rush just as bosses spawn will cause the bosses to not deal contact damage to Isaac for the full duration. This allows for contact damage items, such as Mom's Heels, to be extremely viable in completing Boss Rush.

• If you freeze Haunted Chest at a time when Polty has not yet picked it up, the chest will be impossible to open in any way until Polty unfreezes or dies. If you try to push Haunted Chest away from Polty, the ghost will appear immediately at the current chest after unfreezing.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 120 Volt / Monstrance / Mom's Knife: Continues to damage enemies even while paused, allowing for insane amounts of damage.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns green wisps on the middle ring. Wisps pause all enemies and enemy shots for 3 seconds when destroyed. This effect is not cancelled by shooting tears.

• Items that can be used without firing, such a Mom's knife and orbitals can do massive amounts of damage.

• Any item that does damage without firing + 4.5 Volt: Pause can be recharged while the effect is active, allowing for potentially infinite uptime.

• Daddy Longlegs: Hitting pause stops all enemies from moving but Daddy Longlegs will continue his normal attack pattern, potentially clearing many rooms without any risk of damage unless spawn-on-death enemies are killed and Isaac has trouble avoiding them, forcing him to fire. This strategy is also time demanding so if going for Boss Rush etc. this synergy is detrimental.

• Tainted Jacob: Dark Esau will also be affected by Pause. With proper timing, this allows him to melt through endgame bosses with large amounts of armor-piercing damage by having Dark Esau sit on top of them.

• The Ludovico Technique: The giant tear keeps dealing damage in stopped time, making it easy for boss kills.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• Marked: While the crosshair is out, immediately ends Pause's effect upon use. The player can cancel the use of Marked by pressing the "drop" key or button to then use Pause.

• Using the item in Greed Mode will freeze all enemies but will not pause the timer. New waves of enemies will continue to spawn even while the effect is active.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is a reference to how a television channel can be paused with a TV remote.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If you activate and resume "Pause" while an enemy emits projectiles, the bullets won't proceed with regular but instead extremely decreased speed. However, they will still pass intended range, which bypasses the effect of shot speed being reduced as it normally would with any items that slow projectiles down.
Bug note: When used with Dad's Ring/Monstrance/Saturnus it creates a second ring/aura/circle of light that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for the active item's duration. The second ring/aura/circle is a visual glitch and does not interact with enemies. Moreover, both rings/auras/circles are flashing for the duration. When used while Telekinesis is active Pause creates a second ring that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for Telekinesis's remaining duration. Moreover both rings are flashing and the second ring can not block enemy tears for the duration. Any tears that were still caught in Telekinesis’s radius before using Pause become incredibly slowed and indefinitely follow Isaac until he shoots. The items Salvation, Spear Of Destiny, and Trinity Shield all have a similar bug however these items are completely unable to interact with enemies (or block enemy tears for the shield) while Pause is activated.
Bug note: When used with Star of Bethlehem the light aura will be stuck in the last position before Pause was used even if the familiar continues without it. This is only a visual glitch, Isaac still has to be near the star to receive its benefits. If Pause’s effect ends the light instantly disappears and respawns back around the star again. The light will still fade when the star leaves the room.
Bug note: When used with Dark Arts, the player can unintentionally Soft-lock themselves if the Pause item is used during the effects of Dark Arts, this can be fixed by quitting then entering the game again. This is because Dark Arts does not finish its animation due to the pause item locking it in place. In addition to this, the player cannot escape this soft-lock via the fire button due to the player not being able to fire during the effects of Dark Arts. Moreover if this bug happens while Tainted Judas has Birthright, the dark aura around Tainted Judas will experience a visual bug from Pause that is similar to Monstrance.

fields.description: Freezes all enemies until a fire button is pressed.

Pay To Play.title: Pay To Play
Pay To Play.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the item; the challenge; PAY TO PLAY]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +5 coins.

• [Before Repentance] Shops, Treasure Rooms, and Libraries must be opened with a Penny instead of a Key. These doors appear identical to Arcade doors.

• [Repentance] All locked doors, Locked Chests, and Key Blocks must be opened with a Penny instead of Keys, including those that require 2 keys to open.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Locked doors, chests, and key blocks gain a unique visual where their key slot is replaced with a vertical coin slot.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Mom's Locket: Renders Mom's Locket less effective as the trinket requires a key is consumed by the lock in order to heal Isaac.

• Sharp Key: Thrown keys cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests.

• Store Key: Overridden by Pay To Play. Stores still require coins to unlock.

• Golden Key: Overridden by Pay To Play. Still require coins to unlock.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: In Greed mode, it locks the Shop door and requires a coin to unlock it.
Bug note: Pay to play can softlock a room in the Mother's Shadow sequence by making the Key Block require a Penny after coming back from a Crawl Space.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] +5 Penny. Most doors require one Penny to open instead of a Key.
[Repentance] +5 Penny. All locked doors, Locked Chests, and Key Blocks must be opened with one Penny instead of Keys.

Pay to Win.title: Pay to Win
Pay to Win.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • A Shop Restock Machine always spawns in Treasure Rooms.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The trinket's effect applies when the floor is generated, so it will only take effect if already held when entering a new floor. This means that finding it on a floor will not change the Treasure Room on that floor, nor will dropping it remove its effect on that floor's Treasure Room if Pay to Win was held when the floor was entered.

• [Repentance] This also means that the trinket will have no effect in the Ascent, since it is based on previously generated floors.

• This trinket does not affect the two Treasure Rooms spawned in ???.

• In Greed Mode, this affects both normal and silver types of Treasure Rooms.

• [Repentance] When brought to the alternate path floors, there is a chance of the treasure room having one extra item available to be picked up alongside the usual choice of two items.

• [Repentance] Restock boxes will not appear in the Mirrored World's Treasure Room.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: The chance for Restock Machine blowing up after 4 rerolls is 1 / (1 + number of copies).

• Bag of Crafting: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not Tainted Cain as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the Treasure Room which can be rerolled.

• More Options: Treasure Rooms will always contain two choice items in addition to the Shop Restock Machine.

• [Repentance] In Downpour, Dross, and Mines, Pay to Win by itself can sometimes spawn the combined Treasure Rooms, even without More Options. Having both doesn't guarantee the combined effect.

• • For Ashpit, Mausoleum, Gehenna, and Corpse, this combination does work correctly for normal-sized Treasure Rooms, but not thin ones. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The item is a reference to microtransactions, which are common in modern video games. They serve the "pay-to-win" goal by making it either impossible or extremely tedious for players to either progress through the game (with so-called "roadblocks") or earn certain features such as weapons unless they purchase their "way out."

fields.name: Pay to Win
fields.description: Shop Restock Machines always spawn in Treasure Rooms.

Peep.title: Peep
Peep.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Peep is a boss that can appear in all environments of Chapter 2 (Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves).

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
• Creates puddles of Yellow Creep around him.

• Fires eight yellow projectiles in all directions with varying orientation.

• Jumps into the air and travels a moderate distance in Isaac's direction, sending out a ring of twelve yellow projectiles upon landing.

• Peep Eye dislocate and start floating around the room at specific points in his health. One pops off at 2/3rds, and the other pops off at 1/3rd.

• Peep's eyeballs float diagonally bouncing off of walls and do not take damage. They block Isaac's tears and inflict contact damage.
Peep deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 8] : Starts the battle with both his eyes popped out, similar to The Bloat.
[bc: 12] : 15% smaller, moves faster, and leaves a constant trail of Yellow Creep.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Peep's eyeballs can be destroyed with Chaos Card, Euthanasia, God's Flesh, or Little Horn.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Peep appeared in the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Peep's name could come from the word "pee", which could allude to Peep urinating yellow creep while battling.

• Peep's name could also be a shortened version of "peeper", which is slang for an eye.

• His posthumous version is The Bloat.

• He has 3 unused sprites in his spritesheet that were removed in The Bloat spritesheet.

• [Repentance] Yellow Peep's pupils diverge slightly, resembling Acid Baby.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Peep's Eyes have the same collision radius as Peep itself, which results in the eyes being difficult to dodge since the hitbox doesn't match up with the eyes' visual size.

Pentagram.title: Pentagram
Pentagram.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +1 damage.

• Increases chance for a Devil Room / Angel Room door to open by 10%.

• This chance is increased to 15% with two or more Pentagrams.

• Contributes to the Leviathan transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • If all of Sacrificial Altar's drops have been seen, it will only spawn Pentagrams.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in Darkness Falls.

fields.description: +1 damage, increases Devil Room / Angel Room chance by 10%.

Perfection.title: Perfection
Perfection.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives +10 luck.

• This trinket is destroyed if Isaac takes non-self damage while holding it (i.e. getting hit by Monsters, walking on Spikes, getting hit by an explosion, etc.).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket can only be obtained by clearing 3 consecutive floors without taking damage. It will drop upon the final boss room of said consecutive floors being cleared.

• In Greed Mode, it will drop after defeating the first boss of the third floor (Depths / Necropolis / Dank Depths).

• While playing co-op, everyone needs to play without taking damage for the trinket to spawn.

• Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, Hell Games, Confessionals, Curse Rooms, Sacrifice Rooms, Spiked Chests, Bad Trip pills, White Fire Places and the door to Mausoleum / Gehenna count as self-damage and won't destroy Perfection.

• Every XL floor cleared counts as a single floor for the purposes of obtaining this trinket.

• Perfection can intentionally be dropped if Isaac must take damage for whatever reason, allowing him to keep it.

• Due to the unique method of obtaining it, Perfection can never naturally spawn as a Golden Trinket.

• 10 Luck is coincidentally the highest amount of luck Isaac can have that would help with room clear rewards paying out.

• If Isaac holds multiple copies of Perfection via Mom's Purse or Belly Button, upon taking a hit only one of them will get destroyed.

• [Before Repentance+] Damage taken by Found Soul, Lost Soul, Strawman and Soul of the Forgotten will reset cleared floors count, thus Perfection will not drop. However, Perfection itself will not be destroyed if they take damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blanket / Dogma / Holy Card / Holy Mantle / The Lost / Soul of the Lost / White Fire Places / Wooden Cross: Losing the shield does not destroy Perfection.

• Blood Oath / Dull Razor / Sharp Plug / IV Bag: Does not destroy Perfection, nor does it prevent its acquisition.

• Glowing Hourglass: Makes it much easier to hold on to Perfection since, as long as it can be used in the room where you take damage before you leave, Isaac can reset to the previous room with the trinket intact.

• The Lost / Tainted Lost: Since these characters are likely to die instantly after taking a single hit, Perfection is almost guaranteed to drop after the third floor boss room is cleared and is also almost guaranteed to stay with them until their deaths.

• This means getting luck based items at any point of the run, especially ones with luck scaling that tops out at about 10 luck, is a very good idea.

• The ability to Smelt/Gulp trinkets will also add to the synergy, as there are many luck-based trinkets as well.

• Rock Bottom: The +10 luck persists after switching trinkets as stats are locked to their highest values ever reached after picking Rock Bottom up. However, after losing Perfection, additional luck-ups will have no effect until the luck bonus lost is made up. (The stats are still being calculated behind the scenes, but until it surpasses the run's post-rock-bottom luck record, the record will be used instead).

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Gulp! / Marbles / Smelter: Despite being added to the inventory, it will still be destroyed at the next damage taken.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Perfection is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth the trinket would continue to be dropped by every subsequent floor boss if damage was still not taken and every source of damage would destroy it.

fields.quote: Luck way up. Don't lose it!
fields.description: +10 Luck. If Isaac takes damage, the trinket is destroyed and its effect is removed.

Perthro.title: Perthro
Perthro.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Rerolls all items in the room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • For further interaction and notes regarding item rerolls, see The D6.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • If obtained later in the run, it is recommended to keep it for the Chest / Dark Room, as their first rooms always contain 4 chests whose items can be all rerolled at once.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: Instantly re-rolls items twice, essentially removing an extra item from the item pool.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

fields.name: Perthro
fields.description: Rerolls all items in the room (the same effect as The D6).

Pestilence.title: Pestilence
Pestilence.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pestilence is a Harbinger that can appear in all environments of Chapter 2 (Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves).

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
• Floats around the room, leaving a large trail of damaging Green Creep.

• Fires an Ipecac projectile at Isaac, which leaves Green Creep on impact.

• Summons two Chargers or Spitty and can have a maximum of four summons.

• Any Chargers or Spitties caught in Pestilence's Ipecac explosion will be killed.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
After taking enough damage, Pestilence's head will explode, beginning the second phase.

• No longer moves around the room but slowly drifts around, leaving Green Creep.

• Continues to fire Ipecac projectiles at Isaac, but at a faster rate.

• Summons two Attack Fly.

Pestilence deals a whole heart of contact damage in both phases, though without flight Isaac is more likely to be damaged by the Green Creep instead.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text: [bc: 2] : Leaves a trail of slowing White Creep instead of Green Creep, shoots 6 projectiles in all directions instead of an Ipecac shot and spawns Trites instead of Chargers or Spitties. He cannot spawn more than 3 Trites at once. It spawns Spiders instead of Attack Flies in Phase 2.

sections.heading: Unlockable achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Book of Revelations, 7 Seals]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Pestilence appeared in the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Pestilence is not directly one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse and is not present with the other Horsemen in Revelations (Revelation 6:2). The canonical Four Horsemen are Conquest (white), War (red), Famine (black), and Death (pale).

• However, pestilence is featured as one of God's "four disastrous acts of judgment" alongside sword, famine, and wild beasts (Ezekiel 14:21), which, in some cases, can be interpreted as symbolic of the Horsemen- as the acts of judgement are often used by God for destructive purposes throughout the Bible.

• • These four acts are given to the Horseman of Death to perform (Revelation 6:8) despite the contradictory fact that famine, the attribute of a completely separate Horsemen is among the acts.

• Despite not being a true Horseman, Ultra Pestilence still appears instead of an ultra version of Conquest during The Beast fight.

• Pestilence means a fatal disease epidemic.

• Pestilence is the only Harbinger that is unable to charge out of the room.

• [Before Repentance] Pestilence’s head resembles The Husk.

• Pestilence makes a "Hey!" sound when launching explosive projectiles at Isaac. Famine makes the same noises when spitting shots at Isaac at its second phase.

Petrified Poop.title: Petrified Poop
Petrified Poop.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Petrified Poop is a trinket that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to drop from Poop.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Increases pickup drop rate from poops to 50%.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Can be used when fighting bosses that spawn poop like Larry Jr. or Dingle, although the drop rate is greatly decreased in these rooms.

• Not affected by Luck.

• If obtained during the Mother's Shadow chase, the trinket will not spawn pickups from destroyed poops.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• E. Coli/Flush!: Grants poops made from enemies a chance to drop pickups.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having one of these increases the chance to 60%. [Repentance] Each copy further increases the chance for poops to drop pickups.

• Very effective with A Card Against Humanity.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• E. Coli/Flush!: Poops made from enemies do not drop pickups.

• IBS/Tainted ???: No effect on thrown poops.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This trinket is used in High Brow.

• This trinket seems to be in reference to Coprolites, very old pieces of poop that have become fossilized over a very long time.

fields.name: Petrified Poop
fields.description: Greatly increases the chances of a pickup dropping when destroying Poop.

Piggy Bank.title: Piggy Bank
Piggy Bank.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds 3 Penny on pickup.

• When Isaac takes damage, spawns 1 or 2 Pennies near him.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The coins that are dropped from Piggy Bank are not subtracted from Isaac's total.

• Other types of coins cannot be spawned by Piggy Bank, only normal Pennies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dull Razor: Activates Piggy Bank's effect without actually taking any damage.

• Keeper/Tainted Keeper: Drops 0-1 pennies instead.

• Piggy Bank: Multiple copies will only add 3 more coins on pickup, with no additional coins dropping on taking damage.

fields.description: Gives 3 Penny on pick-up. Every time Isaac is damaged, he will drop one or two additional pennies.

Pin.title: Pin
Pin.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[distinguish: Safety Pin; Push Pin] 

Pin is a boss that can appear in the Cellar.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Pin burrows into the ground before performing the following attacks:

• Jumps out of the ground towards Isaac and burrowing back into the ground at the end of the jump.

• [Before Repentance] Occasionally fires 4 projectiles diagonally from the last section of its body when exiting the ground and/or when burrowing back into the ground.

• [Repentance] Fires 4 projectiles diagonally depending on the length of its jump: does not fire projectiles on short jumps, fires projectiles shortly upon exiting the jump on regular/medium jumps, and fires projectiles both shortly upon exiting and after a few moments airborne on long jumps.

• Partially emerges out of the ground to fire a red Ipecac shot at Isaac before returning underground.

• After performing this attack, Pin will always jump out of the same spot it entered.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text: [bc: 2] : 15% larger with 25% more HP. Fires a radial burst of 6 spiraling projectiles instead of an explosive projectile and fires 6 projectiles instead of 4 when jumping.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Each segment of Pin can be individually damaged, so a single piercing tear could hit Pin multiple times.

• Moreover, if Pin is petrified (due to Mom's Contacts or Charged Baby, etc.), his individual segments can even be destroyed (though that would not necessarily deal higher damage), which will shorten the boss in its length.

• [Repentance] Piercing shots no longer damage segmented enemies multiple times per attack.

• Despite looking like it's flying above the ground, Pin is not immune to ground-based effects such as creep when doing its jumping attack. On the contrary, every segment is guaranteed to pass over the damaging area, making it more susceptible to damage.

• Due to this, Pin also cannot jump across gaps, and will bounce backwards when attempting to cross one.

• The segment that shoots bullets during mid-jump will continue to do so if it's suspended in mid-air with something like Anima Sola.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Pin was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• The Frail is its posthumous version.

• [Before Repentance] Prior to Repentance, Pin's Champion version could never appear in-game despite existing in the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Pin is based off the pinworm, an internal parasite.

• Pin is also likely based on the Larries, a trio of worm bosses in Edmund McMillen's game, Super Meat Boy that would dig in and out of the ground. This is also evident from its original concept art, where Pin was conceptualized a trio of worms instead of one.

• The other boss to reference the Larries from Super Meat Boy, is Larry Jr..

• Pin is likely a reference to Lanmola, a boss from The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, as nearly all of their attacks are the same.

• [Repentance] It is the boss version of the Needles. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Pin is the only boss that got a new champion variant in Repentance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If you fire immediately upon entering the Boss Room, rarely, you can damage Pin before it emerges.
Bug note: If Pin is under the effects of Broken Modem in mid-air, its jump will be stopped and it will fall.

Pinky Eye.title: Pinky Eye
Pinky Eye.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Adds a chance to shoot a poison tear, dealing damage over time when inflicted

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire a poison tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 10 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} * 0.5 \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 10%, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 20% and having both to 33%.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • The Common Cold: Activation rates are individually applied to each tear, effectively allowing for higher amounts of poison tears. However at 12 Luck, this trinket will not do anything for Isaac as The Common Cold is guaranteed to make every tear poisoned at that point.

fields.name: Pinky Eye
fields.description: Adds a 10% chance to shoot a poison tear, dealing damage over time when inflicted.

Pisces.title: Pisces
Pisces.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Increases tear knockback.

• If the player has piercing tears, the knockback effect is reduced.

• [Before Repentance] Tear size multiplier: 1.25x.

• [Repentance] +0.12 tear size.

• [Before Repentance] [tear delay down: 1] 

• [Repentance] +0.5 fire rate.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blister: Overrides Pisces.

• Brimstone: The beam gains knockback.

• Cupid's Arrow/Death's Touch/Dead Onion/Sagittarius: Tears gain knockback.

• Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Ipecac: Explosions also gain increased knockback.

• Mom's Knife: The knife gains knockback.

• Technology/Technology 2/Tech X: The lasers gain knockback.

• Technology 2's constant laser has such strong knockback, it can pin enemies to walls.

• Trisagion: Adds knockback to blasts, which can not only significantly repel enemies when used correctly, it can deal a high amount of damage to enemies unable to escape the knockback.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Isaac appears to be covered in scales, a reference to Pisces being represented by twin fish.

• Edmund McMillen is a pisces.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] -1 Tear Delay, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size.
[Repentance] +0.5 Fire Rate, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size.

Pitfall.title: Pitfall
Pitfall.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pitfalls are invulnerable and stationary enemies which Isaac can walk over. When Isaac walks over a pitfall, he falls in, takes damage, and pops back out after a short delay. Pitfalls disappear after falling into them. They are only spawned by several of Little Horn's attacks.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Flight makes Isaac immune to pitfalls.

sections.heading: Suction Pitfall
sections.text: Suction Pitfalls act as regular pitfalls, but suck Isaac in like a Gaping Maw. They are typically found in rooms with Pressure Plates, which when pressed will make any Suction Pitfalls in the room disappear.

sections.heading: Teleport Pitfall
sections.text: Teleport Pitfalls act as regular pitfalls, but pop Isaac out at a random location after damaging him. Little Horn spawns these and pushes them outward in some of his attacks.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Using Spider Mod will display health bars for Pitfalls.
Bug note: Falling into a Pitfall while a Black Hole is active will result in Isaac becoming headless, immobile and invulnerable, softlocking the run until it is quit and resumed.
Bug note: If Isaac walks over a Teleport Pitfall while Mega Mush is active a visual bug will occur where the pitfall is destroyed and can no longer harm Isaac however its sprites still remain in the room. When Isaac reenters the room or exits and continues the run, the teleport pitfall works normally again.

fields.environment: Only spawned by Little Horn.
