Placebo.title: Placebo
Placebo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, copies the effect of the pill currently held by Isaac.

• [Repentance] Placebo's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the pill Isaac was holding when he used it. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] The item only costs 10 coins when found in a Shop.

• Unknown pills are identified when copied.

• Has no effect when used without a pill.

sections.heading: Recharge time [Repentance]
sections.text:
This is a list of the following recharge times the item can have, depending on the consumable it mimicked last:

1 room
2 rooms
3 rooms
4 rooms
6 rooms
12 rooms

Golden Pills use the recharge time of the pill they mimicked. Recharge time is unaffected by whether or not it was a normal pill or Horse Pill.

Note that because the recharge time is determined after using the pill, Placebo cannot be used as a way to narrow down what type of pill Isaac is holding before he uses it.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 48 Hour Energy:

• [Before Repentance] Can spawn an unlimited number of Lil' Battery, allowing unlimited use of another activated item or pill.

• [Repentance] One battery is guaranteed to be a Lil' Battery, any additional batteries spawn as Micro Battery. The item does not recharge upon use.

• Placebo + Car Battery: Both batteries are guaranteed to be Lil' Battery, any additional batteries spawn as Micro Battery, once again allowing unlimited usage.

• • IX - The Hermit? can be used to "sell" any and all Lil' Battery and Micro Battery for 5 Pennies each, effectively allowing for in instant max of coins, provided you have spawned The Hermit? in another room, or have it in your second slot with Polydactyly.

• • 
• + Schoolbag + Blank Card: Effectively an extremely complicated method of producing infinite money.

• [Before Repentance] Balls of Steel + Sharp Plug: Allows functional invincibility.

• [Before Repentance] The Wafer: Allows for virtually infinite health.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns white wisps on the middle ring. The wisps spawn pills when destroyed. The effects of the wisps and types of pills they spawn is independent from Placebo's charge time and the most recently used pill. Unlike Blank Card and Clear Rune, enemies killed by these wisps' tears do not have a chance to drop pills.

• [Repentance] Vurp: Allows pills that normally take 12 rooms for Placebo to charge to be used twice as frequently.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Starter Deck: All pills are replaced by cards, rendering Placebo useless.

• [Repentance] Starter Deck + Little Baggy: Both cards and pills can be encountered again.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Placebo is a medicine or procedure prescribed for the psychological benefit to the patient rather than for any physiological effect.

• This item is a pill counterpart to Blank Card and Clear Rune.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If used with Bethany or Tainted Bethany, using a pill that has a larger charge requirement than Placebo's current will still consume soul or blood charges equal to the difference.

fields.description: Copies the effect of the pill currently held by Isaac. [Repentance] The recharge time is based on the power of the pill.

Placenta.title: Placenta
Placenta.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one full Red Heart container when picked up.

• Isaac has a 50% chance to regenerate a Half Red Heart every time the in-game timer hits a new minute (00:01:00, 00:02:00, etc).

• [Repentance] Heals 1 additional Red Heart when picked up.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can rarely drop from destroying polyps (outside of Corpse).

• The regeneration can happen multiple times in the same room, so there is no need to move between rooms to continue regeneration.

• [Before Repentance] However, regeneration does not occur when standing in a Crawl Space.

• Regeneration will only occur when Isaac has Red Heart containers or something equivalent:

• Keeper's and Tainted Keeper's coin hearts will regenerate, one coin at a time.

• Bone Hearts regenerate like red hearts.

• Consequently, characters with no applicable health -- ???, The Lost, Black Judas, Tainted ???, Tainted Bethany, Tainted Judas,Tainted Forgotten, and Tainted Lost—do not benefit from the effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blood Oath: With enough patience, health can be safely restored each floor by waiting in the starting room.

• Gnawed Leaf: Regeneration works while turned to stone, allowing Isaac to become invincible and regenerate while in any room.

• Sanguine Bond: Can be used indefinitely with placenta’s regen. Also works with normal sacrifice rooms.

• Sharp Plug: With enough patience, any active item can be reused indefinitely.

• Habit: Like Sharp Plug, any active item can be reused indefinitely with enough patience. 

• IV Bag, Piggy Bank, Fanny Pack, Swallowed Penny, Gimpy, Old Bandage: Can produce infinite of their respective consumables if given enough time

• [machine: Blood Donation Machine] , [machine: Devil Beggar] & [machine: Hell Game] : If given enough time will always reach their item payout.

• Razor Blade: Can be used to stack damage before triggering boss fights that do not automatically trigger upon room entry such as Hush, Mega Satan, or Dogma

• Cracked Dice: Can be used to re-roll items many times in a room if a damage source is present or the player has enough bombs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Maggy's Bow: No effect on regen.

• Tainted Magdalene: Receives 1 full red heart per regen trigger.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A Placenta is an organ that forms from the mother's uterus during pregnancy that supports the unborn child during development until it is expelled during childbirth. In some cultures, it is a common practice for the mother and/or child to eat the expelled placenta.

• This, like many other things Isaac does, is medically inadvisable (without proper preparation methods).

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Going into a Ventricle Razor portal at the same time the effect of Placenta is triggered will cause the effect to trigger in rapid succession, effectively healing Isaac to full health.

fields.description: Grants one full Red Heart container, and a chance to regenerate a Half Red Heart of health every minute of gameplay.

Plan C.title: Plan C
Plan C.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, deals 9,999,999 damage to every enemy in the room, then kills Isaac 3 seconds later.

• [Repentance+] Kills Isaac 10 seconds later in Delirium's room and 11.5 seconds later in Mother's room. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Plan C does not kill both or all phases of bosses like The Lamb, Hush, Ultra Greed, Mega Satan, Mother, and The Beast.

• Some bosses have special interactions with this item:

• [Before Repentance+] Attempting to use this item to kill Delirium or Mother will not work. Their death animation is much longer than the time between using Plan C and Isaac's Last Will appearing, meaning Isaac will die first and it will not count as a kill. Having extra lives that revive Isaac outside the room will not help, either; they must be fought again.

• • However, items that revive Isaac in the same room he died in, namely Lazarus' Rags (or being Lazarus), Inner Child, Soul of Lazarus, and Tainted Lost's Birthright, will allow Isaac to bypass this and kill them with this item. In the case of Lazarus' Rags, though, the completion mark will go toward Lazarus and not the character originally selected.

• • 
• Similarly, if playing as Tainted Lazarus, using Plan C and then using Flip to switch to the other form pauses the death counter until the player switches back to the form that originally used the item.

• • It is possible to kill Delirium by carefully timing pauses after each screen static. Each screen static plays a cutscene that continues to play even while paused, so by pausing and unpausing at the right timings, Delirium's death animation can be shortened to just under 3 seconds allowing for his completion mark to be awarded.

• • Using the effect of Plan C while Isaac is already under the timer of Plan C (such as through the use of another Plan C, ? Card, Wild Card, etc.) will reset the timer each use, allowing to stall bosses with long death animations.

• [Repentance] Killing Mother's second phase with Plan C will kill Isaac just at the end of her death animation. No completion mark is awarded.

• • However, if Isaac is revived outside the boss room, the boss will be considered dead and the mark will be awarded. This does not work for The Lost, Tainted Lost, The Forgotten (when playing as The Soul), and Tainted Forgotten since ghost characters have a slightly shorter death animation.

• [mode: greedier] Killing Ultra Greedier with Plan C will give a completion mark, with the exception of The Lost, Tainted Lost, The Forgotten (when playing as The Soul), and Tainted Forgotten. This is because ghost characters have a slightly shorter death animation, resulting in Isaac's Last Will appearing more quickly.

• [Repentance] If used in The Beast battle, Plan C will only kill the harbinger that Isaac is fighting on screen. It won't have any effect on the other harbingers nor The Beast itself (The Beast can still be killed if Isaac is fighting it when Plan C is used, and there is enough time to earn the completion mark).

• It is recommended not to use this item in Challenges, as even if the goal is within the bosses that dies before Isaac does, the player will likely die before the end of the rising trophy animation.

• For the game's sake, a run is not truly over until Isaac's Last Will appears. This means that some bosses that might seem to finish their death animations after Isaac dies, such as Ultra Greed, will still be technically killed and will still give their completion marks, even if Isaac does not enter the Final Boss Chest.

• Invulnerable enemies and closed Hosts will not be killed by Plan C.

• Isaac's last will shows his last damage source as the cause of death, not Plan C. If Isaac has not taken damage or lost health from any source, Isaac's face is shown.

• Invincibility or the Holy Mantle shield will not save Isaac from being killed.

• Some items that activate when Isaac reaches zero hearts, such as Heartbreak and Spirit Shackles, will not activate, killing Isaac.

• Even if Isaac enters a trapdoor immediately after using Plan C, he will still die after arriving at the next floor.

• Isaac will also die after accepting a Victory Lap or performing a RERUN.

• Plan C has an 80% decreased item pool weight, making it less likely to appear than other collectibles.

• [Repentance] It has a 90% decreased weight in the Red Chest pool, and normal weight in the Ultra Secret Room pool.

• [Before Repentance] Plan C is found in 6 item pools, the second highest count amongst all items, behind Cube of Meat. Its lowered weight, however, offsets its presence.

• [Repentance] Plan C is found in 8 item pools, the highest count amongst all items. Its lowered weight, however, offsets its presence.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Respawns Judas as Black Judas if he has an extra life.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns 8 red wisps that shoot red tears at 12 damage per tear. Using Plan C will kill Isaac as expected, but wisps won't disappear if used with an item that grants an extra life.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• [Repentance] Multiplayer: Only the player who uses Plan C dies.

• If the user dies from other causes before the effects of Plan C can conclude, their ghost will die, resulting in a run loss, regardless of there being other players alive.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to abortion pills, which are commonly given the nickname "Plan C." ("Plan A" being typical birth control methods, and "Plan B" being the so-called "morning-after pill," which prevents pregnancy in cases where contraception has failed.) The item's mechanic is a reference to abortion terminating an unborn fetus.

• Plan C's sprite is a red-tinted Forget Me Now.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Use with caution; Repentance: My last resort]
fields.description: Kills all enemies in the room, then kills Isaac three seconds later.

Playdough Cookie.title: Playdough Cookie
Playdough Cookie.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Every tear has a different color and different corresponding effect. One of the following effects can be granted:

• Brown: None

• Red: 2x damage, Fire Mind, or Petrify

• Pink: Charm

• Purple: Homing or Brain Worm

• Dark Blue: chance for Proptosis tears

• • Does not gain 3x damage, effectively making it a damage down.

• Light Blue: Slow, and Freeze on kill

• Green: Poison

• Yellow: Fear

• Orange: Bait

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The color of the tears from Playdough Cookie are not based on luck, but their individual effects are. (e.g. Red Fire Mind tears will always explode at 13 Luck.)

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Aquarius: Each individual puddle will grant a different effect, and will copy the corresponding color.

• Brimstone (including Azazel's and Tainted Azazel's) / Trisagion / Technology 2 / Tech X: Beam(s) apply a different effect every tick, and have an RGB filter. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.

• All of Trisagion's lasers will share the same color at any given moment, regardless of when they were fired. The same is true for Tech X's rings.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Explosions still use the effects the tears give them, while also inheriting their synergies with the items they're based on and (for Dr. Fetus) visually resembling them. (e.g. Dark Red becomes Hot Bombs, Green becomes Bob's Curse).

• They don't gain damage from Red, or lose damage from Blue, however.

• Spirit Sword: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. This can be used to rapidly apply different effects.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 120 Volt: No effect.

• Compound Fracture / The Parasite / Lachryphagy / Haemolacria: All split shots copy the color and effect of the first shot.

• The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten / Notched Axe: Every swing gains a different color and effect based on that color. It lacks the ability to be spammed that Spirit Sword has, however.

• Ipecac: Fire Mind tears drop a fire pit upon exploding.

• Jacob's Ladder: Lasers use the same effect as the tear.

• Tainted Lilith: The whip attack will apply different effects normally.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear changes color at your tear rate and gives the corresponding effects.

• Maw Of The Void: No effect.

• Mom's Knife: Applies a different effect every tick.

• Revelation / Montezuma's Revenge: Applies the RGB filter, but does not gain its effects.

• Technology: Beam applies a different effect every hit, and gains the RGB filter.

• Varicose Veins: Each one of the 10 tears spawned on hit has one of the available random effects applied to it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Playdough Cookie originates from the Antibirth mod, but was named Playdoh Cookie; this potentially was changed due to copyright issues. By extension, it was also from the Community Remix mod for the flash version, but named Playdough Cookie.

• In Antibirth, it had only 5 different tear colors, and some were not included or had their effects changed in Repentance. Its pickup quote was also changed from "Multicolored tears".

• In Community Remix, it was based on a Reddit concept.

• • It only had three effects, red giving a damage up upon killing an enemy, purple being homing, and green having a chance to poison enemies.

• The pickup quote of this item is possibly a reference to the Skittles' slogan, "Taste the Rainbow".

• Most of the tear effects are correspondent to tear effects of a similar color or effect. The only exception is Dark Blue, which has no correlation to Proptosis.

• Green resembles Scorpio's tears. Other poison items exist, but it is guaranteed much like Scorpio and matches its color.

• Yellow resembles Mom's Perfume's tears. Other fear items exist, but it matches that of Mom's Perfume.

• Light Blue resembles Uranus' tear color, minus the ice shape.

• Pink resembles Mom's Eyeshadow's tears.

• Red resembles the colors of Eye of Belial's sprite and Mom's Contacts's tears.

• • Although Fire Mind is less similar, it could be based on Fire Pits having an orange and red variant.

• Purple resembles Spoon Bender's tears.

• • Brain Worm still counts as a form of homing, though it does not change tear color.

• Orange resembles Rotten Tomato's tears.

fields.description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.

Plum Flute.title: Plum Flute
Plum Flute.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• On use, summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac in the current room for roughly 10 seconds.

• Baby Plum will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before waving goodbye and flying away.

• Baby Plum does 12 contact damage per tick (24 per second), 3.5 damage per shot, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If Isaac goes enough time (about half a minute) without hurting Baby Plum during a boss fight, she will fly away and leave behind a Plum Flute on the Boss Room pedestal.

• Damage done with Suplex! does not count as hurting Baby Plum.

• Damage done indirectly, like losing Black Hearts, does not count as hurting Baby Plum.

• Damage dealt passively by familiars such as Demon Baby, Succubus, and Psy Fly does count as hurting Baby Plum.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Angelic Prism: Baby Plum's shots that pass through the Prism will be split into four.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a wisp on the middle ring, resembling Baby Plum. When the Baby Plum spawned from using Plum Flute bounces diagonally around the room, all the wisps will bounce around the room and fire tears behind themselves as well. The wisps are invulnerable while bouncing around the room.

• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles Baby Plum's contact damage, but not projectile damage. Plum is also larger.

• Car Battery: Summons two Baby Plums, the Baby Plums start out overlapped but can sometimes split up when using different attacks.

• Lost Cork: Affects Baby Plum's blood puddle.

• Sacrificial Altar: Baby Plum can be sacrificed for free, instead of a familiar. Plum Flute can still be used as normal afterwards.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: No effect.

• Eraser: Plum Flute will still function normally if the boss Baby Plum is erased.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Plum Flute resembles the Poké Flute, an item that appears in various Pokémon games and is used to wake sleeping Pokémon.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If Baby Plum is spawned in a Crawl Space or The Beast fight, she will not properly bounce off walls.
Bug note: If Baby Plum is currently active when Tainted Lazarus swaps forms, Baby Plum will vanish. Once Tainted Lazarus swaps forms again, Baby plum will re-appear and continue her attacks.
If she was doing her spit attack, her and her projectiles will end up stuck in place and she will not stop attacking until the player leaves the room.
Bug note: If Baby Plum is charmed by The Siren, her animation will freeze, she will stop firing bullets, and she will only be able to deal contact damage to Isaac.

fields.description: Summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.

Lemon Mishap.title: Lemon Mishap
Lemon Mishap.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Creates a [Before Repentance+] tiny / [Repentance+] small pool of yellow creep, damaging enemies that cross it.

• [Repentance+] The pool lasts for the entire room, only disappearing when it is exited.

• The puddle deals 8 damage per tick or 24 damage per second.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] This item can be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns yellow wisps in the middle ring. The wisps fire faster and have decreased range. The wisps themselves occasionally leave small puddles of yellow creep that last for 3 seconds and deal 7 damage per tick to enemies that walk over them (56 damage per second).

• Lost Cork: Doubles puddle size.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Lemon Party Pill will drop a larger pool of Lemon Mishap.

• In the original Binding of Isaac, Lemon Mishap was the only activated collectible to have an icon different to its item (the item was a lemon, but picked up it was a glass of lemonade).

• The item Free Lemonade is a reference to this.

• In the original Binding of Isaac, Lemon Mishap was widely considered as one of the worst active items in the game, due to low damage and small creep size, making it both hard and unreliable at killing anything. In Rebirth, Lemon Mishap was buffed considerably.

• This item is used in When Life Gives You Lemons).

fields.description: Creates a small pool of yellow creep, damaging enemies that cross it. [Repentance+] The pool lasts for the entire room.

Leo.title: Leo
Leo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac can break obstacles by walking into them.

• Increases Isaac's size.

• Contributes to the Stompy transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Walking into Bomb Rocks will cause them to explode.

• Mushrooms may hurt Isaac with a poison cloud if walked into.

• Polyps may hurt Isaac with blood shots or red creep if walked into.

• Flight does not prevent the effect from occurring.

• Holes in the ground can be filled if Isaac walks into adjacent rocks from the right direction, similar to bombs.

• TNT Barrels will not be destroyed or explode on contact, however Movable TNT Barrels will explode and may deal damage to Isaac if walked into.

• Allows Isaac to walk over and destroy Red Poop without taking damage. Isaac will still take damage if he is standing on it when it reforms.

• Walking into an Angel Statue in the Angel Room will trigger the boss fight, and Isaac will take damage as the Angel spawns on top of him.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Nullifies effects of One Makes You Small pills, One Makes You Larger pills, and other items which decrease size, such as Caffeine Pill and Binky.

• [Repentance] Spiked Rocks can be destroyed, but depending on Isaac's size, angle and velocity they may still hurt him.

• [Repentance] Isaac can crush Rock Spiders and Tinted Rock Spiders by stepping on them. Killing a Rock Spider this way will spawn a Spider which is extremely likely to deal damage to Isaac. [end edition note]

fields.description: Isaac can destroy rocks by walking into them.

Leprosy.title: Leprosy
Leprosy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon taking damage, Isaac gains a body part as an orbital, which blocks enemy shots and deals 7 damage per tick (35 damage per second) to enemies it comes in contact with.

• A maximum of three body parts can be active at once.

• The body parts will be destroyed after dealing 30 ticks of damage and/or blocking 3 shots.

• The body parts persist between floors.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Fistula. [end edition note] 

• Body parts orbit on the same layer as Blue Flies and Locusts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Box of Friends: Will not multiply orbitals.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The description "You're tearing me apart!" is a reference to the movie The Room (which Edmund has said he is a big fan of), in which Tommy Wiseau famously exclaims "You're tearing me apart, Lisa!".

• Leprosy was inspired by a Steam Workshop item by Schmäxel.

• The item used to be misspelled "Leprocy" but was corrected in a later patch.

• Leprosy is a bacterial disease that damages nerves and can cause extremities to rot in extreme cases.

fields.description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.

Less Than Three.title: Less Than Three
Less Than Three.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: {{DISPLAYTITLE:<3}}

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one Heart container.

• Fully restores Isaac's red health. Does not affect Soul Hearts and Black Hearts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can drop from killing Gluttony. [Before Repentance] Gluttony can drop this item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• [Repentance] It can also be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "<3" is the ASCII/Emoticon representation of a heart.

• Although <3's is a heart, it isn't like an anatomically correct heart, nor a heart symbol, instead looking like a combination of the two.

• According to Edmund McMillen's first post-Repentance Lore Stream, the visual appearance of this item is a reference to the movie 'Raising Arizona' in which the character of Glen passingly remarks about an orphan child with his heart born on the outside of his chest.

• McMillen states that this remark left a lasting impression on him when he was younger, and as such he wished to incorporate it into the game in some way.

• This scene itself is a reference to the rare birth defect 'ectopia cordis' in which the child's heart is located either partially or entirely outside of their chest.

• With Isaac canonically being 3 apples tall, the amount of body covered by the heart is fairly accurate compared to the size of an average child heart.

fields.description: Grants Isaac one Red Heart container and fully restores Isaac's health.

Leviathan.title: Leviathan
Leviathan.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Leviathan is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, turning Isaac into a Lovecraftian horror after picking up 3 devil-related items.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Grants 2 Black Hearts and flight.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list ( [Repentance] with the [code: devil] tag).

sections.heading: Passive Collectibles
Notes
sections.text: • Sanguine Bond's spikes have a 2% chance to transform Isaac into Leviathan.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This transformation is based on the biblical creature of the same name.

• This transformation was initially misspelled as "Levathian" in Afterbirth but has been fixed in Afterbirth+.

fields.description: Grants flight and gives +2 Black Hearts.

Liberty Cap.title: Liberty Cap
Liberty Cap.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
Grants a 25% chance of triggering one of the following effects for the current room upon entering it:

• Mini Mush

• Odd Mushroom (Large)

• Odd Mushroom (Thin)

• The Compass

• Blue Cap

• God's Flesh

• Magic Mushroom

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket has a chance to drop from destroying mushrooms.

• [Before Repentance] If the Compass effect triggers while having the Treasure Map, the Compass effect is permanent for the remainder of the floor. (Other Mushroom effects will still apply in each room with their normal odds.)

• By walking into and out of a room, Liberty Cap will change its effect.

• [Before Repentance] This can be used to easily get the Compass effect.

• [Repentance] This can be used to easily get the Magic Mushroom effect before Boss Rush or Dogma (as the Dogma boss room door will only close when touching the middle of the room).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box : One boost or copy increases the chance for activation to 50%, further copies to 100%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item quote is a reference to the Yoshi's Island level 1-7: "Touch Fuzzy Get Dizzy".

• Psilocybe semilanceata, commonly known as "Liberty Cap", is widely present in nature and is a very powerful psychedelic mushroom which contains psilocybin.

• The Liberty Cap's ability to grant the Compass effect was a bug in the original Binding of Isaac which was carried over due to popularity with the fans.

• The pickup quote for the Chinese translation (一摸一起躺板板) is a reference to a popular meme https://youtu.be/3Iqir-pcjTo|meme

fields.name: Liberty Cap
fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Adds a chance when entering a room to gain Mini Mush, Odd Mushroom (Large), Odd Mushroom (Thin), or The Compass for one room.
[Repentance] Adds a chance when entering a room to gain a random passive mushroom item for one room. [end edition note]

Libra.title: Libra
Libra.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Continually balances Isaac's primary attributes - damage, range, tears, and speed (has no effect on luck, shot speed, [Before Repentance] or tear falling speed).

• This effect is NOT one time only - Libra will rebalance Isaac's attributes whenever they are changed by an item, effect, etc. including temporary effects such as the The Book of Belial.

• Grants 6 Penny, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The balancing is based on Isaac as the character himself; he gains no bonuses or penalties to any stats from simply having Libra on its own.

• The game calculates Isaac's speed, range, tear delay, and damage before using them in Libra's balancing formula. This has the following notable effects:

• [Before Repentance] If Isaac's Speed or Tear delay are already at their internal soft caps (2.00 and 5 respectively), items that increase them specifically will give no stats.

• • The only exception would be items that decrease tear delay, and then only if Isaac's tear delay isn't at the hard cap of 1.

• [Repentance] If Isaac's tears stat has reached the soft cap corresponding to 5 fire rate, basic tears ups no longer add bonuses, only direct tear delay upgrades will. Likewise, direct fire rate increases have no effect if the absolute maximum of 120 has been reached.

• • Speed adjustments, despite the stat being bounded between 0.1 and 2.0, always have an effect.

• [Repentance] Speed and range will positively scale as they increase; the higher these stats already are upon receiving a boost to either one, the bigger the boost to the rest of Isaac's stats. Range scales especially quickly, making large range upgrades like My Reflection and Tiny Planet very powerful with Libra.

• Items that apply multipliers to Isaac's tear delay (Mutant Spider, Brimstone, Dr. Fetus, etc.) can be fired more rapidly with less damage.

• Damage upgrades become less effective. In return, speed and range upgrades now increase damage and tears.

• Items that affect the stats of Isaac's tears after they're fired (A Lump of Coal, Blood Clot, Proptosis, etc.) do not go through the balancing formula and work as normal.

• [Before Repentance] Libra's balancing formula values tear delay higher than the other stats and damage less than the other stats. This makes standard tears ups give more stats than a standard range or speed up, and standard damage ups give less stats than a standard range or speed up.

• [Repentance] Generally speaking, if an item increases Isaac's damage per second, Isaac will receive a stat bonus. If the item lowers fire rate and increases damage, or vice versa, in a way that results in loss of DPS, Isaac's stats will go down.

• [Before Repentance] Since tear falling speed is not involved in the calculations, items such as Mini Mush or Kidney Stone that increase tear falling speed but lower range are mostly detrimental.

• Stat upgrade pills have more utility, providing bonuses long after their stat could be usefully increased.

• In order of effectiveness, the pills are: Range, Tears, then Speed Up.

• Placebo with stat upgrade pills provides a constant source of stat increases.

• Damage from poison and burning status effects is based on Isaac's damage before the balancing. The same is true for temporary familiars (such as blue flies.)

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Berserk!: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra would instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stat with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit as the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.

• Soy Milk: As tear delay is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats.

• [Repentance] Soy Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.

• Ipecac: Can be rapidly fired with decreased damage.

• Rock Bottom: Stats will increase as a result of items, get locked at the highest point, and then be balanced out via Libra allowing items like Ipecac and Soy Milk to have higher damage/shot speed respectively.

• Taurus: Gradually increases all stats in an incomplete room. Libra prevents Isaac from becoming invincible (unless with high stats), and stat increases will remain until the end of the fight.

• Tape Worm: As range is valued very highly by the formula, greatly increases all stats. Synergizes well with Mom's Box.

• [Repentance] Tape Worm is a flat +3 range instead of x2, resulting in only a small all stats up.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 120 Volt / Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The attacks from these items ignore Libra: the unbalanced damage value is used.

• Almond Milk: Almond Milk is only a minor DPS upgrade, and as such a very minor all stats up.

• Cricket's Body: Due to how Libra values tear delay, Cricket's Body gives an overall stat downgrade or upgrade depending on Isaac's internal base tear delay: At 7 or less it increases stats, at 8 or more it decreases stats.

• D8: D8's stat changes depend on which stats end up with which multipliers and their base values. Range has a high weight and is uncapped, and thus can result in a massive boost if it scores a high multiplier. Damage is also uncapped but, on the other hand, has a low weight.

• [Repentance] The changes in Libra's formula and the uncapping of speed bonuses beyond 2.0 mean D8 has a good chance of giving a strong all stats up, its magnitude depending on Isaac's other items and which stats were emphasized.

• Dark Arts: Libra is extremely detrimental to how Dark Arts works, and should not be used together: The speed boost during the invincibility phase is transferred into attack bonuses (Which are useless as tears cannot be used), and afterwards, the temporary damage boost is divided across all of Isaac's stats, resulting in very negligible stat boosts.

• Epiphora: The stat bonus for continuously firing in one direction applies to all stats. The accuracy penalty is unaffected.

• Eve's Mascara: Gives an overall stat downgrade, due to tears being weighted heavier than damage.

• [Repentance] Eve's Mascara is a DPS up with no other relevant stats, and as such is a small all stats up.

• Experimental Treatment: The greater number of stat upgrades compared to stat downgrades results in an effectively guaranteed all stats up. Health, Shot Speed, and Luck are still subject to chance.

• Purity: At base stats, the tear delay and damage aura give a greater stat bonus than the range or speed aura.

• [Repentance] All the auras grant a small all stats up of similar magnitudes.

• Succubus: When in the aura, affects re-balanced stats rather than just damage.

• Technology 2: Doubled tear delay due to firing out of only one eye is unaffected by the balancing formula.

• Tiny Planet: The significant range increase results in a large stat boost to speed and tears and a small boost to damage. However, the decrease in range causes orbiting tears to no longer complete a full 360° lap around Isaac, instead dropping off at about half that.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The symbol of the scales is based on the Scales of Justice held by Themis, the Greek personification of divine law and custom.

• Libra gives 6 bombs, 6 keys, and 6 coins, a potential reference to the Number of the Beast (666).

fields.description: Gives 6 Penny, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys and balances out all attributes.

Lil Abaddon.title: Lil Abaddon
Lil Abaddon.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a familiar that creates a fluctuating black ring after a 1 second charge time that damages enemies that touch it, similarly to Maw Of The Void.

• The black ring lasts for 1 second and deals 3.5 damage per tick, up to 15 times per ring, for a total of 52.5 damage.

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Abaddon having [edition rnr+] 4th / [Repentance+] 6th priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The black ring created gets wider and deals double damage.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 10 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Hemoptysis + BFFS!: The curse causes the ring's damage to be increased to 17 damage per tick.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • As its name implies, Lil Abaddon resembles a miniature version of the Abaddon costume.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that charges a miniature Maw Of The Void attack while Isaac shoots.

Lil Blub.title: Lil Blub
Lil Blub.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lil Blub is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in [Repentance] Downpour and [Repentance] Dross.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Lil Blub diagonally floats around the room and performs the following attacks:

• Spits up 2-3 Small Leech that swarm around him, blocking shots.

• Spits out a single larger Small Leech that chases Isaac instead.

• Fires 6 streams of projectiles outwards in a radial burst. These projectiles deal a full heart of damage.

• Jumps once towards Isaac, creating a burst of disorganized arcing projectiles upon landing.

• Lil Blub can only use this attack when below a certain threshold of HP.
The previous two attacks also cause any Small Leeches that are swarming around Lil Blub to start chasing Isaac. Lil Blub cannot use any of these attacks if there are 6 or more Small Leeches in the room.

• Jumps towards Isaac 3-5 times, firing projectiles in the cardinal and diagonal directions upon landing. The cardinal shots are faster and travel further than the diagonal ones.

• Any leeches Lil Blub lands on are instantly killed.

• Lil Blub can only use this attack when below 25% HP, and greatly prefers using it if he can.

Upon death, he spawns 2-4 Small Leeches and bursts into a fountain of projectiles that rain down for a few seconds in a wide area.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Lil Blub's original name in Antibirth was "Beelzeblub", and he is referenced as such in the game files.

• In pre-release content for Repentance, his name was Lil Bub, without the "L".

• Lil Blub appears to be a drowned version of The Duke of Flies.

• It is possible that the shell worn by Min-Min is his posthumous version, as this shell that resembles The Husk, the posthumous version of the Duke of Flies.

• When encountered in the Dross, the color palette of Lil Blub and his attacks is altered to fit the floor. Wormwood also features this.

fields.name: Lil Blub
fields.environment:
Boss
Downpour / Dross / 
boss challenge /

Lil Brimstone.title: Lil Brimstone
Lil Brimstone.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin Brimstone beam that deals [edition alternatives: baseline: 3.5; Repentance: 3] damage per tick and can strike an enemy up to [edition alternatives: baseline: 9; Repentance: 8] times, for a total of [edition alternatives: baseline: 31.5; Repentance: 24] damage. It needs to be charged up and will only fire when the fire button is released.

• [Before Repentance] Unlike Brimstone, Lil Brimstone can start charging up a beam while still firing the previous one.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Conjoined transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Rebirth only] Lil Brimstone is a Special Item.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Brimstone having [edition alternatives: baseline: 3rd; Repentance+: 5th priority] .

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: Brimstone beams will home in on enemies.

• BFFS!: The beam deals double damage.

• Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone beam deals to 8 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone beam under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

• Hemoptysis + BFFS!: The curse causes the beam's damage to be increased to 13 damage per tick.

• [Repentance] King Baby / Marked: While firing, Brimstone will be charged automatically and fired immediately upon full charge, the beam will now target the nearest enemy/crosshair. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Eye of the Occult: When used with a laser attack (such as Brimstone), Lil Brimstone will not automatically fire as it would with Marked.

fields.name: Lil [Before Afterbirth+] ' Brimstone
fields.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires a thin Brimstone beam that charges while holding the fire button and shoots when released.

Lil Chest.title: Lil Chest
Lil Chest.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a chest familiar that has a 25% chance to spawn a pickup and a 10% chance to spawn a trinket after clearing a room. The possible rewards are:

• Red Heart

• Penny

• Bombs

• Keys

• Pills

• Cards

• Runes

• Lil' Battery

• Trinkets

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Lil Chest having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • BFFS!: The chance to spawn a pickup increases to 31.25%, and the chance to spawn a trinket increases to 12.5%.

fields.name: Lil Chest
fields.description: Spawns a chest familiar that spawns a random pickup (25% chance) or trinket (10% chance) upon clearing a room.

Lil Clot.title: Lil Clot
Lil Clot.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Not to be confused with Blood Clot, an item.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a blood clot Familiar on the ground near Isaac. The familiar copies Isaac's movement and attacks, but deals only 35% of Isaac's damage.

• The clot will die after taking damage 3 times.

• If Isaac does not currently have a clot from this trinket, a new one spawns when entering a room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Holding the "drop" button lets Isaac move independently from Lil Clot.

• Lil Clot will persist after the trinket is dropped, but it will not respawn unless the trinket is picked up again.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box / Lil Clot: Grants an additional clot, which will also respawn if the trinket is held.

• BFFS!: Increases the damage to 70% of Isaac's.

• Found Soul: The ghost familiar receives its own floating Lil Clot that acts the same way as Isaac's, vanishing when the ghost dies.

• The Ludovico Technique: The clot's tear floats the same way Isaac's tear does.

• Tractor Beam: Clot's tears travel along the beam regardless of its location.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: When used together with Azazel's Stump, the blood clot familiar sometimes keeps Azazel's properties (flight and short brimstone) for a few rooms after transforming back from Azazel.
Bug note: If Isaac has both The Ladder and a form of flight, the clot familiar will be unable to path over any terrain with a ladder on it despite having the ability to fly, resulting in movement desync.
Bug note: When Isaac uses Glowing Hourglass while holding Lil Clot, an additional blood clot will spawn.

fields.description: Spawns a clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tears. It dies for the current room after taking too much damage.

Lil Delirium.title: Lil Delirium
Lil Delirium.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.

• The familiars it turns into are normal familiars that look white and melted like Delirium.

• Familiars deal the same damage as their normal non-Delirium counterparts.

• Familiars will not do contact damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Lil Delirium can transform into the following familiars:

• Acid Baby

• BBF

• Bob's Brain

• Dry Baby

• Headless Baby

• Hushy

• Incubus

• Lil Brimstone

• Lil Gurdy

• Lil Haunt

• Lil Monstro

• Little Chubby

• Little Gish

• Robo-Baby 2.0

• Rotten Baby

• Seraphim

• Super Meat Boy (Cube of Meat's 4th stage)

• [Repentance] Big Chubby

• [Repentance] Farting Baby

• [Repentance] Fruity Plum

• [Repentance] Isaac's Head

• [Repentance] Lil Loki

• Lil Delirium can transform into the same familiar multiple times in a row and therefore stay in the same form for more than 10 seconds.

• Every time Lil Delirium transforms from a free-floating familiar to a follower one, it positions itself at the end of the familiar train.

• Lil Delirium can damage Isaac when transformed into BBF or Bob's Brain.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars. Lil Delirium starts at [Before Repentance+] 4th / [Repentance+] 6th priority regardless of the familiar it transforms into as long as it starts as a familiar that follows behind Isaac. When Lil Delirium changes out of a familiar that follows behind Isaac; its priority resets and becomes equal to its next form (e.g. having [Before Repentance+] 2nd / [Repentance+] 3rd priority when its next form is ). Changing from one following familiar to another will not change priorities.

• [Repentance+] Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Box of Friends: The copy of Lil Delirium will be a different random familiar.

• [Repentance] Tainted Lilith + Birthright: Lil' Delirium will only stack on top of Gello if it transforms into a familiar that does. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Lil Delirium is based on this Steam Workshop item by Ashkait and Scayze.

• Lil Delirium is one of only five items to appear in both the Angel and Devil item pools, the others being 7 Seals, Void, Duality, and Purgatory.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When entering a new floor or room, Lil Delirium and a normal familiar you have can swap forms as long as Lil Delirium is currently transformed as that familiar. For example, if you have Lil Brimstone and Lil Delirium, Lil Brimstone will become Lil Delirium's form, while Lil Delirium will look normal. This persists for the other familiar, but Lil Delirium will go back to normal. This also works if you pick up the familiar Lil Delirium is transformed as.

fields.description: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.

Lil Dumpy.title: Lil Dumpy
Lil Dumpy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a Dumpy familiar, which follows behind him. When Isaac is about to take damage (as with Panic Button), Lil Dumpy farts, knocking back nearby enemies and shots while also propelling itself in a random direction. Enemies that collide with obstacles or walls take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage. Pushed shots that hit an enemy deal 6 damage normally and 7 damage if they would deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.

• Lil Dumpy has a larger, hidden secondary radius that may randomly trigger its fart effect if an enemy projectile enters it.

• After farting, Lil Dumpy goes on cooldown and "falls asleep" until Isaac walks up to it to wake it up. Lil Dumpy resets upon entering a new room.

• Lil Dumpy deals contact damage, which depends on its speed. If it hits an enemy right after farting, it will deal 8.33 damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Does not prevent damage from environmental hazards, including Spiked Chests.

• Lil Dumpy's position behind Isaac can overlap with other Familiars or other copies of itself.

• Dormant Lil Dumpy can come into contact with and be pushed around by enemies, but doesn't deal contact damage.

• Lil Dumpy can get stuck over rocks and pits, becoming unreachable for the rest of the room.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The contact damage is boosted greatly. For instance, if the familiar hits an enemy right after farting, it will now deal 33.33 damage.

• Gigante Bean: Applies to Lil Dumpy and causes the fart to become much bigger and also deal 10 damage.

• The Twins: Can duplicate Lil Dumpy, practically adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's Holy Mantle-like protection.

• Box of Friends: Will copy Lil Dumpy for extra protection, this process can be repeated many times to make Isaac near-invincible in Greed mode, Greedier mode, Boss Rush or with 4.5 Volt.

• Ventricle Razor / Other methods of teleportation: Lil Dumpy will quickly fly to Isaac instead of teleporting, dealing damage to everything in its path.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Lil Dumpy is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Lil Dumpy instead wandered around the room randomly and would fart when blocking a projectile, which could poison or confuse nearby enemies as well as knock them back and send Lil Dumpy flying.

• The design of this item is also based off of Dumplings, a common enemy present in Antibirth that does not appear in Repentance. Dumplings are a creature featured in multiple of Edmund McMillen's previous Flash games, and even having a game of their own.

• Prior to V1.7.8, Lil Dumpy would instead behave like its Antibirth version.

fields.description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.

Lil Gurdy.title: Lil Gurdy
Lil Gurdy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that can be launched in the direction that Isaac is firing after a short charge-up period.

• [Before Repentance] At full charge, it initially deals 6 damage per tick or 90 damage per second, but quickly drops towards 0 the slower the familiar moves.

• [Repentance] No longer deals damage per tick, instead deals a fix amount of damage depending on charge level, at lowest being ~5 and at max being ~20.

• It bounces off walls multiple times, much like Gurdy Jr.

• [Repentance] It will also bounce off enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Gurglings, Gurdy Jr., Gurdy or Mama Gurdy. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Although Lil Gurdy's right eye is missing when facing right, its left eye is missing instead when facing left.

• Despite being able to destroy poop, Lil Gurdy is not able to extinguish fires.

fields.name: Lil Gurdy
fields.description: A Gurdy Jr. familiar that charges up while Isaac is firing, bouncing around the room when released and dealing contact damage based on its speed.

The Halo.title: The Halo

The Harbingers.title: The Harbingers
The Harbingers.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Harbingers is the achievement that unlocks Famine, War, Pestilence, and Death as four additional bosses. The Harbingers are referenced in the Bible as the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. These bosses are only unlocked once Mom has been defeated for the first time. These bosses, with the exception of Conquest and Headless Horseman, are guaranteed to drop either a Ball of Bandages or a Cube of Meat. By default, there is a 10% chance the current floor's boss will be a Harbinger unless the floor has a fixed boss (for example, Mom in Depths and Necropolis) or the Harbinger has been fought already. By using the Book of Revelations on a floor, it is guaranteed that the boss will be a Harbinger.

sections.heading: Famine
sections.text: Famine is the Harbinger for Chapter 1.

sections.heading: Pestilence
sections.text: Pestilence is the Harbinger for Chapter 2.

sections.heading: War
sections.text: War is the Harbinger for Chapter 3. War cannot be found in Depths II, Necropolis II, or Dank Depths II as Mom will always be the boss of that floor.

sections.heading: Death
sections.text: Death is the Harbinger for Chapter 4. Death cannot be found in Womb II, Utero II, or Scarred Womb II as Mom's Heart or It Lives! will always be the boss of that floor.

sections.heading: Conquest
sections.text: Conquest is an alternative boss to Death in Chapter 4. He is unlocked once 10 items have been taken from Angel Rooms. Conquest does not drop normal Horseman items, instead dropping White Pony.

sections.heading: Headless Horseman
sections.text: Headless Horseman can appear in the place of any Harbinger. Like Conquest, he doesn't drop normal Horseman items, instead dropping A Pony.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Book of Revelations, 7 Seals]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Conquest was added in the Binding of Isaac: Wrath of the Lamb. In the Bible, Conquest is actually the first Horseman to appear, while Pestilence is a Horseman existing only in popular culture, coming from a different translation of the Greek word 'Thanatos', often meaning Death instead (the canon four Horsemen, thus, are Conquest, War, Famine and Death).

• Conquest's entry in the secrets is called "The Forgotten Horseman", because of that very reason.

• Death is the only horseman specifically given a name in The Book of Revelation.

• The use of the Book of Revelations item to summon a horseman for the current floor is reference to the fact that the book of the Bible in which the horsemen are described is Revelation.

• None of the Harbingers have a death animation.

• Under normal circumstances, Conquest and Headless Horseman are 2 of only 5 bosses (the others being Krampus, The Fallen, and Baby Plum if spared) who drop or can drop active items upon defeat.

• Bumbino can drop active items if paid 12 coins, but this does not defeat him in the traditional sense.

• As for abnormal circumstances, the use of Filigree Feather allows the Angels to drop active items, and the use of Satanic Bible allows nearly any boss to drop an active item.

• The horses used by the Harbingers resemble hobbyhorses.

The Heretic.title: The Heretic
The Heretic.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Heretic is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in the Mausoleum.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
• During the beginning of the fight, 5 Exorcists, which are shielded and invulnerable, summon The Heretic from a large pentagram, after which they turn into Fanatics.

• The Heretic is incorporeal until all Fanatics and the Pacers or Gushers they turn into are dead, similar to The Haunt's first phase.

• While incorporeal, The Heretic can still do contact damage.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
• Lobs 7 projectiles that, after landing, burst into 6 fires that spread out in a radial pattern. The landing position of each projectile is marked on the ground.

• The Heretic then follows up by launching itself towards Isaac, creating a radial burst of 8 lines of fire where it lands. It spends a short time readjusting its dislocated jaw before continuing to attack.

• The arena of the Heretic always spawns a number of unlit Fire Places. The Heretic can light up 5-6 of them before firing a purple Brimstone laser that connects all of the lit fires. The order the Heretic lights each fire indicates what order the laser travels.

• These can be extinguished with an explosion, preventing Brimstone lasers from reaching the deactivated Fire Place.

• Dashes off-screen and turns invisible before charging in again, predicting Isaac's movements and attempting to bite down on where Isaac is moving, doing a full heart of damage if the attack connects. It chains this attack a total of 4 times, each time from alternating sides of the room.

• The Heretic occasionally does not finish the fourth charge, instead fading away and quickly charging in one final time from the other side of the screen.

• Upon death, the Heretic's fiery eye drops down and sends out lines of fire in the cardinal directions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• When not fought as a main boss, such as in a Boss Challenge room or a degraded boss, it will not be preceded by Fanatics and have no first phase.

• The Heretic also cannot perform its Brimstone attack outside of its regular boss room as there will be no unlit Fire Places.

• The Heretic can be instantly killed with Vade Retro if it is at 50% health or below.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Heretic originates from a Reddit post by NotYourSaggitarius in 2015, as a versus screen mockup. The boss was later incorporated into the Antibirth mod.

• It appears to be a resurrected variation of The Haunt or The Forsaken.

• The only time the Heretic's empty right eye lights up is during its Brimstone attack.

• The Exorcists that appear during the beginning of the fight to summon the Heretic are found nowhere else in the Mausoleum, unlike in Antibirth, where they were a regularly appearing Monster.

• If The Heretic is destroyed with a Chaos Card before the summoning animation finishes, any remaining Exorcists will become vulnerable and be stuck performing the ritual until they are killed.

The Hollow.title: The Hollow
The Hollow.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Hollow is a boss that can appear in the Catacombs.

It has [Before Repentance] 22 HP / [Repentance] 26 HP per segment.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
The number of individual The Hollow bodies that can spawn each fight can vary from 1-4. The most common encounter with The Hollow is with 2 bodies.

• Flies around the room diagonally, bouncing off of walls.

• The Hollow appears to travel faster when moving at vertical angles compared to horizontal.

• The Hollow can change direction if it collides with Isaac.

• Occasionally spawns poop while moving.

• The Hollow's segments can be split into smaller copies of the boss as long as the new Hollow segments are longer than 2 pieces.
There is a chance that a Grub can spawn alongside a shorter Hollow (basically replacing a second Hollow).

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 18] : 15% larger, has slower movement and 25% more HP (32.5). Each segment that isn't the head spawns a Boom Fly when killed. Does not spawn any poop.
The head will spawn a Boom Fly only if killed immediately after spawning.
[bc: 12] : 15% larger and has 25% more HP (32.5) but retains the same movement speed. Each segment that isn't the head will drop a Penny on death.
The head will drop a penny only if killed immediately after spawning.
[bc: 5] : Chance for each segment that isn't the head to spawn a Charger on death. Occasionally stops movement to shoot 3 bullets at wherever it is facing.
The head will spawn a Charger only if killed immediately after spawning.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Poop spawned by The Hollow will never drop pickups, even when in possession of Petrified Poop.

• [Repentance] Poops spawned by The Hollow have an incredibly low chance to spawn pickups. This chance is not affected by Petrified Poop.

• Leaving the room and returning will make the poop generate pickups normally.

• Piercing tears make fighting The Hollow much easier, as each tear can damage multiple segments.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Hollow was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• It is the posthumous version of Larry Jr.

• The definition of hollow is empty on the inside or surface, which could explain the boss's paleness and complexion.

• The Hollow is the only boss that has three Champion versions.

• In the V1.7.8 update, The Hollow's yellow Champion version was given a unique sprite that looks similar to Ultra Greedier.

• The Hollow is the only regular boss that can be spawned by Mega Satan between thresholds.

• [Repentance] Despite Larry Jr. receiving new body sprites in Repentance, and despite The Hollow's body sprites simply being recolors of Larry Jr.'s sprites, The Hollow's body sprites are unchanged in Repentance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Sometimes this boss will get stuck in the wall when slowed.

The Horny Boys.title: The Horny Boys
The Horny Boys.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Horny Boys are a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in Gehenna.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Floats randomly around the room and cycles between the following attacks in the following order:

• Summons a Boom Fly orbited by 3 pink Eternal Fly Bombs.

• Juggles 3 bombs then throws them toward Isaac. Each bomb has a chance of having the Hot Bombs or Sad Bombs effect.

• Chains together numerous consecutive tear patterns while gradually increasing the rate in which they are fired:

• 4 cardinal projectiles.

• 4 diagonal projectiles.

• 4 cardinal projectiles.

• 8 projectiles in all directions.

• 12 projectiles in all directions.

• 8 clusters in all directions, each contains 3 projectiles.

• 10 projectiles in all directions, rotating counterclockwise.

• 10 projectiles in all directions, rotating clockwise.

• 4 diagonal projectiles.

• 4 cardinal spreads, each contains 3 projectiles.

• 4 diagonal spreads, each contains 3 projectiles.

• 8 projectiles in all directions.

• 4 diagonal spreads, each contains 5 projectiles.

• 10 projectiles in all directions.

• 8 projectiles in all directions.

• 12 projectiles in all directions.

• 12 projectiles in all directions.

• 4 cardinal projectiles.

• 4 diagonal projectiles.

• This attack ends with Hornfel getting sick and vomiting out 3 fireballs that each extend in cardinal directions upon landing.

• Teleports 3 times and throws out a short delay Brimstone Bombs Bomb each time.
OR

• Throws a Sad Bombs Bomb at their feet to create a smokescreen before rapidly teleporting to another location. This attack is repeated 5 times.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• They appear to be a conjoining of Hornfel and Loki.

• Furthering this concept is that they appear to share attacks from both bosses.

• Additionally, using Meat Cleaver against them splits them into their individual entities.

• • Hornfel as a result, is in his 2nd phase, where he cries and attempts to retreat from Isaac, similar to when Isaac breaks his minecart as a Mines boss. He is unable to leave the boss room and may even step onto the spikes present in one of the boss arenas.

• • Hornfel will only drop bomb pickups/items if Loki was killed first.

• Their name in the boss VS screen also shows a bomb and a mark, representing both bosses.

• In the Bestiary, they are referred to as "Horny Boys".

• According to Edmund, Hornfel and Loki are brothers.

• Their name may refer to the term used for being sexually aroused, being "horny".

• They are called "Horni Bois" in the game files.

The Husk.title: The Husk
The Husk.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Husk is a boss that can appear in the Catacombs.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Moves around the room like The Duke of Flies, but much faster and can perform the following attacks:

• Spawns 2 Attack Fly that orbit loosely around him, blocking shots, as well as a Spider.

• These flies, like the ones spawned by the Duke of Flies, can be killed if Isaac walks into them.

• The Husk will not use this attack if there is a total of 8 flies and spiders spawned, but can exceed the 8 limit if he spawns more flies and spiders when just under the limit.

• Fires a spray of projectiles, similar to Monstro, but with fewer projectiles.

• Fires blood shots in 8 directions and spreads the flies orbiting him outwards, freeing them to chase Isaac.

• Unlike the Duke, the Husk can perform this attack at any time without any required amount of orbiting Attack Flies.

• Upon death, all orbiting flies will be free to chase Isaac.

• [Repentance] Spawns a 6-8 random Fly, Attack Flies, and Pooters upon death.

sections.heading: Champion Versions
sections.text:
[bc: 18] : 15% larger with 56% more HP (234). He moves slower and spawns Boom Fly instead of Spiders and Attack Flies. The explosions from the Boom Flies can damage the Husk. Spawns 1-2 additional Boom Flies upon death.
[bc: 1] : 25% smaller and faster. Rather than spawning enemies, he only fires his ring of eight blood shots. Spawns 1-2 additional Red Boom Fly upon death.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Husk was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• He is the posthumous version of the Duke of Flies, more decayed, no longer having any limbs and now also being infested with spiders.

• In his boss art, the Husk has some missing teeth in his mouth, but in-game, he has extra teeth.

• [Before Repentance] The Husk resembles Pestilence's head.

• The shell worn by Min-Min bears a striking resemblance to the Husk, and it was confirmed by Edmund that it is indeed him.

The Inner Eye.title: The Inner Eye
The Inner Eye.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac fires a spread of three tears at once.

• [Before Repentance] Tears down: (Delay * 2.1) + 3

• [Repentance] Tears fired per second * 0.51.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The maximum number of tears per volley that can be reached by combining and/or duplicating 20/20, The Inner Eye, Mutant Spider and The Wiz is 16. Additional inner eyes widen the spread of the 16 tears up to a semicircle around isaac.

• [Repentance+] The Inner Eye's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [edition anr] 20/20: Shoots 5 tears with no further decrease in fire rate. 

• [Repentance] Removes the fire rate penalty while reducing damage to 80%. Additional copies will add one additional tear with no further change to damage/fire rate.

• Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb The Inner Eye it creates three locusts instead of one.

• Cursed Eye: At full charge, fires 3 rows of 4 tears, resulting in 12 tears.

• [Repentance] At full charge, fires 3 rows of 5 tears, resulting in 15 tears.

• Doctor's Remote / Epic Fetus: Replaces the single missile strike with a barrage of three consecutive missiles.

• The Inner Eye: Effects stack, resulting in 6 tears being shot with no further decrease in fire rate.

• [Repentance] Adds an additional tear with no further decrease in fire rate. This can be stacked up to 16 tears. 

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear gains two orbiting tears.

• Mom's Knife: 3 knives are fired.

• [edition anr] Mutant Spider: Shoots 7 tears instead of 3. No further decrease in fire rate.

• [Repentance] Shoots 5 tears instead of 3. Decreases fire rate by a little.

• Polyphemus: Tear rate is not lowered further. Damage is increased by a flat +5 instead of a normal Polyphemus boost.

• [Repentance] Damage is increased by a flat +5 instead of a normal Polyphemus boost. Decreases fire rate by a little.

• Tractor Beam: All tears are fired along the beam, but some may be hard to see as they overlap each other.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 20/20: Overridden by The Inner Eye.

• Brimstone: Fires 3 beams. Affects Azazel's short-ranged Brimstone similarly.

• The Forgotten: Triples bones thrown and swung. Significant decrease in fire rate.

• Keeper: Fires 6 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.

• [Repentance] Fires 4 tears with significantly decreased fire rate.

• Tainted Keeper: Only fires 5 tears in the volley, while still gaining significantly decreased fire rate.

• Kidney Stone: Increase number of tears in tear barrage; however, only fires one stone.

• Lead Pencil: The barrage will activate as normal but Isaac will sometimes fire red tears.

• Loki's Horns: Only occasionally fires one tear in the other three directions.

• Mom's Eye: Only occasionally fires one tear out of the back of Isaac's head.

• Mutant Spider: Overrides The Inner Eye.

• Monstro's Lung: Adds 5 tears to barrage with a significant decrease in fire rate.

• Sad Bombs: Does not affect the number of tears when bombs explode.

• Technology 2: The laser is not affected by The Inner Eye.

• Varicose Veins: No effect on number of tears when taking damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Inner Eye is a reference to the concept of the 'third eye', an idea popular in Eastern mysticism dictating the existence of an invisible third eye usually located on a person's forehead which would allow them to see beyond normal reality.

• [Repentance] The eye on ???'s head appears as an X, similar to this character's other eyes

The Intruder.title: The Intruder
The Intruder.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a spider familiar that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.

• The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.

• These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.

• Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning friendly spiders, and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.

• The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.

• The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 luck.

• The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Intruder is treated as a familiar even while in Isaac's head, and benefits from familiar synergies while in it.

• If The Intruder is released after The Pinking Shears are used, control is given back to an invisible head with only a shadow visible. This is due to both the head (the spider) and the body being mobilized to attack.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: The shots are homing even while in Isaac's head.

• Box of Friends: Doubles the number of tears fired from Isaac's head (if both copies fire at the same time, the tears will stack perfectly so it can be difficult to tell). If The Intruder is released, then interacts normally and spawns a copy.

• Hive Mind: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage.

• BFFS!: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage. Does not stack with Hive Mind.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel: The Intruder's tears come from Azazel while charging his Brimstone.

• Guillotine: The Intruder's tears come from Isaac's body.

• Lilith: The Intruder's tears come from Lilith, despite her blindfold.

• Sacrificial Altar: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while in Isaac's head.

• Transcendence: When The Intruder is released, only Isaac's shadow will be visible.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Intruder is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, once the item was picked up it could not be rerolled.

fields.description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.

The Jar.title: The Jar
The Jar.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac can store up to 4 extra Red Hearts in The Jar if there are no remaining empty Heart Containers.

• When used, all Red Hearts in the jar are dropped on the floor, rather than directly consuming them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Red hearts are the only type of heart that can be stored. Blended Hearts do not count.

• If used in Super Secret Rooms that can only spawn a specific type of heart, it will spawn those types of hearts instead.

• If a whole red heart is picked up and Isaac only heals half a heart container, the other half is placed in the jar, indicated by the jar number increasing by one. Despite the jar indicating that it picked up a whole red heart in this fashion, it will only drop half a red heart on use. When picking up a double red heart, the jar will also store the remainder not healed in the same way.

• Co-op babies, except Magnet Baby, cannot add hearts to the jar, as they are unable to interact with pickups.

• The short-lived half red hearts dropped by Tainted Magdalene can be picked up and stored.

• [Repentance] The item only costs 10 cents when found in a Shop.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Belial interaction: Instead of dropping hearts on the floor, using The Jar consumes up to one full heart in the jar at a time, giving a temporary +0.66 damage up for each half heart consumed and spawning a puddle of red creep that deals 2 damage per tick (20 damage per second).

• Book of Virtues interaction: Consumes stored hearts to spawn heart wisps, rather than releasing heart pickups. Heart wisps have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart when destroyed.

• [Before Repentance] Humbleing Bundle / Maggy's Bow: Spawn double the hearts put into the jar, allowing for infinite health to be spawned.

• Mom's Locket: Any half red hearts stored by The Jar will be converted to full hearts when dropped on the ground. Since The Jar will store any leftover health from healing Red Heart Containers, this can allow for potentially infinite health when healing half-empty containers. Especially effective in conjunction with Cancer or The Wafer.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Broken Remote: Allows for teleportation with no recharge; however, it drops the contained red hearts in the room it was used.

• Car Battery: The Jar acts as usual, and doesn't double the hearts dropped upon activation.

• Schoolbag: The player cannot pick up extra hearts while The Jar is in the inactive slot.

• Shard of Glass: Storing a heart in the jar without healing does not stop the bleeding effect, despite playing the "heart collected" sound effect.

• Keeper/Tainted Keeper: Hearts of any type turn into Blue Flies upon spawning, rendering the item useless.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Jar is a reference to the Empty Bottles of The Legend of Zelda, which The Binding of Isaac takes heavy inspiration from. In Zelda, empty bottles are recurring items that are used to store a variety of items; this includes life-restoring items such as potions or fairies, which The Jar mirrors by allowing the storage of red hearts.

• The Jar may also be a reference to an early 2010s internet meme by the same name, which included storing characters in jars.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] With Booster Pack #5, the item sprite now accurately shows the amount of hearts contained within the jar, alongside sporting a heart-shaped blood stain to make it easily distinguishable from Jar of Flies. This is based on this Steam Workshop mod by O_o.

The Ladder.title: The Ladder
The Ladder.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Allows Isaac to walk across gaps one square across by automatically placing a ladder between the two walkable sections. Enemies can not walk over the ladder.

• Jacob and Esau: both characters can walk over the ladder, but only the character with the item can place it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the Ladder in The Legend of Zelda for the NES.

• This item is used in I RULE!.

• This item can be found as one of the Nintendo-themed Treasure Room items in the 6th of December's Daily Run, which is an homage to the late CEO of Nintendo, Satoru Iwata.

sections.heading: Bug
sections.text:
Bug note: In co-op, fellow players can stand on the ladder. If they do this and the player holding the item walks to another ledge, the ladder beneath player 2 will disappear, allowing him to walk on air.
Bug note: The placed Ladder can trigger Ipecac + lasers explosions.
