Mom's Knife.title: Mom's Knife
Mom's Knife.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears are replaced by a knife that pierces enemies and can travel through obstacles. Holding down the fire button increases its range and power.

• The knife deals damage 20 times per second upon contact with enemies while Isaac is holding it.

• [Before Repentance] The knife deals 2× Isaac's damage while held and 6× damage at the furthest possible point of its throw distance, regardless of the actual maximum range stat.

• [Repentance] Damage dealt by the knife depends on its charge state. The knife deals 2× Isaac's damage when held and 6× damage at about 1/3 of full charge. The knife damage quickly drops to 2× Isaac's damage when returning regardless of charge state. Further charging only increases its maximum range.

• Contributes to the Yes Mother? transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife is a special item.

• [Before Repentance] The knife can be held and fired diagonally with frame perfect input. This can be done easily with a controller's analog stick or with Analog Stick.

• [Repentance] The knife can be held and fired diagonally as if Isaac was holding Analog Stick.

• The knife can be fired in any direction if using mouse controls (enabled in options.ini). [end edition note] 

• The knife will not work in challenges with the blindfolded effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20 / Conjoined / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Isaac holds only one, but shoots multiple knives at their typical spread.

• [Repentance] Apple! / Tough Love: The knife deals increased damage sometimes based on luck. [end edition note] 

• Brimstone / Sulfur: Shooting the knife also shoots a barrage of knives that goes across the screen, with each knife doing 80% ( [Repentance] 2×) of Isaac's damage; the extra knives do not return. The longer the charge, the more knives are added. This effect does not work with Azazel's default mini brimstone. The brimstone-knives do not benefit from A Lump of Coal.

• Compound Fracture: The knife creates bone shards while in contact with an enemy.

• C Section: Fetuses hold small knives that spin around them slowly, causing extra damage.

• Diplopia / Crooked Penny: Each additional copy of the item will grant an extra knife that fires slightly diagonally from the original one, up to a maximum of 16. Picking up more than 16 knives won't fire more knives but will still modify the angle at which they're shot.

• Epic Fetus: Each explosion shoots 10 knives in a circle from the point of impact.

• [Repentance] Euthanasia / Little Horn: The knife can sometimes instantly kill enemies or deal extra damage to bosses. [end edition note] 

• Eye Sore: Will occasionally release 1-3 extra knives when shooting Mom's knife.

• Fire Mind: Still applies burning, but no longer explodes.

• Flat Stone: Knife bounces as it flies away from Isaac, each bounce causing Isaac's tear damage.

• Fruit Cake: The benefits of Fruit Cake still occur, but are short-lived due to the high damage of Mom's Knife.

• The Forgotten: +4 damage. The knife will attach to The Forgotten's bone club, forming a scythe. Increases the size of both the melee swing and the bone throw, and allows a single melee swing to deal damage to an enemy twice instead of just once.

• Ghost Pepper: The flames can shoot from Isaac while holding the fire button.

• [Repentance] The flames only shoot when the fire button is released.

• [Before Repentance] Guppy: Knife hits will rarely spawn a blue fly.

• [Repentance] Knife hits will frequently spawn a blue fly.

• Holy Light: Holy Light can trigger on both held and thrown knives.

• Ipecac: Knife turns green and poisons monsters that hit it. Removes Ipecac's damage increase.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Adds a flat +4 damage instead of Ipecac's +40. Knife turns green and poison monsters that hit it.

• [Repentance] Adds a flat +2 damage and the knife explodes on contact, once per throw. Will not explode while held without throwing and while coming back to the Player after being thrown. Knife turns green and poison monsters that hit it.

• • [Repentance] Ipecac + Technology: Not recommended. Isaac will always take explosion damage when throwing the knife.

• Invulnerability: Even though the knife cannot be fired, the knife will deal damage while Isaac is invincible.

• Jacob's Ladder: The knife will sometimes generate sparks when hitting an enemy.

• Lost Contact: The knife will block bullets, even when held (similar to Trinity Shield but has a smaller blocking area).

• The Ludovico Technique: Isaac controls a floating knife that does 2× Isaac's damage. Tears stat is ignored and damage is dealt at a rate equivalent of 5 tear delay.

• The Ludovico Technique + any multi-shot item: Isaac controls a floating knife surrounded by additional rotating knives.

• • Losing The Ludovico Technique will leave the additional knives, which are no longer controlled and appear in the same spot in every room.

• [Before Repentance] The Ludovico Technique + Lost Contact: Floating knife loses almost all ability to block bullets, with a tiny area around the hilt that can stop shots.

• The Ludovico Technique + Loki's Horns: Loses Loki's Horns effect; Isaac controls only one floating knife.

• The Ludovico Technique + Brimstone: Mom's Knife overrides Brimstone, leaving only the floating knife.

• Marked: The knife fires in the direction of the crosshair, charging automatically, with charging time proportionate to the distance of the crosshair from Isaac.

• Mom's Eye: Another knife is permanently behind Isaac, able to deal contact damage. The chance to fire the rear knife is still affected by luck as usual.

• Mom's Knife: Isaac shoots one extra knife per additional copy of the item in a spread pattern.

• Monstro's Lung: Firing a knife causes several other knives to shoot out in random directions.

• Mysterious Liquid: The knife leaves creep trails while fired.

• The Parasite: The knife fires two knives in perpendicular directions from the first point of contact with an enemy. Additional knives can also fire more knives themselves.

• The Parasite + Technology: Lasers will also split with the knives.

• Pause: Mom's Knife will not stop the pause effect, allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.

• Proptosis: The Knife deals double damage regardless of range.

• [Repentance] The Knife deals triple damage regardless of range.

• Spirit Sword: Allows the spirit sword to be thrown during charged attacks.

• Strange Attractor: Enemies are pulled towards the knife. The effect is minor while not firing and much stronger while the knife is launched.

• Tainted Lilith: Her familiar will carry the knife. When firing once, Gello will not return back to Lilith, instead hanging around stationary. She can drag him around the room and the knife will still deal damage. Pressing any fire button again will whip out Gello, just as normal.

• Technology Both the knife and the laser fire normally.

• [Repentance] There is a connecting laser between Isaac and the knife, similar to The Forgotten's club throw.

• Tech X: Both fire normally.

• [Repentance] The knife is fired with a Tech X ring around it, similarly to The Forgotten's club throw.

• The Wiz: Isaac holds two knives. Knives are shot diagonally.

Other interactions:

• [Before Repentance] Chocolate Milk: Doesn't increase damage, but reduces Isaac's tear delay by 20%. [end edition note] 

• Epic Fetus: Overridden by Epic Fetus. [end edition note] 

• Guillotine: The knife is fired from the body, not from the head.

• Haemolacria: Both apply normally; the tears down negatively affects Mom's Knife's charge time.

• Isaac's Tears:

• [Before Afterbirth+] The item fires normal tears, although it will charge nearly instantly while the attack charges.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Fires normal tears. Charges at the same rate as Isaac's fire rate while charging Mom's Knife.

• [Repentance] Fires normal tears. Charges when firing Mom's Knife.

• Saturnus: No effect for orbiting tears.

• Tammy's Head: Fires 10 knives in a circle around Isaac, doesn't add Tammy's Head's flat damage bonus.

• Tiny Planet: The knife goes in a spiral around Isaac; the longer the knife is charged, the bigger the spiral. [Before Repentance] Not recommended, as this makes Mom's Knife almost impossible to aim.

• [Repentance] Launched knife will orbit Isaac incredibly fast with a much larger hitbox, dealing consistent damage and covering every side of Isaac.

• Items that fire knives out in a straight line, like Brimstone or Monstro's Lung, will cause the knives to circle around Isaac once, then shoot out in the intended direction in a straight line.

• Tractor Beam: The knife will snap to whichever direction Isaac is firing in after it's thrown. However, it can no longer be fired diagonally.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in I RULE!.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, buying the item from the Devil Room cost 1 Red Heart container instead of 2.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, this item gave Isaac the appearance of his mother in her dress.

• The description of the item is a possible reference to one of the Sniper's dialogue when performing the Huntsman taunt in Team Fortress 2.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Tiny Planet and Homing tears may cause a visual bug when there is a high range. This makes it look like the knife is going in circles when it's not rotating around the body.
Bug note: With Tiny Planet, if Isaac releases the knife and exits the room before it returns to him, the knife will receive a significantly larger hitbox that scales with Isaac's Range. Releasing it and waiting until it returns will make it normal again.
Bug note: Using Mom's Knife and Marked with Haemolacria will cause the latter to only fire towards the center of room. Using the fire buttons will barely move the Marked crosshair, while Mom's Knife will be unusable and locked to the right.
Bug note: The Blindfolded condition also applies to the knives fired by Tammy's Head, and prevents it from working.

Mom's Locket.title: Mom's Locket
Mom's Locket.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Friendship Necklace]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a Half Red Heart each time a Key is used to unlock a door, Locked Chest, or key block.

• Turns Half Red Heart pickups into Red Hearts. Half hearts already on the ground will also be upgraded upon re-entering the room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Having Mom's Locket while playing Keeper or Tainted Keeper will restore a full health coin when a key is used.

• Donating keys to a Key Master won't heal Isaac.

• A very useful trinket for unlocking the It's the Key achievement, in which Isaac cannot pick up coins, bombs, and most importantly, hearts.

• Tainted Bethany is granted a blood charge upon using a key.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Equality!: As long as Equality is active, all red hearts will be double.

• Humbleing Bundle: Humbleing Bundle cannot alter half red hearts, but Mom's Locket turns them into full red hearts, which it can double.

• Hypercoagulation / Soul of Magdalene / Tainted Magdalene: Created temporary half hearts are now full red hearts.

• Birthright + Tainted Eve: Blood clots drop full hearts rather than half hearts, making it possible to infinitely make two for one.

• The Jar: Any half red hearts stored by The Jar will be converted to full hearts when dropped on the ground. Since The Jar will store any leftover health from healing Red Heart Containers, this can allow for potentially infinite health when healing half-empty containers. Especially effective in conjunction with Cancer or The Wafer.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either now grants a Red Heart when using a key. Having both grants 1 and a half heart.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Golden Key / Pay To Play / Paper Clip / Blue Key: Renders Mom's Locket less effective, as the trinket requires a key to be consumed by the lock in order to heal Isaac.

sections.heading: Bugs

Mom's Perfume.title: Mom's Perfume
Mom's Perfume.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a chance to shoot fear tears.

• [Before Repentance] [tear delay down: 1] 

• [Repentance] +0.5 fire rate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth+ onward] This item has a 1% chance to spawn when bombing Mom's Dressing Table. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method. [end edition note] 

• Fear tear effect depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \frac{15}{100 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}

• At base luck (0), the chance is 15%, maxing out at 100% at 85 luck.

• Dark Matter is significantly better at inflicting fear than Mom's Perfume.

sections.heading: Synergies

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear flickers yellow, capable of inflicting fear when it does.

sections.heading: Interactions

Mom's Razor.title: Mom's Razor

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the passive item; other uses; Mom (Disambiguation)]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants a razor familiar that orbits Isaac. Enemies that touch the razor take damage equal to 20% of Isaac's tear damage per tick or 300% of Isaac's damage per second ( [Repentance] 150% of Isaac's damage per second) and start to bleed.

• [Before Repentance] Bleeding enemies take damage equal to 10% of their maximum health every 5 seconds. Bosses cannot bleed and won't take any damage from the razor.

• [Repentance] Bleeding enemies repeatedly take 2.8 + (floor * 0.3) damage based on how quickly they move; the faster the enemy, the more damage they take. While moving, a bleeding enemy leaves behind red creep that can damage other enemies.

• [Before Repentance] The razor does not block enemy shots.

• [Repentance] The razor blocks enemy shots.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Before Repentance] It may not always be a good idea to take Mom's Razor if Isaac has one or more Pretty Flies as orbitals, as Mom's Razor can override Pretty Flies without giving protection from enemy shots.

sections.heading: Synergies

• Contributes to the Yes Mother? transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • If no Runes or Soul Stones have been unlocked, it does not drop anything.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mom's Ring has the highest item ID of all items in the vanilla game.

• Consequently, this item is impossible to obtain by the use of Spindown Dice, as there is no item with a higher ID than it without mods.

fields.description: +1 Damage. Drops a random Rune or Soul Stone upon pickup.

Mom's Shovel.title: Mom's Shovel
Mom's Shovel.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: It is obtained by collecting the Broken Shovel 1 and the Broken Shovel 2.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon activation, creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor or to a Crawl Space, identical to We Need To Go Deeper!.

• Using this on a dirt patch that appears in Grave Rooms in Dark Room will unlock The Forgotten.

• Once the Forgotten is unlocked, digging into dirt patches will instead spawn a random type of Chest.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Yes Mother? transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• It is possible to unlock The Forgotten even if The Negative has not yet been unlocked by teleporting straight to the dark room via a Sacrifice Room.

• Does nothing when used on ???, Sheol, Cathedral, Dark Room (except in a Grave Room), Chest, The Void, or Home.

• Once Mom's Shovel is complete, the stomping caused by Broken Shovel 1 stops.

• Unlike the Broken Shovel, Mom's Shovel will not disappear if it is left on a pedestal, and Isaac leaves and re-enters the room it was left in.

• Like We Need To Go Deeper!, this item can be used to destroy rocks if used while Isaac is flying over a rock.

• [Repentance] This item can be obtained by using Spindown Dice on Mucormycosis without obtaining the Broken Shovels. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] The full Mom's Shovel can be found within the area of Death Certificate. Even without unlocking the item, its effect can potentially be activated by Metronome. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Creates two wisps on the middle ring: one looks like The Forgotten, which has increased HP but does not fire tears, and the other looks like The Soul, which fires tears that have a 10% chance of invoking II - The High Priestess on enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: In most cases, no extra effect. When used near the entrances to a room, the item can occasionally open 2 trapdoors at once, [Before Repentance] increasing the chance of opening a Crawl Space.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Forgotten, Bone Heart]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item could be a reference to Ending 20, where Isaac is found dead inside the chest being nothing but skeletal remains, and this item was what Mom used to bury Isaac underground.

• This is seen in The Forgotten Update trailer, where Mom is burying Isaac's remains, along with The Gamekid, and possibly other items he had with him.

fields.description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks The Forgotten when used on a mound of dirt that appears in Dark Room.

Mom's Toenail.title: Mom's Toenail
Mom's Toenail.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] Mom's foot periodically comes down.

• [Before Repentance] The foot stomps every full minute (based on the in-game timer).

• [Repentance] The foot stomps every 20 seconds (based on the in-game timer).

• The foot deals 300 damage.

• [Repentance+] During combat, dropping this trinket will cause Mom's foot to stomp on its location.

• The foot also hurts Isaac for a full heart.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [edition rnr+] Golden Trinket/Mom's Box: Each copy lowers the time between stomps. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] Adds 1 more foot stomp per stack. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] As the foot counts as an explosion, the damage can be avoided with Pyromaniac or Host Hat.

• Unlike the foot spawned by II - The High Priestess or Mom's Shovel, this foot doesn't target enemies nor Isaac.

• The impact can open doors, including Secret Room entrances.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Because the position Mom's foot targets is random, it can land in the empty area of an L-shaped room.
Bug note: Mom's Toenail will not contribute to the Yes Mother? transformation nor unlocking Mom's Contacts despite having the item tag.

fields.name: Mom's Toenail
fields.description: [Before Repentance+] Once [Before Repentance] a minute / [Repentance] every 20 seconds, Mom's foot randomly stomps down somewhere in the room. [Repentance+] During combat, dropping this trinket will cause Mom's foot to stomp on its location.

Sack of Pennies.title: Sack of Pennies
Sack of Pennies.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that drops a Penny every 2 rooms.

• The first drop happens after 1 room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Sack of Pennies having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • BFFS!: The familiar drops coins in a repeating pattern of 1, 2, 2 then 2 rooms.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in PAY TO PLAY.

• This item is the coin counterpart to Bomb Bag, Rune Bag, Mystery Sack, and Sack of Sacks.

fields.name: Sack of Pennies
fields.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Penny every 2 rooms.

Sack of Sacks.title: Sack of Sacks
Sack of Sacks.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and drops a Grab Bag once every few rooms cleared.

• [Before Repentance] The rate alternates between every 5 or 6 rooms.

• [Repentance] The rate alternates between every 7 or 8 rooms.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Sack of Sacks having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] BFFS!: The drop rate is improved to every 4-5 rooms.

• [Repentance] The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: This item is the Grab Bag counterpart to the Sack of Pennies, Rune Bag, Mystery Sack, and Bomb Bag.

fields.name: Sack of Sacks
fields.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Grab Bag every few rooms cleared.

Sacred Heart.title: Sacred Heart
Sacred Heart.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Immaculate Heart; Sacred Orb]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one Red Heart Container and replenishes all health.

• x2.3 damage multiplier.

• +1 flat damage.

• -0.4 tears.

• -0.25 shot speed.

• [Before Repentance] +0.75 tear falling speed.

• [Before Repentance] +4.125 range.

• Grants homing tears.

• [Before Repentance] Grants homing bombs (the effect of Bobby-Bomb).

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Sacred Heart is a special item.

• Sacred Heart has the highest damage multiplier of all passive items.

• The flat damage gained by Sacred Heart is not affected by its damage multiplier. However, other flat damage upgrades (such as those gained by Curved Horn or Void) will be affected normally.

• [Before Repentance] Although Sacred Heart increases range, the reduction of shot speed results in a slight decrease in effective range, not accounting for homing.

• [Repentance] This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight Eternal Hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Tears will track enemies while frozen in place, once one gets close enough.

• Sacred Heart: Picking up multiple copies of the item will only result in acquiring additional heart containers, while decreasing fire rate and shot speed.

• Tainted Bethany: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Sacred Heart (also known as the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus) is a devotion practiced in Catholicism, which represents "the heart of Jesus Christ God, pierced on the cross", and God's "boundless and passionate love for mankind".

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Adds a Red Heart Container. Grants homing tears, a x2.3 Damage multiplier, +1 flat Damage, -0.4 Tears, -0.25 Shot Speed, and +4.125 Range.
[Repentance] Adds a Red Heart Container. Grants homing tears, a x2.3 Damage multiplier, +1 flat Damage, -0.4 Tears, and -0.25 Shot Speed. [end edition note]

Sacred Orb.title: Sacred Orb
Sacred Orb.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Sacred Heart]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Prevents low-quality items from appearing, greatly increasing the quality of items received from all item pools.

• Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.

• Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.

• Quest items cannot be rerolled.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Due to being quality 0, Skatole cannot be obtained from Shell Games after Sacred Orb has been picked up.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bag of Crafting: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

• Binge Eater: The food item is not re-rolled.

• Death Certificate: Death Certificate's item generation ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

• Dice Bag: The one-time-use dice given by this trinket are not affected.

• Expansion Pack: The random effects generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.

• Genesis: If obtained from one of the Genesis room pedestals, no effect on future pedestals spawned in the room. Will function normally upon leaving.

• Lemegeton: Generated items are affected by Sacred Orb.

• Modeling Clay: Temporary items generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.

• Sacred Orb: Additional copies of this item provide no benefit. The chance of quality 2 items being rerolled does not increase.

• Spindown Dice: Spindown Dice ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The design of the Sacred Orb seems to be based upon a globus cruciger, lit. "cross-bearing orb", a Christian symbol of authority.

• This item is a stronger version of Tainted Lost's "better items" mechanic. Its unlock method is unusual, as most other tainted characters have items based on their unique mechanics unlocked by defeating Delirium instead of The Beast.

fields.description: Prevents items of quality 0-1 from appearing, and items of quality 2 from appearing 33% of the time. Quest items are unaffected.

Sacrificial Altar.title: Sacrificial Altar
Sacrificial Altar.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed.

• The order in which the familiars were obtained does not matter; it picks 2 at random to sacrifice.

• Any Blue Flies, Blue Spiders, Locusts, Clots, Dips, or Minisaacs will be converted to 1 Penny each.

• Wisps will be turned into Half Red Hearts each, and Item Wisps will be turned into Half Soul Hearts.

• The list of possible item rewards include:

• If Isaac already has all of the above items, copies of Pentagram will replace any further items spawned.

• On use, causes a brief [cu: darkness] effect for a few seconds.

• If Isaac has no familiars of any kind, including any temporary familiars, the item will do nothing and will not be consumed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If playing as Lilith, the Incubus familiar cannot be sacrificed.

• Other starting familiars, such as those granted by Eden's Blessing or a challenge, can be sacrificed as normal.

• Charmed and friendly enemies cannot be sacrificed.

• Any Pretty Flies are counted as a single sacrifice.

• Familiars spawned from Trinkets like Isaac's Head can be sacrificed, destroying the trinket in the process.

• [Repentance] Upon use may remove Transformations.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Berkano: Locust summoned for the room can be sacrificed as regular Abyss locust, allowing to use the item even if no familiars have been yet obtained.

• Book of Belial interaction: Grants +10.8 temporary damage up for every sacrificed familiar. The damage bonus scales down to 0 over time, similarly to Red Stew. Sacrificing blue flies or blue spiders has no special effect.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Converts each wisp into a Half Red Heart. Spawns a single red and black wisp in the middle ring after the sacrifice.

• Brown Nugget: Spawned fly turrets count as familiars for sacrificing; although dropping the Brown Nugget will despawn the last fly turret, older ones will remain and can be sacrificed.

• [Repentance] Spawned fly turrets count as regular blue flies for sacrificing, and thus are converted to pennies.

• Cambion Conception / Immaculate Conception: Familiars can be sacrificed without consuming the item. The sacrificed familiars will also respawn upon entering a room.

• Guardian Angel / Seraphim / Sworn Protector: 2 Black Hearts will also drop.

• Isaac's Heart: Can remove the Isaac's Heart familiar while the item remains, making Isaac invulnerable.

• Lemegeton: Created familiars can be sacrificed. Additionally, converts each wisp into a Half Soul Heart. The passive item effects granted by the familiars is retained for the duration of the floor.

• Plum Flute: Using Plum Flute, then using Sacrificial Altar will remove the Baby Plum spawned and spawn an item. The Plum Flute is not removed upon doing this, and subsequent usage of Plum Flute still summons Baby Plum normally.

• Quints: The item will be lost only if Isaac has at least 1 spawned familiar in the room used, and each spawned familiar counts as one sacrifice. If Quints is sacrificed first (or is the only item available to sacrifice) and at least two familiars are summoned, two Devil Room items will be spawned while only losing one item.

• Void: When absorbed by Void, the one time use no longer applies, unlike other one time use active items. Familiars can be sacrificed with every activation of Void.

• [Repentance] Pretty Fly Horse Pill: Sacrificing the Big Fan spawned by the pill gives Isaac two Pretty Flies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 7 Seals: Cannot be sacrificed in itself, but Locusts can be sacrificed.

• [Repentance] Can now be sacrificed as usual.

• Abyss: Locusts created from Abyss are counted as familiars and can be sacrificed as normal.

• Ball of Bandages / Cube of Meat : The altar consumes the whole familiar, up to 4 cubes or balls at a time. If more than 4 are available, they count as other familiar(s) that may be separately chosen for sacrifice.

• Best Bud / Dead Bird / Eve's Bird Foot / Bird Cage: These familiars can be sacrificed only when they're active.

• Box of Friends / Monster Manual / Umbilical Cord / The Twins / Soul of Lilith: The familiars generated by these items can be sacrificed and turned into items.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Chaos: The Altar ignores the effects of Chaos, always spawning items from its usual drop pool instead of a random pool.

• [Repentance] Conjoined: The transformation will be lost if Isaac has less than three items needed after using Sacrificial Altar.

• Dirty Mind / Dingle Berry: Each Dip spawned by these items or from a Charming Poop is turned into a coin, regardless of type.

• Giant Cell: Converts all Minisaacs into one coin each.

• Halo of Flies: Both flies created by this item are counted as a single sacrifice each, due to the fact that they are counted as Pretty Flies. The item is taken away if either of the flies are sacrificed.

• The Intruder: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while it's in Isaac's head.

• Lil Delirium: Lil Delirium may be sacrificed, but the item is not removed. The familiar will return once another familiar is gained or lost, or the run is quit and resumed.

• The Pinking Shears: Body familiars that are spawned by this item can be sacrificed by switching between the Pinking Shears and Sacrificial Altar. [Before Repentance] However, the body familiars reappear when picking one of the spawned items up.

• The Swarm: Each fly will be turned into a coin without consuming the item.

• Star of Bethlehem: Although not readily apparent as a familiar, the Star can be sacrificed. It will be destroyed even if it is not currently in the same room.

• Sumptorium / Lil Clot: Each Clot is turned into a coin, regardless of type. Trinket Lil Clot wont be destroyed

• Super Bum: Super Bum may be sacrificed, but none of the items will be removed. The familiar will return once another familiar is gained or lost, or the run is quit and resumed.

• [Repentance] Super Bum may be sacrificed but only one of the items will be removed.

• Vengeful Spirit: Wisps will be sacrificed for one coin each.

• Zodiac: The Gemini familiar granted by Zodiac can be sacrificed without consuming the item.

sections.heading: No effect
sections.text: The following familiars, followers, and orbitals cannot be sacrificed:

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sacrificial Altar is based on this Steam Workshop item by Niro and PJJLegend, originally known as Satanic Ritual.

• Unlike costumes from other active items, Sacrificial Altar's costume is permanent after it is used,

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: [Before Repentance] If used to sacrifice Succubus while Isaac is in its dark aura, the damage multiplier will remain active for the remainder of the floor.

fields.description: Sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.

Sacrificial Dagger.title: Sacrificial Dagger
Sacrificial Dagger.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a sideways dagger that orbits him, dealing high damage to enemies on contact and blocking enemy shots.

• [Before Repentance] The knife deals 15 damage every 1/15th of a second (every 4 frames) or 225 damage per second.

• [Repentance] The knife deals 15 damage every 2/15ths of a second (every 8 frames) or 112.5 damage per second.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The dagger orbits further away from Isaac than many other orbital familiars (minus Big Fan), making it easier to use both offensively and defensively.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Sacrificial Dagger deals the highest amount of contact damage out of all orbitals.

• [Repentance] Prior to Repentance, Sacrificial Dagger dealt the highest amount of contact damage out of all orbitals. With the changes in Repentance, it is beaten by Best Bud.

• In the original The Binding of Isaac, Sacrificial Dagger rotated upright, while in Rebirth it now orbits on its side.

• This item is used in Darkness Falls.

• While the in-game name and Steam achievement name says 'Sacrificial Dagger', when unlocked, the in-game text shows 'Sacrificial Knife'.

• The Sacrificial Dagger's description is likely a reference to the Jewish story of Abraham's sacrifice of his son, Isaac (in what is known as the Binding of Isaac). Abraham took his son Isaac to a mountain to sacrifice his son at the command of God. Despite being commanded to do so, he knew through his faith that God would not allow his son to be sacrificed.

fields.description: Spawns a dagger orbital familiar, blocking enemy shots and dealing a high amount of damage to enemies in contact.

Sad Bombs.title: Sad Bombs
Sad Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Upon exploding, Bombs shoot 10 tears off in every direction, similar to Tammy's Head. The tears deal a flat 25 damage plus Isaac's damage and are affected by any tear modifiers Isaac has on his tears.

• Grants five bombs.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if Hornfel is killed in his second phase. [end edition note] 

• The tears generated by the bombs can push other bombs. Dropping multiple Sad Bombs is not advised since they could be pushed near you.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Tears will hover in place for a few seconds before dispersing.

• BBF/Best Friend/Bob's Brain/Bob's Rotten Head/Mr. Boom: Gains the Sad Bombs effect.

• Blood Bombs: Gives the bombs a unique visual appearance (red tears), and changes the color of the tears shot to red.

• Blood Clot: The bombs produce tears that mimic the tear last fired before explosion.

• Bomber Boy: Each explosion releases 10 tears in all directions.

• [Afterbirth onward] Brimstone: Bombs explode into Brimstone beams in all directions.

• Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Bombs explode into tears that will split.

• [edition anr] Dr. Fetus/ Epic Fetus: Fired bombs/missiles will explode into tears.

• [Repentance] Fired bombs/missiles have a chance to explode into tears. This chance scales with luck, going up to 100% at 30 luck.

• Guppy: The bomb’s tears can also generate flies.

• Haemolacria: Bombs explode into Haemolacria tears which burst into tears.

• Kamikaze!: Tears will explode after activating the item.

• Mom's Knife: Bombs explode into knives that don't return.

• Multidimensional Baby: Each tear from the bomb will be duplicated.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Red Locusts: A ring of 10 tears is shot outward upon detonation, which are affected by Isaac's tear modifiers, and deal damage equal to 15 + 0.6x, where x is Isaac's Damage.

• Scatter Bombs: All mini bombs gain the effect and deal full damage.

• [Repentance] Tears from extra explosions deal 65% of their normal damage.

• Technology: Bombs explode into Technology beams in all directions.

• Tech X: Bombs explode into Technology beams in all directions.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: Does not affect the amount of tears when bombs explode.

• [Repentance] Bomber Boy: Only the center most explosion creates 10 tears.

• Explosivo: Tear explosions are not affected by Sad Bombs.

• Ipecac: Normal Ipecac shots won't explode into tears, but placed bombs will shoot Ipecac shots in every direction.

• The Ludovico Technique/Marked: Tears that burst from bombs cannot be controlled.

• My Reflection: Tears will return to the place where the bomb exploded, not Isaac.

• Tiny Planet: Tears orbit around where the bomb exploded, not Isaac.

• Tech.5: No effect.

• [Before Repentance] Technology 2: Bombs only explode into tears with a slight damage reduction.

• [Repentance] The damage reduction is removed.

fields.description: +5 Bombs. Upon exploding, bombs shoot 10 tears around them, affected by tear modifiers.

Safety Cap.title: Safety Cap
Safety Cap.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a 10% chance of changing the room drop reward to a pill.

• Gives a 33% chance of adding a pill to the rewards from opening certain Chests, or destroying Tinted Rocks, certain Machines, and certain Beggars.

• Other than Tinted Rocks and Wooden Chests, these can only drop the pill if they drop coins, hearts, Bombs, or Keys.

• • Wooden Chests can even drop the pill in addition to an item.

• This includes: 

• This excludes:

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increases the chance of changing the room drop reward to a pill by 20% and increases the chance of adding a pill to rewards to 66%. Having both increases these chances to respectively 30% and 100%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The quote is probably a reference to the song "Don't Swallow The Cap" by The National.

fields.description: Increases the chance of pills dropping after clearing a room, and the chance of finding a pill when opening a Chest.

Safety Pin.title: Safety Pin
Safety Pin.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Pin; Push Pin]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 1 Black Heart.

• [Before Repentance] +5.25 range.

• [Repentance] +2.5 range.

• [Before Repentance] +0.5 tear falling speed.

• +0.16 shot speed.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Black Feather: Grants a damage boost.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Grants one Black Heart, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, +0.16 shot speed.
[Repentance] Grants one Black Heart, +2.5 range, +0.16 shot speed.

Safety Scissors.title: Safety Scissors
Safety Scissors.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the trinket; the item; Scissors; another similar item; The Pinking Shears]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Troll Bombs turn into Bomb pickups before they explode.

• Mega Troll Bombs turn into Double Bombs.

• Golden Troll Bombs turn into Golden Bombs.

• Giga bombs (thrown by Bombgaggers and Ultra War) turn into their respective Giga Bomb pickups.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Bombing a Bomb Bum while possessing this trinket will convert the Troll Bombs he spawns into regular Bombs. This process can be repeated indefinitely for unlimited Bomb pickups.

• These Bomb pickups can be rerolled with the D20.

• Large amounts of Bomb pickups can be farmed if used against Little Horn, War, Pride, or other Troll Bomb spawning enemies or items like Anarchist Cookbook or Curse of the Tower.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The disarming effects of the Troll Bombs will apply to Chub when she swallows it, as the Bomb pickups will come out shortly after, not damaging her.

• Does not affect Wrath's Bombs.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Super Wrath's Bombs turn into their respective pickups.

• Does not affect Big Horn's hot Bombs.

• Does not affect bombs from the Explosive Diarrhea pill.

• [Repentance] Does not affect Hornfel's Bombs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BOGO Bombs: Turns a Troll Bomb into a Double Bomb.

• Tainted ???: Bombs are converted into poop pickups.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Reduces the size of enemy explosions. Having both reduces the size of enemy explosions even more.

fields.name: Safety Scissors
fields.description: Troll Bombs turn into Bomb pickups before they explode. Mega Troll Bombs turn into Double Bombs before they explode.

Sagittarius.title: Sagittarius
Sagittarius.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.2 speed

• [Before Repentance] +0.2 maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).

• Grants piercing tears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Lost Contact: Tears will pierce right through enemy projectiles, deleting them. A very strong offensive/defensive combo.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 8 Inch Nails: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.

• Blister: Overridden by Sagittarius.

• Dr. Fetus: Bombs travel through enemies. When combined with Ipecac, bombs do not explode upon hitting enemies.

• [Repentance] Bombs also deal 2.5x Isaac's damage to enemies when passing through them.

• Pisces: Knockback overridden by Sagittarius.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Penetrative shot; Repentance: Piercing shots] + speed up
fields.description: Increases speed by +0.2 and grants piercing tears.

Salvation.title: Salvation
Salvation.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.

• When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.

• The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).

• • If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.

• Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Camo Undies: Damaging enemies with Salvation will not take away Isaac's camouflage.

• Dark Arts: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.

• Gnawed Leaf: The light beams trigger even when Isaac is a statue.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item resembles the Ichthys symbol, which was a symbol used by early Christians, and is associated with Jesus Christ.

• The halo produced by the item resembles Jesus' Crown of Thorns, and the filename for the effect's graphics is halo_thorns.png.

• Dogma and its television will have a wavy and distorted appearance while in range of Salvation.

• Salvation is especially effective against segmented bosses, as each segment can be targeted by an initial beam, and the cardinal beams deal extra damage by damaging other segments.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When Pause is used with Salvation it creates a second halo that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for the active item's duration. Moreover both halos are flashing and can not interact with enemies for the duration.

fields.description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.

Samson's Chains.title: Samson's Chains
Samson's Chains.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac's ankle that blocks projectiles and deals 5 damage per tick (~10.7 damage per second).

• If the ball is moving fast enough, it will destroy any destructible Obstacles it comes into contact with.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Despite its appearance, the item does not slow Isaac's movement.

• Can be charmed by The Siren, chaining itself to her until damaged enough to return to Isaac.

• Is ignored by Sacrificial Altar.

• Cannot be used to open Secret Rooms or Super Secret Rooms.

• Can be used to initiate the Uriel/Gabriel fight inside Angel Rooms.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Flight: Any method of flight makes it easier and quicker to use Samson's Chains to smash rocks, making for an efficient way to search for Crawl Spaces.

• Tainted Forgotten: The ball is chained to the Forgotten, giving throws additional damage and obstacle destruction. While the Forgotten is held by the Soul, the ball may be swung around as normal.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item references the biblical story of Samson, who was chained upon losing his strength.

• The item visually resembles "leg irons", devices historically used to restrain prisoners' feet.

• Furthermore, the description is the phrase stereotypically associated with older men complaining about their wives, equating their relationship to these devices.

• Samson's Chains, in both appearance and function, resembles the Punish Ball from Spelunky, with the exception of Samson's Chains not slowing down the player.

fields.name: Samson's Chains
fields.description: Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac that pulls behind him that damages enemies, blocks shots, and destroys most Obstacles.

Samson's Lock.title: Samson's Lock
Samson's Lock.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• 1/15 chance to increase damage by 0.5 for the current room each time an enemy dies.

• Samson's Lock can activate up to 10 times per room.

• The activation chance depends on the Luck stat and goes up to 100% with 10 Luck.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The effect can also be activated by destroying Shopkeepers.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Lusty Blood: Both the item and the trinket stack, granting 1 damage per kill. With 100% proc rate on the Lock, Isaac may gain up to 10 damage after 10 kills.

• Rock Bottom: Preserves the highest bonus earned between rooms.

• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 13% and having both to 25%.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t count towards the Samson's Lock counter.

• E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't count towards the Samson's Lock counter.

• [edition rnr+] Freeze Effects: Enemies that are frozen don't count towards the Samson's Lock counter.

• Because of this interaction, when Isaac has Uranus, only enemies killed by icicles from statues, bombs, familiars and other sources will increment Samson's Lock's counter, thus rendering Samson's Lock quite difficult to use. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• According to the Bible, Samson was given supernatural strength by God to fight his enemies, the Philistines, and perform heroic acts; but when he was tricked into allowing his hair to be cut by a Philistine woman named Delilah, Samson was powerless.

• This trinket is a reference to the effect of Bloody Lust (Samson's starting item) in the original game, which was later changed in Rebirth and added in Afterbirth as the item Lusty Blood.

• This trinket has the same flavor text as Red Patch.

fields.name: Samson's Lock
fields.description: 1/15 chance to gain +0.5 damage for the current room each time an enemy dies.

Sanguine Bond.title: Sanguine Bond
Sanguine Bond.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.

• Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
| Chance | Reward 
| 35% | Nothing

| 33% | + 0.5 damage

| 15% | 6 pennies

| 10% | 2 Black Hearts

| 5% | A random Devil Room item

| 2% | Transform into Leviathan

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The spikes will appear in the current Devil Room upon picking up Sanguine Bond.

• The spikes will deal damage to enemies that walk or fly over them, including Krampus.

• As Krampus often spawns in the center of the room, it will deal a significant amount of damage to him, almost killing him completely.

• The item causes all other spikes in the Devil Room to retract.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Goat Head: Allows Isaac to enter and leave the Devil Room at will, making this item substantially more powerful, as red hearts can be collected throughout the floor.

• Goat Head + Scapular: The spikes generated by Sanguine Bond can be farmed infinitely.

• • Quitting and reloading the game will also reset the soul heart regeneration provided by Scapular, thus negating the need for Goat Head.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper / Strawman: The pennies that are spawned when stepping on the spikes can be used to heal Keeper and infinitely farm rewards.

• Placenta: With a lot of time, the spikes can be farmed infinitely.

• Portable Slot: The pennies that are spawned can be gambled to give hearts, allowing more uses.

• The Wafer / Percs: Hearts will last twice as long, allowing more uses. Further uses may be obtained by sacrificing the black hearts given, and any hearts added from devil room items.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Callus: Will not prevent the damage from spikes created by Sanguine Bond.

• Flat File: Retracts the spikes. The trinket must be dropped and the Devil Deal re-entered for the spikes to appear again.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the card of the same name from Magic: the Gathering card game.

• The item description is a likely nod to the item description of Goat Head.

fields.description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

Satan.title: Satan
Satan.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Satan is the boss of Sheol, and the final boss of Ending 12.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: The battle against Satan has three distinct phases.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
The first phase starts with a slight delay after Isaac enters the room:

• Satan shouts, and roughly two seconds after Satan's voice dies out, The Fallen spawns at the center, with two Kamikaze Leech to either side.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
Once The Fallen is dead, the Devil Room statue at the top of the screen transforms into Satan's first form. He stays near the top of the room moving horizontally and performs the following attacks:

• Spits out 2 consecutive spreads of 5 and 4 projectiles towards Isaac. He chains this attack at least twice.

• If Isaac is to either side of him, he can:

• Shoot half-rings of 8 projectiles from both his hands towards the left and right sides of the room.

• If Isaac is below him, he can:

• Shoot two Brimstone lasers from his hands, that curve towards each other while leaving a gap in the middle.

• Charge up and fires a Brimstone beam from his mouth directly downwards.

If Satan is pushed too far away from the top center of the room, he will rapidly spring back to that position.

sections.heading: Phase 3
sections.text:
After depleting his entire second phase health bar and reaching half of his total HP, he flies off-screen and has one attack:

• Stomps the ground with both of his feet at Isaac's previous positions, similar to Mom's stomp attack, but with less delay. The stomps come down one after another, and after two stomps, they persist for a moment before both are retracted.

• Up to two Kamikaze Leeches continuously spawn during this phase.

• They can be killed by Satan's stomp, but will also deal considerable damage to him.

• There appears to be a maximum amount of Kamikaze Leeches that can be spawned, as they stop appearing if the fight draws out for too long and the Kamikaze Leeches are not killed.

Satan's projectiles and contact damage deal a whole heart of damage.

Once Satan is defeated, remaining Kamikaze Leeches die alongside him.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: I RULE!, Judas, The Negative, Mom's Knife, Guardian Angel, A Bag of Bombs, Judas' Tongue, Forget Me Now, The Razor, Blood Rights, Daemon's Tail, Broken Ankh, Book of Secrets, The Mind, Serpent's Kiss, Keeper holds Store Key, Locust of Pestilence, Pointy Rib, Urn of Souls, Red Stew, Godhead, Mom's Lock, Holy Crown, Gilded Key, Your Soul, Dingle Berry, Strange Key, Temporary Tattoo, Wicked Crown, Torn Pocket, Nuh Uh!, Kid's Drawing, The Twins, Keeper's Bargain, Cricket Leg, Polished Bone, Expansion Pack, RC Remote]

sections.heading: Damage Scaling
sections.text:
Damage scaling is a mechanic introduced in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth to provide a more challenging experience to players, enabling some enemies to retaliate against high damage attacks by deploying an "armor" of a sort to greatly reduce the amount of damage taken. Further details and an in-depth explanation may be found here.

[Repentance+] Satan has damage scaling.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Every time Satan is defeated, the current savefile's image changes until The Negative is unlocked.

• Defeating Satan for the 1st time will unlock Champion versions of Bosses.

• Using the The Bible or XV - The Devil? on Satan will instantly kill Isaac.

• On the third wave, Pyromaniac and/or Host Hat will be extremely useful, as Kamikaze Leeches and stomping (which is considered as an explosion) will not hurt Isaac.

• [Repentance] Stomps are no longer considered explosions and cannot have their damage negated.

• [Before Repentance] Unlike in the original Binding of Isaac, Satan's feet don't cause damage on contact for the short time they rest on the ground after a stomp, providing a window of opportunity to deal significant damage with orbitals such as Sacrificial Dagger, or activate other contact effects like Midas' Touch.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Satan appeared in the Halloween Update for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• Satan's pose as a statue and during the VS Screen is a nod to the demon Baphomet, who is usually portrayed in a similar pose.

• Satan, in mythology, began as a fallen angel but evolved over time into a greater evil. This may be the reason The Fallen spawns at the start of the fight, as well as the reason both of them have feathered wings.

• The demonic speech Satan shouts at the start of his first phase reuses one of Mom's voice lines, shouting "Isaac!" in reverse with heavy distortion.

• The music that plays during this battle is titled Hericide. Hericide is a combination of the latin word herus (or erus), meaning master or lord, and the suffix -cide, denoting the act of killing.

• This song's melody shares some similarities with that of Periculum, the Cellar theme. 

• This music also plays during the battle against Mega Satan.

• [Afterbirth onward] This music also plays during the nightmare wave of Greed Mode, for unlocking the floor's Devil Room or Angel Room.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If exactly 600 HP of damage is dealt to Satan, it will completely skip the third phase and spawn the chest, due to how the boss is coded to go to the third phase only if over 600 damage is dealt. Chaos Card also skips Satan's third phase due to this bug.
The easiest way to do this is to use only familiars to do damage, or to use 6 Bombs (without modifications) against Satan's second phase.

fields.name: Satan
fields.environment:
Boss
Sheol / 
The Void /
fields.pool:
Final Boss Chest (Ending 12, or Dark Room if Isaac has The Negative)
Gateway to The Void (15% Chance)

Satanic Bible.title: Satanic Bible
Satanic Bible.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Not to be confused with The Book of Belial.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives one Black Heart.

• [Repentance] Once used, the boss for the floor will drop a Devil Deal instead of a Boss. This item must be paid for with hearts and will prevent Angel Rooms from generating under most circumstances if taken, just like a normal Devil Deal.

• This does not affect The Polaroid, The Negative, or Dad's Note. [end edition note] 

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If taking a Deal leaves Isaac with no health remaining, he can still survive by taking the Deal and then activating Satanic Bible, which will leave him at 1 black heart. This will only work if the Deal is a passive item, as trading Satanic Bible with an active item will make you unable to use it. This does not work while picking up Satanic Bible as the devil deal.

• [Repentance] Bosses with set drops aside from Mom will still drop their normal item, but at the cost of one Heart Container. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] On XL floors, both items will become Devil Deals, even if Satanic Bible was only used once. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] The Lost, Tainted Lost, and Tainted Jacob in his ghost form can safely take any Boss Room item pedestals and it has no effect on subsequent devil deals.

• This also applies to the Lost form granted by the white fire on Downpour / Dross II. Taking a deal in this form will not remove hearts, making the player able to get at least 2 Devil Room items for free on that floor.

• This does not affect the items dropped on The Void. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Using the Satanic Bible changes the Boss Room's item pool to the Devil Room for purposes other than direct boss rewards as well. This works even if the boss does not normally drop items, such as Mom, Satan, or ???.

• Rerolls such as The D6, Perthro, or Soul of Isaac will generate Devil Room items.

• Using Satanic Bible after the Boss Room item has spawned, followed by any reroll, causes the new item to be drawn from the Devil Room item pool, but it will have no heart cost. Taking this item will not prevent Angel Rooms from spawning.

• In the The Void, the initial item spawn from a non-Delirium boss room will be from a random pool as expected, but rerolls will be drawn from the Devil Room without any heart cost. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] In True Co-op, the pedestal's additional items will also be Devil deals, but be drawn from the Boss item pool. If the Devil Deal is an active item, there will be no additional items. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance+] If the Devil Deal is an active item, the next item will spawn on a pedestal instead of being a Devil Deal. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Using Satanic Bible on Downpour / Dross II will affect the Mirrored World Boss drop. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns black wisps in the middle ring, looking like a red inverted cross. Each wisp increases the chances of Devil Room appearing by 10%.

• Converter: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. (Schoolbag required)

• Car Battery: Gives Isaac two black hearts.

• Soul of the Lost: The Devil Deal can be taken for free.

• [Repentance] There's Options: 2 Devil Deals will be offered, but only one can be taken.

• Coupon: The Devil Deal can be taken for free. Schoolbag is recommended.

• Dream Catcher: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, and the player has no interest in the Cube of Meat, or doesn't mind paying health for it, Satanic Bible can be used early.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Revelations: The spawned Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat will cost hearts like a normal devil deal.

• Chaos: The item spawned will be chosen from a random item pool instead.

• IV - The Emperor?: The extra boss room's reward is also transformed into a devil deal.

• Genesis: The boss item is still a devil deal even after using Genesis.

• Lemegeton: Will generate wisps from the Devil Room item pool when used inside the Boss Room after Satanic Bible is used.

• Redemption: Taking the boss's item when it's affected by Satanic Bible will remove the cross however the Boss Room can't give the cross.

• Vanishing Twin: The second boss spawned will also drop an item from the Devil Room item pool that must be paid for.

• Vanishing Twin + Ascent: After using Satanic Bible If an Item spawned by Vanishing Twin is not bought with hearts it can be bought with coins during the Ascent.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The original Satanic Bible was written by Anton Szandor LaVey, the founder of the Church of Satan.

fields.quote: Reusable evil [Repentance] ... but at what cost?
fields.description: Grants one Black Heart. [Repentance] Replaces the boss room item on the current floor with a Devil Deal.

Saturnus.title: Saturnus
Saturnus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.

• The tears will deal 1.5× Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.

• After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.

• Orbiting tears are spectral, although they don't visually appear to be.

• The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.

• Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.

• Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.

• Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Any new effect on tears provided by an item or a trinket won't affect ring tears until getting to a new room.

• This is the same for lost effects (e.g. by dropping a trinket).

• When using a teleporter in Mausoleum/Gehenna, the tears won't teleport and instead travel back towards the ring.

• Saturnus tears deal no damage to "grid entities", such as TNT and Poop.

• When Isaac spawns in the center of a room, or away from the door he should have entered through (for example, against Mom or Gurdy or on the first room of each floor), Saturnus' tears will spawn by the door and move towards Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• A Lump of Coal: The tears grow in size and damage as they orbit around Isaac.

• Angelic Prism: The prism and tears share the same orbit, making them easy to split.

• Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/Stye: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room.

• Having an item that randomly applies the bonus (Mom's Knife, Brimstone, Stapler, etc), will give each tear a 50% chance to have the bonus.

• Cricket's Body: The orbiting tears will split as normal, but the tears produced by the split will orbit Isaac instead of spreading out.

• Godhead: The orbiting tears have Godhead's damaging aura without the homing effect.

• Homing tears: Tears will break orbit to home into nearby enemies. With piercing, tears will return to the orbit after dealing damage.

• Kidney Stone: It's possible for one of the tears surrounding Isaac to be the stone.

• Multidimensional Baby: Because both the orbiting tears and multidimensional baby start on top of Isaac when entering a room, all of the tears are immediately doubled.

• The Parasite + piercing tears: The tears continuously create two smaller tears as they hit enemies, all of which in turn orbit and pierce enemies as well, resulting in far higher damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.

• Crown Of Light: Functions as intended, but the tears surrounding Isaac will appear normal.

• Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection/Mucormycosis: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

• Friend Finder: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.

• Hook Worm: No effect upon ring's tear.

• Ipecac: Tears surrounding Isaac will not cause self damage if at maximum distance until high tear size. If Isaac enters a room and his Saturnus tears have not spread out, they could hit an entity and cause self damage.

• Lachryphagy: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.

• Proptosis: Causes the tears to immediately fall, making Saturnus almost irrelevant. Enemy tears caught in the orbit will not fade away, and its defensive benefits helps slightly to maintain the aggressive playstyle required by Proptosis.

• Ring Worm / Ouroboros Worm: The trinkets cause the ring tears to move with a very anarchistic movement in and out of the circle.

• Sulfuric Acid / Terra: As the orbiting tears can destroy rocks, Isaac can unintentionally detonate Bomb Rocks, causing self damage.

• Tractor Beam: No effect on surrounding tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Saturnus originates from the Antibirth mod.

• Saturnus' effects reference the planet Saturn, known for its prominent ring system.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Using Glowing Hourglass will trigger the effect of Saturnus again when returning to the room that was teleported out of, doubling the tears in that room.
Bug note: When Pause is used with Saturnus, it creates a second circle that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for the active item's duration. The second circle is a visual glitch and can't hold any orbiting tears. Moreover, both circles are flashing for the duration.
Bug note: In the first room of a floor, orbiting tears will appear elsewhere in the room and then be packed in two groups orbiting Isaac, instead of appearing on Isaac and then orbiting with an equivalent distance between each. They will turn back to normal when going to another room. This also happens in Mom's room after using her bed.
Bug note: Saturnus tears affected by Trisagion deal damage to props and knock Isaac's bombs back.

fields.description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.

Sausage.title: Sausage
Sausage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Fully heals Isaac.

• Gives Isaac one Red Heart Container.

• +0.2 Speed.

• +0.5 Damage.

• +0.5 Tears.

• +2.5 Range.

• +0.16 Shot Speed.

• +1.0 Luck.

• +6.9% Devil Room / Angel Room chance.

• +6.9% Planetarium chance.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Spindown Dice: Changes Sausage into Dad's Note, which, if picked up outside of its special Mausoleum / Gehenna Boss Room, simply fades the music out and does nothing. Additionally, Dad's Note cannot be further rerolled, neither via Spindown Dice or by other means of reroll.

• Tainted Bethany: Grants 12 blood charges.

• Tainted Lazarus / Dead Tainted Lazarus: Only the increased Devil/Angel Room and Planetarium encounter chance is shared between the two forms, not the stat-ups (referring to the lazarussharedglobal item tag).

• Additional copies of this item do not increase Devil Room / Angel Room and Planetarium chance further.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sausage is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, some of the stat numbers it gave were slightly different and instead of increasing the chance for certain rooms to spawn it would increase tear height.

• Unlike all other items described as "all stats up" such as Magic Mushroom and SMB Super Fan, Sausage legitimately does increase all stats, including Luck, Shot Speed, Devil Room chance, Angel Room chance, and Planetarium chance (which none of the other "all stats up" items increase).

• The increase in Devil Deal, Angel Room and Planetarium chance, 6.9%, is a reference to how the number 69 can be used as a double entendre.

• This item's sprite, costume effect, and item pool suggest that this item is also based on the double entendre of "hide the sausage".

• In the files, the costume for Sausage is called "costume_069x_sosig.png."

• Its ID number, 669, is also a reference to how the number 69 can be used as a double entendre.

• The item's sprite also looks like saucisson, a dry-cured thick pork sausage typical of French cuisine, Kilburn's country.

• According to Kilburn (lead developer for Antibirth and Repentance), sausages are his favorite food.

fields.description: Adds a Red Heart Container, fully heals Isaac, and gives +0.2 Speed, +0.5 Damage, +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range, +0.2 Shot Speed, and +1.0 Luck. Increases the chance of encountering a Devil Room, Angel Room, and/or Planetarium each by 6.9%.

Scapular.title: Scapular
Scapular.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart (either red, soul, or black), the aura around his head temporarily vanishes and he is granted one Soul Heart.

• After re-entering a room, the ability can be triggered again.

• With Bone Hearts, the effect triggers on both half-filled and empty ones.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If the Scapular is active and Isaac is already at his last half heart, the effect won't trigger even on fatal damage.

• Tainted Samson / Berserk!: If fatal damage activates Tainted Samson's Berserk, or if it occurs during Berserk!'s effect, it will trigger and grant the soul heart.

• [Afterbirth onward] Scapular does not charge between waves in Greed mode, though it can still be recharged by moving between rooms.

• Does not work with The Lost or Keeper, as they cannot reach the required heart value.

• Reaching only half a heart remaining may be more difficult in Chapter 4 onwards, since all half-heart hits are upgraded to a full heart.

• [Repentance] Damage sources that count as "health donation" no longer activate Scapular. This includes Blood Donation Machine, Devil Beggar, Hell Game, Confessional, IV Bag, Razor Blade, Blood Rights, Dull Razor, Sharp Plug, Shard of Glass, Blood Bombs, and Blood Oath. However, Sacrifice Rooms and Curse Room spikes still activate Scapular.

• Scapular can still be exploited by alternating between donating half a heart and taking half a heart of damage from elsewhere. [end edition note] 

• Rotten Hearts cannot activate Scapular as the whole heart will be depleted by any damage source.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Kamikaze!: Damage from Kamikaze's explosions will activate Scapular, allowing Isaac to trigger on-damage effects infinitely between rooms.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Cursed Skull: Provided Scapular can always trigger, grants effective immortality, as the soul heart is always given before the teleport takes place.

• +The Wafer: Grants true immortality, plus one hit on the soul heart, allowing the player to get hit once before teleporting.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
The Scapular allows practically free use of damage-triggered effects, as long as care is taken to keep track of the item's state and remaining health, and possibly being forced to proceed with minimal health after reaching the desired goal is acceptable. The room can be left to reactivate the item at latest when only half a red heart and half a soul heart remain; usually, this necessitates performing the actions in rooms without enemies. Examples include:

• Forcing a Sacrifice Room to pay out.

• Entering and leaving a Curse Room without net loss of health.

• Fully charging the held active item with Habit by purposefully running into a hazard.

• [Before Repentance] Continuously using Sharp Plug. As Isaac cannot take soul heart damage and red heart damage on the same hit, the single soul heart absorbs two hearts worth of damage by itself.

• Using damage-triggered items that pay out with resources or items such as Fanny Pack or Cambion Conception.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: You have been blessed; Repentance: Pray for a miracle]
fields.description: Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart, he is granted one Soul Heart.

Scatter Bombs.title: Scatter Bombs
Scatter Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac's bombs split into 2-4 tiny bombs after exploding.

• [Repentance] Isaac's bombs split into 4-5 tiny bombs after exploding.

• Tiny bombs deal half damage and have decreased blast radius.

• Tiny bombs retain most of Isaac's bomb synergies.

• [Repentance] Tiny bombs explode immediately upon landing.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anarchist Cookbook/Curse of the Tower/XVI - The Tower: Not recommended. The extra bombs makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.

• [Repentance] Anarchist Cookbook: No visual change can be seen with the Troll Bombs, but the smaller bombs have the sprite of the smaller normal bombs.

• Best Friend: The explosion creates mini decoys.

• Blasting Cap: Tiny bombs can also drop bomb pickups.

• [Repentance] Blood Bombs/Bob's Curse: Area-of-Effects from extra explosions have decreased size but deal the same damage. [end edition note] 

• Bob's Rotten Head/Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Explosions are unaffected.

• Bob's Bladder: Tiny bombs will also create creep.

• Brimstone Bombs/Sad Bombs: Lasers/tears from extra explosions deal 65% of their normal damage.

• [Repentance] Butt Bombs: The room damage from extra explosions deal 6.5 damage instead of 10.

• Diplopia: No effect other than the +5 bombs.

• Dr. Fetus/Mr. Boom: Explosions are affected.

• Ghost Bombs: Extra explosions create ghosts that instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, similar to Purgatory. They each deal 2x Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.

• Glitter Bombs: Each additional explosion created has a chance to spawn a pickup or trinket.

• Hot Bombs: Extra explosions create additional fires. [Repentance] Fires from extra explosions start with 1 less durability.

• Nancy Bombs: Extra bombs will have the same bomb modifiers as the original.

• Rocket in a Jar: Rockets create normal tiny bombs when they explode.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The description "We put bombs in your bombs!" is a reference to the Xzibit "Yo Dawg" Internet meme.

fields.quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
fields.description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.
