Blessed Penny.title: Blessed Penny
Blessed Penny.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a chance to drop a Half Soul Heart when money is collected. The chance is based on the coin's worth:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 16.6%

| Double Penny | 30.5%

| Nickel | 59.7%

| Dime | 83.3%

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This trinket is very useful in Greed Mode, as the constant supply of coins helps with accumulating lots of soul hearts.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Increases the chances to:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 25.00%

| Double Penny | 40.00%

| Nickel | 70.00%

| Dime | 90.00%

• Golden Trinket + Mom's Box: Increases the chances to:

| Coin | Chance 
| Penny | 30.00%

| Double Penny | 50.00%

| Nickel | 75.00%

| Dime | 100.00%

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Blessed Penny originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Community Remix, it was named Soul Penny.

fields.description: Gives a chance to drop a Half Soul Heart when a coin is collected.

Blind Rage.title: Blind Rage
Blind Rage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Doubles the invincibility frames Isaac gets after getting hit.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] This item makes it possible to use the Blood Donation Machine twice without taking damage the second time.

• [Before Repentance] This item makes it possible to use the Devil Beggar three times without taking damage the second and third times.

• The invicibility frames also get doubled when effects such as Holy Mantle are triggered, making it very useful for The Lost.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Mom's Box / Golden Trinket / Blind Rage: Each copy adds +2 seconds of invincibility frames.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This trinket refers to Samson being blinded after revealing his weakness to Delilah.

fields.description: Increases invincibility time after getting hit.

Blister.title: Blister
Blister.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the trinket; the enemy; Blister (Enemy)]

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Increases the knockback of Isaac's tears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either further increases knockback. Having both further increases knockback again.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: • This trinket is useful against chasing enemies and enemies that explode upon death such as Mullibooms or Boom Fly.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] 8 Inch Nails / Pisces: The knockback increases are the same and do not stack.

• Brimstone: The beam pushes back enemies.

• The Ludovico Technique: The controlled tear gains knockback.

• [Repentance] : No effect.

• Mom's Box: No effect.

• Mom's Knife: The knife pushes back enemies.

• Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2: The laser pushes back enemies.

• Tech X: The knockback direction is counter-clockwise around the ring.

• [Repentance] Enemies are knocked back in the ring's fired direction.

• Revelation: The beam pushes back enemies.

• Trisagion: The blast slightly pushes back enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In real life, a blister is a small pocket of body fluid that forms within the upper layers of the skin.

fields.description: Increases knockback of tears.

Blood Bag.title: Blood Bag
Blood Bag.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one full Red Heart container.

• Restores [edition alternatives: baseline: 4; Repentance: 5] Red Hearts.

• +0.3 speed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This item can be generated multiple times by paying out multiple Blood Donation Machines.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Blood Bag seems to give Isaac a face similar to Larry Jr.

• [Repentance] This item is used in Bloody Mary, and is required to be unlocked to access the challenge. [end edition note]

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: HP up; Repentance: HP + speed up]
fields.description: Grants one filled Red Heart container, restores [Before Repentance] 4 / [Repentance] 5 Red Hearts, and increases speed by 0.3.

Blood Bombs.title: Blood Bombs
Blood Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one full Red Heart container.

• Restores 4 Red Hearts.

• Causes Isaac's Bombs to leave a pool of red creep on the ground when they explode.

• The creep deals 2 damage per tick (20 per second) and lasts 15 seconds.

• Leaves one large creep in the middle, and four small creeps on random direction and distance.

• • Multiple creeps do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.

• If Isaac has no bombs, allows him to place a bomb at the cost of taking half a heart of damage. This prioritizes Red Hearts over Soul Hearts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Placing a bomb using health counts as self-damage, and as such, does not affect the chances for a Devil deal, does not trigger Damocles, nor does it reroll Tainted Eden.

• The Lost / Tainted Lost will die if a bomb is placed this way.

• • This includes the version of The Lost you turn into after touching the white fireplace in Downpour II.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper will take 1 Coin Heart of damage in exchange for 1 bomb.

• Tainted Bethany can use 1 blood charge in exchange for 1 bomb.

• You can remain at zero bombs and leave excess drops of bombs and hearts to maximize resource use for the floor.

• Placing a bomb using health can let Isaac enter/exit a Curse Room without taking soul/black heart damage.

• But be careful and remember to move quickly upon exiting the Curse room, otherwise you'll take damage from the previous bomb.

sections.heading: Syngergies
sections.text:
• BBF/Bob's Rotten Head/Doctor's Remote/Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Bomber Boy/Scatter Bombs: Leaves a pool of red creep on the ground after each explosion.

• Pyromaniac: Potentially allows for infinite bombs and self-damage if Isaac has red health, since he can heal himself with the bomb he just placed.

• Creeps from following items can inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously:

• Holy Water

• IBS

• Lemon Party

• Lil Spewer

• Mysterious Liquid

• Toxic Shock

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Creeps from following items do not inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously:

• Anemic

• Aquarius (overrides the damage)

• Bob's Bladder (overrides the damage)

• Depression

• Isaac's Heart

• The Scooper

• Shard of Glass

• Lost Cork: Does not increase the radius of creeps.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Blood Bombs originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Blood Bombs would only heal four hearts and the creep would not be produced if the bomb was eaten by bosses like Chub.

• This is the only bomb-augmenting item that does not give any Bombs on pickup.

• The fact that the item gives a heart container and healing instead of bombs may be a hint for the mechanic of using health for bombs, as well as a substitute for actual bombs.

• The fact that the item heals 5 hearts may be a reference to many bomb effect items (such as Butt Bombs) that gives Isaac 5 bombs.

• The fact that the item gives a heart container and heals up to exactly 5 containers, along with the appearance, makes it very similar to Blood Bag.

• A Blood Donation Machine will be shown as a cause of death on Isaac's last will if he dies as a result of placing a bomb and losing all health.

fields.description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.

Blood Clot.title: Blood Clot
Blood Clot.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish: Lil Clot]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
The following stats are applied to tears from Isaac's left eye only.

• +1 flat damage.

• [edition alternatives: baseline: +5; Repentance: +2.75] range.

• [Before Repentance] +0.5 tear falling speed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can rarely drop from destroying polyps ( [Repentance] outside of Corpse).

• The damage bonus is unaffected by both positive and negative damage multipliers.

• Azazel has a chance to fire a beam with the damage bonus. His range is unaffected.

• Cain has a 50% chance of firing a shot with the effects of Blood Clot whenever he fires since he can only shoot from his right eye.

• The Forgotten has a chance for Blood Clot effects to apply to his melee or ranged attack. When Blood Clot effects are applied the bone will turn red. When throwing the bone club, his range seems to be unaffected.

• [Afterbirth onward] Every other set of tears Keeper fires contains the Blood Clot effect. [end edition note] 

• Chemical Peel applies to the same eye and the effects stack.

• Generally, every interaction and synergy that applies to Blood Clot also applies to Chemical Peel. See its page for a full list, with only differences listed here.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Almond Milk/Soy Milk: The damage of Blood Clot is unaffected by the damage multiplier, significantly increasing DPS.

• Dr. Fetus: Turns all bombs red and increases their damage.

• Epic Fetus: Missiles have a high chance to deal 20 points more damage with a red explosion.

• Lead Pencil: The tears in the Lead Pencil barrage will always have the Blood Clot effect.

• Monstro's Lung: Effect is applied every time you shoot.

• Saturnus: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room. To guarantee orbiting tears with the Blood Clot damage bonus, your last fired tear before leaving a room must come from the left eye.

• Technology 2: As the laser from Technology 2 occupies your right eye, all tears now fired from the left eye have the statistical benefit of Blood Clot applied.

• The Wiz: Blood Clot applies on both eyes, meaning the second shot from either eye will always be a Blood Clot shot. It will randomly alternate which shot of the two eyes counts for the other's Blood Clot shot if you fire multiple tears per shot like with Cursed Eye.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Haemolacria]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • A blood clot is a bodily process that prevents excessive bleeding by forming a clot where the immense blood flow is, but can be harmful if it blocks an important passageway to a body organ.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Tears fired from the left eye have +1 flat damage, +5 range, and +0.5 tear falling speed.
[Repentance] Tears fired from the left eye have +1 flat damage and +2.75 range.

Blood Oath.title: Blood Oath
Blood Oath.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor if Isaac has more than a Half Red Heart. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.

• For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is quadratic, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.

• The exact formula is about +(0.15 * HeartsLost ^ 2) damage and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) speed, where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Although the animation is only a single stab when the effect is triggered, it's treated as taking damage one time per half heart lost, leading to synergies with items that activate upon taking damage.

• The damage from Blood Oath can be avoided with invincibility, but will not provide any damage and speed increase. That's a useful strategy for the Bloody Mary.

• Eternal Hearts give the health up before Blood Oath stabs Isaac, so the new heart is also drained.

• Rotten Hearts are only counted as half a red heart each.

• If Isaac has only Rotten Hearts, blood oath will leave Isaac at aHalf Red Heart, the final rotten heart taken will still give stats equivalent to a Half Red Heart 

• This effect causes Whore of Babylon to trigger unconditionally when Blood Oath is activated 

• XI - Strength can be activated at the start of a floor before Blood Oath triggers to have one more heart counted in the bonus.

• If Isaac has half a red heart or less, the effect will not trigger, even if Isaac has soul/black hearts.

• Blood Oath also drains the health of Keeper / Tainted Keeper, leaving their health at one coin heart.

• The damage caused by Blood Oath does not lower the chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room to appear.

• While playing as The Forgotten, red health will not be drained if The Soul is being controlled when Blood Oath triggers.

• If Blood Oath is removed (such as with Tainted Isaac), any existing damage and speed bonuses will remain until the next floor.

• The damage and speed bonuses are removed after defeating The Lamb and refusing a Victory Lap, or upon coming back from obtaining Knife Piece 2.

• Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Blood Oath having the lowest priority at 6th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

• The maximum achievable amounts of stats are +20 damage and +1.15 speed if starting the floor with 12 filled normal red hearts (of which only 11.5 are drained), or +21.8 and +1.2 if there is at least one Bone Heart (which allows all hearts to be drained).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Adrenaline: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.

• BFFS!: Adds 2 full hearts' worth of bonuses if any health is drained at all, e.g. losing 1 heart gives the bonuses of 3 hearts. This allows for up to 14 hearts' worth of bonuses.

• 14 hearts' bonus gives +29.6 damage and +1.4 Speed.

• Damage-triggered items: Activate a number of times equal to the total half hearts drained.

• Does not activate the Panic Button trinket.

• Bozo: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.

• Fanny Pack: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a pickup, which can include hearts.

• Gimpy / Old Bandage / Shard of Glass: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a full red/soul heart, allowing Isaac to heal back some of the damage immediately if he has high luck or a large amount of hearts lost.

• Scapular: Gives Isaac a soul heart if he had only red heart containers upon entering a floor.

• Magdalene + Birthright: With full Red Health, Magdalene can achieve up to +46.3 damage and +1.75 speed, and up to +49 and +1.8 with at least one heart being a Bone Heart.

• Myosotis: Can transport Red Hearts left on the previous floor, allowing early healing from the damage of Blood Oath.

• The Jar: Red hearts can be stored for use on the next floor.

• Placenta: With enough patience, health can be safely restored each floor by waiting in the starting room.

• Stem Cell: The healing occurs before health is drained, allowing for a greater stat bonus.

• Sol: Fills all empty heart containers upon defeating a boss, maximizing potential stat bonuses. 

• Whore of Babylon: Activates the Whore of Babylon effect at the start of each floor.

• Gnawed Leaf / Tooth and Nail: Effectively give Isaac the choice to trigger Blood Oath, by either standing still at the start of the floor or by immediately moving with Gnawed Leaf, or by timing going to the next floor right before Tooth and Nail triggers (at about the third "tick" before triggering).

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Cursed Eye: The stab will trigger the teleport if tears are charging.

• Curse of the Tower: Not recommended. Spawns 6 troll bombs for each half heart removed, typically filling the starting room with troll bombs.

• Invulnerability, Shield, & Statue Effects: Prevent Blood Oath from triggering, causing health to not drain and no bonuses being given 

• Active items or consumables that trigger these effects can be triggered at the start of the floor to prevent Blood Oath from triggering if desired 

• Perfection: The forced damage does not destroy the trinket or count against its acquisition.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Bloody Mary.

• Blood Oath originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Antibirth, it was possible to prevent Red Hearts from being drained while still gaining the stat increases if Isaac's speed was high enough to immediately leave the starting room. Moreover any Rotten Heart Isaac had would cause Blood Oath to remove half of a Soul Heart which would kill him if he did not have one to remove, likely a bug.

• In Community Remix, it would instead immediately give a damage bonus for each red health Isaac doesn't have.

• • It would start with giving Isaac a 1.8 damage up, and then decrease it by 0.085 for each half red heart Isaac has, meaning at 10.5 red hearts it would start to be a damage down.

• The familiar appears much bloodier when a large amount of hearts are drained.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Using Glowing Hourglass to return to the previous floor twice will cause Blood Oath to activate an extra time, giving buffs corresponding to drained HP.
Bug note: Upon coming back from obtaining Knife Piece 2 or after defeating the Lamb and refusing a victory lap, the stat boost obtained from this item at the beginning of the floor will be gone.

fields.description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.

Blood Puppy.title: Blood Puppy
Blood Puppy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).

• After killing 15 enemies, Blood Puppy becomes angry, and changes in the following ways:

• Deals 7.5 damage per tick instead of 2 (15 per second, or 90 per second while charging).

• Charges at enemies that are aligned with it in the cardinal directions.

• • If Blood Puppy charges into a live Bomb, it will get caught on its mouth, preventing it from moving until it explodes.

• Drops a Half Red Heart for every 10 enemies it kills.

• Will also try to attack Isaac, dealing a half heart of contact damage to him.

• Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 armor (effective health is ~140-180).

• After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications:

• Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).

• Destroys obstacles it runs into while charging.

• Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.

• Drops a Red Heart after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.

• Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).

• Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Blood Puppy appears in the Bestiary as a type of monster if Isaac turns it back to normal after it becomes angry. This is required to complete the Bestiary.

• Blood Puppy is not targeted by other familiars while it is angry.

• Blue Flies and other familiars that deal contact damage will still damage Blood Puppy if they happen to collide.

• Mr. ME! will target Blood Puppy if the crosshair targets nothing and there are no enemies in the room, and has a chance to do so if there are enemies in the room.

• Since Bombs ignore armor, a single bomb will tame the Blood Puppy.

• Stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy are an enemy for all intents and purposes, similar to Dark Esau. This means it can be affected by, for example, the slow effect of Broken Watch.

• Friendly Blood Puppies will spawn beside Isaac when he enters a new room, while hostile ones will spawn in the middle or opposite ends of the room.

• Once a hostile Blood Puppy spawns, it might start targeting Isaac, ignoring any enemies it may have spawned on top of. This can be dangerous, as you may unexpectedly get cornered from multiple sides right as you enter a room.

• Starting the Mega Satan or Dogma fight while Blood Puppy is angry can be dangerous, as it will let Blood Puppy attack Isaac while he is unable to move during the boss's spawning animation.

• Level 2 Willo will orbit angry Blood Puppy.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] Ace of Spades / Ace of Clubs / Ace of Diamonds / Ace of Hearts: Using them on an angry Blood Puppy will create the respective pickup and tame it.

• BFFS!: Only increases the size and damage of Blood Puppy during its first phase.

• Box of Friends: Spawns another tamed Blood Puppy.

• C Section: C Section babies do not home on angry Blood Puppy.

• Camo Undies: While the camo effect is active, stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy will not target Isaac, but will still target other enemies.

• Eraser: Using Eraser on Blood Puppy while it's angry will permanently prevent it from advancing to the erased phase. Using it on phase two will prevent it from becoming angry altogether.

• Flush!: Using Flush! will instantly tame an angry Blood Puppy and create a Poop.

• Freeze effects: "Killing" an angry Blood Puppy by freezing it will cause it to stay frozen until Isaac touches it or leaves the room, causing the frozen Blood Puppy to revert back to its tamed phase.

• Friendly Ball: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.

• Friendly enemies: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies; however, friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• GB Bug: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.

• God's Flesh: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.

• Humbleing Bundle: Allows an angry Blood Puppy to drop Double Hearts.

• Meat Cleaver: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

• Spider Mod: An angry Blood Puppy can be inflicted with a random status effect if the spider comes into contact with it.

• Status effects will persist through multiple rooms.

• Using Horse Pill Pheromones on angry Blood Puppy will make it friendly until it becomes angrier or dies, preventing it from dealing damage to Isaac.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.

fields.name: Blood Puppy
fields.behavior: Quickly moves around the room, attacking and charging at other monsters and Isaac when they get in its line of sight.

My Little Unicorn.title: My Little Unicorn
My Little Unicorn.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

• [Before Repentance] Isaac deals 40 contact damage to enemies, once per second.

• [Repentance] Isaac deals 20 contact damage to enemies, twice per second.

• • If an enemy is at 40 HP or less, the contact damage is increased to 40 for that enemy.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The invulnerability effect negates all forms of damage, including health loss from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.

• Ending the current run via opening the end chest while My Little Unicorn is active will cause the credits and main menu music to be sped up. The effect ends upon restarting the game or starting a new run.

• VII - The Chariot card provides the same effect of this item when used.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: With some damage source while this item is active, it can be permanently invulnerable inside the room while you have enemies.

• If combined with 9 Volt, it will be easier to achieve invincibility.

• ???'s Only Friend: The fly can still be controlled while invincible.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns rainbow-colored wisps in the middle ring. The wisps orbit Isaac more quickly than normal wisps and change colors constantly, with both of these effects being boosted while My Little Unicorn is active. The wisps also deal an extra 8 contact damage, for a total of 15 contact damage per tick. When de-activated, the rainbow coloring slightly fades away.

• Car Battery: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.

• Mom's Knife does contact damage in the same direction it was being held at the time of using it, giving a massive amount of free damage by ramming into an enemy.

• If you have the Yes Mother? transformation, you can basically do the same thing using this item.

• Damage on contact items (Aries, The Virus, etc.) and Orbital Familiars (Cube of Meat, Sacrificial Dagger, etc.): Deals damage on top of My Little Unicorn's damage and invincibility.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is a reference to the show My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic. The unicorn is one of the three types of ponies in the show, the others being the pegasus and the earth pony. A notable unicorn from the show is Twilight Sparkle, its main character.

• In the original Binding Of Isaac, using the item changed the music instead of speeding it up.

• If you pause the game while under the effect of My Little Unicorn, the music plays indefinitely.

fields.description: Grants invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

My Reflection.title: My Reflection
My Reflection.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears travel a short distance, then reverse direction and return to Isaac.

• The tears are constantly pulled towards Isaac; if Isaac moves after shooting, the tears will always return to him.

• [Repentance] The distance the tears travel before rebounding is determined by Isaac's Range stat.

• [Before Repentance] +1.5 range.

• [Before Repentance] +1 tear falling speed.

• [Repentance] 2x + 1.5 range, +1.5 damage, -1 luck.

• 1.6x shot speed multiplier.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: The tears will slowly move towards Isaac instead of remaining stationary. Releasing the fire button will launch the tears as usual.

• [Rebirth only] Brimstone: Overrides My Reflection.

• [edition anr] Makes the beam curve when moving. It has the same effect on Azazel's mini-brimstone and doubles the range.

• [Repentance] The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• Continuum: If tears cross the border of the room, they will move towards Isaac from their new position rather than crossing back across the border.

• Compound Fracture / The Parasite/Cricket's Body: Split tears will move towards Isaac.

• Dr. Fetus: Not recommended. The bombs will slide back towards Isaac after having reached a certain distance.

• When combined with Rocket in a Jar, the rockets will not explode unless they hit an obstacle or enemy, making this much safer.

• Epic Fetus: Overrides My Reflection.

• Euthanasia: Needles from Euthanasia bursts will move towards Isaac.

• Flat Stone: Tears bounce away from and then back towards Isaac. However, unless you have range ups, this generally results in tears slowing down then dissipating rather than actually returning.

• Haemolacria: Range becomes extremely high, making Haemolacria tears follow Isaac for a long time before hitting the ground. Burst tears do not have a boomerang effect.

• Ipecac: Not recommended. The explosive tears will begin flying back towards Isaac after having reached a certain distance.

• Lachryphagy: Tears will move towards Isaac and can still be fed and burst. The bursted tears will also move towards Isaac.

• A Lump of Coal: The tears increase in damage as they are pulled towards Isaac.

• The Ludovico Technique: The tear will slowly move towards Isaac, and the shot speed increase allows the tear to be moved much faster.

• [edition anr] Mom's Knife: No effect, as the knife already has this effect.

• [Repentance] The stat changes carry over, but the knife's trajectory does not.

• Montezuma's Revenge: Causes the beam range behind Isaac to become significantly increased as well as having a short range similar to Azazel's beam in front of him. This greatly eases the use of this item allowing for high DPS.

• [Before Repentance] My Reflection: No further stat changes.

• [Repentance] Damage and luck changes stack, range and shot speed don't.

• Piercing tears: Despite the piercing effect, tears cannot damage the same enemy multiple times.

• Pop!: Tears constantly swarm around Isaac, quickly filling the room.

• Proptosis: At base tear size, tears disappear before they can return to Isaac.

• Pupula Duplex: Tears will spin like boomerangs, the effect is purely cosmetic.

• Revelation: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• Rubber Cement: Isaac's tears will continually be pulled towards him, effectively reducing the chances that tears will bounce.

• Spoon Bender: If tears are close enough to an enemy, it will home in and damage them. If not, they will return to Isaac.

• [Repentance] Stop Watch: Slightly reduces the distance tears travel before returning to Isaac, while slightly increasing the distance tears travel while returning to Isaac.

• Strange Attractor: Not recommended. While it may make it easier to hit enemies, it also makes it much easier for them to be attracted to Isaac, surrounding him.

• [Rebirth only] Technology: Overrides My Reflection.

• [edition anr] Makes the beam curve when moving.

• [Repentance] The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• [Rebirth only] Technology 2 / Tech.5

• [edition anr] Tears return to character and the beams curve when moving.

• [Repentance] The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• Tech X: Stat effects of My Reflection remain but the boomerang effect does not.

• Tiny Planet: The orbital tears will move faster to stay in orbit around Isaac, making aiming easier.

• [Repentance] Increases the radius of the orbital tears.

• Trisagion: Makes the beams much longer as they move away from and then back towards Isaac.

• [Repentance] The beams are in the form of a thin loop which cover a larger area, and the beams return to Isaac.

• Whip Worm: Further increases shot speed, making Isaac's tears travel much farther forward before returning to Isaac.

• [Repentance] Shots travel the same distance forward, but loop back further before hitting the ground.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the concept of a mirror breaking when being looked into, usually played as a joke on ugly characters being 'so ugly they break the mirror'.

• This may be a commentary on Isaac's poor self-esteem.

• [Repentance] The Luck Down inflicted by the item is a secondary reference to the superstition of a broken mirror causing seven years of bad luck.

• This is also shared with the [Repentance] Downpour / II mirror

• In his first post-Repentance Lore Stream, Edmund McMillen stated that Isaac's visual appearance (ie: the crescent shape on his forehead) is simply a reference to the shape of boomerangs, as the item causes Isaac's tears to come back to him like the movement pattern of a boomerang.

• In the same lore stream, McMillen explained that the reason Isaac's tears return to him is simply due to the idea of attacking a mirror, with the tears being reflected backwards similarly to how shiny surfaces (such as mirrors) reflect light.

• This item is the only one to apply a multiplier to Isaac's shot speed, instead of a plain bonus.

• This item is used in Suicide King and Slow Roll.

fields.quote: Boomerang tears [Repentance] + DMG up + luck down
fields.description: Gives Isaac's tears a boomerang effect. [Before Repentance] +1.5 range, +1 tear falling speed, x1.6 shot speed multiplier. [Repentance] 2x + 1.5 range, +1.5 damage, -1 luck, 1.6x shot speed multiplier.

My Shadow.title: My Shadow
My Shadow.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Upon taking damage, inflicts fear on all enemies in the room.

• [Before Repentance] Upon taking damage, spawns a dark friendly My Shadow which deal 5 damage per hit to enemies.

• [Repentance] Spawns a shadow familiar that mimics Isaac's movements on a very brief delay. It spawns a friendly My Shadow whenever an enemy comes into contact with it.

• The Chargers deal 8.7 damage per hit to enemies, have 20 health, and only last for the current room. Isaac can have up to 16 Chargers at once.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth only] If this item is triggered in the Flooded Caves, there is a chance that the black charger will be replaced by a Drowned Charger. The summoned Drowned Charger will behave like normal black chargers, and upon death will explode into 4 blood shots that do not damage the player. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Shadows of incoming attacks from above will be harder to see, as they're covered by the item's shadow initially.

• [Before Repentance] This item can only spawn a maximum of 5 chargers.

• [Repentance] My Shadow's hitbox is slightly larger than Isaac's, which spawns a Charger before an enemy hits him if Isaac is standing still.

• [Repentance+] My Shadow's hitbox depends on the size of the character.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Athame: The spawned chargers spawn Athame rings upon death. [end edition note] 

• Dark Arts: Isaac can safely drag the shadow through enemies while Dark Arts is active.

• [Repentance] Duct Tape: Holds the shadow in place based on its relative position when picking up the trinket, making it easier to touch enemies with it. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Jumper Cables: The spawned chargers add to the Jumper Cables counter on death.

• Book of Shadows / My Little Unicorn / Unicorn Stump / The Gamekid: The invincibility effect allows Isaac to infinitely generate chargers that give charge on death, effectively making Isaac invincible for the room. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

• BFFS!: No effect.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly Chargers as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly Chargers however friendly Chargers can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Box of Friends: No effect.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly chargers.

• Eraser: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning as the item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.

• [Repentance] Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from the ghosts can kill the chargers. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Friendly Charger
sections.text: The dark friendly chargers act like normal chargers and will charge at enemies when they have a chance. They will attack enemies until they run out of hp either from contact with enemies or hazards (e.g. spikes or Fire Place).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The allied chargers are affected by mass slowdown effects from items such as the Stop Watch, granting the Shadow Chargers a disadvantage.

• [Before Repentance] If Isaac has homing tears, they will home in on allied chargers.

• The allied chargers will take damage from any sort of explosion, [Afterbirth+ onward] except from your own general explosions, [Before Repentance] though certain synergies involving Scatter Bombs may kill the Friendly charger.

• [Afterbirth only] With Punching Bag, the allied chargers may attack the Punching Bag instead of enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item's sprite looks similar to an upside-down version of Judas' Shadow.

• This item's quote is a reference to the song "Me and My Shadow" by Frank Sinatra and Sammy Davis Jr.

• This item removes Isaac's drop shadow.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Inflicts fear on all enemies in the room upon taking damage and spawns black friendly Chargers that attack enemies.
[Repentance] Spawns a shadow familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It spawns a black friendly Charger whenever an enemy touches it.
Slowly moves around the room, charging at enemies when they get in its line of sight.
fields.behavior: Charges at enemies when in its line of sight, dealing contact damage. Will always spawn friendly via My Shadow.

Myosotis.title: Myosotis
Myosotis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns pickups left on the previous floor in the starting room of the current floor.

• A maximum of 4 pickups can be spawned.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The "previous floor" status of trinkets can be reset by picking them up and dropping them again, allowing multiple other trinkets to be carried between floors.

• If pickups were transported to another floor from the Treasure or Boss Room, their copies will remain in those rooms and can be encountered during the Ascent.

• Affected trinkets still transform into Cracked Keys, potentially allowing you to gain large amounts of Cracked Keys.

• Spawns pickups on the first floor if R Key was used.

• Does not bring pickups from I AM ERROR rooms.

• May spawn Broken Shovel 1 on the next floor if it was knocked down but not taken.

• Special Rooms take priority, in a certain order, over normal rooms, with Boss Rooms having the highest priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box / Myosotis: Each copy increases the amount of pickups spawned by 2, up to a maximum of 8 pickups spawned per floor.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Forget me not is a common name for the flower genus Myosotis. This name comes from a German poem where it symbolizes remembrance of a loved one.

• This trinket originated in Antibirth. It was originally capped at 8 pickups instead of 4.

fields.description: When entering a new floor, up to four uncollected pickups from the previous floor spawn in the starting room.

Mysterious Candy.title: Mysterious Candy
Mysterious Candy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac has a chance to fart or poop every 30 seconds. [Before Repentance] Getting hit can also trigger the effect.

• [Repentance] Farts deal 6 damage and blow away projectiles.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• With smart positioning, poops can be placed and bombed to create bridges for 1 tile gaps, allowing Isaac to reach otherwise unobtainable consumables.

• Isaac can poop as much as he wants without leaving the room, but he still cannot poop where a previous poop was placed or destroyed.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket: Spawned poop is golden.

• Brown Cap: Poops may be used to access secret rooms and blow rocks and debris.

• + Yes Mother?: Not recommended. Poops will blow up as soon as they spawn.

• + Pyromaniac: Provides a slow, but effective source of healing.

• Butt Penny / Petrified Poop : Poops are more likely to drop pickups, allowing to farm them over time.

• Dirty Mind: Allows a steady supply of Dips, with time. Useful for later chapters.

• Gigante Bean: Farts are affected, covering a wide area and dealing 10 damage instead.

• Meconium: Poops spawned by Mysterious Candy have a chance to be black poop.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Hallowed Ground / Midas' Touch: The spawned poops are not affected by these items.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mysterious Candy is a reference to Ex-Lax brand of laxative, where the active ingredient is contained in chocolate bars.

• [Repentance] This trinket is used in Scat Man (challenge #36).

fields.name: Mysterious Candy
fields.description: Isaac farts or poops at random intervals. [Before Repentance] Getting hit can also trigger the effect.

Mysterious Liquid.title: Mysterious Liquid
Mysterious Liquid.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Tears leave a small, short-lasting pool of creep upon hitting an enemy or when their range is depleted.

• The creep deals 1 damage per tick or 30 damage per second.

• [Repentance] The creep can deal up to 25 damage.

• Multiple creep pools can inflict damage on an enemy simultaneously.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Each split tear leaves a creep, creating lots of creep pools.

• Explosivo: Leaves an explosion-sized creep whenever the Explosivo tear goes off.

• Flat Stone: Each tear bounce leaves a pool of creep.

• The Ludovico Technique: Spawns creep trail under the tear on a constant time interval.

• Mom's Knife: Spawns a line of creep behind the knife as it shoots towards enemies, each one left on random time interval.

• Spirit Sword: The projectiles from the sword spawn creep pools, sword attacks do not.

• Tech.5: The lasers spawn creep pools always when it hits obstacles and occasionally on enemies.

• Technology 2: The lasers rapidly spawn creep pools on hitting both obstacles and enemies.

• Tech X: The laser rings spawn creep pools when it hits enemies on a constant time interval.

• Trisagion: The blasts leave long trails of creep pools, and a creep for each damaging tick. Since the effect stacks, they cause massive damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Following items leave the creep pools:

• Eye of Greed

• Fate's Reward

• Found Soul

• Gello

• Host Hat

• Incubus

• Kidney Stone

• Lead Pencil

• Metal Plate

• Sad Bombs

• Saturnus

• Tammy's Head

• Twisted Pair

• Varicose Veins

• Following items do not leave the creep pools:

• Akeldama

• Brimstone Bombs

• Circle of Protection

• Divine Intervention

• It Hurts

• Large Zit

• Shard of Glass

• Slipped Rib

• Vasculitis

• Athame / Maw Of The Void: Only creates the creep pools when damaging enemies or destroyable obstacles.

• Brimstone: Overrides Mysterious Liquid.

• [Afterbirth onward] The beam spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and enemies on a constant time interval.

• • Azazel: Leaves the creep pools at the end of Azazel's shorter brimstone beam.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Ipecac: Overrides Mysterious Liquid.

• [Afterbirth onward] Explosions caused by these items will leave a large pool of creep.

• Fire Mind: Mysterious Liquid removes explosion chance, but fire damage over time is preserved.

• [Afterbirth onward] Tears can explode as expected. The explosions leave a large pool of creep.

• Haemolacria: Only the main tear spawns creep.

• [Repentance] All tears leave the creep pools .

• Lachryphagy: Only the burst tears spawns creep.

• Lost Contact: Overrides Mysterious Liquid.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The combination works as expected, with tears spawning liquid even when stopping enemy shots.

• The Ludovico Technique: Mysterious Liquid's graphical effect remains, but the tear leaves no creep.

• [Afterbirth onward] The tear leaves a trail of creep pools on a constant time interval.

• Montezuma's Revenge: Constantly creates pools of creep at the end of the beam. Corn projectiles do not spawn creep.

• Mucormycosis: All tears including spores spawn creep upon burst, but not on contact with enemies.

• Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection: Spawns creep after each tear's effect wears off and drops to the ground but not on contact with enemies.

• Piercing tears: Tears do not leave creep pools when they hit and pass through an enemy, and only leave creep pools when they hit an obstacle or run out of range.

• Revelation: The beam spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and enemies on a constant time interval.

• Rubber Cement: Tears do not create creep when they bounce off enemies or obstacles and only when they land.

• Spectral tears: Tears only spawn creep pools after they land, not while passing through obstacles.

• Strange Attractor: Overrides Mysterious Liquid.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The combination works as expected.

• Technology: Overrides Mysterious Liquid.

• [Afterbirth onward] The laser spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and occasionally on enemies.

fields.description: Tears leave a small, short lasting pool of creep on impact or when their range is depleted.

Mysterious Paper.title: Mysterious Paper
Mysterious Paper.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon taking damage has a random chance to grant the effect of one of the following items/trinkets:

• The Polaroid

• The Negative

• • [Repentance] Does not include the +1 damage bonus.

• A Missing Page

• Missing Poster

• If Isaac does not already have the item/trinket, then he will be given the item (but only for that particular frame). This means that Isaac has a chance to go to Chest or the Dark Room without The Polaroid or The Negative, he has a chance to revive as The Lost upon death, and so forth.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Will activate effects of both The Polaroid and The Negative OR A Missing Page and Missing Poster at the same time.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• In addition to regular trinket drop sources, Mysterious Paper is guaranteed to drop from Divorce Papers, provided it has been unlocked.

• If the Missing Poster effect is activated, Mysterious Paper will not be removed.

• [Repentance] This trinket cannot be used to substitute The Polaroid or The Negative to open A Strange Door.

• [Repentance] The Black Heart damage bonus of A Missing Page will work, provided a heart/item affected by it will trigger on the frame it's active.

• [Afterbirth onward] If it happens to grant Missing Poster, it can be used to unlock The Lost and will act as an extra life for both the Lost and the Tainted Lost.

fields.name: Mysterious Paper
fields.description: Has a chance to replicate the effects of A Missing Page, The Polaroid, The Negative, or Missing Poster.

Mystery Egg.title: Mystery Egg
Mystery Egg.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns an egg familiar, which cracks and turns into a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt.

• The egg regenerates upon entering a different room.

• The usefulness of the enemy depends on how many consecutive rooms have been cleared without getting hurt.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Mystery Egg having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

• Mystery Egg will activate when taking non-hostile damage (such as from a Blood Donation Machine or Curse Room door).

• For Greed Mode and Greedier Mode, the usefulness of the enemy is based on waves cleared rather than rooms.

• The list of available monsters is as follows:

| Number of rooms / waves cleared | Monsters 
| 0 to 1 rooms cleared without taking damage | Fly, Attack Fly, Maggot, Spider, Dip, Embryo, Nerve Ending

| 2 to 4 rooms cleared without taking damage | Moter, Pooter, Swarm, Level 2 Fly, Full Fly, Horf, Sucker, Dart Fly, Big Spider, Guts, Hopper, Gusher, Round Worm, Mask + Heart, Gush

| 5 to 7 rooms cleared without taking damage | Squirt, Ragling, Homunculus, Level 2 Spider, Small Baby Long Legs, Wall Creep, Night Crawler, Ulcer, Ministro, Mulligan, Hive, Nest, Flaming Hopper, Gaper, Cyclopia, Skinny, Dople, Globin, Maw, Psychic Horf, Tumor, Fatty, Half Sack, Clotty, Charger, Brain, Conjoined Spitty, Buttlicker, Host, One Tooth, Baby, Dukie, Black Globin's Body, Black Globin's Head, Para-Bite

| 8 to 10 rooms cleared without taking damage | Splasher, Boom Fly, Keeper, Fat Bat, Psy Tumor, Imp, Fred, Cod Worm, Lump, Swinger, Bony, Black Globin, Nulls, Begotten, Knight, Bone Knight, Blubber, Conjoined Fatty, Oob, Leech, MemBrain, Wizoob, Mr. Maw, Flesh Death's Head, Mushroom, Blind Creep, The Thing, Blister, Leaper, Hanger, Poison Mind, Fistuloid, Tar Boy

| 11 to 13 rooms cleared without taking damage | Gurgle, Walking Gut, Black Bony, Black Maw, Camillo Jr., Eye, Roundy, Mom's Hand, Mega Clotty, Swarmer, Fat Sack, Mobile Host

| More than 13 rooms cleared without taking damage | Red Ghost, Rage Creep, Vis, Gurglings, Dinga, Portal

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The egg grows in size. Enemies spawned will be a champion variant.

• Even if the enemy spawned cannot be a champion under normal circumstances, they will become a champion.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

• Eraser: Enemies erased by Eraser will never show up again, hindering Mystery Egg should it spawn said removed enemy.

• [Repentance] Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies. [end edition note] 

• Holy Mantle: Losing the Mantle will not cause a friendly enemy to spawn.

• Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or higher.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Mystery Egg is based on this Steam Workshop item by Strawrat and Aczom.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: When using Extension Cord with Mystery Egg, after the egg turns into a friendly enemy, the electricity shoots out into a random corner of the room.
Bug note: When the egg turns into a friendly Mask + Heart, it will sometimes act as the heart companion for a mask already in the room resulting in an unbeatable room.
Bug note: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate friendly enemies.

fields.name: Mystery Egg
fields.description: Spawns an egg familiar, which hatches a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt once per room. The power of the monster improves for each consecutive room cleared without taking damage.

Mystery Gift.title: Mystery Gift
Mystery Gift.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Upon use, spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a base ~17% chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to get A Lump of Coal or The Poop is determined by Luck using this formula: \frac2 { 12 + \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}

• A table showing an example is below. There's no cap, with diminishing returns. At 88 Luck the chance drops to 2%.

| Luck | Item Pool | Poop/Coal

| -10 | 0% | 100%

| 0 | 83.3% | 16.6%

| 8 | 90% | 10%

• A Lump of Coal and The Poop are fixed drops, and cannot be changed by having Chaos, holding NO!, and other similar effects. This also means Mystery Gift can drop copies of either item even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed them.

• Spawning The Poop will create a poison cloud, as if having used The Bean, down to matching the former item's effects.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a random wisp. For the rest of the run, a random wisp spawns after clearing a room if the one given by the item was destroyed, including the replacement wisps given by this effect.

• Damocles: When Damocles is activated, a second item will be spawned with adherence to the item pool for the current room. Even if Mystery Gift "fails" and spawns either The Poop or A Lump of Coal, a second item from the current room's item pool will always be rewarded.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect, Mystery Gift will only spawn a single item.

• Void: Like all single-use active items, this item cannot be absorbed by Void. Instead, it will consume and use the Mystery Gift.

• [Repentance] Mystery Gift will be absorbed and will spawn the item upon Void's next use.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Mystery Gift is based on this Steam Workshop item by Striped.

• The appearance and pickup quote of the item is a reference to the game Spelunky, where there is an item called "Mystery Box", with the description "Thanks! I wrapped it up nice for you!"

• The item's name is also a reference to the Pokémon franchise's feature for distributing event Pokémon.

• The item having a chance to give A Lump of Coal references Santa's tendency to gift coal to naughty children.

• The item having a chance to give The Poop references one of Isaac's floor transition's dreams, in which he is gifted poop.

fields.name: Mystery Gift
fields.description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

Mystery Sack.title: Mystery Sack
Mystery Sack.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns a familiar that drops a Heart, coin, Bomb, or Key (or any of their variations) alternatively every 5 or 6 rooms.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars.

• [Before Repentance+] Mystery Sack has 6th priority.

• [Repentance+] Mystery Sack has 8th priority.

• Can spawn troll bombs.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • BFFS!: The familiar drops pickups alternatingly every 4 or 5 rooms.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Before patch 1.04, this item did not drop any items or do anything at all. Why it did not work remains a mystery.

• This item is the only "bag" item (Sack of Pennies, Rune Bag, Bomb Bag, and Sack of Sacks), that isn't a counterpart to other existing bag items, rather being a combination of some.

fields.name: Mystery Sack
fields.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Heart, coin, Bomb, or Key every 5-6 rooms.

NO!.title: NO!
NO!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Nuh Uh!]

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Prevents activated collectibles from being generated, if possible, from all item pools while this trinket is being held.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Activated items will start appearing again once the item pool's non-activated items are exhausted or become scarce.

• When the trinket is dropped, the item generation mechanics go back to normal, and active items will be generated normally again.

• In runs where many items have been collected/rerolled, the trinket can function as a sort of warning to the player that an item pool will soon be exhausted if activated items begin to show up.

• [Before Repentance] Fixed boss drops and machines are not affected by NO!:

• Anarchist Cookbook from Pride

• Bob's Rotten Head from Sloth

• Crystal Ball from a [machine: Fortune Telling Machine] 

• Head of Krampus from Krampus

• IV Bag from a [machine: Blood Donation Machine] 

• Mr. Boom from Wrath

• A Pony from Headless Horseman

• Shoop da Whoop! from Envy

• White Pony from Conquest

• Yum Heart from Super Lust

• [Repentance] Most fixed active item drops are prevented:

• Pride drops a Key

• Sloth drops a card

• Krampus always drops A Lump of Coal

• [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s drop a Blood Bag if unlocked, still IV Bag otherwise

• Wrath drops Bombs

• Headless Horseman and Conquest drop either Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat

• Envy drops a Troll Bomb

• Super Lust drops a pill

• Baby Plum will spawn a regular boss room item if spared.

• Some active items that are hard-coded to appear in certain rooms will still spawn, such as Grave Rooms that contain We Need To Go Deeper! or Dross rooms that contain The Poop.

• Bumbino will still drop active items from his item pool, if he collects enough coins.

• Mystery Gift can still give The Poop.

• Shopkeepers can still drop Coupon.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Items with 0 quality are rerolled.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues: Will not be prevented from spawning, since it's treated as a passive item. Is nigh-guaranteed to spawn in a Library.

• Death Certificate: Active Items generated in Death Certificate rooms ignore NO!'s changes to item availability.

• Magic Skin: Additional copies of Magic Skin can still replace other items.

• TMTRAINER: Active items generated by TMTRAINER will not be prevented from spawning.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • [Afterbirth+ onward] NO!'s sprite was changed for Booster Pack #5.

fields.name: NO!
fields.description: Prevents active items from being generated, if possible.

Nancy Bombs.title: Nancy Bombs
Nancy Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 5 Bombs.

• Causes Isaac's bombs to gain the effects of 1-4 random bomb synergies (most commonly 1).

• Aside from normal bomb synergy items, this also includes Bob's Bladder, Strange Attractor, and Golden Bombs (golden bombs will not be free).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Nancy Bombs cannot give the effects of Mr. Mega, Rocket in a Jar, or Giga Bombs.

• Even though Nancy Bombs can grant the Fast Bombs synergy, this will have no effect on the bomb placement speed. It will, however, disallow that bomb to knock back other bombs.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs have a chance to be affected by Nancy Bombs.

• Kamikaze!: Gains the effect of a random bomb synergy each time it is used.

• Scatter Bombs: Extra bombs will copy the bomb synergies of the original bomb.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Nancy Bombs originates from the Antibirth mod, but was named Enigma Bombs. By extension, it was also from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Community Remix, it instead would spawn a random bomb upon entering a room, picking between Mr. Mega, Bob's Curse, and Bobby-Bomb.

• The rename from Enigma Bombs was likely to match the naming scheme of 3 Dollar Bill, Fruit Cake, and Rainbow Worm.

• "Nancy" as a pejorative term refers to an effeminate male.

fields.description: +5 Bombs. Each bomb gains 1-4 random bomb synergies.

Necromancer.title: Necromancer
Necromancer.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Necromancer is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, upgrading Isaac's Necronomicon after picking up its page item and trinket.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• The Necronomicon charge becomes a special purple bar that depletes by 10% each use.

• In this state, The Necronomicon cannot be recharged in any usual manner, but instead recharges fully upon reaching the next floor.

• If the charge is fully depleted, The Necronomicon turns back to normal for the rest of the floor, starting with an empty charge bar.

• If the charge is not fully depleted upon reaching the next floor, the purple bar can be overcharged, up to one extra full bar.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up each of the 3 items and trinkets from the following list.

sections.heading: Activated Collectibles
sections.text:
[collectible rows: The Necronomicon] 
|}

sections.heading: Passive Collectibles
sections.text:
[collectible rows: Missing Page 2] 
|}

fields.description: The Necronomicon becomes empowered. It can be used 10 times with no recharge between uses per floor, after which it turns back to normal for the rest of the floor.
fields.items: The Necronomicon, Missing Page 2, A Missing Page

Neptunus.title: Neptunus
Neptunus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While Isaac is not firing tears, a charge bar will start to fill up. Holding down the fire button will release the stored tears rapidly. The fire rate is greater and the bar drains faster when more full.

• The charge time and maximum tears per charge scale with Isaac's tears stat, with higher tears charging faster and having more of them.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• While at 0 charge, Isaac fires at his normal tear delay, meaning there is no downside.

• This item has no effect for Tainted Lilith or Tainted Forgotten.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Camo Undies: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.

• Chocolate Milk: Neptunus' passive charge overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.

• Once Neptunus' charge is used up, Isaac will fire uncharged Chocolate Milk tears, resulting in a much lower damage output than without Chocolate Milk.

• Chocolate Milk + Kidney Stone: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.

• Kidney Stone: Tear bursts stack, firing a very large number of tears in combination with each other.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
Overrides Neptunus:

• Azazel/Brimstone

• C Section

• Dr. Fetus

• Epic Fetus

• The Ludovico Technique

• Mom's Knife

• Monstro's Lung

• Spirit Sword

• Technology

• Tech X

• However, Haemolacria + Tech X does work with Neptunus.

Other interactions:

• Cursed Eye: Overridden by Neptunus.

• Soy Milk: The charge bar is not present and charged tears are released instantly.

• Chocolate Milk + Marked: Not recommended. Isaac will not be able to fire any tears, effectively softlocking the run.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Neptunus, as well as Jupiter, was designed for the original Antibirth mod, but never actually implemented until Repentance.

• Neptunus' effects and pickup quote reference the Roman god of the sea, Neptune.

fields.description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.

Nerve Ending.title: Nerve Ending
Nerve Ending.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Nerve Endings are purely static enemies with no proactive means of dealing damage, aside from contact damage.

sections.heading: Nerve Ending 2
sections.text: Nerve Ending 2s are stationary enemies which will swipe at Isaac if he gets too close. This attack can only connect if Isaac is horizontal with it, but will deal contact damage in any case if Isaac walks into them. Otherwise, they have no means of attacking and are generally harmless.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Nerve Ending 2s can never replace Nerve Endings next to doors.

• If Nerve Ending 2s aren't unlocked yet, they are replaced by Nerve Endings.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • It's possible that the Nerve Ending is a giant axon, an electrical impulse terminal for nerve cells, which could explain its name.
