The Siren.title: The Siren
The Siren.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Siren is a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance that can appear in the Mausoleum.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
• If Isaac has any familiars, The Siren sings, charming up to 3 familiars at a time to assist her and turning their effects against Isaac.

• Isaac's familiars when charmed retain most of their behaviors when assisting The Siren but can now deal contact damage and block shots.

• Charmed familiars have 60 HP and return to Isaac when killed.

• If she has less than 3 charmed shooting familiars from Isaac, she summons up to 3 orbiting Siren Minions of her own. These familiars behave identically to Brother Bobby but with a slower fire rate and can also be killed. She then glides around the room for a few seconds, letting her familiars use their effects against Isaac. If she has any familiars alive after this, she swipes at Isaac, launching all remaining familiars in a cluster in his direction.

• When the cluster collides with a wall it kills all the familiars and releases a burst of radial projectiles and a cluster of disorganized projectiles.

• • The amount of projectiles launched during this attack depends on the number of familiars that collided with the wall.

• Swipes a short distance in Isaac's direction, releasing 5 projectiles.

• Sinks into the floor becoming invulnerable and chases Isaac, leaving a trail of slowing black creep. After reappearing, she swipes at Isaac, shooting a spread of 5 projectiles.

• Screams, emitting a consistent shockwave around her and spawning 9 pulsating rings of projectiles that expand outwards.

• This attack pushes Isaac away like an inverted Gaping Maw.

• The rings of projectiles have openings towards Isaac's general direction.

Upon death, The Siren burns away, leaving behind her skull.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Bombing the skull that the Siren leaves behind spawns and unlocks the Forgotten Lullaby.

• It only spawns the Forgotten Lullaby the first time it is bombed.

• Bombing the skull in subsequent runs treats it as a regular Skull in regards to its drops.

• Leaving and returning to the room causes the skull to disappear.

• [Before Repentance+] The Siren can charm Lilith's Familiars, including her Incubus, hence making Lilith a difficult character to kill The Siren with. To counter this, either bait The Siren into launching the familiars into the wall and killing them or use bombs/active items to deal damage.

• [Before Repentance+] Charmed familiars with a charged attack (eg: Lil Brimstone) hold their charge until the Siren launches the familiars.

• [Before Repentance+] Lasers from charmed Robo-Baby and Robo-Baby 2.0 do not hurt Isaac.

• [Before Repentance+] Charmed Lil Portal can still collect pickups and create a portal.

• [Repentance+] Charmed Lil Portal does nothing and has no hitbox.

• Charmed familiars that are thrown (eg: Bob's Brain) do not count towards the count of 3 familiars that orbit the Siren but are included in the cluster thrown at the end of the attack.

• Charmed Abel mirrors The Siren's movements and shoots at her, though these projectiles are dangerous towards Isaac and do not hurt The Siren.

• Charmed Paschal Candle will still grant a tears buff while charmed.

• Charmed Rotten Baby spawns Attack Fly instead of Blue Flies and Sissy Longlegs spawns Spiders instead of Blue Spiders.

• Charmed Tinytoma orbits The Siren but still blocks hostile projectiles and turns into friendly Blue Spiders after being destroyed. It will also not return to Isaac when destroyed and will spawn charmed again for The Siren.

• Temporary familiars and King Baby cannot be charmed.

• Charmed knife familiar cannot be damaged while it returns after a stab.

• Charmed Angelic Prism will still split tears and deal contact damage to the character, but it wont work for the enemy.

• Charmed The Peeper / familiar from The Scooper will still have the effect of increasing eye damage. The creep from The Scooper will damage enemies.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Forgotten Lullaby]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Siren originates from the Antibirth mod. Compared to the version in Repentance, two features were cut: one was a musical note projectile attack that reversed your controls, and the other was a revival mechanic that occured when The Siren charmed an extra life familiar like 1up! or Dead Cat.

• She is based off of Sirens from Greek mythology, which were dangerous creatures who lured nearby sailors with their enchanting music and singing voices.

• The Siren is the only boss that can interact with Isaac's collected items or familiars.

• The Siren's ring of tears and sinking in the ground attacks are references to the Gorgun boss from the game Enter the Gungeon. Moreover, both bosses leave behind remains that can be destroyed.

• The Siren is voiced by Carla Kihlstedt, also known to be the voice of Mom.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Charmed throwable familiars (such as Bob's Brain) can sometimes remain charmed after the cluster of familiars explodes.

Bomber Boy.title: Bomber Boy
Bomber Boy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 5 Bombs.

• Causes bombs to explode in a large cross-shaped blast by adding two additional explosions in each cardinal direction.

• The damage for a single explosion is [Before Repentance] unchanged (60) [Repentance] 0.75x times its normal damage (resulting in 75 damage per explosion). Each successive explosion that hits the same enemy has its damage halved.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] The damage per successive explosion is: 60, 30, 15, 7.5, 3.75, 1.875, 0.9375, 0.46875, 0.234375.

• [Repentance] The damage per successive explosion is: 75, 37.5, 18.75, 9.375, 4.6875, 2.34375, 1.171875, 0.5859375, 0.29296875.

• Mr. Mega changes the explosions' base damage to [Before Repentance] 110/ [Repentance] 185, with the same damage reductions as above.

• With Bomber Boy, Bedrooms, Super Special Rocks, and the Mines can be accessed with a single bomb.

• Bombing the Donation Machine will cause a greater than normal amount of coins to drop from the Donation Machine.

• The total amount of dropped coins is still deducted from the Donation Machine, however.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Bombing a Blue Fire Place or Purple Fire Place may cause it to drop multiple Soul Hearts.

• [Repentance] Bombs are colored blue and no longer have a skull on them.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BBF/Best Friend/Bob's Brain/ [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Red Locusts: Explosion damage is halved with no additional explosions.

• BBF/Best Friend/Bob's Brain/Mr. Boom/ [Repentance] Red Locusts: Bomber Boy affects the item’s explosion.

• • Red Locusts will create additional smaller explosions that spawn in a tight cross formation.

• Pyromaniac: Heals Isaac multiple times per bomb depending on the number of explosions that hit him.

• Dr. Fetus: Bomber Boy affects the bombs fired by Dr. Fetus.

• Doctor's Remote/Epic Fetus: Bomber Boy affects the missiles' explosions from Epic Fetus, with the explosions' multiplier resulting in 15 times Isaac's damage per explosion. Unlike with regular bombs, Bomber Boy won't decrease the damage from each of the missile's successive explosions, drastically increasing damage.

• Hot Bombs: Each extra explosion creates an additional fire.

• Mr. Mega: All explosions deal more damage, have a larger radius and will overlap each other more, potentially vastly increasing damage. Caution should be exercised, as the explosions' increased radius make self-damage likely.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anarchist Cookbook/Curse of the Tower/XVI - The Tower: Not recommended. The cross pattern explosion makes it very hard to avoid taking damage.

• Bob's Rotten Head: No effect.

• Blasting Cap: The extra explosions cannot drop bomb pickups.

• Epic Fetus: Epic Fetus explosions are unaffected.

• Glitter Bombs: Each additional explosion created has a chance to spawn a pickup or trinket.

• Glitter Bombs: Extra explosions are unaffected by Glitter Bombs.

• Ipecac: Ipecac explosions are unaffected.

• Sad Bombs: Each explosion releases 10 tears in all directions.

• [Repentance] Sad Bombs: Only the center-most explosion creates 10 tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Bomber Boy is a reference to the 1983 video-game Bomberman. Bomber Boy is, specifically, the original name of a Game Boy game known as Atomic Punk in the United States and Dynablaster in Europe and Oceania.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Due to the extreme force of multiple simultaneous explosions, it is possible for Bomber Boy bombs (especially when combined with Mr. Mega) to propel Isaac into obstacles or over pits.
Bug note: Although Bob's Rotten Head works normally with Butt Bombs, and Bomber Boy has no effect with it, their combination drops the explosion damage by 50%.

Bombs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction

sections.heading: Bombs
sections.text:
They are used to damage enemies, destroy rocks, and open up closed regular doors and Secret Rooms. When a bomb pickup spawns, there is a chance for it to be replaced by a Troll Bomb instead.

[Before Repentance] Isaac's bombs deal 60 damage to enemies and one full heart of damage to himself.

[Repentance] Isaac's bombs deal 100 damage to enemies and one full heart of damage to himself. Bomb explosions pierce enemy armor.

sections.heading: [Repentance] Poop
sections.text:
Poop pick-ups are exclusive to Tainted ??? as his mechanic uses poops instead of bombs.

| Poop | ID | Image | Worth | Additional Info 
| [Repentance] Poop Nugget | 0 | | 1 | Drops from Tainted ??? when dealing damage to enemies.

| [Repentance] Big Poop Nugget | 1 | | 3 | Any bomb pickups that would normally spawn are replaced with this when playing as Tainted ???; this does not affect Troll Bombs and their variants.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The probabilities in the table refer to the kind of bomb that is generated by the game when a bomb pickup is spawned with a sub-type of 0 (i.e. a random bomb).

• Pickups, chests, and other movable objects will be flung away if caught in a bomb's explosion radius. Take care not to launch anything you want over spikes or other hazards.

• Troll bombs of all sizes (whether room reward or spawning from monsters) deal a full heart of damage under normal conditions.

• [Afterbirth onward] If Golden Bombs have not been unlocked, they will be replaced by a random Bomb pickup or Troll Bomb in any room layouts containing them.

• [Afterbirth onward] Troll Bombs explode after a random amount of time. This means that if two Troll Bombs spawn at the same time right next to each other, there's a high chance one Troll Bomb will blow up before the other, sending that Troll Bomb sliding outwards a bit before exploding.

• Because the timing relates to when the bombs spawn, if you leave the room and reenter, the fuses will reset and the bombs are likely to explode simultaneously, which is generally safer.

• [Repentance] Gold bombs can be acquired without the unlock by picking up a Golden Key and then consuming a Bombs Are Key pill.

• [Repentance] Giga bomb explosions will never destroy tiles in front of room exits.

• [Repentance] The HUD icon for bombs changes to a bigger one when Isaac holds a Giga bomb.

• [Repentance] Picked up Giga bombs are always used before normal bombs.

• [Repentance] Picked up Giga bombs will override the Golden bomb effect until all Giga bombs are used and they do not stack with it.

• [Repentance] When playing as Jacob and Esau or having Strawman, both characters place a bomb at the cost of using up only one. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: It's the Key]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Troll Bombs are a reference to Trolling, an internet term for tricking or messing with people psychologically.

• The face on the Troll Bomb depicts the Trollface, a face commonly associated with internet trolls and trolling.

• Mega Troll Bombs are spawned by Super Wrath, Super Pride, War (black Champion), and sometimes Little Horn.

• In the original game, Mega Troll Bombs can't be blocked by obstacles or non-piercing tears, will follow the player at any distance, and are much faster.

Bone Spurs.title: Bone Spurs
Bone Spurs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Enemies spawn 1–2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

• Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.

• Bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the moment they were created.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can be spawned by Bumbino if he picks up 12 cents.

• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Carrion Queen. [end edition note] 

• Bone particles will be created whenever Isaac shoots, though this is purely visual.

• Because the bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage in the moment they were created, if the damage stat was changed, the bones that were already present on the screen will use Isaac's old damage stat.

• The bones can immediately hit splitting enemies' spawns, damaging or destroying them as well.

• When fighting Ultra Pestilence, if Isaac has a strong, piercing tear modifier such as Tech X, the Ultra Pestilence flies spawned will die in quick succession, summoning many bones that push the boss off the screen and out of reach, making the fight significantly harder and more tedious.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Doubles the bones' size and damage.

• Spin to Win: Boosts the bones' damage while spinning even though there's no visual tell of the effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn't spawn bones.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't spawn bones.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • A bone spur is a bony growth that often occurs close to joints and can have a multitude of causes from joint damage from osteoarthritis to excessive overuse of said joints.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: [Before Repentance+] If switching between Tainted Lazarus and Dead Tainted Lazarus with the Flip item, there is a chance to spawn a mass amount of bone spurs on the place you flip each time you use the item.

fields.description: Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

Book of Revelations.title: Book of Revelations
Book of Revelations.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, gives one Soul Heart.

• Increases chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room door to open if held while killing the final boss of the floor.

• [Rebirth only] The chance is increased by 35%.

• [Afterbirth onward] The chance is increased by 17.5%.

• If the Book of Revelations is used at least once on a floor, a Harbinger will replace the current floor's boss if possible.

• [edition nar] This will always happen as long as the floor's respective Harbinger has not been encountered, the boss has not been fought yet, and a Harbinger can appear on the floor normally.

• [edition anr] This has a high chance to happen but is not guaranteed.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
The Harbingers capable of appearing, and the floors they appear on, are as follows:

• Famine in Chapter 1

• Pestilence in Chapter 2

• War in Chapter 3, floor 1

• Death or Conquest (if unlocked) in Chapter 4, floor 1

• Headless Horseman on any floor in Chapters 1-4

• Set bosses (Mom, Isaac, The Lamb, etc.) are unaffected by Book of Revelations.

• Only the first boss of a floor affected by [cu: Labyrinth] is affected.

• Book of Revelations won't replace the boss on double-sized Boss Rooms, like Double Trouble rooms or if the boss is Mr. Fred.

• Furthermore, if the Book of Revelations is used on the first floor of a Chapter with a Double Trouble room no Harbinger will spawn on the second floor, even if Book of Revelations is used again. If finding a Harbinger is desired, Isaac should wait until seeing the shape of the Boss Room before using it.

• Keeping Book of Revelations until Chapter 4 is one of the methods to unlock achievements related to Super Meat Boy and Super Bandage Girl, explained in detail here.

• [Before Afterbirth+] This item can replace the Boss even after Isaac initiates a battle with a normal boss and then teleports out before the fight is completed.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] This item can replace The Bloat with a Harbinger in Aprils Fool. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Bosses in Downpour / Mines / Mausoleum and their variants cannot be replaced with Harbingers. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Creates wisps in the inner ring, resembling tiny crosses that do not fire tears. The wisps create a Harbinger that spawns Locusts (the same ones that 7 Seals creates) for the current room when destroyed.

• Converter: Allows for generation of Heart Containers. (Schoolbag required)

• Car Battery: Gives Isaac two soul hearts.

• There's Options: Defeating a Harbinger will spawn both a regular Boss pool item and either Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat.

• Dream Catcher: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, book of revelations can be used early as the downside is no longer relevant.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Genesis: Effects on the Boss Room and boss item still apply to the floor even after using Genesis.

• Satanic Bible: The spawned Ball of Bandages or Cube of Meat will cost hearts like a normal devil deal.

• IV - The Emperor?: Does not guarantee the extra boss to be a horseman.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Book of Revelation (note the lack of an "s") is the final book of The Bible. It depicts the apocalypse through a vision shown to John of Patmos and includes the Four Horsemen and themes of Hell, Satan, and The Lamb. This explains why using it causes the next boss to be a Harbinger, as well as why it increases the chances of a Devil Room / Angel Room to appear.

fields.description: Increases the chance of a Devil Room / Angel Room appearing while held. Upon use, gives one Soul Heart, and replaces the boss of the current floor with a Harbinger if possible.

Book of Secrets.title: Book of Secrets
Book of Secrets.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Randomly grants the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor.

• [Repentance] If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead.

• Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.

• [Before Repentance] The chosen effect on activation may be one that Isaac already has—effectively doing nothing.

• [Repentance] Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.

• [Repentance] Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Book of Secrets has no effect on floors affected by [curse: lost] or an Amnesia pill.

• [Repentance] If [curse: lost] or an Amnesia pill is active on a floor, X-Ray Vision effect is provided immediately.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps in the middle ring, looking like tiny spinning question marks. The wisps invoke the effect of Cracked Orb when destroyed.

• Car Battery:

• [edition anr] Activates twice, but has a chance to uselessly activate the same effect twice.

• [Repentance] Gives 2 different mapping effects and extends the duration of the glow effect applied onto special rocks.

• The Mind: Immediately gives the X-Ray Vision effect for the floor upon use.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item may be a reference to an Apocryphon, or 'secret book'. This term is used to refer to early Christian writings that were written to teach 'secret knowledge' that wasn't allowed to be publicly taught.

• Book of Secrets was the first item voted off in a poll to find the worst quality 0 item on r/bindingofisaac, possibly leading to its quality increase in a later update.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: ??????; Repentance: Tome of knowledge]
fields.description: Gives the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor. [Repentance] If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.

Book of Shadows.title: Book of Shadows
Book of Shadows.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Upon use, creates a protective shield, nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Book of Shadows effect negates health loss from [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s, [machine: Devil Beggar] s, [machine: Hell Game] , and [machine: Confessional] .

• [Repentance+] Book of Shadows' quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 4.5 Volt: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns shielded wisps in the middle ring. The wisps have 1 health, but will not be damaged by blocking projectiles, and can only be destroyed on contact with enemies. When Book of Shadows is active, wisps are immune to all damage, allowing for easy melee kills.

• Car Battery: Doubles the duration of invulnerability.

• Cube of Meat and most other orbitals: Highly effective with Book of Shadows, as Isaac can run into enemies with an active shield to deal massive amounts of damage.

• Razor Blade: Can be used at no cost while the Book of Shadows shield is present, allowing damage to be significantly increased for the room.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blood Oath: If the book is used just before the knife stabs Isaac, he will not lose any health, nor gain any stat upgrades associated with the item.

• Blood Rights/IV Bag/Razor Blade: Does not prevent damage from these items.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • The Book of Shadows is an infamous book of religious texts and instructions for magical rituals found within the Neopagan religion of Wicca.

fields.description: Creates a protective shield, nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.

Book of Virtues.title: Book of Virtues
Book of Virtues.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: It is the starting item for Bethany.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac and fires small spectral tears alongside him. The wisps can block shots and deal contact damage to enemies, but take damage when doing so and will be destroyed when enough damage is taken.

• When a wisp is destroyed, the sound of fire being extinguished plays.

• • A normal wisp is white and blue, has 2 health and spectral tears which deal 3 damage, and is summoned in the middle ring.

• • A wisp's health can be represented by its size, shrinking as its health decreases.

• • Most wisps deal contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage. Doing damage this way usually destroys the wisp unless Isaac is invulnerable.

• Multiple wisps can exist at once. Some combinations have an upper limit of 26 wisps: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.

• If another active item is picked up, Book of Virtues will become a passive item that causes active items to spawn wisps when used, often with special effects.

• While held, changes the first Devil Room encountered to be an Angel Room, and increases the chance of an Angel Room appearing by 25%.

• Allows for Angel Rooms to appear even if a Deal with the Devil was taken before.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• It is the only passive item in the Library pool.

• If Isaac walks into a library for the first time with NO!, The Book of Virtues is very likely to appear.

• Because of this, when acquired from a library, the book cannot be rerolled by use of the D4, D100, a Dice Room, or getting hit as Tainted Eden.

• Whenever Isaac is invulnerable, the wisps are as well, but can still deal contact damage.

• Summoning a wisp while at the maximum will replace the most damaged wisp.

• While having 100% chance of Angel Room discovery, Isaac will not get teleported to a Devil Room by using some items which allow it. Instead, he will be teleported to the Angel Room, keeping his 100% chance of discovering an Angel Room. This can be used to get to the Angel Room on the first floor, where Devil/Angel Rooms do not naturally spawn, and still keep the 100% chance for the next floor.

• This item's passive effects also apply to active items in the consumable slot. (e.g. Tainted Bethany's Lemegeton, Tainted Jacob's Anima Sola, dice from Dice Bag, etc.)

• While the item can function as both passive and active item, it is treated as a passive item by NO!, Void, and XVII - The Stars?.

• This item is displayed in the Extra HUD as a passive item.

• It will take up one of Tainted Isaac's limited item slots.

sections.heading: No effect
sections.text: These combinations simply activate the other item, some of them also spawning a normal wisp.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: Wisps gain homing tears.

• BFFS!: Increases the tear size and doubles the damage of wisps.

• Book of Belial interaction: Can be stacked along with The Book of Belial, allowing you to carry 2 passive books and an activated item on top of them.

• 'M: If an active item is combined with the Book, only the active item is rerolled; the Book remains unchanged. If no active item is combined with the Book, the Book will be rerolled on use. 'M also cannot give Book of Virtues from rerolling other items, as it is considered a passive item.

• Car Battery: Doubles the spawned wisps on activation.

• Glowing Hourglass: Its wisps are kept between uses, allowing for wisp farming on the current floor by picking up Glowing Hourglass and using it to go back to the previous room before Glowing Hourglass was picked up.

• Tear Detonator: The wisps' tears are also detonated; the resulting tears are based on Isaac's own, rather than the wisps'.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Analog Stick: Wisps are unable to shoot diagonally, and will shoot orthogonally instead.

• Lodestone: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.

• NO!: Will not prevent Book of Virtues from spawning, as it's considered a passive item.

• Void: Book of Virtues is considered to be a passive item, so stat boosts will be gained by using Void on it and further uses of Void will not have the Book's effects.

• XVII - The Stars?: Book of Virtues will be removed if it's the oldest collected item, even if another active item is not being held.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Antibirth, it had a two-room charge but was purely an active item and lacked the effect where it combines with other active items.

• Bethany used to be able to use specific types of heart pickups to create special wisps, similarly to how Tainted Eve can make special blood clot familiars using certain hearts.

• Wisps would not take explosive damage and the book’s wisp limit was always 16, with wisps orbiting a first ring of 8 and then a second ring of 8 when the first was full.

• In Community Remix, it had a completely different effect where it functioned like Metronome but with a 6 room charge.

• This item is likely a reference to the 9 virtues of a person living in accord with the Holy Spirit, mentioned in Galatians 5.

• This is the only book item that can still appear if Isaac is holding NO!, due to being considered a passive item.

• If you have Birthright as Judas and another active item, both books will be under the active item; the Book of Belial on the bottom with the Book of Virtues above it. When the active item is used, you will get the effects of both books as well.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room from the one he is currently in (such as by teleporting to the previous room then using it again) will duplicate the wisps. Any extra wisps created from duplication on a filled ring will appear at the entrance of each room Isaac enters and shoot in the direction Isaac is currently shooting.

fields.description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.

Book of the Dead.title: Book of the Dead
Book of the Dead.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8):

• 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar.

• 20% chance for a friendly bone monster.

• • 66% chance for a Bony.

• • 33% chance for a Black Bony.

• [Repentance] When used, spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room (capped at 8):

• 80% chance for an orbital bone familiar.

• 20% chance for a friendly bone monster.

• • The bone monster starts as a Bony.

• • The Bony has a 25% chance to become a Black Bony.

• • The Bony or Black Bony has a 25% chance to become a Big Bony if a killed enemy has enough HP to meet the formula: 
baseHP + floor * stageHP * min(floor, 10) * 0.8 > 18 + floor * 3 * min(floor, 10) * 0.8

• • The Bony, Black Bony, or Big Bony has a 25% chance to become a Bone Fly.

• • The Bony, Black Bony, Big Bony, or Bone Fly has a 1% chance to become a Revenant.

• • There is an additional 8.33% chance for the bone monster to become a Revenant on Mausoleum / Gehenna / Sheol / Dark Room. [end edition note] 

• [edition rnr+] Spawning an enemy other than a Bony/Black Bony is only possible after dying at least once to said enemy on the save file.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Forsaken. [end edition note] 

• Orbital bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the time it was spawned and repel enemies that touch them.

• [Before Repentance] They block 3 shots or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.

• [Repentance] They block 1 shot or deal 2 ticks of contact damage before being destroyed.

• [Before Repentance] Bonies deal 5 contact damage and 5 damage with thrown bones.

• [Repentance] Bonies deal 8.7 contact damage and 6 damage with thrown bones.

• Black Bonies will explode on death, dealing 40 damage to enemies it hits. The explosion will not hurt Isaac. [Before Repentance] It will knock him back.

• Internally, the book tracks up to 32 positions each enemy was killed at in the current room, and uses those locations as spawn points for bone orbitals and Bonies.

• Using the book will always spawn at least 1, gives the rest a 66% chance for each location to spawn one, and can spawn up to 8 per use.

• • Having more locations than 8 will effectively increase the odds to spawn each.

• • If one of these locations doesn't spawn a bone orbital or Bony, it can still spawn one if the book is used in the same room without leaving. However, once a location spawns something, it cannot do so again.

• Using the book in a room that had no enemies or was re-entered does nothing and expends the charge.

• Orbital bones occupy the same area around Isaac as Blue Flies, meaning Isaac can have an incredibly dense ring of bone orbitals around him that nullifies most attacks.

• Non-hostile NPCs such as friendly enemies and Shopkeepers can also provide bone orbitals and Bonies when killed or destroyed.

• [Before Repentance] Destroying Black Poop will damage the friendly monsters acquired from this item.

• [Repentance] Frozen enemies (enemies killed by Uranus, Cube Baby, etc.) will not summon bone familiars unless their frozen bodies are shattered. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns tiny skull wisps on the inner ring. The wisps fire bones and spawn friendly Bonies when destroyed. The book will summon wisps regardless of whether or not there were enemies killed in the current room.

• Car Battery: Gives a higher chance to spawn bone orbitals or friendly enemies, and can spawn up to 16 per use.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards and enemies that are turned into pickups can't be animated.

• Baby-Bender: No effect.

• Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

• Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

• [Before Repentance] Contagion: Poison effect can spread to and kill friendly Bony.

• E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can't be animated.

• Eraser: Bonies erased via Eraser will never spawn again from Book of the Dead, greatly decreasing its power.

• [Repentance] Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can and will kill Bonies. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Mystery Egg]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Book of the Dead is a collection of ancient Egyptian funerary texts made out of papyrus, consisting of magic spells intended to assist a soul's journey through the Duat (underworld) and into the afterlife.

• The quote "Rise from the Grave" is a reference to the beginning screen of the video game Altered Beast.

• This item's effect may be a reference to the book of the dead from NetHack, which also summons multiple undead monsters around you.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If sufficiently many bone orbitals are created, other familiars may disappear. Collecting a new familiar or resuming the run will restore the missing familiars.
Bug note: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate friendly enemies and orbital bones.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
[Repentance] Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, Big Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.

Bookworm.title: Bookworm
Bookworm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bookworm is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †, giving Isaac a monocle after picking up 3 book items.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac fires tears from both eyes simultaneously 25% of the time.

• This effect stacks with items such as 20/20, The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, multiplying the number of tears.

• The chance of firing double tears is not affected by Luck.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list ( [Repentance] with the [code: book] tag).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• As Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus, it's not possible to cycle between three books to give both characters the transformation's effect. Each character needs to pick up three different books, meaning six books in total.

• [Repentance] Unlike 20/20, the damage of doubled tears is not reduced. Each of the doubled tear shots does full damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A bookworm is a person who's devoted to reading, especially books.

• Book of Virtues is the only passive item to contribute to the transformation.

• Bookworm can be very easily attained by going into a Library.

fields.description: Roughly 25% of the time, Isaac shoots an extra tear, like 20/20.

Boom!.title: Boom!
Boom!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Grants 10 Bombs.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item has a 1/7 chance to drop if Hornfel is killed in his second phase. [end edition note] 

• Effectively a much weaker version of Pyro, which grants 99 bombs instead of 10.

• [Repentance] Can appear as a pedestal item when using the 0 - The Fool? with 10 or more bombs in inventory. Multiple copies can spawn, depending on bomb quantity. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] No effect on Tainted ???. No extra poop pickups are granted.

fields.description: Grants 10 Bombs.

Booster Pack (Item).title: Booster Pack (Item)
Booster Pack (Item).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the passive item; the Afterbirth † content updates; Booster Packs]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Drops 5 random cards.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Of the 5 cards spawned, they will have the following chances to be a type of card.

• 1 out of 5 cards: 93.3% playing card, 6.67% special card

• 4 out of 5 cards: 76.7% Tarot card, 19.3% playing card, 4% special card

• Emergency Contact, Dice Shard and Cracked Key cannot be spawned by this item, as they are not considered cards.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Little Baggy: Spawns 5 random pills instead.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The mechanic of having one guaranteed playing card is a reference to booster packs in real life. Packs are guaranteed to contain a few cards of high rarity while the rest are randomly chosen. Each card can also be of an even rarer quality, illustrated here by the small chance of obtaining a special card.

• Booster Pack is from the Antibirth mod where it would drop 3 random cards instead of 5.

fields.description: Drops 5 random cards.

Bosses.title: Bosses
Bosses.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Bosses are very strong monsters found in Boss Rooms at the end of a floor. The boss at the end of the floor must be defeated to advance to the next floor. From Chapter 2 onwards, many of these non-final bosses can spawn as degraded bosses, or normal enemies. The same can go for mini-bosses, which can spawn on later floors as degraded mini-bosses. However, some bosses and mini-bosses cannot appear as degraded bosses at all. The boss for a particular floor is chosen from the pool of bosses for the chapters of the floor. After defeating Satan for the first time, bosses may also spawn as champions, which can change various attributes such as health, damage, and attack pattern. Upon defeat, most bosses drop an item from the Boss item pool as well as 1-2 Hearts of any kind.

Bosses boast additional resistances to status effects. Once a boss has been inflicted with a status, they become immune to further ones for a period of time lasting longer than the initial effect itself. Slowdown-causing items that require the enemy to stay within their area such as Night Light are nearly useless on bosses due to the immunity triggering from the first tick. On the other hand, whole-room slowdown and slowing creep, such as that from Stop Watch and Juicy Sack, ignore the immunity and affect bosses like normal enemies.

Additionally, some floors may spawn a room with a mini-boss.

In total, there are 102 bosses and 20 mini-bosses. 10 bosses were added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, 6 were added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †, and 30 bosses and 2 mini-bosses were added in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Originally, every boss and enemy in Binding of Isaac was going to resemble Isaac in some way. This is still the case for some.

• Double Trouble boss pools can have bosses from previous chapters [Before Repentance] and can be the same for both versions of that chapter's floor. This means that, for example, Double Trouble boss fights in The Caves can feature bosses from The Cellar or The Basement, [Before Repentance] and every Double Trouble fight in The Caves can also be encountered in The Catacombs.

• Bosses often come in three versions: normal (for example, Monstro), posthumous (Monstro II), and alternate (Gish). Usually, the posthumous boss looks like the original with some horrible mutilation; for example, Monstro and Chub had most of their skin ripped off.

• Most bosses and their alternate/posthumous forms either share similar death animations or share the fact that they lack death animations.

• Some bosses appear as evolved or larger versions of enemies (for example, Chub looks like a bigger Charger). Some even act as larger versions of other bosses (Little Horn and Big Horn).

Bot Fly.title: Bot Fly
Bot Fly.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a robotic Pooter familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.

• The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.

• The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.

• The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] Only 5 Bot Flies can circle Isaac at a time.

• While most orbital familiars orbit Isaac counter-clockwise, Bot Fly orbits clockwise. It shares this orbit ring, speed, and pattern with Distant Admiration.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • BFFS!: Increases contact damage but does not increase the damage of the tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bot Fly is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, the shots would home on projectiles only when paired with BFFS!.

• This item's name appears to be a play on the word "bot" when used as shorthand for "robot" and on "botfly", a parasitic insect which lives in tropical climates.

fields.description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.

Box.title: Box
Box.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Not to be confused with Moving Box or Pandora's Box.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns:

• 1 Penny

• 1 Key

• 1 Bomb

• 1 Red Heart

• 1 card/rune

• 1 pill

• 1 trinket

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Box's pickups can be of any variety:

• Coin: Nickel, Dime, Lucky, Sticky Nickel, Golden

• Bomb: 1+1 Bombs, Troll Bomb, Golden Bomb

• Heart: Double Heart, Half-Heart, Soul, Half-Soul, Black, Eternal, Gold, Bone, Rotten

• Key: Golden, Charged Key

• Card: Reversed Cards

• Rune: Soul Stones

• Pill: Horse or Golden pills

• Trinket: Golden Trinket

• [Repentance] Box's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• While walking to the right, Isaac's name can be seen written on the box.

• This item was the final item added in Wrath of the Lamb. The first one is Guppy's Paw.

fields.description: Spawns various pickups: 1 Penny, 1 Key, 1 Bomb, 1 Red Heart, 1 card/rune, 1 pill and 1 trinket.

Box of Friends.title: Box of Friends
Box of Friends.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: It is the starting item for Lilith.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Upon use, it adds one copy of each of Isaac's familiars for the duration of the current room.

• If Isaac has no familiars, a Demon Baby will spawn for the duration of the current room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If Isaac has more than one copy of the same familiar, it will still only add one copy.

• Blue Flies, Blue Spiders, and orbitals (Halo of Flies, Leprosy, etc) are not copied.

• [Repentance] It now copies some orbitals.

• Many familiars can be spawned in Greed mode and Boss Rush, as completing waves charges the item.

• [Repentance] Familiars with the uniquefamiliar item tag are ignored by Box of Friends. If Isaac has only unique familiars, a Demon Baby is spawned.

• [Repentance] The item will cost 10 cents if found in a Shop.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Ball of Bandages / Cube of Meat / Potato Peeler: Upgrades the cube/ball for the current room. This can be used to easily unlock the Super Meat Boy and Bandage Girl achievements.

• [Repentance] Cubes of Meat from Potato Peeler cannot be duplicated or upgraded.

• Blood Puppy: Tames an angry Blood Puppy and spawns another temporary one.

• Bob's Brain: When used upon entering a room, Box of Friends eliminates the item delay, which allows Isaac to launch Bob's Brain immediately.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns black wisps on the middle ring. After creating a wisp, Box of Friends also gives temporary copies of all of Isaac's wisps, including any extra copies Box of Friends made.

• Car Battery: Adds two copies of each familiar.

• Charged Baby: All around useful, can charge box of friends mid room to spawn more of itself creating a charging loop.

• Daddy Longlegs: Familiar will be copied.

• Incubus: Creates additional Incubus familiars, which share the same tear modifiers as the player.

• Lil Dumpy: Will copy Lil Dumpy, effectively adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's Holy Mantle-like protection.

• This process can be repeated to make Isaac near-invincible.

• Smart Fly: Very useful on Greed mode, as using it will add an attacking fly, killing enemies and bosses very quickly.

• Twisted Pair: Creates additional Twisted Pairs with the same tear modifiers as the player. Multiple twisted pairs will line up horizontally, covering a broader area.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• ???'s Soul / Dead Bird / Eve's Bird Foot / Isaac's Head / Scissors: These familiars are not copied.

• 1up! / Dead Cat: Familiars are multiplied but do not give Isaac additional lives.

• 1up! / Dead Cat: No longer copies the familiar either.

• Abyss: Flies gained from Abyss do not count as familiars for Box of Friends, and are not copied.

• Best Bud: If used before taking damage, the white fly will circle Isaac. However, multiple white flies cannot be spawned, so using Box of Friends after taking damage or using it multiple times in a room creates no effect.

• Buddy in a Box: Creates another randomly generated familiar, rather than copying the same one.

• Bumbo: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.

• Tinytoma: Сreates an orbital even if it is destroyed. If the copy splits into smaller versions, they will remain when moving between rooms.

• Guillotine: Duplicates the Head circling Isaac's body. Only one head will shoot tears.

• Considers the second head as an extra copy, granting Isaac a temporary stat boost for the room

• Hallowed Ground: All poop familiars turn into white poop at the same time, and their effects are accumulative. A new poop familiar appears even if the previous poops have been used up.

• Isaac's Heart / Super Bum: Not copied. They will not spawn a Demon Baby if no other valid familiars are found, unlike other familiars that aren't copied.

• Key Piece 1 / Key Piece 2: Key pieces are multiplied, but do not complete the other half.

• [Repentance] Key pieces are not copied.

• Knife Piece 1 / Knife Piece 2: Knife pieces and the knife are not copied.

• Lil Spewer: Creates a random spewer rather than copying the current one.

• Lost Soul: Cannot be duplicated.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Milk!: The familiar itself doesn't appear, but instead, it decreases tear delay by 2 (effective tears up) when used, without needing to take damage.

• [Repentance] No extra tear delay is granted, neither before or after breaking.

• Monster Manual: Familiars spawned by Monster Manual are not copied. It will still spawn a Demon Baby if a familiar from Monster Manual is generated and there are no other valid familiars that can be duplicated.

• Multidimensional Baby: Each copy of Multidimensional Baby follows the previous copy with a 2-second ( [Repentance] 0.66-second) delay. Tears shot through multiple babies will only be duplicated once.

• Pickup generation familiars: The copied familiars will drop pickups independently.

• Quints: Existing Quints familiars will not be duplicated, nor more will be created. If Isaac has no other familiars, the generated Demon Baby will hover with the Quints instead of following Isaac.

• Shade: A new follower Shade spawns even if Isaac has already absorbed the original.

• XV - The Devil?: The Seraphim familiar is not copied.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Box of Friends seems to resemble the Lament Configuration of the Lemarchand's box from Clive Barker's Hellraiser.

• Box of Friends is the only active item to have its charge rate changed twice. On initial release, it recharged in 2 rooms. Then an update on November 4, 2015 increased the recharge time to 4 rooms. Finally, in Repentance, its recharge time was decreased to 3 rooms.

• [Before Afterbirth+] When playing in Korean, this item still has a recharge time of 2.

• In the game files this item's sprite is called "Pandora's Box" by mistake.

fields.description: Duplicates all of Isaac's familiars for the current room. If Isaac has no familiars, spawns a Demon Baby for the room instead.

Box of Spiders.title: Box of Spiders
Box of Spiders.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Spawns 1-4 Blue Spiders.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Rag Man. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Hive Mind: Doubles the spiders' damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns wisps instead of spiders, in the outer ring. Wisps summon Blue Spiders when destroyed. One wisp contains one Blue Spider.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • A box full of spiders is an old way of getting your kids to stop misbehaving. The child is handed a box with a supposed gift inside, only to be scared by spiders as punishment.

fields.description: Spawns [Before Repentance] 1-4 / [Repentance] 4-8 Blue Spiders where Isaac is standing.

Bozo.title: Bozo
Bozo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.1 flat damage.

• Grants a Soul Heart.

• Enemies may randomly become briefly charmed or feared.

• Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn Rainbow Poop.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • None of the above effects are affected by luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Blood Oath: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.

• IV Bag: Each use has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop.

• With max red hearts, The Wafer, and careful timing to get the maximum healing from each rainbow poop, Isaac's effective health pool could be extremely high.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Bozo is based on this Steam Workshop item by electoon.

• This item is a reference to Bozo the Clown, a clown character whose broad popularity peaked in the 1960s.

• The item's ability to inflict fear may be a reference to coulrophobia, the fear of clowns.

• [Repentance] This item shares a description with the item Free Lemonade. [end edition note]

fields.description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.

Brain Worm.title: Brain Worm
Brain Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Pin, Larry Jr., The Hollow or Scolex. [end edition note] 

• The effect will not work if Isaac is too close to enemies.

• The effect will only work if the tear has a line of sight to the enemy: if it's interrupted by an obstacle, Brain Worm won't work even if Isaac has enough tear height to otherwise clear it unless he also possesses spectral tears.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: Tears will snap to enemies after they're released, but not while the tears are staying in place.

• Brimstone / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation / Technology / Technology 2: Laser will snap regardless of length from enemy. Also works with Azazel's Brimstone.

• Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Both the main and split tears are affected by Brain Worm.

• Dr. Fetus: No effect on bombs.

• Eye of the Occult: Tears briefly snap to target enemies but Isaac's control quickly takes over them.

• Homing tears: Override Brain Worm.

• The Ludovico Technique: No effect.

• Mom's Knife: No effect.

• Tech X: No effect.

• Tractor Beam: No Effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either makes shots have a 25% chance to pierce. Having both increase the chance to 50%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Brain Worm originates from the Antibirth mod.

• The name, appearance and effect of the trinket are likely inspired by the Brain enemy.

• The trinket might be a reference to Parelaphostrongylus tenuis, a real life brain worm commonly found in white-tailed deer.

fields.description: Tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.

Booster Packs.title: Booster Packs
Booster Packs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the Afterbirth † content updates; the passive item; Booster Pack (Item)] 
Booster Packs were recurring content updates for The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †. Booster Packs contained popular community-developed mods as updates in the game continued to add features.

sections.heading: Booster Pack # [anchor: 1]
sections.text: The first Booster Pack was released on March 23, 2017 on PC, and contains 9 new items, 3 new trinkets, and 3 new special cards, along with some new features.

sections.heading: Other Features
sections.text:
• Dice Rooms now have a small icon in the corner of the room that denotes what the effect of the room is, inspired by this Steam Workshop mod.

• Added a new option in the menu to display charge bars, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

• Added 5 new Eden hairstyles, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

sections.heading: Booster Pack # [anchor: 2]
sections.text: The second Booster Pack was released on May 12, 2017 on PC, and contains 6 new items, 1 new trinket, and miscellaneous changes.

sections.heading: Other Features
sections.text:
• Angel Rooms were rebalanced - they contain more items but only a single one can be collected.

• Mods no longer disable achievements after beating Mom once. This includes the use of the Debug Console.

• Active items now charge during Challenge Room waves.

• Multiple items that affect the appearance of bombs now stack visually, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

• Jar of Flies now changes appearance depending on how many flies are in the jar, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

• Added Mom's Dressing Table, which changes Isaac's appearance to only reflect a few of his items, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

• Added the Stompy transformation.

sections.heading: Booster Pack # [anchor: 3]
sections.text: The third Booster Pack was released on June 30, 2017, for the PC, and contains 4 new items, and 1 trinket.

sections.heading: Other Features
sections.text: • Added new Eden hairstyles, based on this Steam Workshop mod.

sections.heading: Booster Pack # [anchor: 4]
sections.text: The fourth Booster Pack was released on October 10, 2017 and contains 5 new items, 1 new trinket, and 6 new enemies.

sections.heading: Other Features
sections.text:
• Most items from previous Booster Packs have new and improved graphics.

• Broken Modem collectible sprite was changed.

• Technology Zero collectible and costume sprites were changed.

• Angry Fly collectible and familiar sprites were changed.

• Sprinkler collectible and entity sprites were changed.

• 7 Seals collectible and familiar sprites were changed. Familiar sprites were based on this Steam Workshop mod by Quartz.

• Pop! collectible sprite was changed.

• Hairpin trinket sprite was changed.

• Butter! trinket sprite was changed.

• Door Stop trinket sprite was changed.

• Added 400 new rooms to better integrate the Afterbirth+ enemies (including Booster Pack #4 enemies) into the game.

sections.heading: Booster Pack # [anchor: 5]
sections.text: The fifth and last Booster Pack was released on April 30, 2018 and contains 1 new character, 18 new items, 3 new trinkets, 7 new enemies, and a new boss.

sections.heading: Characters

• Gaping Maws supposedly have a chance to become Broken Gaping Maws, although this never actually happens ingame.

• Changes to [mode: greed] Greed mode Angel Rooms.

Ring Cap.title: Ring Cap
Ring Cap.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Whenever Isaac places a Bomb, an extra bomb is spawned next to the original.

• This does not consume more than one bomb pickup.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The extra bomb spawns in a random location adjacent to the original.

• The additional bomb is affected by any items that affect bombs.

• Ring Cap will also work with Giga Bombs collected via Safety Scissors.

• Can be used to open the door to Bedrooms and the Mines / Ashpit with only one bomb.

• This trinket has no effect on the Explosive Diarrhea pill.

• The bombs explode simultaneously with each other, without risk of any being launched.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Places 1 extra bomb per copy.

• Blasting Cap: The extra bomb also has a chance to drop a bomb pickup.

• Nancy Bombs: Grants a random bomb effect to each bomb separately.

• Rocket in a Jar: Fires two rockets simultaneously.

• Bob's Rotten Head

Ring Worm.title: Ring Worm
Ring Worm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears travel in a high-speed spiral pattern.

• [Repentance] Also grants +0.4 Tears and spectral tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This trinket has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Pin, Larry Jr., The Hollow or Scolex. [end edition note] 

• The tear pattern slightly increases Isaac's effective range.

• [Before Repentance] The trinket has no effect on any non-tear based attack, such as Brimstone or Mom's Knife.

• [Repentance] The trinket now affects all tear/non-tear modifiers, with the only exceptions being Dr. Fetus, Epic Fetus and Tech X, which don't work.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket/Mom's Box: In addition to the further stat increase, each copy makes the spiral path larger.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Backstabber: Due to the unusual tear travel, Ring Worm may be used to hit enemies in the back, without having the need to be placed behind them.

• Tractor Beam: The altered pattern tears travel in is confined to the beam.

• [Repentance] Isaac can benefit from Ring Worm's stat bonus and spectral tears without losing accuracy.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The bullet pattern might be a reference to a power-up in the NES game Uncle Fester's Quest.

• Ring worm (or Dermatophytosis) is a fungal infection very common in children and teenagers. It involves scaly rings on the skin of the scalp, chest, arms, stomach and other places, and is not caused by any sort of worm despite its name.

fields.name: Ring Worm

Rock Bottom.title: Rock Bottom
Rock Bottom.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Prevents Isaac's attributes from falling below their highest values reached.

• Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Health downs do not count as stat downgrades for Rock Bottom.

• Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off.

• For example, using The Book of Belial to gain +2 damage will stay in effect indefinitely, but while it's not currently activated, Isaac must earn more than +2 damage from other items to see a difference. The Book of Belial can then be used once again to stack on top of that new floor, so the damage "lost" to make up for the original temporary bonus isn't really wasted.

• Stacking as many temporary buffs at once as possible may be helpful to reach particularly high values.

• Temporary positive multipliers are not retained, only the values reached through them are.

• Stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.

• Optimally, any available increases to a particular stat should be taken before taking the item that lowers it.

• Permanent negative multipliers, such as Soy Milk, work as expected: after the internal damage value is dropped to 0.2×, it would require over 5× increase in damage from other items and effects afterwards to start increasing the best value again.

• If Rock Bottom is removed, Isaac's stats will no longer be locked and return to match his current items/effects.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
Refer to the articles on Damage, Tears, Range, Shot Speed, Speed, and Luck for lists of items granting otherwise temporary boosts.

• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / Conjoined: Multiple tears will be shot without the source's respective stat downgrades. The damage and tear multipliers will still affect future stat ups.

• Azazel's Stump: Isaac will keep Azazel’s base stats after transforming back. This includes 1.25 base speed, +0.5 tears per second, and a 1.5× damage. The tear delay multiplier will not be given, including while Isaac is Azazel.

• Berserk!: +3 flat damage and +0.4 speed last indefinitely. Will also give a tears up if (½ tears fired per second + 2), unless Isaac’s tears fired per second is already 4 or higher.

• Binge Eater: Speed down from picking up food items no longer applies, and all temporary stat boosts are permanent.

• Brimstone / Chocolate Milk / Monstro's Lung: Charged shot can be fired at Isaac’s normal fire rate.

• VII - The Chariot?: The 4x fire rate bonus from the card makes it possible to reach and keep extremely high values.

• Clicker: Will keep stat bonuses from items removed, and will retain the best stats of all characters that are cycled through.

• D8 / Cracked Dice: With repeated use, 1.5-2× higher values can be applied to Isaac’s speed, tears, range, and damage.

• Dataminer: If one overflows Isaac's tear rate to 120 before picking up Rock Bottom, the tear rate stays at 120.

• Deck of Cards /Ace of Spades: Allows for more cards to spawn, which can then all be used in the same room to maximize stats gained.

• Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: Gives 2× damage multiplier without immediate reduction to tears or shot speed.

• False PHD: When using a pill applies only the damage up with no downside.

• The Forgotten / The Soul: Allows transfer of stat-ups between the two. For example, collecting Ipecac as The Forgotten doesn't give him the +40 damage boost, but it does give it to The Soul. Switching to the Soul, then switching back to the Forgotten prevents him from losing the +40 damage.

• Ipecac: Gives Isaac a massive damage up without the tears down.

• Ipecac + Brimstone / Tech X: If Ipecac is taken before Brimstone / Tech X, its full damage up is applied to the beam/ring properly, but if the order of the items is reversed, Ipecac will only give +2 damage.

• Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: Only the character that has Rock Bottom will be immune to stat downgrades.

• Jupiter: The +0.5 speed boost becomes permanent, turning Jupiter into a +0.2 speed up. Farts made while moving still must be charged by standing still.

• Kidney Stone: Permanently gives Isaac a ×6 fire rate multiplier after firing a kidney stone. Accuracy penalty from firing kidney stones is unaffected.

• Libra: Stat balancing applies after Rock Bottom.

• Metronome: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run. This allows Isaac to potentially accrue a large number of stat upgrades.

• Neptunus: Not affected by Rock Bottom. Fire Rate will decrease normally.

• Perfection: The large luck boost remains even if Perfection is lost.

• Purity: Allows for all stat boosts given by Purity to stay active at the same time.

• Red Stew: The +21.6 damage is permanent.

• Razor Blade / Golden Razor: Can be used multiple times in one room for a large permanent damage boost.

• Soy Milk / Almond Milk: Gives Isaac the full tears up while keeping his previous damage; however, the damage divider still applies to any future damage increases.

• Tainted Eden + Birthright: If Rock Bottom is picked up before Birthright, it is protected from being rerolled, allowing Tainted Eden to retain the highest stats they have reached.

• This reroll protection is even effective against similar reroll effects such as D4 and Missing No..

• Tainted Isaac: Prevents any stat from decreasing, letting the effects of picked up items linger even after discarding them. However, raising stats beyond the values reached will be more difficult after leaving the source item, and swapping away Rock Bottom resets them to Tainted Isaac's current set. Picking it up again will not give the stats back.

• Taurus: Prevents Isaac's speed from dropping whenever a room is cleared.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Rock Bottom originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, Rock Bottom could also appear from tinted rocks and Experimental Treatment was still able to lower Isaac's stats.

• This item is likely a reference to the stone that Jacob slept on when he dreamt of a ladder to heaven; upon awakening, he covers the stone in oil and dedicates it to the area where he had the vision, which he names Bethel. Its name is also a reference to the expression "Hitting rock bottom", which means being emotionally overwhelmed.

• The main cosmetic difference when holding this item is that Isaac faces upward slightly and stops visually crying, which may be a play on the term "things are looking up".

• Contrary to popular belief, Rock Bottom does not set Isaac's stats to the starting values. This was confirmed by Kilburn in the Binding of Isaac Discord server, when he stated that it doesn't do that and has never done that, even in the original release of Antibirth.

fields.description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.

Rocket in a Jar.title: Rocket in a Jar
Rocket in a Jar.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds 5 Bombs.

• If any firing input is given when placing a bomb, a fast-moving, explosive rocket will be shot in the direction corresponding to the input.

• The rockets accept analog firing input. This means they can be shot diagonally or in any other angle with a mouse or joystick.

• Isaac will place a regular bomb if no firing input is received.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Rockets use Isaac's bomb synergies like his bombs normally would.

• Rockets are unaffected by Isaac's shot speed.

• Rockets can be boosted by Brimstone lasers and Hemoptysis sneezes.

• Bosses such as Chub or Carrion Queen can swallow the rockets just like regular bombs.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bob's Bladder: Rockets leave creep, albeit slowly.

• Bobby-Bomb: Rockets become homing.

• Dr. Fetus: Shoots rockets as normal tears. All synergies that would normally apply are given to the rockets.

• Giga Bombs: Fires a giant rocket that moves slower and has the same effects as a normal Giga Bomb.

• Ring Cap: Fires two rockets simultaneously.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Best Friend/Bob's Rotten Head/Epic Fetus/Mr. Boom: No effect.

• Blasting Cap: Rockets can drop bomb pickups.

• Marked: Rockets will fly to the location of the crosshair.

• Sticky Bombs: Rockets will not stick onto enemies.

• Remote Detonator: Rockets do not explode on impact with surfaces, requiring manual detonation.

• Remote Detonator + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will still explode on impact, but can be manually detonated.

• Worm trinkets: Rocket's trajectory is unaffected.

• Wiggle Worm + Dr. Fetus: Rocket will wiggle from side to side mid-flight. This is the only worm trinket that affects Rocket in a Jar.

• My Reflection: No effect.

• My Reflection + Dr. Fetus: Rockets fired with Dr. Fetus will turn back at Isaac, but will not explode in contact with the player. However, it will explode after a duration, possibly damaging Isaac.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Rocket in a Jar originates from the Antibirth mod.

• Rocket in a Jar resembles a missile tank upgrade from the Nintendo franchise Metroid.

fields.description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.

Roid Rage.title: Roid Rage
Roid Rage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] +0.6 speed

• [Before Repentance] +5.25 range

• [Repentance] +0.3 speed

• [Repentance] +2.5 range

Rosary.title: Rosary
Rosary.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants 3 Soul Hearts.

• Items in all pools have a \frac{1}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}} chance to be replaced by The Bible.

• The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.

• [Repentance] +0.5 tears.

• Contributes to the Seraphim transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If The Bible has been picked up before collecting the Rosary, it will not replace other items.

• The Bible can be encountered multiple times even in the same pool if it is not picked up; however, once picked up, it cannot appear again anywhere.

• [Repentance] Collecting more than one Rosary will further increase the chance of finding The Bible. The above limitations still apply, and it can be collected only once no matter the number of Rosaries.

• This item stacks with Rosary Bead, further increasing the chance to find The Bible in the Library and Shop.

• [Rebirth only] The approximate chances of finding The Bible in each item pool are:

• Treasure Room: 2.26%

• Shop: 12.82%

• Boss: 11.36%

• Devil Room: 12.82%

• Angel Room: 20.83%

• Secret Room: 20.83%

• Library: 45.45%

• Golden Chest: 55.56%

• Red Chest: 71.43%

• Beggar: 27.78%

• Devil Beggar: 45.45%

• Curse Room: 38.46%

• Key Master: 71.43%

• • The probabilities after Rebirth have not been computed, though the chances are pretty similar to the ones shown above. This is because the smaller the item pool, the more likely the Bible is to appear, and this effect is far more pronounced than the Bible simply being added to each pool. So, for example, the Bible is much more likely to appear from a Red Chest compared to the Treasure Room.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Faith up; Repentance: Tears + faith up]
fields.description: Grants 3 Soul Hearts. The Bible has a chance to appear in any item pool. [Repentance] +0.5 tears.

Rosary Bead.title: Rosary Bead
Rosary Bead.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] Increases the chance to have an Angel Room replace a Devil Room, from 50% (base chance) to 75%.

• [Repentance+] Guarantees Angel Rooms instead of Devil Rooms, whenever one would spawn.

• Increases the chance to find The Bible to 45% in the Library and in the Shop to 13%.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Future items in all item pools have a chance to be replaced by a Rosary while the trinket is held.

• One boost results in a \frac{4}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}} chance, and both boosts results in a \frac{6}{\mathit{SumOfPoolItemsWeight}} chance.

• The above means Rosaries are much more easily found in smaller pools. As an example, the chance for a replacement in the Treasure Room is on the order of 1%, but for the Planetarium they can be as high as ~36% or ~55% depending on the number of boosts.

• The replaced items will count as seen, which may result in them never being available again depending on the item pool.

• Picking up a Rosary will not remove the chance of finding more.

• [Repentance+] Increases Angel Room chance by 5%. Having both increases it by 10%.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance+] The increased chance will not allow Angel Rooms to appear before Chapter 2.

• [edition rnr+] Due to an Angel Room being guaranteed after skipping the first Devil Deal, Rosary Bead only increases in usefulness after the first Angel Room has been encountered.

• If a [Before Repentance+] Devil, [Before Repentance] Black Market, or Satanic Bible deal has been paid, an Angel Room will not spawn, even with Rosary Bead.

• [Repentance] An Angel Room can still spawn if Isaac has Act of Contrition or Book of Virtues. [end edition note] 

• Unlike Goat Head or The Book of Belial, this trinket does not increase the chance for an Angel/Devil Room Door to spawn when a Boss is killed. It only increases the chance for it to be an Angel room if it does appear.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Despite indicating "Faith Up", there is no "Faith" stat in the game. "Faith Up" only serves to inform the player that it is linked to Angel Rooms in an unspecified way.

fields.name: Rosary Bead
fields.description: Increases the chance of finding The Bible in the Library and Shop, and [Before Repentance+] increases the chance of Angel Rooms appearing / [Repentance+] guarantees Angel Rooms instead of Devil Rooms.

Rotten Baby.title: Rotten Baby
Rotten Baby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar which spawns friendly blue flies in a room with monsters when Isaac holds down a fire key.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] This item can rarely drop from destroying polyps in Corpse. [end edition note] 

• Spawns one Fly at a time.

• Blue Flies deal 2x Isaac's damage.

• Flies will be generated regardless of Isaac's ability to fire tears normally.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Rotten Baby having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:

• Mongo Baby: Mongo Baby will also spawn flies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Rotten Baby becomes larger, but this is only a cosmetic change.

• Hive Mind: Fly damage is doubled.

• The Twins: Unlimited flies can be slowly generated by walking back and forth between rooms while firing. A new fly will generate each time Rotten Baby is duplicated.

sections.heading: Trivia

sections.heading: Bugs
