• This cannot be done if Isaac is holding the item Remote Detonator as the bombs will not explode until Isaac uses his active item, damaging him, unless he has an item that gives him explosion immunity (Ex: Pyromaniac)

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 7 Seals: One of the more versatile familiars that works with Gnawed Leaf. The varied forms and attacks of this familiar make it capable of clearing pretty much any room given time. The locusts it produces often fly to Isaac which takes care of chasing enemies, but its damaging creep and chasing attacks can reach even the farthest enemies.

• 120 Volt: With enough damage, 120 Volt's zaps becomes far more efficient at killing than orbitals.

• At 15 damage minimum, it surpasses most orbitals.

• At 30 damage or more, it surpasses Sacrificial Dagger.

• Angry Fly: Aggressively attacks enemies even if they're far away, but can end up harmlessly orbiting slow or stationary enemies indefinitely, or trying to attack invulnerable enemies. It does better with slow or stationary bosses than regular enemies, diving in to attack periodically instead of harmlessly orbiting.

• Daddy Longlegs: Allows Isaac to easily clear most rooms or bosses while in statue form. Daddy Longlegs cannot damage bosses like The Shell and won't target enemies that are a long distance from Isaac. In a pinch, Mom's Toenail works the same, albeit much slower.

• Damocles: If Isaac is in statue form when the sword falls, he will survive.

• Dark Arts: While Isaac is surrounded by enemies, he will not take damage and will safely go into the shadow state. (Even if enemies are in pointblank range.)

• Decap Attack: The head can be used on stationary bosses to wither them down.

• E. Coli /Midas' Touch /Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: Monsters touching the statue will be affected without Isaac taking collision damage.

• Empty Vessel: if Empty Vessel's requirement is fulfilled, Isaac can safely wait for the shield to activate, allowing to deal damage without leaving invulnerability.

• IBS: Orbitals and other things (such as 120 Volt) can trigger IBS while in statue form, however, Isaac will still be invincible. This can be really good if a Stinky Poop is held above his head.

• Kamikaze!: Statue form will break, but the initial explosion will not damage Isaac, therefore granting Isaac quasi-unlimited bombs.

• The Ludovico Technique: The hovering tear will still deal damage and the statue form won't break as long as the attack buttons aren't being pressed.

• The Ludovico Technique + Strange Attractor: Can pull enemies in while remaining a statue, clearing out rooms easily.

• Mom's Knife: The knife can damage enemies while Isaac is a statue.

• [Repentance] Mom's Heels: While invincible, Isaac can still deal contact damage.

• Monstrance: The aura makes quick work of chasing enemies.

• The Pinking Shears: Isaac's body will attack enemies while his head is invincible.

• Placenta: Isaac can safely regenerate Red Hearts in any room, making it easy to have enough health from any mistake at the cost of time.

• Robo-Baby 2.0: Since it fires automatically, this familiar is one of the more effective synergies, since it will even shoot off screen as it’s knocked around.

• Salvation: The aura can trigger from nearby enemies while Isaac is safely a statue, and the damaging beams when this happens can reach farther enemies. This powerful attack can make quick work of bosses that chase Isaac.

• Spin to Win: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac.

• Sprinkler: Can be placed upon entering a room, and will continue to fire when Isaac is invincible, meaning any room can be cleared without the risk of Isaac taking damage. This theoretically allows end-game bosses to be beaten without having to move.

• Super Magnet: Pulls enemies into Isaac, can be extremely powerful if combined with orbitals that allow contact damage.

• [Repentance] Tainted Magdalene: Tainted Magdalene's "Hug" attack still triggers when in the statue state without taking damage, making short work of aggressive enemies as well as providing lots of healing.

• [Repentance] Tainted Forgotten: The Soul is invincible as long as the bone club is not used and The Forgotten is not thrown, even if The Soul is holding The Forgotten and moving around. Combined with orbitals that deal contact damage like Cube of Meat or items that can trigger damage only by movement such as Purgatory, can make for a trivial method to beat any boss.

• Yes Mother?: When worst comes to worst and Isaac has no orbitals or familiars, the knife can be used to deal damage, due to how common the transformation is.

• Tooth and Nail: Allows one second to act and/or reposition without taking damage. Useful in situations such as ranged combat when enemies bombard from a distance, or to attack and move to a safe distance where Isaac can safely regain statue form.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 2Spooky: Counterintuitive and should be avoided, as most enemies will never approach orbital range.

• The Bible: Statue invulnerability will not prevent death when the Bible is activated during Satan fight.

• Blood Oath: Standing still at the start of a level will block Blood Oath's damage, preventing it from activating.

• Blood Rights / IV Bag / Razor Blade: Statue invulnerability will not prevent damage from these items when activated.

• Book of Virtues / Lemegeton: Wisps are invincible while invulnerable.

• Jacob and Esau: If Esau picks up the item, he can remain invulnerable even when Jacob is moving but not when firing.

• Tainted Jacob / Jacob and Esau: If Tainted Jacob/Esau picks up the item, Tainted Esau/Jacob will be able to push a character into a Curse Room without taking damage.

• The Gamekid / My Little Unicorn / Unicorn Stump: Statue form can activate while invulnerable.

• Short Fuse: Bombs explode before invincibility kicks in.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the Super Leaf from Super Mario Bros. 3, which grants the player the Tanooki suit. The Tanooki Suit also has a tanooki tail and the ability to turn into a statue.

• [Repentance] When paired with Midas' Touch, the statue gains a golden tint.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Leaving and re-entering a run while in statue form makes Isaac continue to appear in statue form, though he is vulnerable.
Bug note: Moving as Tainted Forgotten doesn't disable Gnawed Leaf. (Attacking however, does)

fields.description: After standing still and not shooting for a short time, Isaac turns invincible until he moves or shoots.

Goat Head.title: Goat Head
Goat Head.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Sets the Devil Room chance to 100% regardless of all other modifiers, guaranteeing a Devil Room or Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and remain open.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Even if taken after a boss is killed, Goat Head will force a Devil / Angel Room door to spawn on that floor.

• Taking a deal with the Devil will prevent Angel Rooms from appearing, meaning Goat Head must be acquired from another source for an Angel Room to spawn.

• [edition anr] Goat Head will not force a Devil / Angel Room door to open if the boss fight was in a narrow room.

• [Afterbirth onward] Goat Head has no effect in Greed mode and is not normally available.

• It can still be a starting item for Eden, a bonus item from Eden's Blessing, and is obtainable with Pandora's Box and Sacrificial Altar. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] By touching the white fire in Downpour II and Dross II, Isaac will temporarily become The Lost. After defeating the boss, Goat Head will always keep the devil deal door open, allowing the Lost to take one Devil Deal item for free. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Black Feather: Grants a damage boost.

• Duality: Both Angel and Devil Room doors spawn after every boss, and the selected door will never disappear.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Eucharist: Overrides Goat Head.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to how goats and their blood were often used as a common sacrifice proxy. This is even more evident by the pickup quote.

• This item actually sets devil deal chance to 6660% under the hood, but the value is truncated in the HUD.

fields.description: A Devil Room / Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.

Goat Hoof.title: Goat Hoof
Goat Hoof.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• +0.15 speed.

• [Before Repentance] Also affects maximum speed, may never exceed 2.0.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket/Mom's Box: Having either increases speed by 0.3. Having both by 0.45.

fields.description: +0.15 speed.

God's Flesh.title: God's Flesh
God's Flesh.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Tears now have a [Before Repentance+] 10% / [Repentance+] 20% chance to apply a shrinking effect, causing enemies to shrink in size and also run away from Isaac.

• Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.

• [Repentance] Enemies that spawn from the death of a shrunken enemy will also be shrunken upon spawning. [Repentance+] Enemies that release projectiles, explosions or other effects such as Soul Suckers no longer perform their effect when killed while shrunken.

• The shrinking effect lasts 5 seconds [Repentance+] and enemies will flash white when the effect is about to end.

• Contributes to the Fun Guy transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The shrinking effect does not affect bosses or mini-bosses.

• [Before Repentance+] Champions and enemies that explode upon death will damage Isaac if crushed.

• Shrinking the heart of a Mask + Heart will cause its corresponding Mask to shrink as well. The Mask can be crushed and killed separately.

• The chance to fire a shrinking tear does not scale with Luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Compound Fracture / Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Split tears will retain shrinking effect if main tear had shrinking effect. With Compound Fracture and The Parasite, tears with a shrinking effect look like normal tears.

• Finger!: Finger can also apply the shrinking effect.

• Lachryphagy: Will occasionally fire tears with shrinking effect. All burst tears have a chance to apply the shrinking effect.

• The Ludovico Technique: Tear flickers blue, capable of shrinking enemies when it does.

• Technology Zero: Electricity connected to tears with shrinking effect has a chance to shrink enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Blood Puppy: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.

• Haemolacria: Only main tear has a chance to apply a shrinking effect.

• Brimstone / Azazel: Brimstone laser becomes blue.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The term God's flesh is a nickname for psychedelic mushrooms.

• In Aztec culture, hallucinogenic mushrooms were eaten during religious ceremonies. The Aztec name for these mushrooms translates to "god's flesh".

• It may also be a reference to Industrial/Experimental Metal band Godflesh.

• The effects of this item are similar to the Shrinker from Duke Nukem 3D, including the ability to kill shrunken enemies by stepping on them.

fields.description: Tears have a chance to shrink enemies, making them run away from Isaac. Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.

Godhead.title: Godhead
Godhead.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.5 Damage.

• -0.3 Tears.

• -0.3 Shot Speed.

• [Before Repentance] +1.2 Range.

• [Before Repentance] +0.8 Tear Falling Speed.

• Grants homing tears.

• Tears gain a damaging aura.

• [Before Repentance] The aura deals 30% of Isaac's damage 15 times per second.

• [Repentance] The aura deals 2 damage 30 times per second.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Godhead is a special item.

• The hitbox of the aura is increased with the size of Isaac's tears.

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with a Red Heart, Soul Heart, Gold Heart, and five Eternal Hearts.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Bob's Rotten Head: Creates a Godhead aura around the head and applies homing effect when thrown.

• Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Main tears and burst tears retain all effects.

• Explosivo/Mucormycosis: Causes damaging aura to grow once attached to an enemy.

• Euthanasia: The aura of a needle tear will also do triple damage, but does not cause tear burst or instant kill.

• Glass Cannon: The huge tear gains the homing ability and a much larger, more powerful damaging aura.

• Lachryphagy: Fired tears and burst tears retain aura and homing effect.

• Piercing tears: When a tear bursts, the 8 smaller tears' auras can stack, doing massive damage to enemies within.

• The Ludovico Technique: Tear increases in size and gains the damaging aura effect.

• [Repentance] Tear also gains homing effect. May cause the tear to get stuck near enemies.

• A Lump of Coal: The size and damage of the aura increases as long as the tear is on screen.

• [Repentance] Only the size of the aura increases.

• Pulse Worm: The aura increases and decreases in size.

• Saturnus: The orbiting tears also have the damaging aura, but without the homing effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dr. Fetus: Bombs retain the homing effect, but don't receive a damaging aura.

• Epic Fetus: The crosshair homes in upon enemies, but neither the crosshair nor the missiles receive the damaging aura.

• Gello / Tainted Lilith: The cosmetic change also is applied to Gello.

• Haemolacria: Main tear retains all effects, but burst tears do not.

• [Repentance] Burst tears also retain all effects.

• Mom's Knife: Knife retains the homing effect, but doesn't get the damaging aura.

• Piercing tears: Once the tear hits the enemy, the aura also ceases to do damage to that particular target.

• [Repentance] Enemies can be damaged by the aura after being pierced, but only if the tear is no longer in contact.

• Sinus Infection: The aura on booger tears stuck to an enemy won't hurt that particular enemy, but still damages other enemies.

• Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5/Tech X/Brimstone/Revelation: Lasers retain the homing effect, but don't receive the damaging aura.

• Trisagion: Causes Godhead's aura to visually disappear; however, the aura is still there and can still damage enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Godhead is another term for Godhood or overall divine nature.

• Godhead bears resemblance to the Eye of Providence, Eye of God, or The Eye That Sees All, a common Christian religious symbol. The three corners of the triangle may represent each part of the Holy Trinity.

• The three corners of the triangle may also be a reference to The Mind, The Body, and The Soul items, as the colors of the corners match the colors of the items, that are also unlocked by The Lost.

• This item appears in the Afterbirth † release date trailer.

fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Grants homing tears with a damaging halo. +0.5 Damage, -0.3 Tears -0.3 Shot Speed, +0.8 Tear Falling Speed, and +1.2 Range.
[Repentance] Grants homing tears with a damaging halo. +0.5 Damage, -0.3 Tears, and -0.3 Shot Speed.

Golden Horse Shoe.title: Golden Horse Shoe
Golden Horse Shoe.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• +15% chance for a Treasure Room with two items to spawn on subsequent floors.

• Only one of the two items can be taken, the other will disappear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Also applies to trinkets spawned in Treasure rooms during Pica Run Challenge.

• [Repentance] Also applies during Ascent to any Treasure Rooms that were not previously opened.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Pay to Win: If Golden Horse Shoe activates, both items can be taken.

• Broken Glasses: The second item will always be blind if not on the alt path.

• This doesn't apply with More Options.

• Mom's Box / Golden Trinket: Increases the chance to 30%.

fields.description: +15% chance for Treasure Rooms to have two items. Only one item can be taken.

Epiphora.title: Epiphora
Epiphora.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Tear delay gradually decreases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.

• At max "charge", it will reduce tear delay by half, rounding down.

• [Repentance] Fire rate gradually increases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.

• [Repentance+] Fire rate increases smoothly instead of intervals.

• At max "charge", it will increase fire rate by double.

• The time required to reach max charge is [Before Repentance+] 9 / [Repentance+] 6 seconds.

• Rate of fire returns to its original value if Isaac stops firing, changes firing directions, uses an active item, or is hit.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Being hit, changing rooms, and using items no longer reset the Epiphora bonus.

• [edition rnr+] Entering an unexplored boss room will reset the Epiphora bonus.

• • During the delay when transitioning between rooms, picking up an item, or using an active item, it's possible to change the firing direction without resetting the bonus.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Epiphora technically works with items that require a charge (such as Monstro's Lung), but requires releasing the key or button, causing players to lose the effect.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Analog Stick: Epiphora's bonus will not reset when switching fire diagonally, as long as Isaac's head doesn't turn.

• Continuum: Reduces the need to change firing direction, allowing Isaac to maintain the increased rate of fire.

• Cursed Eye: Epiphora's tear rate multiplier affects the number of tears in a burst for a total of ten shots with a full Epiphora charge.

• Dr. Fetus / Ipecac: Firing bombs continually will decrease tear delay, although doing so is not recommended since it increases the risk of self-damage.

• The Forgotten: When tapping the attack button in a single direction repeatedly, the Ephiphora effect will cause the bone swings to speed up.

• How to Jump: Changing firing direction while jumping does not reset the bonus, similar to when changing rooms.

• Incubus: Incubus's fire rate will match Isaac's.

• The Ludovico Technique: Fire rate increases while moving the tear in one direction; it has a negligible effect during normal gameplay.

• Marked: Both items work as normal, with tear rate gradually increasing until Isaac turns his head, which can happen via him or the crosshair moving too out of parallel.

• Rubber Cement: Reduces the need to change firing direction allowing Isaac to maintain the increased rate of fire.

• Rock Bottom: Isaac will never lose the benefits of Epiphora, even after he stops firing. This effectively makes Epiphora a substantial tears up. Fully charging Ephiphora is still needed to gain a higher tears stat if an item that would increase the tears stat is picked up.

• Tractor Beam: Fire rate still increases when shooting in one direction, but will stay on the line (i.e. no loss in accuracy).

• Loki's Horns / Mom's Eye: Allows for firing in multiple directions at once, decreasing need to change firing direction.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Charging items such as Brimstone, Chocolate Milk, Cursed Eye, Mom's Knife, Monstro's Lung, and Tech X: Effect only activates when holding charge in a specific direction, and deactivates when the charge is released, effectively making Epiphora useless unless Isaac has exceedingly low fire rate.

• [Repentance] Soy Milk / Almond Milk + Chocolate Milk / Cursed Eye / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Due to constant firing, Epiphora's fire rate bonus can now be used.

• [Repentance] Soy Milk / Almond Milk + Brimstone: The Brimstone laser only gains the increased damage from higher tear rates when the laser starts firing, making Epiphora's bonus useless.

• Epic Fetus: Overrides Epiphora.

• Lilith: Lilith and her Incubus cannot gain extra fire rate from Epiphora.

• [Repentance] Incubus' fire rate will increase without the accuracy penalty

• Tainted Isaac: If you pick up an item and drop Epiphora while holding the attack button you will keep the fire rate. The effect will disappear upon entering a new floor.

• Bag of Crafting: Bag of Crafting can be used to switch directions without reducing fire rate when activated.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Epiphora is an overflow of tears onto the face.

fields.description: Shooting in one direction increases Isaac's rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as Isaac changes direction or stops shooting, rate of fire is reset to its normal amount.

Equality!.title: Equality!
Equality!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[Before Repentance+] Before Repentance+=
__forcetoc__

Effects

• All pickups on the ground become their doubled variants as long as Isaac's held pickups are all the same number, e.g. 65 pennies, 65 bombs, 65 keys.

Notes

• [Before Repentance] All single keys, bombs and red hearts in a shop will become free when doubled.

• This is likely due to the entity being removed and a double variant being spawned, instead of simply overriding it before it spawns like Humbleing Bundle does.

• [Before Repentance] Upon picking up a non-doubled pickup that makes Isaac's pickups equal in number, a doubled variant will be spawned as well.

• Doubled pickups will not revert if Isaac's pickups become unequal.

• This trinket works well in Greed mode, doubling all pennies spawned from completing waves as long as Isaac's pickups are equal.

Strategy

• Previously seen non-doubled pickups will become their doubled variants after reaching equal numbers for all of Isaac's pickups. Said doubled pickups will never revert back even if Isaac's pickups numbers changes or if the trinket is dropped.

• It is recommended to leave pickups on the ground until going to the next floor. Not only does it allow for more opportunities to reach equal numbers for all pickups, but it also allows for previously found pickups to transform into their doubled variants.

• Heart pickups will also be doubled, however Isaac's hearts amount will not prevent Equality! from working. This means doubled hearts can be picked up as much as you want without any downside.

• IV Bag, especially if paired with Old Bandage, can be abused for doubled pennies to spawn while also taking advantage of said doubled hearts.

Synergies

• Hypercoagulation / Tainted Magdalene: As long as Equality! is active, all hearts spawned their respective sources will be Double Hearts and do not disappear.

• Options?: While Equality! is active, if one of the two rewards are doubled pickups, both rewards can be collected without the other despawning. Options? also makes Equality! easier to keep active.

• Tainted ???: Tainted ??? will always have 0 bombs, making the trinket only possible to activate while also having 0 coins and keys (except with the Bombs are Key pill).

• Tainted Keeper: Doubled pennies from killed enemies will not despawn. All other coin types will still disappear.

In-game Footage

|-| [Repentance+] In Repentance+=

Effects

• +2.0 fire rate as long as Isaac's held pickups are all the same number.

Synergies

• Mom's Box / Golden Trinket: Adds +2.0 fire rate per stack.

• Portable Slot: Allows Isaac to get rid of coins and potentially spawn bombs and keys, making it easier to keep the number of pickups the same.

fields.description: Turns pickups into their doubled versions while Isaac's numbers of coins, bombs, and keys are equal.

Era Walk.title: Era Walk
Era Walk.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • For the current room, enemies are slowed, Isaac's speed is increased by 0.50, and his shot speed is decreased by 1.00.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Being a special card, the Era Walk has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.

• The card's effect does not stack if it is used multiple times in the same room.

• While the effect is active, Isaac will appear to have Stop Watch, although this is purely cosmetic.

• Does not slow down stomping Mom's feet spawned by Broken Shovel 1.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Tarot Cloth: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Era Walk has been added in Booster Pack #1, after the initial release of the DLC.

• Era Walk is based on this Steam Workshop mod by aeiou.

• Era Walk is a reference to the card Time Walk from Magic: The Gathering. The Pickup Quote is a reference to the card Savor the Moment which has a similar effect.

• Unlike Ancient Recall and Huge Growth, Era Walk's sprite is based on Time Walk's Vintage Masters and 2011 Vintage Championship reprint art instead of the original art.

fields.description: For the current room, enemies are slowed, Isaac's speed is increased by 0.50, and his shot speed is decreased by 1.00.

Eraser.title: Eraser
Eraser.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a monster, the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.

• Deals 15 damage to bosses. If fatal, erases the boss for the rest of the run.

• Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. Batteries and most other methods of recharging have no effect.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Erased enemies and bosses appear as a brief pink puff of smoke. Any on-death effects are not checked.

• The Seven Deadly Sins minibosses and Angels will still drop their respective pickups or items.

• If used on multistage bosses like Hush or Ultra Greed, erasing the first phase skips any further phases.

• Erasing the first phase of Mega Satan will not end the fight until his hands are also defeated.

• Has no effect on invincible enemies, such as Stone Grimaces, lowered Hosts, or Eternal Flys.

• Bulbs can steal charges from the Eraser.

• If Eraser's projectile hits an enemy's projectile that has collision with Isaac's tears and isn't considered an enemy (e.g. Fire Worm's fire, Coal Boy's coal, Big Bony's thrown bone) it has no effect and Eraser's projectile will be destroyed .

• Although the thrown Eraser cannot hit friendly enemies these enemies can still be erased if their hostile variants are erased. This also means that when effects such as Friend Finder attempts to spawn an erased enemy it only creates the brief puff of pink smoke wasting the effect.

• Erased enemies will remain erased if a Victory Lap is started.

• Erased enemies will also remain erased if items such as R Key or Genesis are used.

• Entities such as Ultra Greed Coin (Spinner) or Little Horn's Dark Balls are considered enemies and can be erased.

• It is possible to erase Chubber's launched Charger, rendering it unable to attack.

• Erasing Poltys will render Haunted Chests harmless, but may make some rooms impossible to complete without bombs or flight as they rely on a Polty clearing a path.

• Each floor traveled up during the Ascent will recharge the Eraser.

• If a segmented worm-boss such as Larry Jr. or Scolex is removed via Eraser, Delirium will disappear if it attempts to turn into that boss. This will spawn the ending chest and count as having defeated Delirium. Other multipart bosses' erased pieces may be unable to spawn, but do not kill Delirium entirely.

• Erased enemies don't grant exploration bonuses in Daily Challenges.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• ? Card: Can throw an additional Eraser.

• Angelic Prism: Throwing the Eraser through the Angelic Prism will cause it to split into four.

• The Battery: The eraser can gain an extra charge if it is not used on one floor.

• Bethany / Tainted Bethany: Soul and blood charges can be used with the Eraser, allowing multiple uses per floor.

• Blood Puppy: Throwing the Eraser at an enraged Blood Puppy (second stage) will 'erase' its enraged form, keeping it permanently tame.

• Throwing the Eraser at its third stage will make it cycle through its normal and second stage as it kills enemies.

• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a pink eraser wisp on the middle ring. The wisp is immune to projectiles. If a non-boss enemy touches the wisp, it is erased and the wisp is destroyed. The wisp cannot erase bosses, regardless of how much health they have left.

• Void: An eraser can be thrown with each use of Void after absorbing it, allowing multiple uses per floor.

• Tainted Lazarus: Enemies erased in one form will still be erased when Tainted Lazarus flips.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 9 Volt / Battery Pack: Item doesn't fully charge the Eraser when picked up.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: Lowers the Eraser's range drastically and can only be improved with tear height ups.

• My Shadow / Shade: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning, rendering the item useless as this item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.

• Sharp Plug: Attempting to recharge the Eraser with the Sharp Plug hurts Isaac for half a heart without recharging the item.

• Habit: Taking damage with Habit will not charge Eraser.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Eraser originates from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, this item was single use and wouldn't permanently remove an erased boss from the run, but could kill any boss in one hit.

• The Pickup quote was "Erase your enemies!".

• This item's effect is similar to the scroll of genocide that appears in traditional roguelikes such as NetHack, originating in the Hack variant Hack121.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If used to kill Dogma or the Mom's Heart leading to Corpse, it will not count it as a kill, preventing progress on the respective paths.

fields.description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.

Error.title: Error
Error.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a random trinket effect for each room.

• [Before Repentance+] There is no indication as to which trinket effect Isaac gets.

• [Repentance+] The trinket will transform into a red-coloured version of the trinket it's copying.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Each room is locked to a single trinket effect, meaning that even if Isaac exits and re-enters a room, that room will always have the same trinket effect.

• In rooms where the Tick effect is given, Isaac is unable to swap Error with another trinket.

• If the Store Credit effect is given in a Shop, all items will be free and Error will not be consumed.

• If the Monkey Paw effect is given, Error will never be consumed and can continue to spawn Black Hearts indefinitely.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] If the Bag Lunch, Walnut, or Wish Bone effect is given, the trinket will not be consumed and will continue to spawn items upon taking damage.

• [Before Repentance] Touching a Stoney and Movable TNT counts as taking damage and will spawn a lot of items. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] If the Your Soul effect is given, all Devil Deals will be free and Error will not be consumed. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Error cannot give the effects of trinkets Isaac is currently holding (with Mom's Purse or Belly Button) or ones that were gulped.

• Therefore, somehow gulping all the trinkets in one run will make this trinket useless.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increases the effect of the copied trinket if possible. Having both further increases the effect if possible.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Error 404 is a common network error when a user attempts to follow a broken or dead link.

fields.description: Gives a random trinket effect each room.

Esau Jr..title: Esau Jr.
Esau Jr..attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.

• Coins, Bombs, and Keys are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, items, cards/pills, and trinkets) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.

• When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.

• Trinkets, Cards, Pills, and/or Active items are not given; only passive items are.

• Quest items like The Polaroid are given to both characters, as is the Esau Jr. item.

• Pickups that would normally be generated by the new items will not drop when Esau Jr. is first used.

• If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.

• If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like Abel but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Unlike Lazarus Risen and Black Judas, Esau Jr. is not an actual character. He is merely a costume applied to the current character, and as such retains all of the special features of the character such as health mechanics, Lilith's blindfold, and pocket active items.

• Despite starting with only black hearts, Esau Jr. is able to gain heart containers if the original character could.

• [Before Repentance+] Esau Jr. will not keep any passive starting items the original character had, and they won't count towards the number of items Esau Jr. will get.

• [Repentance+] Esau Jr. keeps all the default starting passive items the character had.

• Eden's passive starting item is neither preserved, or grants Esau Jr. an item. The same applies to items granted by Eden's Blessing.

• If a character has an Eternal Heart, then that character must be active when going to a new floor for the eternal heart to turn into a heart container.

• [Before Repentance+] Using Esau Jr. removes the damage penalty on Daily Challenges while retaining the schwag bonus. Deep Pockets schwag only persists if you don't transition between rooms.

• [Repentance+] Esau Jr.'s quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a black wisp when used to turn into Esau Jr. that is otherwise identical to a normal one; turning back into the original character spawns a normal wisp. Each form will retain their own set of wisps.

• Butter!: Puts Esau Jr. on a pedestal and generates an extra copy for the swapped character to hold, duplicating the item.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Bethany: Esau Jr. will have one heart container, but can still gain heart containers up to the character's normal cap. Soul Hearts will still be used as soul charges instead of health.

• Blood Oath / Card Reading / Dream Catcher / Empty Heart / Isaac's Tomb / Luna / Missing No. / Voodoo Head: The character that has the item must be active going to a new floor for it to have its effect.

• In the case of Luna, the character that has the item must also be active going into Secret Rooms for them to spawn beams of light. However, either character can then enter the beam of light to gain tears and soul hearts.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Chaos / Sacred Orb / TMTRAINER: Will affect the items given to Esau Jr. when used for the first time, but will not affect subsequent uses. Item generation is only affected if the character that has it is currently active.

• The Forgotten: Esau Jr. will have one empty bone heart and three black hearts if used as The Forgotten, and one additional empty bone heart if used as The Soul.

• Genesis: Using Genesis as Esau Jr. will revert back to the original character.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Esau Jr. will have two coin heart containers, but only one is filled.

• Lost Soul: The character that holds Lost Soul must be the one to enter a new floor to get its rewards.

• 'M: Esau Jr. activates as normal, without being rerolled.

• Panic Button: Activates Esau Jr. before the active character takes damage, redirecting the damage to the inactive character. The item's charge is used in the process.

• Schoolbag: The extra active item will continue to be held by the character that has Schoolbag. However, it cannot gain charges through any means until the character becomes active again.

• Tainted Cain: Each item given to Esau Jr. on the first use is based on the item pool of the last spawned item pedestal before each item is crafted. Esau Jr. starts with a separate bag of crafting that has its own inventory and starts empty. The crafting inventories of both characters are saved. Other abilities are unchanged.

• Tainted Eden: Taking damage will visually turn Esau Jr. back into Tainted Eden, but will maintain Esau Jr.'s flight and flat damage bonus.

• Tainted Jacob: Tainted Jacob and Esau Jr. both become ghosts if any of them get touched by Dark Esau.

• Tainted Magdalene: Esau Jr.'s starting black hearts will quickly drain down to half a heart; he must obtain heart containers while in this form to have any survivability.

• Void: Has no effect when absorbed.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If one character has Deep Pockets, swapping to the other character then collecting or spending coins will cap the number of coins at 99.
Bug note: Upon swapping to a character with Bone Hearts for the first time, bone hearts become half soul hearts. This is only cosmetic, and they become normal again if health is updated (obtaining HP up items, etc). The bone hearts must be obtained before the first swap to cause the bug.
Bug note: If at least one character has Spear Of Destiny or Trinity Shield, swapping to the other character causes these items to leave a stationary copy of themselves until Isaac leaves the room. The stationary spear is only a visual bug with no collision while the stationary shield still blocks tears.
Bug note: Items given to Esau Jr. during the initial swap do not count towards transformations.

fields.description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.

Eternal D6.title: Eternal D6
Eternal D6.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, replaces every pedestal item in the current room with other random items corresponding to the current room's item pool.

• Each pedestal item rerolled has a 25% chance to disappear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Lost starts with this item, even if it hasn't been unlocked yet.

• Killing Florian last in an Ultra Pride fight has a chance to drop the Eternal D6 if unlocked.

• In rooms with multiple item pedestals, each pedestal has a separate chance of disappearing when rerolled.

• Despite being described as a 25% chance, whether a pedestal disappears is determined by its InitSeed.

• The result can be predicted by applying a 32-bit xorshift to the InitSeed with shifts 5, 27, and 8. If the resulting unsigned value is less than 230 (1,073,741,824), the pedestal disappears; otherwise, it is rerolled.

• InitSeeds 8, 41, 74, 107, 140, and 173 are observed edge cases that also cause the pedestal to disappear. Including these edge cases, the actual probability is slightly higher than 25%: approximately 25.0000014%.

• Luck has no effect on the item.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: 50% to spawn an eternal white glowing wisp on the middle ring, which cannot be destroyed. Every use has a 50% chance to destroy all the wisps instead of spawning another. Does not affect wisps other than the ones made by this item. Rerolling items does not affect this chance.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: Re-rolls twice like The D6, but the 25% chance of the item disappearing is increased to approx 44%.

• Crooked Penny: If a reroll would make an item disappear, all items on pedestals spawned by Crooked Penny will disappear.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Eternal D6 originates from the Antibirth mod, where it had a charge time of 3, like the Dice in the original Binding of Isaac.

• This item functions similarly to the D6 in the Eternal Edition of the original Binding of Isaac, where it had a chance to delete the item instead of rerolling it when playing on hard mode.

• This item's collectible sprite refers to it as "Florian's D6".

• The secret popup for this item even depicts Florian Himsl lovingly rubbing said D6, as he created the Eternal Edition update for the flash game which added the Eternal D6's functionality to the D6 on Hard Mode. Florian having a chance to drop Eternal D6 in the Ultra Pride fight is also a nod to that.

fields.description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.

Eucharist.title: Eucharist
Eucharist.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • Sets the Angel Deal chance to 100% and the Devil Deal chance to 0% regardless of all other modifiers (except Duality), guaranteeing an Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and preventing it from closing.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• If the Devil Room has been visited before picking up Eucharist, an Angel Room will not replace it on the current floor, despite the Angel Room chance displaying 100%. However, Eucharist will still cause the door to remain open.

• In [mode: greed; greedier] Greed Mode, Angel Room doors will not remain open after exiting the room.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Duality: Both Angel and Devil Room doors spawn after every boss, and the selected door will never disappear.

• Filigree Feather: Due to Angel Rooms being guaranteed, a large influx of items can be obtained over time.

• Red Key: Devil rooms can still be spawned via the creation of red rooms.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Goat Head: Overridden by Eucharist.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A eucharist is a Christian rite in which bread and wine are transubstantiated into the body and blood of Jesus Christ on an altar and consumed thereafter.

• "Peace be with you" is the phrase stated by a person when administering the rite of eucharist.

fields.description: An Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.

Euthanasia.title: Euthanasia
Euthanasia.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a chance to fire needles which deal triple Isaac's tear damage.

• Needles will instantly kill regular enemies and cause them to burst into 10 more tears in all directions.

• The chance to fire a needle depends on luck.

• [Before Repentance] The formula used to determine the chance is: \frac1 { 30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 2 \right \rfloor}

• • At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 100% at 14.5 luck.

• [Repentance] The formula used to determine the chance is: min(\frac1 { 30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \times 2 \right \rfloor},25\%)

• • At base luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 25% at 13 luck.

• The tears released upon an instant-kill also have a chance to be needles, though these ones do not have the instant-kill ability. They do retain the 3× damage, however.

• Contributes to the Spun transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The needle tears can kill enemies that are normally invincible, such as Peep's eyes, Death's Heads, and Stoneys.

• The needle tears can kill Stone Grimaces and Spikeballs, allowing Isaac to permanently remove any obstacle in a room.

• [Repentance] The needle tears can kill Bomb Grimaces, dropping 10 unlit Throwable Bombs. This can make it detrimental to shoot at them, since they are usually provided as a tool rather than an obstacle.

• The tears in the burst are larger than normal but do not have a damage bonus.

• Unless piercing is obtained, Knights will still block the needles if shot from the front.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone / Dr. Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Trisagion: No appearance change, tear burst, or instant kill, but triple damage still works.

• Brimstone / Dr. Fetus: Enemies killed by a needle burst into normal tears.

• Cricket's Body / The Parasite: Needles will always split into needles, although some of them may be incorrectly displayed as regular tears. Burst tears will split as normal.

• Godhead: The aura of a needle tear will also do triple damage, but does not cause tear burst or instant kill.

• Ipecac: No tear burst or instant kill, but triple damage still works.

• [Repentance] Enemies killed by a needle burst into ipecac shots.

• Jacob's Ladder: The electric arcs released from a needle shot also retain the needle's instant kill and tear burst properties.

• Little Horn: If a tear has both the Euthanasia and Little Horn effects and instantly kills an enemy, it does not cause a tear burst.

• Tech.5: The tears that Isaac fires work normally, and the laser has a chance to deal triple damage with no other effects.

• Tech X: Completely overrides Euthanasia. No triple damage, no tear burst, or instant kill.

• [Repentance] Laser Rings will sometimes deal triple damage/instantly kill regular enemies, and enemies killed by needles burst into normal tears.

• [Repentance] Technology: Killed enemies can burst into black tears normally.

• Technology 2: The tears that Isaac fires work normally, but the laser is completely unaffected.

• [Repentance] The laser has an extremely high chance of executing normal enemies.

• Tiny Planet: Euthanasia's tear bursts will follow the orbit in 2 close groups of 5 tears. One group travels clockwise and the other travels counterclockwise.

• Spirit Sword: Each swing of the sword has a chance to do 3x damage and instantly kill a non-boss enemy, causing a tear explosion.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Euthanasia is the act of intentionally ending a person or animal's life to end their pain and suffering. It is usually carried out by an injection, hence why this item has the appearance of a needle.

• Unlike the other syringe items, Euthanasia is the only one that points upwards, as it is a tear effect that is fired towards enemies, instead of being used on Isaac himself.

• Euthanasia and Experimental Treatment are the only 2 syringe items that need to be unlocked.

fields.description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.

Eve's Bird Foot.title: Eve's Bird Foot
Eve's Bird Foot.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Chance to spawn up to 1 Dead Bird familiar for the current room each time an enemy dies.

• The Dead Bird deals 4 damage per second.

• The chance increases with luck, starting at 5% at 0 luck and reaching 100% at 8 luck.

• The familiar spawns already activated, with no taking damage required unlike the item.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This trinket alone cannot spawn more than one Dead Bird per room. It can, however, stack with Dead Bird to spawn two in one room.

• The bird familiar spawned by this trinket is transparent and has one missing leg compared to the one spawned by the actual item.

• The following types of flies are instantly killed when they come in contact with the familiar:

• Army Fly

• Attack Fly

• Dart Fly

• Fly

• Hush Fly

• Moter

• Pooter

• Ring Fly

• Super Pooter

• Swarm

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Increases chance to spawn Dead Bird by additional 5% per stack.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t spawn the bird familiar.

• E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn the bird familiar.

• Box of Friends: No effect.

• Sacrificial Altar: Sacrifices the familiar, destroying the trinket and generating an item normally.

• [edition rnr+] Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t spawn the bird familiar.

fields.description: Has a chance to spawn a Dead Bird familiar for the current room each time an enemy dies.

Eve's Mascara.title: Eve's Mascara
Eve's Mascara.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• 2x damage multiplier.

• -0.5 shot speed.

• [Before Repentance] 0.5x fire rate multiplier.

• [Repentance] 0.66x fire rate multiplier.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Eve's Mascara is DPS neutral, though often the reduction of shot speed is a downgrade.

• Combos very well with any item that scales with damage but not with fire rate, such as Rotten Baby or Fate's Reward.

• [Repentance] Eve's Mascara is effectively a 33% increase in DPS, and the shot speed down is no longer as detrimental due to changes in how range works.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Abyss: When Eve's Mascara is picked up instead of being converted into a locust, it grants all of Abyss's locusts the high damage up without suffering the fire rate reduction allowing Isaac to increase his damage rate substantially the more items he uses Abyss on.

• Epic Fetus: Missiles are not affected by low shot speed and the fire rate difference is negligible, granting double damage with nearly no downside.

• Mom's Knife: The Knife is not affected by shot speed. Fire rate reduction down and 2x damage multiplier still apply.

• Trisagion: Beams turn black and do double damage. The low shot speed makes beams damage enemies more frequently.

• Tech X: Tech X benefits from a lower shot speed due to it staying on enemies longer and is also not affected by range, giving little downsides.

• [Repentance] The fire rate reduction can be a major downside as it takes longer to charge Tech X and shots deal less damage when not fully charged.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dr. Fetus / Ipecac: Shots travel a very short distance, so having Host Hat or Pyromaniac is strongly recommended.

• Eve's Mascara: No further effect when stacked.

• The Ludovico Technique: Not recommended. Tear travels very slowly, making it hard to kill mobile enemies.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Shot speed down + DMG up; Repentance: DMG up, tears + shot speed down]
fields.description:
[Before Repentance] Doubles damage, halves tears stat, and greatly reduces shot speed.
[Repentance] Doubles damage, 0.66x tears multiplier, and greatly reduces shot speed.

Everything Jar.title: Everything Jar
Everything Jar.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Everything Jar can be activated while not fully charged.

• If the item is not fully charged, it spawns a pickup based on how many charges it had:

• 1: A Poop.

• 2: A Penny.

• 3: A Bomb.

• 4: A Key.

• 5: A full Red Heart.

• 6: A pill.

• 7: A card, rune, or soul stone.

• 8: A Soul Heart.

• 9: A Gold Heart.

• 10: A Golden Key.

• 11: A Golden Bomb.

• If the item is fully charged, it instead has one of the following effects:

• Spawns a random amount of various different pickups, including coins, hearts, bombs, keys, cards, pills, and trinkets.

• Spawns a Fly.

• Spawns an assortment of friendly dips, blue spiders, and blue flies.

• Spawns random enemies in front of every door and closes the doors.

• • Enemies also spawn in front of adjacent Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms if there are any.

• Does nothing.

• Spawns an item pedestal that cycles between 9 different items 30 times per second. The item selection is from the current room's item pool.

• Spawns many colored beams of light around the room that deal damage to enemies. These beams of light varyingly scale with Isaac's damage.

• Fills the room with Poop, similarly to A Card Against Humanity

• Spawns 6 Troll Bombs around the room, similarly to Anarchist Cookbook.

• Flips all sprites to the side, gives Isaac random tear effects for the rest of the room, and permanently increases and decreases one of Isaac's stats, similarly to Dataminer.

• • [Repentance+] This also rerolls any item in the room into a glitched TMTRAINER item. [end edition note] 

• Spawns many Shopkeepers around the room. These have a chance to be special/error shopkeepers.

• Spawns a Giga Bomb pickup that gives Isaac a bomb and converts his next bomb into a giga-bomb that deals 300 blast damage, spawns many rock projectiles that deal 15 damage, and creates 13 holes in a diamond shape around the blast zone that deal 99 damage to enemies that were in their areas. These holes cannot spawn if they would close Isaac's path around the room.

• • This bomb has a chance to be lit when it spawns.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns a random wisp.

• Hallowed Ground: Using the first charge will always spawn a white poop.

• Bag of Crafting: Allows Isaac to consistently produce high quality pickups or specific types of pickups for use in known recipes.

• Mama Mega! + Schoolbag: Consistent spawning of golden bombs allows for Mama Mega to be reused repeatedly.

• Midas' Touch: Chance to spawn a golden poop on 1 charge use

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 9 Volt: Fully recharges Everything Jar upon pickup. It also slowly recharges Everything Jar's first charge while Isaac is in an uncleared room.

• Car Battery: Instead of doubling its effect, Everything Jar will spawn a poop alongside its normal drop.

• Glitched Crown / Soul of Isaac / Tainted Isaac: The rapidly cycling item pedestal does not gain more items in its selection or slow down.

• Void: Consuming the Everything Jar will cause Void to spawn a poop when used, regardless of charge level.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Everything Jar can spawn gold hearts and bombs even before they are unlocked.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Everything Jar, Larynx, Notched Axe, and Spin to Win are the only activated items that can be used when not fully charged.

fields.description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.

Evil Charm.title: Evil Charm
Evil Charm.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac +2.0 luck.

• Makes Isaac immune to:

• Confusion and fear status effects.

• Burn effects.

• • [Repentance+] And damage from Fire Places, enemy fires (i.e. Candler), and fire projectiles (i.e. Great Gideon).

• Toxic clouds (i.e. Gasbags).

• • [Repentance+] This includes poison effects such as those from destroying Mushrooms.

• The Godhead aura from Dogma's projectiles.

• [Repentance+] Slowdown from cobwebs.

• [Repentance+] Isaac can stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Evil Charm is from the Antibirth mod. In Antibirth, it would grant a higher +3 Luck but with no other benefits.

• Regardless, even with just +2 luck, it is the item that increases luck the most out of any item in the game, as all other luck-increasing items only increase it by +1, not including Green Baby in co-op mode and the Perfection trinket.

• Only poison and fear are actually used by enemies in the game, but the others are also defined and guarded against by the Charm.

• The Evil Charm looks very similar to a real life item called a Nazar, which is said to ward off the curse of the Evil Eye.

• This item was supposed to have its own unlock method which was later cut from the game. The achievement popup graphic can still be found in the game's files.

fields.description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. [Repentance+] Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

Evil Eye.title: Evil Eye
Evil Eye.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Cain's Eye; Cain's Other Eye]

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Isaac will occasionally fire a slow-moving eye with an infinite range that fires tears identical to Isaac's tears.

• The eyes fire in the same direction as Isaac.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The chance to fire an eye tear depends on the luck stat, and the formula used to determine the chance is: \min(\frac1 {30 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor},10\%)

• At base Luck (0), the chance is 3.33%, maxing out at 10% at 20 Luck.

• The eye has the same rate of fire and damage as Isaac. Its travel speed is also affected by Isaac's shot speed.

• If the eyes are spawned from The Forgotten's melee attack, the eyes will pick up items off the floor in the same way The Forgotten's melee attack does.

• The eyes are not treated as familiars and therefore will not synergize with items like BFFS!.

• Eyes disappear when hitting walls, enemies, and obstacles, even if Isaac has piercing or spectral tears.

• Familiars like Dry Baby, Angry Fly and even Finger! also destroy the eye on collision.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Astral Projection: During the time-stop period of Astral Projection, there is a chance that the eyes fired will stop in the air instead of flying in a direction, and will last indefinitely until an enemy bumps into it, greatly increasing the lifetime of evil eyes. Triggering of Astral Projection also greatly increases fire rate, giving a higher chance to fire eyes.

• Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye: Eye tears won't shoot fires. Instead, they make Isaac shoots fire more frequently.

• Pause: After using pause, eyes will remain frozen in place even after pause's effect has ran out.

• Homing tears: Eyes will fire homing tears; however, the eye itself will not home in on enemies.

• Mom's Eye / Loki's Horns: Evil Eye has a chance to be shot in the corresponding direction. [Repentance] Eyes shot in other directions will still fire in the direction Isaac is shooting.

• Spirit Sword: Eyes swing a sword with slightly reduced range in the direction Isaac is firing.

• Tear Detonator: All tears generated have a chance to be eyes. Eyes themselves do not detonate into six tears.

• Trisagion: Eyes will fire beams. Occasionally causes Trisagion beams to stay static in the air for a few seconds, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with them.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 20/20/Cursed Eye/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: No effect; the eyes will still fire single tears.

• Angelic Prism: Eyes that hit the prism will be destroyed. Tears that the eyes fire will split if they travel through the prism.

• Azazel/Brimstone/Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/The Ludovico Technique/Mom's Knife/Technology/Tech X: Overrides Evil Eye.

• Ball of Bandages/Cube of Meat/Dry Baby: Blocks the Evil Eye, making it hard to use.

• Chocolate Milk: The tears fired by the eyes match Isaac's current charge. The eyes still have continued fire rather than charging shots.

• Continuum: Eyes will still disappear when hitting walls; however, they will fire tears that can travel through walls.

• C Section/Tainted Azazel: Overrides Evil Eye.

• Eye of the Occult: The eye itself cannot be controlled, but the tears it shoots can be.

• Incubus: Incubus cannot fire eyes.

• Ipecac: Tears fired by eyes can damage Isaac.

• Lead Pencil: Eyes will fire barrages of tears every 15 times they fire their own tears.

• Lil Gurdy: Destroys eyes if it touches them.

• [Repentance] Marked: Tears shot from the eye shoot in the direction that Isaac is moving the marker towards, not at the marker.

• Monstro's Lung: Eyes spawn more often but only fire one tear at a time.

• Pop!: Eyes will fire eyeball tears but cannot be knocked around by them.

• Sprinkler: Sprinkler cannot fire eyes.

• Tech.5/Technology 2: Eyes only fire normal tears and the laser cannot fire eyes.

• Tiny Planet: Eyes travel straight forward, and tears fired by eyes orbit around Isaac.

• Tractor Beam: Neither the eyes nor their shots are affected by Tractor Beam.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In many different cultures, the evil eye is a curse cast upon someone, usually by a malicious glare, which can cause them injury or misfortune.

• The design is taken from the Nazar Boncuğu (Evil Eye Bead in Turkish). Nazar Boncuğu is a talisman used to ward off evil in Turkey.

• The blue color, milky effect, and name may be a reference to "The Tell-Tale Heart", a poem by famous Gothic poet Edgar Allan Poe.

• Despite having evil in the name, Evil Eye is not considered evil for the damage bonuses of Black Feather.

fields.description: Adds a chance to fire a slow-moving eye that fires tears in the same direction as Isaac. The eye is destroyed when it hits an enemy or obstacle.

Expansion Pack.title: Expansion Pack
Expansion Pack.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use of an activated item, activates the effect of another random activated item.

• The random effect is any activated item with a charge time of 1 or 2 rooms (with the exception of Metronome, D infinity, and Esau Jr..) View the page on activated items for a complete list.

• Timed-recharge and infinite-use items trigger the effect once per room. Re-entering the room will allow Expansion Pack to trigger again.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Effects from one-time-use, timed-recharge, and infinite-use items will not be produced by Expansion Pack.

• Dead Sea Scrolls qualifies for Expansion Pack as its charge time is 2 rooms. This may result in activations of items not normally selectable by Expansion Pack.

• If Expansion Pack uses an item that requires Isaac to shoot to activate it (like Bob's Rotten Head or Shoop da Whoop!), using it will be counted as another item use and activate Expansion Pack an additional time.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either activates the effect of another random 1 or 2 charge active item. Having both activates 2 another random 1 or 2 charge and 1 random 3 charge active item.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text:
• If Isaac has an active item that recharges over time and doesn't require resources to use, Expansion Pack can be used indefinitely to repeatedly activate certain effects. Effects tied to Dead Sea Scrolls specifically will be noted with *asterisks*:

• Bob's Rotten Head/Doctor's Remote/Mr. Boom/Mine Crafter/*Best Friend*: Allows Isaac to destroy rocks and open Secret Room doors without spending resources.

• Dad's Key/Teleport!: Lets Isaac enter locked rooms without spending resources.

• Unicorn Stump/*Book of Shadows*/*The Gamekid*/*My Little Unicorn*: Gives Isaac invincibility, allowing him to use [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s, [machine: Devil Beggar] s, etc. without spending health.

• Box of Spiders/Guppy's Head/Compost: Allows Isaac generate infinite Blue Flies and Blue Spiders.

• The Poop/Wooden Nickel/*The Book of Sin*/*Deck of Cards*/*Mom's Bottle of Pills*: Allows Isaac to generate infinite resources.

• Fortune Cookie/*Book of Revelations*/*Crystal Ball*/*The Nail*/*Prayer Card*/*Yum Heart*: Allows Isaac to generate infinite health.

• • The health gain can be negated by Teleport! teleporting Isaac into the Curse Room (if one is present on the floor) or *Monstro's Tooth* making Monstro land on Isaac (if he stands still).

• Eternal D6: Allows Isaac to reroll items.

• If Isaac's active item requires resources to use or doesn't recharge over time, its best use with Expansion Pack is during combat in a manner similar to Bombs, due to the prevalence of explosives and effects that can damage enemies in the pool of effects Expansion Pack can pull from.

fields.description: Once per room, using an active item triggers another random active item effect.

Experimental Treatment.title: Experimental Treatment
Experimental Treatment.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Afterbirth+] Randomly increases at least 1 and decreases 1-3 of Isaac's stats. The same stats can be increased/decreased multiple times.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Randomly increases 4 and decreases 2 of Isaac's stats.

• Each increase or decrease for a stat will change it by a fixed value:

• ±1 health.

• ±1 flat damage.

• [Before Repentance] ±0.5 tears.

• [Repentance] ±0.5 fire rate.

• [Before Repentance] ±0.5 range.

• [Repentance] ±2.5 range.

• ±0.2 shot speed.

• ±0.2 speed.

• • [Before Repentance] Also affects maximum speed (may never exceed 2.0).

• ±1 luck.

• If a stat that is already at an upper or lower limit is chosen, there is no visible effect.

• Contributes to the Spun transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
The stat changes are permanent and will not go away if the item is removed.

• [Repentance] This makes the item especially useful for Tainted Isaac, since he gets to keep the stats while having the option to switch Experimental Treatment for another item and the transformation progress isn't lost in the process.
[Repentance] The tears up from this item is allowed to go past the normal tear cap of 5.0. However if it decreases tears, the normal tear cap will also be decreased.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Little Baggy]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Despite the item's old description, the item did not increase all stats or shuffle them.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: All stats up... then shuffled; Repentance: Some stats up, some stats down]
fields.description:
[Before Afterbirth+] Randomly increases and decreases some of Isaac's stats.
[Afterbirth+ onward] Increases four random stats and decreases the other two.

Explosivo.title: Explosivo
Explosivo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Explosivo does damage to Isaac if he is hit by the explosion.

• [Before Repentance] Tears that stick to enemies do not deal any damage until they explode.

• [Repentance] Explosivo shots deal regular tear damage upon sticking to an enemy.

• If an enemy dies or teleports with an Explosivo tear attached, the tear detaches and drops to the ground. If the detached tears touch an enemy, they will stick to that enemy and explode.

• However, when an Explosivo tear is attached to Loki or Lokii, the tear teleports with the respective boss when the boss teleports.

• Since Explosivo causes large tears to grow even larger, they can completely obscure enemies and their surroundings.

• The special tears can stick to the various spiked blocks (Wall Hugger, Slide, and Poky) as well as the variants of Stone Grimace, even when they are inactive. They will not destroy them, however. This can be used to destroy rocks or other obstacles around the tile.

• Explosivo is not affected by luck.

• Explosivo shots can go through any type of Fire Place and [Repentance] coal from Coal Spider and Coal Boy [end edition note] .

• Tears that are attached to enemies can destroy Poops and hit other enemies if they are close enough.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance] Brimstone/The Ludovico Technique/Mom's Knife/Tech X: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.

• Cricket's Body: The explosion results in split Explosivo shots being generated. [Before Repentance] If the target survives, they're likely to immediately stick again. [Repentance] The split tears explode when they hit an enemy or the ground.

• [Repentance] Dr. Fetus: Dr. Fetus bombs may occasionally turn into Sticky Bombs, but don't spawn spiders or slowing white creep.

• Fire Mind: Explosivo tears leave a flame behind after exploding.

• Godhead: The tear keeps its damaging aura while attached to the enemy, the aura grows as the tear does until it explodes. The aura can damage only enemies other than the one the tear is stuck to, however.

• Haemolacria: Main tears and burst tears can have the Explosivo effect. If a main tear has the Explosivo effect, it will burst with its explosion, the burst tears dealing damage based off the explosion damage.

• Ipecac: Sticky shots will explode even if they fall to the floor after the initial target dies.

• Lachryphagy: Explosivo tears can be fed and will burst into Explosivo tears; however, if normal tears are fed first, Explosivo fed to the normal tears will not give the tear the Explosivo effect.

• Lost Contact: Tears that stick to enemies can still block/be destroyed by enemy shots.

• [Repentance] Shielded Explosivo tears are no longer destroyed by shots while they're stuck to enemies. Up to the point that they explode, they block all enemy shots that come into contact with them, effectively cutting off an entire direction of attack (much like Dry/Fart Baby, but with a larger area of blockage and without forcing the player to waste time positioning). As such, this is an extremely powerful synergy between otherwise adequate items.

• Mr. Mega: Increases the damage bonus of Explosivo's explosions to 110.

• Mysterious Liquid: Leaves a pool of green creep on the floor.

• Parasitoid: Egg sacs that trigger the explosion will leave a larger pool of slowing creep.

• Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Explosivo tears can also be booger tears which damage the enemy over time while stuck to them before exploding.

• Soy Milk: The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by Soy Milk's penalty, combining efficiently with the high fire rate.

• Spirit Sword: The fired projectile can take on Explosivo's effects. The sword swing can leave behind Explosivo tears.

• Strange Attractor: When a tear sticks to an enemy, nearby enemies will be quickly pulled in the direction of the tear. The constant pull may however make enemy movement unpredictable.

• [Repentance] Tech.5: The laser also has a chance to apply explosive tears on enemies.

• [Repentance] Technology: Regular explosive tears may stick to enemies hit by the laser.

• [Repentance] Technology 2: The laser has a chance to apply an explosive tear every tick. The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by the laser's penalty, combining efficiently with the high tick rate.

• Technology Zero: Stuck tears will still generate arcs of electricity. Multiple tears stuck to a single enemy can cause very rapid damage.

• Trisagion: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• All other bomb modifiers: No bomb modifier outside Mr. Mega and Short Fuse has an effect on Explosivo tears.

• Bob's Rotten Head: Bob's Rotten Head has a chance to stick onto enemies. The explosion damage bonus increases to 110.

• [Before Repentance] Brimstone/Dr. Fetus/Mom's Knife/Technology/Tech X: Overrides Explosivo.

• Epic Fetus: Overrides Explosivo.

• [Repentance] Holy Light: Some Explosivo tears have the Holy Light effect applied to them. These tears spawn a beam of light after a few seconds of sticking to an enemy instead of exploding.

• Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

• [Before Repentance] The Ludovico Technique: Not recommended. Tear will alternate between "normal" and black. If it touches an enemy, it will stick to it, grow in size, then explode. While the tear is stuck to an enemy, it stops doing damage and cannot be controlled, leaving the player helpless.

• [Before Repentance] Tech.5/Technology 2: The laser is unaffected by Explosivo.

• Trisagion: Overrides Explosivo.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Possible reference to the Tenacious D song of the same name.

• The icon may be a reference to the NES game Top Gun as it looks incredibly similar to the missiles that shoot at you in the game.

• Explosivo means Explosive in Portuguese and Spanish.

• Explosivo is one of the few tear-modifying passive items that does not change Isaac's appearance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If an explosive tear sticks to a Nulls or a Begotten, when they become invisible, the tear will fall to the ground.

fields.description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.

Extension Cord.title: Extension Cord
Extension Cord.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Not to be confused with Sharp Plug.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Bolts of electricity arc between Isaac and his familiars, damaging any enemies between them.

• The bolts do 6 points of damage per strike.

• The bolts flow through each familiar in reverse order of acquisition, and reach Isaac last.

• A bolt arcs every 2 seconds with one familiar. 3 of them arc per second with two familiars. 7.5 per second with three or more familiars.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Does not affect temporary familiars or The Swarm’s gray flies.

• The bolts will damage destructible obstacles, such as TNT and Fire Places, as a normal tear would.

• [Repentance] In True co-op, electricity will arc to all characters, as well as all their familiars.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Each copy deals 6 more damage per tick.

• The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: Bolts will arc between it and The Soul / Tainted Soul.

• Jacob and Esau: Electricity will arc to familiars held by both characters, not just the familiars owned by the character holding it. It will also arc between Jacob and Esau themselves.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Extension Cord is based on this Steam Workshop mod by Mozzie and CupertinoEffect, which was originally a passive item.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: When using BBF, electricity will arc to its last location before exploding, until it respawns.
Bug note: When Holy Water breaks, the sprite is temporarily stored just off the top-left of the screen, toward which electricity will still arc.
Bug note: During the Siren fight in mausoleum if she converts any familiars Isaac will take constant damage.

fields.description: Bolts of electricity arc between Isaac and his familiars, damaging any enemies between them.

Eye Drops.title: Eye Drops
Eye Drops.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Tropicamide]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Increases the fire rate of tears fired from Isaac's left eye by 40%.

• The difference in fire rates causes Isaac's tears to be fired at a staggered rate.

• The first shot in a while is always a double shot.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The listed fire rate on found hud is x1.2 fire rate excluding any items that add to fire rate directly.

• Every type of attack that does not use both of Isaac's eyes benefits from the fire rate up, but will not have staggered attack rate. These include, for example:

• All charged attacks such as Brimstone and Monstro's Lung.

• All tear replacers such as Dr. Fetus and Technology.

• All one-eyed characters and item effects, such as Cain and Stapler.

• Attacking via familiars, such as Incubus and Tainted Lilith.

• Multi-shot attacks such as 20/20 and Mutant Spider do have staggered firing.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/The Peeper: The bonuses these items give go to Isaac's left eye, making them more beneficial.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Bag of Crafting/Crooked Penny/Diplopia: Multiple copies of Eye Drops do not stack.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Eye Drops is from the Antibirth mod.

fields.description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.

Eye Sore.title: Eye Sore
Eye Sore.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [distinguish visual: Giant Cell]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When Isaac shoots, he has a chance to fire 1-3 additional tears in random directions.

• The chance to fire extra tears is unaffected by luck.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Brimstone: Gives a chance to shoot 1-3 additional Brimstone lasers in random directions.

• Brimstone + Monstro's Lung: Overrides the Monstro's Lung + Brimstone synergy.

• Epic Fetus: More marks appear orbiting around where you're aiming.

• Eye of the Occult: Control of all tears' direction means all of the extra shots still travel in the direction in which the fire button is held, providing a substantial increase in DPS.

• Monstro's Lung: Gives a chance to shoot 1-3 additional Monstro's Lung bursts in random directions.

• Tech X: Gives a chance to shoot 1-3 additional laser rings in the same general direction as the main laser ring. Extra rings randomly deviate by up to about 25 degrees from the main ring, and their size and damage also scale with the main one.

• Technology: Gives a chance to fire 1-3 additional lasers in random directions.

• Tiny Planet: The 1-3 additional tears orbit as Isaac's normal tears would, noticeably increasing damage.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Dr. Fetus: Not recommended. When Isaac shoots, he has a chance to fire 1-3 additional bombs in random directions. Without Pyromaniac or Host Hat, self damage likely to happen.

• The Ludovico Technique: Overrides Eye Sore.

• Sprinkler: Sprinkler does not shoot extra tears.

• Tractor Beam: Extra tears do not follow the beam.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
