• Eye Sore originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• This item is likely a reference to Eyes, a character in Nuclear Throne.

fields.description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.

Soul of Isaac.title: Soul of Isaac
Soul of Isaac.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Rerolls all items in the room, but they cycle back to the original item after one second, repeating.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The reroll has the same rules as The D6.

• If more uses are stacked, an additional item per use will be cycled through.

• Activation of a Shop Restock Machine will reset the number of items that will be cycled through.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• It is best to use this in a room with multiple items in order to maximize the amount of items seen, allowing for the most potential choices.

• A smart idea is to use this in the Angel Room. This is because they often have multiple pedestals, including the one spawned by fighting the Angel.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Isaac + Birthright / Tainted Isaac / Glitched Crown: An additional item will be cycled through.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This effect is the same as Tainted Isaac's passive 'more options' effect. 

• It's also identical to the Birthright effect for Isaac.

• This Soul Stone, along with Soul of Magdalene, Soul of Judas, and Soul of Samson, replicates a feature of the character it's unlocked by.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If an active item on a pedestal is touched and then rerolled with Soul of Isaac, the alternate item will also count as "already picked up": it will not drop pickups, grant health or transformations like it normally would.

fields.name: Soul of Isaac
fields.description: Rerolls all items in the room, but they cycle back to the original item after one second, repeating. If more uses are stacked, an additional item per use will be cycled through.

Soul of Jacob and Esau.title: Soul of Jacob and Esau
Soul of Jacob and Esau.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns Esau as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health runs out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room.

• Esau is given random items equal to the number of items Isaac has, each based on the pools of the items Isaac's were obtained from.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The spawned Esau can interact with [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s, [machine: Devil Beggar] s, [machine: Hell Game] s, and Sacrifice Room allowing The Lost and Tainted Lost to safely use them without dying, or a form of invulnerability.

• He cannot leave a room, so he can't be used to negate damage from exiting a Curse Room.

• He also cannot pick up items, nor can he pick up things such as pills/cards/soul stones.

• He can pick up all other pickups and can replenish his health by picking up hearts.

• When the Soul of Jacob and Esau is used, some items given to Esau will also apply to Isaac for the floor. This happens with Black Candle and mapping items such as The Compass, for example.

• If Esau is given PHD / False PHD, pills will remain identified for the rest of the run, even if negative pills aren't converted into positive ones.

• If Esau is given Eden's Blessing, an extra item will be given to Isaac at the start of the next run.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If multiple Souls of Jacob and Esau are used in the same room, only one Esau will be removed after leaving the room. For every room that is left, one copy of Esau will disappear.
Bug note: Items granted to Esau will remove those items from their respective pools as if they were obtained. This also prevents future uses of the soul stone from giving that item to Esau.

fields.name: Soul of Jacob and Esau
fields.description: Spawns Esau as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health runs out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room. Esau has random items equal to the number of items Isaac has, each based on the pools of the items Isaac's were obtained from.

Soul of Judas.title: Soul of Judas
Soul of Judas.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Activates the effect of Dark Arts for 3 seconds. Grants a temporary damage up for each enemy and projectile hit.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The damage boost effect is identical to Black Judas' / Tainted Judas' special Dark Arts interaction.

• See the Dark Arts page for more details and notes.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • Lasting thrice as long as Dark Arts, the Soul of Judas can be better used to destroy numerous projectiles shot by bosses like Mega Satan and Hush, potentially resulting in major damage buffs.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The quote "Right behind you" may be a reference to the Spy from Team Fortress 2, specifically in Meet the Spy.

• This Soul Stone, along with Soul of Isaac, Soul of Magdalene, and Soul of Samson, replicates a feature of the character it's unlocked by.

fields.name: Soul of Judas
fields.description: Increases Isaac's speed and makes him invulnerable for 3 seconds and allows him to pass through enemies. Damages all enemies and destroys all projectiles Isaac ran through when the effect ends, and grants a temporary Damage bonus for each enemy and projectile hit.

Soul of Lazarus.title: Soul of Lazarus
Soul of Lazarus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac dies, and is immediately revived at half a Heart in the same room, with 1.5 second of invincibility time. 

• The soul stone is automatically used upon taking fatal damage, acting as an extra life.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Soul of Lazarus has the highest priority of all revival items.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Soul of Lazarus is very precious for Tainted Lost as revival items are very rare with him.

• Soul of Lazarus can be used to steal a devil deal. If the deal taken would kill Isaac, the soul stone will revive him on the spot.

• One extremely niche use involves being one hit away from death on red HP, and using the soul stone to kill Isaac in order to preserve his chance for a Devil Room.

• As a revival item, it can be used to make use of high-risk/guaranteed death items such as Damocles or Suicide King.

• Since Soul of Lazarus revives Isaac in the same room he died in, it is useful against bosses as reviving does not reset their health.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Plan C: Soul of Lazarus allow to use Plan C safely on bosses that have a death animation longer than 3 seconds.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Echo Chamber: Getting automatically revived by Soul of Lazarus does not add it to the queue, and directly using the soul stone will not allow for automatic revival in the future.

fields.name: Soul of Lazarus
fields.description: Isaac dies, and is immediately revived at half a Heart in the same room, with 1.5 second of invincibility time. The soul stone is automatically used upon taking fatal damage, acting as an extra life.

Soul of Lilith.title: Soul of Lilith
Soul of Lilith.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one permanent familiar from the Baby Shop.

• Soul of Lilith can give familiars that Isaac already has.

• Unique familiars can be received only once.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Soul of Lilith cannot grant Stitches and Gello, as they are both active items.

• Items granted by Soul of Lilith do not count as collected, and can still spawn in any pool they're in. Familiars obtained this way contribute toward transformations such as Conjoined.

• Soul of Lilith takes its familiars from the Baby Shop; however, when Isaac's items are rerolled, those familiars are rerolled in the Treasure Room.

• With Tainted Lost, Soul of Lilith is one of the few ways to obtain non-offensive items.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Tainted Isaac: Using Soul of Lilith while Isaac's inventory is full adds a permanent familiar that does not take up an inventory slot.

• If Soul of Lilith is used while Tainted Isaac has an empty slot, the granted familiar will take up an inventory slot and can be dropped in exchange for another item as normal.

• Void / Abyss / Starter Deck (or other ways of holding 2 consumables at once) + Black Rune: Items granted by Soul of Lilith can be destroyed for their respective bonuses right after using the soul stone while the pedestal pickup animation is playing.

fields.name: Soul of Lilith
fields.description: Grants one permanent familiar from the Baby Shop. Can give familiars that Isaac already has.

Soul of Magdalene.title: Soul of Magdalene
Soul of Magdalene.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Surrounds Isaac with a bubbling red aura for the current room. All enemies killed drop Half Red Hearts that disappear in 2 seconds.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: Mom's Locket: Makes enemies drop full red hearts instead of half red hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This Soul Stone, along with Soul of Isaac, Soul of Judas, and Soul of Samson, replicates a feature of the character it's unlocked by.

fields.name: Soul of Magdalene
fields.description: Surrounds Isaac with a bubbling red aura for the current room. All enemies killed drop Half Red Hearts that disappear in 2 seconds.

Soul of Samson.title: Soul of Samson
Soul of Samson.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac turns berserk for 10 seconds, replacing Isaac's tears with a melee jawbone club and gaining +0.4 Speed, some Tears, and +3 flat Damage.

• The jawbone club works similar to The Forgotten's bone club.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The rune's effect is nearly identical to Berserk!, with the exceptions that Isaac will not get any speed bonuses from killing enemies, nor can the duration of the effect be extended. See the item page for more detailed information on the effect and notes.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The pickup quote "Slay a thousand" is a reference to the biblical Samson, who killed a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone.

• This Soul Stone, along with Soul of Isaac, Soul of Magdalene, and Soul of Judas, replicates a feature of the character it's unlocked by.

fields.name: Soul of Samson
fields.description: Isaac turns berserk for 10 seconds, replacing his tears with a melee jawbone club and gaining +0.4 Speed, some Tears, and +3 flat Damage.

Soul of the Forgotten.title: Soul of the Forgotten
Soul of the Forgotten.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns The Forgotten as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health run out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room. The bone swing deals high damage, and reflects tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The spawned Forgotten can interact with [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s, [machine: Devil Beggar] s, [machine: Hell Game] s, and Sacrifice Room allowing The Lost and Tainted Lost to safely use them without dying, or a form of invulnerability.

• He cannot leave a room, so he can't be used to negate damage from exiting a Curse Room.

• He also cannot pick up items, nor can he pick up things such as pills/cards/soul stones.

• He can pick up hearts, however he can only replenish his bone hearts by collecting a bone heart pickup.

• [Before Repentance+] If The Forgotten is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning Perfection, regardless of whether or not the main character has been hit.

• The spawned Forgotten cannot switch to The Soul.

• Lucky Penny picked up by the Forgotten will not give Isaac luck.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • As mentioned above, the Forgotten can be used to sacrifice health at various sources with no cost to Isaac, enabling Isaac to obtain certain items if lucky enough.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: If multiple Souls of the Forgotten are used in the same room, only 1 Forgotten will be removed after leaving the room. For every room that is left, one copy of him will disappear.

fields.name: Soul of the Forgotten
fields.description: Spawns The Forgotten as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health run out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room. The bone swing deals high damage, and reflects tears.

Soul of the Keeper.title: Soul of the Keeper
Soul of the Keeper.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Drops 1-25 random Penny on the ground.

• These coins may be any normal type with their respective usual chances: Penny, Nickels, Dimes, Lucky Penny, Sticky Nickels or Golden Penny.

• Denomination of coins that spawn is not affected by luck.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Nuh Uh!: Provides an abundance of resources from Chapter 4 onward.

fields.name: Soul of the Keeper
fields.description: Drops 1-25 random Coins on the ground.

Soul of the Lost.title: Soul of the Lost
Soul of the Lost.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Turns Isaac into a ghost for the current room as if he touched the White Fire Place in Downpour II / Dross II, temporarily granting The Lost's properties.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Soul of The Lost does not actually turn the played character into The Lost. As such, completion marks will be attributed to the played character.

• However, it can be used to enter the Mirror Dimension in Downpour/Dross II. Isaac does not turn back into the original character after entering the mirror.

• Unlike touching the White Fire Place, the ghost form granted by the rune will always have Holy Mantle even if it hasn't been unlocked yet for The Lost. 

• The Holy Mantle shield gained from this can be stacked with multiple uses.

• The ghost form can take devil deals at no HP cost, but can only take one.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Since in ghost form only one devil deal can be taken, it is better (if one has HP to spare) to pay for a devil deal then use Soul of the Lost on the most expensive item if applicable.

• Note that, unlike Tainted Jacob's interaction with Dark Esau, using Soul of the Lost after taking a deal that would be fatal will not save you and will result in Isaac dying.

• Soul of The Lost can also be used as last resort in a boss fight to allow for one more hit before dying.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• The Lost: Grants an additional holy mantle shield for the room.

• Tainted Lost: The shield granted by Holy Card is broken before the one granted by Soul of the Lost.

fields.name: Soul of the Lost
fields.description: Turns Isaac into a ghost for the current room as if he touched the White Fire Place in Downpour II / Dross II, temporarily granting The Lost's properties.

Soy Milk.title: Soy Milk
Soy Milk.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Reduces tear delay by the formula: (delay / 4) - 2

• [Repentance] Multiplies fire rate / divides tear delay by 5.5x

• 0.2x damage multiplier.

• [Before Repentance] 0.5x tear size multiplier.

• [Repentance] -0.3 tear size.

• [Repentance] Drastically reduces knockback from Isaac's tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Due to the high fire rate, items that cause tears to inflict status effects activate more frequently.

• This makes Soy Milk very powerful with characters that start with higher luck such as Cain, or those who can avoid damage to obtain Perfection such as The Lost / Tainted Lost.

• [Before Repentance] At base tear rate, Soy Milk sets the player's tear delay to the game's minimum value of 1, for 15 tears per second. This is much lower than the normal minimum tear delay; see the tear delay explanation page.

• [Before Repentance] At base damage, Soy Milk is a very small DPS up. With a tear delay of 8 or lower, Soy Milk becomes a DPS down. The more tears per second before obtaining Soy Milk, the greater the decrease in DPS.

• Soy Milk's damage down stat also significantly decreases tear size.

• [Before Repentance] The endless stream of tears effectively increases directional knockback.

• [Rebirth only] Soy Milk is a special item.

• [Repentance+] Soy Milk's quality is treated as 1 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20: The shot pattern may help in controlling enemy knockback, in addition to dealing up to [Before Repentance] double damage [Repentance] 60% more damage.

• Blood Clot: +1 damage bonus on the left eye. Blood Clot tears are unaffected by the damage penalty.

• [Repentance] Brimstone/Azazel: Beam can be fired continuously after charging. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls.

• Chemical Peel: +2 damage bonus on the left eye. Chemical Peel tears are unaffected by the damage penalty.

• Chocolate Milk: Shots cannot be charged, but Isaac gains a flat +1 damage up after the Soy Milk penalty.

• [Repentance] Shots cannot be charged, but Isaac shoots moderately charged shots at a quick pace.

• Cursed Eye: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. This may be riskier than Cursed Eye alone because Soy Milk prevents Isaac from holding a fully charged shot.

• Euthanasia/Little Horn: Allow Isaac to quickly execute non-boss enemies.

• [Repentance] Little Horn's damage to bosses is not affected by the penalty, resulting in significantly higher damage output.

• Explosivo: Despite the tiny appearance of the bomb tears, the explosions will do normal explosion damage. Due to the massive fire rate, many bombs can be applied in extremely quick succession, decimating anything after a short delay.

• Godhead: The damage of the tears' aura is not affected by the reduction.

• Head of the Keeper: The barrage of tears makes it much more likely for coin drops.

• Ipecac: The very fast rate of fire fills the screen with low damage explosions.

• Ipecac + Technology: The lasers will explode when they hit a rock, wall, or enemy. This combined with Soy Milk's fire rate and Ipecac's damage makes for an extremely safe method of clearing most rooms.

• Lead Pencil: The extra tear burst is fired very often.

• Libra: Decreases fire rate slightly, but massively increases damage, range, and speed. Tear height is also massively increased, meaning tears can hit enemies through obstacles without spectral effect.

• [Repentance] Resets stats to slightly higher than base level.

• [Repentance] Libra + Brimstone: Constant Brimstone beam at normal/higher damage.

• Lost Contact: Extremely effective at blocking shots.

• A Lump of Coal: Significantly increases tear damage as they get further away.

• Monstro's Lung: Continuously fires tear barrages without the need to be charged.

• The Mulligan: Will generate an enormous wave of blue flies given that each tear has a 1/6 chance of spawning one.

• The same applies to Guppy since each tear [Before Repentance] is guaranteed to spawn a fly [Repentance] has a 2/3 chance of spawning one.

• Mysterious Liquid: Each shot creates creep that deals reasonable damage but stacks with every shot, causing hefty damage.

• Piercing tears: Causes tears to affect enemy movement less for better accuracy, though also removes the advantage of rapidly knocking back enemies.

• Pisces: Greatly increases knockback, allowing tears to pin enemies against walls.

• Rock Bottom: Grants a huge fire rate up without lowering Isaac's current damage. However, the damage multiplier and damage down still apply behind the scenes, making it very difficult to gain additional damage.

• Strange Attractor: Enemies get pulled towards Isaac's tears, allowing for higher accuracy and a way to work around the reduced knockback.

• Despite the tears having a stronger magnetic quality as they travel, it is still possible for enemies to get knocked wildly around the room. It is advised to play the long-range game when utilizing this synergy.

• Tech X: Automatically charges and fires fully charged Tech X rings. Non-fully charged rings can still be fired by releasing the fire key during charging, but much harder due to the high fire rate and removal of charge bar.

• Technology Zero: The near-constant stream of tears will have electricity chained between them, providing an electrical net of damage making it almost impossible to not hit an enemy. This can greatly help offset the lowered damage by increasing the number of hits.

• Torn Card: Unlike the normal Ipecac synergy, Torn Card shots ignore the damage down multiplier and always deal +40 damage, significantly increasing DPS.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Almond Milk: Overrides Soy Milk (no additional effect on tears or damage).

• [Rebirth only] Dr. Fetus: Rapidly shoots very low damage bombs. Can create a line of bombs which can knock each other back, which can be difficult to avoid taking damage from.

• [edition anr] Rapidly shoots medium damage bombs. Can create a line of bombs which can knock each other back, which can be difficult to avoid taking damage from.

• [Repentance] Rapidly shoots low damage mini-bombs. Bombs don't knock each other back.

• Epic Fetus: Damage of missiles will be decreased accordingly, but unlike normal tears, there is still a fixed timed delay between firing missiles.

• Kidney Stone: Charge time is not affected.

• Maw Of The Void: Charge time is not affected, but damage is still reduced.

• [Repentance] Mom's Knife: No special synergy; charge bar still disappears, but the knife will not be automatically released upon full charge.

• [Before Repentance] Proptosis: The low-damage, lowered size tears disappear extremely quickly, greatly reducing effective range.

• [Repentance] The damage reduction causes tears to disappear more quickly, slightly reducing effective range.

• Revelation: Charge time is not affected, but damage is still reduced.

• [Before Repentance] Technology 2: Half of the Soy Milk tears are replaced by a constant laser, but damage down compounds.

• [Repentance] Half of the Soy Milk tears are replaced by a constant laser and there is no further damage down on it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in Head Trauma.

fields.description: Tears are smaller and do much less damage, but fire in very rapid succession.

Spear Of Destiny.title: Spear Of Destiny
Spear Of Destiny.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac a spear familiar that he holds in the direction he most recently shot.

• The spear does twice Isaac's damage per 7 frames.

• • In Challenge 30: The Guardian, the spear does one times Isaac's damage per 2 frames and damage range increased by 7/13.

• Instantly inflicts the fear effect on any boss it comes into contact with. This is subject to the boss's resistance.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Spear Of Destiny does not replace tears.

• The item is similar to Mom's Knife, although it cannot be fired.

• [Before Repentance] Despite its size, the spear's hitbox is only located on the silver part and the handle, making it only effective at very close range.

• [Before Repentance] The spear can kill permanently charmed enemies.

• [Before Afterbirth+] Spear Of Destiny does not work while Blindfolded, except in The Guardian.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Proptosis: Triples the damage. Has no penalty with range.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: No effect on size or damage.

• Sacrificial Altar: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to the spear that pierced the side of Jesus as He hung on the cross (also known as the Spear of Longinus), according to the Gospel/Scripture of John.

• This item is used in The Guardian, where it also has a completely unique sprite that is not used anywhere else in the game. The spear is reskinned to look like a sword, which is purely visual and does not change its effects, however.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If the Spear Of Destiny is removed from the player's items (for example, when using the D4), the spear will stay on in the level in the position where it was before the item was lost until Isaac moves to another room. This is purely a visual bug.
Bug note: When Pause is used with Spear Of Destiny it creates a second spear that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for the active item's duration. Moreover, both spears are flashing and can not interact with enemies for the duration.
Bug note: Swapping characters using Esau Jr. or as Tainted Lazarus will leave a stationary copy of the spear until Isaac leaves the room. The stationary spear is only visual, lacking collision.

fields.description: In addition to tears, Isaac holds a spear in front of him which deals contact damage equal to 2× his tear damage, and occasionally inflicts fear.

Special Item.title: Special Item
Special Item.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[Before Repentance] Special items are items in the game that are considered stronger than normal by the developers. If the player sees a special item, even if the player has [cu: Blind] , subsequent special items have a chance of being rerolled rather than being presented to Isaac, decreasing the likelihood of obtaining multiple special items on one run.

The system was removed entirely in Repentance, with the item weight mechanic expanded to compensate.

• The list of special items is as follows:

• Brimstone

• D100

• The D6

• Dr. Fetus

• Epic Fetus

• Godhead

• [Rebirth only] Lil Brimstone

• The Ludovico Technique

• Mom's Knife

• Mutant Spider

• Polyphemus

• Pyromaniac

• Sacred Heart

• [Rebirth only] Soy Milk

• [Rebirth only] Stop Watch

sections.heading: Special Item Generation
sections.text:
When Isaac enters a room with an item in it, items are selected out of certain item pools depending upon the current room. Special items have a chance of being re-rolled depending on how many special items have been seen during the run:

| Number of Special Items Seen | Re-roll Chance 
| 0 | 0%

| 1 | 50%

| 2 | 90%

| 3 | 98%

| 4 or more | 99%

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Isaac's The D6 doesn't count as a "seen" special item, as it is directly given to him when the run starts.

• Special items given by the D4, the D100, 1-pip Dice Rooms, and 6-pip Dice Rooms count as "seen" special items.

• Due to the nature of special items, it can sometimes require hundreds of The D6 rolls for special items that are not in the Treasure Room pool to appear. (Note that with infinite rolls, it is always possible to see a special item as long as it is not already removed from the pools.)

Speed.title: Speed
Speed.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the attribute; the challenge; SPEED!] 

Speed determines how quickly the character moves and is represented by a shoe. Speed has a minimum value of 0.1 and a maximum value of 2.0.

[Before Repentance] Some items may lower the maximum value, and other items may bring it back up, but it can never exceed 2.0.

Each character's base speed is as follows:

| Character | Speed

| Magdalene [edition anr] Keeper Tainted Lilith | 0.85

| [Repentance] Keeper Tainted ??? Dead Tainted Lazarus | 0.9

| Isaac Judas Lazarus The Lost Lilith Apollyon The Forgotten Bethany Jacob and Esau Tainted Isaac Tainted Magdalene Tainted Eve Tainted Samson Tainted Azazel Tainted Lazarus Tainted Lost Tainted Keeper Tainted Apollyon Tainted Soul Tainted Bethany Tainted Jacob | 1.0

| ??? Samson Black Judas | 1.1

| Eve Tainted Judas | 1.23

| Azazel Lazarus Risen | 1.25

| Cain The Soul Tainted Cain | 1.3

• Eden and Tainted Eden: varies between 0.85 and 1.15, inclusive (including decimal values).

• Tainted Forgotten: completely immobile; relies on Tainted Soul to carry and throw him around.

sections.heading: Other
sections.text:
• Speed up pills increase speed by 0.15, and speed down pills decrease speed by 0.12.

• The Spun transformation increases speed by 0.15.

• [Afterbirth onward] In co-op, Yellow Baby will occasionally briefly increase speed by 0.15. Whore Baby will occasionally briefly grant the Whore of Babylon effect, which increases speed. Dark Baby will occasionally briefly increase all stats, including speed.

• The III - The Empress card activates the Whore of Babylon effect for the current room, which increases speed.

• The XI - Strength card activates the Magic Mushroom effect for the current room, which increases speed.

• The VII - The Chariot card activates the My Little Unicorn effect for the current room, which increases speed.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The Era Walk card increases speed and decreases shot speed for the current room.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] The Feels like I'm walking on sunshine! pill activates the Unicorn Stump effect for the current room, which increases speed.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Absorbing an item using Black Rune can increase speed by 0.2.

• Soul of Judas activates the Dark Arts effect, which increases speed.

• Soul of Samson activates the Berserk! effect, which increases speed.

• III - The Empress? card decreases speed by 0.1 for the duration of its effect.

• XII - The Hanged Man? card decreases speed by 0.1 for the duration of its effect.

Speed Ball.title: Speed Ball
Speed Ball.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.3 speed.

• +0.2 shot speed.

• Contributes to the Spun transformation.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Little Baggy]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A "speedball" is cocaine or an amphetamine mixed with heroin or morphine.

• [Repentance] The G FUEL! item that appears with the special GFVE LLLL easter egg seed or during daily runs with the same effect enabled is considered a "temporary" version of Speed Ball with a replaced sprite, different costume and additional effects. Normal Speed Ball is still available, however.

fields.description: +0.3 speed, +0.2 shot speed.

Spelunker Hat.title: Spelunker Hat
Spelunker Hat.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Reveals on the map what type of room all rooms adjacent to your current room are (Shop, Sacrifice Room, etc.).

• Can also reveal Secret Rooms, Super Secret Rooms, and Mini-Boss Rooms.

• [Repentance] Reveals rooms up to 2 rooms away.

• [Repentance] Blocks projectiles falling from above.

• Cannot block Mom's Foot or other stomp attacks.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is a reference to the game Spelunky.

• Despite being a light source such as the Night Light, this item does not project a beam of light.

• In the original Binding of Isaac, Spelunker Hat was not unlocked by default and had to be unlocked by beating The Caves for the first time.

fields.description: Reveals type of adjacent rooms, including location for Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms. [Repentance] Reveals rooms up to 2 rooms away and blocks projectiles falling from above.

Spider Baby (Transformation).title: Spider Baby (Transformation)
Spider Baby (Transformation).attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the transformation; the passive item; Spiderbaby] 

Spider Baby is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †, giving Isaac a spider familiar after picking up 3 spider-related items.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a spider familiar that applies random status effects to enemies it comes into contact with.

• Contrary to popular belief, this transformation does not generate friendly spiders on hit.

• Confusingly, that effect is given by the item of the same name, which also contributes to this transformation.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list ( [Repentance] with the [code: spider] tag).

sections.heading: Activated Collectibles
sections.text:
[collectible rows: Box of Spiders, Spider Butt] 
|}

sections.heading: Passive Collectibles

fields.description: Spawns a spider familiar that applies random status effects to enemies it comes in contact with.

Spider Bite.title: Spider Bite
Spider Bite.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Adds a 25% chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectile fired by them.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Triachnid. [end edition note] 

• The slow duration is 2.5 seconds.

• The slow effect chance depends on the luck stat. The activation rate is equal to 1/(4 - (Luck / 5)). At base luck (0), the chance is 25%, maxing out at 100% at 15 luck.

• Due to how this formula works, increases in activation rate are only seen with every 5 points of luck, as this formula rounds down after dividing Isaac's luck by 5.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Finger!: Finger can also apply the slow effect.

• Technology / Technology 2 / Tech.5 / Tech X / Brimstone: The laser turns light pink and can slow enemies.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In the original Binding of Isaac, Spider Bite was not unlocked by default and had to be unlocked by beating The Basement for the first time.

sections.heading: References
sections.text: • The Binding of Isaac Item Trigger Testing

fields.description: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing speed of enemy movement and any projectile fired by them.

Spider Butt.title: Spider Butt
Spider Butt.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Deals 10 damage to all enemies in the room and slows them for 4 seconds.

• [Repentance] Enemies killed by Spider Butt spawn 1-3 Blue Spiders.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns white wisps in the middle ring, looking like a spider. Wisps' tears have a 7.5% chance to inflict slow on enemies.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: Deals 10 damage to enemies twice but does not increase slow effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item resembles the abdominal segment of a Black Widow spider.

• This item originally in Wrath of the Lamb had to be unlocked by beating a challenge titled, "Spider Boy!".

fields.name: Spider Butt
fields.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies in the room and slows them for 4 seconds. [Repentance] Enemies killed by Spider Butt spawn Blue Spiders.

Spider Mod.title: Spider Mod
Spider Mod.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a grey spider familiar that wanders around and allows Isaac to see tear damage and the health bars of all enemies.

• The spider will inflict a random status effect on any enemies it comes into contact with.

• The spider has a 10% chance to spawn a Blue Spider (2/3 chance) or drop a Lil' Battery (Micro Battery) (1/3 chance) when a room is completed.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] For the sake of simplicity, all damage values shown are multiplied by 10 and rounded up to the nearest number.

• [Repentance] Damage values are no longer multiplied or rounded.

• [Repentance] If a hit would deal 10000 or more damage, it will be displayed as 9999.

• All status effect damage dealt by Spider Mod is based on Isaac's damage stat.

• Spider Mod reveals Mega Satan's health bar and is the only way to see his health.

• [Repentance] In Repentance, doesn't reveal Mega Satan's life bar during his second phase anymore.

• [Repentance] Spider Mod also reveals the health bar for Mother, the Ultra Harbingers, and The Beast. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Spider Mod shows the health of invincible enemies, holes created by Little Horn, and the golden statue of Ultra Greed.

• Spider Mod doesn't show if a segmented enemy has individual segment health like Larry Jr. or a health pool like Chub. Against enemies with invulnerable segments such as Carrion Queen and Scolex, its indicators will show under their head and not under the vulnerable segments.

• Spider Mod's damage doesn't account for damage scaling, [Before Repentance] enemy damage reduction, or invulnerability, which means that the damage indicators for some bosses, Mushrooms, Stone Grimaces, and similar enemies will be inaccurate.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] If Isaac transforms into Spider Baby, it spawns a spider familiar who works similarly to Spider Mod. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Makes Spider Mod bigger and increases the chance to 12.5% for Spider Mod to spawn a battery or blue spider. No effect on status effect damage.

• Hive Mind: Makes Spider Mod bigger. No effect on status effect damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is a reference to Spidermod, a modification to the original The Binding of Isaac, which was made by one of the lead Rebirth developers, Spider853. One feature of Spidermod was to show damage numbers onscreen.

fields.name: Spider Mod
fields.description: Displays Isaac's tear damage and enemy health bars. Spawns a familiar that wanders around and inflicts random status effects on enemies it touches. Can spawn a Lil' Battery (Micro Battery) / Blue spider upon clearing a room.

Spiderbaby.title: Spiderbaby
Spiderbaby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the passive item; the transformation; Spider Baby (Transformation)]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Spawns 1-2 friendly Blue Spider(s) upon taking damage.

• This has a 1500 ms cooldown.

• [Repentance] Spawns 2-5 friendly Blue Spiders upon taking damage.

• Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Widow. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Hive Mind: Increases spider size and doubles damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in The Host.

fields.description: Spawns [Before Repentance] 1-2 / [Repentance] 3-5 Blue Spiders when Isaac takes damage.

Spin to Win.title: Spin to Win
Spin to Win.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While the item is held, grants a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).

• While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 speed and increases the contact damage on Isaac's familiars, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, orbital familiars spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.

• The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.

• Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.

• The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.

• Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.

• Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Isaac's effective speed can be higher than 2.0 while the item is active, even if the stat is capped.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Generates up to eight wisps in the middle ring while charging the item, which are immediately extinguished once the charge runs out. These wisps shoot six times faster than an average wisp and deal 3 damage.

• All wisps, including those produced by Lemegeton, become invulnerable while using Spin to Win, regardless of whether the Book of Virtues is active.

• Duct Tape/RC Remote: Allows Isaac to use familiars' contact damage without getting close to enemies.

• The Forgotten: While playing as The Soul, channeling Spin to Win will cause the Forgotten's skeleton to deal contact damage.

• Gnawed Leaf: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac. Activating or deactivating Spin to Win will remove Gnawed Leaf's invincibility.

• Guardian Angel: The orbital speed boost from Guardian Angel can be combined with that of Spin to Win, causing all the orbital familiars to spin extremely fast around Isaac.

• Panic Button: Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room. This is most likely a bug.

• Pluto: The exceedingly high speed and small hitbox enables Isaac to clip into obstacles such as rocks or pits, allowing him to effectively fly over them. Isaac can potentially get stuck, which can be fixed by exiting and continuing the run.

• Taurus: Spin to Win's speed boost can instantly trigger the item's invincibility effect if it puts Isaac at 2.0 speed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: The damage bonus of BFFS! is removed while Spin to Win is active. Most notably, this means familiars without natural contact damage do not gain additional damage, and others gain less than expected. Familiars that deal over 12 damage per hit before BFFS!' damage bonus is applied will deal reduced damage with Spin to Win active.

• Bob's Brain / BBF / Holy Water / GB Bug: While Spin to Win is active, prevents the familiar from exploding/being destroyed on enemy contact.

• GB Bug wont reroll enemies on contact while Spin to Win is active.

• Car Battery: No effect.

• Metronome: When Metronome chooses Spin to Win, Isaac gains two orbitals with no other benefits of Spin to Win.

• Mom's Razor: Mom's Razor deals a fixed 16.5 contact damage, instead of its usual damage-scaled value, while Spin to Win is active.

• Tainted Forgotten: Unlike the non-tainted counterpart, Tainted Forgotten's body gains no extra contact damage while Spin to Win is active. Additionally, Tainted Forgotten's contact damage familiars have only 80% of their usual damage.

• Void: After absorbing Spin to Win, using Void spawns a temporary, passive Spin to Win familiar for the room. It cannot be activated further for the damage and speed bonuses.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The term 'spin to win' is a term that is associated with RNG based games, specifically ones that utilize a game show wheel.

• The pattern on the top is reminiscent to a multicolored game show wheel, which further cements the origin of the name.

• Spin to Win's item description of 'Let it Rip' is the tagline for Beyblade, which is a toy line and anime centered around battling tops.

• Spin to Win, Larynx, Notched Axe , and Everything Jar are the only activated items that can be used when not fully charged.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: With Book of Virtues, leaving a room just before the item's charge runs out causes all wisps generated by Spin to Win to remain with Isaac, and will retain their very high fire rate.

• The wisps will orbit at their normal speed rather than the increased speed.

• Upon entering an uncompleted boss room, all wisps from this effect are extinguished immediately.
Bug note: On mobile, Spin to Win does not work. It spins for a single frame, then deactivates.

fields.description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.

Sissy Longlegs.title: Sissy Longlegs
Sissy Longlegs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that wanders around the room and occasionally spawns friendly Blue Spiders.

• Blue Spiders are spawned once every 10-15 seconds, as long as there are enemies in the room.

• Only up to 5 Blue Spiders can be spawned at a time.

• [Repentance] Charms enemies briefly on contact.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Spider Baby transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS! / Hive Mind: Spawn delay is decreased to 7-11 seconds.

• Mom's Wig: The maximum number of Blue Spiders is increased to 10.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that wanders randomly, occasionally spawning Blue Spiders. [Repentance] Briefly charms enemies on contact.

Sister Maggy.title: Sister Maggy
Sister Maggy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears [edition alternatives: baseline: once per second that each do 3.5 damage; Repentance: 1.36 times per second that each do 6 damage] .

• These tears appear red, but have no special effects.

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Sister Maggy is functionally identical to Brother Bobby.

• [Repentance] Sister Maggy deals more damage than Brother Bobby, while Brother Bobby has a higher tear rate.

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Sister Maggy having [edition alternatives: baseline: 5th; Repentance+: 7th] priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Mongo Baby: Will copy Sister Maggy’s tears.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in The Family Man.

• In the original game, Sister Maggy deals 5 damage.

fields.image name: * [edition alternatives: Before Afterbirth+: Rebirth; Before Repentance: Afterbirth+]
fields.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears [edition alternatives: baseline: once per second that each do 3.5 damage; Repentance: 1.36 times per second that each do 6 damage] .

Sisters Vis.title: Sisters Vis
Sisters Vis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Sisters Vis are a boss added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth † that can appear in all environments of Chapter 3 (Depths, Necropolis, Dank Depths) [Before Repentance] and Chapter 4 (Womb, Utero, Scarred Womb).

Each sister has 350 HP.

sections.heading: Phase 1
sections.text:
Sisters Vis perform the following attacks in conjunction:

• Similar to The Cage, Sisters Vis curl up into balls and roll around the room, bouncing off the walls and each other. One of them leaves a trail of green creep and begins rolling towards Isaac while the other leaves behind a trail of brown creep and begins rolling away from Isaac. After a while, one sister stops rolling before the other and:

• Fires a Mega Blast laser in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac's position.

• • This Mega Blast laser occasionally sweeps back and forth in a wide arc.

• Fire 2-4 lines of 3-5 projectiles in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac's position.
The attacking Sister Vis finishes a few seconds before the other Sister Vis stops rolling.

• The sisters leap into the air and land on each side of Isaac's position either vertically or horizontally. They then fire Mega Blast lasers towards each other. The two beams collide and stop in the middle of the sisters.

• Together they spawn either two Vis or two Begottens.

• These spawns can be killed if caught in their rolling or their Mega Blast attacks.

• If only one sister is targeted and ends up taking a lot more damage compared to the other in a short period of time, then the sister not being targeted becomes enraged for the rest of the fight, attacking and moving at a faster pace.

sections.heading: Phase 2
sections.text:
When one of the two is killed, the other becomes enraged.

• She no longer performs the jump attack but always performs a Mega Blast or projectile attack after rolling.

• If the Sister Vis that leaves Green Creep dies first, the other will leave Green Creep instead of Brown Creep.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] A possible encounter in Greedier Mode may spawn up to 6 Sisters Vis.

• They can be found in The Void, even when not unlocked.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sisters Vis originated from the 2004 PC game Gish, created by Edmund McMillen.

• In Gish, they are the bosses of the 3rd area: The 7 Planes of Hehenna, and went by the name "Vis Sisters" instead.

• As the Sisters Vis are originally from Gish. The designs of the Vis enemies and The Cage itself originated from them.

• On the Sisters Vis' bodies, there is a Y-shaped mark. During an autopsy, an incision is made into the body and is stitched up afterward. The remaining Y-shaped mark is known as an autopsy stitch.

• Sisters Vis are the only normal boss that shoots the type of laser that is shot by Mega Satan and the item Mega Blast.

• There are unused textures for Sisters Vis in the base game (no DLC).

• The unlock condition for Sisters Vis would have been to "beat Sheol 10 times" and would have appeared in Sheol after being unlocked. It's unknown how this would work in-game, as Satan acts as one of the final bosses and always appears in Sheol.

• They appear to be wearing leather "gimp masks", which are attire used in BDSM.

• Another appearance of this mask in-game is from the item Gimpy.

• [Repentance] It is also worn by Whippers and Snappers while in Gehenna. [end edition note]

Skatole.title: Skatole
Skatole.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• This item causes many Fly enemies to alter their behavior toward Isaac.

• The following flies transform into a neutral normal Fly: Attack Fly, Dart Fly, Ring Fly, Army Fly, and Swarm.

• The following flies no longer shoot at Isaac: Pooter, Super Pooter, and Tainted Pooter.

• • These don't deal contact damage, even without Skatole.

• The following flies move slower and no longer deal contact damage: Level 2 Fly and Bulb.

• • Bulbs will not drain active item charges if touched.

• The following flies no longer deal contact damage, but retain their speed: Eternal Fly, Moter, Hush Fly, Ultra Famine Fly, Ultra Pestilence Fly, and Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball.

• • Moters will not split into Attack Flies, and Eternal Flies will not turn into Attack Flies.

• The following flies move slower and no longer deal contact damage, but can still damage Isaac through other means: Full Fly, Boom Fly, Red Boom Fly, Drowned Boom Fly, Dragon Fly, Dragon Fly X, Bone Fly, Sick Boom Fly, Bloodfly, and Tainted Boom Fly.

• • Bone Flies will still throw bones at Isaac.

• The following flies no longer deal contact damage, but retain their speed and can still damage Isaac through other means: Sucker, Soul Sucker, Spit, Ink, Level 2 Willo, and Mama Fly.

• The following flies move slower, but will still deal contact damage: Boom Fly, Red Boom Fly, Drowned Boom Fly, and Fly Bomb.

• The following flies are completely unaffected, retaining their normal attacks and speed: Swarm, Hush Fly, Sucker, Soul Sucker, Spit, Willo, Eternal Fly Bomb, and Tainted Sucker.

• • Willos and Tainted Suckers don't deal contact damage, even without Skatole.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

• [Repentance] Contributes to the Oh Crap transformation. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This item can only be naturally obtained from the Shell Game.

• [Repentance] Skatole exists in an otherwise unused shellGame item pool. This means it can also be acquired with Bag of Crafting and Chaos, and bosses in The Void can drop it. [end edition note] 

• Beelzebub's effect overrides Skatole.

• [Before Repentance] Flies spawned by The Husk will not become passive.

• [Repentance] Due to being quality 0, Skatole cannot be obtained from Shell Games after Sacred Orb has been picked up.

• This item makes The Duke of Flies a lot easier, as most of his attacks, which spawn flies, will instantly be converted. Staying out of his way while having Skatole can even make it so he ends up killing himself.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Skatole is a mildly toxic white crystalline organic compound that occurs naturally in feces.

• According to Edmund McMillen's First post-Repentance Lore Stream, Skatole's visual was designed first, with McMillen then working backwards to create an appropriate effect to justify an item that puts a poop on Isaac's head.

• Skatole was considered as a cosmetic hat for Team Fortress 2, alongside tears, Brimstone, and Tiny Planet. It was dropped as Valve "... didn't want players running around with a wet piece of poop on their heads."

• [Repentance] This item is used in Scat Man.

• [Repentance] This item is one of the only [edition alternatives: baseline: five; Repentance+: seven] that count towards 2 transformations (Beelzebub and Oh Crap), the other ones being Magic Mushroom, The Bible, Hive Mind, Parasitoid, [Repentance+] The Necronomicon, and Seraphim. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Skatole's slowdown effect also affects Tumors and its variants, despite them not being flies.

fields.description: Flies become harmless or less dangerous depending on the type.

Skeleton Key.title: Skeleton Key
Skeleton Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Gives Isaac 99 Keys.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Rerolling this item with the D4, etc., will not remove the 99 keys.

• This item can appear when using the 0 - The Fool? with 99 keys in inventory.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A skeleton key is a type of master key that can be used to open most types of locks, usually warded locks.

• This item is the Key counterpart to A Dollar and Pyro.

fields.description: Gives Isaac 99 Keys.

Slipped Rib.title: Slipped Rib
Slipped Rib.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.

• [Before Repentance] The reflected projectiles deal 5 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 10 for a full heart.

• [Repentance] The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

• Enemy damage modification from item effects or by stage does not affect the reflected damage.

• Reflected projectiles do not gain Tear effects from Isaac.

• The familiar does not deal contact damage, but kills the same types of flies on contact as Pretty Fly orbitals do.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Projectiles that create other projectiles (e.g. Shady) can harm Isaac and be reflected.

• Homing projectiles (e.g. from Psychic Horf) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.

• Slipped Rib can reflect:

• Explosive projectiles (e.g. from Gurgle), which explode as normal.

• Fireballs (e.g. from Crackle), and their lines of fire do not harm Isaac.

• Fire projectiles (e.g. from Mega Satan).

• Obstacles thrown by Polty or Kineti, dealing a flat 35 damage.

• Slipped Rib does not reflect:

• Lasers or beams.

• Lines of fire from fireballs.

• Projectiles from Big Bony, Coal Boy, Danny.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • BFFS!: Increases its size but does not increase the hitbox or the reflected damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is a reference to slipping rib syndrome.

• This item is Edmund's favorite Booster Pack item according to _Kilburn.

fields.name: Slipped Rib
fields.description: Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.

Sloth.title: Sloth
Sloth.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sloth is a mini-boss and one of the Seven Deadly Sins.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Sloth wanders randomly around the room and performs one of two attacks:

• Fires an Ipecac projectile in Isaac's direction.

• Spawns a Charger charging in the horizontal direction Sloth is facing before returning to normal Charger patterns.
Sloth deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Sloth is often encountered with either 2 Splashers, 2 Chargers, or 2 Attack Fly.

• [Before Repentance] Sloth can drop Bob's Rotten Head even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Book of Sin]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• According to Edmund McMillen, Sloth's first name is Bob, and Sloth is his last name. His first name is referenced by the items Bob's Rotten Head, Bob's Curse and Bob's Brain, and is also referenced by the Bob transformation.

• Furthermore, Edmund confirmed that Bob is Isaac’s father’s brother, which makes Bob Isaac’s uncle.

• • This may possibly be just a joke based on the phrase "Bob's your uncle".

• Sloth's sprite is just a re-coloring of the Globin enemy. This may have been done humorously to match his sin, Sloth (laziness).

• The Seven Deadly Sins that these mini-bosses are based upon are, in Christian teachings, a classification of vices from which all others are derived from.

• Sloth is a personification of one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Sloth is an excessive aversion towards difficulty in regards towards doing good, or moral/spiritual laziness. It is believed to lead to negligence, idleness, spite towards those who do good, despair, and other capital sins such as gluttony and lust.

Smart Fly.title: Smart Fly
Smart Fly.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Spawns a fly familiar that orbits Isaac, blocking enemy shots. If Isaac takes damage, this fly will seek out nearby enemies and attack them for the current room.

• [Before Repentance] The fly always deals 1.5 damage per tick or 22.5 damage per second on contact with enemies.

• [Repentance] The fly always deals 1.5 damage per tick or 6.4 damage per second on contact with enemies.

• Contributes to the Beelzebub transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating Min-Min. [end edition note] 

• Smart Fly does not take up one of the three orbital slots; it floats between two of the other orbitals.

• While behaving like an orbital, Smart Fly will break away from Isaac if he is traveling fast enough and will follow Isaac until he slows down enough to reattach. This is the only orbital item in the game that exhibits such behavior.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Duct Tape: Fly will stay in place when orbiting Isaac but will still pursue enemies.

fields.name: Smart Fly
fields.description: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots. Upon taking damage, the familiar will pursue enemies for the rest of the room, dealing damage.

Smelter.title: Smelter
Smelter.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, any trinkets that Isaac is holding are destroyed, and their effects are permanently applied to him.

• [Repentance] Trinkets that are absorbed show up on the HUD's item tracker.

• Increases the chance for a trinket to drop after clearing a room. (Has a 2% chance to turn the pickup variant into a trinket.)

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• While held, Mom's Box will double the effect of all absorbed trinkets (if their effects can be doubled).

• Absorbing the Tick will allow Isaac to pick up other trinkets again.

• Trinkets whose effects only activate once, such as Store Credit, Missing Poster, and Walnut, will still only activate once after being absorbed.

• Perfection is still removed if Isaac takes damage from regular sources.

• [Repentance] Faded Polaroid cannot be used to open A Strange Door if smelted. [end edition note] 

• It is possible to find previously smelted trinkets during a Victory Lap, or if the trinket Item Pool is exhausted.

• [Before Repentance] Picking up a copy of a trinket which was already absorbed will not duplicate that trinket's effect.

• [Before Repentance] The trinket will not be absorbed if Smelter is activated during the pickup animation.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns yellow wisps on the middle ring. The wisps have a chance to spawn trinkets when destroyed.

• Glyph of Balance: Allows a trinket to appear every time there's a room clear drop as long as the other room clear drop criteria aren't satisfied, as it empties the trinket slot.

• Tainted Eden: Absorbed trinkets are not rerolled by Tainted Eden's passive effect.

• Tainted Isaac: Absorbed trinkets do not take up an item slot.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Smelter, alongside Marrow, are currently the only items that can be unlocked specifically by defeating Mom's Heart or It Lives! on Hard Mode.

fields.description: Consumes Isaac's currently held trinket and applies its effects permanently.

Sol.title: Sol
Sol.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Shows the location of the Boss Room on the minimap.

• After killing the boss in the Boss room shown on the map, has the following effects:

• Activates the effect of XIX - The Sun.

• Gives Isaac +3 damage and +1 luck for the rest of the floor.

• Fully recharges Isaac's active item.

• Removes any Curses from the current floor except the Curse of the Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The buffs from Sol will be active upon entering all the floors in the Ascent, but it will not activate the effect of XIX - The Sun.

• In Home, the buffs from Sol will activate after entering the TV room. The healing and the item recharge will happen after defeating Dogma.

• Only damage and luck buff will be granted upon entering the boss room in the special version of Mausoleum II.

• On floors with multiple bosses (The Void, XL floors, Red Redemption), one random boss room is shown.

• In The Void, only the randomly selected Boss room will grant Sol's effect.

• Does not activate with bosses killed during Boss Rush.

• Despite being on a different floor, Sol's effect persists for ??? and thus contributes to the Hush fight.

• Upon defeating a multi-segment boss where all pieces die at the end (Chub, C.H.A.D, Carrion Queen, etc.), the effect activates once per segment, leading to an effective +3 luck and +9 damage until leaving the room, after which, the extra bonuses will be removed. It's probably a bug.

• Sol will not activate upon clearing the Mirrored World's Boss Room.

• If Sol is obtained in Greed Mode, through Spindown Dice or as a starting item for Eden, the effects will activate when entering the main room for the first time. In addition, it will activate each time a boss wave is completed.

• Sol will not activate during the final stage in the mini-boss fight before Ultra Greed.

• If Isaac manages to die at the same time he kills a boss, Sol will not save him. Instead, Isaac will die with full health.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• The Battery: Provides an extra level of charge if the item was fully charged when the boss was defeated.

• IV - The Emperor?: Clearing the extra boss room does not trigger the effect.

• Mega Blast: Only grants 3 charges.

• Tainted Lazarus: The item recharge, full heal, map reveal, and curse removal only occur if the character with Sol defeats the boss. If the boss is defeated by the character without Sol, the character with Sol still gets the damage and luck bonus for the rest of the floor.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sol originates from the Antibirth mod.

• "Sol" is the word for "sun" in Latin and some of its descendant languages, and is sometimes used to distinguish the Sun of the Solar System from other stars.

• The item's pick up quote might be a reference to DotA's Radiant team win end screen message.

fields.description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates XIX - The Sun, fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.

Soul Locket.title: Soul Locket
Soul Locket.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart gained by picking up Soul Hearts or Black Hearts:

• +0.04 speed.

• +0.1 tears.

• +0.2 flat damage.

• +0.5 range.

• +0.04 shot speed.

• +0.20 luck.

• Spawns a Soul Heart when picked up.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Black Hearts give the same stat boosts as normal soul hearts.

• If a character can only have soul hearts for health (such as ???), picking up two Eternal Hearts will count as giving one soul heart's worth of stat boosts.

• Soul Locket only activates when picking up actual Soul Hearts, not if they're directly added to Isaac's health (such as by a Balls of Steel pill or Book of Revelations).

• This item gives stats when adding to Bethany's soul charges.

• The Lost and Tainted Lost can use this item normally, despite not having health.

• Unlike Alabaster Box, Black Hearts still work with these characters

• This item is useless for Keeper and Tainted Keeper, since they cannot encounter soul hearts.

• Hearts acquired prior to picking up Soul Locket will not provide stat boosts.

• The stat bonuses are seeded, meaning the same stat ups will apply in the same order in the same seed.

• [Before Repentance+] The stat bonuses are "stored" on the Soul Locket. Dropping or losing it in any way won't immediately revert the bonuses gained, only when Isaac's stats are updated again. The respective stat changed is the one that loses the Soul Locket bonuses.

• The bonus stats will be lost if Isaac's stats are updated by dropping out of the game or if the game crashes.

• This item can be crafted from Bag of Crafting with eight Soul Hearts.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is the soul heart equivalent to Candy Heart, and gives twice as many stats per heart collected, comparatively.

fields.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he picks up a Soul Heart.

Soul of ???.title: Soul of ???
Soul of ???.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the soul stone; the item; ???'s Soul]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Releases in this order:

• 8 poison farts over 2 seconds while brown creep is released for 1 second.

• 7 Butt Bombs are then released at the same rate as the farts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The farts and creep are the same as those from Tainted ???'s arsenal.

• The initial fart deals 5 damage, poisons enemies and reflects projectiles. 

• The creep gives +1.5 Fire Rate and +1 Damage if stood on, and deals 1.5x damage per tick to enemies.

• The butt bombs are affected by any bomb modifying items, although their appearance remains unchanged.

fields.name: Soul of ???
fields.description: Causes 8 poison farts that leave lingering brown creep, then plants a trail of 7 Butt Bombs in quick succession. Standing on the creep gives +1.5 Fire Rate and +1 Damage.

Soul of Apollyon.title: Soul of Apollyon
Soul of Apollyon.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Spawns 15 random locusts.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • All locusts have an equal chance to be any of the 5 types.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • Using the Soul of Apollyon near an enemy can be dangerous: an explosive locust may spawn on it and immediately explode, damaging Isaac.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Hive Mind: Doubles the damage dealt by locusts.

fields.name: Soul of Apollyon
fields.description: Spawns 15 random locusts.

Soul of Azazel.title: Soul of Azazel
Soul of Azazel.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Activates Mega Blast for 7.5 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The fired laser has the same width as a Mega Blast laser.

• The laser persists between rooms.

fields.name: Soul of Azazel
fields.description: Activates Mega Blast for 7.5 seconds.

Soul of Bethany.title: Soul of Bethany
Soul of Bethany.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns 6 blue wisps.

• Each wisp has its own 10% chance to instead be a random wisp.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Doubles the base damage, contact damage, and damage scaling per floor of the wisps.

• Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the wisps' fire rate.

• Baby-Bender: Wisp shots become homing shots.

fields.name: Soul of Bethany
fields.description: Spawns 6 Book of Virtues wisps with random properties.

Soul of Cain.title: Soul of Cain
Soul of Cain.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Opens all doors in the room.

• Creates a Red Room on all valid walls of the room. This is indicated by walls that have red door outlines on them.

sections.heading: Notes
Strategy
sections.text:
• Soul of Cain can serve as a Secret Room finder, as secret room entrances do not have red door outlines.

• Refer to the Ultra Secret Room page for the strategy to better find it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Soul of Cain's ability is likely a reference to Red Key being an unlock for Cain in the original Antibirth mod.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Soul of Cain can break the mirror in Downpour II.

fields.name: Soul of Cain
fields.description: Opens all doors in the room and creates a Red Room on all valid walls. This also destroys the mirror located in Downpour / Dross II.

Soul of Eden.title: Soul of Eden
Soul of Eden.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the soul stone; the item; Eden's Soul]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Rerolls all pickups, trinkets, and items in the room.

• Rerolled items use random item pools, as if Chaos were held.

• Rerolled pickups and trinkets work identically to the D20.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The reroll does not change a pedestal's item pool. Normally rerolling an item previously rerolled with the Soul of Eden will reset it to the current room's pool.

• [Repentance+] The Soul of Eden can sometimes spawn within the special bedroom created by Lil Portal.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: • It is better to use the Soul of Eden in a room with many items, as to maximize the number of rare items that can be obtained.

fields.name: Soul of Eden
fields.description: Rerolls all pickups, trinkets, and items in the room. The rerolled items use random pools, as if Chaos were held.

Soul of Eve.title: Soul of Eve
Soul of Eve.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns 14 Dead Bird familiars that fly in from off-screen and attack enemies.

• They last 10 seconds and will begin to leave after the limit, but will stay as long as an enemy is alive. They will disappear if Isaac leaves the room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • When a bird expires and begins to leave, it will only disappear once it flies to the edge of the screen. If another monster spawns or becomes vulnerable before the bird can fully fly away, it will return and continue attacking.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • BFFS!: Doubles the damage of the dead birds.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Soul of Eve's description is a reference to the original description Birthright had when taken as Eve in the original Antibirth mod.

• A murder is a group of crows or ravens.

fields.name: Soul of Eve
fields.description: 14 Dead Bird familiars fly in and attack enemies. They last 10 seconds and will begin to leave after the limit, but will stay as long as an enemy is alive. They will disappear if Isaac leaves the room.

Terra.title: Terra
Terra.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +1 damage.

• Isaac's tears become rocks that have extra knockback and have a chance to destroy obstacles (including walls to Secret Rooms, entrances to Mines/Ashpit and Bedrooms, and normal closed doors).

• Rocks can be pushed onto holes to cover them as if they were bombed normally.

• Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between ×0.5 and ×2 Isaac's damage per tear.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Despite the chance to deal lower damage per shot, the increase to the damage stat results in a higher average DPS.

• Terra bypasses Blasters' 75% damage reduction.

• Terra can destroy the armor of Tuff Twins and The Shell.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Broken Padlock: Locked doors can be opened by shooting at them.

• Finger!: The finger will destroy rocks.

• The Ludovico Technique: Controllable rock tear that will destroy rocks. The size of the tear changes per room.

• Mom's Knife: The knife will sometimes destroy rocks. Rocks can be destroyed by walking into them.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Azazel/Brimstone/Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5/Tech X: Lasers will sometimes destroy rocks and gains increased knockback, but will not open doors or Secret Room entrances.

• [Repentance+] Lasers can now open doors.

• Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Explosions retain the extra damage and knockback, but cannot destroy Key Blocks.

• Spectral tears: Tears continue to destroy obstacles.

• Spirit Sword: Sword swings and spin attacks cannot destroy rocks, only its projectiles.

• Tainted Lilith: The damage from hitting enemies with the fetus is affected by Terra's damage randomization.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Terra originates from the Antibirth mod.

• "Terra" is the word for "earth" in Latin and some of its descendant languages, and is sometimes used to distinguish the Earth of the Solar System from other inhabited planets in science fiction.

fields.description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.

The Adversary.title: The Adversary
The Adversary.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Adversary is a boss that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] In all environments of Chapter 3 (Depths, Necropolis, Dank Depths).

• [Repentance] Only in Necropolis.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
• Quickly fires Brimstone laser towards Isaac if he is seen in any cardinal direction. The beam bends slightly, following Isaac's movement.

• Flies off-screen into the air and plummets down on Isaac's position a few seconds later, creating a circular rock wave on impact which expands to 4 rings.

• Summons 3 Spiders.

• Dims the room, causing the [cu: Darkness] effect for a period of time.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Brimstone attack's homing effect is stronger as it gets farther away from The Adversary. It is much easier to avoid by staying close and being ready to pivot around him via quarter-circle dodges when he telegraphs the attack.

• [Before Repentance] If there is a room containing two Adversaries, their Brimstone shots may be unavoidable if fired from both sides of the room simultaneously.

• [Repentance] Two Adversaries can't fire simultaneously.

• Host Hat and Pyromaniac make Isaac immune to The Adversary's rock wave attack since it is considered to be the same as explosions by the game.

• [plat: 3DS] If The Adversary dims the room, pause the game and the dim will eventually go away while still in the pause screen.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• He is the posthumous version of Dark One.

• "The Adversary" is one of the ways that the original Hebrew word "ha-satan" can be translated.

• "Adversary" is the name of a level in Super Meat Boy, which Edmund, part of Team Meat at the time, worked on.

• The Adversary appears to be a severely injured Dark One, though what caused such injuries is unknown.

• The Adversary has a bandage on his horn in-game, but he does not on his boss portrait.

• The Adversary is one of the three bosses that can darken the room (a temporary Curse of Darkness effect). The other bosses are Dark One and The Lamb.
