sections.text: [achievement text: Technology Zero]

fields.description: Isaac occasionally fires an unlimited range piercing laser alongside his normal tears. The laser can glitch, mimicking the effects of certain items and trinkets.

Tech X.title: Tech X
Tech X.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: For all Tech items, check Tech (Disambiguation)

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Isaac's tears are replaced with ring-shaped lasers.

• Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.

• The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.

• Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.

• [Repentance] Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.

• • \text{Charge Time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) \approx \frac{3}{\text{Fire Rate}}

• • \text{Max Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) - 10)

• • \text{Min Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay}) + 1) - 10)

• • At 30.00 fire rate or above (0 tear delay or lower), charging is no longer needed and fires 30 rings per second. Higher fire rate results in higher laser damage.

• • 
• \text{Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} - 10)

• • 
• Damage per Tick is capped at 100% Isaac's Damage, at 90.00 fire rate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Like normal tears, walking forward makes the rings move faster, and walking backwards makes the rings move slower. Because the ring deals damage for as long as the enemy is inside of it, walking backwards actually increases Tech X's DPS, while walking forward lowers it.

• The rings are similar in appearance to the combination of The Ludovico Technique and Technology.

• The laser rings will linger for a brief moment upon touching a wall, allowing more damage to be dealt to enemies closer to walls.

• The "R U A WIZARD?" pill effect does not work with Tech X.

• Acquiring an extra copy of Tech X will shoot an extra laser ring.

• [Before Repentance] Charging only increases size, not damage. It is useful for hard-to-hit enemies or hitting a wide area at once, but spamming small, uncharged shots will lead to much higher damage output.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] With the charge bars option enabled, the rings can be released immediately as the charge bar appears for easier gauging of maximum damage output.

• [Repentance] The maximum ring size is slightly smaller in Repentance.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 20/20: Fires two Tech X rings instead of one. [Repentance] Damage down applied.

• Apple!/Euthanasia/Holy Light/Little Horn/Mucormycosis/Tough Love: The tear effects will apply randomly at each damage tick depending on Isaac's luck stat.

• Azazel: Azazel fires a Brimstone ring instead of Tech X ring with a 35% damage penalty. If combined with Brimstone, the damage penalty is negated.

• The same applies to Tainted Azazel.

• Bookworm: Can fire an additional Tech X ring with same 25% chance.

• Brimstone: Fires a Brimstone ring. This Brimstone ring is larger than the laser ring and has a much wider hitbox.

• [Before Repentance] Brimstone + Technology: The damage boost from Brimstone + Technology is lost, but the laser fires while charging the Brimstone ring.

• • [Repentance] Fires a Brimstone ring coiled by a laser. Once again increases Isaac's damage by 1.5x.

• [Repentance] Double Brimstone: Further increases the width of the ring, and grants +1 Damage.

• [Repentance] Cricket's Body: Shoots out smaller tears on hit.

• C Section: Overrides the charging effect, but shoots a laser ring with a fetus tear in the middle. The ring's damage is half the fetus' damage.

• Dr. Fetus: Overrides the charging effect, but shoots a laser ring with a bomb in the middle. The ring's damage is Isaac's Damage.

• Dr. Fetus + [Repentance] Cricket's Body: Causes split tears to collide with the bomb, which is almost guaranteed to cause the bomb to move eratically when in close proximity of enemies.

• Epic Fetus: Each missile shoots 10 laser beams like from Technology in each direction with a flat 25 damage bonus, similar to Tammy's Head.

• Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Every damage tick has a chance to stick a tear of the respective effect on enemies.

• Fruit Cake: Works on the laser rings.

• Haemolacria: Haemolacria tears will burst into 3-5 Tech X rings on impact. The sizes of the rings are various, but they deal 100% Isaac's Damage.

• Haemolacria + Brimstone: Brimstone overrides the effects of Tech X, effectively making it useless.

• Head of the Keeper: The tears turn into the Tech X tears, but they still retain the ability for enemies to drop money, which is now based on every tick of damage, rather than with the rings themselves.

• Homing: While the rings won't home in on enemies, they will bend inwards to hit enemies within each ring, resulting in a substantial damage area increase.

• Jacob's Ladder: The rings gain a light blue tint and generate sparks when hitting enemies or obstacles. A ring can generate only one spark per tick.

• Lead Pencil: Every 15th laser ring fired also shoots a cluster of tears.

• Loki's Horns: Adds a chance to fire 4 laser rings at once with 2 in front and 2 behind Isaac, each pair firing on top of each other.

• Lost Contact: Tech X rings can block projectiles as they travel.

• Mom's Eye: Isaac will now sometimes fire an additional ring from his back.

• Mom's Knife: Simultaneously fires the knife and laser ring(s).

• [Repentance] The knife is fired with a Tech X ring around it, similarly to the forgotten's club throw. The ring's damage is based on the amount charged, starting at 33% Isaac's damage and 100% at maximum charge.

• Monstro's Lung: Fires 3-5 extra rings in 30° spread. Extra rings deal from 50% to 100% damage of the main ring.

• [Repentance] Fire Rate is divided by 3.1.

• Ouroboros Worm: The ring inherits the homing chance benefit, without being affected by the pattern.

• The Parasite: The ring produces small tears in contact with enemies.

• Rubber Cement: The rings bounce off walls once.

• Sad Bombs: Bombs explode into Technology beams in all directions.

• Strange Attractor: Magnetic effect pulls pickups and objects to the ring, increasing accuracy.

• Tech.5: Occasionally fires a linear laser while charging Tech X.

• Technology: Fires a linear laser while charging Tech X.

• [Repentance] Fires a Brimstone ring coiled by a laser. Despite its appearance, it does not give 1.5x damage (see Brimstone synergy above).

• Technology 2: Fires a linear laser while charging Tech X.

• Wiggle Worm: Rings take star-shape, slightly increasing its area of effect.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
Overridden by Tech X:

• Azazel's normal attack

• Brain Worm

• Cursed Eye

• Evil Eye

• Explosivo

• Flat Stone

Only stat effects are applied; otherwise overridden by Tech X:

• Anti-Gravity

• Apple! Only tears up applies, without a chance of high-damage rings

• Chocolate Milk

• Compound Fracture

• Cricket's Body

• Death's Touch

• Eye of Belial

• Eye of the Occult

• Hook Worm

• Jacob's Ladder

• Marked

• My Reflection

• Ouroboros Worm

• Sulfuric Acid

• Tiny Planet

• Tractor Beam also causes any effects previously overridden by Tractor Beam (e.g. The Wiz) to return

Other interactions:

• Almond Milk: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. Tech X overrides most of the worm trinket effects.

• Azazel: Azazel's brimstone overrides Tech X.

• Blood Clot / Chemical Peel / The Peeper: The effects have 80% chance to be applied per damage tick.

• Chocolate Milk: Doesn't increase damage, but reduces Isaac's tear delay by 20%.

• [Before Repentance] Continuum + Incubus: Incubus's laser rings cannot go through walls.

• [Repentance] Works as expected.

• Dead Eye: Prior to picking up Tech X, the damage multiplier is preserved to where its at, and missing shots will not remove it. Saving and quitting the game will remove the multiplier. Picking Dead Eye after Tech X has no effect.

• Fire Mind: Laser rings set enemies on fire and do not explode.

• The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: A laser ring forms around the bone toss attack. The Soul uses Tech X normally, and Tainted Soul cannot use it at all.

• Fruit Cake: Only status effects granted by Fruit Cake work on the laser rings.

• Gello: The familiar charges based on the distance from the target enemy. It charges more when it is further from the enemy. It also gains the item's costume.

• Godhead: Damaging halo effect lost, but retains Homing effect and stat changes.

• Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: Normal tears orbit Isaac.

• Incubus: The rings fired by the Incubus have a fixed size; charging the ring will only increase the size of the player's own rings.

• [Repentance] Works as expected.

• Ipecac: Overridden by Tech X. The damage bonus is lost upon entering a different room. Still poisons enemies like Ipecac does.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] +4 damage and poisons enemies.

• [Repentance] Tech X ring causes an explosion on every rock or enemy it passes through. The ring will not open Secret Rooms, though resulting explosions still will.

• [Repentance] Ipecac + Almond Milk / Soy Milk: Explosion damage maintained as tears vastly increases.

• A Lump of Coal: Damage and size of the ring increases the further away it is from the player, but is actually roughly 2/3rds of tear damage up close. It takes a few tiles of distance to reach normal damage and go above it, with the maximum being 1.5x at roughly a room's width away.

• [Repentance] The damage is normal at point blank range but the damage increase per tile is significantly lower.

• Marked: The rings are now fired automatically with ring size depending on Isaac's distance from the cursor; the further he is, the larger the rings are.

• Mom's Eyeshadow: All rings become pink - testing is needed to find out if all rings have charm chance

• Proptosis: The ring's damage and size substantially increase, but decreases the further it travels.

• [Repentance] The ring's damage and size is based on the distance from Isaac. The damage is 4.38x when Isaac is on the center of the ring, down to 1.5x.

• Pulse Worm: The ring pulsates in size between 0.67x to 1.33x over a 2 second cycle.

• The Scooper / Stye: The effects have 20% chance to be applied per damage tick.

• Soy Milk : Fires automatically upon reaching full charge.

• Sulfuric Acid/Terra: The ring can destroy Obstacles, but it can't open doors or Secret Rooms. Terra also greatly increases knockback.

• [Repentance+] The laser can now open doors.

• Tammy's Head: Tammy's head fires regular tears.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: The black ring generated from the synergy of Dr. Fetus and Tech X behaves as a Maw Of The Void ring and may cause black hearts to drop.
Bug note: Having Tech X with Soy Milk / Almond Milk and Kidney Stone causes Isaac unable to fire laser rings when Kidney Stone is active.

fields.description: Tears are replaced with laser rings that pierce through enemies and deal damage to enemies within them. Can be charged to increase the effectiveness of the ring.

Technology.title: Technology
Technology.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: For all Tech Items, check Tech (Disambiguation)

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Replaces tears with a laser beam with unlimited range and piercing. The laser is fired from Isaac's left eye.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Laser rate of fire is determined by the tears stat. This differentiates the item from Technology 2 which fires a continuous beam, and Tech.5 which has a random fire rate.

• [Repentance] Laser size scales with tear size.

• [Repentance] The sound emitted by the laser will also change depending on its size. This is purely aesthetic.

• [Repentance] Lasers are affected by momentum, allowing them to be shot diagonally if fired while Isaac is moving.

• [Repentance] When directly adjacent to a wall or obstacle and firing in the wrong direction the obstacle may block the laser, preventing it from damaging enemies. This can happen on all sides of a given room with the exception of the bottom wall.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Haemolacria: Fires arcing Haemolacria tears that release Technology lasers in all directions upon impact.

• Brimstone: Overrides Technology.

• [Afterbirth onward] The Technology laser coils around the Brimstone beam, granting a 1.5x damage multiplier, which can stack with other multipliers such as Magic Mushroom's 1.5x damage multiplier.

• • [Repentance] Technology's damage multiplier will be overridden if Isaac has the powered up version (from picking up Brimstone twice or using Sulfur with Brimstone).

• Epic Fetus: Fires lasers in all directions upon impact of a missile.

• [Repentance] Eye of the Occult: The laser becomes dark purple and automatically fires at a controllable crosshair. The crosshair behaves nearly identically to the one created by Marked (including in its synergies and interactions with other items) with the exception that lasers often arch towards the crosshair rather than traveling towards it directly and any other projectiles affected by Eye of the Occult that are not lasers (such as from Eye of Greed or Fate's Reward) will chase the crosshair and hover above it for the remainder of their range.

• Technology + Tech.5/Technology 2: Tech.5 and Technology 2 lasers are also affected by the crosshair but cannot create the crosshair on their own. [end edition note] 

• Fire Mind: Laser lights enemies on fire but loses the ability to explode enemies.

• The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Isaac shoots multiple lasers with a decreased rate of fire.

• Lachryphagy: Isaac shoots a short-range laser that will form a Lachryphagy tear, which has piercing.

• The Ludovico Technique: The laser becomes a large ring that is controllable and looks like a Tech X shot. Enemies inside the ring without touching it are not hurt. The tears stat is ignored and the damage is dealt very rapidly at a rate equivalent to a 1 tear delay. [Before Repentance] Shot speed is ignored.

• When Spoon Bender is added to this synergy, the laser ring will morph to target enemies, along with the standard homing effect.

• Marked: Isaac can fire lasers at the crosshair.

• Mom's Eye: Fires a laser from the back of Isaac's head as well as the front.

• Monstro's Lung: Several additional lasers fire in random directions. (One beam will always fire straight forward as normal.)

• [Repentance] Fires a barrage of small lasers.

• Pop!: Laser loses its unlimited range, but spawns eyeball tears at the end of the laser.

• Proptosis: Doubles damage with no damage-decreasing effect on the laser.

• [edition anr] Doubles the damage stat, the beams deal 2x damage at point blank range but it rapidly decreases with distance, down to 0.1 from about 8 tiles away.

• [Repentance] The beams do 6x damage at point blank range but decreases to 0.1 damage at about 8 tiles away.

• Spirit Sword: Sword becomes a lightsaber. Surrounds Isaac with a laser on every swing. Enemy projectiles are deflected by both normal and charged attacks.

• Tech X: Both fire at the same time.

• [Repentance] Fires a Brimstone ring coiled by a laser. Hitbox is bigger with no damage increase.

• Technology: Adds an additional laser for every extra copy of the item up to a maximum of 16, with no downgrade to damage or tears.

• Technology 2: Equips two lasers that can be fired at the same time. As Technology is always fired from the right eye, it is not affected by the halved normal attack rate.

• [Repentance] Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding Stapler, Lead Pencil or playing as Cain will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again.

• Tiny Planet: Laser circles around Isaac and then continues its path forward in a straight line. The laser is also spectral.

• [Afterbirth onward] Tiny Planet + A Lump of Coal: The extra distance covered by the laser more than doubles damage right in front of Isaac, and it increases as normal further away.

• Tough Love / Apple!: The lasers can gain the damage multiplier from each of the items, although there is no visual difference.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Rebirth only] 20/20: Overridden by Technology.

• [Afterbirth onward] Shoot 2 lasers.

• [Before Repentance] Anti-Gravity: Tears up, but no Anti-Gravity effect.

• [Repentance] Create laser balls that fire technology lasers when released.

• [Rebirth only] Azazel: Overrides Azazel's Brimstone.

• [Afterbirth onward] Technology laser wraps around the Brimstone beam, dealing extra damage, but not increasing Brimstone range.

• Blood Clot / Chemical Peel / The Peeper: 50% chance to apply the flat damage up/damage increase with each shot.

• [Before Repentance] Chocolate Milk: Lasers can't be charged, but reduces Isaac's tear delay by 20%.

• [Repentance] The laser can be charged, increasing its size and damage.

• Continuum: Overridden by Technology.

• [Repentance] Technology lasers wrap around the screen with the Continuum effect with momentum retained.

• [Before Repentance] Cursed Eye: Overridden by Technology.

• [Repentance] Charges a barrage of 5 lasers.

• [Before Repentance] Cricket's Body: Tear delay down as expected, but no benefit from the splash effect.

• [Repentance] Releases a 4-way spread of tears whenever the laser hits a wall or an enemy.

• Dead Eye: Prior to picking up Technology, the damage multiplier is preserved to where its at, and missing shots will not remove it. Saving and quitting the game will remove the multiplier. Picking Dead Eye after Technology has no effect.

• Death's Touch: Overridden by Technology, but still grants damage.

• [edition nar] Dr. Fetus: Overrides Technology.

• [edition anr] Fires lasers in addition to bombs.

• Euthanasia: The lasers can gain the damage multiplier from Euthanasia although there is no visual difference. [Before Repentance] Euthanasia loses its instant kill ability, however.

• Eye of Belial: Overridden by Technology.

• Flat Stone: Overridden by Technology.

• Flat Worm / Pulse Worm: No effect.

• Godhead: Homing laser, but the halo is lost.

• [edition anr] Head of the Keeper: Overridden by Technology. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] The laser is recolored to a bright yellow-orange and keeps the chance to drop coins when hitting enemies.

• [edition anr] Holy Light: Holy Light shots will not activate. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Holy Light shots have a chance to activate on hit as expected.

• Hook Worm: Laser follows a square wave, which increases its hitbox.

• Ipecac: Laser doesn't gain Ipecac's flat damage bonus or fire rate decrease, poisons targets.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Gives a flat +4 damage instead of +40, poisons targets. Fire rate is not decreased.

• [Repentance] Gives a flat +2 damage instead of +40, laser poisons and explodes on contact, dealing 10 + twice of Isaac's damage. Fire rate decrease applies.

• • Mom's Knife: Not reccomended. Isaac will blow himself up consistently whenever he shoots the knife.

• Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears.

• Jacob's Ladder: Overridden by Technology. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Fires electricity normally.

• A Lump of Coal: No effect.

• [Afterbirth onward] Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance. This allows for a huge damage increase from longer distances.

• Marked: Overridden by Technology, stat bonuses still apply.

• Mom's Knife: Overrides Technology.

• [edition anr] Both fire normally.

• • When playing as Lilith, Mom's Knife overrides Technology.

• [Repentance] The tip of Mom's Knife connects to isaac's body with a laser when launched. This effect is similar to that of Technology Zero

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife + The Ludovico Technique: The laser ring becomes centered on Isaac and cannot be controlled, and the knife can not be fired. This makes some rooms impossible to do without a familiar.

• My Reflection: Overridden by Technology.

• [edition anr] Makes the beam curve the opposite direction while Isaac is moving sideways.

• [Repentance] The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• • Pop!: The laser ends halfway through the loop. Spawns Eyeball tears like normal.

• Mysterious Liquid: Overridden by Technology.

• [Afterbirth onward] The laser spawns pools of liquid always when it hits obstacles and occasionally on enemies.

• Neptunus: Overridden by Technology.

• Number One: Expected tears up and the laser's color turns yellow.

• Ouroboros Worm: No effect on laser.

• [Repentance] Works as intended.

• Pupula Duplex: Laser becomes spectral.

• [Repentance] Laser beams are thicker in terms of width.

• Soy Milk: Expected high damage down and very high tears up. [Before Repentance] Because Technology has no knockback like standard tears, this will generally be a good DPS increase.

• Technology Zero: No effect.

• The Parasite: Overridden by Technology.

• [Repentance] Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.

• [Repentance+] Also spawn small split tears.

• Parasitoid: Overridden by Technology.

• [Before Repentance] Ring Worm: No effect.

• [Repentance] Laser wraps around itself multiple times, effectively increasing hitbox.

• Rubber Cement: Overridden by Technology.

• [Afterbirth onward] Lasers bounce off of walls.

• Tractor Beam: No effect.

• [Repentance] Lasers are no longer affected by Isaac's momentum.

• Trisagion: Overridden by Technology.

• Wiggle Worm: Laser follows a sine wave, which increases its hitbox.

• Compound Fracture: Overriden by Technology.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Technology Zero]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is used in Computer Savvy.

• [Repentance] Technology gains a unique, animated costume when it inherits a form of charged attack; for example, as a result of its synergies with items such as Chocolate Milk or Cursed Eye. (See 'Gallery.')

• This does not work with items that grant a charged attack but also override Technology's costume, e.g. Monstro's Lung.

• This is one of the few, rare examples of a synergy granting a unique costume - another one being the costume granted by holding multiple copies of Brimstone in Repentance.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: Having Technology, Technology 2 and Mom's Eye makes the back laser fire extremely fast.

fields.description: Replaces tears with a piercing laser with unlimited range.

Technology 2.title: Technology 2
Technology 2.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: For all Tech items, check Tech (Disambiguation)

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Replaces Isaac's right eye tears with an unlimited range piercing laser which fires continuously, dealing damage 15 times per second.

• [Before Repentance] x0.65 Damage multiplier.

• [Before Repentance] The laser deals 20% of Isaac's damage per tick.

• This compounds with the damage down for a total of 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.

• [Repentance] Only the laser deals 13% of Isaac's damage per tick.

• [Repentance] Tears fired per second * (2/3).

• [Repentance] Laser is able to knock back enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Tear delay is effectively doubled, as Isaac will do a bit of the animation to fire a right eye tear, but no tear will come out.

• [Repentance] This applies to items that replace Isaac's tears, such as Mom's Knife and Brimstone.

• Charged shots are not affected by the effective tear delay down, as they don't use the alternative left eye/right eye fire scheme.

• [Before Repentance] As Cain can only fire tears from his right eye, Technology 2 will replace his tears altogether unless he has Technology or a charged attack.

• [Repentance] When used by Cain, or a character that is forced to fire from one eye due to the effects of Stapler or Lead Pencil, they will fire Technology lasers out of their right eye instead of their normal tears, as long as they have no other items that replace their tears (Neptunus or Number One lets them fire tears normally). These lasers cannot be angled with momentum. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Because Lilith is blindfolded and relies on her Incubus, the only effect gained from Technology 2 is the damage down.

• [Repentance] Incubus can fire laser and tears as normal; stat effects apply.

• [Repentance] The blood clots spawned by Tainted Eve will all also fire their own individual lasers.

• The laser can apply status effects very efficiently due to its high tick rate.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• 8 Inch Nails / Blister / Pisces: The laser will consistently push back enemies.

• Blood Clot / Chemical Peel: Since Isaac's right eye is replaced by Technology 2, he can only fire tears from his left eye, which gives all his tears higher damage and range.

• Brimstone: Laser fires continuously while Brimstone charges at normal rate.

• Chocolate Milk: The laser fires while Chocolate Milk charges at normal rate.

• Cricket's Body : The laser will rapidly split into small low damage tears upon impact with an enemy or obstacle.

• Cursed Eye: The laser fires while Cursed Eye charges at normal rate, retaining the teleporting effect.

• [Repentance] Tears are replaced with lasers, fired from the same eye of Technology 2.

• Epic Fetus: The laser fires while the missiles are being aimed.

• [Repentance] Euthanasia / Explosivo / Holy Light / Little Horn / Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection: Every damage tick from the laser can also apply these tear effects and does so rapidly. [end edition note] 

• Explosivo’s 60 point explosion damage bonus is unaffected by the laser’s reduced damage making the combination incredibly effective.

• [Repentance] Incubus / Lil Clot / Sumptorium / Twisted Pair: The familiars fire a continuous laser. [end edition note] 

• Ipecac: Laser damage increases dramatically while also gaining the poison effect.

• Lachryphagy: Significantly shortens the range of the laser. A piercing Lachryphagy tear spawns at the end of the laser every tick, rapidly feeding off of each other and bursting when standing still. This is an extremely powerful combo that alone can provide enough damage output to challenge any boss in the game.

• A fire rate reduction such as from The Inner Eye or a few Tears Down pills makes the combo even stronger, as tears will grow even larger before bursting.

• Lead Pencil: Replaces tears with lasers similar to Technology. These are shot from the eye that shoots Technology 2, doing damage alongside the Technology 2 beam.

• Loki's Horns: Additional tears are affected by Technology 2 but are replaced by Technology's lasers, dealing 100% of Isaac's damage and with 16 luck gives you Technology 2's fire rate.

• Lost Contact: The laser destroys all hostile projectiles that come into contact with it.

• The Ludovico Technique: Isaac simultaneously controls a tear and fires the laser; however, Isaac will only fire the Technology 2 laser in the direction that the tear is currently facing.

• [Repentance] The Ludovico Technique also makes the laser spectral.

• A Lump of Coal: Damage increases the further away the enemy is, on a multiplier that is roughly +20% per tile of distance.

• Marked: Isaac simultaneously controls a big red target on the ground and fires the laser in the cardinal directions.

• [Repentance] The laser now continuously fires towards the crosshair along with tears.

• Mom's Knife: The laser fires while the Knife charges at normal rate.

• Monstro's Lung: The laser fires while Monstro's Lung charges at normal rate. No reduction in tear burst size.

• The Parasite: Laser splits into two perpendicular beams upon hitting an obstacle.

• [Repentance+] Also spawn small split tears.

• Rubber Cement: Laser bounces off of walls.

• Technology: Equips two lasers that can be fired at the same time. As Technology is always fired from the right eye, it is not affected by the halved normal attack rate.

• [Repentance] Technology is affected by the fire rate multiplier. Holding Stapler, Lead Pencil or playing as Cain will allow Isaac to angle shots with momentum again. [end edition note] 

• Tiny Planet: The laser spirals around Isaac once and then goes straight again.

• The Wiz: Tears are fired diagonally while the laser is fired straight forward.

• Urn of Souls: Isaac can still fire the laser as normal while using the urn.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / Sprinkler / any multishot item: No effect.

• Azazel: The Technology 2 continuously fires its lesser damage laser as Azazel charges his Brimstone.

• Brimstone: Overrides Technology 2, but retains the reduced damage.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] Euthanasia / Little Horn / Nose Goblin / Sinus Infection / Sulfuric Acid: The laser is unaffected. [end edition note] 

• [edition anr] Explosivo / Holy Light: The laser is unaffected. [end edition note] 

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Eye of Belial / Parasitoid: The laser is unaffected. [end edition note] 

• Parasitoid: The laser can now rapidly spawn slowing creep and spawns flies or spiders.

• Eye of the Occult: Only affects the laser's color.

• Eye of the Occult + Brimstone / Technology: The Tech 2 laser also automatically fires at the crosshair.

• Fire Mind: Tears still ignite enemies, but no longer have a chance to explode.

• Incubus: Decreases damage of Incubus' tears; Incubus does not fire a continuous laser.

• Isaac's Tears: Fires normal tears.

• Lead Pencil: Isaac loses the ability to fire tears from the remaining eye, identical to Cain's downside.

• Mom's Eye: Occasionally shoots a laser behind Isaac. With 15+ Luck, fires a new laser on every tick, dealing extremely high damage.

• My Reflection: Laser is bent in the opposite direction as Isaac moves sideways, then gradually becomes straight as he stands still.

• [Repentance] The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac, and fires the normal laser backwards.

• Pop!: The laser has drastically reduced range, and eyeball tears are rapidly created at the end of the laser.

• Soy Milk: Both damage reductions are applied, along with removing one eye's worth of tears.

• Technology 2: Multiple copies of the item provide no benefit.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Technology Zero]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • This item is used in Computer Savvy.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Technology 2 prevents Lead Pencil and normal tears from firing if collected with specific items.
Bug note: While playing as The Forgotten, holding fire as either The Forgotten or The Soul then switching to the other will create another Technology 2 laser in the direction being fired that persists until the room is left.
Bug note: If Isaac is holding fire and has The Ludovico Technique while pulling out Urn of Souls, another Technology 2 laser is created in the direction being fired that persists until the urn is put away or the room is left.
Bug note: Having Technology 2, Technology and Mom's Eye makes the back laser fire extremely fast.

fields.quote: [edition alternatives: baseline: Laser; Repentance: Extra laser]
fields.description: Replaces the tears fired from Isaac's right eye with a rapid-firing low damage piercing laser. [Before Repentance] Damage down.

Technology Zero.title: Technology Zero
Technology Zero.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: For all Tech items, check Tech (Disambiguation)

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Connects tears with electricity that damages enemies.

• [Before Repentance] The electricity's damage is equal to Isaac's Damage.

• [Repentance] The electricity deals 30% of Isaac's Damage, 15 times per second, for a total of 4.5 times his damage per second.

• A tear can generate one connection. The tear does not generate another connection even after the connection is lost. However, other tears can still make connections with it.

• Each of Isaac's tears can connect to other allied tears, including those of shooting familiars.

• • The number of connections is limited by the number of Isaac's tears.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • When playing as Jacob and Esau, the tears of the brother who picked up the item will also connect to those fired by his brother. For example, if Jacob picked up the item, his tears will connect to each other as well as to those of Esau, but Esau himself will not fire any electric tears.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: All of the tears fired are connected by electricity, creating a series of electric fences.

• Apple! / Tough Love: The damage of the electricity can be multiplied by the items. This occurs independently from the tears which generated the electricity.

• Cricket's Body / Compound Fracture / The Parasite: Split tears will be connected via electricity.

• Evil Eye: Tears fired by eye will be connected via electricity to Isaac's tears.

• Eye of the Occult: Allows you to move the electrified tears, allowing you to hit more enemies and do more damage.

• Haemolacria: Main tears and bursts can be connected via electricity.

• Proptosis: Triples the electricity damage. Has no penalty with range.

• Sinus Infection/Nose Goblin: Boogers will have electricity flowing between them even if attached to the same enemy, dealing massive damage to bosses.

• Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The lasers are capable of destroying terrain, but are unable to apply knockback, allowing them to easily destroy large quantities of obstacles.

• Tiny Planet: Creates moving laser fields that orbit the character.

• The Wiz: The diagonally-spreading tear shots will be connected by electricity, effectively making up for the item's blind spot and providing an attack with a very wide range.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• The following items override Technology Zero. Tears from other sources such as Lead Pencil can still generate electricity with each other.

• Brimstone

• Dr. Fetus

• Epic Fetus

• Mom's Knife

• Technology

• Tech X

• Trisagion: Tears from other sources can be connected with the base of Trisagion's blast.

• Continuum: Tears will travel through walls; however, the electricity will not connect the tears while they are outside the room. If a tear was connected before it pass through a wall, it will not be connected after passing through, limiting the efficiency of the combination.

• Flat Stone: Tears lose their connection as they bounce. As such, tears cannot make connection to another tear once they bounce, but other tears can make connection to them.

• Haemolacria: Only main tears can be connected.

• Lachryphagy: Tears will generate arcs of electricity until they burst. As the tears will hang in the air for several seconds, this significantly increases the uptime of electricity arcs. Burst tears are similarly connected to each other by electricity.

• Pop!: Tears in midair and tears that knock around each other will still be connected, effectively creating electric barriers and letting the electricity hit multiple times.

• The Ludovico Technique + 20/20/The Inner Eye/Mutant Spider: Main tear and orbiting tears are connected.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Technology Zero is based on this Steam Workshop item by Ashkait and Scayze.

• Strangely, this item has the tech item tag, and therefore contributes toward its own unlock, though this should be impossible under normal circumstances.

fields.description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.

Telekinesis.title: Telekinesis
Telekinesis.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon use, for the next three seconds, any enemy shots that come near Isaac are held in place.

• [Before Repentance] After a shot has been held for two seconds, it is fired back as a tear.

• • Reflected tears always do 3.5 damage.

• [Repentance] When the effect is about to end, all shots are fired back.

• • Reflected normal tears do 6 damage if they would normally do a half heart damage to Isaac.

• • Reflected normal tears do 7 damage if they would normally do a full heart damage to Isaac.

• • Reflected Ipecac shots do 50 damage, and do not harm Isaac.

• • Reflected rocks thrown by Polty do 35 damage.

• [Repentance] The emanating blue pulse pushes enemies away for the duration of the item's usage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The tears can be rammed into enemies while they're held by Telekinesis. [Before Repentance] They won't disappear until the effect ends but do no further damage.

• [Before Repentance] As long as the item is used immediately upon recharging, Isaac is effectively immune to enemy bullets.

• Catching shots from enemies that fire high into the air, like the Tube Worm, is very difficult and not beneficial; in the case of the Tube Worm, shots that are caught will just fall to the ground rather than be fired at enemies.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Tears caught by Telekinesis become blue wisps in the outer ring. The wisps are outside the range of Telekinesis, making them vulnerable to shots before they can be converted to wisps. Wisps persist between rooms.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• ? Card: The cooldown applies even when used through the ? Card.

• 9 Volt: Does not benefit from 9 Volt, unlike other auto-recharge items.

• [Repentance] 9 Volt grants half charge on use, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.

• The Battery: A Lil' Battery (or other battery) has to be picked up for another charge. Both charges are expended at once for a longer duration effect.

• Car Battery: Has no effect.

• [Repentance] Car Battery grants 7 seconds of protection, effectively giving Isaac immunity to enemy bullets as long as the item is used immediately upon recharging.

• Sharp Plug: Charge gained from Sharp Plug is expended immediately and won't stop enemy shots.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Telekinesis is based on this Steam Workshop item by Eufuu, originally known as Telepathy.

• This item and the pickup sprite may be a reference to The Matrix, where the protagonist Neo can stop bullets in mid-air when they are directly in front of him, holding out his right hand exactly how it's represented in the sprite.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text: Bug note: When Pause is used while Telekinesis is active it creates a second ring that stays in place where Isaac used "Pause" which lasts for Telekinesis's remaining duration. Moreover both rings are flashing and the second ring can not block enemy tears for the duration. Any tears that were still caught in Telekinesis’s radius before using Pause become incredibly slowed and indefinitely follow Isaac until he shoots.

fields.description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.

Telepathy For Dummies.title: Telepathy For Dummies
Telepathy For Dummies.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants the following effects for the current room:

• Homing tears.

• [Repentance] +3 range.

• Contributes to the Bookworm transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• For any item interactions, check the corresponding sections on Spoon Bender's page.

• [Repentance] The range increase does not stack with repeated uses.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns purple wisps in the middle ring. These wisps fire homing tears.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Car Battery: No effect.

• However, this can unlock Baby-Bender if it isn't unlocked.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Baby-Bender]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Telepathy for Dummies uses the same costume as Spoon Bender.

• Telepathy For Dummies is a reference to the For Dummies series of reference books, targeted towards beginners using non-intimidating instructions.

fields.description: Gives homing tears for the current room. [Repentance] Also gives +3 range.

Teleport!.title: Teleport!
Teleport!.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Teleports Isaac to a random room on the current floor.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• It is possible to teleport to the Secret Room or Super Secret Room.

• It is not possible to teleport to the I AM ERROR room.

• It is not possible to teleport to the Crawl Space for the floor or the Black Market.

• [Afterbirth only] [mode: greed] It is possible to teleport to a Super Secret Room with no doors, resulting in the player being stuck.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
Possible uses include:

• Teleporting out of dangerous situations.

• Avoiding spiked door damage going out of a Curse Room.

• Teleporting into Challenge Rooms if you don't meet the health requirements to get in.

• Escaping from Challenge Rooms or Boss Rush after picking up a chest or collectible, avoiding the fight.

• Escaping from Mom's boss room, due to there being no exit after defeating her.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns blue wisps in the middle ring. Wisps' tears have a 10% chance of teleporting non-boss enemies to a random location in the current room on hit. Wisps also temporarily vanish every 5 seconds, preventing them from blocking shots or taking/dealing damage.

• Car Battery: No effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The sprite of this item is identical to Doctor's Remote and Teleport 2.0, but with a different color.

• This item is a nod to Spelunky's Teleport item.

• It is also a small nod to Dr. Fetus' many remotes in Super Meat Boy.

• The V1.06.J787 patch notes states the item 'allows the player to influence the teleport direction (using the direction Isaac is moving upon activating the item)'. This effect was never planned to be added into the game, and was put in the changelog because of a misunderstanding.

fields.description: Teleports Isaac to a random room on the current floor, except for I AM ERROR rooms.

Teleport 2.0.title: Teleport 2.0
Teleport 2.0.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The room that Isaac is teleported into will be touching an explored room, if possible.

• When used in a room with enemies in it, Isaac is teleported back into the same room, resetting it.

• The order of types of rooms is predetermined, first available on this list chosen:

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Grave Room / Mirror Room / Mine Cart Room

• Normal rooms

• Red Rooms (opened but unexplored)

• Boss Room

• Super Secret Room

• Shop

• Treasure Room

• Planetarium

• Sacrifice Room / Dice Room

• Library

• Curse Room

• Mini-Boss Room

• Challenge Room / Boss Challenge Room

• Arcade / Vault

• Clean Bedroom / Dirty Bedroom

• Secret Room

• Ultra Secret Room (Mirrored World only, even if it wasn't located)

• Devil Room / Angel Room

• I AM ERROR room.

• In Cathedral or Sheol, using the I AM ERROR room exit will bring Isaac to The Chest or Dark Room respectively.

• This works even if Isaac has the wrong corresponding item (The Polaroid / The Negative) for that floor.

• In Chest, Dark Room, The Void, Dad's Note floor, and Corpse II, Teleport 2.0 will teleport Isaac to the Devil/Angel room instead of the I AM ERROR room. The same is true when using it on the final floor of a Daily Challenge.

• [Afterbirth+ before Repentance] In The Void, using Teleport 2.0 in the I AM ERROR room will teleport Isaac to The Void again, allowing the floor to be restarted. The floor regenerates with new rooms and enemies. This can be done multiple times.

• A floor's Boss must be defeated in order to access rooms prioritized after the Boss Room with this item.

• [Repentance] The exception to this is Corpse II, where simply entering the boss room will count the room as cleared. The hole to the Mother fight does not need to be entered. This allows the player to use this item to access rooms prioritized after the Boss Room without needing to fight Mother. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Using Teleport 2.0 in the Ascent sequence will teleport Isaac to the Angel/Devil Room if all other rooms have been explored. After returning from the Angel/Devil Room, using the Teleport 2.0 again will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room. If it's instead used without exploring any rooms, Isaac will be teleported to the 'starting' room of the floor containing the beam of light up to the next floor.

• This strategy also works in Home, taking Isaac to an Angel/Devil Room if all rooms have been explored. Isaac cannot use this to reach the hidden closet room containing Tainted characters, however. Using it after visiting the Angel/Devil Room will not teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room, and will instead merely teleport to the same Angel/Devil Room again. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Using Teleport 2.0 during the The Beast fight will teleport Isaac to a random spot on the screen without interrupting the fight. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] In the Mirrored World, Isaac will teleport to the Ultra Secret Room before the I AM ERROR room. Although it's empty like any other special room inside the Mirror, this can be useful to find the room in the normal world with Red Key.

• If used again in the Mirrored World, Isaac will teleport to the Red Room which leads Isaac back to the main floor; if used once again, Isaac will teleport to the I AM ERROR room of the normal, non-mirrored floor. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] After killing Mom's Heart in Mausoleum / Gehenna II, Teleport 2.0 will teleport Isaac to the I AM ERROR room with hole leading to Corpse, even if there are unexplored rooms on the floor. [end edition note] 

• After exhausting all possible rooms, using the item will not teleport Isaac anymore.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns flashing blue wisps on the middle ring. Tears have 20% chance of teleporting non-boss enemies to a random location in the current room on hit. Wisps also temporarily vanish every 5 seconds, preventing them from blocking shots or taking/dealing damage.

• This effect is identical to Teleport!'s effect with Book of Virtues, albeit with a 10% higher chance of teleporting enemies on hit.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The sprite of this item is identical to Teleport! and Doctor's Remote, but with a different color.

• Teleporting to the I AM ERROR room when all rooms on the map are explored is a possible failsafe for the error the item would otherwise cause, as no other valid unexplored rooms would exist at that point.

• This item is the successor to Teleport!.

• This item is one of four reliable ways to reach the I AM ERROR room in-game, the others being the Blank Card + ? Card interaction, using Red Key to go beyond the 13x13 level grid, and Undefined.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: After all Mini-Bosses in Mini-Boss Rooms are encountered, on floors that would otherwise spawn Mini-Boss Rooms, they will not spawn, which results in Teleport 2.0 being unable to teleport Isaac to special rooms after the Mini-Boss Room in the teleport order, instead teleporting Isaac to the same room each time.
Bug note: If Isaac is in Mines / Ashpit II while holding Knife Piece 1, and if there is no Curse Room in the floor, Teleport 2.0 sometimes incorrectly teleports Isaac to the room containing the minecart that leads to Knife Piece 2. If this happens, all further uses of Teleport 2.0 in that floor will also lead Isaac to this room.

fields.description: Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.

Telescope Lens.title: Telescope Lens
Telescope Lens.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Raises the default chance for a Planetarium to spawn from 1% to 10%.

• This influences the chance after having already entered a Planetarium, keeping it at 10%.

• Further increases the chance for a Planetarium to spawn by 15% if one has not been entered yet.

• Combined with the raised default chance, this adds up to a perceived +24% chance increase when first picked up.

• Makes it possible for Planetariums to spawn in Chapter 4 and Corpse.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either increases the default chance by 18%. Having both increases the default chance by 33% and Planetariums can also spawn in Cathedral and Sheol.

fields.description: Increases the chance for Planetariums to spawn even if one has been visited and allows Planetariums to spawn in Chapter 4.

Temporary Tattoo.title: Temporary Tattoo
Temporary Tattoo.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Drops a Chest after clearing a Challenge Room, or an extra Boss item after clearing a Boss Challenge Room.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Each copy provides a small random stat increase after completing a challenge room.

• Tainted Keeper: The bonus item dropped after clearing a Boss Challenge Room is free.

Teratoma.title: Teratoma
Teratoma.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Teratoma is a boss that can appear:

• [Before Repentance] In all environments of Chapter 4 (Womb, Utero, Scarred Womb).

• [Repentance] Only in the Utero.

The large Teratoma has 60 HP, the medium forms have 15 HP, and the small forms have 8 HP, for a total of 153 HP.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
• Moves around the room slowly, bouncing off the walls.

• When enough health is depleted, the one large Teratoma breaks into three medium Teratomas.

• Medium forms behave identically, but move slightly faster.

• Each of the three medium Teratomas breaks into two small Teratomas.

• Small forms behave identically, but move very fast.

• Each of the smallest Teratomas spawns two Spiders on defeat unless they are over a pit or other obstacle.

• All stages of Teratoma will do 1 full heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Teratoma was added in the Wrath of the Lamb DLC for the original The Binding of Isaac.

• It is the posthumous form of Fistula.

• A teratoma is a rare tumor that contains tissues that are atypical for its placement in the body. This can include hair, teeth, bones, and so on.

• Unlike the original Binding Of Isaac, Teratoma doesn't bounce off of Rocks.

• [Before Repentance] Teratoma is one of the three bosses that can be spawned by It Lives!, the other two being Chub and Polycephalus.

• [Repentance] It Lives! can now spawn Fistula as well.

Fire rate.title: Fire rate
Fire rate.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the attribute; Isaac's primary weapon; effects] 

Isaac's fire rate is primarily tied to the hidden Tears attribute, which decreases the base delay between fired tears. Items and such that directly modify fire rate also exist, but are rarer than ones that affect the Tears attribute. The game uses an icon depicting three arrows in flight to represent both fire rate and the Tears attribute; In the Found HUD, the arrows denote either [Before Repentance] Isaac's tear delay [Repentance] or his fire rate in tears per second.

sections.heading: Fire Rate Calculation
sections.text:
The formula for calculating fire rate is:
\text{Fire Rate} = ({\frac{30}{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} + {\text{S}}) * {\text{P}}}

Where tear delay is calculated using the Tears stat [edition anr] and tear delay modifiers, S is the sum of all direct additions and subtractions to fire rate, and P is the product of all direct fire rate multipliers.

As the vast majority of items that affect fire rate do so by adding or subtracting Tears, tear delay is the most commonly relevant part of the formula. Depending on how high Isaac's Tears stat is, one of four different formulas is used to calculate tear delay:

\text{Tear Delay} =
\begin{cases}
5 & \text{if } T > T_{max}\\
16 - 6 \times \sqrt{T \times 1.3 {+} 1} & \text{if } T \geq 0 \text{ and } T \leq T_{max}\\
16 - 6 \times \sqrt{T \times 1.3 {+} 1} - 6 \times T & \text{if } T < 0 \text{ and } T > -0.77\\
16 - 6 \times T & \text{if } T \leq -0.77
\end{cases}

• T is the Tears stat.

• T_{max} is the Tears cap, defined as the number that brings you to 5 tear delay. Increasing the tears stat beyond this does nothing directly, but it can counteract potential tears down. If Isaac has no direct fire rate modifiers, he will have a fire rate of 5 tears per second at T_{max} Tears.

• [Before Repentance] Tear Delay is rounded down to the nearest integer. T_{max} is just under 1.37, meaning two items with +0.7 tears is enough to get your tear delay to under 6 and therefore to 5, assuming you start at 0.

• [Repentance] Tear Delay is no longer rounded down. T_{max} is just under 1.82 (1.816239316).

Tear delay is the additional delay between fired tears beyond 1/30 seconds, in units of 1/30 seconds. For example, 7 tear delay means 8/30 seconds between tears, or 30/8 = 3.75 fire rate.

[Before Repentance] Items can directly reduce tear delay.

• The minimum tear delay is 1, corresponding to 15 fire rate.

• Tear delay reduction has accelerating returns. Each -1 tear delay is more effective the more tear delay reduction (and the higher tears stat) you have.

[Repentance] Almost all direct tear delay reductions were replaced with fire rate increases.

• Generally, each -1 tear delay is replaced with a +0.5 fire rate increase.

• The maximum fire rate is 120.

Items that directly affect fire rate include:

• Pisces, which gives +0.5 fire rate.

• Soy Milk, which gives a x5.5 fire rate multiplier.

• The Inner Eye, which gives a x0.51 fire rate multiplier.
There are many other rules and exceptions.

The tears stat has accelerating returns. Each increase of some +X tears provides about the same percentage bonus to fire rate (and therefore damage per second) until you reach the cap. For example, if you get +0.35 tears (a tears up pill) five times, each gives 12-13% fire rate increase, with the first one giving +0.35 fire rate and the last one +0.55 fire rate.

At or below -0.77 Tears, changes to the Tears stat affect fire rate much less. This is especially relevant for Keeper, who starts with -1.9 Tears, and Tainted Keeper, who starts with -2.2 Tears.

Fire rate on the other hand has linear returns. Each +1 fire rate increases shots per second by the same amount. Fire rate increases are applied before fire rate multipliers, so with a multiplier of 2, a +1 fire rate addition will increase fire rate by 2.

sections.heading: Characters
sections.text:
Different characters start with different initial tears stats and fire rate multipliers. The multipliers apply after most additive fire rate modifiers.

• The following characters start with the base +0 tears and ~2.73 fire rate: (Isaac, Magdalene, Cain, Judas, Black Judas, ???, Eve, Lazarus, The Lost, Lilith, Apollyon, The Soul, Bethany, Tainted Isaac, Tainted Magdalene, Tainted Cain, Tainted Judas, Tainted Lazarus, Tainted Lost, Tainted Lilith, Tainted Bethany)

• Samson/Tainted Samson: -0.1 tears

• Tainted Samson has fire rate x0.5 and then +2 while berserking

• Azazel: +0.5 tears, x0.267 fire rate

• Tainted Azazel: x1/3 fire rate

• Eden: ±0.75 tears

• Eden/Tainted Eden: +0.75 to -0.515 tears

• • [Repentance] Tainted Eden's base tears rerolls every time they take damage

• Keeper: -2 tears

• Keeper: -1.9 tears (will be ignored when player has 20/20)

• Tainted Keeper: -2.2 tears (will be ignored when player has 20/20)

• Jacob and Esau: +0.277 tears for Jacob, -0.1 for Esau

• Tainted Jacob: +0.277 tears

• Tainted ???: -0.35 tears

• Tainted Eve: -0.5 tears, x0.66 fire rate

• Dead Tainted Lazarus: -0.1 tears

• Tainted Apollyon: -0.5 tears

• The Forgotten / Tainted Forgotten: x0.5 fire rate (normally overwrites multiplier of Dr. Fetus, Brimstone, Ipecac, and Monstro's Lung)

• Tainted Bethany: x0.75 fire rate above base fire rate, gained by tears and Eye Drops. This results in a fire rate of 4.43 at tears-cap
