Demon Baby.title: Demon Baby
Demon Baby.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and automatically fires normal tears at enemies in its range 3 times per second that each do 3.5 damage.

• Contributes to the Conjoined transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Demon Baby having [edition alternatives: baseline: 5th; Repentance+: 7th] priority.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Box of Friends: If used without having any familiars, a Demon Baby will be spawned for the remainder of the current room.

• Chocolate Milk: Shoots at enemies while charging up a shot, thus giving Isaac an alternative way to kill enemies while charging a shot.

• Guppy: Spawns flies as if normal tears are hitting enemies.

• Mongo Baby: Behaves like Demon Baby, and will no longer shoot its regular tears unless Isaac has another compatible familiar. If Isaac has other familiars that Mongo Baby can mimic, its behavior alternates between Demon Baby’s and the other familiars’.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • In the original The Binding of Isaac, Demon Baby was unlocked by defeating Satan as Eve.

fields.image name: * [edition alternatives: Before Afterbirth+: Rebirth; Before Repentance: Afterbirth+]
fields.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and automatically fires at enemies within its range.

Depression.title: Depression
Depression.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of blue creep that damages enemies.

• The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.

• If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging Holy Light beam onto the enemy.

• The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] This item has a 1% chance to drop when defeating The Rainmaker. [end edition note] 

• [Repentance] Familiars that follow behind Isaac have a certain priority in how close their position is to him over other familiars, with Depression having the lowest priority at [Before Repentance+] 6th / [Repentance+] 8th and thus being farther from Isaac than familiars of different priorities.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • BFFS!: Increase cloud size but does not increase damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Depression is the emotional state of low mood and aversion to activity.

• Depression is also a state of air currents which often result in cloudy and wet weather.

fields.description: Spawns a familiar that leaves a trail of creep that damages enemies at 6 damage per second. Has a chance to spawn damaging beams of light onto enemies that touch the cloud.

Dessert.title: Dessert
Dessert.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one full Red Heart container.

• [Repentance] Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • This item has a 12.6% chance to spawn from paying out a Beggar in addition to being in the Beggar item pool. Multiple copies can be obtained through this method.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Binge Eater: When Isaac picks up Dessert it now grants: a permanent +1.0 Damage and +0.2 Shot Speed, a temporary +3.6 Damage (which diminishes to 0 in 30 seconds), heals 1 additional red heart, and takes a permanent -0.03 Speed reduction.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • [Repentance] Dessert’s sprites can be seen as part of Binge Eater. [end edition note]

fields.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. [Repentance] Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

Devil's Crown.title: Devil's Crown
Devil's Crown.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Every Treasure Room is replaced with a Devil Treasure Room which contains items from the Devil Room item pool that can be bought for the usual number of Heart Containers normally requested (for the spawned item) in a Devil Room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Devil Treasure Room generated will be the same as the Treasure Room that would have been generated, minus the item and room textures.

• Multiple-choice Treasure Rooms, such as those generated in alternative floors and ???, allow both items to be taken upon being converted to Devil Treasure Rooms. The blind item on alternate floors will still be blind, however.

• Urns, mushrooms, polyps, and buckets will be converted into skulls.

• This trinket also converts Treasure rooms on the current floor when picked up. However, this only affects Treasure Rooms that have not been visited yet.

• The same goes vice-versa: dropping the trinket will convert Devil Treasure Rooms to normal ones unless they've been visited.

• Items bought in the Devil Treasure Rooms will affect Angel Room chance like a normal Deal with the Devil would.

• When entering floors during the Ascent, Treasure Rooms visited during the run will keep their previous state, and will be unaffected by this trinket.

• However, unvisited Treasure Rooms can still be converted by dropping and picking up the trinket.

• Does not affect the Silver Treasure Rooms in Greed Mode.

• Extra treasure rooms generated by Red Key will be affected normally.

• Items spawned in Devil Treasure Rooms (e.g via Magic Skin, VI - The Lovers?, XVII - The Stars?, etc.) will all be drawn from the Devil Room item pool.

• Devil's Crown does not affect the reversed Treasure Room in Downpour/Dross II.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [Repentance+] Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Having either makes treasure rooms have a 25% chance of becoming a Number Magnet variant. Having both increases the chance to 33%.

• Getting this counts as Skipping the Treasure Room. Giving Planetarium Chance.

• Coupon: When used in a Devil Treasure Room, gives the item for free, acting like a regular Treasure Room but with devil items, only requiring the use of Coupon.

• This doesnt affect the Angel Room chance, like how using Coupon in a regular Devil Room and grabbing the free item wouldn't.

• Dream Catcher: Shows you the item that spawns without the trinket, allowing you to drop the trinket before entering if you think the treasure room item would be better than the devil deal.

• Glowing Hourglass: Allows you to check the item that spawns with and without the trinket, letting you pick the better item.

• More Options: All Devil Treasure Rooms will have two items, both of which can be purchased.

• This also extends to Broken Glasses, Golden Horse Shoe and XVII - The Stars cards buffed by Tarot Cloth.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Redemption: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular Devil Rooms for the purposes of this item.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Devil's Crown originates from the Antibirth mod.

fields.description: Treasure Rooms are replaced with unique Red Treasure Rooms, offering a Deal with the Devil in place of an item.

Stompy.title: Stompy
Stompy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stompy is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth †, making Isaac larger after picking up 3 items or pills that increase his size.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Gives a chance to spawn rock waves around Isaac upon taking damage.

• [Repentance] Isaac can crush rocks and other destructible obstacles by walking over them.

• Touching spiked rocks sometimes doesn't deal damage, depending on Isaac's size, speed and angle they're touched from.

• Isaac can also crush Rock Spiders and Tinted Rock Spiders by stepping on them. Killing a Rock Spider this way will spawn a Spider which is extremely likely to deal damage to Isaac. [end edition note] 

• Creates dust clouds when walking.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items or pills from the following list.

sections.heading: Pills
sections.text: • One Makes You Larger (each pill taken will count towards the transformation)

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• While the Thunder Thighs item does not contribute to the Stompy transformation, it still grants the ability to crush rocks and other destructible obstacles.

• Picking up items that decrease size do not count against progress for this transformation.

• [Before Repentance] This transformation makes it more difficult to effectively use [machine: Blood Donation Machine] s and [machine: Devil Beggar] s, as the rock waves will destroy them.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This transformation and Adult are the only transformations that pills count towards.

• This is the only transformation that doesn't add to Isaac's costume, and instead only changes his size and adds dust trails when he walks, as if kicking up dirt by stomping.

fields.description: Taking damage has a chance to spawn rock waves. [Repentance] Isaac can break obstacles by walking over them.

Stop Watch.title: Stop Watch
Stop Watch.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the normal watch; the broken version of this item; Broken Watch]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• [Rebirth only] Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room, which slows them down to approximately 51.3% of their original movement and attacking speeds.

• [edition anr] Inflicts slow to all enemies in the current room after the player is hit.

• [Repentance] Slows all enemies to 80% of their original movement speed and attacking speeds. This is separate from the slow status, and fully stacks with it. Isaac's tears and enemy shots are also slowed.

• +0.3 speed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] The background music is slowed down to 70% of the original speed of the music during the item's effect.

• [Repentance] The background music is slowed down to about 90% of the original speed. The slowdown makes the music approximately 2 semitones lower.

• If acquired through Eden's Blessing, the starting track will be affected as well. [end edition note] 

• [Before Repentance] Because of the slow effect, champion versions of enemies will be tinted the same color as all other enemies. This makes it much harder to distinguish certain champion types, such as those that explode upon death.

• Poky, Slides, minecarts and Mega Troll Bombs are not affected and will move in their regular speed.

• [Rebirth only] Stop Watch is a special item.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• [edition anr] Holy Mantle: Blocking damage with Holy Mantle triggers the Stop Watch effect.

• [Repentance] All Slow effects: Stacks with the status resulting in enemies moving at about 41% of their original speed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Broken Watch: Overridden by Stop Watch; the speed up effect will not occur.

• [Afterbirth onward] Both the slow effect and the rarer speed up can trigger at the start of a room.

• • [Before Repentance] This results in enemies being slowed to around 71.8% of their original speed.

• • [Repentance] This results in enemies being sped up by 12%.

• Tech X: Unlike most shots which are slowed down by Stop Watch, Tech X laser rings move at normal speed and gain no benefit they would get from slower shots.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: Era Walk]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Stop Watch is a reference to the item of the same name from the Castlevania series: upon using it, the character will slow down or outright freeze every enemy in the level for a short period of time.

• The name is also a play on the word "stopwatch" (being a pocket-sized timer that can be quickly started or stopped via a button)

fields.quote: Let's slow this down a bit...
fields.description:
[Rebirth only] +0.3 speed. Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room.
[edition anr] +0.3 speed. Upon taking damage, inflicts slow to all enemies for the current room.
[Repentance] +0.3 speed. Slows all enemies in every room to 80% speed.

Store Credit.title: Store Credit
Store Credit.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• While holding the trinket, all items in the Shop are free.

• After purchasing anything there, the trinket disappears.

• This trinket only works on monetary transactions within the Shop.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket: Does not disappear on use. Purchasing an item has a 25% chance to turn into a regular store credit trinket and 75% to remain golden.

sections.heading: Interaction
sections.text:
• Keeper's Box: Cannot be used on items/pickups spawned outside of the Shop.

• The Stairway: Cannot be used on the items/pickups found in the special Angel room.

• Marbles / Smelter / Gulp! pills: Store Credit's effect will only happen once after being absorbed.

• A Pound of Flesh: Store Credit becomes a useless trinket, as neither Devil Deals nor shop items will become free.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Buying a trinket (which is possible only in Greed Mode, as trinkets are not sold otherwise) while holding Store Credit will drop Store Credit without consuming it while still taking the trinket for free.
Bug note: Buying free pickups with the Bag of Crafting doesn't remove the trinket.

fields.name: Store Credit
fields.description: The next Shop purchase is free. The trinket disappears after purchasing anything there.

Store Key.title: Store Key
Store Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Shops can be opened without using Keys.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Cannot appear in Greed Mode.

• Keeper starts with this trinket after he defeats Satan.

• [Repentance] This trinket is useless for Tainted Keeper, as all shops are always open for him.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Shops cannot be their lowest quality variants. If Isaac has both a golden trinket and the Box, shop quality is improved in general.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text: • Pay To Play: Overrides Store Key. Shops still require a coin to enter.

fields.name: Store Key
fields.description: Shops can be opened without using Keys.

Strange Attractor.title: Strange Attractor
Strange Attractor.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the Strange Attractor item; a similar item; Magneto; a related trinket; Broken Magnet]

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Monsters, pickups, and trinkets are magnetically attracted to the player character's tears.

• [Afterbirth onward] This also applies to Isaac's bombs.

• [Repentance] Tears increase in magnetization as they travel, pulling enemies and items with less force at first but becoming stronger when they land.

• The effect may not affect certain immobile enemies; Round Worms will start to vibrate in the presence of multiple magnetic tears, but will not change their position, Hosts will only be attracted when readying to launch an attack.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Extra caution must be taken when using this item, as the attraction effect will pull small, lightweight monsters like Boom Fly towards the character very fast and in an unpredictable manner, with the consequent risk of taking damage.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Brimstone: Enemies and pickups are sucked towards the beam, increasing accuracy significantly.

• Dr. Fetus: Enemies are sucked towards bombs, increasing accuracy and making enemies easier to kill.

• Explosivo: When the shot sticks to an enemy, every enemy near it will be attracted to them.

• Godhead: Enemies will be pulled into Godhead's damaging aura, increasing the aura's effectiveness at causing damage.

• Ipecac: Enemies and pickups are pulled towards the shots, increasing accuracy. The color of shots and their explosive effect is a darker green.

• The Ludovico Technique: Enemies, items, and even most bosses will be sucked to the single floating tear, dealing constant damage while keeping Isaac well away from harm, making this combination extremely effective in almost all scenarios.

• Mom's Knife: Enemies are pulled towards the knife. The effect is minor while not firing and much stronger while the knife is launched.

• Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Attraction effect will remain on the booger shot stuck to an enemy. This can drag the enemy across the whole room until they reach one wall and get stuck on it, effectively disabling their normal movement.

• [Repentance] Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten attracts enemies, putting them in range of his bone club attack.

• Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5: The beam will attract enemies, often sucking them into the beam and holding them there.

• Tech X: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the outer ring, increasing accuracy.

• Tractor Beam: The lack of random spread and momentum-based trajectories on tears makes the way enemies are pulled around more predictable.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Anti-Gravity: The magnetic effect is stronger when multiple tears are stacked in the same position.

• Cricket's Body/Compound Fracture: Since tears will split into more tears, all traveling in different directions, enemies will be randomly moved around.

• Epic Fetus: Overrides Strange Attractor.

• [Afterbirth onward] Enemies get drawn towards the target mark on the ground, ensuring that the missile will hit.

• Explosivo: Enemies will be pulled toward the stuck on tears, dragging them helplessly or grouping them for the explosion.

• Haemolacria: Enemies and pickups are attracted to the main tear, but not burst tears.

• Lachryphagy: Enemies will often get sucked into tears, making it more difficult to feed tears or let them burst.

• Monstro's Lung: Due to the high concentration of tears, enemies will be pulled towards Isaac at great force; in certain cases, enough force will be generated to pull enemies through rocks. This can greatly increase accuracy but depending on enemies' movements and positions can also damage Isaac.

• The Parasite: Enemies will be pulled towards both fired tears and split tears. However, because they both travel in opposite directions, the split tears' magnetic effects tend to cancel each other out.

• Rubber Cement: Due to tears being reflected, enemies tend to be pulled towards Isaac with much force. Additionally, the random angle of tears being reflected results in erratic enemy movement. Not recommended.

• Soy Milk: The rapid tears will pull enemies quickly and erratically around the room. Not recommended.

• Tiny Planet/Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: The orbiting tears will cause enemies to be pulled towards Isaac. Not recommended.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is most likely based on Crazy Aaron's Magnetic Thinking Putty, which has a color of the same name and the tears resemble it.

• Strange Attractor is also a mathematical concept found in dynamical linear systems.

• This item is used in Waka Waka.

fields.description: Pickups, trinkets, and monsters are magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears.

Strange Key.title: Strange Key
Strange Key.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: [disambig msg: the trinket that opens the Hush fight and empowers Pandora's Box; the trinket that creates Blue Womb rooms; Blue Key]

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Unlocks the passageway to ???, regardless of run duration.

• If Pandora's Box is used while holding Strange Key, the following effects will occur instead of Pandora's Box regular effects:

• The normal effect of Pandora's Box for that level is ignored, and instead 6 random items from any of the following item pools are spawned: Treasure Room, Shop, Boss Room, Devil Room, Angel Room, Secret Room, Library, Locked Chest, Curse Room, and Planetarium.

• Both Pandora's Box and the trinket are consumed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Both effects work even if the key has been turned into a passive item from items such as Smelter or Marbles.

• Using Pandora's Box with the key in this state will remove the key from Isaac's Inventory.

• If playing with modal characters such as Tainted Lazarus, the character with the Strange Key must enter the room while holding it to cause the passage to open. Leaving and re-entering the room after switching to the correct character will open the door normally.

• Unlike with Mama Mega!, It Lives! must be beaten for the passageway to ??? to open.

• If the passageway to ??? is somehow not yet unlocked, Strange Key will not open the door.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: Gives +2 random items when used with Pandora's box per copy and can be used to open all locked chests and doors in ???.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Strange Key is likely a reference to the film by David Lynch, Mulholland Drive (2001), where a small blue box being unlocked by a strange key is a major plot point.

fields.description: Unlocks the passageway to ??? and the Hush fight, regardless of the run duration. Using Pandora's Box grants it a special effect, consuming the key.

Strawman.title: Strawman
Strawman.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns Keeper as an extra character alongside Isaac, who is controlled exactly like Esau.

• Keeper will have his base stats, except speed, and use coins as health.

• He will not receive any of his starting items, such as Wooden Nickel or Store Key.

• When Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.

• Grants 1 Bomb upon pickup.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• For calculating room drops, the room drop rate depends on the total luck of Isaac and the Keeper. Because Keeper starts with -2 luck, having Strawman makes room drops much less likely.

• Keeper's health is displayed at all times above his head.

• If [curse: unknown] is in effect, his health bar will be hidden the same way as Isaac's.

• Keeper will start with 2 coin hearts or 3 if the Keeper now holds... A Penny! achievement is unlocked.

• Keeper is able to pick up items independently from Isaac. He has his own inventory.

• This inventory is not displayed on the HUD.

• When Keeper dies, the items he obtained are permanently removed.

• • [Before Repentance+] This includes quest items like The Polaroid, potentially leaving you unable to progress.

• [Repentance+] Keeper can't pick up quest items.

• Keeper is not able to pick up any active items, trinkets, or consumables.

• Keeper cannot pick up any type of hearts, except for Gold Hearts.

• Eternal Hearts can also be picked up, but to no effect, effectively wasting them.

• Keeper's speed syncs with Isaac's, as with Jacob and Esau.

• [Before Repentance+] Devil Room items will cost money instead of health as long as Keeper is alive.

• [Repentance+] Devil Room Items costing red hearts can be picked up by Keeper. Items costing red heart containers will remove the corresponding amount of coin hearts from Keeper. Going to zero coins hearts will kill Keeper. Items costing any amount of soul hearts or active items costing red hearts other than Book of Virtues can not be interacted with by Keeper as if they were a shop item that can not be afforded. 

• [Repentance+] Devil Room Items that can be picked up for free via The Lost, Tainted Lost, Tainted Jacob in ghost form, Soul of the Lost, and White Fire Place, can be picked up by Keeper without other items disappearing. Allowing keeper to take the remaining items before Isaac picks up an item. 

• When placing a Bomb, Keeper will place another at no cost.

• Keeper can be used to play Sacrifice Rooms at the cost of coins instead of hearts.

• Boss Challenge Rooms will be closed unless Keeper is also at 1 coin heart.

• Keeper is not able to walk through doors or into Crawl Space, although he is able to enter the beam of light that takes Isaac to the next floor after the Mom's Heart / It Lives! fight, the one spawned by Genesis, as well as entering the big chest after defeating bosses in later stages.

• Respawn items work as normal for Keeper, but never involve teleporting to the previous room (see interactions).

• If Keeper plays a [machine: Blood Donation Machine] , it will pay out with 0-1 coins.

• Keeper unlocks cannot be earned using Strawman.

• Similar to Jacob and Esau, it is possible to take both items between item choice pedestals with careful positioning.

• Even though Keeper is considered a second character, the run ends if Isaac dies.

• Technically, Strawman is marked as a familiar item in the game's files, although most familiar-modifying items, such as BFFS! don't have any effect on Keeper.

• Unlike Jacob and Esau, invincibility frames are not shared between Keeper and Isaac.

• If collected in a challenge where Isaac is blindfolded, Keeper will be blindfolded too.

• Re-emerging from the part of Mines II where Knife Piece 2 is hidden will cause Strawman to be regenerated from scratch. This permanently remove all items the summoned Keeper had collected up until that point.

• If Strawman is picked up during the second lap of a Victory Lap, he will become The Lost alongside Isaac on every subsequent lap.

• [Before Repentance+] If Keeper is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning Perfection, regardless of whether or not the main character has been hit.

• This item boosts the exploration bonus in daily runs a lot.

• [Repentance+] Strawman's quality is treated as 2 for the purposes of Bag of Crafting. [end edition note] 

• Keeper can not be hit by Dark Esau, only being pushed around by Dark Esau's collision.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Birthright: If Keeper is the one picking it up, it will grant him a heart container.

• Crooked Penny / Diplopia: Picking up multiple copies of the item will spawn additional Keepers that each have their own inventory.

• Extension Cord: Beams of electricity flow between Keeper and Isaac.

• Greed's Gullet: Keeper gains extra coin hearts at every 25 coin interval.

• More Options / There's Options: With careful positioning, both item choice pedestals can be taken.

• [Before Repentance+] The Polaroid / The Negative: Keeper can take the other photo not chosen by Isaac. Keeper will not directly benefit from holding the Polaroid, but the Negative will give him a damage up. Keeper can use his photo to open A Strange Door, allowing Isaac to keep his. If intending to go to Chest or Dark Room, note that the photo held by Keeper will be lost if he dies.

• Sanguine Bond: A very beneficial item for both Isaac and Keeper, as it is fairly easy to snowball into infinitely playing the spikes.

• Yum Heart: Because of how Yum Heart works in co-op, when Isaac uses Yum Heart, it will also restore one coin heart for Keeper.

• Tainted Isaac : Items left out by Tainted Isaac can be picked up by Keeper.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• 1up!: Upon death, Keeper revives at full health in the current room.

• 4.5 Volt / 9 Volt / The Battery / Battery Pack / Car Battery / Habit / Jumper Cables / Sharp Plug: Useless on Keeper, unless Book of Virtues is held.

• Ankh / Judas' Shadow / Lazarus' Rags: Keeper will respawn as the respective character in the current room.

• Ankh + Birthright: Strawman ??? will get twice as much HP from health upgrades.

• Judas' Shadow + Birthright: Strawman Black Judas can use the The Book of Belial acquired via Birthright as normal and the item recharges as normal. Book of Virtues stacks like usual.

• Lazarus' Rags + Birthright: If Birthright was obtained prior to respawn, does nothing. If picked up after, grants its temporary damage.

• • Keeper: While playing as Keeper, if Strawman respawns via any of the aforementioned items, health no longer converts to flies.

• Astral Projection: Keeper gains full benefit of Astral Projection. Isaac gets no speed or fire rate bonuses during its effect, however.

• Baby-Bender / BFFS! / Box of Friends: Strawman does not count as a familiar for the purpose of these items.

• Big Fan / Guardian Angel: If Keeper is the one who picked it up, it will only buff orbital speed for him.

• BFFS! / Hive Mind: If Keeper is the one who picked it up, it will only buff his familiars/flies and spiders and none of Isaac's.

• Blood Bombs: Keeper can keep placing bombs for health after Isaac has run out.

• Book of Virtues: The book can be picked up by Keeper and used as normal, making it the only active item he can use.

• Book of Virtues + Missing No.: The book does not get rerolled.

• Dead Cat: Keeper's maximum health is set to 1 coin. Upon death, he revives in the current room with maximum health reset to 1 coin.

• Eden's Blessing: If Keeper picks up Eden's Blessing, the extra item will be awarded to Isaac at the start of the next run whether Keeper survives or not.

• Esau Jr.: Switching once and back will clear any items Keeper may have had.

• False PHD / PHD: Identifies pills, but doesn't convert them.

• Genesis: Will not grant item choices for any of Keeper's collected items.

• Guppy's Collar: Upon death, Keeper has a chance to revive with 1 coin of filled health in the current room.

• Lachryphagy: Isaac's tears can feed Keeper's for great damage. If Isaac, however, has Lachryphagy, Keeper's tears still interact with them, although sometimes it feeds them, other times it absorbs them, without the splitting effect.

• The Ladder: A ladder will spawn across gaps for the Keeper, however he cannot use it, only Isaac.

• Spirit Shackles: The effect will only happen once, as Keeper cannot recharge them.

• Tainted Cain: Items will not turn into pickups if Keeper takes them.

• Tainted Lazarus/Dead Tainted Lazarus: Upon flipping, Keeper gets regenerated from scratch, meaning his health gets restored to full and all items he picked up will be permanently removed.

• TMTRAINER: All items will become glitched if Keeper holds TMTRAINER. He can be killed to restore item generation to normal.

sections.heading: Unlockable Achievements
sections.text: [achievement text: The Parasite]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A "straw man" (sometimes written as strawman) is a form of argument and an informal fallacy of having the impression of refuting an argument, whereas the real subject of the argument was not addressed or refuted, but instead replaced with a false one. One who engages in this fallacy is said to be "attacking a straw man". "Strawman theory" can also refer to the pseudolegal concept of every individual having two personas — the flesh-and-blood person themselves and their "legal person" — with debts, liabilities, taxes, legal responsibilities, restraining orders, etc. only being applicable to the latter, allowing the former to (supposedly) flout laws that happen to inconvenience them. The fact that the Strawman item spawns a Keeper to be controlled concurrently with your original character lends credence to this latter interpretation of the term.

• Strawman, alongside Mom's Ring, is one of two items which cannot be rerolled into by Spindown Dice; in Strawman's case, this is because the next item by ID number is Dad's Note, which cannot be rerolled by any means (not even if rerolled into by Spindown Dice from Sausage outside of its designated room).

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: Box of Friends will not spawn a Demon Baby if Isaac has no familiars while Keeper is alive.
Bug note: Entering and exiting the Knife Piece 2 sequence in Mines/Ashpit II will remove any items from Strawman.
Bug note: If a Strawman picks up a Strawman of its own, and then the run is exited and re-entered, the game will think a co-op player is present and ask you to connect another controller. If you can't, then you are forced to reboot your game, and the run is unplayable. This also happens when playing Jacob and Esau if Esau picks up Strawman, or when playing as Tainted Lazarus while holding Birthright, and the form holding Strawman is inactive when the run is exited.

fields.description: Spawns a controllable Keeper to fight enemies alongside Isaac, functioning similarly to Jacob and Esau. If Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.

Stud Finder.title: Stud Finder
Stud Finder.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: • When a rock is destroyed, there is an additional 1 in 200 (0.5%) chance for a Crawl Space to spawn.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Stud Finder's effect is applied when a rock is destroyed and does not depend on the rock's location.

• Any of the rocks already seen before picking up Stud Finder can be affected by the trinket.

• Shiny Rock doesn't synergize with Stud Finder, as there is no set location for the rocks that will reveal a Crawl Space when destroyed with Stud Finder.

• Unlike Tinted Rocks and normal Crawl Space rocks, whose generation is dependent on the room they're in, Stud Finder's Crawl Space generation effect mainly depends on the number of rocks destroyed, which means that the more rocks destroyed, the higher the chance to find a Crawl Space.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Mom's Box / Golden Trinket: The chance to find a crawl space increases to 1 in 100 (1%).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • [Afterbirth+ onward] Stud Finder's sprite was changed for Booster Pack #5.

fields.name: Stud Finder
fields.description: Increases the chance to spawn a Crawl Space when a rock is destroyed.

Stye.title: Stye
Stye.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Tears fired from Isaac's right eye have +28% Damage, +6.5 Range, and -0.3 Shot Speed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Brimstone / Technology 2: Has a 50% chance to gain the Damage boost from Stye each individual time they deal damage.

• Stapler / Cain + Chemical Peel / Blood Clot: Each fired tear will have the effects of either Stye or Chemical Peel/Blood Clot.

• Dr. Fetus: Each bomb fired has a 50% chance of gaining the damage boost, but not its Range/Shot Speed effects. Affected bombs and their explosions are tinted a pale blue.

• The 28% damage boost is applied to Isaac's base tear damage and does not affect any other aspect of Dr. Fetus's damage calculation.

• Stye: Multiple copies do not stack. Only the first Stye obtained grants stat changes.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This item is similar to Blood Clot and Chemical Peel, which instead affect tears fired from Isaac's left eye only.

• A stye is a medical condition which involves a painful swollen lump on the eye, usually on the inside of the eyelid.

fields.description: Tears fired from Isaac's right eye have +28% Damage, +6.5 Range, and -0.3 Shot Speed.

Succubus.title: Succubus
Succubus.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Spawns a familiar that bounces around the room and has a dark aura around it.

• Enemies within the radius of the aura take damage.

• • [Before Repentance] The aura deals 30% of Isaac's damage per tick or about 129% of Isaac's damage per second.

• • [Repentance] The aura deals 2.5 damage per tick or about 7.5-10 damage per second.

• If Isaac is within the aura, his tears gain a 1.5× damage multiplier.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The damage boost stacks with other Succubi, as well as other damage multipliers (e.g. Cricket's Head, Sacred Heart, etc.).

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Rock Bottom: The damage boost is permanent. Damage is easier to stack, since Isaac can enter the Succubus aura to permanently boost any temporary damage-ups.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• BFFS!: Succubus and its damaging aura are visually larger, but the damage multiplier is not increased any further away from the familiar. However, the damaging aura is increased.

• Libra: When Isaac is within the aura, affects re-balanced stats rather than just damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• In folklore, Succubi are female demons that attempt to seduce men in their dreams.

• Incubus is the male version of a succubus.

sections.heading: Bugs
sections.text:
Bug note: If Succubus is spawned through Cambion Conception, its dark aura will not grant a damage multiplier to Isaac.
Bug note: If Sacrificial Altar is used to sacrifice Succubus while Isaac is in its dark aura, the damage multiplier will remain active until the remainder of the floor.

fields.description: Spawns a flying familiar that bounces around the room with a black aura, dealing rapid damage to any enemies inside it. While standing in the aura, Isaac gains a 1.5× tear damage multiplier.

Suicide King.title: Suicide King
Suicide King.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Not to be confused with Suicide King (Challenge).

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Kills Isaac and spawns 10 consumables and/or items around the location of use.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Being a special card, Suicide King has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.

• The spawned collectibles will come from the Item Pool related to the Room where Suicide King was used (e.g. Angel Room items if used in an Angel Room).

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
• Since using Suicide King means death, Isaac will need to have a resurrection item to make a good use of it, such as 1up!, the Ankh, the Dead Cat, or being Lazarus.

• When combined with Blank Card and Dead Cat, the card can be used nine times (spawning a total of 90 consumables and/or items).

• Suicide King won't always drop a pedestal item, but often drops numerous Chests, meaning that using Suicide King on a special room or in Chest/Dark Room can be useful to get good items.

• [Repentance] When doing a true co-op run, the player that uses Suicide King can be revived by beating the floor boss. An ideal time to use this card would be during the fight with the floor's boss while its health is low.

• [Repentance+] In online co-op mode, the player who uses Suicide King can also be revived at any time, for a cost, using the Revive Machine.

• Although a niche situation, Echo Chamber and multiple Suicide Kings, likely via Echo Chambered Jera, and several extra lives like the Dead Cat allows stacking large amounts of rewards: each Suicide King in the Echo Chamber spawns its rewards, but Isaac dies only once, allowing up to 4x rewards per life. Counting remaining lives and using different consumables to remove the Suicide Kings from the Chamber afterwards is important to keep in mind.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The Suicide King card is a nickname for the King of Hearts, referred to as such because its artwork depicts a king who seems to be sticking a sword into his own head.

• When Suicide King causes a Game Over (i.e. is used with no revive items), a picture of the last cause of damage will appear on Isaac's last will as the cause of death.

• The background color for the Suicide King achievement has the same color as all the Boss Rush unlocks, suggesting that the Suicide King card was originally intended to be unlocked via completing a Boss Rush, with Lazarus.

• This is further evidenced by the fact that Missing No., Lazarus's Boss Rush unlock has a Challenge background color. This implies that the Suicide King challenge originally unlocked Missing No., or it was intended to be looked at as an error or a glitch, as Missing No. is a glitch-related item.

• The card quote reinforces the idea proposed by Reddit user Jayborino that the only way for Isaac to get out of the chest in the "real world" is to die in the game.

• This user was praised by Edmund himself for his article being "mind blowingly accurate".

fields.description: Kills Isaac and spawns lots of Pickups, items, and/or Chests in the same room.

Sulfur.title: Sulfur
Sulfur.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Upon activation, Isaac is turned into a demon and gains the effects of Brimstone for the current room.

• If Sulfur has already been used in the current room, it instead gives Isaac a 1.2x damage multiplier, +1 damage, and increases the size of the laser for the current room.

• • Further uses of Sulfur will increase Isaac's damage by 1.

• Contributes to the Leviathan transformation.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Sulfur functions identically to Brimstone. For a full list of interactions, see that page.

• Sulfur is extremely powerful in Greed Mode, since it can be used multiple times in the same arena.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: Spawns red wisps in the middle ring that fire a short Brimstone laser beam similar to Azazel, but significantly smaller.

• Brimstone/Car Battery: Activates twice to give an additional damage bonus and wider laser.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Sulfur originates from the Antibirth mod, and by extension, from the Community Remix mod for the flash version.

• In Antibirth, due to a bug, using Sulfur twice in one room would permanently grant Brimstone to Isaac instead of giving him a more powerful brimstone laser.

• "Sulfur" and "Brimstone" were once synonyms but the word "brimstone" has fallen out of use (outside of biblical usage).

• Sulfur's appearance is based on the alchemical symbol for sulfur, although the triangle is upside-down and it lacks a small piece separating the cross from the triangle.

• This item has the same pickup quote as The Nail.

fields.description: Grants Brimstone for the current room.

Sulfuric Acid.title: Sulfuric Acid
Sulfuric Acid.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• +0.3 damage.

• Adds a 25% chance to fire acidic tears that destroy obstacles and open doors (including Secret Room entrances) upon contact.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Tears open only closed doors, not locked doors.

• The chance to fire an acid tear does not increase with luck.

• The acidic tears affect static objects like Bombs, but with some differences:

• They do not open Bomb Chests.

• [Before Repentance] They cannot bridge gaps with obstacles.

• • [Repentance] Gaps are now bridged.

• [Before Repentance] Poop is not destroyed in one hit.

• [Repentance] The mirror leading to the Mirrored World cannot be destroyed.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• [Before Repentance] Brimstone/Tech.5/Technology/Technology 2/Tech X: Only the stat bonus applies to the laser.

• [Repentance] Lasers will sometimes destroy rocks, but will not open doors or secret rooms and has no color change.

• [Repentance+] Lasers can sometimes destroy rocks and doors. Still no color change.

• Broken Padlock: Locked doors can be opened by shooting at them.

• Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus/Ipecac: Overrides Sulfuric Acid, stat bonus still applies.

• Finger!: The finger can destroy rocks when pointing at them.

• Spirit Sword: Only the energy beams can destroy rocks.

• The Forgotten: Only the boomerang attack can destroy obstacles, not swings.

• The Ludovico Technique: The Ludovico tear occasionally becomes acidic.

• [Before Repentance] Mom's Knife: Overrides Sulfuric Acid, stat bonus still applies.

• [Repentance] Knife can destroy obstacles and open doors and secret rooms upon contact with no visual indicator.

• Rubber Cement: Acidic tears can no longer break objects and doors and just bounce.

• [Before Repentance] Spectral tears: Acidic tears will no longer be able to destroy obstacles or open secret rooms.

• [Repentance] Acidic tears break rocks and open secret rooms, without being broken themselves on impact.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Sulfuric acid is a strong, corrosive acid, commonly used as a drain cleaner.

fields.description: +0.3 damage. Adds a chance to fire acidic tears which can destroy obstacles and open doors.

Sumptorium.title: Sumptorium
Sumptorium.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• When used by any character other than Tainted Eve, removes half a heart of health upon use and creates a Clot familiar.

• Blood clot familiars mimic Isaac's movement (including flight), firing, and tear effects.

• Blood clot familiars will mimic all tear-altering effects, such as Spirit Sword.

• Holding down the swap button allows Isaac to move independently from the blood clots.

• • The familiars have health and will be destroyed if they take enough damage. They start with a set amount of HP when spawned, and the health of Red Heart and Rotten Heart Clots will slowly decay down to 1 HP over time, while the health of the other clot types decay down to 5 HP.

• • 
• Their health decays at a rate of 1 HP per 2.5 seconds.

• • 
• They are immune to hazards such as spikes, Fire Places, and lasers.

• • 
• Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage to them when hit.

• • 
• Isaac's Bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.

• • Draining health does not count as taking damage, so creating familiars will not trigger damage-activated effects.

• Each type of heart generates a different type of blood clot:

| Heart | Appearance | Health | Damage | Tear effect

| | | 15 | 35% | n/a

| | | 22.5 | 35% | n/a

| | | 15 | 43% | Dark Matter

| | | 15 | 52% | Sacred Heart

| | | 15 | 35% | Midas' Touch (scales with luck)

| | | 15 | 35% | Compound Fracture

| | | 7.5 | 35% | n/a

For Tainted Eve only

• Passively, holding down the fire button will create blood clot familiars every two seconds and drain half a heart.

• Upon activation, Sumptorium destroys any remaining blood clots and heals Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts that were used to generate them. The blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through as they return.

• Should Tainted Eve have more blood clots than room in her health bar when doing this, all excess blood clots will drop next to her.

• The charge time is only 1 second rather than 10 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The type of heart drained first is decided by the following order: Gold Hearts, Eternal Hearts, Rotten Hearts, Red Hearts, then the rightmost Soul Hearts, Black Hearts, or Bone Hearts.

• Clots from a previous run will carry over during a RERUN.

• Sumptorium can't spawn more than 64 clots at once.

• This limit is shared with blue flies and blue spiders. If there are multiple flies, spiders and clots on the screen at the same time, the limit will be 32 for the clots and 32 for the flies/spiders.

• Sumptorium cannot absorb more than 29 clots at once.

• Activating Sumptorium does not restore Tainted Eve's health immediately, as it is not restored until the recalled blood clots return to Eve.

• If Isaac obtains flight, the clots will hover instead of moving across the floor.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
• Baby-Bender: Gives the clots homing shots.

• BFFS!: Doubles the clots' size and damage.

• Forgotten Lullaby: Increases the clots' fire rate.

• Glowing Hourglass: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate the clots. (This is possibly a bug)

• Sacrificial Altar: Turns each clot into a penny.

• Spin to Win: Makes the clots deal 6 contact damage.

• The Ludovico Technique: Spawns a controllable Ludo tear for each clot.

• The Ludovico Technique + A Lump of Coal: Each Ludo tear's damage is based off of the distance from its corresponding clot.

sections.heading: Interactions
sections.text:
• Book of Virtues interaction: For Tainted Eve, it will create red wisps for every clot consumed, and they will disappear if she starts creating clots again. Soul charges cannot be used to create wisps. Has no effect for other characters.

• Box of Friends: Cannot be used to duplicate clots.

• Car Battery: Summons 2 clots instead of one for double the health cost. Not Recommended forTainted Keeper as it can instantly kill him.

• The Forgotten: In order to stop clots from moving while playing as The Forgotten, it is needed to hold down Left CTRL/RT while switching to The Soul, and vice-versa.

• Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Coin hearts count as Red hearts.

• Lazarus / Revival Items: Clots will be retained after losing the extra life.

• The Lost / Tainted Lost: Sumptorium spawns a blue clot and kills The Lost and Tainted Lost immediately upon use. However, they can still get golden clots without dying if they pick up a golden heart.

• My Reflection: Clots' tears will be redirected to Isaac instead of returning back to them.

• Strawman: Clots will follow Strawman instead of Isaac if they were spawned in a previous room.

• Tainted Eden: Clots made by Sumptorium are retained after taking damage.

• Tainted Forgotten: Clots made by Sumptorium have a club too, but they are commanded by Tainted Soul, making it the only way to attack while moving freely.

• Tractor Beam: Clots' tears will be fired from Isaac instead, and will stay within the tractor beam.

sections.heading: Interactions with Tainted Eve
sections.text:
• Alabaster Box: Sumptorium can create clots by using hearts inside the box. It prioritizes hearts inside the box instead of using Eve's soul or black hearts.

• Lil Clot: The clot spawned by this trinket is its own separate clot variant although it functions the same as the red one. As such, it cannot be absorbed by Sumptorium.

• Maggy's Bow: Does not provide additional healing when absorbing clots.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• A Sumptorium is a metal drinking straw used in the Roman Rite to receive the Blood of Christ in Holy Communion.

• Even though Tainted Eve wields a Sumptorium-like weapon when left on half a heart and all blood clots are destroyed, this is not an effect given by the Sumptorium item itself and is a character-specific trait.

fields.description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As Tainted Eve, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.

Super Ball.title: Super Ball
Super Ball.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text:
• Adds a 10% chance to fire tears that bounce off of enemies and obstacles.

• [Before Repentance+] The chance is not affected by luck.

• • [Repentance+] The chance is now affected by luck, maxing out at 100% at 18 luck.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Super Ball's tear effect functions identically to Rubber Cement. For a full list of interactions and synergies, see that page.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 20% and having both to 33%.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • A Super Ball is a type of toy ball that is known for its extreme bounciness. Dropping it onto a hard surface will cause it to bounce nearly to the point it was dropped.

fields.description: Makes tears have a chance to bounce off enemies and obstacles.

Super Bandage.title: Super Bandage
Super Bandage.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
• Grants one full Red Heart container as well as two Soul Hearts.

• Heals 1 additional heart of health.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The item is a reference to Super Meat Boy, one of Edmund McMillen's other games.

• [Repentance] When picked up, the sound effect that plays is the same one used in Super Meat Boy when the player gets a bandage.

• [Repentance] Super Bandage, along with 1up!, Magic Mushroom, Mini Mush, and Mega Mush is one of the few items that make a unique sound upon pickup.

fields.description: Grants one full Red Heart container and 2 Soul Hearts.

Super Bum.title: Super Bum
Super Bum.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Super Bum is a transformation added in The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth, turning Isaac's three bums into Super Bum.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text: • Replaces all bum familiars obtained before or after the transformation with a Super Bum familiar, who automatically collects all coins, red hearts, and keys in the room and drops twice as many rewards as the regular bums would have produced.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Pick up 3 items from the following list.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• This transformation has a unique animation sequence when the third bum is picked up.

• When Dark Bum is obtained through Cambion Conception, it does not count towards the transformation.

• If multiple bums of the same kind were present before the transformation, e.g. via Box of Friends, all of them will be replaced with only one Super Bum when three different bums are obtained.

• [edition anr] From a scoring perspective, consumables that Super Bum picks up count towards your Schwag bonus on daily runs.

• [Repentance] Whenever Super Bum drops items, it will drop 2 copies of the same item.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• This is the only transformation that does not affect Isaac himself, but instead transforms (and even fuses) certain familiars.

• This is the only transformation that has a unique animation.

• [Repentance] This is the only transformation that Tainted Isaac is required to have 3 pieces of in his inventory in order to obtain it.

fields.description: Replaces Bum Friend, Dark Bum, and Key Bum with Super Bum. This bum collects any of the other beggars' pickups, and offers twice the rewards.

Super Envy.title: Super Envy
Super Envy.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Super Envy is a mini-boss and one of the Seven Super Deadly Sins. He is randomly encountered as an alternate version of Envy.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
• Super Envy floats around the room diagonally, bouncing off of the walls.

• Splits into three medium heads upon death which split into 2-3 small heads each when destroyed. These small heads split one last time into 2 even smaller heads when destroyed.

• The last head killed drops a Troll Bomb or Shoop da Whoop! / Forever alone.

• The heads increase in speed as they split into smaller versions.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Before Repentance] Super Envy can drop Shoop da Whoop! / Forever alone even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Like Envy, Super Envy's expressions are a reference to "rage comic" memes, with the biggest and smallest heads showing a troll face and poker face, respectively.

• This is reinforced by his drops Shoop da Whoop! / Forever alone, both references to memes from the same era.

• Envy and Super Envy have a lower chance of dropping their item than the other sins.

• The Seven Deadly Sins that these mini-bosses are based upon are, in Christian teachings, a classification of vices from which all others are derived.

• [Afterbirth+ onward] Until patch v1.06.J149, Super Envy had a chance to spawn a Shoop da Whoop! instead of a Forever alone. According to the developers, he was always intended to drop Forever alone, but the behavior has been bugged since the initial port of the game.

• [Repentance] Super Envy is the only Super Sin whose Stage HP wasn't increased in Repentance.

Super Gluttony.title: Super Gluttony
Super Gluttony.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Super Gluttony is a mini-boss and one of the Seven Super Deadly Sins. He is randomly encountered as an alternate version of Gluttony.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Super Gluttony wanders randomly around the room and performs one of two attacks:

• Fires 8 projectiles in all directions in conjunction with a disorganized spray of projectiles aimed at Isaac, similar to Monstro.

• Fires a Brimstone laser out of his belly and back towards Isaac if he is aligned in a cardinal direction.
Super Gluttony deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Super Gluttony can spawn with 2 Vis in the mini-boss room.

• [Before Repentance] Super Gluttony can drop Bucket of Lard even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Similar to Gluttony, who is a Vis with a head, Super Gluttony is a Double Vis with a head.

• The Seven Deadly Sins that these mini-bosses are based upon are, in Christian teachings, a classification of vices from which all others are derived.

Super Greed.title: Super Greed
Super Greed.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Super Greed is a mini-boss and one of the Seven Super Deadly Sins. He can appear in Shop or Secret Room, but only if Greed has previously been encountered this way.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text:
Super Greed wanders randomly around the room and performs one of two attacks:

• Fires a spread of 4 projectiles in the cardinal direction closest to Isaac.

• Spawns 2 Keepers to his either side.
If hit by Super Greed, Isaac loses 2-4 coins and drops 1-3 Penny on the floor.

Super Greed deals a whole heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Defeating Super Greed in a Secret Room causes all entrances to adjacent room entrances to be opened. [Before Repentance+] The exceptions are entrances to adjacent Challenge Rooms and Boss Challenge Rooms- which will be barred and blocked off forever, unable to be opened by a bomb.

• If Isaac teleports out of the room after defeating Super Greed but without killing all of the Keepers he spawns, Isaac can re-fight Super Greed for extra coins.

• Shops and Secret Rooms that Super Greed appears in count as Mini-Boss Rooms, and cannot be bombed out of. They also prevent any other mini-boss rooms from generating on that floor. Once Super Greed is encountered in a Shop or Secret Room, he and Greed cannot be encountered that way for the rest of the run.

• [Before Repentance] Super Greed can drop Steam Sale / A Quarter even if Isaac has already encountered/possessed it. 

• [Repentance] The exact spawn chances for Greed/Super Greed are as follows:

• Base chance 33.3%

• Having more than 20 coins entering the floor: +1.66%

• Destroyed a machine on the previous floor: +3.33%

• Destroyed a Shopkeeper in the previous floor: +0.66%

• Donating money in the previous floor: -1.66% per coin, up to a maximum of -8.33% for 5 coins

• These put the minimum and maximum chances at 25% and 39% respectively.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Afterbirth+ onward] Prior to Booster Pack #5, Super Greed had a chance to spawn Blisters. [end edition note] 

• The Seven Deadly Sins that these mini-bosses are based upon are, in Christian teachings, a classification of vices from which all others are derived.

• [Repentance] Tainted Keeper seems to be based on Super Greed, as Keeper is to Greed. [end edition note]

interactions.text: • Any reroll item/collectible: Items in the room can be rerolled, and if the result is undesirable, then Isaac can go back in time to save whatever was used to reroll. However, note that activating the reroll on the same items again will result in the same items being generated as the first time. Rerolling different items from the same type of room (such as going to a different Shop) will result in the reroll effect creating new and different items. This technique is useful for saving charges on items like The D6, or getting multiple options with consumables like the Perthro.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Anything that spawns an item such as Mystery Gift / XVII - The Stars?: After the player activates them, they can then go back in time if the item is undesirable. However, unlike reroll effects, using something that spawns an item/collectible will always generate that same item, dependent on the room type, even if the player goes to a different one in the future. For example, activating XVII - The Stars? in a Secret Room will create two items from the Secret Room item pool, and even if the player goes to the next floor and uses it again in a new Secret Room, the same exact items will be generated. So, the best way to use something that spawns an item is to activate it in rooms with different item pools (Secret, Devil/Angel, Treasure, Shop, etc.) and see which item would be the best before accepting it.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Spin to Win: Makes the clots deal 6 contact damage.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • The Ludovico Technique: Spawns a controllable Ludo tear for each clot.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • The Ludovico Technique + A Lump of Coal: Each Ludo tear's damage is based off of the distance from its corresponding clot.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Book of Virtues interaction: For Tainted Eve, it will create red wisps for every clot consumed, and they will disappear if she starts creating clots again. Soul charges cannot be used to create wisps. Has no effect for other characters.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Box of Friends: Cannot be used to duplicate clots.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Car Battery: Summons 2 clots instead of one for double the health cost. Not Recommended forTainted Keeper as it can instantly kill him.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • The Forgotten: In order to stop clots from moving while playing as The Forgotten, it is needed to hold down Left CTRL/RT while switching to The Soul, and vice-versa.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Keeper / Tainted Keeper: Coin hearts count as Red hearts.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Lazarus / Revival Items: Clots will be retained after losing the extra life.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • The Lost / Tainted Lost: Sumptorium spawns a blue clot and kills The Lost and Tainted Lost immediately upon use. However, they can still get golden clots without dying if they pick up a golden heart.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • My Reflection: Clots' tears will be redirected to Isaac instead of returning back to them.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Strawman: Clots will follow Strawman instead of Isaac if they were spawned in a previous room.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Tainted Eden: Clots made by Sumptorium are retained after taking damage.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Tainted Forgotten: Clots made by Sumptorium have a club too, but they are commanded by Tainted Soul, making it the only way to attack while moving freely.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Tractor Beam: Clots' tears will be fired from Isaac instead, and will stay within the tractor beam.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Alabaster Box: Sumptorium can create clots by using hearts inside the box. It prioritizes hearts inside the box instead of using Eve's soul or black hearts.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Lil Clot: The clot spawned by this trinket is its own separate clot variant although it functions the same as the red one. As such, it cannot be absorbed by Sumptorium.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Maggy's Bow: Does not provide additional healing when absorbing clots.
interactions.status: Documented statement, not a tested pairwise interaction. Nested bullets may depend on parent context; read the article section.

interactions.text: • Golden Trinket / Mom's Box: At base luck, having either increases the chance to 20% and having both to 33%.
